 *
 * Chạy kiểm tra write request nhưng chưa ghi thật.
 */
function kidlearnV3_safeWriteDryRunV3(request) {
  var safeRequest =
    kidlearnV3_writeNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  safeRequest.dryRun =
    true;

  return kidlearnV3_safeWriteV3(
    safeRequest
  );
}


/**
 * Central Safe Write API.
 *
 * UI DEV về sau chỉ nên gọi qua service/router, nhưng core ghi an toàn nằm ở đây.
 */
function kidlearnV3_safeWriteV3(request) {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var lock =
    LockService.getScriptLock();

  var locked =
    false;

  try {
    lock.waitLock(30000);
    locked = true;

    var safeRequest =
      kidlearnV3_writeNormalizeRequest_(
        request
      );

    var dryRun =
      safeRequest.dryRun !== false;

    var plan =
      kidlearnV3_writeBuildPlan_(
        safeRequest,
        dryRun
      );

    if (!plan.success) {
      return kidlearnV3_writeResponse_(
        false,
        'SAFE_WRITE_PLAN_FAILED',
        startedAt,
        {
          dryRun: dryRun,
          plan: plan
        },
        plan.errors.join(' | ')
      );
    }

    if (dryRun) {
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .setProperty(
          KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_KEYS.LAST_DRY_RUN_AT,
          new Date().toISOString()
        );

      return kidlearnV3_writeResponse_(
        true,
        'SAFE_WRITE_DRY_RUN_V3',
        startedAt,
        {
          dryRun: true,
          executed: false,
          plan: plan
        },
        ''
      );
    }

    var writeStatus =
      kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();

    if (
      writeStatus.mode !== KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_MODES.ENABLED ||
      writeStatus.enabled !== true
    ) {
      return kidlearnV3_writeResponse_(
        false,
        'SAFE_WRITE_BLOCKED',
        startedAt,
        {
          dryRun: false,
          executed: false,
          mode: writeStatus.mode,
          enabled: writeStatus.enabled,
          plan: plan
        },
        'Safe Write Layer chưa ENABLED. Không ghi thật.'
      );
    }

    var execution =
      kidlearnV3_writeExecutePlan_(
        plan
      );

    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .setProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_KEYS.LAST_WRITE_AT,
        new Date().toISOString()
      );

    return kidlearnV3_writeResponse_(
      execution.success,
      'SAFE_WRITE_EXECUTE_V3',
      startedAt,
      {
        dryRun: false,
        executed: execution.success,
        plan: plan,
        execution: execution
      },
      execution.success
        ? ''
        : execution.message
    );

  } catch (error) {
    return kidlearnV3_writeResponse_(
      false,
      'SAFE_WRITE_EXCEPTION_V3',
      startedAt,
      {
        dryRun: true,
        executed: false
      },
      String(
        error &&
        error.message
          ? error.message
          : error
      )
    );

  } finally {
    if (locked) {
      lock.releaseLock();
    }
  }
}


/**
 * Smoke test Safe Write Layer.
 *
 * Chỉ DRY_RUN, không ghi thật.
 */
function kidlearnV3_smokeTestSafeWriteLayerV3() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_writeGetSampleContext_();

  var childId =
    context.childId || 'TEST_CHILD_ID';

  var lessonId =
    context.lessonId || 'TEST_LESSON_ID';

  var assignmentId =
    context.assignmentId || '';

  var tests = [];

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_safeWriteDryRunV3({
      operation: 'AUDIT_LOG',
      payload: {
        eventType: 'SAFE_WRITE_SMOKE_TEST',
        message: 'Dry-run audit log for 3J.1',
        entityType: 'PHASE',
        entityId: '3J.1'
      }
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_safeWriteDryRunV3({
      operation: 'START_STUDY_SESSION',
      payload: {
        childId: childId,
        lessonId: lessonId,
        subjectId: context.subjectId || ''
      }
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_safeWriteDryRunV3({
      operation: 'UPSERT_LESSON_PROGRESS',
      payload: {
        childId: childId,
        lessonId: lessonId,
        subjectId: context.subjectId || '',
        status: 'IN_PROGRESS',
        progressPercent: 10
      }
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_safeWriteDryRunV3({
      operation: 'UPSERT_DAILY_GOAL',
      payload: {
        childId: childId,
        goalDate: kidlearnV3_writeToday_(),
        targetMinutes: 20,
        status: 'ACTIVE'
      }
    })
  );

  if (assignmentId) {
    tests.push(
      kidlearnV3_safeWriteDryRunV3({
        operation: 'UPDATE_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS',
        payload: {
          assignmentId: assignmentId,
          status: 'IN_PROGRESS',
          progressPercent: 5
        }
      })
    );
  }

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < tests.length; i++) {
    if (tests[i].success !== true) {
      errors.push(
        'Dry-run test #' +
        (i + 1) +
        ' failed: ' +
        (
          tests[i].error &&
          tests[i].error.message
            ? tests[i].error.message
            : 'Không rõ lỗi.'
        )
      );
    }
  }

  if (!assignmentId) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không có assignmentId mẫu nên bỏ qua dry-run UPDATE_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'SMOKE_TEST_SAFE_WRITE_LAYER_V3',
    phase: '3J.1',
    mode:
      kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3().mode,
    dryRunOnly: true,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    sampleContext: context,
    testCount: tests.length,
    tests: tests
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Smoke test Safe Write Layer V3 chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      errors.length
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Build write plan.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeBuildPlan_(
  request,
  dryRun
) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var operationCode =
    String(request.operation || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  var operation =
    KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_OPERATIONS[
      operationCode
    ];

  if (!operation) {
    errors.push(
      'Operation không được hỗ trợ: ' +
      operationCode
    );

    return kidlearnV3_writePlanResult_(
      false,
      operationCode,
      null,
      null,
      {},
      dryRun,
      errors,
      warnings
    );
  }

  var phase3I =
    kidlearnV3_writeSafePhase3IAssert_();

  if (!phase3I.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 3I chưa CLOSED_LOCKED: ' +
      phase3I.message
    );
  }

  var connection =
    kidlearnV3_writeSafeConnection_();

  if (
    connection.databaseMode !== 'V3' ||
    connection.connectionStatus !== 'CONNECTED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'App DEV chưa CONNECTED với Database V3.'
    );
  }

  var payload =
    request.payload || {};

  kidlearnV3_writeValidateRequiredPayload_(
    operation,
    payload,
    errors
  );

  var db =
    null;

  var sheet =
    null;

  var header =
    null;

  if (errors.length === 0) {
    db =
      kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_();

    sheet =
      kidlearnV3_writeGetSheet_(
        db,
        operation.sheetName
      );

    if (!sheet) {
      errors.push(
        'Không tìm thấy target sheet: ' +
        operation.sheetName
      );
    }
  }

  if (errors.length === 0) {
    header =
      kidlearnV3_writeGetHeader_(
        sheet
      );

    if (!header.primaryKey) {
      errors.push(
        'Target sheet thiếu technical key ở row 2: ' +
        operation.sheetName
      );
    }

    if (
      operation.writeType !== 'APPEND' &&
      kidlearnV3_writeGetColumnIndex_(
        header.keys,
        operation.keyField
      ) < 0
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'Target sheet thiếu keyField cho ' +
        operation.writeType +
        ': ' +
        operation.keyField
      );
    }
  }

  var object =
    {};

  if (errors.length === 0) {
    object =
      kidlearnV3_writeBuildObjectForOperation_(
        operation,
        payload,
        header
      );

    kidlearnV3_writeValidateObjectForHeader_(
      operation,
      object,
      header,
      errors,
      warnings
    );
  }

  return kidlearnV3_writePlanResult_(
    errors.length === 0,
    operationCode,
    operation,
    header,
    object,
    dryRun,
    errors,
    warnings
  );
}


/**
 * Execute write plan.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeExecutePlan_(
  plan
) {
  try {
    var db =
      kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_();

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_writeGetSheet_(
        db,
        plan.targetSheet
      );

    if (!sheet) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Không tìm thấy sheet khi execute: ' +
          plan.targetSheet
      };
    }

    var result =
      null;

    if (plan.writeType === 'APPEND') {
      result =
        kidlearnV3_writeAppendObject_(
          sheet,
          plan.object
        );
    }

    if (plan.writeType === 'UPDATE') {
      result =
        kidlearnV3_writeUpdateObject_(
          sheet,
          plan.keyField,
          plan.object
        );
    }

    if (plan.writeType === 'UPSERT') {
      result =
        kidlearnV3_writeUpsertObject_(
          sheet,
          plan.keyField,
          plan.object
        );
    }

    if (!result) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'writeType không được hỗ trợ khi execute: ' +
          plan.writeType
      };
    }

    var audit =
      kidlearnV3_writeTryAppendAudit_(
        db,
        plan,
        result
      );

    return {
      success: result.success,
      message:
        result.message || '',
      result: result,
      audit: audit
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        String(
          error &&
          error.message
            ? error.message
            : error
        )
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Append object vào sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeAppendObject_(
  sheet,
  object
) {
  var header =
    kidlearnV3_writeGetHeader_(
      sheet
    );

  var row =
    kidlearnV3_writeBuildRowValues_(
      header.keys,
      object
    );

  var nextRow =
    sheet.getLastRow() + 1;

  if (nextRow < 3) {
    nextRow = 3;
  }

  sheet
    .getRange(
      nextRow,
      1,
      1,
      row.length
    )
    .setValues([
      row
    ]);

  return {
    success: true,
    action: 'APPEND',
    sheetName: sheet.getName(),
    rowNumber: nextRow,
    keyField: header.primaryKey,
    keyValue:
      object[header.primaryKey] || ''
  };
}


/**
 * Update object theo key.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeUpdateObject_(
  sheet,
  keyField,
  object
) {
  var header =
    kidlearnV3_writeGetHeader_(
      sheet
    );

  var keyValue =
    String(object[keyField] || '').trim();

  if (!keyValue) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        'Thiếu keyValue cho update: ' +
        keyField
    };
  }

  var rowNumber =
    kidlearnV3_writeFindRowByKey_(
      sheet,
      header,
      keyField,
      keyValue
    );

  if (rowNumber < 0) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        'Không tìm thấy row để update. ' +
        keyField +
        '=' +
        keyValue
    };
  }

  var currentValues =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        rowNumber,
        1,
        1,
        header.keys.length
      )
      .getValues()[0];

  for (var i = 0; i < header.keys.length; i++) {
    var key =
      header.keys[i];

    if (
      object[key] !== undefined &&
      object[key] !== null
    ) {
      currentValues[i] =
        object[key];
    }
  }

  sheet
    .getRange(
      rowNumber,
      1,
      1,
      header.keys.length
    )
    .setValues([
      currentValues
    ]);

  return {
    success: true,
    action: 'UPDATE',
    sheetName: sheet.getName(),
    rowNumber: rowNumber,
    keyField: keyField,
    keyValue: keyValue
  };
}


/**
 * Upsert object theo key.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeUpsertObject_(
  sheet,
  keyField,
  object
) {
  var header =
    kidlearnV3_writeGetHeader_(
      sheet
    );

  var keyValue =
    String(object[keyField] || '').trim();

  if (!keyValue) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        'Thiếu keyValue cho upsert: ' +
        keyField
    };
  }

  var rowNumber =
    kidlearnV3_writeFindRowByKey_(
      sheet,
      header,
      keyField,
      keyValue
    );

  if (rowNumber < 0) {
    return kidlearnV3_writeAppendObject_(
      sheet,
      object
    );
  }

  return kidlearnV3_writeUpdateObject_(
    sheet,
    keyField,
    object
  );
}


/**
 * Build object theo operation.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeBuildObjectForOperation_(
  operation,
  payload,
  header
) {
  var now =
    new Date().toISOString();

  var userEmail =
    kidlearnV3_writeGetUserEmail_();

  if (operation.code === 'AUDIT_LOG') {
    return kidlearnV3_writeWithPrimary_(
      header,
      {
        auditId:
          payload.auditId ||
          kidlearnV3_writeMakeUniqueId_('AUD'),
        eventId:
          payload.eventId ||
          kidlearnV3_writeMakeUniqueId_('EVT'),
        eventType:
          payload.eventType || '',
        action:
          payload.action || payload.eventType || '',
        actorUserId:
          payload.actorUserId || '',
        actorEmail:
          userEmail,
        childId:
          payload.childId || '',
        entityType:
          payload.entityType || '',
        entityId:
          payload.entityId || '',
        message:
          payload.message || '',
        detailsJson:
          kidlearnV3_writeJson_(
            payload.details || payload.detailsJson || {}
          ),
        status:
          payload.status || 'INFO',
        createdAt:
          now,
        createdBy:
          userEmail
      },
      'AUD'
    );
  }

  if (operation.code === 'START_STUDY_SESSION') {
    return kidlearnV3_writeWithPrimary_(
      header,
      {
        studySessionId:
          payload.studySessionId ||
          kidlearnV3_writeMakeUniqueId_('SS'),
        sessionId:
          payload.sessionId ||
          payload.studySessionId ||
          kidlearnV3_writeMakeUniqueId_('SSN'),
        childId:
          payload.childId || '',
        subjectId:
          payload.subjectId || '',
        lessonId:
          payload.lessonId || '',
        activityId:
          payload.activityId || '',
        startedAt:
          payload.startedAt || now,
        endedAt:
          '',
        durationSeconds:
          Number(payload.durationSeconds || 0),
        status:
          payload.status || 'IN_PROGRESS',
        source:
          'UI_DEV',
        createdAt:
          now,
        createdBy:
          userEmail,
        updatedAt:
          now,
        updatedBy:
          userEmail
      },
      'SS'
    );
  }

  if (operation.code === 'FINISH_STUDY_SESSION') {
    return {
      studySessionId:
        payload.studySessionId || '',
      endedAt:
        payload.endedAt || now,
      durationSeconds:
        Number(payload.durationSeconds || 0),
      status:
        payload.status || 'COMPLETED',
      updatedAt:
        now,
      updatedBy:
        userEmail
    };
  }

  if (operation.code === 'UPSERT_LESSON_PROGRESS') {
    var lessonProgressId =
      payload.lessonProgressId ||
      kidlearnV3_writeMakeStableId_(
        'LP',
        [
          payload.childId,
          payload.lessonId
        ]
      );

    return kidlearnV3_writeWithPrimary_(
      header,
      {
        lessonProgressId:
          lessonProgressId,
        childId:
          payload.childId || '',
        subjectId:
          payload.subjectId || '',
        lessonId:
          payload.lessonId || '',
        status:
          payload.status || 'IN_PROGRESS',
        progressPercent:
          Number(payload.progressPercent || 0),
        startedAt:
          payload.startedAt || now,
        completedAt:
          payload.completedAt || '',
        lastAccessedAt:
          now,
        createdAt:
          payload.createdAt || now,
        createdBy:
          userEmail,
        updatedAt:
          now,
        updatedBy:
          userEmail
      },
      'LP'
    );
  }

  if (operation.code === 'UPDATE_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS') {
    return {
      assignmentId:
        payload.assignmentId || '',
      status:
        payload.status || 'IN_PROGRESS',
      progressPercent:
        Number(payload.progressPercent || 0),
      completedAt:
        payload.completedAt || '',
      updatedAt:
        now,
      updatedBy:
        userEmail
    };
  }

  if (operation.code === 'UPSERT_DAILY_GOAL') {
    var goalDate =
      payload.goalDate ||
      payload.date ||
      kidlearnV3_writeToday_();

    var dailyGoalId =
      payload.dailyGoalId ||
      kidlearnV3_writeMakeStableId_(
        'DG',
        [
          payload.childId,
          goalDate
        ]
      );

    return kidlearnV3_writeWithPrimary_(
      header,
      {
        dailyGoalId:
          dailyGoalId,
        childId:
          payload.childId || '',
        goalDate:
          goalDate,
        date:
          goalDate,
        targetMinutes:
          Number(payload.targetMinutes || 20),
        completedMinutes:
          Number(payload.completedMinutes || 0),
        status:
          payload.status || 'ACTIVE',
        createdAt:
          payload.createdAt || now,
        createdBy:
          userEmail,
        updatedAt:
          now,
        updatedBy:
          userEmail
      },
      'DG'
    );
  }

  return {};
}


/**
 * Set primary key nếu schema dùng tên khác ở cột đầu.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeWithPrimary_(
  header,
  object,
  prefix
) {
  if (
    header.primaryKey &&
    !object[header.primaryKey]
  ) {
    object[header.primaryKey] =
      kidlearnV3_writeMakeUniqueId_(
        prefix || 'ROW'
      );
  }

  return object;
}


/**
 * Try append audit sau write thật.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeTryAppendAudit_(
  db,
  plan,
  execution
) {
  if (plan.operation === 'AUDIT_LOG') {
    return {
      skipped: true,
      reason: 'Operation itself is AUDIT_LOG.'
    };
  }

  try {
    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_writeGetSheet_(
        db,
        'LOG_Audit'
      );

    if (!sheet) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'LOG_Audit không tồn tại.'
      };
    }

    var header =
      kidlearnV3_writeGetHeader_(
        sheet
      );

    var object =
      kidlearnV3_writeBuildObjectForOperation_(
        KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_OPERATIONS.AUDIT_LOG,
        {
          eventType: 'SAFE_WRITE_EXECUTED',
          action: plan.operation,
          entityType: plan.targetSheet,
          entityId: plan.keyValue || '',
          message:
            'Safe write executed: ' +
            plan.operation,
          details: {
            plan: kidlearnV3_writeCompactPlan_(plan),
            execution: execution
          },
          status: execution.success ? 'INFO' : 'ERROR'
        },
        header
      );

    return kidlearnV3_writeAppendObject_(
      sheet,
      object
    );

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        String(
          error &&
          error.message
            ? error.message
            : error
        )
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Validate required payload.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeValidateRequiredPayload_(
  operation,
  payload,
  errors
) {
  var required =
    operation.requiredPayload || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < required.length; i++) {
    var key =
      required[i];

    if (
      payload[key] === undefined ||
      payload[key] === null ||
      String(payload[key]).trim() === ''
    ) {
      errors.push(
        operation.code +
        ' thiếu payload.' +
        key
      );
    }
  }
}


/**
 * Validate object với header.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeValidateObjectForHeader_(
  operation,
  object,
  header,
  errors,
  warnings
) {
  if (!header || !header.keys || header.keys.length === 0) {
    errors.push(
      'Header technical keys trống.'
    );

    return;
  }

  var keyField =
    operation.keyField;

  if (
    operation.writeType !== 'APPEND' &&
    String(object[keyField] || '').trim() === ''
  ) {
    errors.push(
      operation.code +
      ' thiếu object keyField: ' +
      keyField
    );
  }

  var objectKeys =
    Object.keys(object);

  var mappedCount = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < objectKeys.length; i++) {
    if (
      kidlearnV3_writeGetColumnIndex_(
        header.keys,
        objectKeys[i]
      ) >= 0
    ) {
      mappedCount++;
    }
  }

  if (mappedCount === 0) {
    errors.push(
      'Không có field nào của object map được vào sheet: ' +
      operation.sheetName
    );
  }

  if (
    operation.writeType !== 'APPEND' &&
    kidlearnV3_writeGetColumnIndex_(
      header.keys,
      keyField
    ) < 0
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Header thiếu keyField: ' +
      keyField
    );
  }

  for (var k = 0; k < objectKeys.length; k++) {
    if (
      kidlearnV3_writeGetColumnIndex_(
        header.keys,
        objectKeys[k]
      ) < 0
    ) {
      warnings.push(
        'Field không có trong sheet và sẽ bị bỏ qua: ' +
        objectKeys[k]
      );
    }
  }
}


/**
 * Plan result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writePlanResult_(
  success,
  operationCode,
  operation,
  header,
  object,
  dryRun,
  errors,
  warnings
) {
  var keyField =
    operation
      ? operation.keyField
      : '';

  var keyValue =
    keyField && object
      ? object[keyField] || ''
      : '';

  return {
    success: success,
    operation: operationCode,
    dryRun: dryRun,
    targetSheet:
      operation
        ? operation.sheetName
        : '',
    writeType:
      operation
        ? operation.writeType
        : '',
    keyField:
      keyField,
    keyValue:
      keyValue,
    object:
      object || {},
    mappedFields:
      header
        ? kidlearnV3_writeGetMappedFields_(
            header.keys,
            object || {}
          )
        : [],
    header:
      header
        ? {
            primaryKey: header.primaryKey,
            keyCount: header.keys.length
          }
        : null,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      warnings.length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Response helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeResponse_(
  success,
  action,
  startedAt,
  data,
  errorMessage
) {
  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  var result = {
    success: success,
    action: action,
    phase: '3J.1',
    schemaVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
    appVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.APP_VERSION,
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    data:
      data || {}
  };

  if (!success) {
    result.error = {
      code: action,
      message: errorMessage || 'Safe write failed.'
    };
  }

  kidlearnV3_writeSaveStatus_(
    result
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Check target sheets.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeCheckTargetSheets_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var items = [];

  var db = null;

  try {
    db =
      kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được Database V3: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );

    return {
      errorCount: errors.length,
      warningCount: warnings.length,
      errors: errors,
      warnings: warnings,
      items: items
    };
  }

  var codes =
    kidlearnV3_writeGetAllowedOperationCodes_();

  var seen = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < codes.length; i++) {
    var operation =
      KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_OPERATIONS[
        codes[i]
      ];

    if (seen[operation.sheetName]) {
      continue;
    }

    seen[operation.sheetName] =
      true;

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_writeGetSheet_(
        db,
        operation.sheetName
      );

    if (!sheet) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu target sheet: ' +
        operation.sheetName
      );

      items.push({
        sheetName: operation.sheetName,
        exists: false
      });

      continue;
    }

    var header =
      kidlearnV3_writeGetHeader_(
        sheet
      );

    items.push({
      sheetName:
        operation.sheetName,
      exists:
        true,
      primaryKey:
        header.primaryKey,
      keyCount:
        header.keys.length
    });

    if (!header.primaryKey) {
      errors.push(
        'Sheet thiếu technical key row 2: ' +
        operation.sheetName
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Get active sheet by exact name.
 *
 * Hàm này nhận được cả:
 * - Spreadsheet object trực tiếp
 * - wrapper object từ kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_
 * - object có spreadsheetId
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeGetSheet_(
  databaseOrSpreadsheet,
  sheetName
) {
  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_writeResolveSpreadsheet_(
      databaseOrSpreadsheet
    );

  if (!spreadsheet) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không resolve được Spreadsheet object khi tìm sheet: ' +
      sheetName
    );
  }

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Resolve database wrapper thành Spreadsheet object thật.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeResolveSpreadsheet_(
  value
) {
  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (
    typeof value.getSheets === 'function' &&
    typeof value.getId === 'function'
  ) {
    return value;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheet &&
    typeof value.spreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheet;
  }

  if (
    value.database &&
    typeof value.database.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.database;
  }

  if (
    value.db &&
    typeof value.db.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.db;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheetObject &&
    typeof value.spreadsheetObject.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheetObject;
  }

  if (
    value.activeSpreadsheet &&
    typeof value.activeSpreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.activeSpreadsheet;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheetId
  ) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.spreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (
    value.databaseSpreadsheetId
  ) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.databaseSpreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (
    value.id &&
    typeof value.id === 'string'
  ) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.id
    );
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Get header technical keys.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeGetHeader_(
  sheet
) {
  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastColumn < 1) {
    return {
      keys: [],
      primaryKey: ''
    };
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        2,
        1,
        1,
        lastColumn
      )
      .getDisplayValues()[0];

  var keys = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    keys.push(
      String(values[i] || '').trim()
    );
  }

  return {
    keys: keys,
    primaryKey:
      kidlearnV3_writeFirstNonBlank_(
        keys
      )
  };
}


/**
 * Build row values.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeBuildRowValues_(
  keys,
  object
) {
  var row = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var key =
      keys[i];

    row.push(
      key && object[key] !== undefined
        ? object[key]
        : ''
    );
  }

  return row;
}


/**
 * Find row by key.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeFindRowByKey_(
  sheet,
  header,
  keyField,
  keyValue
) {
  var columnIndex =
    kidlearnV3_writeGetColumnIndex_(
      header.keys,
      keyField
    );

  if (columnIndex < 0) {
    return -1;
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < 3) {
    return -1;
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        3,
        columnIndex + 1,
        lastRow - 2,
        1
      )
      .getDisplayValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    if (
      String(values[i][0] || '').trim() ===
      String(keyValue || '').trim()
    ) {
      return i + 3;
    }
  }

  return -1;
}


/**
 * Get column index.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeGetColumnIndex_(
  keys,
  key
) {
  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    if (keys[i] === key) {
      return i;
    }
  }

  return -1;
}


/**
 * Get mapped fields.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeGetMappedFields_(
  keys,
  object
) {
  var result = [];
  var objectKeys =
    Object.keys(object || {});

  for (var i = 0; i < objectKeys.length; i++) {
    if (
      kidlearnV3_writeGetColumnIndex_(
        keys,
        objectKeys[i]
      ) >= 0
    ) {
      result.push(
        objectKeys[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Sample context for smoke dry-run.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeGetSampleContext_() {
  var context = {
    childId: '',
    subjectId: '',
    lessonId: '',
    assignmentId: ''
  };

  try {
    var bootstrap =
      kidlearnV3_serviceGetBootstrapV3({});

    if (
      bootstrap.success &&
      bootstrap.data
    ) {
      var child =
        bootstrap.data.selectedChild ||
        (
          bootstrap.data.children &&
          bootstrap.data.children.length
            ? bootstrap.data.children[0]
            : null
        );

      if (child) {
        context.childId =
          child.childId || '';
      }

      var subject =
        bootstrap.data.subjects &&
        bootstrap.data.subjects.length
          ? bootstrap.data.subjects[0]
          : null;

      if (subject) {
        context.subjectId =
          subject.subjectId || '';
      }

      var assignment =
        bootstrap.data.assignments &&
        bootstrap.data.assignments.length
          ? bootstrap.data.assignments[0]
          : null;

      if (assignment) {
        context.assignmentId =
          assignment.assignmentId || '';
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    context.error =
      String(error.message || error);
  }

  context.lessonId =
    context.lessonId ||
    'DRY_RUN_LESSON_ID';

  return context;
}


/**
 * Require function helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRequireFunction_(
  functionName,
  errors
) {
  var exists = false;

  try {
    exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );
  } catch (error) {
    exists = false;
  }

  if (!exists) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu function: ' +
      functionName
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Safe Phase 3I assert.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeSafePhase3IAssert_() {
  try {
    var result =
      kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3();

    return {
      success: result.success === true,
      message: ''
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        String(
          error &&
          error.message
            ? error.message
            : error
        )
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe connection.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeSafeConnection_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getAppDevConnectionV3Status();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      databaseMode: '',
      connectionStatus: '',
      spreadsheetId: '',
      spreadsheetName: '',
      error:
        String(
          error &&
          error.message
            ? error.message
            : error
        )
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Normalize write request.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeNormalizeRequest_(
  request
) {
  if (!request) {
    return {
      operation: '',
      payload: {},
      dryRun: true
    };
  }

  if (
    typeof request !== 'object'
  ) {
    return {
      operation:
        String(request || ''),
      payload: {},
      dryRun: true
    };
  }

  return {
    operation:
      request.operation || '',
    payload:
      request.payload || {},
    dryRun:
      request.dryRun !== false
  };
}


/**
 * Allowed operation codes.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeGetAllowedOperationCodes_() {
  return Object.keys(
    KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_OPERATIONS
  );
}


/**
 * Save compact status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeSaveStatus_(
  result
) {
  try {
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .setProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_KEYS.LAST_STATUS_JSON,
        JSON.stringify({
          success: result.success,
          action: result.action,
          phase: result.phase || '3J.1',
          at: new Date().toISOString()
        })
      );
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn(
      'Không lưu được Safe Write status: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }
}


/**
 * First non blank.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeFirstNonBlank_(
  values
) {
  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    if (String(values[i] || '').trim()) {
      return String(values[i]).trim();
    }
  }

  return '';
}


/**
 * Compact plan for audit.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeCompactPlan_(
  plan
) {
  return {
    operation:
      plan.operation,
    targetSheet:
      plan.targetSheet,
    writeType:
      plan.writeType,
    keyField:
      plan.keyField,
    keyValue:
      plan.keyValue,
    mappedFields:
      plan.mappedFields
  };
}


/**
 * JSON stringify safe.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeJson_(
  value
) {
  if (
    value === undefined ||
    value === null ||
    value === ''
  ) {
    return '{}';
  }

  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    return value;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.stringify(value);
  } catch (error) {
    return JSON.stringify({
      value: String(value)
    });
  }
}


/**
 * Unique ID.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeMakeUniqueId_(
  prefix
) {
  var time =
    Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS'
    );

  var random =
    Math.floor(
      Math.random() * 100000
    );

  return (
    String(prefix || 'ID') +
    '_' +
    time +
    '_' +
    random
  );
}


/**
 * Stable ID.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeMakeStableId_(
  prefix,
  parts
) {
  var text =
    [];

  for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
    text.push(
      String(parts[i] || '')
        .trim()
        .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_')
    );
  }

  return (
    String(prefix || 'ID') +
    '_' +
    text.join('_')
  ).substring(0, 120);
}


/**
 * Today yyyy-MM-dd.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeToday_() {
  return Utilities.formatDate(
    new Date(),
    Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
    'yyyy-MM-dd'
  );
}


/**
 * Current user email.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeGetUserEmail_() {
  try {
    return Session.getActiveUser().getEmail() || '';
  } catch (error) {
    return '';
  }
}


/**
 * Debug database object dùng cho Safe Write Layer.
 */
function kidlearnV3_debugSafeWriteDatabaseObjectV3() {
  var database =
    kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_();

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_writeResolveSpreadsheet_(
      database
    );

  var result = {
    success:
      !!spreadsheet,
    action:
      'DEBUG_SAFE_WRITE_DATABASE_OBJECT_V3',
    databaseType:
      typeof database,
    databaseKeys:
      database && typeof database === 'object'
        ? Object.keys(database)
        : [],
    resolvedSpreadsheet:
      spreadsheet
        ? {
            id: spreadsheet.getId(),
            name: spreadsheet.getName(),
            sheetCount: spreadsheet.getSheets().length
          }
        : null
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - APP SERVICE FACADE
 * Step: 3I.3
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * File này tạo lớp service trung gian cho UI DEV.
 *
 * UI DEV chỉ nên gọi các hàm service trong file này.
 *
 * KHÔNG sửa PROD.
 * KHÔNG ghi dữ liệu học tập.
 * KHÔNG xóa dữ liệu.
 * KHÔNG migration dữ liệu.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_SERVICE_CONFIG = {
  VERSION: '3I.3',
  RESPONSE_VERSION: '1.0',
  DEFAULT_LIMIT: 500,
  MAX_LIMIT: 5000
};


/**
 * Preview Service Facade V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewAppServiceFacadeV3() {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_serviceInvoke_(
      'PREVIEW_APP_SERVICE_FACADE_V3',
      function() {
        return {
          serviceVersion:
            KIDLEARN_V3_SERVICE_CONFIG.VERSION,

          responseVersion:
            KIDLEARN_V3_SERVICE_CONFIG.RESPONSE_VERSION,

          databaseMode:
            kidlearnV3_serviceGetProperty_(
              'KIDLEARN_APP_DATABASE_MODE'
            ),

          connectionStatus:
            kidlearnV3_serviceGetProperty_(
              'KIDLEARN_APP_CONNECTION_STATUS'
            ),

          schemaVersion:
            kidlearnV3_serviceGetProperty_(
              'KIDLEARN_APP_SCHEMA_VERSION'
            ),

          availableUiFunctions: [
            'kidlearnV3_servicePingV3',
            'kidlearnV3_serviceGetBootstrapV3',
            'kidlearnV3_serviceGetDashboardV3',
            'kidlearnV3_serviceGetSubjectsV3',
            'kidlearnV3_serviceGetChildrenV3',
            'kidlearnV3_serviceGetAssignmentsV3',
            'kidlearnV3_serviceGetFamilyContextV3',
            'kidlearnV3_serviceGetConfigV3',
            'kidlearnV3_serviceReadCoreV3'
          ]
        };
      },
      {}
    );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Smoke test Service Facade V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_smokeTestAppServiceFacadeV3() {
  var ping =
    kidlearnV3_servicePingV3();

  var bootstrap =
    kidlearnV3_serviceGetBootstrapV3({});

  var dashboard =
    kidlearnV3_serviceGetDashboardV3({});

  var subjects =
    kidlearnV3_serviceGetSubjectsV3({});

  var children =
    kidlearnV3_serviceGetChildrenV3({});

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  if (!ping.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Ping service thất bại.'
    );
  }

  if (!bootstrap.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Bootstrap service thất bại.'
    );
  }

  if (!dashboard.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Dashboard service thất bại.'
    );
  }

  if (!subjects.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Subjects service thất bại.'
    );
  }

  if (!children.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Children service thất bại.'
    );
  }

  if (
    subjects.success &&
    subjects.data.count < 4
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Subjects service phải đọc được ít nhất 4 môn học.'
    );
  }

  if (
    children.success &&
    children.data.count < 1
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Children service chưa đọc được dữ liệu trẻ em.'
    );
  }

  if (
    bootstrap.success &&
    bootstrap.data.counts.assignments < 1
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'Bootstrap chưa có assignments hoặc dữ liệu assignments đang trống.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,

    action:
      'SMOKE_TEST_APP_SERVICE_FACADE_V3',

    errorCount:
      errors.length,

    warningCount:
      warnings.length,

    errors:
      errors,

    warnings:
      warnings,

    checks: {
      ping:
        ping.success,
      bootstrap:
        bootstrap.success,
      dashboard:
        dashboard.success,
      subjects:
        subjects.success,
      children:
        children.success
    },

    counts: {
      subjects:
        subjects.success
          ? subjects.data.count
          : 0,
      children:
        children.success
          ? children.data.count
          : 0,
      bootstrapAssignments:
        bootstrap.success
          ? bootstrap.data.counts.assignments
          : 0
    }
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Smoke test App Service Facade V3 chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      errors.length
    );
  }

  return result;
}

      var childId =
        String(req.childId || '').trim();

      var rows =

        );

      var limit =

      rows =

        childId: childId,

/**
 * UI gọi đọc các core sheet an toàn.
 * Không expose raw credential.
 */
function kidlearnV3_serviceReadCoreV3(request) {
  return kidlearnV3_serviceInvoke_(
    'READ_CORE_V3',
    function(req) {
      var sheetName =
        String(req.sheetName || '').trim();

      if (sheetName === 'MST_Subjects') {
        var subjects =
          kidlearnV3_adapterGetSubjectsV3();

        return {
          sheetName: sheetName,
          count: subjects.length,
          rows: subjects
        };
      }

      if (sheetName === 'DATA_Users') {
        var users =
          kidlearnV3_adapterGetUsersV3();

        return {
          sheetName: sheetName,
          count: users.length,
          rows: users
        };
      }

      if (sheetName === 'DATA_Children') {
        var children =
          kidlearnV3_adapterGetChildrenV3();

        return {
          sheetName: sheetName,
          count: children.length,
          rows: children
        };
      }

      if (sheetName === 'DATA_UserChildAccess') {
        var access =
          kidlearnV3_adapterGetUserChildAccessV3();

        return {
          sheetName: sheetName,
          count: access.length,
          rows: access
        };
      }

      if (sheetName === 'DATA_Assignments') {
        var assignments =
          kidlearnV3_adapterGetAssignmentsForChildV3(
            req.childId || ''
          );

        return {
          sheetName: sheetName,
          count: assignments.length,
          rows:
            kidlearnV3_serviceTake_(
              assignments,
              kidlearnV3_serviceLimit_(req.limit)
            )
        };
      }

      if (sheetName === 'SYS_Config') {
        var config =
          kidlearnV3_adapterGetConfigMapV3();

        return {
          sheetName: sheetName,
          count:
            Object.keys(config).length,
          config: config
        };
      }

      throw new Error(
        'Sheet không được phép đọc qua serviceReadCoreV3: ' +
        sheetName
      );
    },
    request
  );
}


/**
 * Core wrapper cho tất cả service public.
 */
function kidlearnV3_serviceInvoke_(
  serviceName,
  handler,
  request
) {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var requestId =
    kidlearnV3_serviceRequestId_(
      serviceName,
      startedAt
    );

  var safeRequest =
    kidlearnV3_serviceNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  try {
    kidlearnV3_serviceAssertReady_();

    var data =
      handler(safeRequest);

    var result =
      kidlearnV3_serviceSuccess_(
        serviceName,
        requestId,
        startedAt,
        data
      );

    return result;

  } catch (error) {
    return kidlearnV3_serviceFailure_(
      serviceName,
      requestId,
      startedAt,
      error
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra các thành phần bắt buộc trước khi service chạy.
 */
function kidlearnV3_serviceAssertReady_() {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_adapterGetBootstrapPayloadV3 !== 'function'
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu 3I.2: kidlearnV3_adapterGetBootstrapPayloadV3 chưa tồn tại.'
    );
  }

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_ !== 'function'
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu 3I.1: kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_ chưa tồn tại.'
    );
  }

  var mode =
    kidlearnV3_serviceGetProperty_(
      'KIDLEARN_APP_DATABASE_MODE'
    );

  var status =
    kidlearnV3_serviceGetProperty_(
      'KIDLEARN_APP_CONNECTION_STATUS'
    );

  if (mode !== 'V3') {
    throw new Error(
      'App DEV chưa bật databaseMode V3. Hiện tại: ' +
      mode
    );
  }

  if (status !== 'CONNECTED') {
    throw new Error(
      'App DEV chưa CONNECTED với Database V3. Hiện tại: ' +
      status
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Build response success.
 */
function kidlearnV3_serviceSuccess_(
  serviceName,
  requestId,
  startedAt,
  data
) {
  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  return {
    success: true,
    serviceName: serviceName,
    requestId: requestId,
    responseVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SERVICE_CONFIG.RESPONSE_VERSION,
    schemaVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
    appVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.APP_VERSION,
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    data:
      kidlearnV3_serviceCloneSafe_(
        data
      )
  };
}


/**
 * Build response failure.
 */
function kidlearnV3_serviceFailure_(
  serviceName,
  requestId,
  startedAt,
  error
) {
  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  var message =
    String(
      error &&
      error.message
        ? error.message
        : error
    );

  var result = {
    success: false,
    serviceName: serviceName,
    requestId: requestId,
    responseVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SERVICE_CONFIG.RESPONSE_VERSION,
    schemaVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
    appVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.APP_VERSION,
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    error: {
      code:
        'SERVICE_ERROR',
      message:
        message
    }
  };

  console.error(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Normalize request từ UI.
 */
function kidlearnV3_serviceNormalizeRequest_(
  request
) {
  if (!request) {
    return {};
  }

  if (
    typeof request !== 'object'
  ) {
    return {
      value: request
    };
  }

  return request;
}


/**
 * Clone dữ liệu an toàn để trả cho UI.
 */
function kidlearnV3_serviceCloneSafe_(
  value
) {
  if (
    value === undefined ||
    value === null
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(
      JSON.stringify(value)
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      value:
        String(value)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Sinh requestId.
 */
function kidlearnV3_serviceRequestId_(
  serviceName,
  dateValue
) {
  var text =
    Utilities.formatDate(
      dateValue,
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    );

  var random =
    Math.floor(
      Math.random() * 100000
    );

  return (
    'REQ_' +
    serviceName +
    '_' +
    text +
    '_' +
    random
  );
}


/**
 * Lấy ScriptProperty.
 */
function kidlearnV3_serviceGetProperty_(
  key
) {
  return (
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key) ||
    ''
  );
}


/**
 * Chuẩn hóa limit.
 */
function kidlearnV3_serviceLimit_(
  value
) {
  var limit =
    Number(value || KIDLEARN_V3_SERVICE_CONFIG.DEFAULT_LIMIT);

  if (
    isNaN(limit) ||
    limit < 1
  ) {
    limit =
      KIDLEARN_V3_SERVICE_CONFIG.DEFAULT_LIMIT;
  }

  if (
    limit > KIDLEARN_V3_SERVICE_CONFIG.MAX_LIMIT
  ) {
    limit =
      KIDLEARN_V3_SERVICE_CONFIG.MAX_LIMIT;
  }

  return limit;
}


/**
 * Take N items.
 */
function kidlearnV3_serviceTake_(
  rows,
  limit
) {
  var result = [];

  var max =
    Math.min(
      rows.length,
      limit
    );

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < max;
    i++
  ) {
    result.push(
      rows[i]
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - UI BRIDGE TO SERVICE FACADE
 * Step: 3I.4
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * File này tạo cầu nối UI DEV với App Service Facade V3.

 * KHÔNG ghi dữ liệu học tập.
 */


/**
 * Preview UI Bridge V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewUiServiceBridgeV3() {
  var requiredServerFunctions = [
    'kidlearnV3_servicePingV3',
    'kidlearnV3_serviceGetBootstrapV3',
    'kidlearnV3_serviceGetDashboardV3',
    'kidlearnV3_serviceGetSubjectsV3',
    'kidlearnV3_serviceGetChildrenV3',
    'kidlearnV3_serviceGetAssignmentsV3',
    'kidlearnV3_serviceGetConfigV3'
  ];

  var requiredHtmlFiles = [
    'UI_Service_Client_V3',
    'UI_Dev_Shell_V3'
  ];

  var functionChecks = [];
  var htmlChecks = [];
  var errors = [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < requiredServerFunctions.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var check =
      kidlearnV3_uiCheckFunction_(
        requiredServerFunctions[i]
      );

    functionChecks.push(check);

    if (!check.exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu server function: ' +
        check.name
      );
    }
  }

  for (
    var h = 0;
    h < requiredHtmlFiles.length;
    h++
  ) {
    var htmlCheck =
      kidlearnV3_uiCheckHtmlFile_(
        requiredHtmlFiles[h]
      );

    htmlChecks.push(htmlCheck);

    if (!htmlCheck.exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu HTML file: ' +
        htmlCheck.name
      );
    }
  }

  var connection =
    kidlearnV3_getAppDevConnectionV3Status();

  if (
    connection.databaseMode !== 'V3' ||
    connection.connectionStatus !== 'CONNECTED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'App DEV chưa CONNECTED với Database V3.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_UI_SERVICE_BRIDGE_V3',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    connection: connection,
    functionChecks: functionChecks,
    htmlChecks: htmlChecks
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Mở UI DEV Shell trong modal dialog.
 *
 * Chạy hàm này từ Apps Script để test UI.
 */
function kidlearnV3_showUiDevShellV3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewUiServiceBridgeV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'UI Bridge V3 chưa sẵn sàng. Errors: ' +
      preview.errorCount +
      '. Xem Execution log.'
    );
  }

  var html =
    HtmlService
      .createTemplateFromFile(
        'UI_Dev_Shell_V3'
      )
      .evaluate()
      .setTitle(
        'KIDLEARN V3 - DEV Shell'
      )
      .setWidth(1200)
      .setHeight(800);

  SpreadsheetApp
    .getUi()
    .showModalDialog(
      html,
      'KIDLEARN V3 - DEV Shell'
    );
}


/**
 * Trả về HTML DEV Shell.
 *
 * Dùng cho bước sau nếu cần gắn vào doGet DEV.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getUiDevShellHtmlV3() {
  return HtmlService
    .createTemplateFromFile(
      'UI_Dev_Shell_V3'
    )
    .evaluate()
    .setTitle(
      'KIDLEARN V3 - DEV Shell'
    )
    .setXFrameOptionsMode(

    );

/**
 * Smoke test server-side cho UI Bridge.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiDevShellSmokeTestV3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewUiServiceBridgeV3();

  var ping =
    kidlearnV3_servicePingV3({});

  var bootstrap =
    kidlearnV3_serviceGetBootstrapV3({});

  var subjects =
    kidlearnV3_serviceGetSubjectsV3({});

  var children =
    kidlearnV3_serviceGetChildrenV3({});

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  if (!preview.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Preview UI Bridge chưa đạt.'
    );
  }

  if (!ping.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Service ping thất bại.'
    );
  }

  if (!bootstrap.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Service bootstrap thất bại.'
    );
  }

  if (!subjects.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Service subjects thất bại.'
    );
  }

  if (!children.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Service children thất bại.'
    );
  }

  if (
    subjects.success &&
    subjects.data.count < 4
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Subjects phải có ít nhất 4 môn học.'
    );
  }

  if (
    children.success &&
    children.data.count < 1
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Children chưa có dữ liệu.'
    );
  }

  if (
    bootstrap.success &&
    bootstrap.data.counts.assignments < 1
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'Assignments đang trống hoặc chưa có bài gắn với child hiện tại.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'SMOKE_TEST_UI_DEV_SHELL_V3',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    checks: {
      preview: preview.success,
      ping: ping.success,
      bootstrap: bootstrap.success,
      subjects: subjects.success,
      children: children.success
    },
    counts: {
      subjects:
        subjects.success
          ? subjects.data.count
          : 0,
      children:
        children.success
          ? children.data.count
          : 0,
      assignments:
        bootstrap.success
          ? bootstrap.data.counts.assignments
          : 0
    }
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'UI DEV Shell smoke test chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      errors.length
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Include HTML partial.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiInclude_(
  filename
) {
  return HtmlService
    .createHtmlOutputFromFile(
      filename
    )
    .getContent();
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra function có tồn tại.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiCheckFunction_(
  functionName
) {
  var exists = false;

  try {
    exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );
  } catch (error) {
    exists = false;
  }

  return {
    name: functionName,
    exists: exists
  };
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra HTML file có tồn tại.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiCheckHtmlFile_(
  filename
) {
  try {
    var content =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile(
          filename
        )
        .getContent();

    return {
      name: filename,
      exists: true,
      length: content.length
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      name: filename,
      exists: false,
      error: String(
        error.message || error
      )
    };
  }
}

 * Mở UI Legacy DEV đã gắn DEV_SWITCH V3.

      )
      .setWidth(1200)
      .setHeight(850);

  SpreadsheetApp
    .getUi()
    .showModalDialog(
      html,
      'KIDLEARN Legacy DEV + V3 Switch'
    );
}

var KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_KEYS = {
  MODE: 'KIDLEARN_UI_DEV_SWITCH_MODE',
  ENABLED_AT: 'KIDLEARN_UI_DEV_SWITCH_ENABLED_AT',
  DISABLED_AT: 'KIDLEARN_UI_DEV_SWITCH_DISABLED_AT',
  LAST_SMOKE_TEST_AT: 'KIDLEARN_UI_DEV_SWITCH_LAST_SMOKE_TEST_AT'
};

var KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_MODES = {
  LEGACY: 'LEGACY',
  V3: 'V3'
};


/**
 * Preview DEV_SWITCH V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewUiDevSwitchV3() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var mode =
    kidlearnV3_uiSwitchGetModeV3();

  var checks =
    kidlearnV3_uiSwitchCheckDependencies_();

  var result = {
    success: checks.errorCount === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_UI_DEV_SWITCH_V3',
    mode: mode,
    errorCount: checks.errorCount,
    warningCount: checks.warningCount,
    errors: checks.errors,
    warnings: checks.warnings,
    properties: {
      mode:
        properties.getProperty(
          KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_KEYS.MODE
        ),
      enabledAt:
        properties.getProperty(
          KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_KEYS.ENABLED_AT
        ),
      disabledAt:
        properties.getProperty(
          KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_KEYS.DISABLED_AT
        ),
      lastSmokeTestAt:
        properties.getProperty(
          KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_KEYS.LAST_SMOKE_TEST_AT
        )
    }
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Bật UI DEV Switch sang V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_enableUiDevSwitchV3() {
  var checks =
    kidlearnV3_uiSwitchCheckDependencies_();

  if (checks.errorCount > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể bật DEV_SWITCH V3. Errors: ' +
      checks.errorCount +
      '. Xem Execution log.'
    );
  }

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_KEYS.MODE,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_MODES.V3
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_KEYS.ENABLED_AT,
    new Date().toISOString()
  );

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'ENABLE_UI_DEV_SWITCH_V3',
    mode: KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_MODES.V3,
    message: 'UI DEV Switch đã bật sang V3.'
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Tắt UI DEV Switch, quay lại LEGACY.
 */
function kidlearnV3_disableUiDevSwitchV3() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_KEYS.MODE,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_MODES.LEGACY
  );

  properties.setProperty(

    new Date().toISOString()
  );

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'DISABLE_UI_DEV_SWITCH_V3',
    mode: KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_MODES.LEGACY,

  console.log(

  );

}


/**

function kidlearnV3_uiSwitchGetModeV3() {
  var mode =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_KEYS.MODE
      );

  if (mode === KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_MODES.V3) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_MODES.V3;
  }

}


/**

      'SUBJECTS qua DEV_SWITCH thất bại.'
    );
  }

  if (!children.success) {
    errors.push(
      'CHILDREN qua DEV_SWITCH thất bại.'
    );
  }

  if (

    subjects.data &&

  ) {

  ) {

    }

    );
  }

  return result;

/**
 * Public dispatcher cho UI cũ DEV gọi.
 *
 * UI chỉ cần gọi 1 hàm này:
 * kidlearnV3_uiApiDispatchV3({ action: 'BOOTSTRAP', payload: {} })
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiApiDispatchV3(request) {
  var safeRequest =
    kidlearnV3_uiSwitchNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  var action =
    String(safeRequest.action || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  var payload =
    safeRequest.payload || {};

  var mode =
    kidlearnV3_uiSwitchGetModeV3();

  if (mode !== KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SWITCH_MODES.V3) {
    return {
      success: false,
      serviceName: 'UI_DEV_SWITCH',
      error: {
        code: 'DEV_SWITCH_NOT_V3',
        message:
          'UI DEV Switch chưa bật V3. Mode hiện tại: ' +
          mode
      }
    };
  }

  if (action === 'PING') {
    return kidlearnV3_servicePingV3(
      payload
    );
  }

  if (action === 'BOOTSTRAP') {
    return kidlearnV3_serviceGetBootstrapV3(
      payload
    );
  }

  if (action === 'DASHBOARD') {
    return kidlearnV3_serviceGetDashboardV3(
      payload
    );
  }

  if (action === 'SUBJECTS') {
    return kidlearnV3_serviceGetSubjectsV3(
      payload
    );
  }

  if (action === 'CHILDREN') {
    return kidlearnV3_serviceGetChildrenV3(
      payload
    );
  }

  if (action === 'ASSIGNMENTS') {
    return kidlearnV3_serviceGetAssignmentsV3(
      payload
    );
  }

  if (action === 'FAMILY_CONTEXT') {
    return kidlearnV3_serviceGetFamilyContextV3(
      payload
    );
  }

  if (action === 'CONFIG') {
    return kidlearnV3_serviceGetConfigV3(
      payload
    );
  }

  if (action === 'READ_CORE') {
    return kidlearnV3_serviceReadCoreV3(
      payload
    );
  }

  return {
    success: false,

/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_uiSwitchCheckDependencies_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  kidlearnV3_uiSwitchRequireFunction_(
    'kidlearnV3_servicePingV3',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiSwitchRequireFunction_(
    'kidlearnV3_serviceGetBootstrapV3',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiSwitchRequireFunction_(
    'kidlearnV3_serviceGetDashboardV3',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiSwitchRequireFunction_(
    'kidlearnV3_serviceGetSubjectsV3',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiSwitchRequireFunction_(
    'kidlearnV3_serviceGetChildrenV3',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiSwitchRequireFunction_(
    'kidlearnV3_serviceGetAssignmentsV3',
    errors
  );

  var connection =
    kidlearnV3_getAppDevConnectionV3Status();

  if (
    connection.databaseMode !== 'V3' ||
    connection.connectionStatus !== 'CONNECTED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'App DEV chưa CONNECTED với Database V3.'
    );
  }

  var servicePreview =
    kidlearnV3_previewAppServiceFacadeV3();

  if (!servicePreview.success) {
    errors.push(
      'App Service Facade V3 chưa sẵn sàng.'
    );
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra function có tồn tại.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiSwitchRequireFunction_(
  functionName,
  errors
) {
  var exists = false;

  try {
    exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );
  } catch (error) {
    exists = false;
  }

  if (!exists) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu function: ' +
      functionName
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Normalize request.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiSwitchNormalizeRequest_(
  request
) {
  if (!request) {
    return {
      action: '',
      payload: {}
    };
  }

  if (
    typeof request === 'string'
  ) {
    return {
      action: request,
      payload: {}
    };
  }

  if (
    typeof request !== 'object'
  ) {
    return {
      action: '',
      payload: {
        value: request
      }
    };
  }

  return {
    action: request.action || '',
    payload: request.payload || {}
  };
}

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions = [
    'kidlearnV3_previewWriteRouterV3',
    'kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetSampleContextV3',
    'kidlearnV3_writeRouterDispatchV3',

    'UI_Write_Router_Client_V3',

    );

  errors =

    );

  errors =
    errors.concat(

    );

  };

        'Không chạy được kidlearnV3_previewWriteRouterV3: ' +
        String(error.message || error)
      );
    }
  }

  var result = {

    },

  };

  );

/**
 * Smoke test server-side cho UI Learning Write DEV.
 *
 * Chỉ DRY_RUN.
 */
function kidlearnV3_smokeTestLearningWriteDryRunUiV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetStatusV3({});

  var sample =
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetSampleContextV3({});

  var context =
    sample.success && sample.data
      ? sample.data.sampleContext || {}
      : {};

  var childId =
    context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID';

  var subjectId =
    context.subjectId || '';

  var lessonId =
    context.lessonId || 'DRY_RUN_LESSON_ID';

  var studySessionId =
    'DRY_RUN_SESSION_' +
    Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMddHHmmss'
    );

  var tests = [];

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterAuditEventV3({
      payload: {
        eventType: 'LEARNING_UI_SMOKE_TEST',
        message: 'Dry-run audit from Learning Write UI 3J.4',
        entityType: 'PHASE',
        entityId: '3J.4',
        childId: childId
      },
      dryRun: true
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterStudyStartV3({
      payload: {
        studySessionId: studySessionId,
        childId: childId,
        subjectId: subjectId,
        lessonId: lessonId
      },
      dryRun: true
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterLessonProgressSaveV3({
      payload: {
        childId: childId,
        subjectId: subjectId,
        lessonId: lessonId,
        progressPercent: 25
      },
      dryRun: true
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterDailyGoalSaveV3({
      payload: {
        childId: childId,
        goalDate: kidlearnV3_learningWriteToday_(),
        targetMinutes: 20,
        completedMinutes: 5
      },
      dryRun: true
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterStudyFinishV3({
      payload: {
        studySessionId: studySessionId,
        durationSeconds: 300
      },
      dryRun: true
    })
  );

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  if (!status.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Write Router status thất bại.'
    );
  }

  if (!sample.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Write Router sample context thất bại.'
    );
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < tests.length; i++) {
    if (tests[i].success !== true) {
      errors.push(
        'Learning write dry-run test #' +
        (i + 1) +
        ' failed: ' +
        kidlearnV3_learningWriteGetErrorMessage_(
          tests[i]
        )
      );
    }
  }

  if (!context.assignmentId) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không có assignmentId mẫu nên UI học tập chỉ test learning core actions.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'SMOKE_TEST_LEARNING_WRITE_DRY_RUN_UI_V3',
    phase: '3J.4',
    dryRunOnly: true,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    sampleContext: context,
    studySessionId: studySessionId,
    testCount: tests.length,
    tests: tests
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Smoke test Learning Write UI V3 chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      errors.length
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_learningWriteCheckFunctions_(
  functionNames
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < functionNames.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          functionNames[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: functionNames[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        functionNames[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Check HTML files.
 */
function kidlearnV3_learningWriteCheckHtmlFiles_(
  filenames
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < filenames.length; i++) {
    try {
      var content =
        HtmlService
          .createHtmlOutputFromFile(
            filenames[i]
          )
          .getContent();

      items.push({
        name: filenames[i],
        exists: true,
        length: content.length
      });

    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu HTML file: ' +
        filenames[i]
      );

      items.push({
        name: filenames[i],
        exists: false,
        error:
          String(error.message || error)
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Error message helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_learningWriteGetErrorMessage_(
  response
) {
  if (
    response &&
    response.error &&
    response.error.message
  ) {
    return response.error.message;
  }

  if (
    response &&
    response.details &&
    response.details.writeResponse &&
    response.details.writeResponse.error &&
    response.details.writeResponse.error.message
  ) {
    return response.details.writeResponse.error.message;
  }

  return 'Không rõ lỗi.';
}


/**
 * Today yyyy-MM-dd.
 */
function kidlearnV3_learningWriteToday_() {
  return Utilities.formatDate(
    new Date(),
    Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
    'yyyy-MM-dd'
  );
}

    warningCount:

    errors:

    replacementFunctions: [

  };

  );

/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_smokeTestLegacyCallReplacementV3() {
  var home =
    kidlearnV3_getHomeDataV3({});

  var subjects =
    kidlearnV3_getSubjectsDataV3({});

  var children =
    kidlearnV3_getChildrenDataV3({});

  kidlearnV3_assertLegacyReplacementResponseV3_(

    subjects,
    'SUBJECTS',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_assertLegacyReplacementResponseV3_(
    children,
    'CHILDREN',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_assertLegacyReplacementResponseV3_(
    assignments,
    'ASSIGNMENTS',
    errors
  );

  if (
    subjects.success &&
    subjects.data &&
    subjects.data.count < 4
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'SUBJECTS phải có ít nhất 4 môn học.'
    );
  }

  if (
    children.success &&
    children.data &&
    children.data.count < 1
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'CHILDREN phải có ít nhất 1 child.'
    );
  }

  if (
    assignments.success &&
    assignments.data &&
    assignments.data.count < 1
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'ASSIGNMENTS đang trống hoặc chưa gắn với child hiện tại.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'SMOKE_TEST_LEGACY_CALL_REPLACEMENT_V3',
    mode:
      kidlearnV3_safeLegacyReplacementModeV3_(),
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      warnings.length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      warnings,
    checks: {
      home:
        home.success,
      subjects:
        subjects.success,
      children:
        children.success,
      assignments:
        assignments.success
    },
    counts: {
      subjects:
        subjects.success && subjects.data
          ? subjects.data.count
          : 0,
      children:
        children.success && children.data
          ? children.data.count
          : 0,
      assignments:
        assignments.success && assignments.data
          ? assignments.data.count
          : 0
    }
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Smoke test legacy call replacement chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      errors.length
    );
  }

  return result;

  );

/**
 * Load screen qua UI Router DEV V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_legacyReplacementLoadScreenV3_(
  screen,
  request
) {
  var safeRequest =
    kidlearnV3_normalizeLegacyReplacementRequestV3_(
      request
    );

  safeRequest.screen =
    screen;

  return kidlearnV3_uiRouterLoadScreenV3(
    safeRequest
  );
}


/**
 * Normalize request.
 */
function kidlearnV3_normalizeLegacyReplacementRequestV3_(
  request
) {
  if (!request) {
    return {
      childId: '',
      userId: '',
      limit: 100
    };
  }

  if (
    typeof request !== 'object'
  ) {
    return {
      value: request,
      childId: '',
      userId: '',
      limit: 100
    };
  }

  return {
    childId:
      request.childId || '',
    userId:
      request.userId || '',
    limit:
      request.limit || 100
  };
}


/**
 * Check HTML files.
 */
function kidlearnV3_checkLegacyReplacementHtmlFilesV3_() {
  var names = [
    'UI_Legacy_Call_Adapter_V3',
    'UI_Dev_App_Router_V3'
  ];

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var items = [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < names.length;
    i++
  ) {
    try {
      var content =
        HtmlService
          .createHtmlOutputFromFile(
            names[i]
          )
          .getContent();

      items.push({
        name:
          names[i],
        exists:
          true,
        length:
          content.length
      });

    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu HTML file: ' +
        names[i]
      );

      items.push({
        name:
          names[i],
        exists:
          false,
        error:
          String(error.message || error)
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      warnings.length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      warnings,
    items:
      items
  };
}


/**
 * Assert response.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertLegacyReplacementResponseV3_(
  response,
  label,
  errors
) {
  if (!response) {
    errors.push(
      label + ': response trống.'
    );

    return;
  }

  if (response.success !== true) {
    var message =
      response.error && response.error.message
        ? response.error.message
        : 'Không rõ lỗi.';

    errors.push(
      label + ': ' + message
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Safe mode.
 */
function kidlearnV3_safeLegacyReplacementModeV3_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_uiSwitchGetModeV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return 'UNKNOWN';
  }
}

 *
 * Gate này chuẩn bị UI cho real write sau này,
 * nhưng ở Bundle 3J-A vẫn chỉ DRY_RUN.
 *
 * KHÔNG mở ghi thật qua UI ở 3J.10/3J.11.
 * KHÔNG bật Safe Write ENABLED.
 * KHÔNG sửa PROD.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J_A_UI_REAL_GATE_STATUS',
  INITIALIZED_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J_A_UI_REAL_GATE_INITIALIZED_AT',
  LAST_TEST_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J_A_UI_REAL_GATE_LAST_TEST_AT',
  LAST_READY_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J_A_UI_REAL_GATE_READY_AT',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J_A_UI_REAL_GATE_LAST_RESULT_JSON'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_STATUS = {
  NOT_INITIALIZED: 'NOT_INITIALIZED',
  DESIGNED_DRY_RUN: 'DESIGNED_DRY_RUN',
  DRY_RUN_TESTED: 'DRY_RUN_TESTED',
  READY_FOR_UI_REAL_WRITE_TRIAL: 'READY_FOR_UI_REAL_WRITE_TRIAL'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_CONFIG = {
  VERSION: '3J-A',
  PHASE: '3J.10_3J.11',
  CONFIRM_DRY_RUN_TEXT: 'DRY_RUN_ONLY',
  REAL_WRITE_ALLOWED_NOW: false,
  NEXT_BUNDLE: '3J-B'
};


/**
 * Preview Bundle 3J-A.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewUiRealWriteGateDevV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions = [
    'kidlearnV3_assertReadyToDesignUiRealWriteGateV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getPostRealWriteReviewStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_writeRouterDispatchV3',
    'kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetSampleContextV3',
    'kidlearnV3_uiInclude_'
  ];

  var functionChecks =
    kidlearnV3_uiRealGateCheckFunctions_(
      requiredFunctions
    );

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      functionChecks.errors
    );

  var htmlChecks =
    kidlearnV3_uiRealGateCheckHtmlFiles_([
      'UI_Real_Write_Gate_Client_V3',
      'UI_Real_Write_Gate_Dev_V3'
    ]);

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      htmlChecks.errors
    );

  var phase3J9 =
    kidlearnV3_uiRealGateSafe3J9Assert_();

  if (!phase3J9.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3J.9 chưa READY để thiết kế UI Real Write Gate: ' +
      phase3J9.message
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_uiRealGateSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Bundle 3J-A yêu cầu Safe Write ở DRY_RUN và enabled=false. Hiện tại mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_uiRealGateControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED') {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write đang ENABLED. Cần reset về DRY_RUN trước khi chạy Bundle 3J-A.'
    );
  }

  if (controlledWrite.status === 'ARMED') {
    warnings.push(
      'Controlled Write đang ARMED. Nên reset về DRY_RUN trước khi test UI Gate.'
    );
  }

  var router =
    kidlearnV3_uiRealGateRouterStatus_();

  var routerDryRunOnly =
    router.success &&
    router.data
      ? router.data.dryRunOnly
      : null;

  if (routerDryRunOnly !== true) {
    errors.push(
      'Write Router phải còn DRY_RUN_ONLY=true trong Bundle 3J-A.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE_DEV_V3',
    bundle: '3J-A',
    phase: '3J.10_3J.11',
    realWriteAllowedNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3J9: phase3J9,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite,
    controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite,
    routerStatus: {
      success: router.success === true,
      dryRunOnly: routerDryRunOnly
    },
    functionChecks: functionChecks.items,
    htmlChecks: htmlChecks.items
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Khởi tạo UI Real Write Gate ở chế độ DRY_RUN.
 */
function kidlearnV3_initializeUiRealWriteGateDevV3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewUiRealWriteGateDevV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể initialize UI Real Write Gate. Preview chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      preview.errorCount
    );
  }

  var now =
    new Date();

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_KEYS.STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_STATUS.DESIGNED_DRY_RUN
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_KEYS.INITIALIZED_AT,
    now.toISOString()
  );

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'INITIALIZE_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE_DEV_V3',
    bundle: '3J-A',
    phase: '3J.10',
    status: 'DESIGNED_DRY_RUN',
    realWriteAllowedNow: false,
    confirmDryRunText:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_CONFIG.CONFIRM_DRY_RUN_TEXT,
    message:
      'UI Real Write Gate đã được thiết kế ở chế độ DRY_RUN.'
  };

  kidlearnV3_uiRealGateSaveResult_(
    result
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}

/**

function kidlearnV3_uiRealWriteGateGetSampleContextV3() {

      sample.data || {},

      sample.error || null
  };

  );
