/**
 * Dispatch từ UI Gate.
 *
 * Bundle 3J-A luôn force dryRun=true.
 * Nếu UI gửi dryRun=false hoặc realWriteRequested=true thì block.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRealWriteGateDispatchV3(request) {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var req =
    kidlearnV3_uiRealGateNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  try {
    kidlearnV3_uiRealGateAssertReadyForDryRun_(
      req
    );

    var action =
      kidlearnV3_uiRealGateCanonicalAction_(
        req.action
      );

    var payload =
      kidlearnV3_uiRealGateBuildPayload_(
        action,
        req.payload || {}
      );

    var routerResponse =
      kidlearnV3_writeRouterDispatchV3({
        action: action,
        payload: payload,
        dryRun: true,
        source: 'UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE_DEV_3J_A'
      });

    var finishedAt =
      new Date();

    var result = {
      success:
        routerResponse.success === true,
      action: 'UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE_DISPATCH_V3',
      bundle: '3J-A',
      phase: '3J.11',
      gateAction: action,
      dryRun: true,
      realWriteAllowedNow: false,
      executed: false,
      startedAt:
        startedAt.toISOString(),
      finishedAt:
        finishedAt.toISOString(),
      durationMs:
        finishedAt.getTime() -
        startedAt.getTime(),
      routerResponse:
        routerResponse
    };

    return result;

  } catch (error) {
    var failedAt =
      new Date();

    return {
      success: false,
      action: 'UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE_DISPATCH_V3',
      bundle: '3J-A',
      phase: '3J.11',
      dryRun: true,
      realWriteAllowedNow: false,
      executed: false,
      startedAt:
        startedAt.toISOString(),
      finishedAt:
        failedAt.toISOString(),
      durationMs:
        failedAt.getTime() -
        startedAt.getTime(),
      error: {
        code: 'UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE_BLOCKED',
        message:
          String(error.message || error)
      }
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Smoke test UI Real Write Gate ở DRY_RUN.
 */
function kidlearnV3_smokeTestUiRealWriteGateDryRunV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var tests = [];

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewUiRealWriteGateDevV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể smoke test UI Real Write Gate. Preview chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      preview.errorCount
    );
  }

  var sample =
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetSampleContextV3({});

  var context =
    sample.success &&
    sample.data
      ? sample.data.sampleContext || {}
      : {};

  var childId =
    context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID';

  var subjectId =
    context.subjectId || 'SUB_TV';

  var lessonId =
    'DRY_RUN_UI_GATE_LESSON_' +
    Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMddHHmmss'
    );

  var sessionId =
    'DRY_RUN_UI_GATE_SESSION_' +
    Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMddHHmmss'
    );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_uiRealWriteGateDispatchV3({
      action: 'AUDIT_EVENT',
      confirmText: 'DRY_RUN_ONLY',
      payload: {
        eventType: 'UI_REAL_GATE_DRY_RUN_TEST',
        message: 'Dry-run test from UI Real Write Gate 3J-A',
        entityType: 'BUNDLE',
        entityId: '3J-A',
        childId: childId
      }
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_uiRealWriteGateDispatchV3({
      action: 'STUDY_START',
      confirmText: 'DRY_RUN_ONLY',
      payload: {
        studySessionId: sessionId,
        childId: childId,
        subjectId: subjectId,
        lessonId: lessonId
      }
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_uiRealWriteGateDispatchV3({
      action: 'LESSON_PROGRESS_SAVE',
      confirmText: 'DRY_RUN_ONLY',
      payload: {
        childId: childId,
        subjectId: subjectId,
        lessonId: lessonId,
        progressPercent: 30
      }
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_uiRealWriteGateDispatchV3({
      action: 'DAILY_GOAL_SAVE',
      confirmText: 'DRY_RUN_ONLY',
      payload: {
        childId: childId,
        goalDate: kidlearnV3_uiRealGateToday_(),
        targetMinutes: 20,
        completedMinutes: 10
      }
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_uiRealWriteGateDispatchV3({
      action: 'STUDY_FINISH',
      confirmText: 'DRY_RUN_ONLY',
      payload: {
        studySessionId: sessionId,
        durationSeconds: 300
      }
    })
  );

  for (var i = 0; i < tests.length; i++) {
    if (tests[i].success !== true) {
      errors.push(
        'UI Gate dry-run test #' +
        (i + 1) +
        ' failed: ' +
        kidlearnV3_uiRealGateGetErrorMessage_(
          tests[i]
        )
      );
    }
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_uiRealGateSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Sau smoke test, Safe Write phải vẫn là DRY_RUN/enabled=false.'
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_uiRealGateControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED') {
    errors.push(
      'Sau smoke test, Controlled Write không được ENABLED.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'SMOKE_TEST_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE_DRY_RUN_V3',
    bundle: '3J-A',
    phase: '3J.11',
    dryRunOnly: true,
    realWriteAllowedNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    sampleContext: context,
    testCount: tests.length,
    tests: tests
  };

  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_KEYS.LAST_TEST_AT,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );

  if (result.success) {
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .setProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_KEYS.STATUS,
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_STATUS.DRY_RUN_TESTED
      );
  }

  kidlearnV3_uiRealGateSaveResult_(
    result
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'UI Real Write Gate dry-run smoke test chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      result.errorCount
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Mark Bundle 3J-A ready cho Bundle 3J-B.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markUiRealWriteGateDryRunReadyV3() {
  var smoke =
    kidlearnV3_smokeTestUiRealWriteGateDryRunV3();

  if (!smoke.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark 3J-A ready vì smoke test chưa pass.'
    );
  }

  var now =
    new Date();

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_KEYS.STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_STATUS.READY_FOR_UI_REAL_WRITE_TRIAL
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT,
    now.toISOString()
  );

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE_DRY_RUN_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3J-A',
    phase: '3J.11',
    status: 'READY_FOR_UI_REAL_WRITE_TRIAL',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    realWriteAllowedNow: false,
    message:
      'Bundle 3J-A đã pass. Có thể chuyển sang 3J-B để chạy 01 UI real write trial có kiểm soát.'
  };

  kidlearnV3_uiRealGateSaveResult_(
    result
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert dùng cho Bundle 3J-B.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertUiRealWriteGateDryRunReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getUiRealWriteGateDevStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_STATUS.READY_FOR_UI_REAL_WRITE_TRIAL
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'UI Real Write Gate chưa READY_FOR_UI_REAL_WRITE_TRIAL. Status hiện tại: ' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    status.safeWriteStatus.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    status.safeWriteStatus.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write phải ở DRY_RUN trước khi sang 3J-B.'
    );
  }

  var routerDryRunOnly =
    status.routerStatus &&
    status.routerStatus.data
      ? status.routerStatus.data.dryRunOnly
      : null;

  if (routerDryRunOnly !== true) {
    errors.push(
      'Write Router vẫn phải DRY_RUN_ONLY=true trước khi 3J-B thiết kế trial riêng.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE_DRY_RUN_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3J-A',
    phase: '3J.11',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    status: status.status,
    realWriteAllowedNow: false
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'UI Real Write Gate chưa đủ điều kiện sang 3J-B. Errors: ' +
      errors.length
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert gate sẵn sàng cho DRY_RUN dispatch.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRealGateAssertReadyForDryRun_(
  request
) {
  var confirmText =
    String(request.confirmText || '').trim();

  if (
    confirmText !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_GATE_CONFIG.CONFIRM_DRY_RUN_TEXT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirmText=DRY_RUN_ONLY.'
    );
  }

  if (request.dryRun === false) {
    throw new Error(
      'Bundle 3J-A không cho phép dryRun=false.'
    );
  }

  if (request.realWriteRequested === true) {
    throw new Error(
      'Bundle 3J-A không cho phép realWriteRequested=true.'
    );
  }

  var phase3J9 =
    kidlearnV3_uiRealGateSafe3J9Assert_();

  if (!phase3J9.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3J.9 chưa ready: ' +
      phase3J9.message
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_uiRealGateSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Safe Write phải ở DRY_RUN/enabled=false cho UI Gate dry-run.'
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_uiRealGateControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED') {
    throw new Error(
      'Controlled Write đang ENABLED. Bundle 3J-A chỉ DRY_RUN.'
    );
  }

  var router =
    kidlearnV3_uiRealGateRouterStatus_();

  var dryRunOnly =
    router.success &&
    router.data
      ? router.data.dryRunOnly
      : null;

  if (dryRunOnly !== true) {
    throw new Error(
      'Write Router không còn DRY_RUN_ONLY=true.'
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Canonical action.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRealGateCanonicalAction_(
  action
) {
  var value =
    String(action || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  var allowed = {
    AUDIT_EVENT: true,
    STUDY_START: true,
    STUDY_FINISH: true,
    LESSON_PROGRESS_SAVE: true,
    DAILY_GOAL_SAVE: true,
    ASSIGNMENT_START: true,
    ASSIGNMENT_PROGRESS: true,
    ASSIGNMENT_COMPLETE: true
  };

  if (!allowed[value]) {
    throw new Error(
      'UI Real Write Gate action không hợp lệ: ' +
      value
    );
  }

  return value;
}


/**
 * Build payload an toàn.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRealGateBuildPayload_(
  action,
  payload
) {
  var object =
    payload && typeof payload === 'object'
      ? payload
      : {};

  var safe = {};

  var keys =
    Object.keys(object);

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    safe[keys[i]] =
      object[keys[i]];
  }

  safe.source =
    'UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE_DEV_3J_A';

  safe.gateAction =
    action;

  safe.realWriteAllowedNow =
    false;

  return safe;
}


/**
 * Normalize request.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRealGateNormalizeRequest_(
  request
) {
  if (!request) {
    return {};
  }

  if (typeof request !== 'object') {
    return {
      value: request
    };
  }

  return request;
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRealGateCheckFunctions_(
  functionNames
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < functionNames.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          functionNames[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: functionNames[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        functionNames[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Check HTML files.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRealGateCheckHtmlFiles_(
  filenames
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < filenames.length; i++) {
    try {
      var content =
        HtmlService
          .createHtmlOutputFromFile(
            filenames[i]
          )
          .getContent();

      items.push({
        name: filenames[i],
        exists: true,
        length: content.length
      });

    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu HTML file: ' +
        filenames[i]
      );

      items.push({
        name: filenames[i],
        exists: false,
        error:
          String(error.message || error)
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}

/**

function kidlearnV3_uiRealGateGetErrorMessage_(
  response
) {
  if (
    response &&
    response.error &&
    response.error.message
  ) {
    return response.error.message;
  }

  if (
    response &&
    response.routerResponse &&
    response.routerResponse.error &&
    response.routerResponse.error.message
  ) {
    return response.routerResponse.error.message;
  }

  return 'Không rõ lỗi.';
}

    realWriteScope: 'ONE_LOG_AUDIT_ROW_ONLY',
    mode: 'ATOMIC_RESET_ARM_ENABLE_WRITE_RESET',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    uiGate3JA: gate,
    safeWriteStatus: kidlearnV3_3jbSafeWriteStatus_(),
    controlledWriteStatus: kidlearnV3_3jbControlledWriteStatus_(),
    targetSheets: targetCheck.items,

  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}

/**
 * Helper chạy trial CLEAN từ Apps Script.
 *
 * Chạy hàm này thay vì bấm UI:
 * kidlearnV3_runUiRealWriteTrial3JBCleanV3
 */
function kidlearnV3_runUiRealWriteTrial3JBCleanV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_uiRealWriteTrial3JBExecuteV3({
    confirmText:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TRIAL_TEXT
  });
}


/**
 * Chạy 01 UI real write trial.
 *
 * Bản CLEAN:
 * - Reset DRY_RUN
 * - ARM
 * - ENABLE
 * - Assert ENABLED
 * - Ghi 01 LOG_Audit
 * - Snapshot diff
 * - Auto reset DRY_RUN
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRealWriteTrial3JBExecuteV3(request) {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var req =
    kidlearnV3_3jbNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var transactionId =
    kidlearnV3_3jbMakeTransactionId_();

  var beforeSnapshot = null;
  var afterSnapshot = null;
  var writeResponse = null;
  var writeInfo = {};
  var diff = {};
  var rollbackPlan = {};
  var resetBefore = null;
  var armResult = null;
  var enableResult = null;
  var assertEnabled = null;
  var autoReset = null;

  try {
    if (
      String(req.confirmText || '').trim() !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TRIAL_TEXT
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        'Thiếu confirmText=CONFIRM_UI_REAL_WRITE_3J_B.'
      );
    }

    resetBefore =
      kidlearnV3_resetControlledWriteDevToDryRunV3();

    var preview =
      kidlearnV3_previewUiRealWriteTrial3JBV3();

    if (!preview.success) {
      throw new Error(
        'Preview 3J-B chưa đạt. Errors=' +
        preview.errorCount +
        '. ' +
        preview.errors.join(' | ')
      );
    }

    armResult =
      kidlearnV3_armControlledWriteDevV3();

    if (!armResult.success) {
      throw new Error(
        'ARM Controlled Write thất bại.'
      );
    }

    enableResult =
      kidlearnV3_enableControlledWriteDevV3();

    if (!enableResult.success) {
      throw new Error(
        'ENABLE Controlled Write thất bại.'
      );
    }

    assertEnabled =
      kidlearnV3_assertControlledWriteDevEnabledV3();

    if (!assertEnabled.success) {
      throw new Error(
        'Controlled Write chưa ENABLED sau khi enable.'
      );
    }

    beforeSnapshot =
      kidlearnV3_3jbSnapshotSheets_(
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_TARGET_SHEETS
      );

    writeResponse =
      kidlearnV3_writeServiceSubmitV3({
        operation: 'AUDIT_LOG',
        dryRun: false,
        confirmWrite:
          KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_CONFIG.CONFIRM_WRITE_TOKEN,
        payload: {
          eventType: 'UI_REAL_WRITE_TRIAL_3J_B',
          action: 'UI_REAL_WRITE_TRIAL',
          message:
            '3J-B CLEAN UI real write trial. transactionId=' +
            transactionId,
          entityType: 'UI_REAL_WRITE_TRIAL',
          entityId: transactionId,
          status: 'INFO',
          source: 'UI_REAL_WRITE_TRIAL_3JB_CLEAN',
          transactionId: transactionId,
          referenceId: transactionId,
          notes:
            'Scope=LOG_Audit only; bundle=3J-B; phase=3J.12; transactionId=' +
            transactionId,
          details: {
            bundle: '3J-B',
            version: 'CLEAN',
            phase: '3J.12',
            transactionId: transactionId,
            purpose:
              'Verify one controlled real write through UI DEV gate.',
            scope:
              'LOG_Audit only'
          }
        }
      });

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    Utilities.sleep(800);

    afterSnapshot =
      kidlearnV3_3jbSnapshotSheets_(
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_TARGET_SHEETS
      );

    writeInfo =
      kidlearnV3_3jbExtractWriteInfo_(
        writeResponse,
        transactionId
      );

    writeInfo.rowNumber =
      kidlearnV3_3jbFindAuditRowByTransactionId_(
        transactionId
      );

    if (
      writeResponse &&
      writeResponse.success === true &&
      writeInfo.rowNumber >= 3
    ) {
      writeInfo.executed = true;
      writeInfo.dryRun = false;

      if (!writeInfo.targetSheet) {
        writeInfo.targetSheet = 'LOG_Audit';
      }

      if (!writeInfo.writeType) {
        writeInfo.writeType = 'APPEND';
      }
    }

    if (
      !writeResponse ||
      writeResponse.success !== true
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'Write Service submit thất bại: ' +
        kidlearnV3_3jbGetErrorMessage_(
          writeResponse
        )
      );
    }

    if (writeInfo.rowNumber < 3) {
      errors.push(
        'Không tìm thấy row LOG_Audit chứa transactionId sau khi write: ' +
        transactionId
      );
    }

    diff =
      kidlearnV3_3jbCompareTrialDiff_(
        beforeSnapshot,
        afterSnapshot
      );

    errors =
      errors.concat(
        diff.errors || []
      );

    warnings =
      warnings.concat(
        diff.warnings || []
      );

    rollbackPlan =
      kidlearnV3_3jbBuildRollbackPlan_(
        transactionId,
        writeInfo
      );

  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  autoReset =
    kidlearnV3_3jbTryAutoReset_();

  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'UI_REAL_WRITE_TRIAL_3JB_EXECUTE_V3',
    bundle: '3J-B',
    version: 'CLEAN',
    phase: '3J.12',
    transactionId: transactionId,
    targetSheet: 'LOG_Audit',
    writeOperation: 'AUDIT_LOG',
    realWriteScope: 'ONE_LOG_AUDIT_ROW_ONLY',
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    resetBefore: resetBefore,
    armResult: kidlearnV3_3jbCompactActionResult_(armResult),
    enableResult: kidlearnV3_3jbCompactActionResult_(enableResult),
    assertEnabled: kidlearnV3_3jbCompactActionResult_(assertEnabled),
    writeInfo: writeInfo,
    diff: diff,
    rollbackPlan: rollbackPlan,
    autoReset: autoReset,
    checklist:
      kidlearnV3_3jbBuildTrialChecklist_(
        errors,
        warnings,
        diff,
        writeInfo,
        autoReset
      )
  };

  kidlearnV3_3jbSaveTrialResult_(
    result
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Reset sau trial.
 */
function kidlearnV3_resetAfterUiRealWriteTrial3JBV3() {
  var reset =
    kidlearnV3_3jbTryAutoReset_();

  var result = {
    success:
      reset &&
      reset.success === true,
    action: 'RESET_AFTER_UI_REAL_WRITE_TRIAL_3JB_V3',
    bundle: '3J-B',
    phase: '3J.12',
    reset: reset,
    safeWriteStatus:
      kidlearnV3_3jbSafeWriteStatus_(),
    controlledWriteStatus:
      kidlearnV3_3jbControlledWriteStatus_()
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Post-UI real write review.
 *
 * Không ghi thêm dữ liệu.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runPostUiRealWriteReview3JBV3() {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getUiRealWriteTrial3JBStatusV3();

  var last =
    status.lastResult || {};

  var transactionId =
    status.lastTransactionId ||
    last.transactionId ||
    '';

  if (!transactionId) {
    errors.push(
      'Không tìm thấy transactionId của UI real write trial 3J-B.'
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3jbSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Sau UI trial, Safe Write phải ở DRY_RUN/enabled=false. Hiện tại mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3jbControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED') {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write vẫn đang ENABLED sau UI trial.'
    );
  }

  var allowedStatus = {
    PASSED: true,
    REVIEW_PASSED: true,
    CLOSED: true
  };

  if (!allowedStatus[status.status]) {
    errors.push(
      'UI real write trial 3J-B chưa PASSED để review. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  var dataCheck = {
    success: false,
    skipped: true
  };

  if (transactionId) {
    dataCheck =
      kidlearnV3_3jbCheckTrialDataState_(
        transactionId,
        false
      );

    errors =
      errors.concat(
        dataCheck.errors || []
      );

    warnings =
      warnings.concat(
        dataCheck.warnings || []
      );
  }

  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  var decision =
    errors.length === 0
      ? 'REVIEW_PASSED_READY_TO_CLOSE_3J'
      : 'HOLD_KEEP_UI_REAL_WRITE_OFF';

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'RUN_POST_UI_REAL_WRITE_REVIEW_3JB_V3',
    bundle: '3J-B',
    phase: '3J.13',
    transactionId: transactionId,
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite,
    controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite,
    trialStatusBeforeReview: status.status,
    dataCheck: dataCheck,
    decision: {
      decisionCode: decision,
      canClosePhase3J:
        errors.length === 0,
      openUiRealWriteNow: false,
      nextPhase:
        errors.length === 0
          ? '3J.14'
          : ''
    },
    checklist:
      kidlearnV3_3jbBuildPostReviewChecklist_(
        errors,
        warnings,
        dataCheck,
        safeWrite,
        controlledWrite
      )
  };

  kidlearnV3_3jbSaveReviewResult_(
    result
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Mark post review ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markPostUiRealWriteReview3JBReadyV3() {
  var review =
    kidlearnV3_runPostUiRealWriteReview3JBV3();

  if (!review.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark 3J-B review ready. Errors: ' +
      review.errorCount +
      '. ' +
      review.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var now =
    new Date();

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_KEYS.STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_STATUS.REVIEW_PASSED
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT,
    now.toISOString()
  );

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_POST_UI_REAL_WRITE_REVIEW_3JB_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3J-B',
    phase: '3J.13',
    status: 'REVIEW_PASSED',
    nextStep: '3J.14',
    message:
      '3J-B post-UI real write review đã pass. Có thể close Phase 3J.'
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Rollback UI real write trial 3J-B.
 */
function kidlearnV3_rollbackUiRealWriteTrial3JBV3(request) {
  var req =
    kidlearnV3_3jbNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  if (
    String(req.confirmRollback || '').trim() !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_CONFIG.CONFIRM_ROLLBACK_TEXT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirmRollback=CONFIRM_ROLLBACK_UI_3J_B.'
    );
  }

  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getUiRealWriteTrial3JBStatusV3();

  var transactionId =
    status.lastTransactionId ||
    (
      status.lastResult
        ? status.lastResult.transactionId
        : ''
    );

  if (!transactionId) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không tìm thấy transactionId để rollback 3J-B.'
    );
  }

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3jbGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_3jbGetSheet_(
      spreadsheet,
      'LOG_Audit'
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không tìm thấy LOG_Audit.'
    );
  }

  var rows =
    kidlearnV3_3jbFindRowsContainingText_(
      sheet,
      transactionId
    );

  if (rows.length < 1) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không tìm thấy row LOG_Audit chứa transactionId: ' +
      transactionId
    );
  }

  for (var i = rows.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    sheet.deleteRow(
      rows[i]
    );
  }

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  Utilities.sleep(500);

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'ROLLBACK_UI_REAL_WRITE_TRIAL_3JB_V3',
    bundle: '3J-B',
    phase: '3J.12',
    transactionId: transactionId,
    deletedRows: rows,
    deletedRowCount: rows.length,
    rolledBackAt:
      new Date().toISOString(),
    message:
      'Đã rollback UI real write trial 3J-B bằng cách xóa dòng LOG_Audit test.'
  };

  kidlearnV3_3jbSaveRollback_(
    result
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Helper rollback có confirm sẵn.
 */
function kidlearnV3_confirmRollbackUiRealWriteTrial3JBV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_rollbackUiRealWriteTrial3JBV3({
    confirmRollback:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_CONFIG.CONFIRM_ROLLBACK_TEXT
  });
}


/**
 * Close Phase 3J.
 */
function kidlearnV3_closePhase3JV3() {
  var assertReview =
    kidlearnV3_assertPostUiRealWriteReview3JBPassedV3();

  if (!assertReview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể close Phase 3J. 3J-B review chưa pass.'
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3jbSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể close Phase 3J khi Safe Write chưa ở DRY_RUN.'
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3jbControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED') {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể close Phase 3J khi Controlled Write còn ENABLED.'
    );
  }

  var now =
    new Date();

  var closeResult = {
    success: true,
    action: 'CLOSE_PHASE_3J_V3',
    phase: '3J.14',
    status: 'CLOSED_LOCKED',
    closedAt:
      now.toISOString(),
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    summary: {
      bundle3JA:
        'UI Real Write Gate designed and tested in DRY_RUN.',
      bundle3JB:
        'One clean atomic UI real write trial completed and reviewed.',
      safeWriteMode:
        safeWrite.mode,
      safeWriteEnabled:
        safeWrite.enabled,
      controlledWriteStatus:
        controlledWrite.status,
      prodTouched:
        false
    }
  };

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_KEYS.PHASE_3J_CLOSE_STATUS,
    'CLOSED_LOCKED'
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_KEYS.PHASE_3J_CLOSED_AT,
    now.toISOString()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_KEYS.PHASE_3J_NEXT_PHASE,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_KEYS.PHASE_3J_CLOSE_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(closeResult)
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_KEYS.STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_STATUS.CLOSED
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(closeResult, null, 2)
  );

  return closeResult;
}

 */
function kidlearnV3_getPhase3JCloseStatusV3() {
  var properties =

      ) ||
      '',
    closeResult:
      kidlearnV3_3jbReadPhase3JCloseResult_(),
    trial3JBStatus:

  };

/**
 * Assert Phase 3J closed.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertPhase3JClosedV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getPhase3JCloseStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (status.status !== 'CLOSED_LOCKED') {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 3J chưa CLOSED_LOCKED. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (status.nextPhase !== '3K') {
    errors.push(
      'Next phase phải là 3K. Hiện tại=' +
      status.nextPhase
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3jbSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Sau khi close 3J, Safe Write phải ở DRY_RUN.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_PHASE_3J_CLOSED_V3',
    phase: '3J.14',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    status: status.status,
    nextPhase: status.nextPhase,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Phase 3J chưa close đúng. Errors: ' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert post-review pass.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertPostUiRealWriteReview3JBPassedV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getUiRealWriteTrial3JBStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !== 'REVIEW_PASSED' &&
    status.status !== 'CLOSED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3J-B chưa REVIEW_PASSED/CLOSED. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_POST_UI_REAL_WRITE_REVIEW_3JB_PASSED_V3',
    bundle: '3J-B',
    phase: '3J.13',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    status: status.status
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3J-B review chưa pass. Errors: ' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Check trial data state.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbCheckTrialDataState_(
  transactionId,
  rolledBack
) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3jbGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  var auditSheet =
    kidlearnV3_3jbGetSheet_(
      spreadsheet,
      'LOG_Audit'
    );

  var auditRows =
    auditSheet
      ? kidlearnV3_3jbFindRowsContainingText_(
          auditSheet,
          transactionId
        )
      : [];

  if (rolledBack) {
    if (auditRows.length > 0) {
      errors.push(
        'Sau rollback, LOG_Audit vẫn còn row transactionId. Found=' +
        auditRows.length
      );
    }

  } else {
    if (auditRows.length < 1) {
      errors.push(
        'LOG_Audit phải có ít nhất 1 row chứa transactionId. Found=0. transactionId=' +
        transactionId
      );
    }

    if (auditRows.length > 1) {
      warnings.push(
        'LOG_Audit có ' +
        auditRows.length +
        ' rows chứa transactionId. Chấp nhận nếu learning sheets không bị tác động.'
      );
    }
  }

  var dataSheetNames = [
    'DATA_StudySessions',
    'DATA_LessonProgress',
    'DATA_DailyGoals',
    'DATA_Assignments'
  ];

  var dataChecks = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < dataSheetNames.length; i++) {
    var sheetName =
      dataSheetNames[i];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_3jbGetSheet_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetName
      );

    var rows =
      sheet
        ? kidlearnV3_3jbFindRowsContainingText_(
            sheet,
            transactionId
          )
        : [];

    if (rows.length > 0) {
      errors.push(
        sheetName +
        ' không được chứa transactionId của UI audit trial. Found=' +
        rows.length
      );
    }

    dataChecks.push({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      foundTokenCount: rows.length,
      rows: rows
    });
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    transactionId: transactionId,
    rolledBack: rolledBack,
    auditRows: auditRows,
    auditRowCount: auditRows.length,
    dataChecks: dataChecks,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Compare trial diff.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbCompareTrialDiff_(
  beforeSnapshot,
  afterSnapshot
) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var changedSheets = [];
  var rowDeltas = {};

  var beforeMap =
    kidlearnV3_3jbMapSnapshots_(
      beforeSnapshot.items || []
    );

  var afterMap =
    kidlearnV3_3jbMapSnapshots_(
      afterSnapshot.items || []
    );

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_TARGET_SHEETS.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sheetName =
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_TARGET_SHEETS[i];

    var before =
      beforeMap[sheetName];

    var after =
      afterMap[sheetName];

    if (!before || !after) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu snapshot cho sheet: ' +
        sheetName
      );

      continue;
    }

    var rowDelta =
      after.lastRow -
      before.lastRow;

    var checksumChanged =
      after.checksum !== before.checksum;

    rowDeltas[sheetName] = {
      beforeLastRow: before.lastRow,
      afterLastRow: after.lastRow,
      rowDelta: rowDelta,
      checksumChanged: checksumChanged
    };

    if (
      rowDelta !== 0 ||
      checksumChanged
    ) {
      changedSheets.push(
        sheetName
      );
    }

    if (sheetName === 'LOG_Audit') {
      if (rowDelta < 1) {
        errors.push(
          'LOG_Audit phải tăng ít nhất 1 row. Actual=' +
          rowDelta
        );
      }

      if (!checksumChanged) {
        errors.push(
          'LOG_Audit checksum phải đổi.'
        );
      }

      if (rowDelta !== 1) {
        warnings.push(
          'LOG_Audit tăng ' +
          rowDelta +
          ' rows. Chấp nhận nếu learning sheets không bị tác động.'
        );
      }

      continue;
    }

    if (rowDelta !== 0) {
      errors.push(
        sheetName +
        ' không được tăng row. Actual=' +
        rowDelta
      );
    }

    if (checksumChanged) {
      errors.push(
        sheetName +
        ' không được đổi checksum.'
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    changedSheets: changedSheets,
    expectedChangedSheets: ['LOG_Audit'],
    rowDeltas: rowDeltas,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Build trial checklist.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbBuildTrialChecklist_(
  errors,
  warnings,
  diff,
  writeInfo,
  autoReset
) {
  return [
    {
      item: 'UI real write trial executed',
      status:
        writeInfo.rowNumber >= 3
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'Only LOG_Audit changed',
      status:
        diff &&
        diff.success === true
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'Auto reset to DRY_RUN',
      status:
        autoReset &&
        autoReset.success === true
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'Rollback plan generated',
      status:
        writeInfo.transactionId
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: '3J.12 result',
      status:
        errors.length === 0
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED',
      warningCount:
        warnings.length
    }
  ];
}


/**
 * Build post review checklist.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbBuildPostReviewChecklist_(
  errors,
  warnings,
  dataCheck,
  safeWrite,
  controlledWrite
) {
  return [
    {
      item: 'Safe Write reset về DRY_RUN',
      status:
        safeWrite.mode === 'DRY_RUN' &&
        safeWrite.enabled === false
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'Controlled Write không ENABLED',
      status:
        controlledWrite.status !== 'ENABLED'
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'UI trial LOG_Audit traceable',
      status:
        dataCheck.auditRowCount >= 1
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'Không tác động learning data sheets',
      status:
        dataCheck.success
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: '3J.13 result',
      status:
        errors.length === 0
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED',
      warningCount:
        warnings.length
    }
  ];
}


/**
 * Snapshot nhiều sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbSnapshotSheets_(
  sheetNames
) {
  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3jbGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  var items = [];
  var summary = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < sheetNames.length; i++) {
    var item =
      kidlearnV3_3jbSnapshotSheet_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetNames[i]
      );

    items.push(item);

    summary.push({
      sheetName: item.sheetName,
      exists: item.exists,
      lastRow: item.lastRow,
      lastColumn: item.lastColumn,
      dataRowCount: item.dataRowCount,
      checksum: item.checksum
    });
  }

  return {
    spreadsheetId:
      spreadsheet.getId(),
    spreadsheetName:
      spreadsheet.getName(),
    capturedAt:
      new Date().toISOString(),
    items: items,
    summary: summary
  };
}


/**
 * Snapshot một sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbSnapshotSheet_(
  spreadsheet,
  sheetName
) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_3jbGetSheet_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      sheetName: sheetName,
      exists: false,
      lastRow: 0,
      lastColumn: 0,
      dataRowCount: 0,
      checksum: ''
    };
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  var values = [];

  if (
    lastRow > 0 &&
    lastColumn > 0
  ) {
    values =
      sheet
        .getRange(
          1,
          1,
          lastRow,
          lastColumn
        )
        .getDisplayValues();
  }

  var text =
    JSON.stringify({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      lastRow: lastRow,
      lastColumn: lastColumn,
      values: values
    });

  return {
    sheetName: sheetName,
    exists: true,
    lastRow: lastRow,
    lastColumn: lastColumn,
    dataRowCount:
      Math.max(0, lastRow - 2),
    checksum:
      kidlearnV3_3jbMd5_(
        text
      )
  };
}


/**
 * Build rollback plan.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbBuildRollbackPlan_(
  transactionId,
  writeInfo
) {
  return {
    rollbackType: 'DELETE_UI_TRIAL_LOG_AUDIT_ROW',
    transactionId: transactionId,
    targetSheet: 'LOG_Audit',
    rowNumber:
      writeInfo.rowNumber || '',
    verifyBeforeDelete: [
      'Row phải chứa transactionId.',
      'Không xóa audit rows khác.',
      'Không xóa learning data.'
    ],
    rollbackFunction:
      'kidlearnV3_rollbackUiRealWriteTrial3JBV3',
    helperRollbackFunction:
      'kidlearnV3_confirmRollbackUiRealWriteTrial3JBV3',
    requiredConfirmRollback:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_CONFIG.CONFIRM_ROLLBACK_TEXT
  };
}


/**
 * Extract write info.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbExtractWriteInfo_(
  response,
  transactionId
) {
  var info = {
    success:
      response &&
      response.success === true,
    executed: false,
    dryRun: true,
    targetSheet: '',
    writeType: '',
    keyField: '',
    keyValue: '',
    rowNumber: '',
    transactionId: transactionId
  };

  try {
    var data =
      response && response.data
        ? response.data
        : {};

    var safeWrite =
      data.safeWrite || {};

    var safeData =
      safeWrite.data || {};

    var plan =
      data.plan ||
      safeData.plan ||
      {};

    var execution =
      safeData.execution || {};

    var executionResult =
      execution.result || {};

    info.executed =
      data.executed === true ||
      safeData.executed === true ||
      execution.executed === true;

    info.dryRun =
      data.dryRun === true ||
      safeData.dryRun === true;

    info.targetSheet =
      plan.targetSheet || '';

    info.writeType =
      plan.writeType || '';

    info.keyField =
      plan.keyField || '';

    info.keyValue =
      plan.keyValue || '';

    info.rowNumber =
      executionResult.rowNumber || '';

  } catch (error) {
    info.extractError =
      String(error.message || error);
  }

  return info;
}


/**
 * Check target sheets.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbCheckTargetSheets_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var items = [];

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_3jbGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được Database V3: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );

    return {
      errors: errors,
      warnings: warnings,
      items: items
    };
  }

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_TARGET_SHEETS.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sheetName =
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_TARGET_SHEETS[i];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_3jbGetSheet_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetName
      );

    if (!sheet) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu target sheet: ' +
        sheetName
      );

      items.push({
        sheetName: sheetName,
        exists: false
      });

      continue;
    }

    items.push({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      exists: true,
      lastRow: sheet.getLastRow(),
      lastColumn: sheet.getLastColumn()
    });
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Auto reset helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbTryAutoReset_() {
  try {
    var reset =
      kidlearnV3_resetControlledWriteDevToDryRunV3();

    var safeWrite =
      kidlearnV3_3jbSafeWriteStatus_();

    return {
      success:
        safeWrite.mode === 'DRY_RUN' &&
        safeWrite.enabled === false,
      reset: reset,
      safeWriteStatus: safeWrite
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Save trial result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbSaveTrialResult_(
  result
) {
  var status =
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_STATUS.PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_STATUS.FAILED;

  var compact = {
    success: result.success,
    action: result.action,
    bundle: result.bundle,
    version: result.version,
    phase: result.phase,
    transactionId: result.transactionId,
    targetSheet: result.targetSheet,
    writeOperation: result.writeOperation,
    finishedAt: result.finishedAt,
    durationMs: result.durationMs,
    errorCount: result.errorCount,
    warningCount: result.warningCount,
    errors: result.errors,
    warnings: result.warnings,
    armResult: result.armResult,
    enableResult: result.enableResult,
    assertEnabled: result.assertEnabled,
    writeInfo: result.writeInfo,
    diff: result.diff,
    rollbackPlan: result.rollbackPlan,
    autoReset: result.autoReset,
    checklist: result.checklist
  };

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(

/**
 * Database spreadsheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_() {
  var database =
    kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_();

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3jbResolveSpreadsheet_(
      database
    );

  if (!spreadsheet) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không resolve được Spreadsheet object từ Database V3.'
    );
  }

  return spreadsheet;
}


/**
 * Resolve database wrapper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbResolveSpreadsheet_(
  value
) {
  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (
    typeof value.getSheets === 'function' &&
    typeof value.getId === 'function'
  ) {
    return value;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheet &&
    typeof value.spreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheet;
  }

  if (
    value.database &&
    typeof value.database.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.database;
  }

  if (
    value.db &&
    typeof value.db.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.db;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheetObject &&
    typeof value.spreadsheetObject.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheetObject;
  }

  if (
    value.activeSpreadsheet &&
    typeof value.activeSpreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.activeSpreadsheet;
  }

  if (value.spreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.spreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (value.databaseSpreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.databaseSpreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (
    value.id &&
    typeof value.id === 'string'
  ) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.id
    );
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Get exact sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbGetSheet_(
  spreadsheet,
  sheetName
) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Find audit row by transactionId.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbFindAuditRowByTransactionId_(
  transactionId
) {
  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3jbGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_3jbGetSheet_(
      spreadsheet,
      'LOG_Audit'
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return -1;
  }

  var rows =
    kidlearnV3_3jbFindRowsContainingText_(
      sheet,
      transactionId
    );

  if (rows.length === 0) {
    return -1;
  }

  return rows[rows.length - 1];
}


/**
 * Find all rows containing text.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbFindRowsContainingText_(
  sheet,
  text
) {
  var token =
    String(text || '').trim();

  var rows = [];

  if (!token) {
    return rows;
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (
    lastRow < 3 ||
    lastColumn < 1
  ) {
    return rows;
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        3,
        1,
        lastRow - 2,
        lastColumn
      )
      .getDisplayValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var rowText =
      values[i].join(' | ');

    if (rowText.indexOf(token) >= 0) {
      rows.push(
        i + 3
      );
    }
  }

  return rows;
}


/**
 * Map snapshots.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbMapSnapshots_(
  items
) {
  var map = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    map[items[i].sheetName] =
      items[i];
  }

  return map;
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbCheckFunctions_(
  functionNames
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < functionNames.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          functionNames[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: functionNames[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        functionNames[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}

function kidlearnV3_3jbSafeUiGateReady_() {
  try {

function kidlearnV3_3jbSafeWriteStatus_() {

function kidlearnV3_3jbFailure_(

    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REAL_TRIAL_3JB_CONFIG.PHASE,

      code: 'UI_REAL_WRITE_TRIAL_3JB_ERROR',
      message: message
    }
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Error message helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbGetErrorMessage_(
  response
) {
  if (!response) {
    return 'Không có response.';
  }

  if (
    response.errors &&
    response.errors.length
  ) {
    return response.errors.join(' | ');
  }

  if (
    response.error &&
    response.error.message
  ) {
    return response.error.message;
  }

  if (
    response.data &&
    response.data.error &&
    response.data.error.message
  ) {
    return response.data.error.message;
  }

  return JSON.stringify(response);
}


/**
 * Normalize request.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbNormalizeRequest_(
  request
) {
  if (!request) {
    return {};
  }

  if (typeof request !== 'object') {
    return {
      value: request
    };
  }

  return request;
}


/**
 * Make transaction ID.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbMakeTransactionId_() {
  var text =
    Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss_SSS'
    );

  var random =
    Math.floor(
      Math.random() * 100000
    );

  return (
    'UI_TX_3JB_CLEAN_' +
    text +
    '_' +
    random
  );
}


/**
 * MD5 checksum.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbMd5_(
  text
) {
  var digest =
    Utilities.computeDigest(
      Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.MD5,
      text,
      Utilities.Charset.UTF_8
    );

  var result = '';

  for (var i = 0; i < digest.length; i++) {
    var value =
      digest[i];

    if (value < 0) {
      value += 256;
    }

    result +=
      ('0' + value.toString(16)).slice(-2);
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Compact result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3jbCompactActionResult_(
  value
) {
  if (!value) {
    return null;

  return {
    success: value.success === true,
    action: value.action || '',
    status: value.status || '',
    safeWriteMode: value.safeWriteMode || '',
    safeWriteEnabled: value.safeWriteEnabled
  };
}

/**
 * Smoke test UI Router DEV V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_smokeTestUiRouterDevV3() {
  var initial =
    kidlearnV3_uiRouterGetInitialStateV3({});

  var home =
    kidlearnV3_uiRouterLoadScreenV3({
      screen: 'HOME'
    });

  var subjects =
    kidlearnV3_uiRouterLoadScreenV3({
      screen: 'SUBJECTS'
    });

  var children =
    kidlearnV3_uiRouterLoadScreenV3({
      screen: 'CHILDREN'
    });

  var assignments =
    kidlearnV3_uiRouterLoadScreenV3({
      screen: 'ASSIGNMENTS'
    });

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  kidlearnV3_uiRouterAssertResponse_(
    initial,
    'INITIAL',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiRouterAssertResponse_(
    home,
    'HOME',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiRouterAssertResponse_(
    subjects,
    'SUBJECTS',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiRouterAssertResponse_(
    children,
    'CHILDREN',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiRouterAssertResponse_(
    assignments,
    'ASSIGNMENTS',
    errors
  );

  if (
    subjects.success &&
    subjects.data &&
    subjects.data.count < 4
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'SUBJECTS phải có ít nhất 4 môn học.'
    );
  }

  if (
    children.success &&
    children.data &&
    children.data.count < 1
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'CHILDREN phải có ít nhất 1 child.'
    );
  }

  if (
    assignments.success &&
    assignments.data &&
    assignments.data.count < 1
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'ASSIGNMENTS đang trống hoặc chưa gắn với child hiện tại.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'SMOKE_TEST_UI_ROUTER_DEV_V3',
    mode: kidlearnV3_uiRouterSafeSwitchMode_(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    checks: {
      initial: initial.success,
      home: home.success,
      subjects: subjects.success,
      children: children.success,
      assignments: assignments.success
    },
    counts: {
      subjects:
        subjects.success && subjects.data
          ? subjects.data.count
          : 0,
      children:
        children.success && children.data
          ? children.data.count
          : 0,
      assignments:
        assignments.success && assignments.data
          ? assignments.data.count
          : 0
    }
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Smoke test UI Router DEV V3 chưa đạt. Errors: ' +

  return result;

/**
 * Public API: lấy initial state cho UI Router.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRouterGetInitialStateV3(request) {
  var safeRequest =
    kidlearnV3_uiRouterNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  var screen =
    kidlearnV3_uiRouterCanonicalScreen_(
      safeRequest.screen || 'HOME'
    );

  var loaded =
    kidlearnV3_uiRouterLoadScreenV3({
      screen: screen,
      childId: safeRequest.childId || '',
      userId: safeRequest.userId || '',
      limit: safeRequest.limit || 100
    });

  if (!loaded.success) {
    return loaded;
  }

  return {
    success: true,
    action: 'UI_ROUTER_INITIAL_STATE_V3',
    mode: kidlearnV3_uiRouterSafeSwitchMode_(),
    currentScreen: loaded.screen,
    navigation: kidlearnV3_uiRouterBuildNavigation_(),
    data: loaded.data,
    route: loaded.route
  };
}


/**
 * Public API: load payload theo màn hình.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRouterLoadScreenV3(request) {
  var safeRequest =
    kidlearnV3_uiRouterNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  var screen =
    kidlearnV3_uiRouterCanonicalScreen_(
      safeRequest.screen
    );

  if (!screen) {
    return kidlearnV3_uiRouterFailure_(
      'UNKNOWN',
      'UNKNOWN_SCREEN',
      'Screen không được hỗ trợ: ' +
      String(safeRequest.screen || '')
    );
  }

  var checks =
    kidlearnV3_uiRouterCheckDependencies_();

  if (checks.errorCount > 0) {
    return kidlearnV3_uiRouterFailure_(
      screen,
      'ROUTER_NOT_READY',
      checks.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var screenResponse =
    kidlearnV3_uiGetScreenPayloadV3({
      screen: screen,
      childId: safeRequest.childId || '',
      userId: safeRequest.userId || '',
      limit: safeRequest.limit || 100
    });

  if (!screenResponse.success) {
    return kidlearnV3_uiRouterFromScreenError_(
      screen,
      screenResponse
    );
  }

  return kidlearnV3_uiRouterSuccess_(
    screen,
    screenResponse.data,
    safeRequest
  );
}


/**
 * Canonical screen name.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRouterCanonicalScreen_(
  screen
) {
  var value =
    String(screen || 'HOME')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    value === '' ||
    value === 'INDEX' ||
    value === 'MAIN'
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_UI_ROUTER_SCREENS.HOME;
  }

  if (
    value === KIDLEARN_V3_UI_ROUTER_SCREENS.HOME ||
    value === 'DASHBOARD'
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_UI_ROUTER_SCREENS.HOME;
  }

  if (
    value === KIDLEARN_V3_UI_ROUTER_SCREENS.SUBJECTS ||
    value === 'SUBJECT'
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_UI_ROUTER_SCREENS.SUBJECTS;
  }

  if (
    value === KIDLEARN_V3_UI_ROUTER_SCREENS.CHILDREN ||
    value === 'CHILD' ||
    value === 'KIDS'
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_UI_ROUTER_SCREENS.CHILDREN;
  }

  if (
    value === KIDLEARN_V3_UI_ROUTER_SCREENS.ASSIGNMENTS ||
    value === 'TASKS' ||
    value === 'TASK'
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_UI_ROUTER_SCREENS.ASSIGNMENTS;
  }

  return '';
}

    }
  ];
}


/**
 * Metadata theo screen.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRouterGetRouteMeta_(
  screen
) {
  var navigation =
    kidlearnV3_uiRouterBuildNavigation_();

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < navigation.length;
    i++
  ) {
    if (navigation[i].screen === screen) {
      return navigation[i];
    }
  }

  return {
    screen: screen,
    title: screen,
    icon: '',
    description: ''
  };
}


/**
 * Response success.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRouterSuccess_(
  screen,
  data,
  request
) {
  return {
    success: true,
    action: 'UI_ROUTER_LOAD_SCREEN_V3',
    mode: kidlearnV3_uiRouterSafeSwitchMode_(),
    screen: screen,
    route: kidlearnV3_uiRouterGetRouteMeta_(screen),
    schemaVersion: KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
    appVersion: KIDLEARN_V3.APP_VERSION,
    request: {
      childId: request.childId || '',
      userId: request.userId || '',
      limit: request.limit || 100
    },
    data: data || {}
  };
}


/**
 * Response failure.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRouterFailure_(
  screen,
  code,
  message
) {
  return {
    success: false,
    action: 'UI_ROUTER_LOAD_SCREEN_V3',
    mode: kidlearnV3_uiRouterSafeSwitchMode_(),
    screen: screen,
    schemaVersion: KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
    error: {
      code: code,
      message: message
    }
  };
}


/**
 * Convert screen mapper error.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRouterFromScreenError_(
  screen,
  response
) {
  var code =
    response &&
    response.error &&
    response.error.code
      ? response.error.code
      : 'SCREEN_MAPPER_ERROR';

  var message =
    response &&
    response.error &&
    response.error.message
      ? response.error.message
      : 'Screen Mapper trả về lỗi.';

  return kidlearnV3_uiRouterFailure_(
    screen,
    code,
    message
  );
}


/**
 * Normalize request.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRouterNormalizeRequest_(
  request
) {
  if (!request) {
    return {};
  }

  if (
    typeof request !== 'object'
  ) {
    return {
      screen: String(request || '')
    };
  }

  return request;
}


/**
 * Check dependencies.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRouterCheckDependencies_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  kidlearnV3_uiRouterRequireFunction_(
    'kidlearnV3_uiGetScreenPayloadV3',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiRouterRequireFunction_(
    'kidlearnV3_uiGetHomePayloadV3',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiRouterRequireFunction_(
    'kidlearnV3_uiGetSubjectsPayloadV3',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiRouterRequireFunction_(
    'kidlearnV3_uiGetChildrenPayloadV3',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiRouterRequireFunction_(
    'kidlearnV3_uiGetAssignmentsPayloadV3',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiRouterRequireFunction_(
    'kidlearnV3_uiSwitchGetModeV3',
    errors
  );

  var mode =
    kidlearnV3_uiRouterSafeSwitchMode_();

  if (mode !== 'V3') {
    errors.push(
      'DEV_SWITCH chưa bật V3. Mode hiện tại: ' +
      mode
    );
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Require function.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRouterRequireFunction_(
  functionName,
  errors
) {
  var exists = false;

  try {
    exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );
  } catch (error) {
    exists = false;
  }

  if (!exists) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu function: ' +
      functionName
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Safe get switch mode.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRouterSafeSwitchMode_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_uiSwitchGetModeV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return 'UNKNOWN';
  }
}


/**
 * Assert response cho smoke test.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiRouterAssertResponse_(
  response,
  label,
  errors
) {
  if (!response) {
    errors.push(
      label + ': response trống.'
    );

    return;
  }

  if (response.success !== true) {
    var message =
      response.error && response.error.message
        ? response.error.message
        : 'Không rõ lỗi.';

    errors.push(
      label + ': ' + message
    );
  }
}

/**

var KIDLEARN_V3_SCREEN_KEYS = {
  HOME: 'HOME',
  DASHBOARD: 'DASHBOARD',
  SUBJECTS: 'SUBJECTS',
  CHILDREN: 'CHILDREN',
  ASSIGNMENTS: 'ASSIGNMENTS',
  CONFIG: 'CONFIG'
};


/**
 * Preview UI Screen Mapper V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewUiScreenMapperV3() {
  var checks =
    kidlearnV3_uiScreenCheckDependencies_();

  var result = {
    success: checks.errorCount === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_UI_SCREEN_MAPPER_V3',
    errorCount: checks.errorCount,
    warningCount: checks.warningCount,
    errors: checks.errors,
    warnings: checks.warnings,
    availableScreens: [
      KIDLEARN_V3_SCREEN_KEYS.HOME,
      KIDLEARN_V3_SCREEN_KEYS.DASHBOARD,
      KIDLEARN_V3_SCREEN_KEYS.SUBJECTS,
      KIDLEARN_V3_SCREEN_KEYS.CHILDREN,
      KIDLEARN_V3_SCREEN_KEYS.ASSIGNMENTS,
      KIDLEARN_V3_SCREEN_KEYS.CONFIG
    ],
    publicFunctions: [
      'kidlearnV3_uiGetScreenPayloadV3',
      'kidlearnV3_uiGetHomePayloadV3',
      'kidlearnV3_uiGetDashboardPayloadV3',
      'kidlearnV3_uiGetSubjectsPayloadV3',
      'kidlearnV3_uiGetChildrenPayloadV3',
      'kidlearnV3_uiGetAssignmentsPayloadV3'
    ]
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Smoke test UI Screen Mapper V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_smokeTestUiScreenMapperV3() {
  var home =
    kidlearnV3_uiGetHomePayloadV3({});

  var dashboard =
    kidlearnV3_uiGetDashboardPayloadV3({});

  var subjects =
    kidlearnV3_uiGetSubjectsPayloadV3({});

  var children =
    kidlearnV3_uiGetChildrenPayloadV3({});

  var assignments =
    kidlearnV3_uiGetAssignmentsPayloadV3({});

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  kidlearnV3_uiScreenAssertResponse_(
    home,
    'HOME',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiScreenAssertResponse_(
    dashboard,
    'DASHBOARD',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiScreenAssertResponse_(
    subjects,
    'SUBJECTS',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiScreenAssertResponse_(
    children,
    'CHILDREN',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_uiScreenAssertResponse_(
    assignments,
    'ASSIGNMENTS',
    errors
  );

  if (
    subjects.success &&
    subjects.data.count < 4
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'SUBJECTS phải có ít nhất 4 môn học.'
    );
  }

  if (
    children.success &&
    children.data.count < 1
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'CHILDREN phải có ít nhất 1 child.'
    );
  }

  if (
    assignments.success &&
    assignments.data.count < 1
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'ASSIGNMENTS đang trống hoặc chưa gắn với child hiện tại.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'SMOKE_TEST_UI_SCREEN_MAPPER_V3',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    counts: {
      subjects:
        subjects.success
          ? subjects.data.count
          : 0,
      children:
        children.success
          ? children.data.count
          : 0,
      assignments:
        assignments.success
          ? assignments.data.count
          : 0
    }
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Smoke test UI Screen Mapper V3 chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      errors.length
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Public API chính cho UI cũ DEV.
 *
 * UI gọi:
 * kidlearnV3_uiGetScreenPayloadV3({
 *   screen: 'HOME',
 *   childId: '',
 *   userId: ''
 * })
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiGetScreenPayloadV3(request) {
  var safeRequest =
    kidlearnV3_uiScreenNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  var screen =
    String(safeRequest.screen || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    screen === '' ||
    screen === KIDLEARN_V3_SCREEN_KEYS.HOME
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_uiGetHomePayloadV3(
      safeRequest
    );
  }

  if (
    screen === KIDLEARN_V3_SCREEN_KEYS.DASHBOARD
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_uiGetDashboardPayloadV3(
      safeRequest
    );
  }

  if (
    screen === KIDLEARN_V3_SCREEN_KEYS.SUBJECTS
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_uiGetSubjectsPayloadV3(
      safeRequest
    );
  }

  if (
    screen === KIDLEARN_V3_SCREEN_KEYS.CHILDREN
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_uiGetChildrenPayloadV3(
      safeRequest
    );
  }

  if (
    screen === KIDLEARN_V3_SCREEN_KEYS.ASSIGNMENTS
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_uiGetAssignmentsPayloadV3(
      safeRequest
    );
  }

  if (
    screen === KIDLEARN_V3_SCREEN_KEYS.CONFIG
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_uiGetConfigPayloadV3(
      safeRequest
    );
  }

  return kidlearnV3_uiScreenFailure_(
    screen,
    'UNKNOWN_SCREEN',
    'Screen không được hỗ trợ: ' + screen
  );
}


/**
 * Home payload cho UI cũ.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiGetHomePayloadV3(request) {
  var response =
    kidlearnV3_uiApiDispatchV3({
      action: 'BOOTSTRAP',
      payload: request || {}
    });

  if (!response.success) {
    return kidlearnV3_uiScreenFromServiceError_(
      'HOME',
      response
    );
  }

  var data =
    response.data || {};

  var mapped =
    kidlearnV3_uiScreenMapHome_(
      data
    );

  return kidlearnV3_uiScreenSuccess_(
    'HOME',
    mapped
  );
}

  var response =

/**
 * Map Home.
 */
function kidlearnV3_uiScreenMapHome_(
  data
) {
  var selectedChild =
    data.selectedChild || null;

  var dashboard =
    data.dashboard || {};

  return {
    app: {
      databaseMode:
        data.databaseMode || 'V3',
      schemaVersion:
        data.schemaVersion || '',
      appVersion:
        data.appVersion || ''
    },

    counts:
      data.counts || {},

    currentChild:
      kidlearnV3_uiScreenMapChildItem_(
        selectedChild
      ),

    dashboard: {
      subjectCount:
        dashboard.subjectCount || 0,
      assignmentCount:
        dashboard.assignmentCount || 0,
      activeAssignmentCount:
        dashboard.activeAssignmentCount || 0,
      completedAssignmentCount:
        dashboard.completedAssignmentCount || 0,
      overdueAssignmentCount:
        dashboard.overdueAssignmentCount || 0,
      completionPercent:
        dashboard.completionPercent || 0
    },

    subjects:
      kidlearnV3_uiScreenMapSubjectList_(
        data.subjects || []
      ),

    children:
      kidlearnV3_uiScreenMapChildList_(
        data.children || []
      ),

    assignments:
      kidlearnV3_uiScreenMapAssignmentList_(
        data.assignments || []
      ),

    config:
      data.config || {}
  };
}

    subjects:

      )
  };
}

function kidlearnV3_uiScreenCheckDependencies_() {
  var errors = [];

  var mode =

  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được DEV_SWITCH mode: ' +

    );

  if (mode !== 'V3') {
    errors.push(

    );

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,

  };
}

/**
 * Preview 3L-A.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewAppShell3LAV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var functionChecks =
    kidlearnV3_3laCheckFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3KClosedV3',
      'kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_',
      'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_buildLearningScreen3KBV3',
      'kidlearnV3_uiInclude_',
      'kidlearnV3_runQaBatchProvidedStepsV3'
    ]);

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      functionChecks.errors
    );

  var htmlChecks =
    kidlearnV3_3laCheckHtmlFiles_([
      'UI_App_Shell_3LA_Client_V3',
      'UI_App_Shell_3LA'
    ]);

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      htmlChecks.errors
    );

  var phase3K =
    kidlearnV3_3laSafeAssertPhase3KClosed_();

  if (!phase3K.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 3K chưa CLOSED_LOCKED: ' +
      phase3K.message
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3laSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3L-A yêu cầu Safe Write DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var dataSummary = null;

  try {
    if (errors.length === 0) {
      dataSummary =
        kidlearnV3_3laGetDataSummary_();

      if (dataSummary.childrenCount < 1) {
        errors.push(
          'DATA_Children chưa có child.'
        );
      }

      if (dataSummary.usersCount < 1) {
        warnings.push(
          'DATA_Users chưa có user. 3L-A sẽ dùng DEV role fallback.'
        );
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được data summary 3L-A: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_APP_SHELL_3LA_V3',
    bundle: '3L-A',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    readOnly: true,
    writeEnabled: false,
    allowedRoles:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_CONFIG.ALLOWED_ROLES,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3K: phase3K,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite,
    functionChecks: functionChecks.items,
    htmlChecks: htmlChecks.items,
    dataSummary: dataSummary
  };

  kidlearnV3_3laSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_STATUS.PREVIEWED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Build App Shell context.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildAppShellContext3LAV3(request) {
  var req =
    kidlearnV3_3laNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewAppShell3LAV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể build App Shell 3L-A vì preview chưa đạt. Errors=' +
      preview.errorCount +
      '. ' +
      preview.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var data =
    kidlearnV3_3laReadBaseData_();

  var role =
    kidlearnV3_3laResolveRole_(
      req,
      data
    );

  var activeUser =
    kidlearnV3_3laResolveUser_(
      req,
      data,
      role
    );

  var activeChild =
    kidlearnV3_3laResolveChild_(
      req,
      data,
      activeUser
    );

  var navigation =
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_NAV[role] || [];

  var learningSummary =
    kidlearnV3_3laBuildLearningSummary_(
      activeChild,
      req
    );

  var shell = {
    success: true,
    action: 'BUILD_APP_SHELL_CONTEXT_3LA_V3',
    bundle: '3L-A',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_CONFIG.PHASE,
    screenId:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_CONFIG.SCREEN_ID,
    generatedAt:
      new Date().toISOString(),
    readOnly: true,
    writeEnabled: false,
    role: role,
    session: {
      role: role,
      userId:
        activeUser.userId || '',
      userName:
        activeUser.fullName ||
        activeUser.userName ||
        activeUser.displayName ||
        'DEV User',
      childId:
        activeChild.childId || '',
      childName:
        activeChild.childName ||
        activeChild.fullName ||
        'Kid Learner',
      gradeLevel:
        activeChild.gradeLevel ||
        activeChild.grade ||
        '2',
      locale: 'vi-VN'
    },
    roleConfig:
      kidlearnV3_3laBuildRoleConfig_(
        role
      ),
    navigation: navigation,
    header:
      kidlearnV3_3laBuildHeader_(
        role,
        activeUser,
        activeChild
      ),
    homeCards:
      kidlearnV3_3laBuildHomeCards_(
        role,
        learningSummary
      ),
    quickActions:
      kidlearnV3_3laBuildQuickActions_(
        role
      ),
    learningSummary: learningSummary,
    guards: {
      phase3KClosed: true,
      readOnly: true,
      writeEnabled: false,
      safeWriteExpectedMode: 'DRY_RUN',
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      prodTouched: false
    },
    diagnostics: {
      usersCount: data.users.length,
      childrenCount: data.children.length,
      accessCount: data.access.length,
      role: role,
      navCount: navigation.length,
      homeCardCount:
        kidlearnV3_3laBuildHomeCards_(
          role,
          learningSummary
        ).length
    }
  };

  kidlearnV3_3laSaveResult_(
    {
      success: true,
      action: shell.action,
      bundle: shell.bundle,
      phase: shell.phase,
      errorCount: 0,
      warningCount: 0,
      diagnostics: shell.diagnostics
    },
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_STATUS.SHELL_BUILT,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_KEYS.LAST_BUILD_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(shell, null, 2)
  );

  return shell;
}


/**
 * Open App Shell UI 3L-A.
 */
function kidlearnV3_showAppShell3LAV3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewAppShell3LAV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'App Shell 3L-A chưa sẵn sàng. Errors=' +

/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_uiAppShell3LAGetContextV3(request) {

  );

/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_uiAppShell3LAGetScreenPayloadV3(request) {

    );

    generatedAt:
      new Date().toISOString(),
    shellSession:
      shell.session,
    content:

      ),

  };

  console.log(

  );

/**
 * Smoke test App Shell 3L-A.
 */
function kidlearnV3_smokeTestAppShell3LAV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewAppShell3LAV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể smoke test 3L-A vì preview chưa đạt. Errors=' +
      preview.errorCount
    );
  }

  var familyShell =
    kidlearnV3_buildAppShellContext3LAV3({
      role: 'FAMILY_ADMIN'
    });

  var childShell =
    kidlearnV3_buildAppShellContext3LAV3({
      role: 'CHILD'
    });

  if (!familyShell.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Build FAMILY_ADMIN shell không success.'
    );
  }

  if (!childShell.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Build CHILD shell không success.'
    );
  }

  if (familyShell.role !== 'FAMILY_ADMIN') {
    errors.push(
      'FAMILY_ADMIN shell role sai: ' +
      familyShell.role
    );
  }

  if (childShell.role !== 'CHILD') {
    errors.push(
      'CHILD shell role sai: ' +
      childShell.role
    );
  }

  if (
    !familyShell.navigation ||
    familyShell.navigation.length < 1
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'FAMILY_ADMIN shell thiếu navigation.'
    );
  }

  if (
    !childShell.navigation ||
    childShell.navigation.length < 1
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'CHILD shell thiếu navigation.'
    );
  }

  if (familyShell.writeEnabled !== false) {
    errors.push(
      '3L-A FAMILY_ADMIN shell phải writeEnabled=false.'
    );
  }

  if (childShell.writeEnabled !== false) {
    errors.push(
      '3L-A CHILD shell phải writeEnabled=false.'
    );
  }

  var learningPayload =
    kidlearnV3_uiAppShell3LAGetScreenPayloadV3({
      role: 'CHILD',
      screenId: 'LEARNING_HOME_V3'
    });

  if (!learningPayload.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không build được LEARNING_HOME_V3 payload.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'SMOKE_TEST_APP_SHELL_3LA_V3',
    bundle: '3L-A',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    readOnly: true,
    writeEnabled: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    diagnostics: {
      familyNavCount:
        familyShell.navigation
          ? familyShell.navigation.length
          : 0,
      childNavCount:
        childShell.navigation
          ? childShell.navigation.length
          : 0,
      familyCardsCount:
        familyShell.homeCards
          ? familyShell.homeCards.length
          : 0,
      childCardsCount:
        childShell.homeCards
          ? childShell.homeCards.length
          : 0
    }
  };

  kidlearnV3_3laSaveResult_(
    result,
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_STATUS.SMOKE_TESTED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_KEYS.LAST_SMOKE_TEST_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Smoke test 3L-A failed. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Mark 3L-A ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markAppShell3LAReadyV3() {
  var smoke =
    kidlearnV3_smokeTestAppShell3LAV3();

  if (!smoke.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark 3L-A ready vì smoke test chưa pass.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_APP_SHELL_3LA_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3L-A',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:

    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    message:
      '3L-A ready. Có thể chuyển sang 3L-B để tối ưu lesson content rendering.'
  };

  kidlearnV3_3laSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_STATUS.READY_FOR_3L_B,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}

/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_assertAppShell3LAReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getAppShell3LAStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (

    status: status.status,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)

  if (!result.success) {

}
