/**
 * Build role config.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laBuildRoleConfig_(role) {
  if (role === 'CHILD') {
    return {
      role: 'CHILD',
      homeTitle: 'Con học hôm nay',
      showChildSelector: false,
      showAdminPanels: false,
      showLearningActions: true,
      theme: 'child',
      defaultScreenId: 'CHILD_HOME'
    };
  }

  return {
    role: 'FAMILY_ADMIN',
    homeTitle: 'Gia đình quản lý học tập',
    showChildSelector: true,
    showAdminPanels: true,
    showLearningActions: false,
    theme: 'family',
    defaultScreenId: 'FAMILY_HOME'
  };
}


/**
 * Build header.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laBuildHeader_(
  role,
  user,
  child
) {
  return {
    appName: 'KIDLEARN V3',
    role: role,
    title:
      role === 'CHILD'
        ? 'Xin chào ' +
          (
            child.childName ||
            child.fullName ||
            'con'
          )
        : 'Quản lý học tập gia đình',
    subtitle:
      role === 'CHILD'
        ? 'Hôm nay mình cùng học vui nhé.'
        : 'Theo dõi bài học, nhiệm vụ và tiến độ của con.',
    userName:
      user.fullName ||
      user.userName ||
      user.displayName ||
      'DEV User',
    childName:
      child.childName ||
      child.fullName ||
      'Kid Learner',
    gradeLevel:
      child.gradeLevel ||
      child.grade ||
      '2'
  };
}


/**
 * Build home cards.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laBuildHomeCards_(
  role,
  learningSummary
) {
  if (role === 'CHILD') {
    return [
      {
        cardId: 'continue_learning',
        title: 'Học tiếp',
        value:
          learningSummary.selectedLessonTitle ||
          'Chọn bài học',
        description: 'Mở bài học gần nhất hoặc bài đầu tiên.',
        screenId: 'LEARNING_HOME_V3',
        emphasis: true
      },
      {
        cardId: 'today_goal',
        title: 'Mục tiêu hôm nay',
        value:
          String(
            learningSummary.dailyGoalMinutes || 20
          ) + ' phút',
        description: 'Cố gắng hoàn thành mục tiêu học hôm nay.',
        screenId: 'PROGRESS_HOME',
        emphasis: false
      },
      {
        cardId: 'achievement',
        title: 'Thành tích',
        value: '⭐',
        description: 'Xem huy hiệu và phần thưởng.',
        screenId: 'ACHIEVEMENTS_HOME',
        emphasis: false
      }
    ];
  }

  return [
    {
      cardId: 'child_progress',
      title: 'Tiến độ học',
      value:
        String(
          learningSummary.progressPercent || 0
        ) + '%',
      description: 'Xem nhanh tiến độ bài học của con.',
      screenId: 'PROGRESS_HOME',
      emphasis: true
    },
    {
      cardId: 'assignments',
      title: 'Nhiệm vụ',
      value:
        String(
          learningSummary.assignmentsCount || 0
        ),
      description: 'Theo dõi nhiệm vụ đang giao.',
      screenId: 'ASSIGNMENTS_HOME',
      emphasis: false
    },
    {
      cardId: 'subjects',
      title: 'Môn học',
      value:
        String(
          learningSummary.subjectsCount || 0
        ),
      description: 'Xem các môn học đang có.',
      screenId: 'LEARNING_HOME_V3',
      emphasis: false
    }
  ];
}


/**
 * Build quick actions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laBuildQuickActions_(role) {
  if (role === 'CHILD') {
    return [
      {
        actionId: 'open_learning',
        label: 'Vào học',
        screenId: 'LEARNING_HOME_V3',
        enabled: true,
        writeMode: 'READ_ONLY_3LA'
      },
      {
        actionId: 'open_library',
        label: 'Mở thư viện',
        screenId: 'LIBRARY_HOME',
        enabled: true,
        writeMode: 'READ_ONLY_3LA'
      }
    ];
  }

  return [
    {
      actionId: 'view_progress',
      label: 'Xem tiến độ',
      screenId: 'PROGRESS_HOME',
      enabled: true,
      writeMode: 'READ_ONLY_3LA'
    },
    {
      actionId: 'view_assignments',
      label: 'Xem nhiệm vụ',
      screenId: 'ASSIGNMENTS_HOME',
      enabled: true,
      writeMode: 'READ_ONLY_3LA'
    }
  ];
}


/**
 * Build screen content.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laBuildScreenContent_(
  screenId,
  shell
) {
  if (
    screenId === 'LEARNING_HOME_V3' &&
    typeof kidlearnV3_buildLearningScreen3KBV3 === 'function'
  ) {
    try {
      return {
        contentType: 'LEARNING_SCREEN_PAYLOAD',
        payload:
          kidlearnV3_buildLearningScreen3KBV3({
            childId: shell.session.childId
          })
      };
    } catch (error) {
      return {
        contentType: 'ERROR_PLACEHOLDER',
        title: 'Không mở được Learning screen',
        message:
          String(error.message || error)
      };
    }
  }

  if (
    screenId === 'FAMILY_HOME' ||
    screenId === 'CHILD_HOME' ||
    screenId === 'HOME'
  ) {
    return {
      contentType: 'HOME',
      title: shell.roleConfig.homeTitle,
      cards: shell.homeCards,
      quickActions: shell.quickActions
    };
  }

  return {
    contentType: 'PLACEHOLDER',
    title:
      kidlearnV3_3laFindNavLabel_(
        shell.navigation,
        screenId
      ),
    message:
      'Screen shell đã sẵn sàng. Nội dung chi tiết sẽ được nối ở các bundle sau.',
    screenId: screenId
  };
}


/**
 * Find nav label.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laFindNavLabel_(
  navigation,
  screenId
) {
  for (var i = 0; i < navigation.length; i++) {
    if (navigation[i].screenId === screenId) {
      return navigation[i].label;
    }
  }

  return screenId || 'Screen';
}


/**
 * Build learning summary.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laBuildLearningSummary_(
  activeChild,
  request
) {
  var summary = {
    subjectsCount: 0,
    lessonsCount: 0,
    assignmentsCount: 0,
    progressPercent: 0,
    selectedLessonTitle: '',
    dailyGoalMinutes: 20
  };

  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_buildLearningScreen3KBV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      var screen =
        kidlearnV3_buildLearningScreen3KBV3({
          childId:
            activeChild.childId || '',
          role:
            request.role || ''
        });

      summary.subjectsCount =
        screen.diagnostics
          ? Number(screen.diagnostics.subjectsCount || 0)
          : 0;

      summary.lessonsCount =
        screen.diagnostics
          ? Number(screen.diagnostics.lessonsCount || 0)
          : 0;

      summary.assignmentsCount =
        screen.diagnostics
          ? Number(screen.diagnostics.assignmentsCount || 0)
          : 0;

      summary.progressPercent =
        screen.lessonPlayer &&
        screen.lessonPlayer.lesson
          ? Number(screen.lessonPlayer.lesson.progressPercent || 0)
          : 0;

      summary.selectedLessonTitle =
        screen.lessonPlayer &&
        screen.lessonPlayer.lesson
          ? String(screen.lessonPlayer.lesson.lessonTitle || '')
          : '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    summary.warning =
      String(error.message || error);
  }

  return summary;
}


/**
 * Resolve role.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laResolveRole_(
  request,
  data
) {
  var role =
    String(request.role || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  if (
    role === 'CHILD' ||
    role === 'FAMILY_ADMIN'
  ) {
    return role;
  }

  if (
    data.users.length > 0 &&
    data.users[0].role
  ) {
    var userRole =
      String(data.users[0].role || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    if (
      userRole === 'CHILD' ||
      userRole === 'FAMILY_ADMIN'
    ) {
      return userRole;
    }
  }

  return 'FAMILY_ADMIN';
}


/**
 * Resolve user.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laResolveUser_(
  request,
  data,
  role
) {
  var userId =
    String(request.userId || '').trim();

  for (var i = 0; i < data.users.length; i++) {
    if (
      userId &&
      String(data.users[i].userId || '') === userId
    ) {
      return data.users[i];
    }
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < data.users.length; j++) {
    var rowRole =
      String(data.users[j].role || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    if (rowRole === role) {
      return data.users[j];
    }
  }

  return data.users[0] || {
    userId: 'DEV_USER_3LA',
    fullName: 'DEV User',
    role: role
  };
}


/**
 * Resolve child.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laResolveChild_(
  request,
  data,
  activeUser
) {
  var childId =
    String(request.childId || '').trim();

  for (var i = 0; i < data.children.length; i++) {
    if (
      childId &&
      String(data.children[i].childId || '') === childId
    ) {
      return data.children[i];
    }
  }

  var userId =
    String(activeUser.userId || '').trim();

  if (userId) {
    for (var a = 0; a < data.access.length; a++) {
      if (
        String(data.access[a].userId || '') === userId &&
        data.access[a].childId
      ) {
        var accessChildId =
          String(data.access[a].childId || '');

        for (var c = 0; c < data.children.length; c++) {
          if (
            String(data.children[c].childId || '') === accessChildId
          ) {
            return data.children[c];
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return data.children[0] || {
    childId: 'DEV_CHILD_3LA',
    childName: 'Kid Learner',
    gradeLevel: '2'
  };
}


/**
 * Get data summary.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laGetDataSummary_() {
  var data =
    kidlearnV3_3laReadBaseData_();

  return {
    usersCount: data.users.length,
    childrenCount: data.children.length,
    accessCount: data.access.length
  };
}


/**
 * Read base data.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laReadBaseData_() {
  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3laGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  return {
    users:
      kidlearnV3_3laReadRows_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_Users'
      ),
    children:
      kidlearnV3_3laReadRows_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_Children'
      ),
    access:
      kidlearnV3_3laReadRows_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_UserChildAccess'
      )
  };
}


/**
 * Read rows using row 2 as keys.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laReadRows_(
  spreadsheet,
  sheetName
) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_3laGetSheet_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return [];
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (
    lastRow < 3 ||
    lastColumn < 1
  ) {
    return [];
  }

  var keys =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        2,
        1,
        1,
        lastColumn
      )
      .getDisplayValues()[0];

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        3,
        1,
        lastRow - 2,
        lastColumn
      )
      .getDisplayValues();

  var rows = [];

  for (var r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
    var row = {};
    var hasValue = false;

    for (var c = 0; c < keys.length; c++) {
      var key =
        String(keys[c] || '').trim();

      if (!key) {
        continue;
      }

      row[key] =
        values[r][c];

      if (values[r][c] !== '') {
        hasValue = true;
      }
    }

    if (hasValue) {
      rows.push(row);
    }
  }

  return rows;
}


/**
 * Database spreadsheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_() {
  var database =
    kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_();

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3laResolveSpreadsheet_(
      database
    );

  if (!spreadsheet) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không resolve được Spreadsheet object từ Database V3.'
    );
  }

  return spreadsheet;
}


/**
 * Resolve Spreadsheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laResolveSpreadsheet_(value) {
  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (
    typeof value.getSheets === 'function' &&
    typeof value.getId === 'function'
  ) {
    return value;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheet &&
    typeof value.spreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheet;
  }

  if (
    value.database &&
    typeof value.database.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.database;
  }

  if (
    value.db &&
    typeof value.db.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.db;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheetObject &&
    typeof value.spreadsheetObject.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheetObject;
  }

  if (
    value.activeSpreadsheet &&
    typeof value.activeSpreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.activeSpreadsheet;
  }

  if (value.spreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.spreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (value.databaseSpreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.databaseSpreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (
    value.id &&
    typeof value.id === 'string'
  ) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.id
    );
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Get exact sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laGetSheet_(
  spreadsheet,
  sheetName
) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laCheckFunctions_(
  names
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          names[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: names[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        names[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Check HTML files.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laCheckHtmlFiles_(
  filenames
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < filenames.length; i++) {
    try {
      var content =
        HtmlService
          .createHtmlOutputFromFile(
            filenames[i]
          )
          .getContent();

      items.push({
        name: filenames[i],
        exists: true,
        length: content.length
      });

    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu HTML file: ' +
        filenames[i]
      );

      items.push({
        name: filenames[i],
        exists: false,
        error:
          String(error.message || error)
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Safe assert Phase 3K closed.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laSafeAssertPhase3KClosed_() {
  try {
    var result =
      kidlearnV3_assertPhase3KClosedV3();

    return {
      success: result.success === true,
      message: ''
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laSafeWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Save result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laSaveResult_(
  result,
  status,
  dateKey
) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var currentStatus =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_KEYS.STATUS
    ) || '';

  var finalStatus =
    status;

  if (
    currentStatus ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_STATUS.READY_FOR_3L_B &&
    (
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_STATUS.PREVIEWED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_STATUS.SHELL_BUILT ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_STATUS.SMOKE_TESTED
    )
  ) {
    finalStatus =
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_STATUS.READY_FOR_3L_B;
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_KEYS.STATUS,
    finalStatus
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      bundle: result.bundle,
      phase: result.phase,
      status: finalStatus,
      originalRequestedStatus: status,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      diagnostics: result.diagnostics || null,
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


/**
 * Read last result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laReadLastResult_() {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON
      );

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Normalize request.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3laNormalizeRequest_(request) {
  if (!request) {
    return {};
  }

  if (typeof request !== 'object') {
    return {
      value: request
    };
  }

  return request;
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * 3L-A ULTRA LITE QA / MARK READY
 * Purpose:
 * - Tránh chạy smoke test nặng.
 * - Chỉ kiểm tra các điều kiện cốt lõi.
 * - Không ghi DB.
 * ================================================================
 */


/**
 * Smoke test 3L-A ultra lite.
 */
function kidlearnV3_smokeTestAppShell3LAUltraLiteV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var phase3K =
    kidlearnV3_3laSafeAssertPhase3KClosed_();

  if (!phase3K.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 3K chưa CLOSED_LOCKED: ' +
      phase3K.message
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3laSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3L-A yêu cầu Safe Write DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var htmlChecks =
    kidlearnV3_3laCheckHtmlFiles_([
      'UI_App_Shell_3LA_Client_V3',
      'UI_App_Shell_3LA'
    ]);

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      htmlChecks.errors
    );

  var dataSummary = null;

  try {
    dataSummary =
      kidlearnV3_3laGetDataSummary_();

    if (dataSummary.childrenCount < 1) {
      errors.push(
        'DATA_Children chưa có child.'
      );
    }

    if (dataSummary.usersCount < 1) {
      warnings.push(
        'DATA_Users chưa có user. 3L-A dùng DEV fallback.'
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được data summary 3L-A: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var familyShell = null;
  var childShell = null;

  try {
    familyShell =
      kidlearnV3_buildAppShellContext3LAUltraLiteV3({
        role: 'FAMILY_ADMIN'
      });

    childShell =
      kidlearnV3_buildAppShellContext3LAUltraLiteV3({
        role: 'CHILD'
      });

    if (familyShell.role !== 'FAMILY_ADMIN') {
      errors.push(
        'FAMILY_ADMIN shell role sai: ' +
        familyShell.role
      );
    }

    if (childShell.role !== 'CHILD') {
      errors.push(
        'CHILD shell role sai: ' +
        childShell.role
      );
    }

    if (
      !familyShell.navigation ||
      familyShell.navigation.length < 1
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'FAMILY_ADMIN shell thiếu navigation.'
      );
    }

    if (
      !childShell.navigation ||
      childShell.navigation.length < 1
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'CHILD shell thiếu navigation.'
      );
    }

    if (
      familyShell.writeEnabled !== false ||
      childShell.writeEnabled !== false
    ) {
      errors.push(
        '3L-A shell phải writeEnabled=false.'
      );
    }

  } catch (shellError) {
    errors.push(
      'Không build được App Shell ultra lite: ' +
      String(shellError.message || shellError)
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'SMOKE_TEST_APP_SHELL_3LA_ULTRA_LITE_V3',
    bundle: '3L-A',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    readOnly: true,
    writeEnabled: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    dataSummary: dataSummary,
    diagnostics: {
      familyNavCount:
        familyShell && familyShell.navigation
          ? familyShell.navigation.length
          : 0,
      childNavCount:
        childShell && childShell.navigation
          ? childShell.navigation.length
          : 0
    }
  };

  kidlearnV3_3laSaveResult_(
    result,
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_STATUS.SMOKE_TESTED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_KEYS.LAST_SMOKE_TEST_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3L-A Ultra Lite smoke failed. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Build App Shell context ultra lite.
 *
 * Không gọi previewAppShell3LAV3 để tránh lặp nặng.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildAppShellContext3LAUltraLiteV3(request) {
  var req =
    kidlearnV3_3laNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  var data =
    kidlearnV3_3laReadBaseData_();

  var role =
    kidlearnV3_3laResolveRole_(
      req,
      data
    );

  var activeUser =
    kidlearnV3_3laResolveUser_(
      req,
      data,
      role
    );

  var activeChild =
    kidlearnV3_3laResolveChild_(
      req,
      data,
      activeUser
    );

  var navigation =
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_NAV[role] || [];

  var learningSummary = {
    subjectsCount: 0,
    lessonsCount: 0,
    assignmentsCount: 0,
    progressPercent: 0,
    selectedLessonTitle: '',
    dailyGoalMinutes: 20,
    mode: 'ULTRA_LITE'
  };

  var shell = {
    success: true,
    action: 'BUILD_APP_SHELL_CONTEXT_3LA_ULTRA_LITE_V3',
    bundle: '3L-A',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_CONFIG.PHASE,
    screenId:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_SHELL_3LA_CONFIG.SCREEN_ID,
    generatedAt:
      new Date().toISOString(),
    readOnly: true,
    writeEnabled: false,
    role: role,
    session: {
      role: role,
      userId:
        activeUser.userId || '',
      userName:
        activeUser.fullName ||
        activeUser.userName ||
        activeUser.displayName ||
        'DEV User',
      childId:
        activeChild.childId || '',
      childName:
        activeChild.childName ||
        activeChild.fullName ||
        'Kid Learner',
      gradeLevel:
        activeChild.gradeLevel ||
        activeChild.grade ||
        '2',
      locale: 'vi-VN'
    },
    roleConfig:
      kidlearnV3_3laBuildRoleConfig_(
        role
      ),
    navigation: navigation,
    header:
      kidlearnV3_3laBuildHeader_(
        role,
        activeUser,
        activeChild
      ),
    homeCards:
      kidlearnV3_3laBuildHomeCards_(
        role,
        learningSummary
      ),
    quickActions:
      kidlearnV3_3laBuildQuickActions_(
        role
      ),
    learningSummary: learningSummary,
    guards: {
      phase3KClosed: true,
      readOnly: true,
      writeEnabled: false,
      safeWriteExpectedMode: 'DRY_RUN',
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      prodTouched: false
    },
    diagnostics: {
      usersCount: data.users.length,
      childrenCount: data.children.length,
      accessCount: data.access.length,
      role: role,
      navCount: navigation.length
    }
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(shell, null, 2)
  );

  return shell;
}

/**
 * Preview Write Router V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewWriteRouterV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions = [
    'kidlearnV3_previewWriteServiceFacadeV3',
    'kidlearnV3_writeServiceDispatchV3',
    'kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetSampleContextV3',
    'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3'
  ];

  var functionChecks =
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterCheckFunctions_(
      requiredFunctions
    );

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      functionChecks.errors
    );

  var htmlChecks =
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterCheckHtmlFiles_([
      'UI_Write_Router_Client_V3',
      'UI_Write_Router_Test_V3'
    ]);

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      htmlChecks.errors
    );

  var phase3I =
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterSafePhase3IAssert_();

  if (!phase3I.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 3I chưa đóng đúng điều kiện cho 3J: ' +
      phase3I.message
    );
  }

  var writeServiceStatus =
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterSafeWriteServiceStatus_();

  if (!writeServiceStatus.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Write Service Facade chưa sẵn sàng.'
    );
  }

  var safeWriteMode =
    writeServiceStatus.success &&
    writeServiceStatus.data &&
    writeServiceStatus.data.safeWriteStatus
      ? writeServiceStatus.data.safeWriteStatus.mode
      : '';

  if (safeWriteMode !== 'DRY_RUN') {
    warnings.push(
      'Safe Write Layer hiện không phải DRY_RUN. Mode hiện tại: ' +
      safeWriteMode +
      '. 3J.3 vẫn sẽ ép DRY_RUN_ONLY.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_WRITE_ROUTER_V3',
    phase: '3J.3',
    routerVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_ROUTER_CONFIG.VERSION,
    dryRunOnly:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_ROUTER_CONFIG.DRY_RUN_ONLY,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3I: phase3I,
    writeServiceStatus: {
      success: writeServiceStatus.success,
      safeWriteMode: safeWriteMode
    },
    functionChecks:
      functionChecks.items,
    htmlChecks:
      htmlChecks.items,
    routes:
      kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetRoutes_()
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Smoke test Write Router V3.
 *
 * Chỉ DRY_RUN.
 */
function kidlearnV3_smokeTestWriteRouterV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetStatusV3({});

  var sample =
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetSampleContextV3({});

  var context =
    sample.success && sample.data
      ? sample.data.sampleContext || {}
      : {};

  var tests = [];

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterAuditEventV3({
      payload: {
        eventType: 'WRITE_ROUTER_SMOKE_TEST',
        message: 'Dry-run audit from Write Router 3J.3',
        entityType: 'PHASE',
        entityId: '3J.3'
      },
      dryRun: true
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterStudyStartV3({
      payload: {
        childId: context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID',
        subjectId: context.subjectId || '',
        lessonId: context.lessonId || 'DRY_RUN_LESSON_ID'
      },
      dryRun: true
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterStudyFinishV3({
      payload: {
        studySessionId: 'DRY_RUN_STUDY_SESSION_ID',
        durationSeconds: 300
      },
      dryRun: true
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterLessonProgressSaveV3({
      payload: {
        childId: context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID',
        subjectId: context.subjectId || '',
        lessonId: context.lessonId || 'DRY_RUN_LESSON_ID',
        progressPercent: 30
      },
      dryRun: true
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterDailyGoalSaveV3({
      payload: {
        childId: context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID',
        goalDate: kidlearnV3_writeRouterToday_(),
        targetMinutes: 20,
        completedMinutes: 5
      },
      dryRun: true
    })
  );

  if (context.assignmentId) {
    tests.push(
      kidlearnV3_writeRouterAssignmentStartV3({
        payload: {
          assignmentId: context.assignmentId
        },
        dryRun: true
      })
    );

    tests.push(
      kidlearnV3_writeRouterAssignmentProgressV3({
        payload: {
          assignmentId: context.assignmentId,
          progressPercent: 45
        },
        dryRun: true
      })
    );

    tests.push(
      kidlearnV3_writeRouterAssignmentCompleteV3({
        payload: {
          assignmentId: context.assignmentId
        },
        dryRun: true
      })
    );
  }

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  if (!status.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Write Router status thất bại.'
    );
  }

  if (!sample.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Write Router sample context thất bại.'
    );
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < tests.length; i++) {
    if (tests[i].success !== true) {
      errors.push(
        'Write Router dry-run test #' +
        (i + 1) +
        ' failed: ' +
        kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetErrorMessage_(
          tests[i]
        )
      );
    }
  }

  if (!context.assignmentId) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không có assignmentId mẫu nên bỏ qua assignment start/progress/complete.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'SMOKE_TEST_WRITE_ROUTER_V3',
    phase: '3J.3',
    dryRunOnly: true,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    sampleContext: context,
    testCount: tests.length,
    tests: tests
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Smoke test Write Router V3 chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      errors.length
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Public: lấy trạng thái router.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetStatusV3(request) {
  return kidlearnV3_writeRouterInvoke_(
    'WRITE_ROUTER_GET_STATUS_V3',
    function() {
      return {
        routerVersion:
          KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_ROUTER_CONFIG.VERSION,
        responseVersion:
          KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_ROUTER_CONFIG.RESPONSE_VERSION,
        dryRunOnly:
          KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_ROUTER_CONFIG.DRY_RUN_ONLY,
        routes:
          kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetRoutes_(),
        writeServiceStatus:
          kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetStatusV3({})
      };
    },
    request
  );
}


/**
 * Public: lấy sample context.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetSampleContextV3(request) {
  return kidlearnV3_writeRouterInvoke_(
    'WRITE_ROUTER_GET_SAMPLE_CONTEXT_V3',
    function() {
      var response =
        kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetSampleContextV3({});

      if (!response.success) {
        throw new Error(
          kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetErrorMessage_(
            response
          )
        );
      }

      return {
        sampleContext:
          response.data.sampleContext || {}
      };

  );
}


/**
 * Public dispatcher chính cho UI.
 *
 * Request mẫu:
 * {
 *   action: 'LESSON_PROGRESS_SAVE',
 *   payload: {...},
 *   dryRun: true
 * }
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterDispatchV3(request) {
  var safeRequest =
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  var action =
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterCanonicalAction_(
      safeRequest.action
    );

  if (action === 'STATUS') {
    return kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetStatusV3(
      safeRequest
    );
  }

  if (action === 'SAMPLE_CONTEXT') {
    return kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetSampleContextV3(
      safeRequest
    );
  }

  return kidlearnV3_writeRouterRunAction_(
    action,
    safeRequest
  );
}


/**
 * Wrapper: audit event.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterAuditEventV3(request) {
  return kidlearnV3_writeRouterRunAction_(
    'AUDIT_EVENT',

  );
}

function kidlearnV3_writeRouterStudyStartV3(request) {

/**
 * Run action qua route.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterRunAction_(
  action,
  request
) {
  return kidlearnV3_writeRouterInvoke_(
    'WRITE_ROUTER_' + action + '_V3',
    function(req) {
      var route =
        kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetRoute_(
          action
        );

      if (!route) {
        throw new Error(
          'Write Router action không được hỗ trợ: ' +
          action
        );
      }

      if (
        KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_ROUTER_CONFIG.DRY_RUN_ONLY &&
        req.dryRun === false
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          '3J.3 đang DRY_RUN_ONLY. Không cho gửi write thật.'
        );
      }

      var payload =
        kidlearnV3_writeRouterBuildPayload_(
          action,
          req.payload || {}
        );

      var writeResponse =
        kidlearnV3_writeServiceDispatchV3({
          action: 'SUBMIT',
          operation: route.operation,
          payload: payload,
          dryRun: true
        });

      if (!writeResponse.success) {
        var error =
          new Error(
            kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetErrorMessage_(
              writeResponse
            )
          );

        error.writeResponse =
          writeResponse;

        throw error;
      }

      return {
        routerAction: action,
        operation: route.operation,
        dryRun: true,
        routedPayload: payload,
        writeService: writeResponse,
        plan:
          writeResponse.data &&
          writeResponse.data.plan
            ? writeResponse.data.plan
            : null
      };
    },
    request
  );
}


/**
 * Canonical action.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterCanonicalAction_(
  action
) {
  var value =
    String(action || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (value === '') {
    return '';
  }

  if (value === 'PING') {
    return 'STATUS';
  }

  if (
    value === 'START_STUDY' ||
    value === 'START_SESSION'
  ) {
    return 'STUDY_START';
  }

  if (
    value === 'FINISH_STUDY' ||
    value === 'END_STUDY' ||
    value === 'END_SESSION'
  ) {
    return 'STUDY_FINISH';
  }

  if (
    value === 'SAVE_LESSON_PROGRESS' ||
    value === 'LESSON_PROGRESS'
  ) {
    return 'LESSON_PROGRESS_SAVE';
  }

  if (
    value === 'START_ASSIGNMENT'
  ) {
    return 'ASSIGNMENT_START';
  }

  if (
    value === 'SAVE_ASSIGNMENT_PROGRESS'
  ) {
    return 'ASSIGNMENT_PROGRESS';
  }

  if (
    value === 'COMPLETE_ASSIGNMENT'
  ) {
    return 'ASSIGNMENT_COMPLETE';
  }

  if (
    value === 'SAVE_DAILY_GOAL' ||
    value === 'DAILY_GOAL'
  ) {
    return 'DAILY_GOAL_SAVE';
  }

  if (
    value === 'AUDIT' ||
    value === 'AUDIT_LOG'
  ) {
    return 'AUDIT_EVENT';
  }

  return value;
}


/**
 * Build payload theo action học tập.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterBuildPayload_(
  action,
  payload
) {
  var now =
    new Date().toISOString();

  if (action === 'AUDIT_EVENT') {
    return {
      eventType:
        payload.eventType || 'UI_LEARNING_EVENT',
      message:
        payload.message || '',
      entityType:
        payload.entityType || '',
      entityId:
        payload.entityId || '',
      childId:
        payload.childId || '',
      details:
        payload.details || {}
    };
  }

  if (action === 'STUDY_START') {
    return {
      childId:
        payload.childId || '',
      subjectId:
        payload.subjectId || '',
      lessonId:
        payload.lessonId || '',
      activityId:
        payload.activityId || '',
      startedAt:
        payload.startedAt || now,
      status:
        'IN_PROGRESS'
    };
  }

  if (action === 'STUDY_FINISH') {
    return {
      studySessionId:
        payload.studySessionId || '',
      endedAt:
        payload.endedAt || now,
      durationSeconds:
        Number(payload.durationSeconds || 0),
      status:
        payload.status || 'COMPLETED'
    };
  }

  if (action === 'LESSON_PROGRESS_SAVE') {
    return {
      childId:
        payload.childId || '',
      subjectId:
        payload.subjectId || '',
      lessonId:
        payload.lessonId || '',
      status:
        payload.status || 'IN_PROGRESS',
      progressPercent:
        Number(payload.progressPercent || 0)
    };
  }

  if (action === 'ASSIGNMENT_START') {
    return {
      assignmentId:
        payload.assignmentId || '',
      status:
        'IN_PROGRESS',
      progressPercent:
        Number(payload.progressPercent || 0)
    };
  }

  if (action === 'ASSIGNMENT_PROGRESS') {
    return {
      assignmentId:
        payload.assignmentId || '',
      status:
        payload.status || 'IN_PROGRESS',
      progressPercent:
        Number(payload.progressPercent || 0)
    };
  }

  if (action === 'ASSIGNMENT_COMPLETE') {
    return {
      assignmentId:
        payload.assignmentId || '',
      status:
        'COMPLETED',
      progressPercent:
        100,
      completedAt:
        payload.completedAt || now
    };
  }

  if (action === 'DAILY_GOAL_SAVE') {
    return {
      childId:
        payload.childId || '',
      goalDate:
        payload.goalDate ||
        payload.date ||
        kidlearnV3_writeRouterToday_(),
      targetMinutes:
        Number(payload.targetMinutes || 20),
      completedMinutes:
        Number(payload.completedMinutes || 0),
      status:
        payload.status || 'ACTIVE'
    };
  }

  return payload || {};
}


/**
 * Get route.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetRoute_(
  action
) {
  return KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_ROUTER_ACTIONS[
    action
  ] || null;
}


/**
 * Get routes list.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetRoutes_() {
  var keys =
    Object.keys(
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_ROUTER_ACTIONS
    );

  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    result.push(
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_ROUTER_ACTIONS[
        keys[i]
      ]
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Core wrapper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterInvoke_(
  serviceName,
  handler,
  request
) {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var requestId =
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterRequestId_(
      serviceName,
      startedAt
    );

  var safeRequest =
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  try {
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterAssertReady_();

    var data =
      handler(safeRequest);

    return kidlearnV3_writeRouterSuccess_(
      serviceName,
      requestId,
      startedAt,
      data
    );

  } catch (error) {
    return kidlearnV3_writeRouterFailure_(
      serviceName,
      requestId,
      startedAt,
      error
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Assert ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterAssertReady_() {
  var missing = [];

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_writeServiceDispatchV3 !== 'function'
  ) {
    missing.push(
      'kidlearnV3_writeServiceDispatchV3'
    );
  }

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetStatusV3 !== 'function'
  ) {
    missing.push(
      'kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetStatusV3'
    );
  }

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3 !== 'function'
  ) {
    missing.push(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3'
    );
  }

  if (missing.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu dependency cho Write Router: ' +
      missing.join(', ')
    );
  }

  kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3();
}


/**
 * Success response.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterSuccess_(
  serviceName,
  requestId,
  startedAt,
  data
) {
  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  return {
    success: true,
    serviceName: serviceName,
    requestId: requestId,
    phase: '3J.3',
    routerVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_ROUTER_CONFIG.VERSION,
    responseVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_ROUTER_CONFIG.RESPONSE_VERSION,
    schemaVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
    appVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.APP_VERSION,
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    data:
      kidlearnV3_writeRouterCloneSafe_(
        data
      )
  };
}


/**
 * Failure response.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterFailure_(
  serviceName,
  requestId,
  startedAt,
  error
) {
  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  var result = {
    success: false,
    serviceName: serviceName,
    requestId: requestId,
    phase: '3J.3',
    routerVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_ROUTER_CONFIG.VERSION,
    responseVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_ROUTER_CONFIG.RESPONSE_VERSION,
    schemaVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
    appVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.APP_VERSION,
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    error: {
      code: 'WRITE_ROUTER_ERROR',
      message:
        String(
          error &&
          error.message
            ? error.message
            : error
        )
    }
  };

  if (
    error &&
    error.writeResponse
  ) {
    result.details = {
      writeResponse:
        error.writeResponse
    };
  }

  console.error(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Normalize request.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterNormalizeRequest_(
  request
) {
  if (!request) {
    return {
      action: '',
      payload: {},
      dryRun: true
    };
  }

  if (
    typeof request !== 'object'
  ) {
    return {
      action:
        String(request || ''),
      payload: {},
      dryRun: true
    };
  }

  return {
    action:
      request.action || '',
    payload:
      request.payload || {},
    dryRun:
      request.dryRun !== false
  };
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterCheckFunctions_(
  functionNames
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < functionNames.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          functionNames[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: functionNames[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        functionNames[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Check HTML files.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterCheckHtmlFiles_(
  filenames
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < filenames.length; i++) {
    try {
      var content =
        HtmlService
          .createHtmlOutputFromFile(
            filenames[i]
          )
          .getContent();

      items.push({
        name: filenames[i],
        exists: true,
        length: content.length
      });

    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu HTML file: ' +
        filenames[i]
      );

      items.push({
        name: filenames[i],
        exists: false,
        error:
          String(error.message || error)
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Safe Phase 3I assert.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterSafePhase3IAssert_() {
  try {
    var result =
      kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3();

    return {
      success:
        result.success === true,
      message:
        ''
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        String(
          error &&
          error.message
            ? error.message
            : error
        )
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe Write Service status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterSafeWriteServiceStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetStatusV3({});
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: {
        message:
          String(error.message || error)
      }
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Error message helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetErrorMessage_(
  response
) {
  if (
    response &&
    response.error &&
    response.error.message
  ) {
    return response.error.message;
  }

  if (
    response &&
    response.details &&
    response.details.writeResponse &&
    response.details.writeResponse.error &&
    response.details.writeResponse.error.message
  ) {
    return response.details.writeResponse.error.message;
  }

  return 'Không rõ lỗi.';
}


/**
 * Request ID.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterRequestId_(
  serviceName,
  dateValue
) {
  var text =
    Utilities.formatDate(
      dateValue,
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    );

  var random =
    Math.floor(
      Math.random() * 100000
    );

  return (
    'WROUTE_' +
    serviceName +
    '_' +
    text +
    '_' +
    random
  );
}


/**
 * Clone safe.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterCloneSafe_(
  value
) {
  if (
    value === undefined ||
    value === null
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(
      JSON.stringify(value)
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      value:
        String(value)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Today yyyy-MM-dd.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeRouterToday_() {
  return Utilities.formatDate(
    new Date(),
    Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
    'yyyy-MM-dd'
  );
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - WRITE SERVICE FACADE
 * Step: 3J.2
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * File này tạo lớp service trung gian cho UI DEV gửi request ghi.
 *
 * UI DEV KHÔNG gọi trực tiếp Safe Write Layer.
 * UI DEV gọi Write Service Facade.
 *
 * Mặc định vẫn DRY_RUN.
 *
 * KHÔNG sửa PROD.
 * KHÔNG bật ghi thật ở bước 3J.2.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_SERVICE_CONFIG = {
  VERSION: '3J.2',
  RESPONSE_VERSION: '1.0',
  DEFAULT_DRY_RUN: true,
  CONFIRM_WRITE_TOKEN: 'CONFIRM_WRITE_V3'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_SERVICE_ACTIONS = {
  STATUS: 'STATUS',
  SAMPLE_CONTEXT: 'SAMPLE_CONTEXT',
  DRY_RUN: 'DRY_RUN',
  SUBMIT: 'SUBMIT',
  AUDIT_LOG: 'AUDIT_LOG',
  START_STUDY_SESSION: 'START_STUDY_SESSION',
  FINISH_STUDY_SESSION: 'FINISH_STUDY_SESSION',
  UPSERT_LESSON_PROGRESS: 'UPSERT_LESSON_PROGRESS',
  UPDATE_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS: 'UPDATE_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS',
  UPSERT_DAILY_GOAL: 'UPSERT_DAILY_GOAL'
};


/**
 * Preview Write Service Facade V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewWriteServiceFacadeV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions = [
    'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_previewSafeWriteLayerV3',
    'kidlearnV3_safeWriteV3',
    'kidlearnV3_safeWriteDryRunV3',
    'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getAppDevConnectionV3Status',
    'kidlearnV3_serviceGetBootstrapV3'
  ];

  var functionChecks =
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceCheckFunctions_(
      requiredFunctions
    );

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      functionChecks.errors
    );

  var phase3I =
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceSafePhase3IAssert_();

  if (!phase3I.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 3I chưa đóng đúng điều kiện cho 3J: ' +
      phase3I.message
    );
  }

  var connection =
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceSafeConnection_();

  if (
    connection.databaseMode !== 'V3' ||
    connection.connectionStatus !== 'CONNECTED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'App DEV chưa CONNECTED với Database V3.'
    );
  }

  var safeWriteStatus =
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceSafeLayerStatus_();

  if (
    safeWriteStatus.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' &&
    safeWriteStatus.mode !== 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write Layer chưa ở DRY_RUN/ENABLED. Mode hiện tại: ' +
      safeWriteStatus.mode
    );
  }

  var safeWritePreview = {
    success: false,
    skipped: true
  };

  if (errors.length === 0) {
    try {
      safeWritePreview =
        kidlearnV3_previewSafeWriteLayerV3();

      if (!safeWritePreview.success) {
        errors.push(
          'Safe Write Layer preview chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
          safeWritePreview.errorCount
        );
      }

    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(
        'Không chạy được kidlearnV3_previewSafeWriteLayerV3: ' +
        String(error.message || error)
      );
    }
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_WRITE_SERVICE_FACADE_V3',
    phase: '3J.2',
    serviceVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_SERVICE_CONFIG.VERSION,
    responseVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_SERVICE_CONFIG.RESPONSE_VERSION,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3I: phase3I,
    connection: connection,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWriteStatus,
    safeWritePreview: {
      success:
        safeWritePreview.success === true,
      skipped:
        safeWritePreview.skipped === true ? true : false
    },
    functionChecks:
      functionChecks.items,
    allowedActions:
      kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetAllowedActions_(),
    allowedOperations:
      kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetAllowedOperations_()
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Smoke test Write Service Facade V3.
 *
 * Chỉ DRY_RUN.
 * Không ghi thật.
 */
function kidlearnV3_smokeTestWriteServiceFacadeV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetStatusV3({});

  var sample =
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetSampleContextV3({});

  var context =
    sample.success && sample.data
      ? sample.data.sampleContext || {}
      : {};

  var tests = [];

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceAuditLogV3({
      payload: {
        eventType: 'WRITE_SERVICE_SMOKE_TEST',
        message: 'Dry-run audit test from Write Service Facade 3J.2',
        entityType: 'PHASE',
        entityId: '3J.2'
      },
      dryRun: true
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceStartStudySessionV3({
      payload: {
        childId: context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID',
        subjectId: context.subjectId || '',
        lessonId: context.lessonId || 'DRY_RUN_LESSON_ID'
      },
      dryRun: true
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceUpsertLessonProgressV3({
      payload: {
        childId: context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID',
        subjectId: context.subjectId || '',
        lessonId: context.lessonId || 'DRY_RUN_LESSON_ID',
        status: 'IN_PROGRESS',
        progressPercent: 15
      },
      dryRun: true
    })
  );

  tests.push(
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceUpsertDailyGoalV3({
      payload: {
        childId: context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID',
        goalDate: kidlearnV3_writeServiceToday_(),
        targetMinutes: 20,
        status: 'ACTIVE'
      },
      dryRun: true
    })
  );

  if (context.assignmentId) {
    tests.push(
      kidlearnV3_writeServiceUpdateAssignmentStatusV3({
        payload: {
          assignmentId: context.assignmentId,
          status: 'IN_PROGRESS',
          progressPercent: 5
        },
        dryRun: true
      })
    );
  }

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  if (!status.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Write Service status thất bại.'
    );
  }

  if (!sample.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Write Service sample context thất bại.'
    );
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < tests.length; i++) {
    if (tests[i].success !== true) {
      errors.push(
        'Write Service dry-run test #' +
        (i + 1) +
        ' failed: ' +
        kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetErrorMessage_(
          tests[i]
        )
      );
    }
  }

  if (!context.assignmentId) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không có assignmentId mẫu nên bỏ qua dry-run UPDATE_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'SMOKE_TEST_WRITE_SERVICE_FACADE_V3',
    phase: '3J.2',
    dryRunOnly: true,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    status: {
      success: status.success,
      mode:
        status.success && status.data
          ? status.data.safeWriteStatus.mode
          : ''
    },
    sampleContext: context,
    testCount: tests.length,
    tests: tests
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Smoke test Write Service Facade V3 chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      errors.length
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Mở UI test Write Service Facade.
 *
 * Chỉ mở qua menu Google Sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_showWriteServiceTestUiV3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewWriteServiceFacadeV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Write Service Facade V3 chưa sẵn sàng. Errors: ' +
      preview.errorCount +
      '. Xem Execution log.'
    );
  }

  var html =

      )
      .evaluate()
      .setTitle(
        'KIDLEARN V3 - Write Service Test'
      )
      .setWidth(1200)
      .setHeight(850);

  SpreadsheetApp
    .getUi()
    .showModalDialog(
      html,
      'KIDLEARN V3 - Write Service Test'
    );
}

function kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetStatusV3(request) {

/**
 * Dispatcher public cho UI DEV.
 *
 * Request mẫu:
 * {
 *   action: 'AUDIT_LOG',
 *   payload: {...},
 *   dryRun: true
 * }
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceDispatchV3(request) {
  var safeRequest =
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  var action =
    String(safeRequest.action || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (action === 'STATUS') {
    return kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetStatusV3(
      safeRequest
    );
  }

  if (action === 'SAMPLE_CONTEXT') {
    return kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetSampleContextV3(
      safeRequest
    );
  }

  if (action === 'DRY_RUN') {
    return kidlearnV3_writeServiceDryRunV3(
      safeRequest
    );
  }

  if (action === 'SUBMIT') {
    return kidlearnV3_writeServiceSubmitV3(
      safeRequest
    );
  }

  if (
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceIsAllowedOperation_(
      action
    )
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_writeServiceRunNamedOperation_(
      action,
      safeRequest,
      true
    );
  }

  return kidlearnV3_writeServiceFailureDirect_(
    'WRITE_SERVICE_DISPATCH_V3',
    'UNKNOWN_WRITE_SERVICE_ACTION',
    'Action không được hỗ trợ: ' + action
  );
}


/**
 * Generic DRY_RUN.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceDryRunV3(request) {
  return kidlearnV3_writeServiceInvoke_(
    'WRITE_SERVICE_DRY_RUN_V3',
    function(req) {
      var operation =
        String(req.operation || req.action || '')
          .trim()
          .toUpperCase();

      return kidlearnV3_writeServiceRunSafeWrite_(
        operation,
        req.payload || {},
        true
      );
    },
    request
  );
}


/**
 * Generic submit.
 *
 * Ở 3J.2 hàm này đã có sẵn, nhưng chưa dùng ghi thật.
 * Muốn dryRun=false phải có confirmWrite = CONFIRM_WRITE_V3.
 * Safe Write Layer vẫn sẽ chặn nếu chưa ENABLED.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceSubmitV3(request) {
  return kidlearnV3_writeServiceInvoke_(
    'WRITE_SERVICE_SUBMIT_V3',
    function(req) {
      var operation =
        String(req.operation || req.action || '')
          .trim()
          .toUpperCase();

      var confirmWrite =
        String(req.confirmWrite || '').trim();

      if (
        req.dryRun === false &&
        confirmWrite !==
          KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_SERVICE_CONFIG.CONFIRM_WRITE_TOKEN
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          'Thiếu confirmWrite=CONFIRM_WRITE_V3 nên không được gửi write thật.'
        );
      }

      return kidlearnV3_writeServiceRunSafeWrite_(
        operation,
        req.payload || {},
        req.dryRun !== false
      );
    },
    request
  );
}

function kidlearnV3_writeServiceAuditLogV3(request) {

function kidlearnV3_writeServiceStartStudySessionV3(request) {

/**
 * Run named operation.
 *
 * forceDryRunDefault = true nghĩa là nếu request không truyền dryRun=false
 * thì luôn chạy dry-run.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceRunNamedOperation_(
  operation,
  request,
  forceDryRunDefault
) {
  return kidlearnV3_writeServiceInvoke_(
    'WRITE_SERVICE_' + operation + '_V3',
    function(req) {
      var dryRun =
        forceDryRunDefault
          ? req.dryRun !== false
          : true;

      return kidlearnV3_writeServiceRunSafeWrite_(
        operation,
        req.payload || {},
        dryRun
      );
    },
    request
  );
}


/**
 * Run Safe Write Layer qua service.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceRunSafeWrite_(
  operation,
  payload,
  dryRun
) {
  var operationCode =
    String(operation || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    !kidlearnV3_writeServiceIsAllowedOperation_(
      operationCode
    )
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Operation không được phép qua Write Service: ' +
      operationCode
    );
  }

  var safeWriteStatus =
    kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();

  if (
    safeWriteStatus.mode === 'DISABLED' ||
    !safeWriteStatus.mode
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Safe Write Layer đang DISABLED. Hãy chạy kidlearnV3_initializeSafeWriteLayerV3 trước.'
    );
  }

  var safeWriteResponse =
    kidlearnV3_safeWriteV3({
      operation: operationCode,
      payload: payload || {},
      dryRun: dryRun !== false
    });

  if (safeWriteResponse.success !== true) {
    var error =
      new Error(
        kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetErrorMessage_(
          safeWriteResponse
        )
      );

    error.safeWriteResponse =
      safeWriteResponse;

    throw error;
  }

  return {
    operation: operationCode,
    dryRun:
      dryRun !== false,
    executed:
      safeWriteResponse.data &&
      safeWriteResponse.data.executed === true,
    safeWrite:
      safeWriteResponse,
    plan:
      safeWriteResponse.data
        ? safeWriteResponse.data.plan || null
        : null
  };
}


/**
 * Core service wrapper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceInvoke_(
  serviceName,
  handler,
  request
) {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var requestId =
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceRequestId_(
      serviceName,
      startedAt
    );

  var safeRequest =
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  try {
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceAssertReady_();

    var data =
      handler(safeRequest);

    return kidlearnV3_writeServiceSuccess_(
      serviceName,
      requestId,
      startedAt,
      data
    );

  } catch (error) {
    return kidlearnV3_writeServiceFailure_(
      serviceName,
      requestId,
      startedAt,
      error
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Assert base ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceAssertReady_() {
  var missing = [];

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3 !== 'function'
  ) {
    missing.push(
      'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3'
    );
  }

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_safeWriteV3 !== 'function'
  ) {
    missing.push(
      'kidlearnV3_safeWriteV3'
    );
  }

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3 !== 'function'
  ) {
    missing.push(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3'
    );
  }

  if (missing.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu dependency 3J.1/3I.10: ' +
      missing.join(', ')
    );
  }

  kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3();

  var connection =
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceSafeConnection_();

  if (
    connection.databaseMode !== 'V3' ||
    connection.connectionStatus !== 'CONNECTED'
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'App DEV chưa CONNECTED với Database V3.'
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Success response.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceSuccess_(
  serviceName,
  requestId,
  startedAt,
  data
) {
  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  return {
    success: true,
    serviceName: serviceName,
    requestId: requestId,
    phase: '3J.2',
    serviceVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_SERVICE_CONFIG.VERSION,
    responseVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_SERVICE_CONFIG.RESPONSE_VERSION,
    schemaVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
    appVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.APP_VERSION,
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    data:
      kidlearnV3_writeServiceCloneSafe_(
        data
      )
  };
}


/**
 * Failure response.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceFailure_(
  serviceName,
  requestId,
  startedAt,
  error
) {
  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  var message =
    String(
      error &&
      error.message
        ? error.message
        : error
    );

  var result = {
    success: false,
    serviceName: serviceName,
    requestId: requestId,
    phase: '3J.2',
    serviceVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_SERVICE_CONFIG.VERSION,
    responseVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_SERVICE_CONFIG.RESPONSE_VERSION,
    schemaVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
    appVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.APP_VERSION,
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    error: {
      code: 'WRITE_SERVICE_ERROR',
      message: message
    }
  };

  if (
    error &&
    error.safeWriteResponse
  ) {
    result.details = {
      safeWriteResponse:
        error.safeWriteResponse
    };
  }

  console.error(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Direct failure không cần assert ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceFailureDirect_(
  serviceName,
  code,
  message
) {
  var now =
    new Date();

  return {
    success: false,
    serviceName: serviceName,
    phase: '3J.2',
    serviceVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_SERVICE_CONFIG.VERSION,
    responseVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_SERVICE_CONFIG.RESPONSE_VERSION,
    schemaVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
    appVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.APP_VERSION,
    startedAt:
      now.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      now.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      0,
    error: {
      code: code,
      message: message
    }
  };
}


/**
 * Normalize request.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceNormalizeRequest_(
  request
) {
  if (!request) {
    return {
      action: '',
      operation: '',
      payload: {},
      dryRun: true
    };
  }

  if (
    typeof request !== 'object'
  ) {
    return {
      action:
        String(request || ''),
      operation:
        String(request || ''),
      payload: {},
      dryRun: true
    };
  }

  return {
    action:
      request.action || '',
    operation:
      request.operation || '',
    payload:
      request.payload || {},
    dryRun:
      request.dryRun !== false,
    confirmWrite:
      request.confirmWrite || ''
  };
}


/**
 * Allowed actions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetAllowedActions_() {
  return Object.keys(
    KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_SERVICE_ACTIONS
  );
}


/**
 * Allowed operations từ Safe Write Layer.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetAllowedOperations_() {
  if (
    typeof KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_OPERATIONS === 'undefined'
  ) {
    return [];
  }

  return Object.keys(
    KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_OPERATIONS
  );
}


/**
 * Check operation allowed.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceIsAllowedOperation_(
  operation
) {
  var code =
    String(operation || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  var operations =
    kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetAllowedOperations_();

  for (var i = 0; i < operations.length; i++) {
    if (operations[i] === code) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceCheckFunctions_(
  functionNames
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < functionNames.length; i++) {
    var item =
      kidlearnV3_writeServiceCheckFunction_(
        functionNames[i]
      );

    items.push(item);

    if (!item.exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        item.name
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    errors:
      errors,
    items:
      items
  };
}


/**
 * Check một function.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceCheckFunction_(
  functionName
) {
  var exists = false;

  try {
    exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );
  } catch (error) {
    exists = false;
  }

  return {
    name: functionName,
    exists: exists
  };
}


/**
 * Safe Phase 3I assert.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceSafePhase3IAssert_() {
  try {
    var result =
      kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3();

    return {
      success:
        result.success === true,
      message:
        ''
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        String(
          error &&
          error.message
            ? error.message
            : error
        )
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe connection.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceSafeConnection_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getAppDevConnectionV3Status();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      databaseMode: '',
      connectionStatus: '',
      spreadsheetId: '',
      spreadsheetName: '',
      error:
        String(
          error &&
          error.message
            ? error.message
            : error
        )
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe SafeWrite status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceSafeLayerStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:
        String(
          error &&
          error.message
            ? error.message
            : error
        )
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Sample context.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetSampleContext_() {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_writeGetSampleContext_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_writeGetSampleContext_();
  }

  var context = {
    childId: '',
    subjectId: '',
    lessonId: 'DRY_RUN_LESSON_ID',
    assignmentId: ''
  };

  try {
    var bootstrap =
      kidlearnV3_serviceGetBootstrapV3({});

    if (
      bootstrap.success &&
      bootstrap.data
    ) {
      var child =
        bootstrap.data.selectedChild ||
        (
          bootstrap.data.children &&
          bootstrap.data.children.length
            ? bootstrap.data.children[0]
            : null
        );

      if (child) {
        context.childId =
          child.childId || '';
      }

      var subject =
        bootstrap.data.subjects &&
        bootstrap.data.subjects.length
          ? bootstrap.data.subjects[0]
          : null;

      if (subject) {
        context.subjectId =
          subject.subjectId || '';
      }

      var assignment =
        bootstrap.data.assignments &&
        bootstrap.data.assignments.length
          ? bootstrap.data.assignments[0]
          : null;

      if (assignment) {
        context.assignmentId =
          assignment.assignmentId || '';
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    context.error =
      String(error.message || error);
  }

  return context;
}


/**
 * Error message helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetErrorMessage_(
  response
) {
  if (
    response &&
    response.error &&
    response.error.message
  ) {
    return response.error.message;
  }

  if (
    response &&
    response.data &&
    response.data.plan &&
    response.data.plan.errors &&
    response.data.plan.errors.length
  ) {
    return response.data.plan.errors.join(' | ');
  }

  return 'Không rõ lỗi.';
}


/**
 * Request ID.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceRequestId_(
  serviceName,
  dateValue
) {
  var text =
    Utilities.formatDate(
      dateValue,
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    );

  var random =
    Math.floor(
      Math.random() * 100000
    );

  return (
    'WREQ_' +
    serviceName +
    '_' +
    text +
    '_' +
    random
  );
}


/**
 * Clone safe.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceCloneSafe_(
  value
) {
  if (
    value === undefined ||
    value === null
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(
      JSON.stringify(value)
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      value:
        String(value)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Today yyyy-MM-dd.
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeServiceToday_() {
  return Utilities.formatDate(
    new Date(),
    Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
    'yyyy-MM-dd'
  );
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - DATABASE BACKUP
 * Step: 3H.4
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * Tạo bản sao toàn bộ Spreadsheet DEV trước khi đổi tên Sheet V2.
 *
 * KHÔNG sửa dữ liệu nguồn.
 * KHÔNG xóa Sheet.
 * KHÔNG đổi tên Sheet.
 */


/**
 * Xem trạng thái backup hiện tại.
 *
 * Hàm chỉ đọc dữ liệu.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewDatabaseBackup() {
  var context = kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();
  var storedBackup = kidlearnV3_getStoredBackupInfo_();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    environment: context.environment,
    spreadsheetName: context.spreadsheetName,
    spreadsheetId: context.spreadsheetId,
    setupStatus: context.setupStatus,
    storedBackup: storedBackup
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Tạo một bản sao mới của toàn bộ Spreadsheet DEV.
 *
 * Mỗi lần chạy sẽ tạo một backup mới.
 */
function kidlearnV3_backupDatabaseV3() {
  var context = kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  var lock = LockService.getScriptLock();

  var locked = lock.tryLock(
    KIDLEARN_V3.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS
  );

  if (!locked) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không lấy được script lock. ' +
      'Có thể một tiến trình khác đang chạy.'
    );
  }

  try {
    var spreadsheet = context.spreadsheet;

    var originalFile = DriveApp.getFileById(
      spreadsheet.getId()
    );

    var backupName =
      kidlearnV3_buildBackupName_(spreadsheet);

    var backupFile =
      kidlearnV3_createBackupCopy_(
        originalFile,
        backupName
      );

    var createdAt = new Date();

    backupFile.setDescription(
      'KIDLEARN V3 backup trước khi đổi tên Sheet V2. ' +
      'Nguồn: ' +
      spreadsheet.getName() +
      '. Schema: ' +
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION +
      '. Tạo lúc: ' +
      createdAt.toISOString()
    );

    var properties =
      PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

    properties.setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3
        .SCRIPT_PROPERTIES
        .LAST_BACKUP_FILE_ID,
      backupFile.getId()
    );

    properties.setProperty(
      'KIDLEARN_LAST_BACKUP_NAME',
      backupFile.getName()
    );

    properties.setProperty(
      'KIDLEARN_LAST_BACKUP_CREATED_AT',
      createdAt.toISOString()
    );

    kidlearnV3_setSetupStatus_(
      KIDLEARN_V3.SETUP_STATUS.BACKUP_COMPLETED
    );

    var result = {
      success: true,
      action: 'BACKUP_CREATED',
      backupFileId: backupFile.getId(),
      backupName: backupFile.getName(),
      backupUrl: backupFile.getUrl(),
      sourceSpreadsheetId: spreadsheet.getId(),
      sourceSpreadsheetName: spreadsheet.getName(),
      createdAt: createdAt.toISOString(),
      setupStatus:
        KIDLEARN_V3.SETUP_STATUS.BACKUP_COMPLETED
    };

    console.log(
      JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
    );

    return result;

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}


/**
 * Tạo tên backup có timestamp.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildBackupName_(
  spreadsheet
) {
  var timeZone =
    spreadsheet.getSpreadsheetTimeZone();

  if (!timeZone) {
    timeZone = Session.getScriptTimeZone();
  }

  if (!timeZone) {
    timeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
  }

  var timestamp = Utilities.formatDate(
    new Date(),
    timeZone,
    'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
  );

  return (
    'BACKUP_' +
    spreadsheet.getName() +
    '_PRE_V3_' +
    timestamp
  );
}


/**
 * Tạo bản sao trong cùng thư mục với file nguồn.
 *
 * Nếu không xác định được thư mục, backup được tạo
 * trong My Drive.
 */
function kidlearnV3_createBackupCopy_(
  originalFile,
  backupName
) {
  var parents = originalFile.getParents();

  if (parents.hasNext()) {
    var parentFolder = parents.next();

    return originalFile.makeCopy(
      backupName,
      parentFolder
    );
  }

  return originalFile.makeCopy(
    backupName
  );
}


/**
 * Đọc thông tin backup gần nhất từ Script Properties.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getStoredBackupInfo_() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var backupFileId = properties.getProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3
      .SCRIPT_PROPERTIES
      .LAST_BACKUP_FILE_ID
  );

  var backupName = properties.getProperty(
    'KIDLEARN_LAST_BACKUP_NAME'
  );

  var createdAt = properties.getProperty(
    'KIDLEARN_LAST_BACKUP_CREATED_AT'
  );

  if (!backupFileId) {
    return {
      exists: false,
      valid: false,
      message: 'Chưa có backup được ghi nhận.'
    };
  }

  try {
    var backupFile =
      DriveApp.getFileById(backupFileId);

    if (backupFile.isTrashed()) {
      return {
        exists: true,
        valid: false,
        backupFileId: backupFileId,
        backupName: backupName,
        createdAt: createdAt,
        message: 'File backup đang nằm trong thùng rác.'
      };
    }

    return {
      exists: true,
      valid: true,
      backupFileId: backupFile.getId(),
      backupName: backupFile.getName(),
      backupUrl: backupFile.getUrl(),
      createdAt: createdAt,
      message: 'Backup hợp lệ.'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      exists: true,
      valid: false,
      backupFileId: backupFileId,
      backupName: backupName,
      createdAt: createdAt,
      message:
        'Không truy cập được file backup: ' +
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Bắt buộc phải có backup hợp lệ trước khi đổi tên Legacy.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertValidBackup_() {
  var backupInfo =
    kidlearnV3_getStoredBackupInfo_();

  if (!backupInfo.valid) {
    throw new Error(
      'DỪNG THỰC THI: Chưa có backup hợp lệ. ' +
      backupInfo.message
    );
  }

  return backupInfo;
}
