<!-- Nhúng thư viện Chart.js qua CDN để vẽ biểu đồ -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>

<script>
const GradebookController = {
  
  pieChartInstance: null,
  lineChartInstance: null,

  // Từ điển Icon và Màu sắc tương ứng với tên môn học
  subjectTheme: {
    "Toán học": { icon: "📗", color: "text-green-600" },
    "Tiếng Việt": { icon: "📕", color: "text-red-500" },
    "Tiếng Anh": { icon: "🔠", color: "text-blue-500" },
    "Khoa học": { icon: "🔬", color: "text-indigo-500" },
    "Lịch sử & Địa lý": { icon: "🌐", color: "text-purple-500" },
    "Âm nhạc": { icon: "🎵", color: "text-pink-500" },
    "Mỹ thuật": { icon: "🎨", color: "text-teal-500" },
    "Thể dục": { icon: "🏃", color: "text-orange-500" },
    "Default": { icon: "📘", color: "text-slate-600" }
  },

  /**
   * Khởi tạo và gọi API lấy dữ liệu
   */
  init: function() {
    this.fetchData();
  },

  fetchData: async function() {
    const token = AuthService.getToken();
    if (!token) return;

    // Reset Table UI to Loading
    document.getElementById('gb-table-body').innerHTML = `
      <tr>
        <td colspan="7" class="p-12 text-center">
          <div class="loader-spinner !border-indigo-500 mb-3"></div>
          <p class="text-slate-500 font-medium text-sm">Đang tải bảng điểm...</p>
        </td>
      </tr>`;

    try {
      const sem = document.getElementById('gb-filter-semester').value;
      const year = document.getElementById('gb-filter-year').value;

      const payload = { token: token, semester: sem, year: year };
      const response = await NetworkService.call('api_getGradebookData', payload);
      
      const data = response.data;
      this.renderTable(data.scores);
      this.renderSummary(data.summary);
      this.renderCharts(data);
      
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[Gradebook] Fetch Error:", err);
      document.getElementById('gb-table-body').innerHTML = `
        <tr><td colspan="7" class="p-8 text-center text-red-500 font-medium">Lỗi tải dữ liệu: ${err.message}</td></tr>`;
    }
  },

  /**
   * Render bảng điểm chi tiết
   */
  renderTable: function(scores) {
    const tbody = document.getElementById('gb-table-body');
    tbody.innerHTML = '';

    if (!scores || scores.length === 0) {
      tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="7" class="p-8 text-center text-slate-500">Chưa có dữ liệu điểm số cho học kỳ này.</td></tr>`;
      return;
    }

    scores.forEach((item, index) => {
      // Nhận diện Icon theo tên môn
      const theme = this.subjectTheme[item.subject] || this.subjectTheme["Default"];
      
      // Xử lý Badge Đánh giá (Màu sắc)
      let evalBadge = '';
      const evalText = (item.evaluation || "").trim();
      const evalLower = evalText.toLowerCase();
      
      if (evalLower === "xuất sắc") evalBadge = `<span class="bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 border border-purple-200 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 justify-center mx-auto w-max">${evalText} 🤩</span>`;
      else if (evalLower === "tốt") evalBadge = `<span class="bg-green-100 text-green-700 border border-green-200 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 justify-center mx-auto w-max">${evalText} 😀</span>`;
      else if (evalLower === "khá") evalBadge = `<span class="bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 justify-center mx-auto w-max">${evalText} 🙂</span>`;
      else if (evalLower === "đạt") evalBadge = `<span class="bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700 border border-yellow-200 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 justify-center mx-auto w-max">${evalText} 😐</span>`;
      else evalBadge = `<span class="bg-red-100 text-red-700 border border-red-200 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 justify-center mx-auto w-max">${evalText || "Chưa có"}</span>`;

      // Tạo Row HTML
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      tr.className = "hover:bg-indigo-50/30 transition-colors text-center text-sm font-medium text-slate-700";
      tr.innerHTML = `
        <td class="p-4 text-slate-400">${index + 1}</td>
        <td class="p-4 text-left flex items-center gap-3">
          <span class="text-xl">${theme.icon}</span> 
          <span class="font-bold text-slate-800">${item.subject}</span>
        </td>
        <td class="p-4">${item.scoreProcess || '-'}</td>
        <td class="p-4">${item.scoreQuiz || '-'}</td>
        <td class="p-4">${item.scoreTest || '-'}</td>
        <td class="p-4 border-l border-slate-100 bg-slate-50/50 font-extrabold ${theme.color} text-base">${item.scoreFinal || '-'}</td>
        <td class="p-4">${evalBadge}</td>
      `;
      tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
  },

  /**
   * Render dòng Tổng kết (Footer bảng)
   */
  renderSummary: function(summary) {
    document.getElementById('gb-avg-score').textContent = summary.average || "--";
    document.getElementById('gb-avg-grade').textContent = summary.grade || "--";
    document.getElementById('gb-pie-avg').textContent = summary.average || "--";
  },

  /**
   * Dùng Chart.js để vẽ 2 biểu đồ
   */
  renderCharts: function(data) {
    // 1. Dọn dẹp Canvas cũ (Cần thiết cho SPA để tránh lỗi "Canvas is already in use")
    if (this.pieChartInstance) this.pieChartInstance.destroy();
    if (this.lineChartInstance) this.lineChartInstance.destroy();

    const stats = data.summary.stats;
    const chartData = [stats.xuatSac, stats.tot, stats.kha, stats.dat, stats.chuaDat];
    const chartColors = ['#a855f7', '#22c55e', '#3b82f6', '#facc15', '#ef4444']; // Purple, Green, Blue, Yellow, Red

    // Render Legend Text UI
    const legendEl = document.getElementById('gb-pie-legend');
    legendEl.innerHTML = `
      <li class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-purple-500"></span> Xuất sắc (${stats.xuatSac})</li>
      <li class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-green-500"></span> Tốt (${stats.tot})</li>
      <li class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-blue-500"></span> Khá (${stats.kha})</li>
      <li class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-yellow-400"></span> Đạt (${stats.dat})</li>
      <li class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-red-500"></span> Chưa đạt (${stats.chuaDat})</li>
    `;

    // Biểu đồ Pie (Donut)
    const ctxPie = document.getElementById('gb-pie-chart').getContext('2d');
    this.pieChartInstance = new Chart(ctxPie, {
      type: 'doughnut',
      data: {
        labels: ['Xuất sắc', 'Tốt', 'Khá', 'Đạt', 'Chưa đạt'],
        datasets: [{
          data: chartData,
          backgroundColor: chartColors,
          borderWidth: 0,
          cutout: '75%' // Tạo khoảng trống ở giữa để điền số
        }]
      },
      options: {
        responsive: true,
        maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: {
          legend: { display: false }, // Ẩn legend mặc định, dùng legend tự tạo bằng HTML
          tooltip: {
            callbacks: { label: function(context) { return " " + context.label + ": " + context.raw + " môn"; } }
          }
        }
      }
    });

    // Biểu đồ Line (Tiến bộ)
    const progData = data.progressHistory;
    const ctxLine = document.getElementById('gb-line-chart').getContext('2d');
    
    // Tạo màu Gradient cho Line Chart
    let gradient = ctxLine.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 400);
    gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2)'); // green-500 nhạt
    gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)');

    this.lineChartInstance = new Chart(ctxLine, {
      type: 'line',
      data: {
        labels: progData.labels,
        datasets: [{
          label: 'Điểm Trung Bình',
          data: progData.data,
          borderColor: '#22c55e', // green-500
          backgroundColor: gradient,
          borderWidth: 3,
          pointBackgroundColor: '#ffffff',
          pointBorderColor: '#22c55e',
          pointBorderWidth: 2,
          pointRadius: 4,
          pointHoverRadius: 6,
          fill: true,
          tension: 0.4 // Làm cong đường nét
        }]
      },
      options: {
        responsive: true,
        maintainAspectRatio: false,
        plugins: { legend: { display: false } },
        scales: {
          y: { 
            beginAtZero: false, 
            min: 5, 
            max: 10,
            grid: { color: '#f1f5f9', drawBorder: false }, // slate-100
            ticks: { font: { size: 10 }, color: '#94a3b8' } 
          },
          x: { 
            grid: { display: false, drawBorder: false },
            ticks: { font: { size: 10 }, color: '#94a3b8' } 
          }
        },
        interaction: { intersect: false, mode: 'index' },
      }
    });
  }
};
</script>

<script>
const NetworkService = {
  /**
   * Gọi hàm Backend bằng Promise, thay thế hoàn toàn callback hell
   * @param {string} serverFunctionName - Tên hàm trên Code.gs (ví dụ: 'api_loginUser')
   * @param {Object} payload - Dữ liệu truyền lên (Token, Data...)
   * @returns {Promise<Object>} Trả về object chuẩn { success, data, message, devLog, errorCode }
   */
  call: function(serverFunctionName, payload) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(response) {
          // Xử lý theo chuẩn ApiResponse từ Backend
          if (response && response.success === true) {
            resolve(response);
          } else if (response && response.success === false) {
            console.error('[NetworkService Business Error]', response.devLog || response.message);
            reject(new Error(response.message || 'Lỗi nghiệp vụ từ máy chủ.'));
          } else {
            // Fallback cho trường hợp Backend trả về sai format
            console.warn('[NetworkService Warning] Phản hồi không đúng định dạng chuẩn.');
            resolve(response);
          }
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
          // Bắt lỗi hệ thống (Network đứt, GAS Timeout, Lỗi 5xx)
          console.error('[NetworkService System Error]', error);
          reject(new Error('Lỗi kết nối máy chủ. Vui lòng thử lại sau.'));
        })
        [serverFunctionName](payload);
    });
  }
};
</script>

<script>
const SubjectDetailController = {
  
  init: function() {
    // 1. Lấy mã môn học từ LocalStorage (Được lưu từ trang Khóa học)
    const activeSubjectId = localStorage.getItem('current_active_subject') || "SUBJECT_TV";
    this.fetchData(activeSubjectId);
  },

  fetchData: async function(subjectId) {
    const token = AuthService.getToken();
    if (!token) return;

    try {
      const payload = { token: token, subjectId: subjectId };
      const response = await NetworkService.call('api_getSubjectDetail', payload);
      
      const data = response.data;
      this.applyThemeAndHeader(data.header);
      this.renderSidebarTimeline(data.sidebar, data.header.theme);
      this.renderTaskGrid(data.taskGrid, data.header.theme);
      this.renderWidgets(data.widgets, data.header.theme);
      
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[SubjectDetail] Fetch Error:", err);
      document.getElementById('sd-banner').innerHTML = `<p class="text-red-500 font-bold p-10 bg-white rounded-xl">Lỗi tải dữ liệu: ${err.message}</p>`;
    }
  },

  /**
   * Thay áo (Theming) và đổ dữ liệu Header
   */
  applyThemeAndHeader: function(headerData) {
    const th = headerData.theme;
    
    // Đổi Text Header
    document.getElementById('sd-title').textContent = headerData.title;
    document.getElementById('sd-subtitle').textContent = headerData.subtitle;
    document.getElementById('sd-greeting').textContent = headerData.greeting;
    document.getElementById('sd-greeting-sub').textContent = headerData.greetingSub;
    document.getElementById('sd-completed-lessons').textContent = headerData.completedStr;

    // Đổi Màu Khối (Icon, Banner, Progress)
    const iconMain = document.getElementById('sd-icon-main');
    iconMain.className = `w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-2xl shadow-sm ${th.bg} ${th.text}`;
    
    const banner = document.getElementById('sd-banner');
    banner.className = `w-full rounded-3xl p-8 relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-center transition-colors duration-500 min-h-[160px] ${th.bg}`;
    
    const iconBook = document.getElementById('sd-icon-book');
    iconBook.className = `w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-xl ${th.bg} ${th.text}`;

    const progressBar = document.getElementById('sd-progress-bar');
    progressBar.className = `h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-1000 ${th.accent}`;
    
    // Animation Thanh Tiến Độ
    setTimeout(() => {
      progressBar.style.width = headerData.progress + '%';
      document.getElementById('sd-progress-text').textContent = headerData.progress + '%';
      document.getElementById('sd-progress-text').classList.add(th.text);
    }, 100);
  },

  /**
   * Vẽ Cây Bài Học bên Trái (Timeline)
   */
  renderSidebarTimeline: function(sidebarData, theme) {
    document.getElementById('sd-active-topic').textContent = sidebarData.activeTopic;
    const listEl = document.getElementById('sd-lesson-list');
    listEl.innerHTML = '';

    sidebarData.lessons.forEach(lesson => {
      let statusIcon = '';
      let dotColor = '';
      let textClass = 'text-slate-700';
      let wrapperClass = '';

      if (lesson.status === "completed") {
        statusIcon = `<span class="w-5 h-5 bg-green-500 text-white rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-bold shadow-sm">✓</span>`;
        dotColor = 'bg-green-500';
      } else if (lesson.status === "active") {
        statusIcon = `<button class="${theme.btn} text-white w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-bold shadow-md hover:scale-110 transition-transform">▶</button>`;
        dotColor = theme.accent;
        wrapperClass = `bg-white shadow-md border ${theme.border} p-3 rounded-2xl -ml-6 z-10 relative flex-1`; // Nổi bật bài đang học
        textClass = `font-extrabold ${theme.text}`;
      } else {
        statusIcon = `<span class="text-slate-300">🔒</span>`;
        dotColor = 'bg-slate-200';
        textClass = 'text-slate-400';
      }

      const lessonEl = document.createElement('div');
      lessonEl.className = "relative flex items-center gap-4 cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-50 p-2 rounded-xl transition-colors group";
      
      // Chấm tròn Timeline
      const dot = `<div class="absolute -left-[23px] w-3 h-3 ${dotColor} rounded-full ring-4 ring-white"></div>`;
      
      const content = `
        <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center text-xl shrink-0 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform shadow-sm border border-slate-100">
          ${lesson.icon}
        </div>
        <div class="flex-1 ${wrapperClass}">
          <h4 class="text-sm font-bold ${textClass} line-clamp-1">${lesson.title}</h4>
          <p class="text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-500 line-clamp-1">${lesson.desc}</p>
        </div>
        <div class="shrink-0 ml-2">
          ${statusIcon}
        </div>
      `;

      lessonEl.innerHTML = dot + content;
      listEl.appendChild(lessonEl);
    });
  },

  /**
   * Vẽ Khối Bài Tập Tương Tác Giữa Trang
   */
  renderTaskGrid: function(tasks, theme) {
    const gridEl = document.getElementById('sd-task-grid');
    gridEl.innerHTML = '';

    tasks.forEach(task => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = `${task.bg} border border-white/50 p-4 rounded-2xl flex flex-col justify-between hover:shadow-md cursor-pointer transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 min-h-[120px] group`;
      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
          <div class="w-10 h-10 bg-white rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-xl shadow-sm group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
             ${task.icon}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <h4 class="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm mb-1">${task.title}</h4>
          <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium">${task.desc}</p>
        </div>
      `;
      gridEl.appendChild(card);
    });
  },

  /**
   * Đổ dữ liệu Widgets Cột Phải
   */
  renderWidgets: function(widgets, theme) {
    // Streak
    document.getElementById('sd-header-streak').textContent = widgets.streak;
    document.getElementById('sd-streak-count').textContent = widgets.streak;
    
    // Fact
    document.getElementById('sd-fact').textContent = widgets.fact;

    // Goals
    const goalsEl = document.getElementById('sd-daily-goals');
    goalsEl.innerHTML = '';
    widgets.dailyGoals.forEach(goal => {
      const icon = goal.done 
        ? `<span class="w-5 h-5 bg-green-500 text-white rounded-md flex items-center justify-center text-xs shadow-sm">✓</span>` 
        : `<span class="w-5 h-5 bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 rounded-md"></span>`;
      
      const textClass = goal.done ? "text-slate-400 line-through" : "text-slate-700";

      const li = document.createElement('li');
      li.className = "flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-50 p-1.5 rounded-lg";
      li.innerHTML = `${icon} <span class="${textClass}">${goal.task}</span>`;
      goalsEl.appendChild(li);
    });
  }
};
</script>

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - MIGRATION DATA HELPERS
 * Step: 3H.8
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 */


/**
 * Danh sách nguồn Legacy V2.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_getLegacySources_() {
  return [
    {
      sheetName: 'LEGACY_V2_Data_Users',
      targetSheets: [
        'DATA_Users',
        'DATA_Children',
        'DATA_UserChildAccess'
      ],
      optional: false
    },
    {
      sheetName: 'LEGACY_V2_Data_Tasks',
      targetSheets: [
        'DATA_Assignments'
      ],
      optional: false
    },
    {
      sheetName: 'LEGACY_V2_Thiet_Lap',
      targetSheets: [
        'SYS_Config'
      ],
      optional: false
    },
    {
      sheetName: 'LEGACY_V2_Danh_Muc',
      targetSheets: [
        'SYS_Categories'
      ],
      optional: false
    },
    {
      sheetName: 'LEGACY_V2_Log_HeThong',
      targetSheets: [
        'LOG_Audit'
      ],
      optional: false
    },
    {
      sheetName: 'LEGACY_V2_Data_Scores',
      targetSheets: [
        'DATA_Attempts',
        'DATA_Responses'
      ],
      optional: true
    }
  ];
}


/**
 * Đọc dữ liệu Legacy thành object theo header.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_readLegacyRows_(
  sheet
) {
  var lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
  var lastColumn = sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (
    lastRow < 1 ||
    lastColumn < 1
  ) {
    return {
      headerRow: 0,
      headers: [],
      rows: []
    };
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        1,
        1,
        lastRow,
        lastColumn
      )
      .getDisplayValues();

  var headerRowIndex =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_findHeaderRowIndex_(
      values
    );

  if (headerRowIndex < 0) {
    return {
      headerRow: 0,
      headers: [],
      rows: []
    };
  }

  var headers =
    values[headerRowIndex];

  var normalizedHeaders = [];

  for (
    var h = 0;
    h < headers.length;
    h++
  ) {
    normalizedHeaders.push(
      kidlearnV3_v2m_normalizeHeader_(
        headers[h]
      )
    );
  }

  var rows = [];

  for (
    var r = headerRowIndex + 1;
    r < values.length;
    r++
  ) {
    if (
      !kidlearnV3_v2m_hasData_(
        values[r]
      )
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    var row = {
      _rowNumber: r + 1,
      _raw: {}
    };

    for (
      var c = 0;
      c < headers.length;
      c++
    ) {
      var label =
        String(headers[c] || '').trim();

      var normalized =
        normalizedHeaders[c];

      var value =
        values[r][c];

      if (label !== '') {
        row[label] = value;
      }

      if (normalized !== '') {
        row[normalized] = value;
      }

      row._raw[
        label || ('COL_' + (c + 1))
      ] = value;
    }

    rows.push(row);
  }

  return {
    headerRow: headerRowIndex + 1,
    headers: headers,
    rows: rows
  };
}


/**
 * Tìm dòng header.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_findHeaderRowIndex_(
  values
) {
  var maxRows =
    Math.min(
      values.length,
      5
    );

  for (
    var r = 0;
    r < maxRows;
    r++
  ) {
    var count = 0;

    for (
      var c = 0;
      c < values[r].length;
      c++
    ) {
      if (
        String(values[r][c] || '').trim() !== ''
      ) {
        count++;
      }
    }

    if (count >= 2) {
      return r;
    }
  }

  return -1;
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra một dòng có dữ liệu.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_hasData_(
  rowValues
) {
  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < rowValues.length;
    i++
  ) {
    if (
      String(rowValues[i] || '').trim() !== ''
    ) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}


/**
 * Normalize header.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_normalizeHeader_(
  value
) {
  var text =
    String(value || '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

  try {
    text =
      text
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(
          /[\u0300-\u036f]/g,
          ''
        );
  } catch (error) {
    // Ignore normalize errors.
  }

  text =
    text.replace(
      /đ/g,
      'd'
    );

  text =
    text.replace(
      /[^a-z0-9]+/g,
      ''
    );

  return text;
}


/**
 * Lấy giá trị từ legacy row theo nhiều tên cột có thể có.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_pick_(
  legacyRow,
  candidates
) {
  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < candidates.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var candidate =
      candidates[i];

    if (
      legacyRow[candidate] !== undefined &&
      String(legacyRow[candidate]).trim() !== ''
    ) {
      return String(legacyRow[candidate]).trim();
    }

    var normalized =
      kidlearnV3_v2m_normalizeHeader_(
        candidate
      );

    if (
      legacyRow[normalized] !== undefined &&
      String(legacyRow[normalized]).trim() !== ''
    ) {
      return String(legacyRow[normalized]).trim();
    }
  }

  return '';
}


/**
 * Tạo ID hợp lệ theo prefix primary key trong schema.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_makeId_(
  definition,
  suffix
) {
  var prefix =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_getPrimaryPrefix_(
      definition
    );

  var cleanSuffix =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_code_(
      suffix
    );

  return prefix + cleanSuffix;
}


/**
 * Lấy prefix của primary key.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_getPrimaryPrefix_(
  definition
) {
  var primaryColumn =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_findColumn_(
      definition,
      definition.primaryKey
    );

  if (
    primaryColumn &&
    primaryColumn.validation &&
    primaryColumn.validation.prefix
  ) {
    return primaryColumn.validation.prefix;
  }

  var sheetName =
    definition.sheetName || '';

  var fallback = {
    DATA_Users: 'USR_',
    DATA_Children: 'CHILD_',
    DATA_UserChildAccess: 'UCA_',
    DATA_Assignments: 'ASG_',
    SYS_Categories: 'CAT_',
    LOG_Audit: 'AUD_',
    SYS_MigrationLog: 'MIG_'
  };

  return fallback[sheetName] || 'ID_';
}


/**
 * Chuẩn hóa code.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_code_(
  value
) {
  var text =
    String(value || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  try {
    text =
      text
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(
          /[\u0300-\u036f]/g,
          ''
        );
  } catch (error) {
    // Ignore normalize errors.
  }

  text =
    text.replace(
      /Đ/g,
      'D'
    );

  text =
    text.replace(
      /[^A-Z0-9]+/g,
      '_'
    );

  text =
    text.replace(
      /^_+|_+$/g,
      ''
    );

  if (text === '') {
    text = 'UNKNOWN';
  }

  return text;
}


/**
 * Tìm column definition.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_findColumn_(
  definition,
  key
) {
  var columns =
    definition.columns || [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < columns.length;
    i++
  ) {
    if (
      columns[i].key === key
    ) {
      return columns[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra Sheet có column key không.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_hasColumn_(
  definition,
  key
) {
  return (
    kidlearnV3_v2m_findColumn_(
      definition,
      key
    ) !== null
  );
}


/**
 * Set field nếu schema có cột đó.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
  definition,
  row,
  key,
  value
) {
  if (
    kidlearnV3_v2m_hasColumn_(
      definition,
      key
    )
  ) {
    row[key] = value;
  }
}

/**
 * Tạo access giữa family admin và child.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_createUserChildAccess_(
  sheet,
  definition,
  runtime
) {
  var count = 0;
  var now = new Date();

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < runtime.familyAdminUserIds.length;
    i++
  ) {
    for (
      var j = 0;
      j < runtime.childIds.length;
      j++
    ) {
      var userId =
        runtime.familyAdminUserIds[i];

      var childId =
        runtime.childIds[j];

      var accessId =
        kidlearnV3_v2m_makeId_(
          definition,
          'V2_ACCESS_' +
          kidlearnV3_v2m_code_(userId) +
          '_' +
          kidlearnV3_v2m_code_(childId)
        );

      var row = {};

      row[definition.primaryKey] =
        accessId;

      kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
        definition,
        row,
        'accessId',
        accessId
      );

      kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
        definition,
        row,
        'userChildAccessId',
        accessId
      );

      kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
        definition,
        row,
        'userId',
        userId
      );

      kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
        definition,
        row,
        'childId',
        childId
      );

      kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
        definition,
        row,
        'role',
        'FAMILY_ADMIN'
      );

      kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
        definition,
        row,
        'accessRole',
        'FAMILY_ADMIN'
      );

      kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
        definition,
        row,
        'isPrimary',
        true
      );

      kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
        definition,
        row,
        'status',
        'ACTIVE'
      );

      kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
        definition,
        row,
        'createdAt',
        now
      );

      kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
        definition,
        row,
        'updatedAt',
        now
      );

      kidlearnV3_v2m_upsertRow_(
        sheet,
        definition,
        row
      );

      count++;
    }
  }

  return count;
}


/**
 * Build DATA_Assignments row.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_buildAssignmentRow_(
  definition,
  legacyRow,
  assignmentId,
  defaultChildId
) {
  var now = new Date();
  var row = {};

  row[definition.primaryKey] =
    assignmentId;

  var title =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_pick_(
      legacyRow,
      [
        'title',
        'taskTitle',
        'taskName',
        'ten nhiem vu',
        'noi dung',
        'bai tap',
        'name'
      ]
    );

  if (!title) {
    title =
      'Nhiệm vụ V2 dòng ' +
      legacyRow._rowNumber;
  }

  var status =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_inferAssignmentStatus_(
      legacyRow
    );

  kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
    definition,
    row,
    'assignmentId',

/**
 * Upsert row theo primary key.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_upsertRow_(
  sheet,
  definition,
  rowObject
) {
  if (
    !sheet ||
    !definition
  ) {
    return {
      action: 'SKIPPED',
      reason: 'SHEET_OR_SCHEMA_MISSING'
    };
  }

  var primaryKey =
    definition.primaryKey;

  var primaryValue =
    String(rowObject[primaryKey] || '').trim();

  if (!primaryValue) {
    return {
      action: 'SKIPPED',
      reason: 'PRIMARY_VALUE_EMPTY'
    };
  }

  var rowValues =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_buildRowValues_(
      definition,
      rowObject
    );

  var rowNumber =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_findRowByPrimary_(
      sheet,
      definition,
      primaryValue
    );

  if (rowNumber > 0) {
    sheet
      .getRange(
        rowNumber,
        1,
        1,
        rowValues.length
      )
      .setValues([
        rowValues
      ]);

    return {
      action: 'UPDATED',
      rowNumber: rowNumber
    };
  }

  var nextRow =
    sheet.getLastRow() + 1;

  if (nextRow < 3) {
    nextRow = 3;
  }

  sheet
    .getRange(
      nextRow,
      1,
      1,
      rowValues.length
    )
    .setValues([
      rowValues
    ]);

  return {
    action: 'INSERTED',
    rowNumber: nextRow
  };
}


/**
 * Build row values theo schema.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_buildRowValues_(
  definition,
  rowObject
) {
  var values = [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < definition.columns.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var column =
      definition.columns[i];

    if (
      rowObject[column.key] !== undefined
    ) {
      values.push(
        rowObject[column.key]
      );
    } else {
      values.push(
        kidlearnV3_v2m_defaultValue_(
          column
        )
      );
    }
  }

  return values;
}


/**
 * Default value theo schema.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_defaultValue_(
  column
) {
  var D =
    KIDLEARN_V3_DEFAULTS;

  var value =
    column.defaultValue;

  if (
    value === undefined ||
    value === null
  ) {
    return '';
  }

  if (
    D &&
    value === D.NOW
  ) {
    return new Date();
  }

  if (
    D &&
    value === D.TODAY
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_v2m_today_();
  }

  if (
    D &&
    value === D.SYSTEM
  ) {
    return 'MIGRATION_V2';
  }

  if (
    D &&
    value === D.EMPTY_JSON_ARRAY
  ) {
    return '[]';
  }

  if (
    D &&
    value === D.EMPTY_JSON_OBJECT
  ) {
    return '{}';
  }

  return value;
}


/**
 * Tìm dòng theo primary key.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_findRowByPrimary_(
  sheet,
  definition,
  primaryValue
) {
  var columnIndex =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_columnIndex_(
      definition,
      definition.primaryKey
    );

  if (columnIndex < 1) {
    return 0;
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < 3) {
    return 0;
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        3,
        columnIndex,
        lastRow - 2,
        1
      )
      .getDisplayValues();

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < values.length;
    i++
  ) {
    if (
      String(values[i][0] || '').trim() ===
      String(primaryValue)
    ) {
      return i + 3;
    }
  }

  return 0;
}


/**
 * Tìm index cột.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_columnIndex_(
  definition,
  key
) {
  var columns =
    definition.columns || [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < columns.length;
    i++
  ) {
    if (
      columns[i].key === key
    ) {
      return i + 1;
    }
  }

  return 0;
}


/**
 * Infer role từ V2.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_inferRole_(
  legacyRow
) {
  var role =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_pick_(
      legacyRow,
      [
        'role',
        'userRole',
        'vai tro',
        'loai nguoi dung',
        'type'
      ]
    );

  var normalized =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_normalizeHeader_(
      role
    );

  if (
    normalized.indexOf('child') !== -1 ||
    normalized.indexOf('student') !== -1 ||
    normalized.indexOf('hocsinh') !== -1 ||
    normalized.indexOf('be') !== -1
  ) {
    return 'CHILD';
  }

  return 'FAMILY_ADMIN';
}


/**
 * Có nên tạo child từ legacy row không.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_shouldCreateChild_(
  legacyRow,
  role
) {
  if (role === 'CHILD') {
    return true;
  }

  var childName =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_pick_(
      legacyRow,
      [
        'childName',
        'studentName',
        'ten be',
        'ten hoc sinh',
        'lop',
        'grade',
        'gradeLevel'
      ]
    );

  return childName !== '';
}


/**
 * Infer assignment status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_inferAssignmentStatus_(
  legacyRow
) {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_pick_(
      legacyRow,
      [
        'status',
        'trang thai',
        'done',
        'completed',
        'isDone'
      ]
    );

  var normalized =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_normalizeHeader_(
      status
    );

  if (
    normalized === 'true' ||
    normalized.indexOf('done') !== -1 ||
    normalized.indexOf('complete') !== -1 ||
    normalized.indexOf('hoanthanh') !== -1
  ) {
    return 'COMPLETED';
  }

  if (
    normalized.indexOf('cancel') !== -1 ||
    normalized.indexOf('huy') !== -1
  ) {
    return 'CANCELLED';
  }

  if (
    normalized.indexOf('overdue') !== -1 ||
    normalized.indexOf('trehan') !== -1
  ) {
    return 'OVERDUE';
  }

  return 'ASSIGNED';
}


/**
 * JSON summary ngắn.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_jsonSummary_(
  objectValue
) {
  var text = '';

  try {
    text =
      JSON.stringify(objectValue);
  } catch (error) {
    text =
      String(objectValue || '');
  }

  if (text.length > 2500) {
    text =
      text.substring(0, 2500);
  }

  return text;
}


/**
 * Date hôm nay.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_today_() {
  var now = new Date();

  return new Date(
    now.getFullYear(),
    now.getMonth(),
    now.getDate()
  );
}


/**
 * Report missing source.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_reportMissing_(
  sourceSheetName,
  optional
) {
  return {
    sourceSheet: sourceSheetName,
    status: optional ? 'OPTIONAL_MISSING' : 'MISSING',
    sourceRowCount: 0,
    message: optional
      ? 'Sheet Legacy tùy chọn không tồn tại.'
      : 'Thiếu Sheet Legacy bắt buộc.'
  };
}


/**
 * Tóm tắt report.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_summarizeReport_(
  report
) {
  var summary = {
    sourceCount: report.length,
    missingCount: 0,
    optionalMissingCount: 0,
    doneCount: 0,
    skippedCount: 0
  };

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < report.length;
    i++
  ) {
    if (
      report[i].status === 'MISSING'
    ) {
      summary.missingCount++;
    }

    if (
      report[i].status === 'OPTIONAL_MISSING'
    ) {
      summary.optionalMissingCount++;
    }

    if (
      report[i].status === 'DONE'
    ) {
      summary.doneCount++;
    }

    if (
      String(report[i].status).indexOf('SKIPPED') === 0
    ) {
      summary.skippedCount++;
    }
  }

  return summary;
}


/**
 * Ghi summary vào SYS_MigrationLog.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_writeMigrationSummary_(
  spreadsheet,
  schema,
  summary
) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'SYS_MigrationLog'
    );

  var definition =
    schema.SYS_MigrationLog;

  if (
    !sheet ||
    !definition
  ) {
    return;
  }

  var now = new Date();

  var migrationId =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_makeId_(
      definition,
      'V2_TO_V3_' +
      Utilities.formatDate(
        now,
        Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
        'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
      )
    );

  var row = {};

  row[definition.primaryKey] =
    migrationId;

  kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
    definition,
    row,
    'migrationId',
    migrationId
  );

  kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
    definition,
    row,
    'migrationName',
    'V2_TO_V3_DATA_MIGRATION'
  );

  kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
    definition,
    row,
    'sourceVersion',
    'V2'
  );

  kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
    definition,
    row,
    'targetVersion',
    KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION
  );

  kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
    definition,
    row,
    'status',
    summary.missingCount === 0
      ? 'COMPLETED'
      : 'PARTIAL'
  );

  kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
    definition,
    row,
    'message',
    kidlearnV3_v2m_jsonSummary_(
      summary
    )
  );

  kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
    definition,
    row,
    'startedAt',
    now
  );

  kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
    definition,
    row,
    'completedAt',
    now
  );

  kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
    definition,
    row,
    'createdAt',
    now
  );

  kidlearnV3_v2m_set_(
    definition,
    row,
    'createdBy',
    'MIGRATION_V2'
  );

  kidlearnV3_v2m_upsertRow_(
    sheet,
    definition,
    row
  );
}


/**
 * Mark setup status sau migration.
 * Ghi trực tiếp vào ScriptProperties để không bị chặn bởi enum setup status cũ.
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_markMigratedSafe_() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.SETUP_STATUS,
    'V2_DATA_MIGRATED'
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DATA_MIGRATED_AT',
    new Date().toISOString()
  );
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - MIGRATE DATA V2 TO V3
 * Step: 3H.8
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * File này migrate dữ liệu từ LEGACY_V2_* sang V3.
 *
 * KHÔNG xóa Sheet.
 * KHÔNG xóa dữ liệu Legacy.
 * KHÔNG đổi tên Sheet.
 * Có thể chạy lại an toàn theo primary key.
 */


/**
 * Preview migration V2 sang V3.
 * Hàm này chỉ đọc dữ liệu, không ghi.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewMigrationV2ToV3() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  kidlearnV3_validateCreatedSheets();

  var spreadsheet =
    context.spreadsheet;

  var schema =
    kidlearnV3_buildSchema_();

  var sources =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_getLegacySources_();

  var report = [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < sources.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var source =
      sources[i];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        source.sheetName
      );

    if (!sheet) {
      report.push({
        sourceSheet: source.sheetName,
        targetSheets: source.targetSheets,
        optional: source.optional,
        status: source.optional ? 'OPTIONAL_MISSING' : 'MISSING',
        rowCount: 0,
        message: source.optional
          ? 'Sheet Legacy tùy chọn không tồn tại.'
          : 'Thiếu Sheet Legacy bắt buộc.'
      });

      continue;
    }

    var rows =
      kidlearnV3_v2m_readLegacyRows_(
        sheet
      );

    report.push({
      sourceSheet: source.sheetName,
      targetSheets: source.targetSheets,
      optional: source.optional,
      status: 'READY',
      headerRow: rows.headerRow,
      rowCount: rows.rows.length,
      headers: rows.headers
    });
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    environment: context.environment,
    spreadsheetName: context.spreadsheetName,
    schemaVersion: KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
    report: report
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Chạy migration V2 sang V3.
 *
 * Có thể chạy lại an toàn.
 */
function kidlearnV3_migrateV2ToV3() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  kidlearnV3_validateCreatedSheets();
  kidlearnV3_assertValidBackup_();

  var lock =
    LockService.getDocumentLock();

  var locked =
    lock.tryLock(
      KIDLEARN_V3.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS
    );

  if (!locked) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không lấy được document lock. Có thể tiến trình khác đang chạy.'
    );
  }

  try {
    var spreadsheet =
      context.spreadsheet;

    var schema =
      kidlearnV3_buildSchema_();

    var runtime = {
      migratedUserIds: [],
      migratedChildIds: [],
      familyAdminUserIds: [],
      childIds: [],
      defaultChildId: '',
      startedAt: new Date()
    };

    var report = [];

    report.push(
      kidlearnV3_v2m_migrateUsersAndChildren_(
        spreadsheet,
        schema,
        runtime
      )
    );

    report.push(
      kidlearnV3_v2m_migrateSettings_(
        spreadsheet,
        schema
      )
    );

    report.push(
      kidlearnV3_v2m_migrateCategories_(
        spreadsheet,
        schema
      )
    );

    report.push(
      kidlearnV3_v2m_migrateTasks_(
        spreadsheet,
        schema,
        runtime
      )
    );

    report.push(
      kidlearnV3_v2m_migrateSystemLogs_(
        spreadsheet,
        schema
      )
    );

    report.push(
      kidlearnV3_v2m_migrateScoresOptional_(
        spreadsheet,
        schema,
        runtime
      )
    );

    var summary =
      kidlearnV3_v2m_summarizeReport_(
        report
      );

    kidlearnV3_v2m_writeMigrationSummary_(
      spreadsheet,
      schema,
      summary
    );

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    kidlearnV3_v2m_markMigratedSafe_();

    var result = {
      success: true,
      environment: context.environment,
      spreadsheetName: context.spreadsheetName,
      schemaVersion: KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
      summary: summary,
      report: report
    };

    console.log(
      JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
    );

    return result;

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}


/**
 * Verify migration sau khi chạy.
 */
function kidlearnV3_verifyMigrationV2ToV3() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  var spreadsheet =
    context.spreadsheet;

  var schema =
    kidlearnV3_buildSchema_();

  var errors = [];
  var report = [];

  var requiredTargets = [
    'DATA_Users',
    'DATA_Children',
    'DATA_UserChildAccess',
    'DATA_Assignments',
    'SYS_Config',
    'SYS_Categories',
    'LOG_Audit',
    'SYS_MigrationLog'
  ];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < requiredTargets.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sheetName =
      requiredTargets[i];

    var definition =
      schema[sheetName];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetName
      );

    if (
      !definition ||
      !sheet
    ) {
      errors.push(
        sheetName +
        ': thiếu Sheet hoặc schema.'
      );

      continue;
    }

    var dataCount =
      Math.max(
        0,
        sheet.getLastRow() - 2
      );

    report.push({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      dataRowCount: dataCount
    });
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    report: report
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Verify migration chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      errors.length
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Migrate LEGACY_V2_Data_Users sang:
 * - DATA_Users
 * - DATA_Children
 * - DATA_UserChildAccess
 */
function kidlearnV3_v2m_migrateUsersAndChildren_(
  spreadsheet,
  schema,
  runtime
) {
  var sourceSheetName =
    'LEGACY_V2_Data_Users';

  var sourceSheet =
    kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sourceSheetName
    );

  if (!sourceSheet) {
    return kidlearnV3_v2m_reportMissing_(
      sourceSheetName,
      false
    );
  }

  var source =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_readLegacyRows_(
      sourceSheet
    );

  var usersSheet =
    kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Users'
    );

  var childrenSheet =
    kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Children'
    );

  var accessSheet =
    kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_UserChildAccess'
    );

  var userDef =
    schema.DATA_Users;

  var childDef =
    schema.DATA_Children;

  var accessDef =
    schema.DATA_UserChildAccess;

  var userCount = 0;
  var childCount = 0;
  var accessCount = 0;

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < source.rows.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var legacyRow =
      source.rows[i];

    var rowNumber =
      legacyRow._rowNumber;

    var role =
      kidlearnV3_v2m_inferRole_(
        legacyRow
      );

    var userId =
      kidlearnV3_v2m_makeId_(
        userDef,
        'V2_USER_' + rowNumber
      );

    var userRow =
      kidlearnV3_v2m_buildUserRow_(
        userDef,
        legacyRow,
        userId,
        role
      );

    kidlearnV3_v2m_upsertRow_(
      usersSheet,
      userDef,
      userRow
    );

    userCount++;

    runtime.migratedUserIds.push(
      userId
    );

    if (role === 'FAMILY_ADMIN') {
      runtime.familyAdminUserIds.push(
        userId
      );
    }

    var shouldCreateChild =
      kidlearnV3_v2m_shouldCreateChild_(
        legacyRow,
        role
      );

    if (shouldCreateChild) {
      var childId =
        kidlearnV3_v2m_makeId_(
          childDef,
          'V2_CHILD_' + rowNumber
        );

      var childRow =
        kidlearnV3_v2m_buildChildRow_(
          childDef,
          legacyRow,
          childId
        );

      kidlearnV3_v2m_upsertRow_(
        childrenSheet,
        childDef,
        childRow
      );

      childCount++;

      runtime.migratedChildIds.push(
        childId
      );

      runtime.childIds.push(
        childId
      );
    }
  }

  if (runtime.childIds.length === 0) {
    var defaultChildId =
      kidlearnV3_v2m_makeId_(
        childDef,
        'V2_CHILD_DEFAULT'
      );

    var defaultChildRow =
      kidlearnV3_v2m_buildDefaultChildRow_(
        childDef,
        defaultChildId
      );

    kidlearnV3_v2m_upsertRow_(
      childrenSheet,
      childDef,
      defaultChildRow
    );

    runtime.childIds.push(
      defaultChildId
    );

    runtime.defaultChildId =
      defaultChildId;

    childCount++;
  } else {
    runtime.defaultChildId =
      runtime.childIds[0];
  }

  if (runtime.familyAdminUserIds.length === 0) {
    var adminId =
      kidlearnV3_v2m_makeId_(
        userDef,
        'V2_ADMIN_DEFAULT'
      );

    var adminRow =
      kidlearnV3_v2m_buildDefaultAdminRow_(
        userDef,
        adminId
      );

    kidlearnV3_v2m_upsertRow_(
      usersSheet,
      userDef,
      adminRow
    );

    runtime.familyAdminUserIds.push(
      adminId
    );

    userCount++;
  }

  accessCount =
    kidlearnV3_v2m_createUserChildAccess_(
      accessSheet,
      accessDef,
      runtime
    );

  return {
    sourceSheet: sourceSheetName,
    status: 'DONE',
    sourceRowCount: source.rows.length,
    insertedOrUpdated: {
      DATA_Users: userCount,
      DATA_Children: childCount,
      DATA_UserChildAccess: accessCount
    }
  };
}

    );

    );

  for (

  return {
    sourceSheet: sourceSheetName,
    status: 'DONE',

    insertedOrUpdated: {
      DATA_Assignments: migrated
    }
  };

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - PREPARE LEGACY V2 SHEETS
 * Step: 3H.4
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * Chức năng:
 * - Xem trước kế hoạch đổi tên Sheet V2.
 * - Cho phép Data_Scores không tồn tại.
 * - Kiểm tra backup.
 * - Đổi tên Sheet V2 sang LEGACY_V2_*.
 *
 * KHÔNG xóa Sheet.
 * KHÔNG tạo Sheet V3.
 * KHÔNG migration dữ liệu.
 */


/**
 * Data_Scores là Sheet tùy chọn.
 *
 * Một số bản V2 không có Sheet này.
 */
function kidlearnV3_isOptionalLegacySheet_(
  sourceName
) {
  var optionalSheets = [
    'Data_Scores'
  ];

  return (
    optionalSheets.indexOf(sourceName) !== -1
  );
}


/**
 * Xem trước trạng thái các Sheet V2.
 *
 * Hàm chỉ đọc dữ liệu.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewLegacyRename() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  var spreadsheet =
    context.spreadsheet;

  var plan =
    kidlearnV3_buildLegacyRenamePlan_(
      spreadsheet
    );

  var result = {
    success: true,

    environment:
      context.environment,

    spreadsheetName:
      context.spreadsheetName,

    totalCount:
      plan.length,

    readyCount:
      kidlearnV3_countLegacyPlanStatus_(
        plan,
        'READY'
      ),

    alreadyRenamedCount:
      kidlearnV3_countLegacyPlanStatus_(
        plan,
        'ALREADY_RENAMED'
      ),

    optionalMissingCount:
      kidlearnV3_countLegacyPlanStatus_(
        plan,
        'OPTIONAL_MISSING'
      ),

    missingCount:
      kidlearnV3_countLegacyPlanStatus_(
        plan,
        'MISSING'
      ),

    conflictCount:
      kidlearnV3_countLegacyPlanStatus_(
        plan,
        'CONFLICT'
      ),

    caseConflictCount:
      kidlearnV3_countLegacyPlanStatus_(
        plan,
        'CASE_CONFLICT'
      ),

    backup:
      kidlearnV3_getStoredBackupInfo_(),

    plan:
      plan
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Quy trình an toàn:
 *
 * 1. Kiểm tra Sheet V2.
 * 2. Tạo backup.
 * 3. Đổi tên các Sheet hiện có.
 */
function kidlearnV3_backupAndRenameLegacySheets() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewLegacyRename();

  kidlearnV3_assertLegacyPreviewReady_(
    preview
  );

  var completedCount =
    preview.alreadyRenamedCount +
    preview.optionalMissingCount;

  if (
    preview.readyCount === 0 &&
    completedCount === preview.totalCount
  ) {
    var noChangeResult = {
      success: true,

      action:
        'NO_CHANGE',

      message:
        'Các Sheet V2 hiện có đã được đổi tên. ' +
        'Sheet Legacy tùy chọn không tồn tại.',

      backup:
        preview.backup,

      renamePreview:
        preview
    };

    console.log(
      JSON.stringify(
        noChangeResult,
        null,
        2
      )
    );

    return noChangeResult;
  }

  var backupResult =
    kidlearnV3_backupDatabaseV3();

  var renameResult =
    kidlearnV3_renameLegacySheets();

  var result = {
    success: true,

    action:
      'BACKUP_AND_RENAME_COMPLETED',

    backup:
      backupResult,

    rename:
      renameResult
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Đổi tên các Sheet V2 đang tồn tại.
 *
 * Data_Scores không tồn tại sẽ được bỏ qua.
 */
function kidlearnV3_renameLegacySheets() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  var backupInfo =
    kidlearnV3_assertValidBackup_();

  var spreadsheet =
    context.spreadsheet;

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewLegacyRename();

  kidlearnV3_assertLegacyPreviewReady_(
    preview
  );

  var lock =
    LockService.getDocumentLock();

  var locked =
    lock.tryLock(
      KIDLEARN_V3.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS
    );

  if (!locked) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không lấy được document lock. ' +
      'Có thể một tiến trình khác đang chạy.'
    );
  }

  try {
    var map =
      KIDLEARN_V2_LEGACY_SHEET_MAP;

    var sourceNames =
      Object.keys(map);

    var report = [];

    for (
      var i = 0;
      i < sourceNames.length;
      i++
    ) {
      var sourceName =
        sourceNames[i];

      var targetName =
        map[sourceName];

      var sourceSheet =
        spreadsheet.getSheetByName(
          sourceName
        );

      var targetSheet =
        spreadsheet.getSheetByName(
          targetName
        );

      if (
        sourceSheet &&
        targetSheet
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          'Xung đột: đồng thời tồn tại ' +
          sourceName +
          ' và ' +
          targetName +
          '.'
        );
      }

      if (
        !sourceSheet &&
        targetSheet
      ) {
        report.push({
          sourceName:
            sourceName,

          targetName:
            targetName,

          action:
            'ALREADY_RENAMED'
        });

        continue;
      }

      if (
        !sourceSheet &&
        !targetSheet
      ) {
        if (
          kidlearnV3_isOptionalLegacySheet_(
            sourceName
          )
        ) {
          report.push({
            sourceName:
              sourceName,

            targetName:
              targetName,

            action:
              'OPTIONAL_MISSING'
          });

          continue;
        }

        throw new Error(
          'Không tìm thấy Sheet nguồn hoặc Legacy: ' +
          sourceName
        );
      }

      sourceSheet.setName(
        targetName
      );

      report.push({
        sourceName:
          sourceName,

        targetName:
          targetName,

        action:
          'RENAMED'
      });
    }

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    kidlearnV3_verifyLegacyRename_(
      spreadsheet
    );

    kidlearnV3_setSetupStatus_(
      KIDLEARN_V3
        .SETUP_STATUS
        .LEGACY_RENAMED
    );

    var result = {
      success: true,

      setupStatus:
        KIDLEARN_V3
          .SETUP_STATUS
          .LEGACY_RENAMED,

      backupFileId:
        backupInfo.backupFileId,

      backupName:
        backupInfo.backupName,

      renamedCount:
        kidlearnV3_countLegacyReportAction_(
          report,
          'RENAMED'
        ),

      alreadyRenamedCount:
        kidlearnV3_countLegacyReportAction_(
          report,
          'ALREADY_RENAMED'
        ),

      optionalMissingCount:
        kidlearnV3_countLegacyReportAction_(
          report,
          'OPTIONAL_MISSING'
        ),

      totalProcessed:
        report.length,

      sheets:
        report
    };

    console.log(
      JSON.stringify(
        result,
        null,
        2
      )
    );

    return result;

  } catch (error) {
    kidlearnV3_setSetupStatus_(
      KIDLEARN_V3
        .SETUP_STATUS
        .FAILED
    );

    throw error;

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}


/**
 * Xây dựng kế hoạch đổi tên Sheet V2.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildLegacyRenamePlan_(
  spreadsheet
) {
  var map =
    KIDLEARN_V2_LEGACY_SHEET_MAP;

  var sourceNames =
    Object.keys(map);

  var plan = [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < sourceNames.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sourceName =
      sourceNames[i];

    var targetName =
      map[sourceName];

    var sourceSheet =
      spreadsheet.getSheetByName(
        sourceName
      );

    var targetSheet =
      spreadsheet.getSheetByName(
        targetName
      );

    var targetCaseConflict =
      kidlearnV3_findSheetIgnoreCase_(
        spreadsheet,
        targetName
      );

    var item = {
      order:
        i + 1,

      sourceName:
        sourceName,

      targetName:
        targetName,

      sourceExists:
        sourceSheet !== null,

      targetExists:
        targetSheet !== null,

      optional:
        kidlearnV3_isOptionalLegacySheet_(
          sourceName
        ),

      status:
        '',

      message:
        ''
    };

    if (targetCaseConflict) {
      item.status =
        'CASE_CONFLICT';

      item.message =
        'Có Sheet gần giống tên Legacy: ' +
        targetCaseConflict.getName();

      plan.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (
      sourceSheet &&
      targetSheet
    ) {
      item.status =
        'CONFLICT';

      item.message =
        'Đồng thời tồn tại Sheet nguồn và Sheet Legacy.';

      plan.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (
      sourceSheet &&
      !targetSheet
    ) {
      item.status =
        'READY';

      item.message =
        'Sẵn sàng đổi tên.';

      plan.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (
      !sourceSheet &&
      targetSheet
    ) {
      item.status =
        'ALREADY_RENAMED';

      item.message =
        'Sheet đã được đổi tên trước đó.';

      plan.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (
      kidlearnV3_isOptionalLegacySheet_(
        sourceName
      )
    ) {
      item.status =
        'OPTIONAL_MISSING';

      item.message =
        'Sheet tùy chọn không tồn tại. ' +
        'Có thể tiếp tục quy trình.';

      plan.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    item.status =
      'MISSING';

    item.message =
      'Không tìm thấy Sheet nguồn hoặc Legacy.';

    plan.push(item);
  }

  return plan;
}


/**
 * Dừng nếu preview có lỗi nghiêm trọng.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertLegacyPreviewReady_(
  preview
) {
  if (
    preview.conflictCount > 0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'DỪNG THỰC THI: Có Sheet nguồn và ' +
      'Sheet Legacy cùng tồn tại.'
    );
  }

  if (
    preview.caseConflictCount > 0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'DỪNG THỰC THI: Có xung đột tên Sheet ' +
      'không phân biệt chữ hoa thường.'
    );
  }

  if (
    preview.missingCount > 0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'DỪNG THỰC THI: Có Sheet V2 bắt buộc bị thiếu. ' +
      'Xem kết quả preview.'
    );
  }

  return true;
}


/**
 * Xác nhận các Sheet V2 hiện có đã được đổi tên.
 */
function kidlearnV3_verifyLegacyRename_(
  spreadsheet
) {
  var map =
    KIDLEARN_V2_LEGACY_SHEET_MAP;

  var sourceNames =
    Object.keys(map);

  var errors = [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < sourceNames.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sourceName =
      sourceNames[i];

    var targetName =
      map[sourceName];

    var sourceSheet =
      spreadsheet.getSheetByName(
        sourceName
      );

    var targetSheet =
      spreadsheet.getSheetByName(
        targetName
      );

    if (sourceSheet) {
      errors.push(
        'Sheet nguồn vẫn còn: ' +
        sourceName
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (targetSheet) {
      continue;
    }

    if (
      kidlearnV3_isOptionalLegacySheet_(
        sourceName
      )
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    errors.push(
      'Thiếu Sheet Legacy bắt buộc: ' +
      targetName
    );
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Kiểm tra Legacy thất bại: ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return true;
}


/**
 * Đếm trạng thái trong kế hoạch.
 */
function kidlearnV3_countLegacyPlanStatus_(
  plan,
  status
) {
  var count = 0;

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < plan.length;
    i++
  ) {
    if (
      plan[i].status === status
    ) {
      count++;
    }
  }

  return count;
}


/**
 * Đếm hành động trong báo cáo.
 */
function kidlearnV3_countLegacyReportAction_(
  report,
  action
) {
  var count = 0;

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < report.length;
    i++
  ) {
    if (
      report[i].action === action
    ) {
      count++;
    }
  }

  return count;
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - PERFORMANCE BASELINE / CACHE STRATEGY
 * Bundle: 3M-B
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * 3M-B:
 * - Không ghi dữ liệu học tập thật
 * - Không real write
 * - Không rollback
 * - Không migration
 * - Không create/delete sheet
 * - Chỉ ghi ScriptProperties để lưu baseline/status
 * - Chỉ dùng CacheService để test cache
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MB_STATUS',
  LAST_PREVIEW_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MB_LAST_PREVIEW_AT',
  LAST_BASELINE_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MB_LAST_BASELINE_AT',
  LAST_CACHE_VERIFY_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MB_LAST_CACHE_VERIFY_AT',
  LAST_READY_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MB_LAST_READY_AT',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MB_LAST_RESULT_JSON',
  LAST_BASELINE_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MB_LAST_BASELINE_JSON'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_STATUS = {
  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  PREVIEWED: 'PREVIEWED',
  BASELINE_COLLECTED: 'BASELINE_COLLECTED',
  CACHE_VERIFIED: 'CACHE_VERIFIED',
  READY_FOR_3M_C: 'READY_FOR_3M_C',
  FAILED: 'FAILED'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG = {
  VERSION: '3M-B',
  PHASE: '3M-B',
  NEXT_BUNDLE: '3M-C',
  WRITE_MODE: 'NO_DB_WRITE',
  REAL_WRITE_ALLOWED: false,

  /**
   * Ngưỡng này không dùng để fail ngay.
   * Nếu vượt ngưỡng sẽ warning, để mình biết điểm cần tối ưu.
   */
  BUDGETS_MS: {
    STATUS_FAST: 1500,
    APP_SHELL_ULTRA_LITE: 5000,
    LESSON_CONTENT_COLD: 12000,
    LESSON_CONTENT_CACHED: 4000,
    INTERACTION_PAYLOAD: 15000,
    PHASE_STATUS: 3000
  },

  /**
   * Nếu 1 measurement vượt HARD_LIMIT_MS thì mới fail.
   */
  HARD_LIMIT_MS: 60000,

  CACHE_SECONDS: 180,

  CACHE_KEYS: {
    PERF_PROBE: 'KIDLEARN_V3_3MB_PERF_PROBE',
    LESSON_DATA_3LB: 'KIDLEARN_V3_3LB_LESSON_DATA_CACHE'
  }
};


/**
 * Preview 3M-B.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewPerformanceBaseline3MBV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var functionChecks =
    kidlearnV3_3mbCheckFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_assertQaAsync3MAReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_',
      'kidlearnV3_getQaAsyncStatus3MAV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getPhase3LCloseStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_buildLessonContentUltraLite3LBV3',
      'kidlearnV3_buildLearningInteractionPayloadUltraLite3LCV3',
      'kidlearnV3_runQaBatchProvidedStepsV3'
    ]);

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      functionChecks.errors
    );

  var phase3MA =
    kidlearnV3_3mbSafeAssert_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertQaAsync3MAReadyV3',
      '3M-A'
    );

  if (!phase3MA.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3M-A chưa READY_FOR_3M_B: ' +
      phase3MA.message
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3mbSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3M-B yêu cầu Safe Write DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3mbControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write đang ENABLED. Không được chạy performance baseline.'
    );
  }

  var cacheProbe =
    kidlearnV3_3mbProbeCacheService_();

  if (!cacheProbe.success) {
    errors.push(
      'CacheService chưa hoạt động đúng: ' +
      cacheProbe.error
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_PERFORMANCE_BASELINE_3MB_V3',
    bundle: '3M-B',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    writeMode: KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.WRITE_MODE,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3MA: phase3MA,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite,
    controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite,
    cacheProbe: cacheProbe,
    functionChecks: functionChecks.items,
    budgetsMs: KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.BUDGETS_MS,
    hardLimitMs: KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.HARD_LIMIT_MS
  };

  kidlearnV3_3mbSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_STATUS.PREVIEWED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Run performance baseline.
 *
 * Chỉ đo các hàm trọng yếu, không scan full DB.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runPerformanceBaseline3MBV3() {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var measurements = [];

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewPerformanceBaseline3MBV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể chạy 3M-B baseline vì preview chưa đạt. Errors=' +
      preview.errorCount +
      '. ' +
      preview.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  /**
   * Clear cache trước để đo cold path.
   */
  kidlearnV3_clearPerformanceCaches3MBV3();

  measurements.push(
    kidlearnV3_3mbMeasure_(
      'SAFE_WRITE_STATUS',
      'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
      null,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.BUDGETS_MS.STATUS_FAST
    )
  );

  measurements.push(
    kidlearnV3_3mbMeasure_(
      'QA_ASYNC_STATUS',
      'kidlearnV3_getQaAsyncStatus3MAV3',
      null,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.BUDGETS_MS.STATUS_FAST
    )
  );

  measurements.push(
    kidlearnV3_3mbMeasureAppShell_()
  );

  measurements.push(
    kidlearnV3_3mbMeasure_(
      'LESSON_CONTENT_COLD',
      'kidlearnV3_buildLessonContentUltraLite3LBV3',
      {},
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.BUDGETS_MS.LESSON_CONTENT_COLD
    )
  );

  measurements.push(
    kidlearnV3_3mbMeasure_(
      'LESSON_CONTENT_CACHED',
      'kidlearnV3_buildLessonContentUltraLite3LBV3',
      {},
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.BUDGETS_MS.LESSON_CONTENT_CACHED
    )
  );

  measurements.push(
    kidlearnV3_3mbMeasure_(
      'INTERACTION_PAYLOAD',
      'kidlearnV3_buildLearningInteractionPayloadUltraLite3LCV3',
      {},
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.BUDGETS_MS.INTERACTION_PAYLOAD
    )
  );

  measurements.push(
    kidlearnV3_3mbMeasure_(
      'PHASE_3L_CLOSE_STATUS',
      'kidlearnV3_getPhase3LCloseStatusV3',
      null,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.BUDGETS_MS.PHASE_STATUS
    )
  );

  for (var i = 0; i < measurements.length; i++) {
    if (!measurements[i].success) {
      errors.push(
        measurements[i].name +
        ': ' +
        measurements[i].error
      );
    }

    if (measurements[i].warning) {
      warnings.push(
        measurements[i].warning
      );
    }

    if (
      measurements[i].durationMs >
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.HARD_LIMIT_MS
    ) {
      errors.push(
        measurements[i].name +
        ' vượt hard limit ' +
        KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.HARD_LIMIT_MS +
        'ms. Actual=' +
        measurements[i].durationMs +
        'ms'
      );
    }
  }

  var cacheVerify =
    kidlearnV3_verifyCacheStrategy3MBV3();

  if (!cacheVerify.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(
        cacheVerify.errors || []
      );
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      cacheVerify.warnings || []
    );

  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'RUN_PERFORMANCE_BASELINE_3MB_V3',
    bundle: '3M-B',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    writeMode: KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.WRITE_MODE,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    measurements: measurements,
    cacheVerify: cacheVerify,
    recommendations:
      kidlearnV3_3mbBuildRecommendations_(
        measurements
      )
  };

  kidlearnV3_3mbSaveBaseline_(
    result
  );

  kidlearnV3_3mbSaveResult_(
    result,
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_STATUS.BASELINE_COLLECTED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_KEYS.LAST_BASELINE_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3M-B performance baseline failed. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Verify cache strategy.
 */
function kidlearnV3_verifyCacheStrategy3MBV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var cache =
    CacheService.getScriptCache();

  var probeKey =
    KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.CACHE_KEYS.PERF_PROBE;

  var probeValue =
    JSON.stringify({
      at: new Date().toISOString(),
      random: Math.random()
    });

  try {
    cache.put(
      probeKey,
      probeValue,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.CACHE_SECONDS
    );

    var got =
      cache.get(probeKey);

    if (got !== probeValue) {
      errors.push(
        'CacheService put/get không khớp.'
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'CacheService lỗi: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var strategy = {
    lessonContent3LB: {
      cacheKey:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.CACHE_KEYS.LESSON_DATA_3LB,
      ttlSeconds: 120,
      policy:
        'Cache lesson master data short-term. Clear cache when changing MST_Lessons/MST_LessonBlocks/MST_Activities/MST_MediaAssets.'
    },
    appShell3LA: {
      cacheKey:
        'NOT_ENABLED_YET',
      ttlSeconds: 0,
      policy:
        'Hiện tại App Shell đọc users/children nhẹ. Chưa cần cache bắt buộc.'
    },
    interaction3LC: {
      cacheKey:
        'REUSE_3LB_CACHE',
      ttlSeconds: 120,
      policy:
        'Interaction payload dùng lại lesson content cache từ 3L-B.'
    },
    qaAsync3MA: {
      cacheKey:
        'NO_CACHE',
      policy:
        'QA Async dùng ScriptProperties state, không dùng cache để tránh mất state.'
    }
  };

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'VERIFY_CACHE_STRATEGY_3MB_V3',
    bundle: '3M-B',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.PHASE,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    cacheStrategy: strategy,
    verifiedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_3mbSaveResult_(
    result,
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_STATUS.CACHE_VERIFIED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_KEYS.LAST_CACHE_VERIFY_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Clear known performance caches.
 */
function kidlearnV3_clearPerformanceCaches3MBV3() {
  var cache =
    CacheService.getScriptCache();

  var keys = [
    KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.CACHE_KEYS.PERF_PROBE,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.CACHE_KEYS.LESSON_DATA_3LB
  ];

  try {
    cache.removeAll(keys);
  } catch (error) {
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      try {
        cache.remove(keys[i]);
      } catch (ignore) {
        // ignore
      }
    }
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'CLEAR_PERFORMANCE_CACHES_3MB_V3',
    bundle: '3M-B',
    clearedKeys: keys,
    clearedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Mark 3M-B ready.
 *
 * Không chạy lại baseline để tránh timeout.
 * Chỉ check last baseline đã success.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markPerformanceBaseline3MBReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getPerformanceBaseline3MBStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  var allowed = {
    BASELINE_COLLECTED: true,
    CACHE_VERIFIED: true,
    READY_FOR_3M_C: true
  };

  if (!allowed[status.status]) {
    errors.push(
      '3M-B chưa có baseline/cache verified hợp lệ. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  var lastBaseline =
    status.lastBaseline || {};

  if (
    !lastBaseline ||
    lastBaseline.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last baseline chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3mbSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Khi mark 3M-B ready, Safe Write phải DRY_RUN/enabled=false.'
    );
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    var failed = {
      success: false,
      action: 'MARK_PERFORMANCE_BASELINE_3MB_READY_V3',
      bundle: '3M-B',
      status: status.status,
      errorCount: errors.length,
      errors: errors
    };

    console.log(
      JSON.stringify(failed, null, 2)
    );

    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark 3M-B ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_PERFORMANCE_BASELINE_3MB_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3M-B',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_STATUS.READY_FOR_3M_C,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    message:
      '3M-B ready. Có thể chuyển sang 3M-C Security review / role guard.',
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite,
    markedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_3mbSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_STATUS.READY_FOR_3M_C,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}

 * Get 3M-B status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getPerformanceBaseline3MBStatusV3() {
  var properties =

  var result = {

      ) ||

      ) ||

      properties.getProperty(

/**
 * Assert 3M-B ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertPerformanceBaseline3MBReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getPerformanceBaseline3MBStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_STATUS.READY_FOR_3M_C
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3M-B chưa READY_FOR_3M_C. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_PERFORMANCE_BASELINE_3MB_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3M-B',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status: status.status,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3M-B chưa ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );

  return result;

/**
 * Measure generic function.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mbMeasure_(
  name,
  functionName,
  arg,
  budgetMs
) {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var result = {
    success: false,
    name: name,
    functionName: functionName,
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt: '',
    durationMs: 0,
    budgetMs: budgetMs || 0,
    warning: '',
    error: '',
    outputSummary: null
  };

  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      throw new Error(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        functionName
      );
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output;

    if (arg === null || typeof arg === 'undefined') {
      output = fn();
    } else {
      output = fn(arg);
    }

    result.outputSummary =
      kidlearnV3_3mbSummarizeOutput_(
        output
      );

    if (
      output &&
      output.success === false
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        kidlearnV3_3mbGetOutputErrorMessage_(
          output
        )
      );
    }

    result.success = true;

  } catch (error) {
    result.success = false;
    result.error =
      String(error.message || error);
  }

  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  result.finishedAt =
    finishedAt.toISOString();

  result.durationMs =
    finishedAt.getTime() -
    startedAt.getTime();

  if (
    result.success &&
    budgetMs &&
    result.durationMs > budgetMs
  ) {
    result.warning =
      name +
      ' vượt budget ' +
      budgetMs +
      'ms. Actual=' +
      result.durationMs +
      'ms';
  }

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Measure App Shell.
 *

function kidlearnV3_3mbMeasureAppShell_() {
  if (

/**
 * Cache probe.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mbProbeCacheService_() {
  try {
    var cache =
      CacheService.getScriptCache();

    var key =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.CACHE_KEYS.PERF_PROBE;

    var value =
      'CACHE_OK_' + new Date().getTime();

    cache.put(
      key,
      value,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_CONFIG.CACHE_SECONDS
    );

    var got =
      cache.get(key);

    return {
      success: got === value,
      key: key,
      expected: value,
      actual: got || ''
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Build recommendations.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mbBuildRecommendations_(
  measurements
) {
  var recs = [];

  var byName = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < measurements.length; i++) {
    byName[measurements[i].name] =
      measurements[i];

    if (measurements[i].warning) {
      recs.push(
        'Tối ưu ' +
        measurements[i].name +
        ': ' +
        measurements[i].warning
      );
    }
  }

  if (
    byName.LESSON_CONTENT_COLD &&
    byName.LESSON_CONTENT_CACHED &&
    byName.LESSON_CONTENT_CACHED.durationMs <
      byName.LESSON_CONTENT_COLD.durationMs
  ) {
    recs.push(
      'Cache 3L-B đang có hiệu quả: cached nhanh hơn cold.'
    );
  }

  if (
    byName.LESSON_CONTENT_CACHED &&
    byName.LESSON_CONTENT_CACHED.durationMs >=
      byName.LESSON_CONTENT_COLD.durationMs
  ) {
    recs.push(
      'Cache 3L-B chưa thể hiện lợi ích rõ. Sau này cần cache theo lessonId/subjectId.'
    );
  }

  recs.push(
    'Daily QA chỉ dùng assert/status/ultra-lite. Không dùng full checksum.'
  );

  recs.push(
    'Các màn hình lớn nên cache master data 120–180 giây, không cache state ghi dữ liệu.'
  );

  return recs;
}


/**
 * Summarize output.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mbSummarizeOutput_(
  output
) {
  if (!output || typeof output !== 'object') {
    return {
      rawType: typeof output
    };
  }

  return {
    success: output.success,
    action: output.action || '',
    bundle: output.bundle || '',
    phase: output.phase || '',
    status: output.status || '',
    errorCount: output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount: output.warningCount || 0,
    diagnostics: output.diagnostics || null,
    progressPercent: output.progressPercent || null
  };
}


/**
 * Output error message.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mbGetOutputErrorMessage_(
  output
) {
  if (!output) {
    return 'Không có output.';
  }

  if (
    output.errors &&
    output.errors.length
  ) {
    return output.errors.join(' | ');
  }

  if (
    output.error &&
    output.error.message
  ) {
    return output.error.message;
  }

  if (output.error) {
    return String(output.error);
  }

  return 'Function trả success=false nhưng không có message.';
}


/**
 * Safe assert helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mbSafeAssert_(
  functionName,
  label
) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var result =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        result && result.success === true,
      label: label,
      message:
        result && result.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(result)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mbSafeWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_3mbControlledWriteStatus_() {

    ) {

        kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

      result.available = true;

    }

    return {
      available: false,
