      status: '',
      safeWriteMode: '',
      safeWriteEnabled: false,
      error:
        'Missing kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      safeWriteMode: '',
      safeWriteEnabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mbCheckFunctions_(
  names
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          names[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: names[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        names[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Save baseline compact.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mbSaveBaseline_(
  baseline
) {
  var compact = {
    success: baseline.success,
    action: baseline.action,
    bundle: baseline.bundle,
    phase: baseline.phase,
    startedAt: baseline.startedAt,
    finishedAt: baseline.finishedAt,
    durationMs: baseline.durationMs,
    errorCount: baseline.errorCount,
    warningCount: baseline.warningCount,
    errors: baseline.errors,
    warnings: baseline.warnings,
    measurements:
      baseline.measurements.map(function(item) {
        return {
          name: item.name,
          functionName: item.functionName,
          success: item.success,
          durationMs: item.durationMs,
          budgetMs: item.budgetMs,
          warning: item.warning,
          error: item.error,
          outputSummary: item.outputSummary
        };
      }),
    recommendations: baseline.recommendations || []
  };

  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_KEYS.LAST_BASELINE_JSON,
      JSON.stringify(compact)
    );
}


/**
 * Save result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mbSaveResult_(
  result,
  status,
  dateKey
) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var currentStatus =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_KEYS.STATUS
    ) || '';

  var finalStatus =
    status;

  if (
    currentStatus === KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_STATUS.READY_FOR_3M_C &&
    (
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_STATUS.PREVIEWED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_STATUS.BASELINE_COLLECTED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_STATUS.CACHE_VERIFIED
    )
  ) {
    finalStatus =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_STATUS.READY_FOR_3M_C;
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_KEYS.STATUS,
    finalStatus
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PERF_3MB_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      bundle: result.bundle,
      phase: result.phase,
      status: finalStatus,
      originalRequestedStatus: status,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


/**
 * Read JSON property.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mbReadJsonProperty_(
  key
) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**

 * Purpose:

 * - Không ghi DB
 * - Chỉ đọc/ghi ScriptProperties khi chạy close compat

/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_getPhase3JCloseStatusV3() {

    phase: '3J.14',

      ) ||

      ) ||
      '',
    nextPhase:
      properties.getProperty(
        'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J_NEXT_PHASE'
      ) ||
      '',

      kidlearnV3_3jCompatParseJson_(

        )
      ),

      ) ||
      '',
    last3JBRunAt:
      properties.getProperty(

      ) ||

      ) ||

      ) ||

        )
      ),
    safeWriteStatus:
      kidlearnV3_3jCompatSafeWriteStatus_(),

  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert Phase 3J closed.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertPhase3JClosedV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getPhase3JCloseStatusV3();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  if (status.status !== 'CLOSED_LOCKED') {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 3J chưa CLOSED_LOCKED. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (status.nextPhase !== '3K') {
    errors.push(
      'Next phase phải là 3K. Hiện tại=' +
      status.nextPhase
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    status.safeWriteStatus || {};

  if (safeWrite.available === true) {
    if (
      safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
      safeWrite.enabled !== false
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'Safe Write chưa ở DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
        safeWrite.mode +
        ', enabled=' +
        safeWrite.enabled
      );
    }
  } else {
    warnings.push(
      'Không kiểm tra được Safe Write status vì thiếu hàm kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3.'
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    status.controlledWriteStatus || {};

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write vẫn đang ENABLED.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_PHASE_3J_CLOSED_V3',
    phase: '3J.14',
    status: status.status,
    nextPhase: status.nextPhase,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite,
    controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite,
    phase3JBStatus: status.phase3JBStatus,
    last3JBTransactionId: status.last3JBTransactionId
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Phase 3J chưa close đúng. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Close Phase 3J bằng compat.
 *
 * Chỉ dùng khi:
 * - 3J-B đã REVIEW_PASSED hoặc CLOSED
 * - Safe Write đã DRY_RUN/enabled=false
 * - Controlled Write không ENABLED
 */
function kidlearnV3_closePhase3JCompatV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getPhase3JCloseStatusV3();

  if (
    status.status === 'CLOSED_LOCKED' &&
    status.nextPhase === '3K'
  ) {
    return {
      success: true,
      action: 'CLOSE_PHASE_3J_COMPAT_V3',
      phase: '3J.14',
      status: 'CLOSED_LOCKED',
      nextPhase: '3K',
      message:
        'Phase 3J đã CLOSED_LOCKED từ trước.'
    };
  }

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.phase3JBStatus !== 'REVIEW_PASSED' &&
    status.phase3JBStatus !== 'CLOSED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Không thể close compat vì 3J-B chưa REVIEW_PASSED/CLOSED. phase3JBStatus=' +
      status.phase3JBStatus
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    status.safeWriteStatus || {};

  if (safeWrite.available === true) {
    if (
      safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
      safeWrite.enabled !== false
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'Safe Write phải ở DRY_RUN/enabled=false trước khi close 3J.'
      );
    }
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    status.controlledWriteStatus || {};

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write vẫn ENABLED, không được close 3J.'
    );
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể close Phase 3J bằng compat. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var now =
    new Date();

  var closeResult = {
    success: true,
    action: 'CLOSE_PHASE_3J_COMPAT_V3',
    phase: '3J.14',
    status: 'CLOSED_LOCKED',
    closedAt:
      now.toISOString(),
    nextPhase: '3K',
    source:
      'Phase_3J_Compat_Status_V3',
    summary: {
      phase3JBStatus:
        status.phase3JBStatus,
      last3JBTransactionId:
        status.last3JBTransactionId,
      safeWriteMode:
        safeWrite.mode || '',
      safeWriteEnabled:
        safeWrite.enabled,
      controlledWriteStatus:
        controlledWrite.status || '',
      prodTouched: false
    }
  };

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J_CLOSE_STATUS',
    'CLOSED_LOCKED'
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J_CLOSED_AT',
    now.toISOString()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J_NEXT_PHASE',
    '3K'
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J_CLOSE_RESULT_JSON',
    JSON.stringify(closeResult)
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3JB_STATUS',
    'CLOSED'
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(closeResult, null, 2)
  );

  return closeResult;
}

/**
 * Preview trước khi đóng Phase 3I.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewClosePhase3IV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions = [
    'kidlearnV3_enableUiDevSwitchV3',
    'kidlearnV3_uiSwitchGetModeV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getAppDevConnectionV3Status',
    'kidlearnV3_previewEndToEndUiDevV3',
    'kidlearnV3_runEndToEndUiDevV3',
    'kidlearnV3_markPhase3IReadyForCloseV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getPhase3IStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_previewLegacyCallReplacementV3',
    'kidlearnV3_smokeTestLegacyCallReplacementV3'
  ];

  var functionChecks =
    kidlearnV3_phase3ICheckFunctions_(
      requiredFunctions
    );

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      functionChecks.errors
    );

  var mode =
    kidlearnV3_phase3ISafeSwitchMode_();

  if (mode !== 'V3') {
    errors.push(
      'DEV_SWITCH chưa bật V3. Mode hiện tại: ' + mode
    );
  }

  var connection =
    kidlearnV3_phase3ISafeConnectionStatus_();

  if (
    connection.databaseMode !== 'V3' ||
    connection.connectionStatus !== 'CONNECTED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'App DEV chưa CONNECTED với Database V3.'
    );
  }

  var phaseStatus =
    kidlearnV3_phase3ISafeE2EStatus_();

  if (
    phaseStatus.status !== 'READY_TO_CLOSE' &&
    phaseStatus.status !== 'PASSED' &&
    phaseStatus.status !== 'CLOSED_LOCKED'
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'Phase 3I chưa có trạng thái READY_TO_CLOSE/PASSED. Hàm close sẽ tự chạy E2E lại trước khi khóa.'
    );
  }

  var currentLock =
    kidlearnV3_getPhase3ICloseStatusV3();

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_CLOSE_PHASE_3I_V3',
    phase: '3I.10',
    nextPhase: '3J',
    mode: mode,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    connection: connection,
    phaseStatus: phaseStatus,
    currentLock: currentLock,
    functionChecks: functionChecks.items
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Đóng Phase 3I và khóa cấu hình UI DEV.
 *
 * Hàm này sẽ:
 * 1. Kiểm tra DEV_SWITCH V3.
 * 2. Chạy lại E2E 3I.
 * 3. Đánh dấu READY_TO_CLOSE.
 * 4. Ghi lock manifest.
 * 5. Set trạng thái CLOSED_LOCKED.
 */
function kidlearnV3_closePhase3IAndLockUiDevV3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewClosePhase3IV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể đóng Phase 3I. Preview chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      preview.errorCount
    );
  }

  var readyResult =
    kidlearnV3_markPhase3IReadyForCloseV3();

  if (!readyResult.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể đóng Phase 3I vì mark READY_TO_CLOSE thất bại.'
    );
  }

  var now =
    new Date();

  var lockSummary =
    kidlearnV3_phase3IBuildLockSummary_(
      now,
      readyResult
    );

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.CLOSE_STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_CLOSE_STATUS.CLOSED_LOCKED
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.LOCK_STATUS,
    'LOCKED'
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.UI_DEV_LOCKED,
    'TRUE'
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.CLOSED_AT,
    now.toISOString()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.LOCKED_AT,
    now.toISOString()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.CLOSED_BY,
    kidlearnV3_phase3IGetUserEmail_()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.NEXT_PHASE,
    '3J'
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.LOCK_REASON,
    'PHASE_3I_COMPLETED_AND_READY_FOR_3J'
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.LOCK_SUMMARY_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(lockSummary)
  );

  kidlearnV3_phase3ISetE2EPhaseStatus_(
    'CLOSED_LOCKED'
  );

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'CLOSE_PHASE_3I_AND_LOCK_UI_DEV_V3',
    phase: '3I',
    status: 'CLOSED_LOCKED',
    lockStatus: 'LOCKED',
    uiDevLocked: true,
    nextPhase: '3J',
    closedAt: now.toISOString(),
    summary: lockSummary,
    message: 'Phase 3I đã đóng và UI DEV config đã khóa để chuyển sang Phase 3J.'
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Xem trạng thái khóa Phase 3I.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getPhase3ICloseStatusV3() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var summaryText =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.LOCK_SUMMARY_JSON
    );

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'GET_PHASE_3I_CLOSE_STATUS_V3',
    phase: '3I',
    closeStatus:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.CLOSE_STATUS
      ) ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_CLOSE_STATUS.OPEN,
    lockStatus:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.LOCK_STATUS
      ) ||
      'UNLOCKED',
    uiDevLocked:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.UI_DEV_LOCKED
      ) === 'TRUE',
    closedAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.CLOSED_AT
      ) ||
      '',
    lockedAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.LOCKED_AT
      ) ||
      '',
    closedBy:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.CLOSED_BY
      ) ||
      '',
    nextPhase:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.NEXT_PHASE
      ) ||
      '',
    lockReason:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.LOCK_REASON
      ) ||
      '',
    summary:
      kidlearnV3_phase3IParseJsonSafe_(
        summaryText
      )
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert cho Phase 3J.
 *
 * Phase 3J chỉ nên bắt đầu khi hàm này success.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getPhase3ICloseStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (status.closeStatus !== 'CLOSED_LOCKED') {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 3I chưa CLOSED_LOCKED. Hiện tại: ' +
      status.closeStatus
    );
  }

  if (status.lockStatus !== 'LOCKED') {
    errors.push(
      'UI DEV config chưa LOCKED. Hiện tại: ' +
      status.lockStatus
    );
  }

  if (status.uiDevLocked !== true) {
    errors.push(
      'KIDLEARN_V3_UI_DEV_LOCKED chưa bằng TRUE.'
    );
  }

  if (status.nextPhase !== '3J') {
    errors.push(
      'Next phase chưa phải 3J. Hiện tại: ' +
      status.nextPhase
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_PHASE_3I_CLOSED_FOR_3J_V3',
    phase: '3I',
    nextPhase: '3J',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    closeStatus: status.closeStatus,
    lockStatus: status.lockStatus,
    uiDevLocked: status.uiDevLocked
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Phase 3I chưa đủ điều kiện chuyển sang 3J. Errors: ' +
      errors.length
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Mở khóa bảo trì tạm thời.
 *
 * Chỉ dùng khi cần sửa lỗi DEV.
 */
function kidlearnV3_unlockPhase3IForMaintenanceV3(request) {
  var safeRequest =
    kidlearnV3_phase3INormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  var reason =
    String(safeRequest.reason || '').trim();

  if (!reason) {
    throw new Error(
      'Cần nhập reason khi mở khóa maintenance.'
    );
  }

  var now =
    new Date();

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.CLOSE_STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_CLOSE_STATUS.UNLOCKED_FOR_MAINTENANCE
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.LOCK_STATUS,
    'UNLOCKED'
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.UI_DEV_LOCKED,
    'FALSE'
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.UNLOCKED_AT,
    now.toISOString()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LOCK_KEYS.UNLOCK_REASON,
    reason
  );

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'UNLOCK_PHASE_3I_FOR_MAINTENANCE_V3',
    phase: '3I',
    status: 'UNLOCKED_FOR_MAINTENANCE',
    unlockedAt: now.toISOString(),
    reason: reason
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Re-lock sau maintenance.
 */
function kidlearnV3_relockPhase3IAfterMaintenanceV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_closePhase3IAndLockUiDevV3();
}


/**
 * Build lock summary gọn.
 */
function kidlearnV3_phase3IBuildLockSummary_(
  dateValue,
  readyResult
) {
  var connection =
    kidlearnV3_phase3ISafeConnectionStatus_();

  var phaseStatus =
    kidlearnV3_phase3ISafeE2EStatus_();

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  return {
    phase: '3I',
    closeStatus: 'CLOSED_LOCKED',
    lockStatus: 'LOCKED',
    uiDevLocked: true,
    nextPhase: '3J',
    lockedAt: dateValue.toISOString(),
    lockedBy: kidlearnV3_phase3IGetUserEmail_(),
    schemaVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
    appVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.APP_VERSION,
    devSwitchMode:
      kidlearnV3_phase3ISafeSwitchMode_(),
    appConnection: {
      databaseMode:
        connection.databaseMode || '',
      connectionStatus:
        connection.connectionStatus || '',
      spreadsheetId:
        connection.spreadsheetId || '',
      spreadsheetName:
        connection.spreadsheetName || ''
    },
    phaseStatus: {
      status:
        phaseStatus.status || '',
      lastErrorCount:
        phaseStatus.lastErrorCount || 0,
      lastWarningCount:
        phaseStatus.lastWarningCount || 0
    },
    scriptPropertiesSnapshot: {
      databaseMode:
        properties.getProperty(
          'KIDLEARN_APP_DATABASE_MODE'
        ) ||
        '',
      connectionStatus:
        properties.getProperty(
          'KIDLEARN_APP_CONNECTION_STATUS'
        ) ||
        '',
      appSchemaVersion:
        properties.getProperty(
          'KIDLEARN_APP_SCHEMA_VERSION'
        ) ||
        '',
      uiDevSwitchMode:
        properties.getProperty(
          'KIDLEARN_UI_DEV_SWITCH_MODE'
        ) ||
        ''
    },
    readyResult: {
      action:
        readyResult.action || '',
      status:
        readyResult.status || '',
      errorCount:
        readyResult.e2eSummary
          ? readyResult.e2eSummary.errorCount
          : 0,
      warningCount:
        readyResult.e2eSummary
          ? readyResult.e2eSummary.warningCount
          : 0
    }
  };
}


/**
 * Check function list.
 */
function kidlearnV3_phase3ICheckFunctions_(
  functionNames
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < functionNames.length; i++) {
    var item =
      kidlearnV3_phase3ICheckFunction_(
        functionNames[i]
      );

    items.push(item);

    if (!item.exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        item.name
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Check một function.
 */
function kidlearnV3_phase3ICheckFunction_(
  functionName
) {
  var exists = false;

  try {
    exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );
  } catch (error) {
    exists = false;
  }

  return {
    name: functionName,
    exists: exists
  };
}


/**
 * Safe switch mode.
 */
function kidlearnV3_phase3ISafeSwitchMode_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_uiSwitchGetModeV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return 'UNKNOWN';
  }
}


/**
 * Safe connection status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_phase3ISafeConnectionStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getAppDevConnectionV3Status();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      databaseMode: '',
      connectionStatus: '',
      spreadsheetId: '',
      spreadsheetName: '',
      error: String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe E2E status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_phase3ISafeE2EStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getPhase3IStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      status: '',
      lastErrorCount: 0,
      lastWarningCount: 0,
      error: String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Set E2E phase status nếu key tồn tại.
 */
function kidlearnV3_phase3ISetE2EPhaseStatus_(
  status
) {
  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS.PHASE_STATUS
    ) {
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .setProperty(
          KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS.PHASE_STATUS,
          status
        );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn(
      'Không cập nhật được E2E phase status: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Parse JSON an toàn.
 */
function kidlearnV3_phase3IParseJsonSafe_(
  text
) {
  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Normalize request.
 */
function kidlearnV3_phase3INormalizeRequest_(
  request
) {
  if (!request) {
    return {};
  }

  if (
    typeof request !== 'object'
  ) {
    return {
      value: request
    };
  }

  return request;
}


/**
 * Lấy email user nếu Apps Script cho phép.
 */
function kidlearnV3_phase3IGetUserEmail_() {
  try {
    return Session.getActiveUser().getEmail() || '';
  } catch (error) {
    return '';
  }
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - PHASE 3L POST REVIEW & CLOSE
 * Bundle: 3L-D
 * Step:
 * - 3L-D: Post-review and close Phase 3L
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * 3L-D:
 * - Không ghi dữ liệu học tập thật
 * - Không real write
 * - Không rollback
 * - Không migration
 * - QA batch không tự close phase
 * - Close Phase 3L phải chạy riêng
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_STATUS',
  LAST_PREVIEW_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_LAST_PREVIEW_AT',
  LAST_REVIEW_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_LAST_REVIEW_AT',
  LAST_READY_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_LAST_READY_AT',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_LAST_RESULT_JSON',

  PHASE_3L_CLOSE_STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3L_CLOSE_STATUS',
  PHASE_3L_CLOSED_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3L_CLOSED_AT',
  PHASE_3L_NEXT_PHASE: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3L_NEXT_PHASE',
  PHASE_3L_CLOSE_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3L_CLOSE_RESULT_JSON'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_STATUS = {
  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  PREVIEWED: 'PREVIEWED',
  REVIEW_PASSED: 'REVIEW_PASSED',
  READY_TO_CLOSE_3L: 'READY_TO_CLOSE_3L',
  CLOSED: 'CLOSED',
  FAILED: 'FAILED'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_CONFIG = {
  VERSION: '3L-D',
  PHASE: '3L-D',
  PHASE_GROUP: '3L',
  NEXT_PHASE: '3M',
  CLOSE_STATUS: 'CLOSED_LOCKED',
  WRITE_MODE: 'DRY_RUN_ONLY'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_TARGET_SHEETS = [
  'LOG_Audit',
  'DATA_StudySessions',
  'DATA_LessonProgress',
  'DATA_DailyGoals',
  'DATA_Assignments'
];


/**
 * Preview 3L-D.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewPhase3LClose3LDV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var functionChecks =
    kidlearnV3_3ldCheckFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_assertAppShell3LAReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_assertLessonContent3LBReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_assertLearningInteraction3LCReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_',
      'kidlearnV3_runQaBatchProvidedStepsV3'
    ]);

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      functionChecks.errors
    );

  var phase3LA =
    kidlearnV3_3ldSafeAssert_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertAppShell3LAReadyV3',
      '3L-A'
    );

  var phase3LB =
    kidlearnV3_3ldSafeAssert_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertLessonContent3LBReadyV3',
      '3L-B'
    );

  var phase3LC =
    kidlearnV3_3ldSafeAssert_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertLearningInteraction3LCReadyV3',
      '3L-C'
    );

  if (!phase3LA.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3L-A chưa READY_FOR_3L_B: ' +
      phase3LA.message
    );
  }

  if (!phase3LB.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3L-B chưa READY_FOR_3L_C: ' +
      phase3LB.message
    );
  }

  if (!phase3LC.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3L-C chưa READY_FOR_3L_D: ' +
      phase3LC.message
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3ldSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3L-D yêu cầu Safe Write DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3ldControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write vẫn ENABLED. Không được close Phase 3L.'
    );
  }

  var sheetSummary = null;

  try {
    sheetSummary =
      kidlearnV3_3ldGetTargetSheetRowSummary_();
  } catch (error) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không lấy được target sheet summary: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_PHASE_3L_CLOSE_3LD_V3',
    bundle: '3L-D',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_CONFIG.PHASE,
    phaseGroup: KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_CONFIG.PHASE_GROUP,
    nextPhase: KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    writeMode: 'DRY_RUN_ONLY',
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    closeIncludedInBatch: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3LA: phase3LA,
    phase3LB: phase3LB,
    phase3LC: phase3LC,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite,
    controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite,
    functionChecks: functionChecks.items,
    targetSheetSummary: sheetSummary
  };

  kidlearnV3_3ldSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_STATUS.PREVIEWED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Post-review Phase 3L.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runPostReviewPhase3L3LDV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewPhase3LClose3LDV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể post-review 3L-D vì preview chưa đạt. Errors=' +
      preview.errorCount +
      '. ' +
      preview.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var status3LA =
    kidlearnV3_3ldReadStatusProperty_(
      'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LA_STATUS'
    );

  var status3LB =
    kidlearnV3_3ldReadStatusProperty_(
      'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LB_STATUS'
    );

  var status3LC =
    kidlearnV3_3ldReadStatusProperty_(
      'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LC_STATUS'
    );

  if (status3LA !== 'READY_FOR_3L_B') {
    errors.push(
      'Property 3L-A status phải READY_FOR_3L_B. Hiện tại=' +
      status3LA
    );
  }

  if (status3LB !== 'READY_FOR_3L_C') {
    errors.push(
      'Property 3L-B status phải READY_FOR_3L_C. Hiện tại=' +
      status3LB
    );
  }

  if (status3LC !== 'READY_FOR_3L_D') {
    errors.push(
      'Property 3L-C status phải READY_FOR_3L_D. Hiện tại=' +
      status3LC
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3ldSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Post-review Phase 3L yêu cầu Safe Write DRY_RUN/enabled=false.'
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3ldControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write vẫn ENABLED trong post-review Phase 3L.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'RUN_POST_REVIEW_PHASE_3L_3LD_V3',
    bundle: '3L-D',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_CONFIG.PHASE,
    decision:
      errors.length === 0
        ? 'READY_TO_CLOSE_PHASE_3L'
        : 'HOLD_PHASE_3L',
    canClosePhase3L:
      errors.length === 0,
    writeMode: 'DRY_RUN_ONLY',
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phaseStatuses: {
      phase3LA: status3LA,
      phase3LB: status3LB,
      phase3LC: status3LC
    },
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite,
    controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite,
    reviewedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_3ldSaveResult_(
    result,
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_STATUS.REVIEW_PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_KEYS.LAST_REVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Post-review Phase 3L failed. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Mark 3L-D ready to close Phase 3L.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markPhase3LReadyToClose3LDV3() {
  var review =
    kidlearnV3_runPostReviewPhase3L3LDV3();

  if (!review.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark READY_TO_CLOSE_3L vì post-review chưa pass.'
    );
  }

  var result = {

    message:

  };

  kidlearnV3_3ldSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_STATUS.READY_TO_CLOSE_3L,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

}


/**
 * Assert 3L-D ready to close.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertPhase3LReadyToClose3LDV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getPhase3LDStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_STATUS.READY_TO_CLOSE_3L &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_STATUS.CLOSED
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3L-D chưa READY_TO_CLOSE_3L/CLOSED. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_PHASE_3L_READY_TO_CLOSE_3LD_V3',
    bundle: '3L-D',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status: status.status,
    nextManualStep:
      'kidlearnV3_closePhase3LV3',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3L-D chưa ready to close. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Close Phase 3L.
 *
 * Chạy riêng, không đưa vào QA batch.
 */
function kidlearnV3_closePhase3LV3() {
  var ready =
    kidlearnV3_assertPhase3LReadyToClose3LDV3();

  if (!ready.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể close Phase 3L vì 3L-D chưa ready.'
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3ldSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể close Phase 3L khi Safe Write chưa DRY_RUN/enabled=false.'
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3ldControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể close Phase 3L khi Controlled Write còn ENABLED.'
    );
  }

  var now =
    new Date();

  var closeResult = {
    success: true,
    action: 'CLOSE_PHASE_3L_V3',
    phase: '3L',
    closedByBundle: '3L-D',
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_CONFIG.CLOSE_STATUS,
    closedAt:
      now.toISOString(),
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    summary: {
      phase3LA: 'READY_FOR_3L_B',
      phase3LB: 'READY_FOR_3L_C',
      phase3LC: 'READY_FOR_3L_D',
      phase3LD: 'READY_TO_CLOSE_3L',
      safeWriteMode:
        safeWrite.mode,
      safeWriteEnabled:
        safeWrite.enabled,
      controlledWriteStatus:
        controlledWrite.status || '',
      realWriteAllowed:
        false,
      prodTouched:
        false
    }
  };

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_KEYS.PHASE_3L_CLOSE_STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_CONFIG.CLOSE_STATUS
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_KEYS.PHASE_3L_CLOSED_AT,
    now.toISOString()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_KEYS.PHASE_3L_NEXT_PHASE,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_KEYS.PHASE_3L_CLOSE_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(closeResult)
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_KEYS.STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_STATUS.CLOSED
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(closeResult)
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(closeResult, null, 2)
  );

  return closeResult;
}

function kidlearnV3_assertPhase3LClosedV3() {

  var result = {

    action: 'ASSERT_PHASE_3L_CLOSED_V3',

    nextPhase: status.nextPhase,

  };

  );

  if (!result.success) {

/**
 * Target sheet row summary.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ldGetTargetSheetRowSummary_() {
  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3ldGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  var items = [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_TARGET_SHEETS.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sheetName =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_TARGET_SHEETS[i];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_3ldGetSheet_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetName
      );

    items.push({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      exists: sheet ? true : false,
      lastRow:
        sheet ? sheet.getLastRow() : 0,
      lastColumn:
        sheet ? sheet.getLastColumn() : 0
    });
  }

  return {
    success: true,
    capturedAt:
      new Date().toISOString(),
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Database spreadsheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ldGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_() {
  var database =
    kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_();

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3ldResolveSpreadsheet_(
      database
    );

  if (!spreadsheet) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không resolve được Spreadsheet object từ Database V3.'
    );
  }

  return spreadsheet;
}


/**
 * Resolve Spreadsheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ldResolveSpreadsheet_(value) {
  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (
    typeof value.getSheets === 'function' &&
    typeof value.getId === 'function'
  ) {
    return value;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheet &&
    typeof value.spreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheet;
  }

  if (
    value.database &&
    typeof value.database.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.database;
  }

  if (
    value.db &&
    typeof value.db.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.db;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheetObject &&
    typeof value.spreadsheetObject.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheetObject;
  }

  if (
    value.activeSpreadsheet &&
    typeof value.activeSpreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.activeSpreadsheet;
  }

  if (value.spreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.spreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (value.databaseSpreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.databaseSpreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (
    value.id &&
    typeof value.id === 'string'
  ) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.id
    );
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Get exact sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ldGetSheet_(
  spreadsheet,
  sheetName
) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Safe assert helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ldSafeAssert_(
  functionName,
  label
) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var result =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        result && result.success === true,
      label: label,
      message:
        result && result.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(result)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ldSafeWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Controlled Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ldControlledWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      var result =
        kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

      result.available = true;

      return result;
    }

    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      safeWriteMode: '',
      safeWriteEnabled: false,
      error:
        'Missing kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      safeWriteMode: '',
      safeWriteEnabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ldCheckFunctions_(names) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          names[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: names[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        names[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Save result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ldSaveResult_(
  result,
  status,
  dateKey
) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var currentStatus =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_KEYS.STATUS
    ) || '';

  var finalStatus =
    status;

  if (
    currentStatus === KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_STATUS.READY_TO_CLOSE_3L &&
    (
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_STATUS.PREVIEWED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_STATUS.REVIEW_PASSED
    )
  ) {
    finalStatus =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_STATUS.READY_TO_CLOSE_3L;
  }

  if (
    currentStatus === KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_STATUS.CLOSED
  ) {
    finalStatus =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_STATUS.CLOSED;
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_KEYS.STATUS,
    finalStatus
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3LD_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      bundle: result.bundle,
      phase: result.phase,
      status: finalStatus,
      originalRequestedStatus: status,
      decision: result.decision || '',
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


/**
 * Read status property.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ldReadStatusProperty_(key) {
  return (
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key) ||
    ''
  );
}


/**
 * Read JSON property.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ldReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**

var KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3NB_STATUS',
  LAST_PREVIEW_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3NB_LAST_PREVIEW_AT',

};

  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  PREVIEWED: 'PREVIEWED',
  PLAN_GENERATED: 'PLAN_GENERATED',

};


var KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_CONFIG = {
  VERSION: '3N-B',
  PHASE: '3N-B',
  NEXT_BUNDLE: '3N-C',
  NEXT_STAGE: 'PROD_DRY_RUN_DEPLOYMENT_REHEARSAL',
  EXPECTED_SHEET_COUNT: 44,
  WRITE_MODE: 'DRIVE_BACKUP_ONLY',
  REAL_WRITE_ALLOWED: false,
  PROD_DEPLOY_NOW: false
};


/**
 * Preview 3N-B.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewDevBackupDeploymentPlan3NBV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions =
    kidlearnV3_3nbCheckFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_assertProdCandidateReview3NAReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdCandidateReview3NAStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_',
      'kidlearnV3_runQaBatchProvidedStepsV3'
    ]);

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      requiredFunctions.errors
    );

  var phase3NA =
    kidlearnV3_3nbSafeAssert_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertProdCandidateReview3NAReadyV3',
      '3N-A'
    );

  if (!phase3NA.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3N-A chưa READY_FOR_3N_B: ' +
      phase3NA.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3nbCheckSafeModes_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      safeModes.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      safeModes.warnings
    );

  var candidateStatus =
    kidlearnV3_3nbSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdCandidateReview3NAStatusV3'
    );

  var dbSummary = null;

  try {
    dbSummary =
      kidlearnV3_3nbBuildDatabaseSummary_();

    if (dbSummary.missingSheetCount > 0) {
      errors.push(
        'DEV candidate thiếu V3 sheet. Missing=' +
        dbSummary.missingSheetCount
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không build được database summary 3N-B: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_DEV_BACKUP_DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_3NB_V3',
    bundle: '3N-B',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    writeMode: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_CONFIG.WRITE_MODE,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    driveBackupWillBeCreatedOnlyByManualFunction: true,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3NA: phase3NA,
    candidateStatus: candidateStatus,
    safeModes: safeModes,
    databaseSummary: dbSummary,
    requiredFunctions: requiredFunctions.items
  };

  kidlearnV3_3nbSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_STATUS.PREVIEWED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Generate PROD deployment plan.
 *
 * Không deploy PROD.
 */
function kidlearnV3_generateProdDeploymentPlan3NBV3() {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewDevBackupDeploymentPlan3NBV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể generate PROD deployment plan 3N-B vì preview chưa đạt. Errors=' +
      preview.errorCount +
      '. ' +
      preview.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var candidateStatus =
    kidlearnV3_getProdCandidateReview3NAStatusV3();

  var candidateId =
    candidateStatus.candidateId || '';

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3nbGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  var dbSummary =
    kidlearnV3_3nbBuildDatabaseSummary_();

  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  var plan = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'GENERATE_PROD_DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_3NB_V3',
    bundle: '3N-B',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_CONFIG.PHASE,
    candidateId: candidateId,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    sourceDevCandidate: {
      spreadsheetId: spreadsheet.getId(),
      spreadsheetName: spreadsheet.getName(),
      spreadsheetUrl: spreadsheet.getUrl()
    },
    databaseSummary: dbSummary,
    deploymentPlan: {
      stage1: 'Create DEV candidate backup.',
      stage2: 'Review backup file and manifest.',
      stage3: 'Prepare PROD target separately.',
      stage4: 'Run PROD dry-run deployment rehearsal in 3N-C.',
      stage5: 'Only after manual approval, create actual PROD deployment phase.',
      prodSheetTouchedNow: false,
      backupRequiredBeforeProd: true,
      manualApprovalRequired: true
    },
    blockedActionsIn3NB: [
      'No PROD copy',
      'No PROD deploy',
      'No migration',
      'No rollback',
      'No real write',
      'No create/delete sheet'
    ],
    startedAt: startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt: finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_3nbSavePlan_(
    plan
  );

  kidlearnV3_3nbSaveResult_(
    plan,
    plan.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_STATUS.PLAN_GENERATED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_KEYS.LAST_PLAN_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(plan, null, 2)
  );

  if (!plan.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Generate PROD deployment plan 3N-B failed. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return plan;
}


/**
 * Create DEV candidate backup.
 *
 * Chạy riêng, không đưa vào QA batch để tránh tạo nhiều backup.
 *
 * options:
 * {
 *   forceNewBackup: true / false
 * }
 */
function kidlearnV3_createDevCandidateBackup3NBV3(options) {
  var req =
    kidlearnV3_3nbNormalizeOptions_(
      options
    );

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var existingBackupId =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_KEYS.BACKUP_FILE_ID
    ) || '';

  var existingBackupUrl =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_KEYS.BACKUP_FILE_URL
    ) || '';

  if (
    existingBackupId &&
    existingBackupUrl &&
    req.forceNewBackup !== true
  ) {
    var reused = {
      success: true,
      action: 'CREATE_DEV_CANDIDATE_BACKUP_3NB_V3',
      bundle: '3N-B',
      status: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_STATUS.BACKUP_CREATED,
      reusedExistingBackup: true,
      backupFileId: existingBackupId,
      backupFileUrl: existingBackupUrl,
      message:
        'Đã có backup cũ của 3N-B. Không tạo bản copy mới. Muốn tạo mới, chạy với {forceNewBackup:true}.'
    };

    kidlearnV3_3nbSaveResult_(
      reused,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_STATUS.BACKUP_CREATED,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_KEYS.LAST_BACKUP_AT
    );

    console.log(
      JSON.stringify(reused, null, 2)
    );

    return reused;
  }

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewDevBackupDeploymentPlan3NBV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể tạo backup 3N-B vì preview chưa đạt. Errors=' +
      preview.errorCount +
      '. ' +
      preview.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var plan =
    kidlearnV3_getDevBackupDeploymentPlan3NBStatusV3().lastPlan;

  if (!plan || plan.success !== true) {
    plan =
      kidlearnV3_generateProdDeploymentPlan3NBV3();
  }

  var candidateStatus =
    kidlearnV3_getProdCandidateReview3NAStatusV3();

  var candidateId =
    candidateStatus.candidateId ||
    kidlearnV3_3nbMakeBackupTimestamp_();

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3nbGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  var sourceFile =
    DriveApp.getFileById(
      spreadsheet.getId()
    );

  var backupName =
    '[KIDLEARN V3 DEV BACKUP] ' +
    spreadsheet.getName() +
    ' - ' +
    candidateId +
    ' - ' +
    kidlearnV3_3nbMakeBackupTimestamp_();

  var backupFile =
    kidlearnV3_3nbMakeCopyInSameFolder_(
      sourceFile,
      backupName
    );

  var backupResult = {
    success: true,
    action: 'CREATE_DEV_CANDIDATE_BACKUP_3NB_V3',
    bundle: '3N-B',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_STATUS.BACKUP_CREATED,
    candidateId: candidateId,
    sourceSpreadsheetId: spreadsheet.getId(),
    sourceSpreadsheetName: spreadsheet.getName(),
    backupFileId: backupFile.getId(),
    backupFileName: backupFile.getName(),
    backupFileUrl: backupFile.getUrl(),
    prodDeployNow: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    createdAt:
      new Date().toISOString(),
    note:
      'Backup đã được tạo trên Google Drive. Chưa copy/deploy sang PROD.'
  };

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_KEYS.BACKUP_FILE_ID,
    backupResult.backupFileId
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_KEYS.BACKUP_FILE_URL,
    backupResult.backupFileUrl
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_KEYS.LAST_BACKUP_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(backupResult)
  );

  kidlearnV3_3nbSaveResult_(
    backupResult,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_STATUS.BACKUP_CREATED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_KEYS.LAST_BACKUP_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(backupResult, null, 2)
  );

  return backupResult;
}


/**
 * Mark 3N-B ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markDevBackupDeploymentPlan3NBReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getDevBackupDeploymentPlan3NBStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    !status.lastPlan ||
    status.lastPlan.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3N-B chưa có deployment plan success=true.'
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.backupFileId ||
    !status.backupFileUrl
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3N-B chưa có backupFileId/backupFileUrl. Cần chạy kidlearnV3_createDevCandidateBackup3NBV3.'
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3nbCheckSafeModes_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      safeModes.errors
    );

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark 3N-B ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_DEV_BACKUP_DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_3NB_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3N-B',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_STATUS.READY_FOR_3N_C,
    backupFileId: status.backupFileId,
    backupFileUrl: status.backupFileUrl,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    message:
      '3N-B ready. DEV candidate đã có backup và deployment plan. Bước tiếp theo là 3N-C PROD dry-run deployment rehearsal.',
    markedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_3nbSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_STATUS.READY_FOR_3N_C,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}

/**
 * Assert 3N-B ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertDevBackupDeploymentPlan3NBReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getDevBackupDeploymentPlan3NBStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_STATUS.READY_FOR_3N_C
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3N-B chưa READY_FOR_3N_C. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (!status.backupFileId) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu backupFileId.'
    );
  }

  if (!status.backupFileUrl) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu backupFileUrl.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_DEV_BACKUP_DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_3NB_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3N-B',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status: status.status,
    backupFileId: status.backupFileId,
    backupFileUrl: status.backupFileUrl,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3N-B chưa ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Build database summary.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbBuildDatabaseSummary_() {
  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3nbGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  var expectedSheets =
    kidlearnV3_3nbGetExpectedSheets_();

  var items = [];
  var missing = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < expectedSheets.length; i++) {
    var sheetName =
      expectedSheets[i];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_3nbGetSheet_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetName
      );

    if (!sheet) {
      missing.push(sheetName);

      items.push({
        sheetName: sheetName,
        exists: false
      });

      continue;
    }

    items.push({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      exists: true,
      lastRow: sheet.getLastRow(),
      lastColumn: sheet.getLastColumn()
    });
  }

  return {
    spreadsheetId: spreadsheet.getId(),
    spreadsheetName: spreadsheet.getName(),
    spreadsheetUrl: spreadsheet.getUrl(),
    expectedSheetCount: expectedSheets.length,
    foundSheetCount:
      items.filter(function(item) {
        return item.exists;
      }).length,
    missingSheetCount: missing.length,
    missingSheets: missing,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Make copy in same folder.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbMakeCopyInSameFolder_(
  sourceFile,
  backupName
) {
  var parents =
    sourceFile.getParents();

  if (parents.hasNext()) {
    var parent =
      parents.next();

    return sourceFile.makeCopy(
      backupName,
      parent
    );
  }

  return sourceFile.makeCopy(
    backupName
  );
}


/**
 * Check safe modes.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbCheckSafeModes_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3nbSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write phải DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3nbControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write đang ENABLED.'
    );
  }

  if (controlledWrite.available === false) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy Controlled Write status function. Bỏ qua check này trong DEV.'
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    summary: {
      safeWriteMode: safeWrite.mode || '',
      safeWriteEnabled: safeWrite.enabled,
      controlledWriteAvailable: controlledWrite.available,
      controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite.status || ''
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Database spreadsheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_() {
  var database =
    kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_();

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3nbResolveSpreadsheet_(
      database
    );

  if (!spreadsheet) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không resolve được Spreadsheet object từ Database V3.'
    );
  }

  return spreadsheet;
}


/**
 * Resolve Spreadsheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbResolveSpreadsheet_(value) {
  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (
    typeof value.getSheets === 'function' &&
    typeof value.getId === 'function'
  ) {
    return value;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheet &&
    typeof value.spreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheet;
  }

  if (
    value.database &&
    typeof value.database.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.database;
  }

  if (
    value.db &&
    typeof value.db.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.db;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheetObject &&
    typeof value.spreadsheetObject.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheetObject;
  }

  if (
    value.activeSpreadsheet &&
    typeof value.activeSpreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.activeSpreadsheet;
  }

  if (value.spreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.spreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (value.databaseSpreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.databaseSpreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (
    value.id &&
    typeof value.id === 'string'
  ) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.id
    );
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Get exact sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbGetSheet_(
  spreadsheet,
  sheetName
) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Safe call.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        available: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        error: 'Missing function'
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success: true,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      output:
        kidlearnV3_3nbSummarizeOutput_(
          output
        )
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe assert.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbSafeAssert_(
  functionName,
  label
) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output &&
        output.success === true,
      label: label,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbSafeWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Controlled Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbControlledWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      var result =
        kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

      result.available = true;

      return result;
    }

    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        'Missing kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbCheckFunctions_(names) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          names[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: names[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        names[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Summarize output.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbSummarizeOutput_(output) {
  if (!output || typeof output !== 'object') {
    return {
      rawType: typeof output
    };
  }

  return {
    success: output.success,
    action: output.action || '',
    bundle: output.bundle || '',
    phase: output.phase || '',
    status: output.status || '',
    candidateId: output.candidateId || '',
    nextBundle: output.nextBundle || '',
    nextStage: output.nextStage || '',
    errorCount: output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount: output.warningCount || 0
  };
}


/**
 * Save plan.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbSavePlan_(plan) {
  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_KEYS.LAST_PLAN_JSON,
      JSON.stringify(plan)
    );
}


/**
 * Save result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbSaveResult_(
  result,
  status,
  dateKey
) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var currentStatus =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_KEYS.STATUS
    ) || '';

  var finalStatus =
    status;

  if (
    currentStatus ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_STATUS.READY_FOR_3N_C &&
    (
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_STATUS.PREVIEWED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_STATUS.PLAN_GENERATED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_STATUS.BACKUP_CREATED
    )
  ) {
    finalStatus =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_STATUS.READY_FOR_3N_C;
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_KEYS.STATUS,
    finalStatus
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_PLAN_3NB_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      bundle: result.bundle,
      phase: result.phase,
      status: finalStatus,
      originalRequestedStatus: status,
      candidateId: result.candidateId || '',
      backupFileId: result.backupFileId || '',
      backupFileUrl: result.backupFileUrl || '',
      prodDeployNow: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


/**
 * Read JSON property.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Normalize options.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbNormalizeOptions_(options) {
  if (!options) {
    return {};
  }

  if (typeof options !== 'object') {
    return {
      value: options
    };
  }

  return options;
}


/**
 * Backup timestamp.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3nbMakeBackupTimestamp_() {
  return Utilities.formatDate(
    new Date(),
    Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
    'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
  );
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - PROD CANDIDATE CHECKLIST
 * Bundle: 3M-D
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * 3M-D:
 * - Chỉ review readiness.
 * - Không deploy PROD.
 * - Không ghi dữ liệu học tập thật.
 * - Không real write.
 * - Không rollback.
 * - Không migration.
 * - Không create/delete sheet.
 * - Chỉ ghi ScriptProperties để lưu checklist/status.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MD_STATUS',
  LAST_PREVIEW_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MD_LAST_PREVIEW_AT',
  LAST_CHECKLIST_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MD_LAST_CHECKLIST_AT',
  LAST_READY_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MD_LAST_READY_AT',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MD_LAST_RESULT_JSON',
  LAST_CHECKLIST_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MD_LAST_CHECKLIST_JSON'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_STATUS = {
  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  PREVIEWED: 'PREVIEWED',
  CHECKLIST_PASSED: 'CHECKLIST_PASSED',
  READY_FOR_PROD_CANDIDATE_REVIEW: 'READY_FOR_PROD_CANDIDATE_REVIEW',
  FAILED: 'FAILED'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_CONFIG = {
  VERSION: '3M-D',
  PHASE: '3M-D',
  NEXT_STAGE: 'PROD_CANDIDATE_REVIEW',
  WRITE_MODE: 'NO_DB_WRITE',
  REAL_WRITE_ALLOWED: false,
  EXPECTED_SHEET_COUNT: 44,
  REQUIRED_CLOSE_STATUS: 'CLOSED_LOCKED'
};


/**
 * Preview 3M-D.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewProdCandidateChecklist3MDV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions =
    kidlearnV3_3mdCheckFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_assertSecurityRoleGuard3MCReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3JClosedV3',
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3KClosedV3',
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3LClosedV3',
      'kidlearnV3_assertQaAsync3MAReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_assertPerformanceBaseline3MBReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_',
      'kidlearnV3_roleGuard3MCV3',
      'kidlearnV3_runQaBatchProvidedStepsV3'
    ]);

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      requiredFunctions.errors
    );

  var optionalFunctions =
    kidlearnV3_3mdCheckFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getQaAsyncStatus3MAV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getPerformanceBaseline3MBStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getSecurityRoleGuard3MCStatusV3'
    ]);

  if (optionalFunctions.errors.length > 0) {
    warnings =
      warnings.concat(
        optionalFunctions.errors.map(function(item) {
          return 'Optional function warning: ' + item;
        })
      );
  }

  var phase3MC =
    kidlearnV3_3mdSafeAssert_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertSecurityRoleGuard3MCReadyV3',
      '3M-C'
    );

  if (!phase3MC.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3M-C chưa READY_FOR_3M_D: ' +
      phase3MC.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3mdCheckSafeModes_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      safeModes.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      safeModes.warnings
    );

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_PROD_CANDIDATE_CHECKLIST_3MD_V3',
    bundle: '3M-D',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextStage: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    writeMode: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_CONFIG.WRITE_MODE,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3MC: phase3MC,
    safeModes: safeModes,
    requiredFunctions: requiredFunctions.items,
    optionalFunctions: optionalFunctions.items,
    note:
      '3M-D chỉ xác nhận DEV V3 đủ điều kiện làm PROD candidate. Chưa deploy PROD.'
  };

  kidlearnV3_3mdSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_STATUS.PREVIEWED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Run PROD candidate checklist.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runProdCandidateChecklist3MDV3() {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewProdCandidateChecklist3MDV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể chạy PROD candidate checklist 3M-D vì preview chưa đạt. Errors=' +
      preview.errorCount +
      '. ' +
      preview.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var phaseReview =
    kidlearnV3_3mdReviewPhaseReadiness_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      phaseReview.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      phaseReview.warnings
    );

  var sheetInventory =
    kidlearnV3_3mdReviewSheetInventory_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      sheetInventory.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      sheetInventory.warnings
    );

  var safeModeReview =
    kidlearnV3_3mdCheckSafeModes_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      safeModeReview.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      safeModeReview.warnings
    );

  var securityReview =
    kidlearnV3_3mdReviewSecurityGuards_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      securityReview.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      securityReview.warnings
    );

  var performanceReview =
    kidlearnV3_3mdReviewPerformanceBaseline_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      performanceReview.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      performanceReview.warnings
    );

  var asyncReview =
    kidlearnV3_3mdReviewQaAsyncState_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      asyncReview.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      asyncReview.warnings
    );

  var prodRiskReview =
    kidlearnV3_3mdReviewProdRiskGates_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      prodRiskReview.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      prodRiskReview.warnings
    );

  var decision =
    errors.length === 0
      ? 'READY_FOR_PROD_CANDIDATE_REVIEW'
      : 'HOLD_DEV_V3';

  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'RUN_PROD_CANDIDATE_CHECKLIST_3MD_V3',
    bundle: '3M-D',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextStage: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    decision: decision,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    writeMode: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_CONFIG.WRITE_MODE,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    checklist: {
      phaseReview: phaseReview,
      sheetInventory: sheetInventory.summary,
      safeModeReview: safeModeReview.summary,
      securityReview: securityReview.summary,
      performanceReview: performanceReview.summary,
      asyncReview: asyncReview.summary,
      prodRiskReview: prodRiskReview.summary
    },
    requiredManualBeforeProd: [
      'Tạo backup DEV database trước khi chuẩn bị PROD.',
      'Review lại role/access thật trong DATA_UserChildAccess.',
      'Review dữ liệu master lesson/question trước khi copy sang PROD.',
      'PROD deployment phải là phase riêng, không chạy trong 3M-D.'
    ]
  };

  kidlearnV3_3mdSaveChecklist_(
    result
  );

  kidlearnV3_3mdSaveResult_(
    result,
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_STATUS.CHECKLIST_PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_KEYS.LAST_CHECKLIST_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3M-D PROD candidate checklist failed. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Mark 3M-D ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markProdCandidateChecklist3MDReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdCandidateChecklist3MDStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  var allowed = {
    CHECKLIST_PASSED: true,
    READY_FOR_PROD_CANDIDATE_REVIEW: true
  };

  if (!allowed[status.status]) {
    errors.push(
      '3M-D chưa có checklist passed. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  var lastChecklist =
    status.lastChecklist || {};

  if (
    !lastChecklist ||
    lastChecklist.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last PROD candidate checklist chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3mdCheckSafeModes_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      safeModes.errors
    );

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    var failed = {
      success: false,
      action: 'MARK_PROD_CANDIDATE_CHECKLIST_3MD_READY_V3',
      bundle: '3M-D',
      status: status.status,
      errorCount: errors.length,
      errors: errors
    };

    console.log(
      JSON.stringify(failed, null, 2)
    );

    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark 3M-D ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_PROD_CANDIDATE_CHECKLIST_3MD_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3M-D',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_STATUS.READY_FOR_PROD_CANDIDATE_REVIEW,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    message:
      'DEV V3 đã sẵn sàng cho PROD candidate review. Chưa deploy PROD trong bước này.',
    markedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_3mdSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_STATUS.READY_FOR_PROD_CANDIDATE_REVIEW,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}

      stopOnFailure: true
    }
  );
