/**
 * Review phase readiness.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mdReviewPhaseReadiness_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var items = [];

  var checks = [
    {
      label: 'Phase 3J closed',
      functionName: 'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3JClosedV3'
    },
    {
      label: 'Phase 3K closed',
      functionName: 'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3KClosedV3'
    },
    {
      label: 'Phase 3L closed',
      functionName: 'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3LClosedV3'
    },
    {
      label: '3M-A ready',
      functionName: 'kidlearnV3_assertQaAsync3MAReadyV3'
    },
    {
      label: '3M-B ready',
      functionName: 'kidlearnV3_assertPerformanceBaseline3MBReadyV3'
    },
    {
      label: '3M-C ready',
      functionName: 'kidlearnV3_assertSecurityRoleGuard3MCReadyV3'
    }
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < checks.length; i++) {
    var item =
      kidlearnV3_3mdSafeAssert_(
        checks[i].functionName,
        checks[i].label
      );

    items.push(item);

    if (!item.success) {
      errors.push(
        checks[i].label +
        ' chưa pass: ' +
        item.message
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    items: items,
    summary: {
      checkedCount: checks.length,
      passedCount:
        items.filter(function(item) {
          return item.success;
        }).length,
      failedCount:
        items.filter(function(item) {
          return !item.success;
        }).length
    }
  };
}


/**
 * Review sheet inventory.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mdReviewSheetInventory_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var items = [];

  var expectedSheets =
    kidlearnV3_3mdGetExpectedSheets_();

  if (
    expectedSheets.length !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_CONFIG.EXPECTED_SHEET_COUNT
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'Expected sheet list hiện có ' +
      expectedSheets.length +
      ' sheet. Chuẩn V3 là 44.'
    );
  }

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3mdGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  for (var i = 0; i < expectedSheets.length; i++) {
    var sheetName =
      expectedSheets[i];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_3mdGetSheet_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetName
      );

    if (!sheet) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu V3 sheet: ' +
        sheetName
      );

      items.push({
        sheetName: sheetName,
        exists: false
      });

      continue;
    }

    var lastRow =
      sheet.getLastRow();

    var lastColumn =
      sheet.getLastColumn();

    if (lastRow < 2) {
      warnings.push(
        sheetName +
        ' có ít hơn 2 dòng header/key.'
      );
    }

    items.push({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      exists: true,
      lastRow: lastRow,
      lastColumn: lastColumn
    });
  }

  var activeLegacyNames =
    kidlearnV3_3mdFindActiveLegacySheetNames_(
      spreadsheet
    );

  if (activeLegacyNames.length > 0) {
    warnings.push(
      'Vẫn còn legacy sheet active chưa rename LEGACY_V2_: ' +
      activeLegacyNames.join(', ')
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    items: items,
    summary: {
      expectedSheetCount: expectedSheets.length,
      foundSheetCount:
        items.filter(function(item) {
          return item.exists;
        }).length,
      missingSheetCount:
        items.filter(function(item) {
          return !item.exists;
        }).length,
      activeLegacySheetCount:
        activeLegacyNames.length,
      activeLegacySheets:
        activeLegacyNames
    }
  };
}


/**
 * Check safe modes.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mdCheckSafeModes_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3mdSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write phải DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3mdControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write đang ENABLED.'
    );
  }

  if (controlledWrite.available === false) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy Controlled Write status function. Bỏ qua check này trong DEV.'
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite,
    controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite,
    summary: {
      safeWriteMode: safeWrite.mode || '',
      safeWriteEnabled: safeWrite.enabled,
      controlledWriteAvailable: controlledWrite.available,
      controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite.status || ''
    }
  };
}


/**
 * Review security guards.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mdReviewSecurityGuards_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var tests = [];

  var cases = [
    {
      name: 'CHILD can view learning',
      request: {
        role: 'CHILD',
        screenId: 'LEARNING_HOME_V3',
        actionCode: 'VIEW_LEARNING'
      },
      expectSuccess: true
    },
    {
      name: 'CHILD blocked from settings',
      request: {
        role: 'CHILD',
        screenId: 'SETTINGS_HOME',
        actionCode: 'VIEW_SETTINGS'
      },
      expectSuccess: false
    },
    {
      name: 'FAMILY_ADMIN can view settings',
      request: {
        role: 'FAMILY_ADMIN',
        screenId: 'SETTINGS_HOME',
        actionCode: 'VIEW_SETTINGS'
      },
      expectSuccess: true
    },
    {
      name: 'ADMIN blocked',
      request: {
        role: 'ADMIN',
        screenId: 'SETTINGS_HOME',
        actionCode: 'VIEW_SETTINGS'
      },
      expectSuccess: false
    }
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < cases.length; i++) {
    var guardResult =
      kidlearnV3_roleGuard3MCV3(
        cases[i].request
      );

    var passed =
      guardResult.success === cases[i].expectSuccess;

    tests.push({
      name: cases[i].name,
      expected: cases[i].expectSuccess,
      actual: guardResult.success,
      passed: passed
    });

    if (!passed) {
      errors.push(
        'Security guard test failed: ' +
        cases[i].name +
        '. Expected=' +
        cases[i].expectSuccess +
        ', actual=' +
        guardResult.success
      );
    }

    if (
      guardResult.warnings &&
      guardResult.warnings.length
    ) {
      warnings =
        warnings.concat(
          guardResult.warnings
        );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    tests: tests,
    summary: {
      testCount: tests.length,
      passedCount:
        tests.filter(function(item) {
          return item.passed;
        }).length,
      failedCount:
        tests.filter(function(item) {
          return !item.passed;
        }).length
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Find active legacy sheet names.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mdFindActiveLegacySheetNames_(
  spreadsheet
) {
  var legacy = {
    Data_Tasks: true,
    Data_Users: true,
    Data_Scores: true,
    Thiet_Lap: true,
    Danh_Muc: true,
    Log_HeThong: true
  };

  var names = [];
  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    var name =
      sheets[i].getName();

    if (legacy[name]) {
      names.push(name);
    }
  }

  return names;
}


/**
 * Database spreadsheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mdGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_() {
  var database =
    kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_();

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3mdResolveSpreadsheet_(
      database
    );

  if (!spreadsheet) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không resolve được Spreadsheet object từ Database V3.'
    );
  }

  return spreadsheet;
}


/**
 * Resolve Spreadsheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mdResolveSpreadsheet_(value) {
  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (
    typeof value.getSheets === 'function' &&
    typeof value.getId === 'function'
  ) {
    return value;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheet &&
    typeof value.spreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheet;
  }

  if (
    value.database &&
    typeof value.database.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.database;
  }

  if (
    value.db &&
    typeof value.db.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.db;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheetObject &&
    typeof value.spreadsheetObject.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheetObject;
  }

  if (
    value.activeSpreadsheet &&
    typeof value.activeSpreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.activeSpreadsheet;
  }

  if (value.spreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.spreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (value.databaseSpreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.databaseSpreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (
    value.id &&
    typeof value.id === 'string'
  ) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.id
    );
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Get exact sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mdGetSheet_(
  spreadsheet,
  sheetName
) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Safe assert helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mdSafeAssert_(
  functionName,
  label
) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var result =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        result && result.success === true,
      label: label,
      message:
        result && result.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(result)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}

 */
function kidlearnV3_3mdSafeWriteStatus_() {

    return kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_3mdControlledWriteStatus_() {
  try {

      typeof kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      var result =
        kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

      result.available = true;

      return result;
    }

    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      safeWriteMode: '',
      safeWriteEnabled: false,
      error:
        'Missing kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      safeWriteMode: '',
      safeWriteEnabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mdCheckFunctions_(names) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          names[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: names[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        names[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Save checklist compact.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mdSaveChecklist_(result) {
  var compact = {
    success: result.success,
    action: result.action,
    bundle: result.bundle,
    phase: result.phase,
    nextStage: result.nextStage,
    decision: result.decision,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    startedAt: result.startedAt,
    finishedAt: result.finishedAt,
    durationMs: result.durationMs,
    errorCount: result.errorCount,
    warningCount: result.warningCount,
    errors: result.errors,
    warnings: result.warnings,
    checklist: result.checklist,
    requiredManualBeforeProd: result.requiredManualBeforeProd
  };

  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_KEYS.LAST_CHECKLIST_JSON,
      JSON.stringify(compact)
    );
}


/**
 * Save result compact.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mdSaveResult_(
  result,
  status,
  dateKey
) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var currentStatus =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_KEYS.STATUS
    ) || '';

  var finalStatus =
    status;

  if (
    currentStatus ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_STATUS.READY_FOR_PROD_CANDIDATE_REVIEW &&
    (
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_STATUS.PREVIEWED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_STATUS.CHECKLIST_PASSED
    )
  ) {
    finalStatus =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_STATUS.READY_FOR_PROD_CANDIDATE_REVIEW;
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_KEYS.STATUS,
    finalStatus
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_3MD_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      bundle: result.bundle,
      phase: result.phase,
      status: finalStatus,
      originalRequestedStatus: status,
      decision: result.decision || '',
      prodDeployNow: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


/**
 * Read JSON property.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mdReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - PROD CANDIDATE REVIEW / FREEZE DEV CANDIDATE
 * Bundle: 3N-A
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * 3N-A:
 * - Chỉ freeze DEV candidate bằng manifest.
 * - Không deploy PROD.
 * - Không copy PROD.
 * - Không real write.
 * - Không rollback.
 * - Không migration.
 * - Không create/delete sheet.
 * - Chỉ ghi ScriptProperties để lưu candidate manifest/status.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3NA_STATUS',
  CANDIDATE_ID: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3NA_CANDIDATE_ID',
  LAST_PREVIEW_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3NA_LAST_PREVIEW_AT',
  LAST_MANIFEST_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3NA_LAST_MANIFEST_AT',
  LAST_READY_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3NA_LAST_READY_AT',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3NA_LAST_RESULT_JSON',
  LAST_MANIFEST_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3NA_LAST_MANIFEST_JSON'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_STATUS = {
  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  PREVIEWED: 'PREVIEWED',
  MANIFEST_GENERATED: 'MANIFEST_GENERATED',
  READY_FOR_3N_B: 'READY_FOR_3N_B',
  FAILED: 'FAILED'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_CONFIG = {
  VERSION: '3N-A',
  PHASE: '3N-A',
  NEXT_BUNDLE: '3N-B',
  NEXT_STAGE: 'PROD_BACKUP_AND_DEPLOY_PLAN',
  EXPECTED_SHEET_COUNT: 44,
  WRITE_MODE: 'NO_DB_WRITE',
  REAL_WRITE_ALLOWED: false
};


/**
 * Preview 3N-A.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewProdCandidateReview3NAV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var functionChecks =
    kidlearnV3_3naCheckFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_assertProdCandidateChecklist3MDReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_',
      'kidlearnV3_runQaBatchProvidedStepsV3'
    ]);

  errors =
    errors.concat(functionChecks.errors);

  var optionalChecks =
    kidlearnV3_3naCheckFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_getProdCandidateChecklist3MDStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getQaAsync3MAStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getPerformanceBaseline3MBStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getSecurityRoleGuard3MCStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getPhase3LCloseStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3'
    ]);

  if (optionalChecks.errors.length > 0) {
    warnings =
      warnings.concat(
        optionalChecks.errors.map(function(item) {
          return 'Optional warning: ' + item;
        })
      );
  }

  var phase3MD =
    kidlearnV3_3naSafeAssert_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertProdCandidateChecklist3MDReadyV3',
      '3M-D'
    );

  if (!phase3MD.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3M-D chưa READY_FOR_PROD_CANDIDATE_REVIEW: ' +
      phase3MD.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3naCheckSafeModes_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(safeModes.errors);

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  var dbSummary = null;

  try {
    dbSummary =
      kidlearnV3_3naBuildDatabaseSummary_();

    if (
      dbSummary.expectedSheetCount !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_CONFIG.EXPECTED_SHEET_COUNT
    ) {
      warnings.push(
        'Expected sheet count không phải 44. Actual=' +
        dbSummary.expectedSheetCount
      );
    }

    if (dbSummary.missingSheetCount > 0) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu V3 sheet trong DEV candidate. Missing=' +
        dbSummary.missingSheetCount
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không build được database summary 3N-A: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_PROD_CANDIDATE_REVIEW_3NA_V3',
    bundle: '3N-A',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    writeMode: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_CONFIG.WRITE_MODE,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3MD: phase3MD,
    safeModes: safeModes,
    databaseSummary: dbSummary,
    functionChecks: functionChecks.items,
    optionalChecks: optionalChecks.items,
    note:
      '3N-A chỉ tạo manifest và freeze DEV candidate. Chưa deploy PROD.'
  };

  kidlearnV3_3naSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_STATUS.PREVIEWED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  return result;
}


/**
 * Generate PROD candidate manifest.
 */
function kidlearnV3_generateProdCandidateManifest3NAV3() {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewProdCandidateReview3NAV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể generate manifest 3N-A vì preview chưa đạt. Errors=' +
      preview.errorCount +
      '. ' +
      preview.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var candidateId =
    kidlearnV3_3naMakeCandidateId_();

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3naGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  var phaseStatuses =
    kidlearnV3_3naCollectPhaseStatuses_();

  var databaseSummary =
    kidlearnV3_3naBuildDatabaseSummary_();

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3naCheckSafeModes_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(safeModes.errors);

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  var releaseNotes =
    kidlearnV3_3naBuildReleaseNotes_();

  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  var manifest = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'GENERATE_PROD_CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_3NA_V3',
    bundle: '3N-A',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_CONFIG.PHASE,
    candidateId: candidateId,
    candidateStatus:
      errors.length === 0
        ? 'DEV_CANDIDATE_FROZEN'
        : 'DEV_CANDIDATE_HOLD',
    prodDeployNow: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    writeMode: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_CONFIG.WRITE_MODE,
    generatedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    generatedFrom: {
      spreadsheetId: spreadsheet.getId(),
      spreadsheetName: spreadsheet.getName(),
      spreadsheetUrl: spreadsheet.getUrl()
    },
    versionInfo:
      kidlearnV3_3naBuildVersionInfo_(),
    phaseStatuses: phaseStatuses,
    databaseSummary: databaseSummary,
    safeModes: safeModes.summary,
    releaseNotes: releaseNotes,
    manualRequirementsBeforeProd: [
      'Tạo backup DEV candidate.',
      'Review DATA_UserChildAccess thật, không dùng DEV fallback.',
      'Review master lesson/question/content.',
      'Chuẩn bị PROD deployment plan riêng.',
      'Không deploy PROD bằng 3N-A.'
    ],
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() - startedAt.getTime(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_3naSaveManifest_(
    manifest
  );

  kidlearnV3_3naSaveResult_(
    manifest,
    manifest.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_STATUS.MANIFEST_GENERATED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_KEYS.LAST_MANIFEST_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2));

  if (!manifest.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Generate PROD candidate manifest 3N-A failed. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return manifest;
}


/**
 * Mark 3N-A ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markProdCandidateReview3NAReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdCandidateReview3NAStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_STATUS.MANIFEST_GENERATED &&
    status.status !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_STATUS.READY_FOR_3N_B
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3N-A chưa có manifest generated. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastManifest ||
    status.lastManifest.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last manifest chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3naCheckSafeModes_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(safeModes.errors);

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark 3N-A ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_PROD_CANDIDATE_REVIEW_3NA_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3N-A',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_STATUS.READY_FOR_3N_B,
    candidateId:
      status.candidateId || '',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    message:
      'DEV V3 candidate đã được freeze bằng manifest. Bước tiếp theo là 3N-B Backup & PROD deployment plan.',
    markedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_3naSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_STATUS.READY_FOR_3N_B,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  return result;
}

/**
 * Assert 3N-A ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertProdCandidateReview3NAReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdCandidateReview3NAStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_STATUS.READY_FOR_3N_B
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3N-A chưa READY_FOR_3N_B. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_PROD_CANDIDATE_REVIEW_3NA_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3N-A',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status: status.status,
    candidateId: status.candidateId || '',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3N-A chưa ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Build database summary.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naBuildDatabaseSummary_() {
  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3naGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  var expectedSheets =
    kidlearnV3_3naGetExpectedSheets_();

  var items = [];
  var missing = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < expectedSheets.length; i++) {
    var sheetName =
      expectedSheets[i];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_3naGetSheet_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetName
      );

    if (!sheet) {
      missing.push(sheetName);

      items.push({
        sheetName: sheetName,
        exists: false
      });

      continue;
    }

    items.push({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      exists: true,
      lastRow: sheet.getLastRow(),
      lastColumn: sheet.getLastColumn()
    });
  }

  return {
    spreadsheetId: spreadsheet.getId(),
    spreadsheetName: spreadsheet.getName(),
    expectedSheetCount: expectedSheets.length,
    foundSheetCount:
      items.filter(function(item) {
        return item.exists;
      }).length,
    missingSheetCount: missing.length,
    missingSheets: missing,
    items: items
  };
}

  };
}


/**
 * Build version info.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naBuildVersionInfo_() {
  var info = {
    appVersion: '',
    schemaVersion: '',
    environment: '',
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  try {
    if (typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined') {
      info.appVersion =
        KIDLEARN_V3.APP_VERSION || '';
      info.schemaVersion =
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    info.warning =
      String(error.message || error);
  }

  try {
    var properties =
      PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

    info.environment =
      properties.getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') || '';
  } catch (ignore) {}

  return info;
}

}


/**
 * Check safe modes.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naCheckSafeModes_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3naSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write phải DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3naControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write đang ENABLED.'
    );
  }

  if (controlledWrite.available === false) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy Controlled Write status function. Bỏ qua check này trong DEV.'
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    summary: {
      safeWriteMode: safeWrite.mode || '',
      safeWriteEnabled: safeWrite.enabled,
      controlledWriteAvailable: controlledWrite.available,
      controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite.status || ''
    }
  };
}

/**
 * Database spreadsheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_() {
  var database =
    kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_();

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3naResolveSpreadsheet_(
      database
    );

  if (!spreadsheet) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không resolve được Spreadsheet object từ Database V3.'
    );
  }

  return spreadsheet;
}


/**
 * Resolve Spreadsheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naResolveSpreadsheet_(value) {
  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (
    typeof value.getSheets === 'function' &&
    typeof value.getId === 'function'
  ) {
    return value;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheet &&
    typeof value.spreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheet;
  }

  if (
    value.database &&
    typeof value.database.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.database;
  }

  if (
    value.db &&
    typeof value.db.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.db;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheetObject &&
    typeof value.spreadsheetObject.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheetObject;
  }

  if (
    value.activeSpreadsheet &&
    typeof value.activeSpreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.activeSpreadsheet;
  }

  if (value.spreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(value.spreadsheetId);
  }

  if (value.databaseSpreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(value.databaseSpreadsheetId);
  }

  if (
    value.id &&
    typeof value.id === 'string'
  ) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(value.id);
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Get exact sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naGetSheet_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Safe call.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        available: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        error: 'Missing function'
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success: true,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      output: kidlearnV3_3naSummarizeOutput_(output)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      error: String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Summarize output.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naSummarizeOutput_(output) {
  if (!output || typeof output !== 'object') {
    return {
      rawType: typeof output
    };
  }

  return {
    success: output.success,
    action: output.action || '',
    bundle: output.bundle || '',
    phase: output.phase || '',
    status: output.status || '',
    nextBundle: output.nextBundle || '',
    nextPhase: output.nextPhase || '',
    nextStage: output.nextStage || '',
    errorCount: output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount: output.warningCount || 0,
    progressPercent: output.progressPercent || ''
  };
}


/**
 * Safe assert helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naSafeAssert_(functionName, label) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var result =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        result && result.success === true,
      label: label,
      message:
        result && result.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(result)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naSafeWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Controlled Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naControlledWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      var result =
        kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

      result.available = true;

      return result;
    }

    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        'Missing kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naCheckFunctions_(names) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          names[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: names[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        names[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Make candidate ID.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naMakeCandidateId_() {
  var text =
    Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    );

  return 'KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CANDIDATE_' + text;
}


/**
 * Save manifest.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naSaveManifest_(manifest) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_KEYS.CANDIDATE_ID,
    manifest.candidateId
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_KEYS.LAST_MANIFEST_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(manifest)
  );
}


/**
 * Save result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naSaveResult_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var currentStatus =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_KEYS.STATUS
    ) || '';

  var finalStatus =
    status;

  if (
    currentStatus ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_STATUS.READY_FOR_3N_B &&
    (
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_STATUS.PREVIEWED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_STATUS.MANIFEST_GENERATED
    )
  ) {
    finalStatus =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_STATUS.READY_FOR_3N_B;
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_KEYS.STATUS,
    finalStatus
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_REVIEW_3NA_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      bundle: result.bundle,
      phase: result.phase,
      status: finalStatus,
      originalRequestedStatus: status,
      candidateId: result.candidateId || '',
      prodDeployNow: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


/**
 * Read JSON property.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3naReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Preview 3O-D.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewProdChangeRequestApprovalGate3ODV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions =
    kidlearnV3_3odCheckFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_assertProdChangeRequestWorkflow3OCReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestWorkflow3OCStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReadonlySupportChangeGate3OBStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReleaseFinalLock3NJStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getControlledProdDeployment3NFStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_runQaBatchProvidedStepsV3'
    ]);

  errors = errors.concat(requiredFunctions.errors);

  var phase3OC =
    kidlearnV3_3odSafeAssert_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertProdChangeRequestWorkflow3OCReadyV3',
      '3O-C'
    );

  if (!phase3OC.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-C chưa READY_FOR_3O_D: ' +
      phase3OC.message
    );
  }

  var workflowStatus =
    kidlearnV3_3odSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestWorkflow3OCStatusV3'
    );

  if (
    workflowStatus.summary.status &&
    workflowStatus.summary.status !== 'READY_FOR_3O_D'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-C workflow chưa READY_FOR_3O_D. Status=' +
      workflowStatus.summary.status
    );
  }

  var supportGate =
    kidlearnV3_3odSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReadonlySupportChangeGate3OBStatusV3'
    );

  if (
    supportGate.summary.changeGateStatus &&
    supportGate.summary.changeGateStatus !== 'CLOSED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Change gate từ 3O-B phải CLOSED trước approval gate. Current=' +
      supportGate.summary.changeGateStatus
    );
  }

  var finalLock =
    kidlearnV3_3odSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReleaseFinalLock3NJStatusV3'
    );

  if (
    finalLock.summary.status &&
    finalLock.summary.status !== 'PROD_RELEASE_LOCKED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3N-J chưa PROD_RELEASE_LOCKED. Status=' +
      finalLock.summary.status
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3odGetProdInfo_();

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileId từ 3N-F.');
  }

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileUrl) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileUrl từ 3N-F.');
  }

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3odCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file chưa accessible: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3odCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_APPROVAL_GATE_3OD_V3',
    bundle: '3O-D',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    writeMode: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.WRITE_MODE,
    confirmText:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    approvalGateOnly: true,
    specificChangeApprovedNow: false,
    changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
    prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3OC: phase3OC,
    workflowStatus: workflowStatus.summary,
    supportGate: supportGate.summary,
    finalLock: finalLock.summary,
    prodInfo: prodInfo,
    prodCheck: prodCheck,
    safeModes: safeModes,
    requiredFunctions: requiredFunctions.items,
    note:
      '3O-D chỉ là approval gate để đi tiếp sang planning. Không approve request cụ thể và không ghi PROD.'
  };

  kidlearnV3_3odSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.PREVIEWED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  return result;
}

      preview.errorCount +
      '. ' +
      preview.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var approvalGateId =
    kidlearnV3_3odMakeApprovalGateId_();

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3odGetProdInfo_();

  var workflow =
    kidlearnV3_3odSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestWorkflow3OCStatusV3'
    );

  var supportGate =
    kidlearnV3_3odSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReadonlySupportChangeGate3OBStatusV3'
    );

  var monitoring =
    kidlearnV3_3odSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReadonlyMonitoringOnboarding3OAStatusV3'
    );

  var finalLock =
    kidlearnV3_3odSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReleaseFinalLock3NJStatusV3'
    );

  var handover =
    kidlearnV3_3odSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReleaseHandover3NIStatusV3'
    );

    );

  var safeModes =

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  var approvalPolicy =
    kidlearnV3_3odBuildApprovalPolicy_();

  var finishedAt = new Date();

  var approvalPackage = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'GENERATE_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_APPROVAL_GATE_PACKAGE_3OD_V3',
    bundle: '3O-D',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.PACKAGE_GENERATED
        : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.FAILED,
    approvalGateId: approvalGateId,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,

      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    confirmText:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    approvalGateOnly: true,
    specificChangeApprovedNow: false,
    changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
    prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,

    prodReference: {
      prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
      prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
      prodFileName: prodInfo.prodFileName || '',
      deploymentId: prodInfo.deploymentId || '',
      accessible: prodCheck.success
    },

    upstreamReadiness: {

      supportGate3OB: supportGate.summary,
      monitoring3OA: monitoring.summary,
      handover3NI: handover.summary,
      finalLock3NJ: finalLock.summary
    },

    approvalPolicy: approvalPolicy,

    approvalChecklist: [
      {
        item: '3O-C workflow ready',
        passed:
          workflow.summary.status === 'READY_FOR_3O_D'
      },
      {
        item: '3O-B change gate remains CLOSED',
        passed:
          supportGate.summary.changeGateStatus === 'CLOSED'
      },
      {
        item: 'PROD release remains locked',
        passed:
          finalLock.summary.status === 'PROD_RELEASE_LOCKED'
      },
      {
        item: 'PROD file accessible',
        passed: prodCheck.success
      },
      {

        passed:

          safeModes.summary.safeWriteEnabled === false
      },
      {

        passed: true
      },
      {
        item: 'No PROD write policy opened in 3O-D',
        passed: true
      }
    ],

    approvalMeaning:
      'Approval gate này chỉ cho phép đi tiếp sang 3O-E implementation planning. Nó không approve request cụ thể và không mở PROD write.',

    noSideEffect: {
      prodFileModifiedBy3OD: false,
      prodDataWrittenBy3OD: false,

    },

function kidlearnV3_recordProdChangeRequestApprovalGate3ODManualConfirmV3() {

      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT,

/**
 * Record approval gate.
 *
 * options:
 * {
 *   confirmText: 'APPROVE_CHANGE_REQUEST_GATE_3O_D',
 *   approvedBy: '...',
 *   approvalNote: '...'
 * }
 */
function kidlearnV3_recordProdChangeRequestApprovalGate3ODV3(options) {
  var req =
    kidlearnV3_3odNormalizeOptions_(options);

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  if (
    String(req.confirmText || '') !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Confirm text không đúng. Cần đúng: ' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
    );
  }

  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestApprovalGate3ODStatusV3();

  if (
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.PACKAGE_GENERATED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.APPROVAL_GATE_RECORDED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_E
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-D chưa PACKAGE_GENERATED. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastPackage ||
    status.lastPackage.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last approval gate package chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3odGetProdInfo_();

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3odCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file không accessible khi record approval: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3odCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    var failed = {
      success: false,
      action: 'RECORD_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_APPROVAL_GATE_3OD_V3',
      bundle: '3O-D',
      phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.PHASE,
      status: status.status,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      prodDeployNow: false,
      specificChangeApprovedNow: false,
      changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
      errorCount: errors.length,
      warningCount: warnings.length,
      errors: errors,
      warnings: warnings
    };

    console.log(JSON.stringify(failed, null, 2));

    throw new Error(
      'Không thể record approval gate 3O-D. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var approvalGateId =
    status.approvalGateId ||
    kidlearnV3_3odMakeApprovalGateId_();

  var approval = {
    success: true,
    action: 'RECORD_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_APPROVAL_GATE_3OD_V3',
    bundle: '3O-D',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.APPROVAL_GATE_RECORDED,
    approvalGateId: approvalGateId,
    approvedBy:
      req.approvedBy || 'DEV_APPROVER_MANUAL_3OD',
    approvalNote:
      req.approvalNote || '',
    approvalMeaning:
      'Approval gate recorded to proceed to 3O-E planning only. No specific change request is approved or executed in 3O-D.',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    approvalGateOnly: true,
    specificChangeApprovedNow: false,
    changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
    prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
    safeModes: safeModes.summary,
    recordedAt:
      new Date().toISOString(),
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_KEYS.APPROVAL_GATE_ID,
    approvalGateId
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_KEYS.LAST_APPROVAL_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(approval)
  );

  kidlearnV3_3odSaveResult_(
    approval,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.APPROVAL_GATE_RECORDED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_KEYS.LAST_APPROVAL_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(approval, null, 2));

  return approval;
}


/**
 * Mark 3O-D ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markProdChangeRequestApprovalGate3ODReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestApprovalGate3ODStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.APPROVAL_GATE_RECORDED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_E
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-D chưa APPROVAL_GATE_RECORDED. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastApproval ||
    status.lastApproval.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last approval chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  if (!status.approvalGateId) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu approvalGateId.'
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3odGetProdInfo_();

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3odCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file không accessible khi mark ready: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3odCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark 3O-D ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_APPROVAL_GATE_3OD_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3O-D',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_E,
    approvalGateId: status.approvalGateId || '',
    prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    specificChangeApprovedNow: false,
    changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
    message:
      '3O-D ready. Approval gate đã được ghi nhận để đi tiếp sang 3O-E planning. Không có request cụ thể nào được approve hoặc execute.',
    markedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_3odSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_E,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  return result;
}

      ),

      ),

      )
  };

  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert 3O-D ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertProdChangeRequestApprovalGate3ODReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestApprovalGate3ODStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_E
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-D chưa READY_FOR_3O_E. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (!status.approvalGateId) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu approvalGateId.'
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3odGetProdInfo_();

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileId.');
  }

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileUrl) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileUrl.');
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_APPROVAL_GATE_3OD_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3O-D',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status: status.status,
    approvalGateId: status.approvalGateId || '',
    prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3O-D chưa ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Check file accessible.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3odCheckFileAccessible_(fileId, label) {
  try {
    if (!fileId) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label || '',
        fileId: '',
        message: 'Thiếu fileId.'
      };
    }

    var file =
      DriveApp.getFileById(fileId);

    return {
      success: true,
      label: label || '',
      fileId: fileId,
      fileName: file.getName(),
      fileUrl: file.getUrl(),
      message: 'File accessible.'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label || '',
      fileId: fileId || '',
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check safe modes.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3odCheckSafeModes_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3odSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write trong DEV script phải DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3odControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write đang ENABLED.'
    );
  }

  if (controlledWrite.available === false) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy Controlled Write status function. Bỏ qua check này trong DEV.'
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    summary: {
      safeWriteMode: safeWrite.mode || '',
      safeWriteEnabled: safeWrite.enabled,
      controlledWriteAvailable: controlledWrite.available,
      controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite.status || ''
    }
  };
}


/**
 * Safe assert.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3odSafeAssert_(functionName, label) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' +
          functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output &&
        output.success === true,
      label: label,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe call.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3odSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        available: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        summary: {
          status: '',
          error: 'Missing function'
        }
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success: true,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      summary:
        kidlearnV3_3odSummarizeStatusOutput_(
          output
        )
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      summary: {
        status: '',
        error: String(error.message || error)
      }
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Summarize status output.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3odSummarizeStatusOutput_(output) {
  if (!output || typeof output !== 'object') {
    return {
      rawType: typeof output
    };
  }

  return {
    success: output.success,
    action: output.action || '',
    bundle: output.bundle || '',
    phase: output.phase || '',
    status: output.status || '',
    nextBundle: output.nextBundle || '',
    nextStage: output.nextStage || '',
    prodFileId: output.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: output.prodFileUrl || '',
    workflowId: output.workflowId || '',
    supportPackageId: output.supportPackageId || '',
    changeGateId: output.changeGateId || '',
    changeGateStatus: output.changeGateStatus || '',
    finalLockId: output.finalLockId || '',
    errorCount: output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount: output.warningCount || 0
  };
}


/**
 * Safe Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3odSafeWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Controlled Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3odControlledWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      var result =
        kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

      result.available = true;

      return result;
    }

    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        'Missing kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3odCheckFunctions_(names) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          names[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: names[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        names[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Approval gate ID.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3odMakeApprovalGateId_() {
  return (
    'PROD_CR_APPROVAL_GATE_3OD_' +
    Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    )
  );
}


/**
 * Save package.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3odSavePackage_(approvalPackage) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_KEYS.APPROVAL_GATE_ID,
    approvalPackage.approvalGateId || ''
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_KEYS.LAST_PACKAGE_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(approvalPackage)
  );
}


/**
 * Save result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3odSaveResult_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var currentStatus =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_KEYS.STATUS
    ) || '';

  var finalStatus =
    status;

  if (
    currentStatus ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_E &&
    (
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.PREVIEWED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.PACKAGE_GENERATED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.APPROVAL_GATE_RECORDED
    )
  ) {
    finalStatus =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_E;
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_KEYS.STATUS,
    finalStatus
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_APPROVAL_3OD_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      bundle: result.bundle,
      phase: result.phase,
      status: finalStatus,
      originalRequestedStatus: status,
      approvalGateId: result.approvalGateId || '',
      prodFileId: result.prodFileId || '',
      prodFileUrl: result.prodFileUrl || '',
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      prodDeployNow: false,
      specificChangeApprovedNow: false,
      changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
      prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


/**
 * Read JSON property.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3odReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Normalize options.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3odNormalizeOptions_(options) {
  if (!options) return {};

  if (typeof options !== 'object') {
    return {
      value: options
    };
  }

  return options;
}

};

/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_previewProdChangeRequestCloseOperationalLock3OMV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions =
    kidlearnV3_3omCheckFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_assertProdSelectedCRPostTrialValidation3OLReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdSelectedCRPostTrialValidation3OLStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdSelectedCRControlledExecutionTrial3OKStatusV3',

      'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_runQaBatchProvidedStepsV3'
    ]);

  errors = errors.concat(requiredFunctions.errors);

  var phase3OL =
    kidlearnV3_3omSafeAssert_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertProdSelectedCRPostTrialValidation3OLReadyV3',

  if (!phase3OL.success) {

      phase3OL.message
    );
  }

    kidlearnV3_3omGetPostTrialInfo_();

    errors.push(
      '3O-L status chưa READY_FOR_3O_M. Status=' +
      postTrial.status
    );
  }

  if (
    postTrial.releaseDecision !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_CLOSE_3OM_CONFIG.RELEASE_DECISION_EXPECTED
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Release decision từ 3O-L không đúng. Expected=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_CLOSE_3OM_CONFIG.RELEASE_DECISION_EXPECTED +
      ', Actual=' +
      postTrial.releaseDecision
    );
  }

  if (!postTrial.controlledTrialId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu controlledTrialId từ 3O-K/3O-L.');
  }

  if (!postTrial.auditId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu auditId từ 3O-K/3O-L.');
  }

  if (postTrial.selectedRequestExecutedNow === true) {
    errors.push('Selected request không được execute trong chain này.');
  }

  if (postTrial.selectedDataChangedNow === true) {
    errors.push('Selected data không được changed trong chain này.');
  }

  if (postTrial.fullProdWritePolicyOpenedNow === true) {
    errors.push('Full PROD write policy không được opened trong chain này.');
  }

  var finalLock =
    kidlearnV3_3omSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReleaseFinalLock3NJStatusV3'
    );

  if (
    finalLock.summary.status &&
    finalLock.summary.status !== 'PROD_RELEASE_LOCKED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3N-J chưa PROD_RELEASE_LOCKED. Status=' +
      finalLock.summary.status
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3omGetProdInfo_();

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileId từ 3N-F.');
  }

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileUrl) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileUrl từ 3N-F.');
  }

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3omCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file chưa accessible: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var auditRowCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3omFindAuditTrialRow_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      postTrial.controlledTrialId,
      postTrial.auditId
    );

  if (!auditRowCheck.success) {

      auditRowCheck.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3omCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_CLOSE_OPERATIONAL_LOCK_3OM_V3',
    bundle: '3O-M',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_CLOSE_3OM_CONFIG.PHASE,

    nextStage: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_CLOSE_3OM_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    writeMode: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_CLOSE_3OM_CONFIG.WRITE_MODE,
    confirmText:

    finalOperationalMode:

    prodDeployNow: false,

    migrationExecutedNow: false,

  kidlearnV3_3omSaveResult_(
