/**
 * PROD info từ 3N-F.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ohGetProdInfo_() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getControlledProdDeployment3NFStatusV3();

  return {
    status: status.status || '',
    deploymentId: status.deploymentId || '',
    prodFileId: status.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: status.prodFileUrl || '',
    prodFileName: status.prodFileName || ''
  };
}


/**
 * Check file accessible.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ohCheckFileAccessible_(fileId, label) {
  try {
    if (!fileId) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label || '',
        fileId: '',
        message: 'Thiếu fileId.'
      };
    }

    var file =
      DriveApp.getFileById(fileId);

    return {
      success: true,
      label: label || '',
      fileId: fileId,
      fileName: file.getName(),
      fileUrl: file.getUrl(),
      message: 'File accessible.'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label || '',
      fileId: fileId || '',
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check safe modes.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ohCheckSafeModes_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3ohSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write trong DEV script phải DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3ohControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write đang ENABLED.'
    );
  }

  if (controlledWrite.available === false) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy Controlled Write status function. Bỏ qua check này trong DEV.'
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    summary: {
      safeWriteMode: safeWrite.mode || '',
      safeWriteEnabled: safeWrite.enabled,
      controlledWriteAvailable: controlledWrite.available,
      controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite.status || ''
    }
  };
}


/**
 * Safe assert.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ohSafeAssert_(functionName, label) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' +
          functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output &&
        output.success === true,
      label: label,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe call.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ohSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        available: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        summary: {
          status: '',
          error: 'Missing function'
        }
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success: true,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      summary:
        kidlearnV3_3ohSummarizeStatusOutput_(
          output
        )
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      summary: {
        status: '',
        error: String(error.message || error)
      }
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Summarize status output.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ohSummarizeStatusOutput_(output) {
  if (!output || typeof output !== 'object') {
    return {
      rawType: typeof output
    };
  }

  return {
    success: output.success,
    action: output.action || '',
    bundle: output.bundle || '',
    phase: output.phase || '',
    status: output.status || '',
    nextBundle: output.nextBundle || '',
    nextStage: output.nextStage || '',
    prodFileId: output.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: output.prodFileUrl || '',
    dryRunId: output.dryRunId || '',
    executionGateId: output.executionGateId || '',
    planId: output.planId || '',
    approvalGateId: output.approvalGateId || '',
    workflowId: output.workflowId || '',
    finalLockId: output.finalLockId || '',
    errorCount: output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount: output.warningCount || 0
  };
}


/**
 * Safe Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ohSafeWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Controlled Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ohControlledWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      var result =
        kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

      result.available = true;

      return result;
    }

    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        'Missing kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ohCheckFunctions_(names) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          names[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: names[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        names[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Decision gate ID.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ohMakeDecisionGateId_() {
  return (
    'PROD_CR_DECISION_GATE_3OH_' +
    Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    )
  );
}


/**
 * Save package.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ohSavePackage_(decisionPackage) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DECISION_3OH_KEYS.DECISION_GATE_ID,
    decisionPackage.decisionGateId || ''
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DECISION_3OH_KEYS.LAST_PACKAGE_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(decisionPackage)
  );
}


/**
 * Save result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ohSaveResult_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var currentStatus =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DECISION_3OH_KEYS.STATUS
    ) || '';

  var finalStatus =
    status;

  if (
    currentStatus ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DECISION_3OH_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_I &&
    (
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DECISION_3OH_STATUS.PREVIEWED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DECISION_3OH_STATUS.PACKAGE_GENERATED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DECISION_3OH_STATUS.DECISION_GATE_RECORDED
    )
  ) {
    finalStatus =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DECISION_3OH_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_I;
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DECISION_3OH_KEYS.STATUS,
    finalStatus
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DECISION_3OH_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      bundle: result.bundle,
      phase: result.phase,
      status: finalStatus,
      originalRequestedStatus: status,
      decisionGateId: result.decisionGateId || '',
      prodFileId: result.prodFileId || '',
      prodFileUrl: result.prodFileUrl || '',
      decisionResult: result.decisionResult || '',
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      prodDeployNow: false,
      changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
      prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
      rollbackExecutedNow: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


/**
 * Read JSON property.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ohReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Normalize options.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ohNormalizeOptions_(options) {
  if (!options) return {};

  if (typeof options !== 'object') {
    return {
      value: options
    };
  }

  return options;
}

  ) {

    );

    kidlearnV3_3ogSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReleaseFinalLock3NJStatusV3'
    );

  if (
    finalLock.summary.status &&
    finalLock.summary.status !== 'PROD_RELEASE_LOCKED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3N-J chưa PROD_RELEASE_LOCKED. Status=' +

  warnings = warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  var result = {

    bundle: '3O-G',

/**
 * Run execution dry-run rehearsal.
 *
 * Chỉ simulation:
 * - Không ghi PROD.
 * - Không execute request.
 * - Không mở PROD write.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runProdChangeRequestExecutionDryRunRehearsal3OGV3() {
  var startedAt = new Date();
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestExecutionDryRun3OGStatusV3();

  if (
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.PACKAGE_GENERATED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.REHEARSAL_PASSED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_H
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-G cần PACKAGE_GENERATED trước khi chạy rehearsal. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastPackage ||
    status.lastPackage.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last dry-run package chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3ogGetProdInfo_();

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3ogCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file không accessible khi rehearsal: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var prodSpreadsheet = null;

  if (prodInfo.prodFileId) {
    prodSpreadsheet =
      SpreadsheetApp.openById(
        prodInfo.prodFileId
      );
  }

  var beforeSnapshot =
    prodSpreadsheet
      ? kidlearnV3_3ogSnapshotRowCounts_(
          prodSpreadsheet,
          KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_CONFIG.TARGET_NO_WRITE_SHEETS
        )
      : {
          items: []
        };

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3ogCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  var scenarios =
    kidlearnV3_3ogBuildDryRunScenarios_();

  var rehearsalItems = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < scenarios.items.length; i++) {
    var item =
      kidlearnV3_3ogRehearseScenario_(
        scenarios.items[i]
      );

    rehearsalItems.push(item);

    errors =
      errors.concat(
        item.errors || []
      );

    warnings =
      warnings.concat(
        item.warnings || []
      );
  }

  var policyCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3ogValidateDryRunPolicy_(
      rehearsalItems
    );

  errors = errors.concat(policyCheck.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(policyCheck.warnings);

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  var afterSnapshot =
    prodSpreadsheet
      ? kidlearnV3_3ogSnapshotRowCounts_(
          prodSpreadsheet,
          KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_CONFIG.TARGET_NO_WRITE_SHEETS
        )
      : {
          items: []
        };

  var noWriteCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3ogCompareRowCountSnapshots_(
      beforeSnapshot,
      afterSnapshot
    );

  errors = errors.concat(noWriteCheck.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(noWriteCheck.warnings);

  var finishedAt = new Date();

  var rehearsal = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'RUN_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_EXECUTION_DRY_RUN_REHEARSAL_3OG_V3',
    bundle: '3O-G',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.REHEARSAL_PASSED
        : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.FAILED,
    dryRunId: status.dryRunId || '',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
    dryRunOnly: true,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
    prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
    rollbackExecutedNow: false,

    rehearsalSummary: {
      scenarioCount: scenarios.scenarioCount,
      rehearsedCount: rehearsalItems.length,
      policyCheck: policyCheck.summary,
      noWriteCheck: noWriteCheck.summary,
      safeModes: safeModes.summary
    },

    rehearsalItems: rehearsalItems,

    rehearsalDecision:
      errors.length === 0
        ? 'READY_FOR_EXECUTION_DECISION_GATE_3O_H'
        : 'HOLD_DRY_RUN_REHEARSAL_FAILED',

    noSideEffect: {
      prodFileModifiedBy3OG: false,
      prodDataWrittenBy3OG: false,
      prodSheetCreatedBy3OG: false,
      prodSheetDeletedBy3OG: false,
      requestExecutedBy3OG: false,
      prodWritePolicyOpenedBy3OG: false,
      rollbackExecutedBy3OG: false
    },

    startedAt: startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt: finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() - startedAt.getTime(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_3ogSaveRehearsal_(
    rehearsal
  );

  kidlearnV3_3ogSaveResult_(
    rehearsal,
    rehearsal.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.REHEARSAL_PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_KEYS.LAST_REHEARSAL_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(rehearsal, null, 2));

  if (!rehearsal.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3O-G dry-run rehearsal failed. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return rehearsal;
}


/**
 * Mark 3O-G ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markProdChangeRequestExecutionDryRun3OGReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestExecutionDryRun3OGStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.REHEARSAL_PASSED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_H
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-G chưa REHEARSAL_PASSED. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastPackage ||
    status.lastPackage.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last dry-run package chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastRehearsal ||
    status.lastRehearsal.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last rehearsal chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  if (!status.dryRunId) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu dryRunId.'
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3ogGetProdInfo_();

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3ogCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file không accessible khi mark ready: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3ogCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark 3O-G ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_EXECUTION_DRY_RUN_3OG_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3O-G',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_H,
    dryRunId: status.dryRunId || '',
    prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    dryRunOnly: true,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
    prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
    rollbackExecutedNow: false,
    message:
      '3O-G ready. Execution dry-run rehearsal đã pass. Bước tiếp theo là 3O-H execution decision gate.',
    markedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_3ogSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_H,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  return result;
}

/**
 * Assert 3O-G ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertProdChangeRequestExecutionDryRun3OGReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestExecutionDryRun3OGStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_H
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-G chưa READY_FOR_3O_H. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (!status.dryRunId) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu dryRunId.'
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3ogGetProdInfo_();

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileId.');
  }

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileUrl) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileUrl.');
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_EXECUTION_DRY_RUN_3OG_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3O-G',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status: status.status,
    dryRunId: status.dryRunId || '',
    prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3O-G chưa ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Rehearse one scenario.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogRehearseScenario_(scenario) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  if (!scenario.scenarioId) {
    errors.push('Scenario thiếu scenarioId.');
  }

  if (!scenario.requestType) {
    errors.push('Scenario thiếu requestType.');
  }

  if (!scenario.executionMode) {
    errors.push(
      'Scenario thiếu executionMode: ' +
      scenario.scenarioId
    );
  }

  if (scenario.allowActualExecutionNow === true) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-G không được allowActualExecutionNow=true: ' +
      scenario.scenarioId
    );
  }

  if (scenario.allowProdWriteNow === true) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-G không được allowProdWriteNow=true: ' +
      scenario.scenarioId
    );
  }

  if (scenario.allowRollbackNow === true) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-G không được allowRollbackNow=true: ' +
      scenario.scenarioId
    );
  }

  if (
    !scenario.requiredBeforeActual ||
    !Array.isArray(scenario.requiredBeforeActual) ||
    scenario.requiredBeforeActual.length < 1
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Scenario thiếu requiredBeforeActual: ' +
      scenario.scenarioId
    );
  }

  if (
    scenario.riskLevel === 'HIGH' &&
    scenario.requiredBeforeActual.length < 4
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'High-risk scenario cần requiredBeforeActual chi tiết hơn: ' +
      scenario.scenarioId
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    scenarioId: scenario.scenarioId || '',
    requestType: scenario.requestType || '',
    riskLevel: scenario.riskLevel || '',
    executionMode: scenario.executionMode || '',
    dryRunOnly: true,
    prodWriteRequiredForActual:
      scenario.prodWriteRequiredForActual === true,
    allowActualExecutionNow:
      scenario.allowActualExecutionNow === true,
    allowProdWriteNow:
      scenario.allowProdWriteNow === true,
    allowRollbackNow:
      scenario.allowRollbackNow === true,
    rehearsalDecision:
      errors.length === 0
        ? 'DRY_RUN_REHEARSAL_ACCEPTED'
        : 'DRY_RUN_REHEARSAL_REJECTED',
    nextRequiredBeforeActual:
      scenario.requiredBeforeActual || [],
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Validate dry-run policy.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogValidateDryRunPolicy_(items) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var item =
      items[i];

    if (item.dryRunOnly !== true) {
      errors.push(
        'Policy violation: dryRunOnly phải true. Scenario=' +
        item.scenarioId
      );
    }

    if (item.allowActualExecutionNow === true) {
      errors.push(
        'Policy violation: scenario đang cho execute thật. Scenario=' +
        item.scenarioId
      );
    }

    if (item.allowProdWriteNow === true) {
      errors.push(
        'Policy violation: scenario đang cho mở PROD write. Scenario=' +
        item.scenarioId
      );
    }

    if (item.allowRollbackNow === true) {
      errors.push(
        'Policy violation: scenario đang cho rollback. Scenario=' +
        item.scenarioId
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    summary: {
      checkedScenarioCount: items.length,
      dryRunOnlyCount:
        items.filter(function(item) {
          return item.dryRunOnly === true;
        }).length,
      actualExecutionAllowedCount:
        items.filter(function(item) {
          return item.allowActualExecutionNow === true;
        }).length,
      prodWriteAllowedCount:
        items.filter(function(item) {
          return item.allowProdWriteNow === true;
        }).length,
      rollbackAllowedCount:
        items.filter(function(item) {
          return item.allowRollbackNow === true;
        }).length
    }
  };
}


/**
 * Snapshot row counts.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogSnapshotRowCounts_(spreadsheet, sheetNames) {
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < sheetNames.length; i++) {
    var sheetName =
      sheetNames[i];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_3ogGetSheet_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetName
      );

    items.push({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      exists: sheet ? true : false,
      lastRow: sheet ? sheet.getLastRow() : 0,
      lastColumn: sheet ? sheet.getLastColumn() : 0
    });
  }

  return {
    capturedAt:
      new Date().toISOString(),
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Compare row count snapshots.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogCompareRowCountSnapshots_(beforeSnapshot, afterSnapshot) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var beforeMap =
    kidlearnV3_3ogMapSnapshots_(
      beforeSnapshot.items || []
    );

  var afterMap =
    kidlearnV3_3ogMapSnapshots_(
      afterSnapshot.items || []
    );

  var compared = [];

  for (var sheetName in beforeMap) {
    if (!beforeMap.hasOwnProperty(sheetName)) {
      continue;
    }

    var before =
      beforeMap[sheetName];

    var after =
      afterMap[sheetName] || {
        exists: false,
        lastRow: 0,
        lastColumn: 0
      };

    var changed =
      before.exists !== after.exists ||
      before.lastRow !== after.lastRow ||
      before.lastColumn !== after.lastColumn;

    compared.push({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      beforeLastRow: before.lastRow,
      afterLastRow: after.lastRow,
      beforeLastColumn: before.lastColumn,
      afterLastColumn: after.lastColumn,
      changed: changed
    });

    if (changed) {
      errors.push(
        'PROD sheet thay đổi trong 3O-G dry-run rehearsal: ' +
        sheetName +
        '. beforeRow=' +
        before.lastRow +
        ', afterRow=' +
        after.lastRow +
        ', beforeCol=' +
        before.lastColumn +
        ', afterCol=' +
        after.lastColumn
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    compared: compared,
    summary: {
      checkedSheetCount: compared.length,
      changedSheetCount:
        compared.filter(function(item) {
          return item.changed;
        }).length,
      readOnlyConfirmed:
        errors.length === 0
    }
  };
}


/**
 * Map snapshots.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogMapSnapshots_(items) {
  var map = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    map[items[i].sheetName] = items[i];
  }

  return map;
}


/**
 * PROD info từ 3N-F.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogGetProdInfo_() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getControlledProdDeployment3NFStatusV3();

  return {
    status: status.status || '',
    deploymentId: status.deploymentId || '',
    prodFileId: status.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: status.prodFileUrl || '',
    prodFileName: status.prodFileName || ''
  };
}


/**
 * Check file accessible.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogCheckFileAccessible_(fileId, label) {
  try {
    if (!fileId) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label || '',
        fileId: '',
        message: 'Thiếu fileId.'
      };
    }

    var file =
      DriveApp.getFileById(fileId);

    return {
      success: true,
      label: label || '',
      fileId: fileId,
      fileName: file.getName(),
      fileUrl: file.getUrl(),
      message: 'File accessible.'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label || '',
      fileId: fileId || '',
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check safe modes.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogCheckSafeModes_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3ogSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write trong DEV script phải DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3ogControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write đang ENABLED.'
    );
  }

  if (controlledWrite.available === false) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy Controlled Write status function. Bỏ qua check này trong DEV.'
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    summary: {
      safeWriteMode: safeWrite.mode || '',
      safeWriteEnabled: safeWrite.enabled,
      controlledWriteAvailable: controlledWrite.available,
      controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite.status || ''
    }
  };
}


/**
 * Get exact sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogGetSheet_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Safe assert.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogSafeAssert_(functionName, label) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' +
          functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output &&
        output.success === true,
      label: label,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe call.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        available: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        summary: {
          status: '',
          error: 'Missing function'
        }
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success: true,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      summary:
        kidlearnV3_3ogSummarizeStatusOutput_(
          output
        )
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      summary: {
        status: '',
        error: String(error.message || error)
      }
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Summarize status output.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogSummarizeStatusOutput_(output) {
  if (!output || typeof output !== 'object') {
    return {
      rawType: typeof output
    };
  }

  return {
    success: output.success,
    action: output.action || '',
    bundle: output.bundle || '',
    phase: output.phase || '',
    status: output.status || '',
    nextBundle: output.nextBundle || '',
    nextStage: output.nextStage || '',
    prodFileId: output.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: output.prodFileUrl || '',
    executionGateId: output.executionGateId || '',
    planId: output.planId || '',
    approvalGateId: output.approvalGateId || '',
    workflowId: output.workflowId || '',
    finalLockId: output.finalLockId || '',
    errorCount: output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount: output.warningCount || 0
  };
}


/**
 * Safe Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogSafeWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Controlled Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogControlledWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      var result =
        kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

      result.available = true;

      return result;
    }

    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        'Missing kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogCheckFunctions_(names) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          names[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: names[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        names[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Dry-run ID.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogMakeDryRunId_() {
  return (
    'PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_' +
    Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    )
  );
}


/**
 * Save package.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogSavePackage_(dryRunPackage) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_KEYS.DRYRUN_ID,
    dryRunPackage.dryRunId || ''
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_KEYS.LAST_PACKAGE_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(dryRunPackage)
  );
}


/**
 * Save rehearsal.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogSaveRehearsal_(rehearsal) {
  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_KEYS.LAST_REHEARSAL_JSON,
      JSON.stringify(rehearsal)
    );
}


/**
 * Save result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogSaveResult_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var currentStatus =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_KEYS.STATUS
    ) || '';

  var finalStatus =
    status;

  if (
    currentStatus ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_H &&
    (
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.PREVIEWED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.PACKAGE_GENERATED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.REHEARSAL_PASSED
    )
  ) {
    finalStatus =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_H;
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_KEYS.STATUS,
    finalStatus
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_DRYRUN_3OG_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      bundle: result.bundle,
      phase: result.phase,
      status: finalStatus,
      originalRequestedStatus: status,
      dryRunId: result.dryRunId || '',
      prodFileId: result.prodFileId || '',
      prodFileUrl: result.prodFileUrl || '',
      dryRunOnly: true,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      prodDeployNow: false,
      changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
      prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
      rollbackExecutedNow: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


/**
 * Read JSON property.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ogReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

  ) {

  var result = {

    bundle: '3O-E',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_CONFIG.PHASE,

/**
 * Run planning simulation.
 *
 * Simulation only:
 * - Không execute request.
 * - Không ghi PROD.
 * - Không mở PROD write.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runProdChangeRequestImplementationPlanningSimulation3OEV3() {
  var startedAt = new Date();
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestImplementationPlanning3OEStatusV3();

  if (
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.PLAN_GENERATED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.SIMULATION_PASSED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_F
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-E cần PLAN_GENERATED trước khi chạy simulation. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastPlan ||
    status.lastPlan.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last implementation plan chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3oeCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  var samplePlans =
    kidlearnV3_3oeBuildSampleImplementationPlans_();

  var reviewedPlans = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < samplePlans.length; i++) {
    var review =
      kidlearnV3_3oeReviewSampleImplementationPlan_(
        samplePlans[i]
      );

    reviewedPlans.push(review);

    errors =
      errors.concat(
        review.errors || []
      );

    warnings =
      warnings.concat(
        review.warnings || []
      );
  }

  var policyCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3oeValidatePlanningPolicy_(
      reviewedPlans
    );

  errors = errors.concat(policyCheck.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(policyCheck.warnings);

  var finishedAt = new Date();

  var simulation = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'RUN_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_IMPLEMENTATION_PLANNING_SIMULATION_3OE_V3',
    bundle: '3O-E',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.SIMULATION_PASSED
        : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.FAILED,
    planId: status.planId || '',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    planningOnly: true,
    changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
    prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
    rollbackExecutedNow: false,
    samplePlanCount: samplePlans.length,
    reviewedPlanCount: reviewedPlans.length,
    reviewedPlans: reviewedPlans,
    policyCheck: policyCheck.summary,
    safeModes: safeModes.summary,
    simulationDecision:
      errors.length === 0
        ? 'READY_FOR_CONTROLLED_EXECUTION_GATE_3O_F'
        : 'HOLD_PLANNING_SIMULATION_FAILED',
    noSideEffect: {
      prodFileModifiedBy3OE: false,
      prodDataWrittenBy3OE: false,
      prodSheetCreatedBy3OE: false,
      prodSheetDeletedBy3OE: false,
      requestExecutedBy3OE: false,
      prodWritePolicyOpenedBy3OE: false,
      rollbackExecutedBy3OE: false
    },
    startedAt: startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt: finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() - startedAt.getTime(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_3oeSaveSimulation_(
    simulation
  );

  kidlearnV3_3oeSaveResult_(
    simulation,
    simulation.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.SIMULATION_PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_KEYS.LAST_SIMULATION_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(simulation, null, 2));

  if (!simulation.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3O-E planning simulation failed. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return simulation;
}


/**
 * Mark 3O-E ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markProdChangeRequestImplementationPlanning3OEReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestImplementationPlanning3OEStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.SIMULATION_PASSED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_F
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-E chưa SIMULATION_PASSED. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastPlan ||
    status.lastPlan.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last plan chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastSimulation ||
    status.lastSimulation.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last simulation chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  if (!status.planId) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu planId.'
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3oeGetProdInfo_();

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3oeCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file không accessible khi mark ready: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3oeCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark 3O-E ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_IMPLEMENTATION_PLANNING_3OE_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3O-E',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_F,
    planId: status.planId || '',
    prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    planningOnly: true,
    changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
    message:
      '3O-E ready. Implementation planning đã pass simulation. Bước tiếp theo là 3O-F controlled execution gate.',
    markedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_3oeSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_F,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  return result;
}

  var status =

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_F
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-E chưa READY_FOR_3O_F. Status=' +

    );
  }

  if (!status.planId) {
    errors.push(

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileId.');
  }

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileUrl) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileUrl.');
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_IMPLEMENTATION_PLANNING_3OE_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3O-E',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status: status.status,
    planId: status.planId || '',
    prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',

      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,

  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {

      errors.length +

    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Build sample implementation plans.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeBuildSampleImplementationPlans_() {
  var templates =
    kidlearnV3_3oeBuildImplementationTemplates_().templates;

  var samplePlans = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < templates.length; i++) {
    var template =
      templates[i];

    samplePlans.push({
      requestId:
        'SAMPLE_IMPL_3OE_' +
        template.requestType,
      requestType:
        template.requestType,
      implementationMode:
        template.implementationMode,
      impactedSheets:
        template.impactedSheets,
      riskLevel:
        template.riskLevel,
      prodWriteRequired:
        template.prodWriteRequired,
      executionGateRequired:
        template.executionGateRequired,
      recommendedNextPhase:
        template.recommendedNextPhase,
      approvalOwner:
        template.riskLevel === 'HIGH'
          ? 'RELEASE_OWNER'
          : 'FAMILY_ADMIN_OWNER',
      testPlan:
        template.testPlan,
      rollbackPlan:
        template.rollbackPlan,
      executeNow:
        false,
      approveNow:
        false,
      openProdWriteNow:
        false
    });
  }

  return samplePlans;
}


/**
 * Review sample implementation plan.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeReviewSampleImplementationPlan_(plan) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFields = [
    'requestId',
    'requestType',
    'implementationMode',
    'riskLevel',
    'approvalOwner',
    'recommendedNextPhase'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < requiredFields.length; i++) {
    var field =
      requiredFields[i];

    if (!String(plan[field] || '').trim()) {
      errors.push(
        'Plan ' +
        plan.requestId +
        ' thiếu field: ' +
        field
      );
    }
  }

  if (
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_CONFIG.REQUEST_TYPES
      .indexOf(plan.requestType) < 0
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Plan có requestType không hợp lệ: ' +
      plan.requestType
    );
  }

  if (
    !plan.testPlan ||
    !Array.isArray(plan.testPlan) ||
    plan.testPlan.length < 1
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Plan thiếu testPlan: ' +
      plan.requestId
    );
  }

  if (
    !plan.rollbackPlan ||
    !Array.isArray(plan.rollbackPlan) ||
    plan.rollbackPlan.length < 1
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Plan thiếu rollbackPlan: ' +
      plan.requestId
    );
  }

  if (plan.executeNow === true) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-E không được execute plan: ' +
      plan.requestId
    );
  }

  if (plan.approveNow === true) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-E không được approve request cụ thể: ' +
      plan.requestId
    );
  }

  if (plan.openProdWriteNow === true) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-E không được mở PROD write: ' +
      plan.requestId
    );
  }

  if (
    plan.riskLevel === 'HIGH' &&
    plan.executionGateRequired !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'High-risk plan phải executionGateRequired=true: ' +
      plan.requestId
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    requestId: plan.requestId || '',
    requestType: plan.requestType || '',
    implementationMode: plan.implementationMode || '',
    riskLevel: plan.riskLevel || '',
    prodWriteRequired: plan.prodWriteRequired === true,
    executionGateRequired: plan.executionGateRequired === true,
    recommendedNextPhase: plan.recommendedNextPhase || '',
    approvalOwner: plan.approvalOwner || '',
    executeNow: plan.executeNow === true,
    approveNow: plan.approveNow === true,
    openProdWriteNow: plan.openProdWriteNow === true,
    planningDecision:
      errors.length === 0
        ? 'PLAN_ACCEPTED_FOR_NEXT_GATE_ONLY'
        : 'PLAN_REJECTED_IN_SIMULATION',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Validate planning policy.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeValidatePlanningPolicy_(reviewedPlans) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < reviewedPlans.length; i++) {
    var item =
      reviewedPlans[i];

    if (item.executeNow === true) {
      errors.push(
        'Planning policy violation: executeNow=true for ' +
        item.requestId
      );
    }

    if (item.approveNow === true) {
      errors.push(
        'Planning policy violation: approveNow=true for ' +
        item.requestId
      );
    }

    if (item.openProdWriteNow === true) {
      errors.push(
        'Planning policy violation: openProdWriteNow=true for ' +
        item.requestId
      );
    }

    if (
      item.riskLevel === 'HIGH' &&
      item.executionGateRequired !== true
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'High-risk request missing execution gate: ' +
        item.requestId
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    summary: {
      reviewedPlanCount: reviewedPlans.length,
      highRiskPlanCount:
        reviewedPlans.filter(function(item) {
          return item.riskLevel === 'HIGH';
        }).length,
      prodWriteRequiredCount:
        reviewedPlans.filter(function(item) {
          return item.prodWriteRequired === true;
        }).length,
      executeNowCount:
        reviewedPlans.filter(function(item) {
          return item.executeNow === true;
        }).length,
      approveNowCount:
        reviewedPlans.filter(function(item) {
          return item.approveNow === true;
        }).length,
      openProdWriteNowCount:
        reviewedPlans.filter(function(item) {
          return item.openProdWriteNow === true;
        }).length
    }
  };
}

 * PROD info từ 3N-F.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeGetProdInfo_() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getControlledProdDeployment3NFStatusV3();

  return {
    status: status.status || '',
    deploymentId: status.deploymentId || '',
    prodFileId: status.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: status.prodFileUrl || '',
    prodFileName: status.prodFileName || ''
  };
}


/**
 * Check file accessible.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeCheckFileAccessible_(fileId, label) {
  try {
    if (!fileId) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label || '',
        fileId: '',
        message: 'Thiếu fileId.'
      };
    }

    var file =
      DriveApp.getFileById(fileId);

    return {
      success: true,
      label: label || '',
      fileId: fileId,
      fileName: file.getName(),
      fileUrl: file.getUrl(),
      message: 'File accessible.'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label || '',
      fileId: fileId || '',
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check safe modes.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeCheckSafeModes_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3oeSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write trong DEV script phải DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3oeControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write đang ENABLED.'
    );
  }

  if (controlledWrite.available === false) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy Controlled Write status function. Bỏ qua check này trong DEV.'
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    summary: {
      safeWriteMode: safeWrite.mode || '',
      safeWriteEnabled: safeWrite.enabled,
      controlledWriteAvailable: controlledWrite.available,
      controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite.status || ''
    }
  };
}


/**
 * Safe assert.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeSafeAssert_(functionName, label) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' +
          functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output &&
        output.success === true,
      label: label,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe call.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        available: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        summary: {
          status: '',
          error: 'Missing function'
        }
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success: true,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      summary:
        kidlearnV3_3oeSummarizeStatusOutput_(
          output
        )
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      summary: {
        status: '',
        error: String(error.message || error)
      }
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Summarize status output.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeSummarizeStatusOutput_(output) {
  if (!output || typeof output !== 'object') {
    return {
      rawType: typeof output
    };
  }

  return {
    success: output.success,
    action: output.action || '',
    bundle: output.bundle || '',
    phase: output.phase || '',
    status: output.status || '',
    nextBundle: output.nextBundle || '',
    nextStage: output.nextStage || '',
    prodFileId: output.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: output.prodFileUrl || '',
    approvalGateId: output.approvalGateId || '',
    workflowId: output.workflowId || '',
    supportPackageId: output.supportPackageId || '',
    changeGateId: output.changeGateId || '',
    changeGateStatus: output.changeGateStatus || '',
    finalLockId: output.finalLockId || '',
    errorCount: output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount: output.warningCount || 0
  };
}


/**
 * Safe Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeSafeWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Controlled Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeControlledWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      var result =
        kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

      result.available = true;

      return result;
    }

    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        'Missing kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeCheckFunctions_(names) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          names[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: names[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        names[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Plan ID.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeMakePlanId_() {
  return (
    'PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_' +
    Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
    )
  );
}


/**
 * Save plan.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeSavePlan_(planPackage) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_KEYS.PLAN_ID,
    planPackage.planId || ''
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_KEYS.LAST_PLAN_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(planPackage)
  );
}


/**
 * Save simulation.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeSaveSimulation_(simulation) {
  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_KEYS.LAST_SIMULATION_JSON,
      JSON.stringify(simulation)
    );
}


/**
 * Save result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeSaveResult_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var currentStatus =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_KEYS.STATUS
    ) || '';

  var finalStatus =
    status;

  if (
    currentStatus ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_F &&
    (
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.PREVIEWED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.PLAN_GENERATED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.SIMULATION_PASSED
    )
  ) {
    finalStatus =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_F;
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_KEYS.STATUS,
    finalStatus
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_PLAN_3OE_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      bundle: result.bundle,
      phase: result.phase,
      status: finalStatus,
      originalRequestedStatus: status,
      planId: result.planId || '',
      prodFileId: result.prodFileId || '',
      prodFileUrl: result.prodFileUrl || '',
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      prodDeployNow: false,
      planningOnly: true,
      changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
      prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
      rollbackExecutedNow: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


/**
 * Read JSON property.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3oeReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Preview 3O-C.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewProdChangeRequestWorkflow3OCV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions =
    kidlearnV3_3ocCheckFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_assertProdReadonlySupportChangeGate3OBReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReadonlySupportChangeGate3OBStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReleaseFinalLock3NJStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getControlledProdDeployment3NFStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_runQaBatchProvidedStepsV3'
    ]);

  errors = errors.concat(requiredFunctions.errors);

  var phase3OB =
    kidlearnV3_3ocSafeAssert_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertProdReadonlySupportChangeGate3OBReadyV3',
      '3O-B'
    );

  if (!phase3OB.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-B chưa READY_FOR_3O_C: ' +
      phase3OB.message
    );
  }

  var supportGate =
    kidlearnV3_3ocSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReadonlySupportChangeGate3OBStatusV3'
    );

  if (
    supportGate.summary.changeGateStatus &&
    supportGate.summary.changeGateStatus !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_CONFIG.REQUIRED_3OB_CHANGE_GATE_STATUS
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Change gate từ 3O-B phải CLOSED trước khi thiết kế 3O-C. Current=' +
      supportGate.summary.changeGateStatus
    );
  }

  var finalLock =
    kidlearnV3_3ocSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReleaseFinalLock3NJStatusV3'
    );

  if (
    finalLock.summary.status &&
    finalLock.summary.status !== 'PROD_RELEASE_LOCKED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3N-J chưa PROD_RELEASE_LOCKED. Status=' +
      finalLock.summary.status
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3ocGetProdInfo_();

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileId từ 3N-F.');
  }

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileUrl) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileUrl từ 3N-F.');
  }

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3ocCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file chưa accessible: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3ocCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_3OC_V3',
    bundle: '3O-C',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    writeMode: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_CONFIG.WRITE_MODE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    approvalGrantedNow: false,
    changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3OB: phase3OB,
    supportGate: supportGate.summary,
    finalLock: finalLock.summary,
    prodInfo: prodInfo,
    prodCheck: prodCheck,
    safeModes: safeModes,
    requiredFunctions: requiredFunctions.items,
    note:
      '3O-C chỉ thiết kế workflow review change request. Không approve và không ghi PROD.'
  };

  kidlearnV3_3ocSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.PREVIEWED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  return result;
}


/**

function kidlearnV3_generateProdChangeRequestWorkflow3OCV3() {

      preview.errorCount +
      '. ' +
      preview.errors.join(' | ')
    );

    kidlearnV3_3ocMakeWorkflowId_();

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3ocGetProdInfo_();

  var supportGate =
    kidlearnV3_3ocSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReadonlySupportChangeGate3OBStatusV3'
    );

    kidlearnV3_3ocSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReleaseHandover3NIStatusV3'
    );

    kidlearnV3_3ocSafeCall_(

    );

    kidlearnV3_3ocSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReleaseFinalLock3NJStatusV3'
    );

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3ocCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  var workflow =
    kidlearnV3_3ocBuildWorkflowDefinition_();

  var finishedAt = new Date();

  var workflowPackage = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'GENERATE_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_3OC_V3',
    bundle: '3O-C',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.WORKFLOW_GENERATED
        : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.FAILED,
    workflowId: workflowId,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,

    approvalGrantedNow: false,
    changeRequestExecutedNow: false,

    prodReference: {

      prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
      prodFileName: prodInfo.prodFileName || '',
      deploymentId: prodInfo.deploymentId || ''
    },

    upstreamReadiness: {
      supportGate3OB: supportGate.summary,
      monitoring3OA: monitoring.summary,
      handover3NI: handover.summary,
      finalLock3NJ: finalLock.summary
    },

    workflowDefinition: workflow,

    reviewPrinciples: [
      'Mọi change request chỉ được review, không tự động thực thi.',
      'Mọi thay đổi PROD cần approval gate riêng.',
      'Request liên quan PROD write policy luôn phải qua phase riêng.',
      'Request liên quan content/data cần đánh giá risk và rollback trước.',
      'Không sửa trực tiếp PROD file trong lúc review.'
    ],

    noSideEffect: {
      prodFileModifiedBy3OC: false,
      prodDataWrittenBy3OC: false,
      prodSheetCreatedBy3OC: false,
      prodSheetDeletedBy3OC: false,
      prodWritePolicyOpenedBy3OC: false
    },

    safeModes: safeModes.summary,

    startedAt: startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt: finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() - startedAt.getTime(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_3ocSaveWorkflow_(
    workflowPackage
  );

  kidlearnV3_3ocSaveResult_(
    workflowPackage,
    workflowPackage.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.WORKFLOW_GENERATED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_KEYS.LAST_WORKFLOW_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(workflowPackage, null, 2));

  if (!workflowPackage.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3O-C workflow package failed. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return workflowPackage;
}


/**
 * Run review workflow simulation.
 *
 * Simulation only:
 * - Không tạo request thật.
 * - Không approve.
 * - Không ghi PROD.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runProdChangeRequestWorkflowSimulation3OCV3() {
  var startedAt = new Date();
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestWorkflow3OCStatusV3();

  if (
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.WORKFLOW_GENERATED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.SIMULATION_PASSED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_D
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-C cần WORKFLOW_GENERATED trước khi chạy simulation. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastWorkflow ||
    status.lastWorkflow.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last workflow chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3ocCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  var sampleRequests =
    kidlearnV3_3ocBuildSampleChangeRequests_();

  var reviewed = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < sampleRequests.length; i++) {
    var review =
      kidlearnV3_3ocReviewSampleRequest_(
        sampleRequests[i]
      );

    reviewed.push(review);

    if (!review.success) {
      errors =
        errors.concat(
          review.errors || []
        );
    }

    warnings =
      warnings.concat(
        review.warnings || []
      );
  }

  var routeCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3ocValidateReviewRoutes_(
      reviewed
    );

  errors = errors.concat(routeCheck.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(routeCheck.warnings);

  var finishedAt = new Date();

  var simulation = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'RUN_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_SIMULATION_3OC_V3',
    bundle: '3O-C',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.SIMULATION_PASSED
        : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.FAILED,
    workflowId: status.workflowId || '',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    approvalGrantedNow: false,
    changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
    sampleRequestCount: sampleRequests.length,
    reviewedRequestCount: reviewed.length,
    routeCheck: routeCheck.summary,
    reviewedRequests: reviewed,
    safeModes: safeModes.summary,
    simulationDecision:
      errors.length === 0
        ? 'READY_FOR_CHANGE_REQUEST_APPROVAL_GATE_3O_D'
        : 'HOLD_WORKFLOW_SIMULATION_FAILED',
    noSideEffect: {
      prodFileModifiedBy3OC: false,
      prodDataWrittenBy3OC: false,
      prodSheetCreatedBy3OC: false,
      prodSheetDeletedBy3OC: false,
      requestApprovedBy3OC: false,
      requestExecutedBy3OC: false
    },
    startedAt: startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt: finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() - startedAt.getTime(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_3ocSaveSimulation_(
    simulation
  );

  kidlearnV3_3ocSaveResult_(
    simulation,
    simulation.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.SIMULATION_PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_KEYS.LAST_SIMULATION_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(simulation, null, 2));

  if (!simulation.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3O-C workflow simulation failed. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return simulation;
}


/**
 * Mark 3O-C ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markProdChangeRequestWorkflow3OCReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestWorkflow3OCStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.SIMULATION_PASSED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_D
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-C chưa SIMULATION_PASSED. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastWorkflow ||
    status.lastWorkflow.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last workflow chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastSimulation ||
    status.lastSimulation.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last simulation chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3ocGetProdInfo_();

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3ocCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file không còn accessible: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3ocCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark 3O-C ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_3OC_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3O-C',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_CONFIG.PHASE,

    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    approvalGrantedNow: false,
    message:
      '3O-C ready. Change request review workflow đã pass simulation. Bước tiếp theo là 3O-D approval gate.',
    markedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_3ocSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_D,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  return result;
}

/**
 * Assert 3O-C ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertProdChangeRequestWorkflow3OCReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestWorkflow3OCStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_D
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-C chưa READY_FOR_3O_D. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (!status.workflowId) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu workflowId.'
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3ocGetProdInfo_();

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileId.');
  }

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileUrl) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileUrl.');
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_PROD_CHANGE_REQUEST_WORKFLOW_3OC_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3O-C',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status: status.status,
    workflowId: status.workflowId || '',
    prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3O-C chưa ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Review sample request.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ocReviewSampleRequest_(request) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFields =
    kidlearnV3_3ocBuildWorkflowDefinition_().requiredFields;

  for (var i = 0; i < requiredFields.length; i++) {
    var key =
      requiredFields[i];

    if (!String(request[key] || '').trim()) {
      errors.push(
        'Request ' +
        request.requestId +
        ' thiếu field: ' +
        key
      );
    }
  }

  var requestType =
    String(request.requestType || '').trim();

  var supported =
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_CR_WORKFLOW_3OC_CONFIG.SAMPLE_REQUEST_TYPES
      .indexOf(requestType) >= 0;

  if (!supported) {
    errors.push(
      'Request type không hợp lệ: ' +
      requestType
    );
  }

  var highRisk =
    requestType === 'PROD_WRITE_POLICY_REQUEST' ||
    requestType === 'NEW_RELEASE_REQUEST';

  var routedStatus =
    highRisk
      ? 'APPROVAL_REQUIRED'
      : 'REVIEW_REQUIRED';

  var nextPhase =
    highRisk
      ? '3O-D_APPROVAL_GATE_REQUIRED'
      : '3O-D_OR_LATER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED';

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    requestId: request.requestId || '',
    requestType: requestType,
    riskLevel: request.riskLevel || '',
    highRisk: highRisk,
    supported: supported,
    routedStatus: routedStatus,
    nextPhase: nextPhase,
    approvalRequired: true,
    approvedNow: false,
    executedNow: false,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    reviewDecision:
      errors.length === 0
        ? 'ACCEPTED_FOR_REVIEW_QUEUE_ONLY'
        : 'REJECTED_IN_SIMULATION',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Validate review routes.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ocValidateReviewRoutes_(reviewed) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < reviewed.length; i++) {
    var item =
      reviewed[i];

    if (item.approvedNow === true) {
      errors.push(
        'Simulation không được approve request trong 3O-C: ' +
        item.requestId
      );
    }

    if (item.executedNow === true) {
      errors.push(
        'Simulation không được execute request trong 3O-C: ' +
        item.requestId
      );
    }

    if (item.prodWriteAllowed === true) {
      errors.push(
        'Simulation không được mở PROD write trong 3O-C: ' +
        item.requestId
      );
    }

    if (item.approvalRequired !== true) {
      errors.push(
        'Mọi request trong 3O-C phải approvalRequired=true: ' +
        item.requestId
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    summary: {
      reviewedCount: reviewed.length,
      approvalRequiredCount:
        reviewed.filter(function(item) {
          return item.approvalRequired === true;
        }).length,
      approvedNowCount:
        reviewed.filter(function(item) {
          return item.approvedNow === true;
        }).length,
      executedNowCount:
        reviewed.filter(function(item) {
          return item.executedNow === true;
        }).length,
      highRiskCount:
        reviewed.filter(function(item) {
          return item.highRisk === true;
        }).length
    }
  };
}
