};


/**
 * Preview 3O-J.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewProdSelectedCRFinalExecutionApprovalGate3OJV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions =
    kidlearnV3_3ojCheckFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_assertProdSelectedChangeRequestExecutionPackage3OIReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdSelectedChangeRequestExecutionPackage3OIStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestExecutionDecisionGate3OHStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestExecutionDryRun3OGStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestControlledExecutionGate3OFStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestImplementationPlanning3OEStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReleaseFinalLock3NJStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getControlledProdDeployment3NFStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_runQaBatchProvidedStepsV3'
    ]);

  errors = errors.concat(requiredFunctions.errors);

  var phase3OI =
    kidlearnV3_3ojSafeAssert_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertProdSelectedChangeRequestExecutionPackage3OIReadyV3',
      '3O-I'
    );

  if (!phase3OI.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-I chưa READY_FOR_3O_J: ' +
      phase3OI.message
    );
  }

  var selectedPackage =
    kidlearnV3_3ojGetSelectedPackageInfo_();

  if (!selectedPackage.executionPackageId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu executionPackageId từ 3O-I.');
  }

  if (!selectedPackage.selectedRequestId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu selectedRequestId từ 3O-I.');
  }

  if (!selectedPackage.selectedRequestType) {
    errors.push('Thiếu selectedRequestType từ 3O-I.');
  }

  var decisionGate =
    kidlearnV3_3ojSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestExecutionDecisionGate3OHStatusV3'
    );

  if (
    decisionGate.summary.status &&
    decisionGate.summary.status !== 'READY_FOR_3O_I'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-H decision gate chưa READY_FOR_3O_I. Status=' +
      decisionGate.summary.status
    );
  }

  var dryRun =
    kidlearnV3_3ojSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestExecutionDryRun3OGStatusV3'
    );

  if (
    dryRun.summary.status &&
    dryRun.summary.status !== 'READY_FOR_3O_H'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-G dry-run chưa READY_FOR_3O_H. Status=' +
      dryRun.summary.status
    );
  }

  var finalLock =
    kidlearnV3_3ojSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReleaseFinalLock3NJStatusV3'
    );

  if (
    finalLock.summary.status &&
    finalLock.summary.status !== 'PROD_RELEASE_LOCKED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3N-J chưa PROD_RELEASE_LOCKED. Status=' +
      finalLock.summary.status
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3ojGetProdInfo_();

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileId từ 3N-F.');
  }

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileUrl) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileUrl từ 3N-F.');
  }

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3ojCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file chưa accessible: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3ojCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_PROD_SELECTED_CR_FINAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL_GATE_3OJ_V3',
    bundle: '3O-J',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    writeMode: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.WRITE_MODE,
    confirmText:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT,
    approvalResult:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.APPROVAL_RESULT,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    executionAllowedNow: false,
    finalApprovalGateOnly: true,
    changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
    prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
    rollbackExecutedNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3OI: phase3OI,
    selectedPackage: selectedPackage,
    decisionGate: decisionGate.summary,
    dryRun: dryRun.summary,
    finalLock: finalLock.summary,
    prodInfo: prodInfo,
    prodCheck: prodCheck,
    safeModes: safeModes,
    requiredFunctions: requiredFunctions.items,
    note:
      '3O-J chỉ là final execution approval gate. Không execute request và không ghi PROD.'
  };

  kidlearnV3_3ojSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.PREVIEWED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  return result;
}


/**
 * Generate final execution approval package.
 *
 * Không record approval trong hàm này.
 * Không execute request.
 */
function kidlearnV3_generateProdSelectedCRFinalExecutionApprovalPackage3OJV3() {
  var startedAt = new Date();
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewProdSelectedCRFinalExecutionApprovalGate3OJV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể generate final execution approval package 3O-J vì preview chưa đạt. Errors=' +
      preview.errorCount +
      '. ' +
      preview.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var finalApprovalId =
    kidlearnV3_3ojMakeFinalApprovalId_();

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3ojGetProdInfo_();

  var selectedPackage =
    kidlearnV3_3ojGetSelectedPackageInfo_();

  var selectedPackageStatus =
    kidlearnV3_3ojSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdSelectedChangeRequestExecutionPackage3OIStatusV3'
    );

  var decisionGate =
    kidlearnV3_3ojSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestExecutionDecisionGate3OHStatusV3'
    );

  var dryRun =
    kidlearnV3_3ojSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestExecutionDryRun3OGStatusV3'
    );

  var executionGate =
    kidlearnV3_3ojSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestControlledExecutionGate3OFStatusV3'
    );

  var planning =
    kidlearnV3_3ojSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdChangeRequestImplementationPlanning3OEStatusV3'
    );

  var finalLock =
    kidlearnV3_3ojSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReleaseFinalLock3NJStatusV3'
    );

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3ojCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file không accessible khi generate final approval package: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3ojCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  var approvalPolicy =
    kidlearnV3_3ojBuildFinalApprovalPolicy_(
      selectedPackage
    );

  var finishedAt = new Date();

  var approvalPackage = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'GENERATE_PROD_SELECTED_CR_FINAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL_PACKAGE_3OJ_V3',
    bundle: '3O-J',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.PACKAGE_GENERATED
        : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.FAILED,
    finalApprovalId: finalApprovalId,
    executionPackageId: selectedPackage.executionPackageId || '',
    selectedRequestId: selectedPackage.selectedRequestId || '',
    selectedRequestType: selectedPackage.selectedRequestType || '',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    confirmText:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT,
    approvalResult:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.APPROVAL_RESULT,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    executionAllowedNow: false,
    finalApprovalGateOnly: true,
    changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
    prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
    rollbackExecutedNow: false,

    prodReference: {
      prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
      prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
      prodFileName: prodInfo.prodFileName || '',
      deploymentId: prodInfo.deploymentId || '',
      accessible: prodCheck.success
    },

    selectedPackage: selectedPackage,

    upstreamReadiness: {
      selectedPackage3OI: selectedPackageStatus.summary,
      decisionGate3OH: decisionGate.summary,
      dryRun3OG: dryRun.summary,
      executionGate3OF: executionGate.summary,
      planning3OE: planning.summary,
      finalLock3NJ: finalLock.summary
    },

    finalApprovalPolicy: approvalPolicy,

    approvalChecklist: [
      {
        item: '3O-I selected execution package ready',
        passed:
          selectedPackageStatus.summary.status === 'READY_FOR_3O_J'
      },
      {
        item: 'Selected request ID exists',
        passed:
          selectedPackage.selectedRequestId ? true : false
      },
      {
        item: 'Selected request type exists',
        passed:
          selectedPackage.selectedRequestType ? true : false
      },
      {
        item: '3O-H decision gate ready',
        passed:
          decisionGate.summary.status === 'READY_FOR_3O_I'
      },
      {
        item: '3O-G dry-run rehearsal ready',
        passed:
          dryRun.summary.status === 'READY_FOR_3O_H'
      },
      {
        item: 'PROD release remains locked',
        passed:
          finalLock.summary.status === 'PROD_RELEASE_LOCKED'
      },
      {
        item: 'PROD file accessible',
        passed: prodCheck.success
      },
      {
        item: 'Safe Write remains DRY_RUN/enabled=false',
        passed:
          safeModes.summary.safeWriteMode === 'DRY_RUN' &&
          safeModes.summary.safeWriteEnabled === false
      },
      {
        item: 'No request executed in 3O-J',
        passed: true
      },
      {
        item: 'No PROD write policy opened in 3O-J',
        passed: true
      },
      {
        item: 'No rollback executed in 3O-J',
        passed: true
      }
    ],

    approvalMeaning:
      'Final approval gate này chỉ cho phép đi tiếp sang 3O-K controlled execution trial. Nó không execute request, không ghi PROD và không mở PROD write trong 3O-J.',

    noSideEffect: {
      prodFileModifiedBy3OJ: false,
      prodDataWrittenBy3OJ: false,
      prodSheetCreatedBy3OJ: false,
      prodSheetDeletedBy3OJ: false,
      requestExecutedBy3OJ: false,
      prodWritePolicyOpenedBy3OJ: false,
      rollbackExecutedBy3OJ: false
    },

    safeModes: safeModes.summary,

    startedAt: startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt: finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() - startedAt.getTime(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_3ojSavePackage_(
    approvalPackage
  );

  kidlearnV3_3ojSaveResult_(
    approvalPackage,
    approvalPackage.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.PACKAGE_GENERATED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_KEYS.LAST_PACKAGE_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(approvalPackage, null, 2));

  if (!approvalPackage.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3O-J final execution approval package failed. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return approvalPackage;
}


/**
 * Manual confirm wrapper.
 *
 * Không dùng Session.getActiveUser để tránh thêm OAuth scope.
 * Không execute request.
 * Không ghi PROD.
 */
function kidlearnV3_recordProdSelectedCRFinalExecutionApproval3OJManualConfirmV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_recordProdSelectedCRFinalExecutionApproval3OJV3({
    confirmText:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT,
    approvalResult:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.APPROVAL_RESULT,
    approvedBy: 'DEV_FINAL_EXECUTION_APPROVER_MANUAL_3OJ',
    approvalNote:
      'Final execution approval gate recorded in 3O-J. This only permits moving to 3O-K controlled execution trial. No PROD change executed.'
  });
}


/**
 * Record final execution approval gate.
 *
 * options:
 * {
 *   confirmText: 'APPROVE_SELECTED_CR_FINAL_EXECUTION_GATE_3O_J',
 *   approvalResult: 'APPROVE_PROCEED_TO_3O_K_CONTROLLED_TRIAL_ONLY',
 *   approvedBy: '...',
 *   approvalNote: '...'
 * }
 */
function kidlearnV3_recordProdSelectedCRFinalExecutionApproval3OJV3(options) {
  var req =
    kidlearnV3_3ojNormalizeOptions_(options);

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  if (
    String(req.confirmText || '') !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Confirm text không đúng. Cần đúng: ' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
    );
  }

  if (
    String(req.approvalResult || '') !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.APPROVAL_RESULT
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'approvalResult không đúng. Cần đúng: ' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.APPROVAL_RESULT
    );
  }

  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdSelectedCRFinalExecutionApproval3OJStatusV3();

  if (
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.PACKAGE_GENERATED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.FINAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL_RECORDED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_K
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-J chưa PACKAGE_GENERATED. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastPackage ||
    status.lastPackage.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last final approval package chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3ojGetProdInfo_();

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3ojCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file không accessible khi record final approval: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3ojCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    var failed = {
      success: false,
      action: 'RECORD_PROD_SELECTED_CR_FINAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL_3OJ_V3',
      bundle: '3O-J',
      phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.PHASE,
      status: status.status,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      prodDeployNow: false,
      executionAllowedNow: false,
      changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
      prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
      rollbackExecutedNow: false,
      errorCount: errors.length,
      warningCount: warnings.length,
      errors: errors,
      warnings: warnings
    };

    console.log(JSON.stringify(failed, null, 2));

    throw new Error(
      'Không thể record final execution approval 3O-J. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var finalApprovalId =
    status.finalApprovalId ||
    kidlearnV3_3ojMakeFinalApprovalId_();

  var selectedPackage =
    kidlearnV3_3ojGetSelectedPackageInfo_();

  var approval = {
    success: true,
    action: 'RECORD_PROD_SELECTED_CR_FINAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL_3OJ_V3',
    bundle: '3O-J',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.FINAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL_RECORDED,
    finalApprovalId: finalApprovalId,
    executionPackageId: selectedPackage.executionPackageId || '',
    selectedRequestId: selectedPackage.selectedRequestId || '',
    selectedRequestType: selectedPackage.selectedRequestType || '',
    approvedBy:
      req.approvedBy || 'DEV_FINAL_EXECUTION_APPROVER_MANUAL_3OJ',
    approvalResult:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.APPROVAL_RESULT,
    approvalNote:
      req.approvalNote || '',
    approvalMeaning:
      'Final execution approval recorded to proceed to 3O-K controlled execution trial only. No request executed and no PROD write opened in 3O-J.',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    executionAllowedNow: false,
    finalApprovalGateOnly: true,
    changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
    prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
    rollbackExecutedNow: false,
    safeModes: safeModes.summary,
    recordedAt:
      new Date().toISOString(),
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_KEYS.FINAL_APPROVAL_ID,
    finalApprovalId
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_KEYS.LAST_APPROVAL_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(approval)
  );

  kidlearnV3_3ojSaveResult_(
    approval,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.FINAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL_RECORDED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_KEYS.LAST_APPROVAL_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(approval, null, 2));

  return approval;
}


/**
 * Mark 3O-J ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markProdSelectedCRFinalExecutionApproval3OJReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdSelectedCRFinalExecutionApproval3OJStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.FINAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL_RECORDED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_K
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-J chưa FINAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL_RECORDED. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastApproval ||
    status.lastApproval.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last final approval chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  if (!status.finalApprovalId) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu finalApprovalId.'
    );
  }

  var selectedPackage =
    kidlearnV3_3ojGetSelectedPackageInfo_();

  if (!selectedPackage.executionPackageId) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu executionPackageId từ 3O-I.'
    );
  }

  if (!selectedPackage.selectedRequestId) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu selectedRequestId từ 3O-I.'
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3ojGetProdInfo_();

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3ojCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file không accessible khi mark ready: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3ojCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark 3O-J ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_PROD_SELECTED_CR_FINAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL_3OJ_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3O-J',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_K,
    finalApprovalId: status.finalApprovalId || '',
    executionPackageId: selectedPackage.executionPackageId || '',
    selectedRequestId: selectedPackage.selectedRequestId || '',
    selectedRequestType: selectedPackage.selectedRequestType || '',
    prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    approvalResult:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.APPROVAL_RESULT,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    executionAllowedNow: false,
    changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
    prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
    rollbackExecutedNow: false,
    message:
      '3O-J ready. Final execution approval gate đã được record. Bước tiếp theo là 3O-K controlled execution trial.',
    markedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_3ojSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_K,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  return result;
}

/**
 * Assert 3O-J ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertProdSelectedCRFinalExecutionApproval3OJReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdSelectedCRFinalExecutionApproval3OJStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_K
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-J chưa READY_FOR_3O_K. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (!status.finalApprovalId) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu finalApprovalId.'
    );
  }

  var selectedPackage =
    kidlearnV3_3ojGetSelectedPackageInfo_();

  if (!selectedPackage.executionPackageId) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu executionPackageId.'
    );
  }

  if (!selectedPackage.selectedRequestId) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu selectedRequestId.'
    );
  }

  if (!selectedPackage.selectedRequestType) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu selectedRequestType.'
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3ojGetProdInfo_();

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileId.');
  }

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileUrl) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileUrl.');
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_PROD_SELECTED_CR_FINAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL_3OJ_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3O-J',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status: status.status,
    finalApprovalId: status.finalApprovalId || '',
    executionPackageId: selectedPackage.executionPackageId || '',
    selectedRequestId: selectedPackage.selectedRequestId || '',
    selectedRequestType: selectedPackage.selectedRequestType || '',
    prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    approvalResult:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_CONFIG.APPROVAL_RESULT,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    executionAllowedNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3O-J chưa ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Get selected package info from 3O-I.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ojGetSelectedPackageInfo_() {
  try {
    var status =
      kidlearnV3_getProdSelectedChangeRequestExecutionPackage3OIStatusV3();

    var lastPackage =
      status.lastPackage || {};

    var selectedRequest =
      lastPackage.selectedRequest || {};

    var executionPlan =
      lastPackage.executionPlan || {};

    return {
      status: status.status || '',
      executionPackageId:
        status.executionPackageId ||
        lastPackage.executionPackageId ||
        '',
      selectedRequestId:
        status.selectedRequestId ||
        lastPackage.selectedRequestId ||
        selectedRequest.selectedRequestId ||
        '',
      selectedRequestType:
        status.selectedRequestType ||
        lastPackage.selectedRequestType ||
        selectedRequest.selectedRequestType ||
        '',
      prodWriteRequiredForActual:
        selectedRequest.prodWriteRequiredForActual === true ||
        (
          lastPackage.packagePolicy &&
          lastPackage.packagePolicy.prodWritePolicyRequiredForActualWrite === true
        ),
      executionMode:
        executionPlan.executionMode || '',
      finalExecutionApprovalRequired:
        (
          lastPackage.packagePolicy &&
          lastPackage.packagePolicy.finalExecutionApprovalRequired === true
        ) ||
        executionPlan.finalExecutionApprovalRequired === true,
      packageStatus:
        lastPackage.status || '',
      packageSuccess:
        lastPackage.success === true
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      status: '',
      executionPackageId: '',
      selectedRequestId: '',
      selectedRequestType: '',
      prodWriteRequiredForActual: false,
      executionMode: '',
      finalExecutionApprovalRequired: false,
      packageStatus: '',
      packageSuccess: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Check file accessible.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ojCheckFileAccessible_(fileId, label) {
  try {
    if (!fileId) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label || '',
        fileId: '',
        message: 'Thiếu fileId.'
      };
    }

    var file =
      DriveApp.getFileById(fileId);

    return {
      success: true,
      label: label || '',
      fileId: fileId,
      fileName: file.getName(),
      fileUrl: file.getUrl(),
      message: 'File accessible.'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label || '',
      fileId: fileId || '',
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check safe modes.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ojCheckSafeModes_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3ojSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write trong DEV script phải DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3ojControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write đang ENABLED.'
    );
  }

  if (controlledWrite.available === false) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy Controlled Write status function. Bỏ qua check này trong DEV.'
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    summary: {
      safeWriteMode: safeWrite.mode || '',
      safeWriteEnabled: safeWrite.enabled,
      controlledWriteAvailable: controlledWrite.available,
      controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite.status || ''
    }
  };
}


/**
 * Safe assert.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ojSafeAssert_(functionName, label) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' +
          functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output &&
        output.success === true,
      label: label,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe call.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ojSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        available: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        summary: {
          status: '',
          error: 'Missing function'
        }
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success: true,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      summary:
        kidlearnV3_3ojSummarizeStatusOutput_(
          output
        )
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      summary: {
        status: '',
        error: String(error.message || error)
      }
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Summarize status output.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ojSummarizeStatusOutput_(output) {
  if (!output || typeof output !== 'object') {
    return {
      rawType: typeof output
    };
  }

  return {
    success: output.success,
    action: output.action || '',
    bundle: output.bundle || '',
    phase: output.phase || '',
    status: output.status || '',
    nextBundle: output.nextBundle || '',
    nextStage: output.nextStage || '',
    prodFileId: output.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: output.prodFileUrl || '',
    executionPackageId: output.executionPackageId || '',
    selectedRequestId: output.selectedRequestId || '',
    selectedRequestType: output.selectedRequestType || '',
    decisionGateId: output.decisionGateId || '',
    dryRunId: output.dryRunId || '',
    executionGateId: output.executionGateId || '',
    planId: output.planId || '',
    finalLockId: output.finalLockId || '',
    errorCount: output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount: output.warningCount || 0
  };
}


/**
 * Safe Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ojSafeWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Controlled Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ojControlledWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      var result =
        kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

      result.available = true;

      return result;
    }

    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        'Missing kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ojCheckFunctions_(names) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          names[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: names[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        names[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Final approval ID.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ojMakeFinalApprovalId_() {
  return (
    'PROD_SELECTED_CR_FINAL_APPROVAL_3OJ_' +

      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'

  );
}

  );

  );

/**
 * Save result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ojSaveResult_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var currentStatus =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_KEYS.STATUS
    ) || '';

  var finalStatus =
    status;

  if (

    (
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.PREVIEWED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.PACKAGE_GENERATED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.FINAL_EXECUTION_APPROVAL_RECORDED
    )
  ) {
    finalStatus =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_K;
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_KEYS.STATUS,
    finalStatus
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_FINAL_EXEC_APPROVAL_3OJ_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      bundle: result.bundle,
      phase: result.phase,
      status: finalStatus,
      originalRequestedStatus: status,
      finalApprovalId: result.finalApprovalId || '',
      executionPackageId: result.executionPackageId || '',
      selectedRequestId: result.selectedRequestId || '',
      selectedRequestType: result.selectedRequestType || '',
      prodFileId: result.prodFileId || '',
      prodFileUrl: result.prodFileUrl || '',
      approvalResult: result.approvalResult || '',
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      prodDeployNow: false,
      executionAllowedNow: false,
      changeRequestExecutedNow: false,
      prodWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
      rollbackExecutedNow: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


/**
 * Read JSON property.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ojReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Normalize options.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3ojNormalizeOptions_(options) {
  if (!options) return {};

  if (typeof options !== 'object') {
    return {
      value: options
    };
  }

  return options;
}

/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_previewProdSelectedCRPostTrialValidation3OLV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions =
    kidlearnV3_3olCheckFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_assertProdSelectedCRControlledExecutionTrial3OKReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdSelectedCRControlledExecutionTrial3OKStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdSelectedCRFinalExecutionApproval3OJStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdSelectedChangeRequestExecutionPackage3OIStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReleaseFinalLock3NJStatusV3',

      'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_runQaBatchProvidedStepsV3'
    ]);

  errors = errors.concat(requiredFunctions.errors);

  var phase3OK =
    kidlearnV3_3olSafeAssert_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertProdSelectedCRControlledExecutionTrial3OKReadyV3',
      '3O-K'
    );

  if (!phase3OK.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-K chưa READY_FOR_3O_L: ' +
      phase3OK.message
    );
  }

  var trialInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3olGetTrialInfo_();

    errors.push('Thiếu controlledTrialId từ 3O-K.');
  }

  if (!trialInfo.auditId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu auditId từ 3O-K.');
  }

  if (trialInfo.prodAuditWriteExecuted !== true) {
    errors.push('3O-K chưa xác nhận prodAuditWriteExecuted=true.');
  }

  if (trialInfo.selectedRequestExecutedNow === true) {
    errors.push('3O-K không được selectedRequestExecutedNow=true.');
  }

  if (trialInfo.selectedDataChangedNow === true) {
    errors.push('3O-K không được selectedDataChangedNow=true.');
  }

  var finalLock =
    kidlearnV3_3olSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getProdReleaseFinalLock3NJStatusV3'
    );

  if (
    finalLock.summary.status &&
    finalLock.summary.status !== 'PROD_RELEASE_LOCKED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3N-J chưa PROD_RELEASE_LOCKED. Status=' +
      finalLock.summary.status
    );
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3olGetProdInfo_();

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileId từ 3N-F.');
  }

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileUrl) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileUrl từ 3N-F.');
  }

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3olCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file chưa accessible: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var auditRowCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3olFindAuditTrialRow_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      trialInfo.controlledTrialId,
      trialInfo.auditId
    );

  if (!auditRowCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không tìm thấy audit trial row từ 3O-K: ' +
      auditRowCheck.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3olCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_PROD_SELECTED_CR_POST_TRIAL_VALIDATION_3OL_V3',
    bundle: '3O-L',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    writeMode: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_CONFIG.WRITE_MODE,

/**
 * Generate release decision package.
 *
 * Không ghi PROD.
 */
function kidlearnV3_generateProdSelectedCRReleaseDecision3OLV3() {
  var startedAt = new Date();
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdSelectedCRPostTrialValidation3OLStatusV3();

  if (
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_STATUS.POST_TRIAL_REVIEW_PASSED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_STATUS.RELEASE_DECISION_GENERATED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_M
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-L cần POST_TRIAL_REVIEW_PASSED trước khi generate release decision. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastReview ||
    status.lastReview.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last post-trial review chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  var releaseDecisionId =
    kidlearnV3_3olMakeReleaseDecisionId_();

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3olGetProdInfo_();

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3olCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file không accessible khi generate release decision: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var trialInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3olGetTrialInfo_();

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3olCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);
  warnings = warnings.concat(safeModes.warnings);

  var decisionPolicy =
    kidlearnV3_3olBuildReleaseDecisionPolicy_(
      trialInfo
    );

  var finishedAt = new Date();

  var decision = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'GENERATE_PROD_SELECTED_CR_RELEASE_DECISION_3OL_V3',
    bundle: '3O-L',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_STATUS.RELEASE_DECISION_GENERATED
        : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_STATUS.FAILED,
    releaseDecisionId: releaseDecisionId,
    postTrialReviewId:
      status.postTrialReviewId || '',
    controlledTrialId: trialInfo.controlledTrialId || '',
    auditId: trialInfo.auditId || '',
    executionPackageId: trialInfo.executionPackageId || '',
    selectedRequestId: trialInfo.selectedRequestId || '',
    selectedRequestType: trialInfo.selectedRequestType || '',
    releaseDecision:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_CONFIG.RELEASE_DECISION,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    selectedRequestExecutionAllowed: false,
    selectedRequestExecutedNow: false,
    selectedDataChangedNow: false,
    fullProdWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
    migrationExecutedNow: false,
    rollbackExecutedNow: false,

    decisionPolicy: decisionPolicy,

    decisionChecklist: [
      {
        item: '3O-K trial ready',
        passed:
          trialInfo.status === 'READY_FOR_3O_L'
      },
      {
        item: 'Audit row exists',
        passed:
          trialInfo.auditId ? true : false
      },
      {
        item: 'Audit-only change confirmed',
        passed:
          trialInfo.expectedAuditOnlyChangeConfirmed === true
      },
      {
        item: 'Selected request was not executed',
        passed:
          trialInfo.selectedRequestExecutedNow !== true
      },
      {
        item: 'Selected data was not changed',
        passed:
          trialInfo.selectedDataChangedNow !== true
      },
      {
        item: 'Full PROD write policy was not opened',
        passed:
          trialInfo.fullProdWritePolicyOpenedNow !== true
      },
      {
        item: 'PROD file accessible',
        passed: prodCheck.success
      },
      {
        item: 'Safe Write remains DRY_RUN/enabled=false',
        passed:
          safeModes.summary.safeWriteMode === 'DRY_RUN' &&
          safeModes.summary.safeWriteEnabled === false
      }
    ],

    decisionMeaning:
      '3O-L accepts the audit-only controlled trial and does not approve selected data execution. The system remains read-only except the historical audit row already appended in 3O-K.',

    noSideEffectAt3OL: {
      prodFileModifiedBy3OL: false,
      prodDataWrittenBy3OL: false,
      prodSheetCreatedBy3OL: false,
      prodSheetDeletedBy3OL: false,
      selectedRequestExecutedBy3OL: false,
      prodWritePolicyOpenedBy3OL: false,
      rollbackExecutedBy3OL: false
    },

    safeModes: safeModes.summary,

    startedAt: startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt: finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() - startedAt.getTime(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_3olSaveDecision_(
    decision
  );

  kidlearnV3_3olSaveResult_(
    decision,
    decision.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_STATUS.RELEASE_DECISION_GENERATED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_KEYS.LAST_DECISION_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(decision, null, 2));

  if (!decision.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3O-L release decision failed. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return decision;
}


/**
 * Mark 3O-L ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markProdSelectedCRPostTrialValidation3OLReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdSelectedCRPostTrialValidation3OLStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_STATUS.RELEASE_DECISION_GENERATED &&
    status.status !== KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_M
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-L chưa RELEASE_DECISION_GENERATED. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastReview ||
    status.lastReview.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last review chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastDecision ||
    status.lastDecision.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last decision chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  if (!status.postTrialReviewId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu postTrialReviewId.');
  }

  if (!status.releaseDecisionId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu releaseDecisionId.');
  }

  var trialInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3olGetTrialInfo_();

  if (!trialInfo.controlledTrialId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu controlledTrialId.');
  }

  if (!trialInfo.auditId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu auditId.');
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3olGetProdInfo_();

  var prodCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3olCheckFileAccessible_(
      prodInfo.prodFileId,
      'PROD'
    );

  if (!prodCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'PROD file không accessible khi mark ready: ' +
      prodCheck.message
    );
  }

  var safeModes =
    kidlearnV3_3olCheckSafeModes_();

  errors = errors.concat(safeModes.errors);

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark 3O-L ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_PROD_SELECTED_CR_POST_TRIAL_VALIDATION_3OL_READY_V3',

/**
 * Assert 3O-L ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertProdSelectedCRPostTrialValidation3OLReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getProdSelectedCRPostTrialValidation3OLStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_M
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3O-L chưa READY_FOR_3O_M. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (!status.postTrialReviewId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu postTrialReviewId.');
  }

  if (!status.releaseDecisionId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu releaseDecisionId.');
  }

  var trialInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3olGetTrialInfo_();

  if (!trialInfo.controlledTrialId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu controlledTrialId.');
  }

  if (!trialInfo.auditId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu auditId.');
  }

  var prodInfo =
    kidlearnV3_3olGetProdInfo_();

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileId.');
  }

  if (!prodInfo.prodFileUrl) {
    errors.push('Thiếu prodFileUrl.');
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_PROD_SELECTED_CR_POST_TRIAL_VALIDATION_3OL_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3O-L',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status: status.status,
    postTrialReviewId: status.postTrialReviewId || '',
    releaseDecisionId: status.releaseDecisionId || '',
    controlledTrialId: trialInfo.controlledTrialId || '',
    auditId: trialInfo.auditId || '',
    prodFileId: prodInfo.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: prodInfo.prodFileUrl || '',
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    releaseDecision:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_CONFIG.RELEASE_DECISION,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    selectedRequestExecutionAllowed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3O-L chưa ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Build post-trial checklist.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3olBuildPostTrialChecklist_(trialInfo, auditRowCheck, safeModes) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var items = [
    {
      item: '3O-K status READY_FOR_3O_L',
      passed:
        trialInfo.status === 'READY_FOR_3O_L'
    },
    {
      item: 'Audit trial row found in PROD LOG_Audit',
      passed:
        auditRowCheck.success === true
    },
    {
      item: 'prodAuditWriteExecuted true',
      passed:
        trialInfo.prodAuditWriteExecuted === true
    },
    {
      item: 'Expected audit-only change confirmed',
      passed:
        trialInfo.expectedAuditOnlyChangeConfirmed === true
    },
    {
      item: 'Selected request was not executed',
      passed:
        trialInfo.selectedRequestExecutedNow !== true
    },
    {
      item: 'Selected data was not changed',
      passed:
        trialInfo.selectedDataChangedNow !== true
    },
    {
      item: 'Full PROD write policy was not opened',
      passed:
        trialInfo.fullProdWritePolicyOpenedNow !== true
    },
    {
      item: 'Rollback was not executed',
      passed:
        trialInfo.rollbackExecutedNow !== true
    },
    {
      item: 'Safe Write remains DRY_RUN/enabled=false',
      passed:
        safeModes.summary.safeWriteMode === 'DRY_RUN' &&
        safeModes.summary.safeWriteEnabled === false
    }
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    if (items[i].passed !== true) {
      errors.push(
        'Post-trial checklist failed: ' +
        items[i].item
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    items: items,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}

/**
 * Get trial info from 3O-K.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3olGetTrialInfo_() {
  try {
    var status =
      kidlearnV3_getProdSelectedCRControlledExecutionTrial3OKStatusV3();

    var lastTrial =
      status.lastTrial || {};

    var lastValidation =
      status.lastValidation || {};

    var compare =
      lastTrial.compare || {};

    var validationSummary =
      lastValidation.validationSummary || {};

    return {
      status: status.status || '',
      controlledTrialId:
        status.controlledTrialId ||
        lastTrial.controlledTrialId ||
        lastValidation.controlledTrialId ||
        '',
      auditId:
        status.auditId ||
        lastTrial.auditId ||
        lastValidation.auditId ||
        '',
      auditRowNumber:
        lastTrial.auditRowNumber ||
        lastValidation.auditRowNumber ||
        0,
      executionPackageId:
        lastTrial.executionPackageId ||
        lastValidation.executionPackageId ||
        '',
      selectedRequestId:
        lastTrial.selectedRequestId ||
        lastValidation.selectedRequestId ||
        '',
      selectedRequestType:
        lastTrial.selectedRequestType ||
        lastValidation.selectedRequestType ||
        '',
      prodAuditWriteExecuted:
        lastTrial.prodAuditWriteExecuted === true ||
        validationSummary.auditRowFound === true,
      expectedAuditOnlyChangeConfirmed:
        compare.expectedAuditOnlyChangeConfirmed === true ||
        validationSummary.expectedAuditOnlyChangeConfirmed === true,
      selectedRequestExecutedNow:
        lastTrial.selectedRequestExecutedNow === true ||
        validationSummary.selectedRequestExecutedNow === true,
      selectedDataChangedNow:
        lastTrial.selectedDataChangedNow === true ||
        validationSummary.selectedDataChangedNow === true,
      fullProdWritePolicyOpenedNow:
        lastTrial.fullProdWritePolicyOpenedNow === true ||
        validationSummary.fullProdWritePolicyOpenedNow === true,
      rollbackExecutedNow:
        lastTrial.rollbackExecutedNow === true,
      trialSuccess:
        lastTrial.success === true,
      validationSuccess:
        lastValidation.success === true
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      status: '',
      controlledTrialId: '',
      auditId: '',
      auditRowNumber: 0,
      executionPackageId: '',
      selectedRequestId: '',
      selectedRequestType: '',
      prodAuditWriteExecuted: false,
      expectedAuditOnlyChangeConfirmed: false,
      selectedRequestExecutedNow: false,
      selectedDataChangedNow: false,
      fullProdWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
      rollbackExecutedNow: false,
      trialSuccess: false,
      validationSuccess: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Find audit trial row in PROD LOG_Audit.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3olFindAuditTrialRow_(prodFileId, controlledTrialId, auditId) {
  try {
    if (!prodFileId) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Thiếu prodFileId.'
      };
    }

    var spreadsheet =
      SpreadsheetApp.openById(prodFileId);

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_3olGetSheet_(
        spreadsheet,
        KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_CONFIG.AUDIT_SHEET
      );

    if (!sheet) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Không tìm thấy LOG_Audit.'
      };
    }

    var lastRow =
      sheet.getLastRow();

    var lastColumn =
      sheet.getLastColumn();

    if (lastRow < 3 || lastColumn < 1) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'LOG_Audit chưa có data rows.'
      };
    }

    var startRow =
      Math.max(3, lastRow - 150);

    var numRows =
      lastRow - startRow + 1;

    var values =
      sheet
        .getRange(startRow, 1, numRows, lastColumn)
        .getDisplayValues();

    var needle1 =
      String(controlledTrialId || '');

    var needle2 =
      String(auditId || '');

    for (var r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
      var joined =
        values[r].join(' | ');

      if (
        joined.indexOf(needle1) >= 0 &&
        joined.indexOf(needle2) >= 0
      ) {
        return {
          success: true,
          rowNumber: startRow + r,
          message: 'Found 3O-K audit trial row.',
          controlledTrialId: controlledTrialId,
          auditId: auditId,
          checkedLastRows: numRows
        };
      }
    }

    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        'Không tìm thấy row chứa controlledTrialId và auditId trong 150 rows cuối LOG_Audit.',
      controlledTrialId: controlledTrialId,
      auditId: auditId,
      checkedLastRows: numRows
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      controlledTrialId: controlledTrialId,
      auditId: auditId
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Check file accessible.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3olCheckFileAccessible_(fileId, label) {
  try {
    if (!fileId) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label || '',
        fileId: '',
        message: 'Thiếu fileId.'
      };
    }

    var file =
      DriveApp.getFileById(fileId);

    return {
      success: true,
      label: label || '',
      fileId: fileId,
      fileName: file.getName(),
      fileUrl: file.getUrl(),
      message: 'File accessible.'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label || '',
      fileId: fileId || '',
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check safe modes.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3olCheckSafeModes_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3olSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write trong DEV script phải DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3olControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write DEV đang ENABLED.'
    );
  }

  if (controlledWrite.available === false) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy Controlled Write status function. Bỏ qua check này trong DEV.'
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    summary: {
      safeWriteMode: safeWrite.mode || '',
      safeWriteEnabled: safeWrite.enabled,
      controlledWriteAvailable: controlledWrite.available,
      controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite.status || ''
    }
  };
}


/**
 * Get exact sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3olGetSheet_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Safe assert.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3olSafeAssert_(functionName, label) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' +
          functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output &&
        output.success === true,
      label: label,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe call.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3olSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        available: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        summary: {
          status: '',
          error: 'Missing function'
        }
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success: true,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      summary:
        kidlearnV3_3olSummarizeStatusOutput_(
          output
        )
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      available: true,
      functionName: functionName,
      summary: {
        status: '',
        error: String(error.message || error)
      }
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Summarize status output.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3olSummarizeStatusOutput_(output) {
  if (!output || typeof output !== 'object') {
    return {
      rawType: typeof output
    };
  }

  return {
    success: output.success,
    action: output.action || '',
    bundle: output.bundle || '',
    phase: output.phase || '',
    status: output.status || '',
    nextBundle: output.nextBundle || '',
    nextStage: output.nextStage || '',
    prodFileId: output.prodFileId || '',
    prodFileUrl: output.prodFileUrl || '',
    controlledTrialId: output.controlledTrialId || '',
    auditId: output.auditId || '',
    finalApprovalId: output.finalApprovalId || '',
    executionPackageId: output.executionPackageId || '',
    selectedRequestId: output.selectedRequestId || '',
    selectedRequestType: output.selectedRequestType || '',
    finalLockId: output.finalLockId || '',
    errorCount: output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount: output.warningCount || 0
  };
}

 * Safe Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3olSafeWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Controlled Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3olControlledWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      var result =
        kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

      result.available = true;

      return result;
    }

    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        'Missing kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3olCheckFunctions_(names) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          names[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: names[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        names[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}

/**
 * Save result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3olSaveResult_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var currentStatus =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_KEYS.STATUS
    ) || '';

  var finalStatus =
    status;

  if (
    currentStatus ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_M &&
    (
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_STATUS.PREVIEWED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_STATUS.POST_TRIAL_REVIEW_PASSED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_STATUS.RELEASE_DECISION_GENERATED
    )
  ) {
    finalStatus =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_STATUS.READY_FOR_3O_M;
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_KEYS.STATUS,
    finalStatus
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PROD_POST_TRIAL_3OL_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      bundle: result.bundle,
      phase: result.phase,
      status: finalStatus,
      originalRequestedStatus: status,
      postTrialReviewId: result.postTrialReviewId || '',
      releaseDecisionId: result.releaseDecisionId || '',
      controlledTrialId: result.controlledTrialId || '',
      auditId: result.auditId || '',
      executionPackageId: result.executionPackageId || '',
      selectedRequestId: result.selectedRequestId || '',
      selectedRequestType: result.selectedRequestType || '',
      prodFileId: result.prodFileId || '',
      prodFileUrl: result.prodFileUrl || '',
      releaseDecision: result.releaseDecision || '',
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      prodDeployNow: false,
      selectedRequestExecutionAllowed: false,
      selectedRequestExecutedNow: false,
      selectedDataChangedNow: false,
      fullProdWritePolicyOpenedNow: false,
      migrationExecutedNow: false,
      rollbackExecutedNow: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


/**
 * Read JSON property.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3olReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Check MST_MediaAssets sheet.
 * This is read-only.
 */
function kidlearnV3_checkMstMediaAssetsRegistry4B2R5V3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet = kidlearnV3_4b2r5OpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được spreadsheet: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var sheet = null;

  if (spreadsheet) {
    sheet =
      kidlearnV3_4b2r5GetSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        'MST_MediaAssets'
      );

    if (!sheet) {
      errors.push('Không tìm thấy sheet MST_MediaAssets.');
    }
  }

  var headerInfo = {
    row1: [],
    row2: [],
    normalizedKeys: []
  };

  if (sheet) {
    var lastColumn = sheet.getLastColumn();

    if (lastColumn < 1) {
      errors.push('MST_MediaAssets không có cột.');
    } else {
      headerInfo.row1 =
        sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastColumn).getValues()[0];

      if (sheet.getLastRow() >= 2) {
        headerInfo.row2 =
          sheet.getRange(2, 1, 1, lastColumn).getValues()[0];
      }

      headerInfo.normalizedKeys =
        kidlearnV3_4b2r5NormalizeHeaderKeys_(
          headerInfo.row1,
          headerInfo.row2
        );
    }
  }

  var recommended =
    kidlearnV3_4b2r5GetRecommendedFields_();

  var found = [];
  var missing = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < recommended.length; i++) {
    var key =
      recommended[i];

    if (
      kidlearnV3_4b2r5HeaderContains_(
        headerInfo.normalizedKeys,
        key
      )
    ) {
      found.push(key);
    } else {
      missing.push(key);
    }
  }

  if (missing.length > 0) {
    warnings.push(
      'MST_MediaAssets chưa có đủ recommended fields: ' +
      missing.join(', ') +
      '. Đây là warning vì hiện tại 4B-2R-5 mới chốt plan, chưa bắt app đọc asset thật.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'CHECK_MST_MEDIA_ASSETS_REGISTRY_4B_2R_5_V3',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_ASSET_PLAN_4B2R5_CONFIG.PHASE,
    registrySheet: 'MST_MediaAssets',
    spreadsheetId:
      spreadsheet ? spreadsheet.getId() : '',
    spreadsheetName:
      spreadsheet ? spreadsheet.getName() : '',
    sheetExists:
      sheet !== null,
    rowCount:
      sheet ? Math.max(0, sheet.getLastRow() - 2) : 0,
    columnCount:
      sheet ? sheet.getLastColumn() : 0,
    foundRecommendedFields: found,
    missingRecommendedFields: missing,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_4b2r5SaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_ASSET_PLAN_4B2R5_STATUS.REGISTRY_CHECKED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_ASSET_PLAN_4B2R5_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_ASSET_PLAN_4B2R5_KEYS.LAST_REGISTRY_CHECK_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'MST_MediaAssets registry check failed. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

function kidlearnV3_4b2r5GetRecommendedFields_() {

    'entityCode',

  ];
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r5OpenSpreadsheet_() {
  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) return active;

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DEV spreadsheet.');
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r5GetSheetByExactName_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r5NormalizeHeaderKeys_(row1, row2) {
  var max =
    Math.max(
      row1 ? row1.length : 0,
      row2 ? row2.length : 0
    );

  var keys = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < max; i++) {
    var raw =
      row2 && row2[i]
        ? row2[i]
        : row1 && row1[i]
          ? row1[i]
          : '';

    keys.push(
      kidlearnV3_4b2r5NormalizeKey_(raw)
    );
  }

  return keys;
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r5HeaderContains_(normalizedKeys, key) {
  var target =
    kidlearnV3_4b2r5NormalizeKey_(key);

  for (var i = 0; i < normalizedKeys.length; i++) {
    if (normalizedKeys[i] === target) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r5NormalizeKey_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '');
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r5SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r5SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_ASSET_PLAN_4B2R5_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_ASSET_PLAN_4B2R5_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase: result.phase,
      parentPhase: result.parentPhase || '4B-2R',
      status: status,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_ASSET_PLAN_4B2R5_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_ASSET_PLAN_4B2R5_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r5ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * Context builder
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_4i1BuildReadiness_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4i1CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var phase4H =
    kidlearnV3_4i1SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4HClosedLockedV3'
    );

  if (!phase4H.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4H chưa locked: ' +
      phase4H.message
    );
  }

  var policy =
    null;

  try {
    policy =
      kidlearnV3_getAssignmentLearningPolicy4I1V3();
  } catch (errorPolicy) {
    errors.push(
      'Không tạo được policy 4I-1: ' +
      String(errorPolicy.message || errorPolicy)
    );
  }

  var context =
    null;

  try {
    context =
      kidlearnV3_4i1BuildContext_({
        childId:
          KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID,
        parentId:
          KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PARENT_ID,
        recentLimit:
          KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.DEFAULT_RECENT_LIMIT
      });
  } catch (errorContext) {
    errors.push(
      'Không build được Assignment Learning Context: ' +
      String(errorContext.message || errorContext)
    );
  }

  if (context && context.warnings) {
    warnings =
      warnings.concat(context.warnings);
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_READINESS_4I_1_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    contextName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.CONTEXT_NAME,
    prerequisite: {
      phase4HLocked:
        phase4H.success === true,
      policyBuilt:
        policy && policy.success === true,
      contextBuilt:
        context && context.success === true
    },
    policy:
      policy,
    contextSummary:
      context
        ? context.contextSummary
        : null,
    dataAvailability:
      context
        ? context.dataAvailability
        : null,
    gateMode:
      kidlearnV3_4i1GetGateMode_(),
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4i1UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4i1UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1BuildContext_(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  kidlearnV3_4i1EnsureDefaultGateMode_();

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4i1CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var phase4H =
    kidlearnV3_4i1SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4HClosedLockedV3'
    );

  if (!phase4H.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4H chưa locked: ' +
      phase4H.message
    );
  }

  var childId =
    String(
      options.childId ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID
    ).trim();

  var parentId =
    String(
      options.parentId ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PARENT_ID
    ).trim();

  var recentLimit =
    Number(
      options.recentLimit ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.DEFAULT_RECENT_LIMIT
    );

  if (isNaN(recentLimit) || recentLimit <= 0) {
    recentLimit =
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.DEFAULT_RECENT_LIMIT;
  }

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4i1OpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (errorOpen) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được DEV spreadsheet: ' +
      String(errorOpen.message || errorOpen)
    );
  }

  var todayKey =
    kidlearnV3_4i1TodayKey_();

  var child =
    {
      childId:
        childId,
      displayName:
        'Bé'
    };

  var policy =
    kidlearnV3_getAssignmentLearningPolicy4I1V3();

  var dataAvailability =
    {
      DATA_Children: false,
      DATA_Assignments: false,
      DATA_DailyGoals: false,
      DATA_LessonProgress: false,
      DATA_StudySessions: false,
      MST_Lessons: false,
      MST_Subjects: false
    };

  var assignments = [];
  var lessonMap = {};
  var subjectMap = {};
  var progressMap = {};
  var todayGoal = null;
  var recentStudySessions = [];

  if (spreadsheet) {
    child =
      kidlearnV3_4i1ReadChild_(
        spreadsheet,
        childId,
        child,
        dataAvailability,
        warnings
      );

    subjectMap =
      kidlearnV3_4i1ReadSubjectMap_(
        spreadsheet,
        dataAvailability,
        warnings
      );

    lessonMap =
      kidlearnV3_4i1ReadLessonMap_(
        spreadsheet,
        dataAvailability,
        warnings
      );

    progressMap =
      kidlearnV3_4i1ReadLessonProgressMap_(
        spreadsheet,
        childId,
        dataAvailability,
        warnings
      );

    todayGoal =
      kidlearnV3_4i1ReadTodayGoal_(
        spreadsheet,
        childId,
        todayKey,
        dataAvailability,
        warnings
      );

    assignments =
      kidlearnV3_4i1ReadAssignments_(
        spreadsheet,
        childId,
        todayKey,
        lessonMap,
        subjectMap,
        progressMap,
        dataAvailability,
        warnings
      );

    recentStudySessions =
      kidlearnV3_4i1ReadRecentStudySessions_(
        spreadsheet,
        childId,
        recentLimit,
        dataAvailability,
        warnings
      );
  }

  var grouped =
    kidlearnV3_4i1GroupAssignments_(
      assignments
    );

  var cards =
    kidlearnV3_4i1BuildLearningCards_(
      assignments,
      todayKey
    );

  var primaryAssignment =
    kidlearnV3_4i1PickPrimaryAssignment_(
      cards
    );

  var contextSummary = {
    todayKey:
      todayKey,
    assignmentCount:
      assignments.length,
    activeCount:
      grouped.active.length,
    inProgressCount:
      grouped.inProgress.length,
    completedCount:
      grouped.completed.length,
    overdueCount:
      grouped.overdue.length,
    hasPrimaryAssignment:
      primaryAssignment ? true : false,
    todayGoalExists:
      todayGoal ? true : false,
    gateMode:
      kidlearnV3_4i1GetGateMode_()
  };

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'GET_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_CONTEXT_4I_1_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    contextName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.CONTEXT_NAME,
    child:
      child,
    parentId:
      parentId,
    todayKey:
      todayKey,
    policy:
      policy,
    gateMode:
      kidlearnV3_4i1GetGateMode_(),
    todayGoal:
      todayGoal,
    assignmentLearningContext: {
      title:
        'Bài học được giao',
      subtitle:
        'Con học theo kế hoạch phụ huynh đã lập.',
      primaryAssignment:
        primaryAssignment,
      cards:
        cards,
      groups:
        {
          active:
            grouped.active,
          inProgress:
            grouped.inProgress,
          completed:
            grouped.completed,
          overdue:
            grouped.overdue
        },
      emptyState: {
        show:
          cards.length === 0,
        title:
          'Chưa có bài học được giao',
        message:
          'Khi phụ huynh giao bài, bài học sẽ xuất hiện ở đây.'
      },
      recentStudySessions:
        recentStudySessions
    },
    uiPolicy: {
      step:
        '4I-2',
      childCanSeeAssignments:
        true,
      childCanOpenLesson:
        true,
      dryRunRoutingOnly:
        true,
      realAssignmentStatusWrite:
        false,
      realWriteStep:
        '4I-3',
      useExistingLessonPlayer4C:
        true,
      useExistingAnswerWrite4D:
        true
    },
    contextSummary:
      contextSummary,
    dataAvailability:
      dataAvailability,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4i1UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4i1UniqueArray_(warnings),
    builtAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  return result;
}

function kidlearnV3_4i1ReadChild_(spreadsheet, childId, fallbackChild, dataAvailability, warnings) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4i1GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Children'
    );

  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    warnings.push('DATA_Children trống hoặc không tồn tại.');
    return fallbackChild;
  }

  dataAvailability.DATA_Children = true;

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4i1ReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var rowChildId =
      String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['childId', 'id', 'Mã bé', 'Mã trẻ']) || '').trim();

    if (rowChildId === childId) {
      return {
        childId:
          childId,
        displayName:
          String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['displayName', 'childName', 'name', 'Tên bé', 'Họ tên']) || 'Bé'),
        grade:
          String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['grade', 'Lớp']) || ''),
        sourceRow:
          i + 2
      };
    }
  }

  return fallbackChild;
}
