function kidlearnV3_4i1ReadLessonProgressMap_(spreadsheet, childId, dataAvailability, warnings) {
  var map = {};

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4i1GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_LessonProgress'
    );

  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    warnings.push('DATA_LessonProgress trống hoặc không tồn tại.');
    return map;
  }

  dataAvailability.DATA_LessonProgress = true;

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4i1ReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var rowChildId =
      String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['childId', 'studentId', 'learnerId', 'Mã bé']) || '').trim();

    if (rowChildId && rowChildId !== childId) continue;

    var lessonId =
      String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['lessonId', 'Mã bài học']) || '').trim();

    if (!lessonId) continue;

    var progressPercent =
      kidlearnV3_4i1ToNumber_(
        kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['progressPercent', 'completionPercent', 'percentComplete', 'Tiến độ'])
      );

    var status =
      String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['status', 'Trạng thái']) || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    map[lessonId] = {
      lessonId:
        lessonId,
      childId:
        rowChildId || childId,
      progressPercent:
        progressPercent,
      status:
        status,
      isCompleted:
        progressPercent >= 100 ||
        kidlearnV3_4i1IsCompletedStatus_(status),
      updatedAt:
        kidlearnV3_4i1ToIso_(
          kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['updatedAt', 'lastUpdatedAt', 'Cập nhật lúc'])
        ),
      sourceRow:
        i + 2
    };
  }

  return map;
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1ReadTodayGoal_(spreadsheet, childId, todayKey, dataAvailability, warnings) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4i1GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_DailyGoals'
    );

  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    warnings.push('DATA_DailyGoals trống hoặc không tồn tại.');
    return null;
  }

  dataAvailability.DATA_DailyGoals = true;

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4i1ReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  for (var i = values.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var rowChildId =
      String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['childId', 'studentId', 'learnerId', 'Mã bé']) || '').trim();

    var goalDate =
      kidlearnV3_4i1ToDateKey_(
        kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['goalDate', 'date', 'planDate', 'Ngày mục tiêu', 'Ngày kế hoạch'])
      );

    if (rowChildId === childId && goalDate === todayKey) {
      return {
        goalId:
          String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['goalId', 'dailyGoalId', 'id', 'Mã mục tiêu']) || ''),
        childId:
          childId,
        goalDate:
          goalDate,
        targetMinutes:
          kidlearnV3_4i1ToNumber_(
            kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['targetMinutes', 'targetMinute', 'minutes', 'Số phút mục tiêu'])
          ),
        completedMinutes:
          kidlearnV3_4i1ToNumber_(
            kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['completedMinutes', 'actualMinutes', 'doneMinutes', 'Số phút hoàn thành'])
          ),
        status:
          String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['status', 'Trạng thái']) || 'ACTIVE'),
        sourceRow:
          i + 2
      };
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1ReadAssignments_(spreadsheet, childId, todayKey, lessonMap, subjectMap, progressMap, dataAvailability, warnings) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4i1GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Assignments'
    );

  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    warnings.push('DATA_Assignments trống hoặc không tồn tại.');
    return [];
  }

  dataAvailability.DATA_Assignments = true;

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4i1ReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var rowChildId =
      String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['childId', 'studentId', 'learnerId', 'Mã bé']) || '').trim();

    if (childId && rowChildId && rowChildId !== childId) continue;

    var lessonId =
      String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['lessonId', 'Mã bài học']) || '').trim();

    if (!lessonId) continue;

    var status =
      String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['status', 'Trạng thái']) || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    var dueDate =
      kidlearnV3_4i1ToDateKey_(
        kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['dueDate', 'planDate', 'assignedDate', 'date', 'Ngày kế hoạch', 'Hạn hoàn thành'])
      );

    var lesson =
      lessonMap[lessonId] || {};

    var subjectCode =
      String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['subjectCode', 'subjectId', 'Mã môn']) || lesson.subjectCode || '').trim();

    var subject =
      subjectMap[subjectCode] || {};

    var progress =
      progressMap[lessonId] || {
        lessonId:
          lessonId,
        progressPercent:
          0,
        status:
          '',
        isCompleted:
          false
      };

    var completedByProgress =
      progress.isCompleted === true;

    var completedByStatus =
      kidlearnV3_4i1IsCompletedStatus_(status);

    items.push({
      assignmentId:
        String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['assignmentId', 'id', 'Mã bài giao']) || ''),
      childId:
        rowChildId || childId,
      lessonId:
        lessonId,
      lessonTitle:
        lesson.lessonTitle || lessonId,
      subjectCode:
        subjectCode,
      subjectName:
        subject.subjectName || subjectCode,
      status:
        status || 'ASSIGNED',
      dueDate:
        dueDate,
      assignedAt:
        kidlearnV3_4i1ToIso_(
          kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['assignedAt', 'createdAt', 'Ngày giao'])
        ),
      startedAt:
        kidlearnV3_4i1ToIso_(
          kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['startedAt', 'startAt', 'Bắt đầu lúc'])
        ),
      completedAt:
        kidlearnV3_4i1ToIso_(
          kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['completedAt', 'finishedAt', 'Hoàn thành lúc'])
        ),
      source:
        String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['source', 'assignmentSource', 'Nguồn']) || ''),
      lessonProgress:
        progress,
      isActive:
        kidlearnV3_4i1IsActiveStatus_(status),
      isInProgress:
        kidlearnV3_4i1IsInProgressStatus_(status),
      isCompleted:
        completedByStatus || completedByProgress,
      isOverdue:
        dueDate && dueDate < todayKey && !completedByStatus && !completedByProgress,
      sourceRow:
        i + 2
    });
  }

  return kidlearnV3_4i1SortAssignments_(items);
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1ReadRecentStudySessions_(spreadsheet, childId, limit, dataAvailability, warnings) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4i1GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_StudySessions'
    );

  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    warnings.push('DATA_StudySessions trống hoặc không tồn tại.');
    return [];
  }

  dataAvailability.DATA_StudySessions = true;

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4i1ReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var rowChildId =
      String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['childId', 'studentId', 'learnerId', 'Mã bé']) || '').trim();

    if (childId && rowChildId && rowChildId !== childId) continue;

    items.push({
      sessionId:
        String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['sessionId', 'id']) || ''),
      childId:
        rowChildId || childId,
      lessonId:
        String(kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['lessonId', 'Mã bài học']) || ''),
      startedAt:
        kidlearnV3_4i1ToIso_(
          kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['startedAt', 'startTime', 'createdAt'])
        ),
      endedAt:
        kidlearnV3_4i1ToIso_(
          kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['endedAt', 'endTime', 'updatedAt'])
        ),
      durationMinutes:
        kidlearnV3_4i1ToNumber_(
          kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['durationMinutes', 'minutes'])
        ),
      sourceRow:
        i + 2
    });
  }

  items.sort(function (a, b) {
    return String(b.startedAt || '').localeCompare(String(a.startedAt || ''));
  });

  return items.slice(0, limit);
}


/**
 * ================================================================
 * Assignment helpers
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_4i1GroupAssignments_(assignments) {
  var grouped = {
    active: [],
    inProgress: [],
    completed: [],
    overdue: []
  };

  assignments =
    assignments || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < assignments.length; i++) {
    var item =
      assignments[i];

    if (item.isCompleted) {
      grouped.completed.push(item);
    } else if (item.isOverdue) {
      grouped.overdue.push(item);
    } else if (item.isInProgress) {
      grouped.inProgress.push(item);
    } else if (item.isActive) {
      grouped.active.push(item);
    }
  }

  return grouped;
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1BuildLearningCards_(assignments, todayKey) {
  var cards = [];

  assignments =
    assignments || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < assignments.length; i++) {
    var item =
      assignments[i];

    if (item.isCompleted) {
      cards.push(
        kidlearnV3_4i1BuildCard_(item, 'COMPLETED')
      );
    } else if (item.isOverdue) {
      cards.push(
        kidlearnV3_4i1BuildCard_(item, 'OVERDUE')
      );
    } else if (item.isInProgress) {
      cards.push(
        kidlearnV3_4i1BuildCard_(item, 'RESUME')
      );
    } else if (item.isActive) {
      cards.push(
        kidlearnV3_4i1BuildCard_(item, 'START')
      );
    }
  }

  return cards;
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1BuildCard_(assignment, mode) {
  var progress =
    assignment.lessonProgress || {};

  return {
    assignmentId:
      assignment.assignmentId,
    lessonId:
      assignment.lessonId,
    lessonTitle:
      assignment.lessonTitle,
    subjectCode:
      assignment.subjectCode,
    subjectName:
      assignment.subjectName,
    status:
      assignment.status,
    dueDate:
      assignment.dueDate,
    mode:
      mode,
    progressPercent:
      progress.progressPercent || 0,
    progressStatus:
      progress.status || '',
    isCompleted:
      assignment.isCompleted === true,
    canOpenLesson:
      mode === 'START' || mode === 'RESUME' || mode === 'OVERDUE',
    canStart:
      mode === 'START' || mode === 'OVERDUE',
    canResume:
      mode === 'RESUME',
    canMarkCompleteIn4I3:
      progress.isCompleted === true,
    actionLabel:
      mode === 'COMPLETED'
        ? 'Đã hoàn thành'
        : (
          mode === 'RESUME'
            ? 'Học tiếp'
            : 'Bắt đầu học'
        ),
    readOnly:
      true,
    writeStep:
      '4I-3',
    sourceRow:
      assignment.sourceRow
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1PickPrimaryAssignment_(cards) {
  cards =
    cards || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
    if (cards[i].mode === 'RESUME') {
      return cards[i];
    }
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < cards.length; j++) {
    if (cards[j].mode === 'START') {
      return cards[j];
    }
  }

  for (var k = 0; k < cards.length; k++) {
    if (cards[k].mode === 'OVERDUE') {
      return cards[k];
    }
  }

  return cards.length ? cards[0] : null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1SortAssignments_(items) {
  items =
    items || [];

  items.sort(function (a, b) {
    var scoreA =
      kidlearnV3_4i1AssignmentSortScore_(a);

    var scoreB =
      kidlearnV3_4i1AssignmentSortScore_(b);

    if (scoreA !== scoreB) {
      return scoreA - scoreB;
    }

    return String(a.dueDate || '').localeCompare(String(b.dueDate || ''));
  });

  return items;
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1AssignmentSortScore_(item) {
  if (item.isInProgress) return 1;
  if (item.isActive && !item.isOverdue) return 2;
  if (item.isOverdue) return 3;
  if (item.isCompleted) return 4;
  return 9;
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1IsActiveStatus_(status) {
  status =
    String(status || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  return (
    status === '' ||
    status === 'ASSIGNED' ||
    status === 'OPEN' ||
    status === 'PENDING' ||
    status === 'IN_PROGRESS' ||
    status === 'STARTED'
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1IsInProgressStatus_(status) {
  status =
    String(status || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  return (
    status === 'IN_PROGRESS' ||
    status === 'STARTED'
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1IsCompletedStatus_(status) {
  status =
    String(status || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  return (
    status === 'COMPLETED' ||
    status === 'DONE' ||
    status === 'FINISHED'
  );
}


/**
 * ================================================================
 * Spreadsheet helpers
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_4i1OpenSpreadsheet_() {
  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) {
    return active;
  }

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

function kidlearnV3_4i1GetSheetByExactName_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

function kidlearnV3_4i1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, aliases) {
  var index =
    kidlearnV3_4i1FindColumnIndexByAliases_(
      headers,
      aliases
    );

  if (index < 0) return '';

  return row[index];
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1FindColumnIndexByAliases_(headers, aliases) {
  headers =
    headers || [];

  aliases =
    aliases || [];

  var expanded =
    kidlearnV3_4i1ExpandAliases_(
      aliases
    );

  for (var i = 0; i < expanded.length; i++) {
    var target =
      kidlearnV3_4i1NormalizeHeader_(
        expanded[i]
      );

    if (!target) continue;

    for (var j = 0; j < headers.length; j++) {
      var current =
        kidlearnV3_4i1NormalizeHeader_(
          headers[j]
        );

      if (current === target) {
        return j;
      }
    }
  }

  return -1;
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1ExpandAliases_(aliases) {
  var dictionary =
    kidlearnV3_4i1AliasDictionary_();

  var seen = {};
  var result = [];

  function add(value) {
    value =
      String(value || '').trim();

    if (!value) return;

    var key =
      kidlearnV3_4i1NormalizeHeader_(
        value
      );

    if (!seen[key]) {
      seen[key] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    var alias =
      String(aliases[i] || '').trim();

    add(alias);

    var normalized =
      kidlearnV3_4i1NormalizeHeader_(alias);

    var extra =
      dictionary[normalized] || [];

    for (var j = 0; j < extra.length; j++) {
      add(extra[j]);
    }
  }

  return result;
}

function kidlearnV3_4i1NormalizeHeader_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value || '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

  text =
    kidlearnV3_4i1StripVietnameseDiacritics_(
      text
    );

  return text
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '')
    .replace(/\./g, '')
    .replace(/\//g, '')
    .replace(/\(/g, '')
    .replace(/\)/g, '');
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1StripVietnameseDiacritics_(text) {
  text =
    String(text || '');

  try {
    text =
      text.normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  return text
    .replace(/đ/g, 'd')
    .replace(/Đ/g, 'D');
}

function kidlearnV3_4i1EnsureDefaultGateMode_() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var current =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_KEYS.WRITE_GATE_MODE
    );

  if (!current) {
    properties.setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_KEYS.WRITE_GATE_MODE,
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_GATE_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY
    );
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1GetGateMode_() {
  var mode =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_KEYS.WRITE_GATE_MODE
      ) ||
    KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_GATE_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY;

  if (
    mode !== KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_GATE_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY &&
    mode !== KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_GATE_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_GATE_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY;
  }

  return mode;
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  try {
    if (typeof kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_ === 'function') {
      kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

      return {
        success: true,
        environment: 'DEV',
        prodWriteAllowed: false,
        errors: []
      };
    }
  } catch (errorAssertDev) {
    errors.push(
      String(errorAssertDev.message || errorAssertDev)
    );
  }

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      kidlearnV3_4i1UniqueArray_(errors)
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1SafeCall_(functionName, args) {
  args =
    args || [];

  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName:
          functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output:
          null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn.apply(null, args);

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      nextPhase:
        output && output.nextPhase ? output.nextPhase : '',
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4i1PreviewValue_(JSON.stringify(output || {})),
      output:
        output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output:
        null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1ToNumber_(value) {
  var number =
    Number(value || 0);

  return isNaN(number) ? 0 : number;
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1TodayKey_() {
  try {
    return Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyy-MM-dd'
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1ToDateKey_(value) {
  if (!value) return '';

  if (Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Date]') {
    try {
      return Utilities.formatDate(
        value,
        Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
        'yyyy-MM-dd'
      );
    } catch (errorDate) {
      return value.toISOString().substring(0, 10);
    }
  }

  var text =
    String(value || '').trim();

  if (!text) return '';

  if (text.length >= 10 && text.charAt(4) === '-') {
    return text.substring(0, 10);
  }

  var date =
    new Date(text);

  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return '';
  }

  try {
    return Utilities.formatDate(
      date,
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyy-MM-dd'
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return date.toISOString().substring(0, 10);
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1ToIso_(value) {
  if (!value) return '';

  if (Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Date]') {
    return value.toISOString();
  }

  var text =
    String(value || '').trim();

  if (!text) return '';

  var date =
    new Date(text);

  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return text;
  }

  return date.toISOString();
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1PreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 450) {
    return text.substring(0, 450) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  items =
    items || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success:
        result.success,
      action:
        result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.PHASE,
      parentPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status:
        status,
      contextName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.CONTEXT_NAME,
      gateMode:
        kidlearnV3_4i1GetGateMode_(),
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      contextSummary:
        result.contextSummary || null,
      dataAvailability:
        result.dataAvailability || null,
      prodWriteAllowed:
        false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4i1ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw:
        text
    };
  }
}

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_STATUS.READY_FOR_4I_3
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '4I-2 chưa READY_FOR_4I_3. Current=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'ASSERT_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I_2_READY_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      status.status,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    errors:
      errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(errors.join(' | '));
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * Readiness
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_4i2BuildReadiness_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4i2CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var phase4I1 =
    kidlearnV3_4i2SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertAssignmentLearningPolicyContext4I1ReadyV3'
    );

  if (!phase4I1.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4I-1 chưa READY_FOR_4I_2: ' +
      phase4I1.message
    );
  }

  var context =
    kidlearnV3_4i2SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getAssignmentLearningContext4I1V3',
      [
        {
          childId:
            KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID,
          parentId:
            KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PARENT_ID
        }
      ]
    );

  if (!context.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được Assignment Learning Context 4I-1: ' +
      context.message
    );
  }

  var markers =
    kidlearnV3_4i2InspectUiMarkers_();

  if (!markers.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(markers.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(markers.warnings || []);

  var visualScore =
    markers.success ? 90 : 70;

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_READINESS_4I_2_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    uiName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.UI_NAME,
    prerequisite: {
      phase4I1Ready:
        phase4I1.success === true,
      contextReadable:
        context.success === true
    },
    contextSummary:
      context.output && context.output.contextSummary
        ? context.output.contextSummary
        : null,
    uiPolicy: {
      childHomeCard:
        true,
      assignmentPanel:
        true,
      emptyStateSupported:
        true,
      routeDryRunOnly:
        true,
      realAssignmentWrite:
        false,
      realWriteStep:
        '4I-3'
    },
    uiMarkers:
      markers,
    visualScore:
      visualScore,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4i2UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4i2UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4i2BuildRoutePreview_(payload) {
  payload = payload || {};

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var childId =
    String(
      payload.childId ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID
    ).trim();

  var assignmentId =
    String(payload.assignmentId || '').trim();

  var lessonId =
    String(payload.lessonId || '').trim();

  var context = null;

  try {
    context =
      kidlearnV3_getAssignmentLearningContext4I1V3({
        childId:
          childId,
        parentId:
          KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PARENT_ID
      });
  } catch (errorContext) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được Assignment Learning Context 4I-1: ' +
      String(errorContext.message || errorContext)
    );
  }

  var cards =
    context &&
    context.assignmentLearningContext &&
    context.assignmentLearningContext.cards
      ? context.assignmentLearningContext.cards
      : [];

  var matched = null;

  for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
    if (
      assignmentId &&
      String(cards[i].assignmentId || '') === assignmentId
    ) {
      matched = cards[i];
      break;
    }

    if (
      !assignmentId &&
      lessonId &&
      String(cards[i].lessonId || '') === lessonId
    ) {
      matched = cards[i];
      break;
    }
  }

  if (!matched && cards.length > 0) {
    matched = cards[0];

    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy assignment theo payload. Dùng primary/first assignment để preview route.'
    );
  }

  if (!matched) {
    warnings.push(
      'Hiện chưa có Assignment. Route preview trả empty state, không ghi dữ liệu.'
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_ASSIGNMENT_ROUTE_PREVIEW_4I_2_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.PHASE,
    childId:
      childId,
    requested: {
      assignmentId:
        assignmentId,
      lessonId:
        lessonId
    },
    matchedAssignment:
      matched,
    routePreview: {
      canRoute:
        matched && matched.lessonId ? true : false,
      lessonId:
        matched ? matched.lessonId : '',
      assignmentId:
        matched ? matched.assignmentId : '',
      routeMode:
        matched ? matched.mode : 'EMPTY',
      dryRunOnly:
        true,
      useExistingLessonPlayer4C:
        true,
      realAssignmentStatusWrite:
        false,
      realWriteStep:
        '4I-3'
    },
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4i2UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4i2UniqueArray_(warnings),
    previewedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4i2RunSampleRoutePreview_() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_getAssignmentLearningContext4I1V3({
      childId:
        KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID,
      parentId:
        KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PARENT_ID
    });

  var primary =
    context &&
    context.assignmentLearningContext
      ? context.assignmentLearningContext.primaryAssignment
      : null;

  return kidlearnV3_previewAssignmentLessonRouting4I2V3({
    childId:
      KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID,
    assignmentId:
      primary ? primary.assignmentId : '',
    lessonId:
      primary ? primary.lessonId : ''
  });
}

    errorCount:

function kidlearnV3_4i2CheckMarkers_(content, markers, label, errors) {
  content =
    String(content || '');

  for (var i = 0; i < markers.length; i++) {
    if (content.indexOf(markers[i]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        label + ' thiếu marker: ' + markers[i]
      );
    }
  }
}


/**
 * ================================================================
 * Generic helpers
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_4i2CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  try {
    if (typeof kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_ === 'function') {
      kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

      return {
        success: true,
        environment: 'DEV',
        prodWriteAllowed: false,
        errors: []
      };
    }
  } catch (errorAssertDev) {
    errors.push(
      String(errorAssertDev.message || errorAssertDev)
    );
  }

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      kidlearnV3_4i2UniqueArray_(errors)
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4i2SafeCall_(functionName, args) {
  args =
    args || [];

  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName:
          functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output:
          null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn.apply(null, args);

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      nextBundle:
        output && output.nextBundle ? output.nextBundle : '',
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4i2PreviewValue_(JSON.stringify(output || {})),
      output:
        output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output:
        null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4i2PreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 450) {
    return text.substring(0, 450) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4i2UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  items =
    items || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4i2SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success:
        result.success,
      action:
        result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.PHASE,
      parentPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status:
        status,
      uiName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.UI_NAME,
      contextSummary:
        result.contextSummary || null,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed:
        false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4i2SaveRoutePreview_(result) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_KEYS.LAST_ROUTE_PREVIEW_AT,
    new Date().toISOString()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_4I2_KEYS.LAST_ROUTE_PREVIEW_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success:
        result.success,
      action:
        result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase,
      routePreview:
        result.routePreview || {},
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4i2ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw:
        text
    };
  }
}
