 * Safety:
 * - Không ghi DATA_Responses.
 * - Không ghi LOG_Audit.
 * - Không ghi Google Drive.
 * - Không tạo DATA_Assignments.
 * - Không reset DATA_LessonProgress.
 * - Chỉ ghi ScriptProperties trạng thái kỹ thuật 4F-4A.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4F4A_STATUS',
  LAST_PREVIEW_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4F4A_LAST_PREVIEW_AT',
  LAST_CHECK_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4F4A_LAST_CHECK_AT',
  LAST_READY_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4F4A_LAST_READY_AT',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4F4A_LAST_RESULT_JSON'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_STATUS = {
  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  PREVIEWED: 'PREVIEWED',
  CHECK_PASSED: 'CHECK_PASSED',
  READY_FOR_4F_4B: 'READY_FOR_4F_4B',
  FAILED: 'FAILED'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG = {
  PHASE: '4F-4A',
  PARENT_PHASE: '4F',
  PREVIOUS_BUNDLE: '4F-3',
  NEXT_BUNDLE: '4F-4B',
  NEXT_STAGE: 'CHILD_HOME_RETRY_CARD_UI_READ_ONLY',
  CONTEXT_NAME: 'CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_READ_ONLY',
  DEFAULT_CHILD_ID: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
  TARGET_REVIEW_STATUS: 'REVIEWED_RETRY',
  PROD_WRITE_ALLOWED: false,
  REAL_SHEET_WRITE_ALLOWED_NOW: false,
  REAL_DRIVE_WRITE_ALLOWED_NOW: false
};


/**
 * Main context function for UI.
 *
 * options:
 * {
 *   childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
 *   limit: 20
 * }
 */
function kidlearnV3_getChildRetryContext4F4AV3(options) {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_4f4aBuildChildRetryContext_(options || {});

  result.action =
    'GET_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F_4A_V3';

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4F-4A child retry context failed. Errors=' +
      result.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Preview 4F-4A.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewChildRetryContext4F4AV3() {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_4f4aBuildChildRetryContext_({});

  result.action =
    'PREVIEW_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F_4A_V3';

  result.status =
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_STATUS.PREVIEWED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_STATUS.FAILED;

  kidlearnV3_4f4aSaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.status,
    KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4F-4A preview failed. Errors=' +
      result.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Check 4F-4A.
 */
function kidlearnV3_checkChildRetryContext4F4AV3() {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_4f4aBuildChildRetryContext_({});

  result.action =
    'CHECK_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F_4A_V3';

  result.status =
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_STATUS.CHECK_PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_STATUS.FAILED;

  kidlearnV3_4f4aSaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.status,
    KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_KEYS.LAST_CHECK_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4F-4A check failed. Errors=' +
      result.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Mark ready for 4F-4B.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markChildRetryContext4F4AReadyV3() {
  var check =
    kidlearnV3_checkChildRetryContext4F4AV3();

  if (!check.success) {
    throw new Error('4F-4A check chưa pass.');
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F_4A_READY_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_STATUS.READY_FOR_4F_4B,
    contextName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.CONTEXT_NAME,
    targetReviewStatus:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.TARGET_REVIEW_STATUS,
    retryCount:
      check.retryQueue ? check.retryQueue.retryCount : 0,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    message:
      '4F-4A ready. Có thể qua 4F-4B để hiển thị card Bài cần làm lại trên Child Home.',
    markedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_4f4aSaveStatus_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_STATUS.READY_FOR_4F_4B,
    KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


/**
 * Get status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getChildRetryContext4F4AStatusV3() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'GET_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F_4A_STATUS_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    status:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_KEYS.STATUS
      ) ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_STATUS.NOT_RUN,
    lastPreviewAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
      ) || '',
    lastCheckAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_KEYS.LAST_CHECK_AT
      ) || '',
    lastReadyAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
      ) || '',
    lastResult:
      kidlearnV3_4f4aReadJsonProperty_(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON
      ),
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertChildRetryContext4F4AReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getChildRetryContext4F4AStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_STATUS.READY_FOR_4F_4B
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '4F-4A chưa READY_FOR_4F_4B. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'ASSERT_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F_4A_READY_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      status.status,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    errors:
      errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(errors.join(' | '));
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * QA batch.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaBatch4F4AV3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewChildRetryContext4F4AV3();

  var check =
    kidlearnV3_checkChildRetryContext4F4AV3();

  var ready =
    kidlearnV3_markChildRetryContext4F4AReadyV3();

  var assertReady =
    kidlearnV3_assertChildRetryContext4F4AReadyV3();

  var result = {
    success:
      preview.success === true &&
      check.success === true &&
      ready.success === true &&
      assertReady.success === true,
    suiteName:
      'PHASE_4F_4A_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_READ_ONLY',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_STATUS.READY_FOR_4F_4B,
    retryCount:
      check.retryQueue ? check.retryQueue.retryCount : 0,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    results: {
      preview: preview.success,
      check: check.success,
      ready: ready.success,
      assertReady: assertReady.success
    }
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error('4F-4A QA batch failed.');
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Build child retry context.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4aBuildChildRetryContext_(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var childId =
    String(
      options.childId ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID
    ).trim();

  var limit =
    Number(options.limit || 20);

  if (isNaN(limit) || limit <= 0) {
    limit = 20;
  }

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4f4aCheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var f3 =
    kidlearnV3_4f4aSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertParentReviewUiWriteGate4F3ReadyV3'
    );

  if (!f3.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4F-3 chưa READY_FOR_4F_4: ' +
      f3.message
    );
  }

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aOpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (errorOpen) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được DEV spreadsheet: ' +
      String(errorOpen.message || errorOpen)
    );
  }

  var responseReadiness = null;
  var retryItems = [];
  var childMap = {};
  var subjectMap = {};
  var lessonMap = {};

  if (spreadsheet) {
    responseReadiness =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aInspectDataResponses_(spreadsheet);

    if (!responseReadiness.success) {
      errors =
        errors.concat(responseReadiness.errors || []);
    }

    childMap =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aBuildChildMap_(spreadsheet);

    subjectMap =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aBuildSubjectMap_(spreadsheet);

    lessonMap =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aBuildLessonMap_(spreadsheet);

    if (responseReadiness.success) {
      retryItems =
        kidlearnV3_4f4aCollectRetryItems_({
          sheet:
            responseReadiness.sheet,
          headers:
            responseReadiness.headers,
          columnMap:
            responseReadiness.columnMap,
          metadataColumnIndex:
            responseReadiness.metadataColumnIndex,
          childId:
            childId,
          limit:
            limit,
          childMap:
            childMap,
          subjectMap:
            subjectMap,
          lessonMap:
            lessonMap
        });

      warnings =
        warnings.concat(retryItems.warnings || []);

      retryItems =
        retryItems.items || [];
    }
  }

  var childInfo =
    kidlearnV3_4f4aResolveChildInfo_(
      childId,
      childMap
    );

  var retryQueue =
    kidlearnV3_4f4aBuildRetryQueue_(
      childId,
      retryItems
    );

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F_4A_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    contextName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.CONTEXT_NAME,
    child:
      childInfo,
    targetReviewStatus:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.TARGET_REVIEW_STATUS,
    rolePolicy: {
      childCanSeeRetryQueue:
        true,
      familyAdminCanSeeRetryQueue:
        true,
      childCanOpenLesson:
        true,
      childCanOpenDriveLink:
        false,
      parentCanOpenDriveLink:
        true
    },
    retryFlowPolicy: {
      readOnlyNow:
        true,
      createsDataAssignmentsNow:
        false,
      resetsLessonProgressNow:
        false,
      createsNewLessonAttemptNow:
        false,
      openOldLessonOnly:
        true,
      writePhase:
        'NONE_IN_4F_4A',
      routingPhase:
        '4F-4C'
    },
    uiPolicy: {
      showRetryCardOnChildHome:
        retryQueue.retryCount > 0,
      showEmptyState:
        retryQueue.retryCount === 0,
      cardTitle:
        'Bài cần làm lại',
      primaryButtonLabel:
        'Làm lại bài này',
      nextUiStep:
        '4F-4B'
    },
    retryQueue:
      retryQueue,
    sourceInfo: {
      responseSheet:
        'DATA_Responses',
      metadataColumn:
        responseReadiness && responseReadiness.metadataColumnName
          ? responseReadiness.metadataColumnName
          : '',
      rowsScanned:
        responseReadiness ? responseReadiness.rowsScanned : 0,
      currentLogic:
        'Filter answerMetaJson.handwritingReview.status == REVIEWED_RETRY'
    },
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4f4aUniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4f4aUniqueArray_(warnings)
  };

  return result;
}


/**
 * DATA_Responses readiness.
 * 4F-4A-P1:
 * More flexible metadata column detection.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4aInspectDataResponses_(spreadsheet) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4f4aGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Responses'
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      success: false,
      errors: [
        'Không tìm thấy sheet DATA_Responses.'
      ]
    };
  }

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  if (lastColumn < 1) {
    return {
      success: false,
      sheet:
        sheet,
      errors: [
        'DATA_Responses không có header.'
      ]
    };
  }

  var headers =
    sheet
      .getRange(1, 1, 1, lastColumn)
      .getValues()[0];

  var columnMap =
    kidlearnV3_4f4aBuildColumnMap_(headers);

  var metadataResult =
    kidlearnV3_4f4aResolveMetadataColumnIndex4F4AP1_(
      sheet,
      headers
    );

  if (!metadataResult.success) {
    errors.push(
      'DATA_Responses thiếu metadata column. ' +
      'Không tìm được bằng alias, 4E-4 lastLink, hoặc scan JSON.'
    );
  } else {
    warnings =
      warnings.concat(metadataResult.warnings || []);
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    sheet:
      sheet,
    headers:
      headers,
    columnMap:
      columnMap,
    metadataColumnIndex:
      metadataResult.metadataColumnIndex,
    metadataColumnName:
      metadataResult.metadataColumnName,
    metadataColumnSource:
      metadataResult.source,
    rowsScanned:
      Math.max(0, lastRow - 1),
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      warnings.length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Collect retry items.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4aCollectRetryItems_(params) {
  var sheet =
    params.sheet;

  var headers =
    params.headers || [];

  var columnMap =
    params.columnMap || {};

  var childId =
    params.childId || '';

  var limit =
    params.limit || 20;

  var childMap =
    params.childMap || {};

  var subjectMap =
    params.subjectMap || {};

  var lessonMap =
    params.lessonMap || {};

  var warnings = [];
  var items = [];

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 2) {
    return {
      items: [],
      warnings: warnings
    };
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, lastColumn)
      .getValues();

    var metaIndex =
    typeof params.metadataColumnIndex === 'number'
      ? params.metadataColumnIndex
      : -1;

  if (metaIndex < 0) {
    metaIndex =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aFindColumnIndexByAliases_(
        headers,
        [
          'answerMetaJson',
          'answerMetaJSON',
          'answerMetadataJson',
          'responseMetaJson',
          'responseMetadataJson',
          'detailsJson',
          'metaJson',
          'payloadJson',
          'metadataJson',
          'metadata',
          'answerMeta',
          'details',
          'payload'
        ]
      );
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var rowNumber =
      i + 2;

    var metaText =
      metaIndex >= 0
        ? String(row[metaIndex] || '')
        : '';

    var parsed =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aSafeJsonParse_(metaText);

    if (!parsed.success) {
      if (metaText) {
        warnings.push(
          'Row ' + rowNumber + ' answerMetaJson không phải JSON hợp lệ.'
        );
      }

      continue;
    }

    var meta =
      parsed.value || {};

    var review =
      meta.handwritingReview || {};

    var asset =
      meta.handwritingAsset || {};

    var currentReviewStatus =
      String(
        review.status ||
        asset.reviewStatus ||
        ''
      )
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();

    if (
      currentReviewStatus !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_CONTEXT_4F4A_CONFIG.TARGET_REVIEW_STATUS
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    var itemChildId =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aReadValueByAliases_(
        row,
        headers,
        [
          'childId',
          'studentId',
          'learnerId'
        ]
      ) ||
      meta.childId ||
      asset.childId ||
      '';

    itemChildId =
      String(itemChildId || '').trim();

    if (
      childId &&
      itemChildId &&
      itemChildId !== childId
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    var responseId =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aReadValueByAliases_(
        row,
        headers,
        [
          'responseId',
          'id'
        ]
      ) ||
      meta.responseId ||
      asset.responseId ||
      '';

    var lessonId =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aReadValueByAliases_(
        row,
        headers,
        [
          'lessonId'
        ]
      ) ||
      meta.lessonId ||
      asset.lessonId ||
      '';

    var activityId =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aReadValueByAliases_(
        row,
        headers,
        [
          'activityId'
        ]
      ) ||
      meta.activityId ||
      asset.activityId ||
      '';

    var subjectCode =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aReadValueByAliases_(
        row,
        headers,
        [
          'subjectCode',
          'subjectId'
        ]
      ) ||
      meta.subjectCode ||
      asset.subjectCode ||
      '';

    var answerMode =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aReadValueByAliases_(
        row,
        headers,
        [
          'answerMode'
        ]
      ) ||
      meta.answerMode ||
      asset.answerMode ||
      'HANDWRITE_INPUT';

    var lessonInfo =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aResolveLessonInfo_(
        lessonId,
        lessonMap
      );

    var subjectInfo =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aResolveSubjectInfo_(
        subjectCode || lessonInfo.subjectCode,
        subjectMap
      );

    var resolvedChild =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aResolveChildInfo_(
        itemChildId || childId,
        childMap
      );

    var item = {
      retryId:
        'RETRY_' +
        String(responseId || rowNumber),
      responseId:
        String(responseId || ''),
      responseRowNumber:
        rowNumber,
      childId:
        itemChildId || childId,
      childName:
        resolvedChild.name,
      subjectCode:
        subjectInfo.subjectCode,
      subjectName:
        subjectInfo.subjectName,
      lessonId:
        String(lessonId || ''),
      lessonTitle:
        lessonInfo.lessonTitle || 'Bài học cần làm lại',
      activityId:
        String(activityId || ''),
      answerMode:
        String(answerMode || 'HANDWRITE_INPUT'),
      reviewStatus:
        currentReviewStatus,
      reviewerNote:
        String(review.reviewerNote || ''),
      reviewedAt:
        String(review.reviewedAt || ''),
      reviewedBy:
        String(review.reviewedBy || ''),
      handwritingAsset: {
        fileId:
          String(asset.fileId || ''),
        fileUrl:
          String(asset.fileUrl || ''),
        fileName:
          String(asset.fileName || ''),
        mimeType:
          String(asset.mimeType || 'image/png')
      },
      uiText: {
        title:
          'Bài cần làm lại',
        subtitle:
          subjectInfo.subjectName
            ? subjectInfo.subjectName + ' • ' + (lessonInfo.lessonTitle || lessonId)
            : (lessonInfo.lessonTitle || lessonId || 'Bài viết tay'),
        reason:

      },

      sourceMeta: {

/**
 * Spreadsheet helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4aOpenSpreadsheet_() {
  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) {
    return active;
  }

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DEV spreadsheet id.');
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4aGetSheetByExactName_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Header helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4aBuildColumnMap_(headers) {
  var map = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
    var key =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aNormalizeHeader_(headers[i]);

    if (key && map[key] === undefined) {
      map[key] = i;
    }
  }

  return map;
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4aFindColumnIndexByAliases_(headers, aliases) {
  headers =
    headers || [];

  aliases =
    aliases || [];

  var normalizedAliases = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    normalizedAliases[
      kidlearnV3_4f4aNormalizeHeader_(aliases[i])
    ] = true;
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < headers.length; j++) {
    var normalized =
      kidlearnV3_4f4aNormalizeHeader_(headers[j]);

    if (normalizedAliases[normalized]) {
      return j;
    }
  }

  return -1;
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4aReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, aliases) {
  var index =
    kidlearnV3_4f4aFindColumnIndexByAliases_(
      headers,
      aliases
    );

  if (index < 0) return '';

  return row[index];
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4aNormalizeHeader_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '');
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4aCheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      errors
  };
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4aSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName:
          functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      nextBundle:
        output && output.nextBundle ? output.nextBundle : '',
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4f4aPreviewValue_(JSON.stringify(output || {})),
      output:
        output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output:
        null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4aSafeJsonParse_(text) {
  text =
    String(text || '').trim();

  if (!text) {
    return {
      success: true,
      value: {},
      raw: ''
    };
  }

  try {
    return {
      success: true,
      value: JSON.parse(text),
      raw: text
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      value: {},
      raw: text,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4aPreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 350) {
    return text.substring(0, 350) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4aUniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * 4F-4A-P1
 * Resolve metadata column flexibly.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4aResolveMetadataColumnIndex4F4AP1_(sheet, headers) {
  var warnings = [];

  var directIndex =
    kidlearnV3_4f4aFindColumnIndexByAliases_(
      headers,
      [
        'answerMetaJson',
        'answerMetaJSON',
        'answerMetadataJson',
        'responseMetaJson',
        'responseMetadataJson',
        'detailsJson',
        'metaJson',
        'payloadJson',
        'metadataJson',
        'metadata',
        'answerMeta',
        'details',
        'payload'
      ]
    );

  if (directIndex >= 0) {
    return {
      success: true,
      metadataColumnIndex: directIndex,
      metadataColumnName: String(headers[directIndex] || ''),
      source: 'HEADER_ALIAS',
      warnings: warnings
    };
  }

  var from4E4 =
    kidlearnV3_4f4aResolveMetadataColumnFrom4E4LastLink4F4AP1_(
      headers
    );

  if (from4E4.success) {
    warnings.push(
      'Metadata column được lấy từ 4E-4 lastLink, không phải từ tên header.'
    );

    return {
      success: true,
      metadataColumnIndex: from4E4.metadataColumnIndex,
      metadataColumnName: String(headers[from4E4.metadataColumnIndex] || ''),
      source: '4E_4_LAST_LINK',
      warnings: warnings
    };
  }

  var fromScan =
    kidlearnV3_4f4aScanMetadataColumnByJson4F4AP1_(
      sheet,
      headers
    );

  if (fromScan.success) {
    warnings.push(
      'Metadata column được nhận diện bằng cách scan JSON trong DATA_Responses.'
    );

    return {
      success: true,
      metadataColumnIndex: fromScan.metadataColumnIndex,
      metadataColumnName: String(headers[fromScan.metadataColumnIndex] || ''),
      source: 'SCAN_JSON_HANDWRITING_META',
      warnings: warnings
    };
  }

  return {
    success: false,
    metadataColumnIndex: -1,
    metadataColumnName: '',
    source: 'NOT_FOUND',
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Try to reuse metadataColumnIndex stored by 4E-4 lastLink.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4aResolveMetadataColumnFrom4E4LastLink4F4AP1_(headers) {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getHandwritingAssetLink4E4StatusV3 !== 'function'
    ) {
      return {
        success: false
      };
    }

    var status =
      kidlearnV3_getHandwritingAssetLink4E4StatusV3();

    var lastLink =
      status && status.lastLink
        ? status.lastLink
        : null;

    if (
      !lastLink &&
      status &&
      status.lastResult &&
      status.lastResult.lastLink
    ) {
      lastLink =
        status.lastResult.lastLink;
    }

    if (!lastLink) {
      return {
        success: false
      };
    }

    var oneBasedIndex =
      Number(lastLink.metadataColumnIndex || 0);

    if (
      isNaN(oneBasedIndex) ||
      oneBasedIndex <= 0
    ) {
      return {
        success: false
      };
    }

    var zeroBasedIndex =
      oneBasedIndex - 1;

    if (
      zeroBasedIndex < 0 ||
      zeroBasedIndex >= headers.length
    ) {
      return {
        success: false
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      metadataColumnIndex: zeroBasedIndex,
      metadataColumnName: String(headers[zeroBasedIndex] || ''),
      source: '4E_4_LAST_LINK'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Fallback: scan DATA_Responses cells to find JSON containing
 * handwritingReview or handwritingAsset.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4aScanMetadataColumnByJson4F4AP1_(sheet, headers) {
  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 2 || lastColumn < 1) {
    return {
      success: false
    };
  }

  var rowCount =
    Math.min(lastRow - 1, 80);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, rowCount, lastColumn)
      .getValues();

  var columnScores = [];

  for (var c = 0; c < lastColumn; c++) {
    columnScores[c] = 0;
  }

  for (var r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
    for (var col = 0; col < lastColumn; col++) {
      var text =
        String(values[r][col] || '').trim();

      if (!text) continue;

      if (
        text.indexOf('{') !== 0 &&
        text.indexOf('[') !== 0
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      var parsed =
        kidlearnV3_4f4aSafeJsonParse_(text);

      if (!parsed.success) continue;

      var meta =
        parsed.value || {};

      if (
        meta.handwritingReview ||
        meta.handwritingAsset ||
        meta.answerMode ||
        meta.updatedAt
      ) {
        columnScores[col] =
          columnScores[col] + 1;
      }
    }
  }

  var bestIndex = -1;
  var bestScore = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < columnScores.length; i++) {
    if (columnScores[i] > bestScore) {
      bestScore = columnScores[i];
      bestIndex = i;
    }
  }

  if (bestIndex >= 0 && bestScore > 0) {
    return {
      success: true,
      metadataColumnIndex: bestIndex,
      metadataColumnName: String(headers[bestIndex] || ''),
      score: bestScore,
      source: 'SCAN_JSON_HANDWRITING_META'
    };
  }

  return {
    success: false
  };
}

/**

 * options:
 * {

 *   lessonId: '...',
 *   childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT'
 * }
 */
function kidlearnV3_getRetryLessonRoute4F4CV3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var result =
    kidlearnV3_4f4cBuildRetryRoute_(options);

  result.action =
    'GET_RETRY_LESSON_ROUTE_4F_4C_V3';

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4F-4C retry lesson route failed. Errors=' +

  return result;

/**
 * Build readiness.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4cBuildReadiness_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4f4cCheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var f4b =
    kidlearnV3_4f4cSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertChildRetryCardUi4F4BReadyV3'
    );

  if (!f4b.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4F-4B chưa READY_FOR_4F_4C: ' +
      f4b.message
    );
  }

  var retryContextCall =
    kidlearnV3_4f4cSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getChildRetryContext4F4AV3'
    );

  if (!retryContextCall.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được retry context 4F-4A: ' +
      retryContextCall.message
    );
  }

  var requiredFunctions =
    kidlearnV3_4f4cCheckRequiredFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_getChildRetryContext4F4AV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getLessonPlayerContext4C3V3'
    ]);

  if (!requiredFunctions.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(requiredFunctions.errors || []);
  }

  var markers =
    kidlearnV3_4f4cInspectUiMarkers_();

  if (!markers.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(markers.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(markers.warnings || []);

  var retryContext =
    retryContextCall.output || null;

  var retryCount =
    retryContext && retryContext.retryQueue
      ? Number(retryContext.retryQueue.retryCount || 0)
      : 0;

  if (retryCount === 0) {
    warnings.push(
      'retryCount = 0. Đây là hợp lệ nếu chưa có bài REVIEWED_RETRY để test UI.'
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_CHILD_RETRY_LESSON_ROUTING_READINESS_4F_4C_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_ROUTING_4F4C_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_ROUTING_4F4C_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    routingName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_ROUTING_4F4C_CONFIG.ROUTING_NAME,
    prerequisite: {
      phase4F4BReady:
        f4b.success === true,
      retryContextReadable:
        retryContextCall.success === true,
      lessonPlayerContextFunctionExists:
        requiredFunctions.success === true
    },
    retryContext:
      retryContext,
    uiBehavior: {
      buttonAction:
        'open-retry-lesson-4f4c',
      opensExistingLessonPlayer:
        true,
      childCanOpenDriveLink:
        false,
      createsAssignmentNow:
        false,
      resetsLessonProgressNow:
        false,
      writesStudySessionNow:
        false
    },
    uiMarkers:
      markers,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_ROUTING_4F4C_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_ROUTING_4F4C_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4f4cUniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4f4cUniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Build actual route for UI.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4cBuildRetryRoute_(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var childId =
    String(
      options.childId ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_ROUTING_4F4C_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID
    ).trim();

  var responseId =
    String(options.responseId || '').trim();

  var lessonId =
    String(options.lessonId || '').trim();

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4f4cCheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var context = null;

  try {
    context =
      kidlearnV3_getChildRetryContext4F4AV3({
        childId:
          childId,
        limit:
          100
      });
  } catch (errorContext) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được child retry context: ' +
      String(errorContext.message || errorContext)
    );
  }

  var item = null;

  if (context && context.retryQueue && context.retryQueue.items) {
    item =
      kidlearnV3_4f4cFindRetryItem_(
        context.retryQueue.items,
        responseId,
        lessonId
      );
  }

  if (!item) {
    errors.push(
      'Không tìm thấy bài REVIEWED_RETRY tương ứng. responseId=' +
      responseId +
      ', lessonId=' +
      lessonId +
      '. Nếu retryCount=0 thì cần có bài được phụ huynh chọn RETRY trước.'
    );
  }

  var lessonPreflight = {
    success: false,
    message: 'NOT_RUN'
  };

  if (item && item.lessonId) {
    lessonPreflight =
      kidlearnV3_4f4cPreflightLessonContext_(
        item
      );

    if (!lessonPreflight.success) {
      warnings.push(
        'Lesson context preflight warning: ' +
        lessonPreflight.message +
        '. UI vẫn thử mở Lesson Player bằng router 4C4.'
      );
    }
  }

  var route = null;

  if (item) {
    route = {
      routeId:
        'RETRY_ROUTE_4F4C_' +
        String(item.responseId || item.lessonId || new Date().getTime()),
      sourcePhase:
        '4F-4C',
      retryMode:
        true,
      childId:
        item.childId || childId,
      responseId:
        item.responseId || '',
      responseRowNumber:
        item.responseRowNumber || '',
      lessonId:
        item.lessonId || '',
      lessonTitle:
        item.lessonTitle || '',
      subjectCode:
        item.subjectCode || '',
      subjectName:
        item.subjectName || '',
      activityId:
        item.activityId || '',
      answerMode:
        item.answerMode || 'HANDWRITE_INPUT',
      reviewStatus:
        item.reviewStatus || 'REVIEWED_RETRY',
      reviewerNote:
        item.reviewerNote || '',
      openMode:
        'OPEN_EXISTING_LESSON_PLAYER',
      targetUiFunction:
        'window.openLessonFromSubjectDashboard4C2',
      childCanOpenDriveLink:
        false,
      writesNow:
        false,
      createsAssignmentNow:
        false,
      resetsLessonProgressNow:
        false,
      uiText: {
        openingMessage:
          'Mở lại bài để con làm lại nhé.',
        lessonButtonLabel:
          'Làm lại bài này'
      }
    };
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_RETRY_LESSON_ROUTE_4F_4C_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_ROUTING_4F4C_CONFIG.PHASE,
    route:
      route,
    lessonPreflight:
      lessonPreflight,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4f4cUniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4f4cUniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4cFindRetryItem_(items, responseId, lessonId) {
  items = items || [];

  responseId =
    String(responseId || '').trim();

  lessonId =
    String(lessonId || '').trim();

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    if (
      responseId &&
      String(items[i].responseId || '').trim() === responseId
    ) {
      return items[i];
    }
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < items.length; j++) {
    if (
      lessonId &&
      String(items[j].lessonId || '').trim() === lessonId
    ) {
      return items[j];
    }
  }

  if (!responseId && !lessonId && items.length) {
    return items[0];
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4cPreflightLessonContext_(item) {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getLessonPlayerContext4C3V3 !== 'function'
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Thiếu kidlearnV3_getLessonPlayerContext4C3V3'
      };
    }

    var context =
      kidlearnV3_getLessonPlayerContext4C3V3({
        childId:
          item.childId || KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_ROUTING_4F4C_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID,
        lessonId:
          item.lessonId || '',
        subjectCode:
          item.subjectCode || '',
        source:
          '4F-4C_RETRY_PREVIEW'
      });

    return {
      success:
        context && context.success === true,
      lessonId:
        item.lessonId || '',
      subjectCode:
        item.subjectCode || '',
      message:
        context && context.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : JSON.stringify(context || {})
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      lessonId:
        item.lessonId || '',
      subjectCode:
        item.subjectCode || '',
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * UI marker inspection.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4cInspectUiMarkers_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var shell = '';
  var client = '';
  var styles = '';

  try {
    shell =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Shell_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Shell_4A: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  try {
    client =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Client_ChildRetryRouting_4F4C')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error2) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_ChildRetryRouting_4F4C: ' +
      String(error2.message || error2)
    );
  }

  try {
    styles =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Styles_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error3) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Styles_4A: ' +
      String(error3.message || error3)
    );
  }

  var shellMarkers = [
    'UI_Product_Client_ChildRetryRouting_4F4C'
  ];

  var clientMarkers = [
    'KIDLEARN_CHILD_RETRY_ROUTING_UI_4F4C',
    'patchChildRetryButtonsForRouting4F4C',
    'openRetryLesson4F4C',
    'kidlearnV3_getRetryLessonRoute4F4CV3',
    'kl-child-retry-routing-4f4c',
    'open-retry-lesson-4f4c'
  ];

  var styleMarkers = [
    '.kl-child-retry-routing-4f4c',
    '.kl-child-retry-routing-feedback-4f4c',
    '.kl-child-retry-routing-feedback-4f4c.is-success',
    '.kl-child-retry-routing-feedback-4f4c.is-error'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < shellMarkers.length; i++) {
    if (shell.indexOf(shellMarkers[i]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        'Shell thiếu include marker: ' +
        shellMarkers[i]
      );
    }
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < clientMarkers.length; j++) {
    if (client.indexOf(clientMarkers[j]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        'Client 4F-4C thiếu marker: ' +
        clientMarkers[j]
      );
    }
  }

  for (var k = 0; k < styleMarkers.length; k++) {
    if (styles.indexOf(styleMarkers[k]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        'CSS 4F-4C thiếu marker: ' +
        styleMarkers[k]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'INSPECT_CHILD_RETRY_ROUTING_UI_MARKERS_4F_4C_V3',
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      warnings.length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Function existence checks.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4cCheckRequiredFunctions_(functionNames) {
  var errors = [];
  var results = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < functionNames.length; i++) {
    var name =
      functionNames[i];

    var exists =
      kidlearnV3_4f4cFunctionExists_(name);

    results.push({
      functionName:
        name,
      exists:
        exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu required function: ' + name
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    results:
      results,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    errors:
      errors
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4cFunctionExists_(functionName) {
  try {
    return eval(
      'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
    ) === true;
  } catch (error) {
    return false;
  }
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4cCheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      errors
  };
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4cSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName:
          functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      nextBundle:
        output && output.nextBundle ? output.nextBundle : '',
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4f4cPreviewValue_(JSON.stringify(output || {})),
      output:
        output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output:
        null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4cPreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 350) {
    return text.substring(0, 350) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4cUniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}

function kidlearnV3_4f4cReadJsonProperty_(key) {

/**
 * Build readiness.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4dBuildReadiness_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4f4dCheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var gateSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4f4dInspectGate_();

  if (!gateSummary.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không kiểm tra được 4F-3 gate: ' +
      gateSummary.message
    );
  } else if (!gateSummary.gateClosed) {
    errors.push(
      '4F-3 gate đang mở. Vui lòng đóng gate trước khi chuẩn bị lock 4F. Current=' +
      gateSummary.gateMode
    );
  }

  var componentChecks = [
    {
      key: '4F-3',
      label: 'Controlled UI Write Gate',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4f4dSafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertParentReviewUiWriteGate4F3ReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4F-4A',
      label: 'Child Retry Context Read-only',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4f4dSafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertChildRetryContext4F4AReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4F-4B',
      label: 'Child Home Retry Card UI Read-only',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4f4dSafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertChildRetryCardUi4F4BReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4F-4C',
      label: 'Retry Lesson Routing',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4f4dSafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertChildRetryLessonRouting4F4CReadyV3'
        )
    }
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < componentChecks.length; i++) {
    if (
      componentChecks[i].required &&
      componentChecks[i].check.success !== true
    ) {
      errors.push(
        componentChecks[i].key +
        ' chưa ready: ' +
        componentChecks[i].check.message
      );
    }
  }

  var retryContextSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4f4dInspectRetryContext_();

  if (!retryContextSummary.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được retry context: ' +
      retryContextSummary.message
    );
  }

  if (
    retryContextSummary.success &&
    retryContextSummary.retryCount === 0
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'retryCount = 0. Đây là hợp lệ nếu chưa có bài REVIEWED_RETRY để test UI thực tế.'
    );
  }

  var routeSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4f4dInspectRouteIfAvailable_(
      retryContextSummary
    );

  if (!routeSummary.success && retryContextSummary.retryCount > 0) {
    errors.push(
      'Có retry item nhưng route không pass: ' +
      routeSummary.message
    );
  }

  if (!routeSummary.success && retryContextSummary.retryCount === 0) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không test route thực tế vì retryCount = 0. Đây là hợp lệ.'
    );
  }

  var uiMarkerSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4f4dInspectUiMarkers_();

  if (!uiMarkerSummary.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(uiMarkerSummary.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(uiMarkerSummary.warnings || []);

  var componentSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4f4dBuildComponentSummary_(
      componentChecks
    );

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_CHILD_RETRY_QA_READY_4F_4D_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_QA_4F4D_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_QA_4F4D_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    qaName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_QA_4F4D_CONFIG.QA_NAME,
    devSafety:
      dev,
    gateSummary:
      gateSummary,
    componentSummary:
      componentSummary,
    retryContextSummary:
      retryContextSummary,
    routeSummary:
      routeSummary,
    uiMarkerSummary:
      uiMarkerSummary,
    readyForPhaseLock:
      errors.length === 0,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_QA_4F4D_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_QA_4F4D_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4f4dUniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4f4dUniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Gate inspection.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4dInspectGate_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getParentReviewUiWriteGate4F3StatusV3 !== 'function'
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Thiếu kidlearnV3_getParentReviewUiWriteGate4F3StatusV3'
      };
    }

    var gate =
      kidlearnV3_getParentReviewUiWriteGate4F3StatusV3();

    var gateMode =
      String(gate.gateMode || '').trim();

    return {
      success:
        gate.success === true,
      gateMode:
        gateMode,
      gateClosed:
        gateMode === KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_QA_4F4D_CONFIG.EXPECTED_GATE_MODE,
      expectedGateMode:
        KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_QA_4F4D_CONFIG.EXPECTED_GATE_MODE,
      writeAllowedNow:
        gate.writeAllowedNow === true,
      message:
        gate.success === true ? 'OK' : JSON.stringify(gate)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      gateMode: '',
      gateClosed: false,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Retry context inspection.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4dInspectRetryContext_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getChildRetryContext4F4AV3 !== 'function'
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        retryCount: 0,
        message:
          'Thiếu kidlearnV3_getChildRetryContext4F4AV3'
      };
    }

    var context =
      kidlearnV3_getChildRetryContext4F4AV3({
        childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
        limit: 100
      });

    var retryQueue =
      context.retryQueue || {};

    var items =
      retryQueue.items || [];

    return {
      success:
        context.success === true,
      retryCount:
        Number(retryQueue.retryCount || items.length || 0),
      itemCount:
        Number(retryQueue.itemCount || items.length || 0),
      targetReviewStatus:
        context.targetReviewStatus || '',
      firstItem:
        items.length > 0
          ? {
              responseId:
                items[0].responseId || '',
              lessonId:
                items[0].lessonId || '',
              subjectCode:
                items[0].subjectCode || '',
              reviewStatus:
                items[0].reviewStatus || ''
            }
          : null,
      emptyStateValid:
        items.length === 0,
      message:
        context.success === true ? 'OK' : JSON.stringify(context)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      retryCount: 0,
      itemCount: 0,
      firstItem: null,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Test route only if retry item exists.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4dInspectRouteIfAvailable_(retryContextSummary) {
  retryContextSummary =
    retryContextSummary || {};

  if (
    !retryContextSummary.firstItem ||
    retryContextSummary.retryCount <= 0
  ) {
    return {
      success: false,
      skipped:
        true,
      reason:
        'NO_RETRY_ITEM',
      message:
        'retryCount = 0, bỏ qua route test thực tế.'
    };
  }

  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getRetryLessonRoute4F4CV3 !== 'function'
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        skipped:
          false,
        message:
          'Thiếu kidlearnV3_getRetryLessonRoute4F4CV3'
      };
    }

    var item =
      retryContextSummary.firstItem;

    var routeResult =
      kidlearnV3_getRetryLessonRoute4F4CV3({
        childId:
          'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
        responseId:
          item.responseId,
        lessonId:
          item.lessonId
      });

    var route =
      routeResult.route || {};

    return {
      success:
        routeResult.success === true &&
        !!route.lessonId,
      skipped:
        false,
      responseId:
        route.responseId || item.responseId || '',
      lessonId:
        route.lessonId || item.lessonId || '',
      subjectCode:
        route.subjectCode || item.subjectCode || '',
      openMode:
        route.openMode || '',
      writesNow:
        route.writesNow === true,
      createsAssignmentNow:
        route.createsAssignmentNow === true,
      resetsLessonProgressNow:
        route.resetsLessonProgressNow === true,
      message:
        routeResult.success === true ? 'OK' : JSON.stringify(routeResult)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      skipped:
        false,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * UI markers.
 */

function kidlearnV3_4f4dCheckMarkers_(content, markers, label, errors) {
  content =

function kidlearnV3_4f4dBuildComponentSummary_(componentChecks) {
  var summary = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < componentChecks.length; i++) {
    summary.push({
      key:
        componentChecks[i].key,
      label:
        componentChecks[i].label,
      required:
        componentChecks[i].required === true,
      success:
        componentChecks[i].check.success === true,
      phase:
        componentChecks[i].check.phase || '',
      status:
        componentChecks[i].check.status || '',
      nextBundle:
        componentChecks[i].check.nextBundle || '',
      message:
        componentChecks[i].check.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : componentChecks[i].check.message
    });
  }

  return summary;
}

  try {

      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&

    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(

          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      errors
  };
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f4dSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName:
          functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      nextBundle:
        output && output.nextBundle ? output.nextBundle : '',
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4f4dPreviewValue_(JSON.stringify(output || {})),
      output:
        output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output:
        null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4dPreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 350) {
    return text.substring(0, 350) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4dUniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4dSaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_QA_4F4D_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_QA_4F4D_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success:
        result.success,
      action:
        result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_QA_4F4D_CONFIG.PHASE,
      parentPhase:
        result.parentPhase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_QA_4F4D_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status:
        status,
      qaName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_QA_4F4D_CONFIG.QA_NAME,
      retryCount:
        result.retryContextSummary
          ? result.retryContextSummary.retryCount
          : result.retryCount || 0,
      gateMode:
        result.gateSummary
          ? result.gateSummary.gateMode
          : result.gateMode || '',
      gateClosed:
        result.gateSummary
          ? result.gateSummary.gateClosed === true
          : result.gateClosed === true,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_QA_4F4D_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_CHILD_RETRY_QA_4F4D_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed:
        false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      errorCount:

      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4f4dReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =

      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * KIDLEARN V3 - 4E-3P
 * Manual Drive Folder ID Config for Handwriting Storage
 *
 * Purpose:
 * - Register manually created Google Drive folders.
 * - Prevent auto-creating root project folders outside project flow.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_CONFIG_4E3P_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4E3P_FOLDER_CONFIG_STATUS',
  ROOT_FOLDER_ID: 'KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_ROOT_FOLDER_ID',
  HANDWRITING_FOLDER_ID: 'KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_FOLDER_ID',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4E3P_FOLDER_CONFIG_LAST_RESULT_JSON'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_CONFIG_4E3P_STATUS = {
  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  READY: 'READY',
  FAILED: 'FAILED'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_CONFIG_4E3P_CONFIRM =
  'REGISTER_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_FOLDER_IDS_4E3P';


function kidlearnV3_registerHandwritingDriveFolderIds4E3PV3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var confirmText =
    String(options.confirm || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  if (
    confirmText !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_CONFIG_4E3P_CONFIRM
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm. Cần confirm=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_CONFIG_4E3P_CONFIRM
    );
  }

  var rootFolderId =
    String(options.rootFolderId || '').trim();

  var handwritingFolderId =
    String(options.handwritingFolderId || '').trim();

  if (!rootFolderId) {
    throw new Error('Thiếu rootFolderId.');
  }

  if (!handwritingFolderId) {
    throw new Error('Thiếu handwritingFolderId.');
  }

  if (rootFolderId === handwritingFolderId) {
    throw new Error(
      'rootFolderId và handwritingFolderId không được giống nhau.'
    );
  }

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4e3pCheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'DEV safety failed: ' +
      dev.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var rootFolder =
    DriveApp.getFolderById(rootFolderId);

  var handwritingFolder =
    DriveApp.getFolderById(handwritingFolderId);

  var isChild =
    kidlearnV3_4e3pFolderHasParent_(
      handwritingFolder,
      rootFolderId
    );

  if (!isChild) {
    throw new Error(
      'Folder handwritingFolderId không nằm trực tiếp trong rootFolderId. ' +
      'Vui lòng tạo HANDWRITING_RESPONSES bên trong folder dự án rồi lấy đúng ID.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'REGISTER_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_FOLDER_IDS_4E3P_V3',
    phase: '4E-3P',
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_CONFIG_4E3P_STATUS.READY,
    rootFolderId: rootFolderId,
    rootFolderName: rootFolder.getName(),
    rootFolderUrl: rootFolder.getUrl(),
    handwritingFolderId: handwritingFolderId,
    handwritingFolderName: handwritingFolder.getName(),
    handwritingFolderUrl: handwritingFolder.getUrl(),
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    note:
      'Manual Drive folder IDs registered. 4E-3 will use these folders.',
    registeredAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperties({
      [KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_CONFIG_4E3P_KEYS.STATUS]:
        KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_CONFIG_4E3P_STATUS.READY,
      [KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_CONFIG_4E3P_KEYS.ROOT_FOLDER_ID]:
        rootFolderId,
      [KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_CONFIG_4E3P_KEYS.HANDWRITING_FOLDER_ID]:
        handwritingFolderId,
      [KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_CONFIG_4E3P_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON]:
        JSON.stringify(result)
    }, false);

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_getHandwritingDriveFolderConfig4E3PV3() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var rootFolderId =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_CONFIG_4E3P_KEYS.ROOT_FOLDER_ID
    ) || '';

  var handwritingFolderId =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_CONFIG_4E3P_KEYS.HANDWRITING_FOLDER_ID
    ) || '';

  var errors = [];

  if (!rootFolderId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu rootFolderId trong ScriptProperties.');
  }

  if (!handwritingFolderId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu handwritingFolderId trong ScriptProperties.');
  }

  var rootFolder = null;
  var handwritingFolder = null;

  if (errors.length === 0) {
    try {
      rootFolder =
        DriveApp.getFolderById(rootFolderId);

      handwritingFolder =
        DriveApp.getFolderById(handwritingFolderId);
    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(
        'Không đọc được folder từ Drive ID: ' +
        String(error.message || error)
      );
    }
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'GET_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_FOLDER_CONFIG_4E3P_V3',
    phase: '4E-3P',
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_CONFIG_4E3P_STATUS.READY
        : KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_CONFIG_4E3P_STATUS.FAILED,
    rootFolderId: rootFolderId,
    rootFolderName: rootFolder ? rootFolder.getName() : '',
    rootFolderUrl: rootFolder ? rootFolder.getUrl() : '',
    handwritingFolderId: handwritingFolderId,
    handwritingFolderName: handwritingFolder ? handwritingFolder.getName() : '',
    handwritingFolderUrl: handwritingFolder ? handwritingFolder.getUrl() : '',
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_assertHandwritingDriveFolderConfig4E3PReadyV3() {
  var config =
    kidlearnV3_getHandwritingDriveFolderConfig4E3PV3();

  if (!config.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4E-3P folder config chưa ready: ' +
      config.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return config;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e3pFolderHasParent_(folder, parentId) {
  var parents =
    folder.getParents();

  while (parents.hasNext()) {
    var parent =
      parents.next();

    if (parent.getId() === parentId) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}

function kidlearnV3_saveHandwritingPngToDrive4E3V3(options) {

      .trim()

    KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_DRIVE_WRITE_4E3_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
