      normalized,
      targetResponse,
      canvasCheck,
      warnings
    );

  if (!drivePlan.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(drivePlan.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(drivePlan.warnings || []);

  var metadataPlan =
    kidlearnV3_4e2BuildResponseMetadataUpdatePlan_(
      normalized,
      targetResponse,
      drivePlan,
      canvasCheck,
      warnings
    );

  if (!metadataPlan.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(metadataPlan.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(metadataPlan.warnings || []);

  var auditPlan =
    kidlearnV3_4e2BuildAuditPreviewPlan_(
      normalized,
      targetResponse,
      drivePlan,
      metadataPlan,
      warnings
    );

  if (!auditPlan.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(auditPlan.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(auditPlan.warnings || []);

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'BUILD_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRY_RUN_PREVIEW_4E_2_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    dryRunName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.DRY_RUN_NAME,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:

    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualAuditWritePerformed: false,
    normalizedPayload:
      kidlearnV3_4e2RedactPayloadForLog_(normalized),
    canvasCheck: canvasCheck,
    targetResponse: targetResponse,
    driveUploadPreview: drivePlan,
    responseMetadataUpdatePreview: metadataPlan,
    auditPreview: auditPlan,
    writePlanFor4E3: {
      operation: 'CONTROLLED_DEV_DRIVE_CREATE_FILE',
      targetMimeType:
        KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.MIME_TYPE,

      prodWriteAllowed: false
    },
    readinessSummary: {
      e1Ready:
        e1.success === true,
      devEnvironmentOk:
        devSafety.success === true,
      canvasPngValid:
        canvasCheck.success === true,
      targetResponseResolved:
        targetResponse.success === true,
      drivePlanBuilt:
        drivePlan.success === true,

        metadataPlan.success === true,
      auditPlanBuilt:
        auditPlan.success === true,
      readyFor4E3ControlledDriveWrite:
        errors.length === 0
    },
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4e2UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4e2UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    success: result.success,
    action: result.action,
    phase: result.phase,
    dryRunName: result.dryRunName,
    targetResponseId:
      targetResponse.responseId || '',
    proposedFileName:
      drivePlan.proposedFileName || '',
    proposedDrivePath:
      drivePlan.proposedDrivePath || '',

      canvasCheck.bytes || 0,

  }, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4E-2 handwriting upload dry-run preview failed. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**

 */

  var result =
    kidlearnV3_buildHandwritingUploadDryRunPreview4E2V3(
      kidlearnV3_4e2BuildSamplePayload_()
    );

  var statusBefore =
    kidlearnV3_4e2GetCurrentStatus_();

  var statusAfter =
    kidlearnV3_4e2ResolveStatusAfterCheck_(
      statusBefore,
      result.success
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_STATUS.PREVIEWED
        : KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_STATUS.FAILED
    );

  result.action =
    'PREVIEW_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRY_RUN_4E_2_V3';

  result.statusBefore =
    statusBefore;

  result.statusAfter =
    statusAfter;

  kidlearnV3_4e2SaveStatus_(
    result,
    statusAfter,
    KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    success: result.success,
    action: result.action,
    phase: result.phase,
    statusAfter: statusAfter,
    nextBundle: result.nextBundle,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    errorCount: result.errorCount,
    warningCount: result.warningCount,
    warnings: result.warnings
  }, null, 2));

  return result;
}

    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    results: {
      preview: preview.success,
      check: check.success,
      ready: ready.success,
      assertReady: assertReady.success
    }
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

/**
 * Sample handwriting payload.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e2BuildSamplePayload_() {
  var responseStatus =
    kidlearnV3_4e2SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getResponseRealWrite4D3StatusV3'
    );

  var responseId = '';
  var childId = 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT';
  var lessonId = 'MATH_L1';
  var activityId = 'MATH_L1_ACT_1';

  if (
    responseStatus.success &&
    responseStatus.output &&
    responseStatus.output.lastWrite
  ) {
    responseId =
      responseStatus.output.lastWrite.responseId || responseId;
  }

  return {
    responseId: responseId,
    childId: childId,
    lessonId: lessonId,
    activityId: activityId,
    subjectCode: 'MATH',
    answerMode: 'HANDWRITE_INPUT',
    canvasDataUrl:
      kidlearnV3_4e2BuildTinyPngDataUrl_(),
    source: '4E-2_SAMPLE_HANDWRITING_DRY_RUN'
  };
}


/**
 * Tiny PNG data URL for dry-run validation only.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e2BuildTinyPngDataUrl_() {
  return 'data:image/png;base64,' +
    'iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mP8/x8AAwMCAO+/p9sAAAAASUVORK5CYII=';
}


/**
 * Normalize payload.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e2NormalizePayload_(payload) {
  payload = payload || {};

  return {
    responseId:
      String(payload.responseId || '').trim(),
    childId:
      String(payload.childId || 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT').trim(),
    lessonId:
      String(payload.lessonId || '').trim(),
    activityId:
      String(payload.activityId || '').trim(),
    subjectCode:
      String(payload.subjectCode || payload.subjectKey || '').trim(),
    answerMode:
      String(payload.answerMode || 'HANDWRITE_INPUT').trim().toUpperCase(),
    canvasDataUrl:
      String(payload.canvasDataUrl || '').trim(),
    source:
      String(payload.source || 'HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRY_RUN_PREVIEW').trim()
  };
}


/**
 * Validate PNG data URL.
 * Không tạo Blob/file.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e2ValidateCanvasDataUrl_(dataUrl) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var text =
    String(dataUrl || '').trim();

  if (!text) {
    errors.push('canvasDataUrl trống.');
  }

  if (
    text &&
    text.indexOf('data:image/png;base64,') !== 0
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'canvasDataUrl không phải PNG base64 data URL.'
    );
  }

  var base64 = '';

  if (text.indexOf(',') > -1) {
    base64 =
      text.split(',')[1] || '';
  }

  if (!base64) {
    errors.push('Không đọc được phần base64 của canvasDataUrl.');
  }

  var bytes = 0;

  if (base64) {
    try {
      var decoded =
        Utilities.base64Decode(base64);

      bytes =
        decoded.length;

      if (bytes < 20) {
        warnings.push(
          'PNG data khá nhỏ. Với bài viết tay thật, dung lượng thường lớn hơn.'
        );
      }

      if (bytes > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
        errors.push(
          'PNG data vượt 5MB. Cần nén hoặc giảm kích thước canvas trước khi lưu.'
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(
        'Không decode được base64 PNG: ' +
        String(error.message || error)
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    mimeType:
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.MIME_TYPE,
    dataUrlPrefixOk:
      text.indexOf('data:image/png;base64,') === 0,
    base64Length:
      base64.length,
    bytes: bytes,
    willCreateBlobNow: false,
    willCreateFileNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Resolve target response.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e2ResolveTargetResponse_(payload, warnings) {
  var errors = [];
  warnings = warnings || [];

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4e2OpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được DEV spreadsheet: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var responseId =
    payload.responseId;

  if (!responseId) {
    var responseStatus =
      kidlearnV3_4e2SafeCall_(
        'kidlearnV3_getResponseRealWrite4D3StatusV3'
      );

    if (
      responseStatus.success &&
      responseStatus.output &&
      responseStatus.output.lastWrite &&
      responseStatus.output.lastWrite.responseId
    ) {
      responseId =
        responseStatus.output.lastWrite.responseId;
      warnings.push(
        'payload không có responseId. Dùng lastWrite.responseId từ 4D-3.'
      );
    }
  }

  if (!responseId) {
    errors.push(
      'Không xác định được responseId để gắn handwriting asset.'
    );
  }

  var headerInfo = null;
  var responseIdColumn = null;
  var metadataColumn = null;
  var targetRowNumber = 0;
  var existingMetaText = '';

  if (spreadsheet) {
    headerInfo =
      kidlearnV3_4e2InspectSheetHeaders_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_Responses',
        warnings
      );

    if (!headerInfo.exists) {
      errors.push('Không tìm thấy DATA_Responses.');
    } else {
      responseIdColumn =
        kidlearnV3_4e2FindHeaderMatch_(
          headerInfo.headers || [],
          [
            'responseId',
            'responseid',
            'id',
            'responseKey',
            'maPhanHoi',
            'maTraLoi'
          ]
        );

      metadataColumn =
        kidlearnV3_4e2FindHeaderMatch_(
          headerInfo.headers || [],
          [
            'answerMetaJson',
            'detailsJson',
            'metaJson',
            'payloadJson',
            'metadataJson'
          ]
        );

      if (!responseIdColumn) {
        errors.push('DATA_Responses không map được responseId/id.');
      }

      if (!metadataColumn) {
        errors.push(
          'DATA_Responses chưa có metadata column để gắn handwritingAsset.'
        );
      }

      if (responseId && responseIdColumn) {
        var sheet =
          kidlearnV3_4e2GetSheetByExactName_(
            spreadsheet,
            'DATA_Responses'
          );

        targetRowNumber =
          kidlearnV3_4e2FindRowById_(
            sheet,
            headerInfo,
            responseIdColumn.columnIndex,
            responseId
          );

        if (!targetRowNumber) {
          errors.push(
            'Không tìm thấy responseId trong DATA_Responses: ' +
            responseId
          );
        } else if (metadataColumn) {
          existingMetaText =
            String(
              sheet
                .getRange(
                  targetRowNumber,
                  metadataColumn.columnIndex
                )
                .getValue() || ''
            );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    responseId: responseId,
    childId: payload.childId,
    lessonId: payload.lessonId,
    activityId: payload.activityId,
    subjectCode: payload.subjectCode,
    answerMode: payload.answerMode,
    sheetName: 'DATA_Responses',
    targetRowNumber: targetRowNumber,
    responseIdColumnDetected: responseIdColumn,
    metadataColumnDetected: metadataColumn,
    existingMetaPreview:
      kidlearnV3_4e2PreviewValue_(existingMetaText),
    existingMetaParsed:
      kidlearnV3_4e2SafeJsonParse_(existingMetaText),
    willUpdateSheetNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };
}


/**
 * Build Drive upload plan.
 * Không tạo folder/file.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e2BuildDriveUploadPlan_(
  payload,
  targetResponse,
  canvasCheck,
  warnings
) {
  var errors = [];
  var localWarnings = [];
  warnings = warnings || [];

  var timestamp =
    kidlearnV3_4e2FormatTimestamp_(new Date());

  var safeChildId =
    kidlearnV3_4e2SafePathPart_(payload.childId);

  var safeLessonId =
    kidlearnV3_4e2SafePathPart_(payload.lessonId || 'UNKNOWN_LESSON');

  var safeResponseId =
    kidlearnV3_4e2SafePathPart_(
      targetResponse.responseId || 'UNKNOWN_RESPONSE'
    );

  var proposedFileName =
    'HW_' +
    timestamp +
    '_' +
    safeResponseId +
    KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.FILE_EXTENSION;

  var folderPlan =
    kidlearnV3_4e2BuildFolderPlan_(
      safeChildId,
      safeLessonId,
      localWarnings
    );

  if (!folderPlan.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(folderPlan.errors || []);
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'BUILD_DRIVE_UPLOAD_PLAN_4E_2_V3',
    storage: 'GOOGLE_DRIVE',
    mimeType:
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.MIME_TYPE,
    proposedFileName: proposedFileName,
    proposedDrivePath:
      [
        KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.ROOT_ASSET_FOLDER_NAME,
        KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.HANDWRITING_FOLDER_NAME,
        safeChildId,
        safeLessonId,
        proposedFileName
      ].join('/'),
    folderPlan: folderPlan,
    canvasBytes:
      canvasCheck.bytes || 0,
    createPlan: {
      createRootFolderIfMissing:
        folderPlan.rootFolder.exists !== true,
      createHandwritingFolderIfMissing:
        folderPlan.handwritingFolder.exists !== true,
      createChildFolderIfMissing:
        folderPlan.childFolder.exists !== true,
      createLessonFolderIfMissing:
        folderPlan.lessonFolder.exists !== true,
      createPngFile:
        true
    },
    futureAssetPreview: {
      fileId: '<created in 4E-3>',
      fileUrl: '<created in 4E-3>',
      fileName: proposedFileName,
      mimeType:
        KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.MIME_TYPE,
      reviewStatus:
        KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.DEFAULT_REVIEW_STATUS
    },
    willCreateFolderNow: false,
    willCreateFileNow: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4e2UniqueArray_(localWarnings).length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4e2UniqueArray_(localWarnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Build folder plan.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e2BuildFolderPlan_(safeChildId, safeLessonId, warnings) {
  var errors = [];
  warnings = warnings || [];

  var rootFolder =
    kidlearnV3_4e2FindFirstFolderByName_(
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.ROOT_ASSET_FOLDER_NAME
    );

  var handwritingFolder = null;
  var childFolder = null;
  var lessonFolder = null;

  if (!rootFolder) {
    warnings.push(
      'Root folder chưa tồn tại. 4E-3 sẽ cần tạo KIDLEARN_DEV_ASSETS.'
    );
  } else {
    handwritingFolder =
      kidlearnV3_4e2FindFirstChildFolderByName_(
        rootFolder.folder,
        KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.HANDWRITING_FOLDER_NAME
      );

    if (!handwritingFolder) {
      warnings.push(
        'HANDWRITING_RESPONSES chưa tồn tại trong root folder. 4E-3 sẽ cần tạo.'
      );
    }
  }

  if (handwritingFolder) {
    childFolder =
      kidlearnV3_4e2FindFirstChildFolderByName_(
        handwritingFolder.folder,
        safeChildId
      );

    if (!childFolder) {
      warnings.push(
        'Child folder chưa tồn tại: ' + safeChildId + '. 4E-3 sẽ cần tạo.'
      );
    }
  }

  if (childFolder) {
    lessonFolder =
      kidlearnV3_4e2FindFirstChildFolderByName_(
        childFolder.folder,
        safeLessonId
      );

    if (!lessonFolder) {
      warnings.push(
        'Lesson folder chưa tồn tại: ' + safeLessonId + '. 4E-3 sẽ cần tạo.'
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    rootFolder:
      kidlearnV3_4e2FolderInfo_(rootFolder),
    handwritingFolder:
      kidlearnV3_4e2FolderInfo_(handwritingFolder),
    childFolder:
      kidlearnV3_4e2FolderInfo_(childFolder),
    lessonFolder:
      kidlearnV3_4e2FolderInfo_(lessonFolder),
    willCreateFolderNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };
}


/**
 * Build DATA_Responses metadata update preview.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e2BuildResponseMetadataUpdatePlan_(
  payload,
  targetResponse,
  drivePlan,
  canvasCheck,
  warnings
) {
  var errors = [];
  var localWarnings = [];
  warnings = warnings || [];

  if (!targetResponse.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không thể build metadata update vì targetResponse chưa hợp lệ.'
    );
  }

  var existingMeta =
    targetResponse.existingMetaParsed &&
    targetResponse.existingMetaParsed.success
      ? targetResponse.existingMetaParsed.value
      : {};

  if (
    targetResponse.existingMetaParsed &&
    targetResponse.existingMetaParsed.raw &&
    !targetResponse.existingMetaParsed.success
  ) {
    localWarnings.push(
      'Metadata hiện tại không phải JSON hợp lệ. 4E-3/4E-4 cần xử lý merge cẩn thận.'
    );
  }

  var proposedMeta =
    kidlearnV3_4e2DeepClone_(existingMeta || {});

  proposedMeta.handwritingAsset = {
    storage: 'GOOGLE_DRIVE',
    fileId: '<created in 4E-3>',
    fileUrl: '<created in 4E-3>',
    mimeType:
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.MIME_TYPE,
    fileName:
      drivePlan.proposedFileName || '',
    drivePath:
      drivePlan.proposedDrivePath || '',
    reviewStatus:
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.DEFAULT_REVIEW_STATUS,
    sourcePhase: '4E-2_DRY_RUN_PREVIEW',
    canvasBytes:
      canvasCheck.bytes || 0,
    createdAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  proposedMeta.handwritingReview = {
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.DEFAULT_REVIEW_STATUS,
    autoOcrEnabled: false,
    aiAutoGradingEnabled: false,
    parentReviewRequired: true
  };

  proposedMeta.answerMode =
    payload.answerMode || 'HANDWRITE_INPUT';

  var proposedMetaJson =
    JSON.stringify(proposedMeta);

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'BUILD_RESPONSE_METADATA_UPDATE_PLAN_4E_2_V3',
    targetSheet: 'DATA_Responses',
    targetRowNumber:
      targetResponse.targetRowNumber,
    responseId:
      targetResponse.responseId,
    metadataColumn:
      targetResponse.metadataColumnDetected,
    existingMetaPreview:
      targetResponse.existingMetaPreview,
    proposedMetaPreview:
      kidlearnV3_4e2PreviewValue_(proposedMetaJson),
    proposedMetaJsonLength:
      proposedMetaJson.length,
    proposedMetaShape: proposedMeta,
    updateOperationFor4E4:
      'MERGE_HANDWRITING_ASSET_IN_ANSWER_META_JSON',
    willUpdateSheetNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4e2UniqueArray_(localWarnings).length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4e2UniqueArray_(localWarnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Build audit preview.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e2BuildAuditPreviewPlan_(
  payload,
  targetResponse,
  drivePlan,
  metadataPlan,
  warnings
) {
  var errors = [];
  var localWarnings = [];
  warnings = warnings || [];

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4e2OpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được DEV spreadsheet để build audit preview: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var headerInfo = null;
  var rowValues = [];
  var matched = [];
  var unmapped = [];
  var auditId =
    'AUD_4E2_DRY_' + new Date().getTime();

  if (spreadsheet) {
    headerInfo =
      kidlearnV3_4e2InspectSheetHeaders_(
        spreadsheet,
        'LOG_Audit',
        warnings
      );

    if (!headerInfo.exists) {
      errors.push('Không tìm thấy LOG_Audit.');
    } else {
      var details = {
        phase: '4E-2',
        dryRunOnly: true,
        action: 'PREVIEW_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD',
        targetSheet: 'DATA_Responses',
        responseId: targetResponse.responseId,
        proposedDrivePath: drivePlan.proposedDrivePath,
        proposedFileName: drivePlan.proposedFileName,
        metadataColumn:
          targetResponse.metadataColumnDetected
            ? targetResponse.metadataColumnDetected.raw
            : '',
        actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
        actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
        note:
          'Dry-run only. No Drive file and no Sheet update in 4E-2.'
      };

      var canonicalData = {
        auditId: auditId,
        action: 'PREVIEW_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_4E2',
        entityType: 'DATA_Responses',
        entityId: targetResponse.responseId,
        detailsJson: JSON.stringify(details),
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        actorId: payload.childId,
        source: '4E-2',
        environment: 'DEV'
      };

      var aliasMap =
        kidlearnV3_4e2GetAuditFieldAliasMap_();

      rowValues =
        kidlearnV3_4e2BuildBlankRow_(
          headerInfo.lastColumn
        );

      for (var key in canonicalData) {
        if (!canonicalData.hasOwnProperty(key)) continue;

        var match =
          kidlearnV3_4e2FindHeaderMatch_(
            headerInfo.headers || [],
            aliasMap[key] || [key]
          );

        if (match) {
          rowValues[match.columnIndex - 1] =
            canonicalData[key];

          matched.push({
            canonical: key,
            matchedHeader: match.raw,
            columnIndex: match.columnIndex
          });
        } else {
          unmapped.push({
            canonical: key
          });
        }
      }

      var required = [
        'auditId',
        'action',
        'entityType',
        'entityId',
        'detailsJson',
        'createdAt'
      ];

      for (var i = 0; i < required.length; i++) {
        if (
          kidlearnV3_4e2IsUnmapped_(
            unmapped,
            required[i]
          )
        ) {
          errors.push(
            'LOG_Audit không map được required field: ' +
            required[i]
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'BUILD_AUDIT_PREVIEW_PLAN_4E_2_V3',
    targetSheet: 'LOG_Audit',
    operation: 'DRY_RUN_AUDIT_APPEND_PREVIEW',
    auditId: auditId,
    targetNextRow:
      headerInfo ? headerInfo.lastRow + 1 : '',
    rowValues: rowValues,
    rowObjectByHeader:
      headerInfo
        ? kidlearnV3_4e2BuildRowObjectByHeader_(
            headerInfo,
            rowValues
          )
        : {},
    matchedFields: matched,
    unmappedFields: unmapped,
    willAppendAuditNow: false,
    actualAuditWritePerformed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4e2UniqueArray_(localWarnings).length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4e2UniqueArray_(localWarnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Drive search helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e2FindFirstFolderByName_(folderName) {
  var iterator =
    DriveApp.getFoldersByName(folderName);

  if (!iterator.hasNext()) return null;

  var folder =
    iterator.next();

  return {
    folder: folder,
    id: folder.getId(),
    name: folder.getName(),
    url: folder.getUrl(),
    exists: true
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2FindFirstChildFolderByName_(parentFolder, folderName) {
  if (!parentFolder) return null;

  var iterator =
    parentFolder.getFoldersByName(folderName);

  if (!iterator.hasNext()) return null;

  var folder =
    iterator.next();

  return {
    folder: folder,
    id: folder.getId(),
    name: folder.getName(),
    url: folder.getUrl(),
    exists: true
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2FolderInfo_(folderWrapper) {
  if (!folderWrapper) {
    return {
      exists: false,
      id: '',
      name: '',
      url: ''
    };
  }

  return {
    exists: true,
    id: folderWrapper.id,
    name: folderWrapper.name,
    url: folderWrapper.url
  };
}


/**
 * Sheet helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e2InspectSheetHeaders_(spreadsheet, sheetName, warnings) {
  warnings = warnings || [];

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4e1InspectSheetHeaders_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4e1InspectSheetHeaders_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName,
      warnings
    );
  }

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4d1InspectSheetHeaders_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4d1InspectSheetHeaders_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName,
      warnings
    );
  }

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4e2GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      exists: false,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      headerRowIndex: 0,
      dataStartRowIndex: 0,
      lastRow: 0,
      lastColumn: 0,
      headers: []
    };
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(1, 1, Math.min(2, lastRow), lastColumn)
      .getValues();

  var headerRowIndex = 1;

  if (
    values.length > 1 &&
    kidlearnV3_4e2HeaderScore_(values[1]) >=
      kidlearnV3_4e2HeaderScore_(values[0]) &&
    kidlearnV3_4e2HeaderScore_(values[1]) >= 3
  ) {
    headerRowIndex = 2;
  }

  var row =
    values[headerRowIndex - 1] || [];

  var headers = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    var raw =
      String(row[i] || '').trim();

    if (!raw) continue;

    headers.push({
      columnIndex: i + 1,
      raw: raw,
      normalized:
        kidlearnV3_4e2NormalizeLookupKey_(raw)
    });
  }

  return {
    exists: true,
    sheetName: sheetName,
    headerRowIndex: headerRowIndex,
    dataStartRowIndex: headerRowIndex + 1,
    lastRow: lastRow,
    lastColumn: lastColumn,
    headers: headers
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2HeaderScore_(row) {
  var score = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(row[i] || '').trim();

    if (/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/.test(value)) {
      score++;
    }
  }

  return score;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2FindHeaderMatch_(headers, aliases) {
  var map = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    map[
      kidlearnV3_4e2NormalizeLookupKey_(aliases[i])
    ] = true;
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < headers.length; j++) {
    if (map[headers[j].normalized]) {
      return headers[j];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2FindRowById_(
  sheet,
  headerInfo,
  idColumnIndex,
  expectedId
) {
  if (!sheet || !idColumnIndex || !expectedId) return 0;

  var startRow =
    headerInfo.dataStartRowIndex || headerInfo.headerRowIndex + 1;

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < startRow) return 0;

  var rowCount =
    lastRow - startRow + 1;

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(startRow, idColumnIndex, rowCount, 1)
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < rowCount; i++) {
    if (
      String(values[i][0]) === String(expectedId)
    ) {
      return startRow + i;
    }
  }

  return 0;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2OpenSpreadsheet_() {
  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) return active;

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DEV spreadsheet.');
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2GetSheetByExactName_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Alias helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e2GetAuditFieldAliasMap_() {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4d5GetAuditFieldAliasMap_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4d5GetAuditFieldAliasMap_();
  }

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4d4GetAuditFieldAliasMap_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4d4GetAuditFieldAliasMap_();
  }

  return {
    auditId: ['auditId', 'auditid', 'logId', 'logid', 'id'],
    action: ['action', 'actionType', 'event', 'operation'],
    entityType: ['entityType', 'targetSheet', 'sheetName', 'objectType'],
    entityId: ['entityId', 'targetId', 'objectId', 'recordId'],
    detailsJson: ['detailsJson', 'payloadJson', 'metaJson', 'description'],
    createdAt: ['createdAt', 'timestamp', 'time', 'loggedAt'],
    actorId: ['actorId', 'userId'],
    source: ['source', 'module', 'phase'],
    environment: ['environment', 'env']
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2IsUnmapped_(unmapped, canonical) {
  for (var i = 0; i < unmapped.length; i++) {
    if (unmapped[i].canonical === canonical) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2BuildBlankRow_(length) {
  var row = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    row.push('');
  }

  return row;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2BuildRowObjectByHeader_(headerInfo, rowValues) {
  var obj = {};
  var headers = headerInfo.headers || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
    obj[headers[i].raw] =
      rowValues[headers[i].columnIndex - 1] || '';
  }

  return obj;
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e2CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'CHECK_DEV_SAFETY_4E_2_V3',
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e2NormalizeLookupKey_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '')
    .replace(/[^\w]/g, '');
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2SafePathPart_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value || '')
      .trim()
      .replace(/[\\\/:*?"<>|#%\{\}\[\]~&]/g, '_')
      .replace(/\s+/g, '_');

  if (!text) return 'UNKNOWN';

  if (text.length > 80) {
    return text.substring(0, 80);
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2FormatTimestamp_(date) {
  var tz =
    Session.getScriptTimeZone() || 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';

  return Utilities.formatDate(
    date,
    tz,
    'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2PreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 180) {
    return text.substring(0, 180) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2SafeJsonParse_(text) {
  text =
    String(text || '').trim();

  if (!text) {
    return {
      success: true,
      value: {},
      raw: ''
    };
  }

  try {
    return {
      success: true,
      value: JSON.parse(text),
      raw: text
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      value: {},
      raw: text,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2DeepClone_(obj) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(obj || {}));
  } catch (error) {
    return {};
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2RedactPayloadForLog_(payload) {
  var copy =
    kidlearnV3_4e2DeepClone_(payload);

  if (copy.canvasDataUrl) {
    copy.canvasDataUrl =
      '[PNG_DATA_URL_REDACTED_LENGTH_' +
      String(payload.canvasDataUrl || '').length +
      ']';
  }

  return copy;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2GetCurrentStatus_() {
  return (
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_KEYS.STATUS
      ) ||
    KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_STATUS.NOT_RUN
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2ResolveStatusAfterCheck_(statusBefore, proposedStatus) {
  if (
    statusBefore ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_STATUS.READY_FOR_4E_3 &&
    proposedStatus !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_STATUS.FAILED
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_STATUS.READY_FOR_4E_3;
  }

  return proposedStatus;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.PHASE,
      parentPhase:
        result.parentPhase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status: status,
      dryRunName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.DRY_RUN_NAME,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_HANDWRITING_UPLOAD_DRYRUN_4E2_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
      targetResponseId:
        result.targetResponse
          ? result.targetResponse.responseId
          : '',
      proposedDrivePath:
        result.driveUploadPreview
          ? result.driveUploadPreview.proposedDrivePath
          : '',
      readinessSummary:
        result.readinessSummary || null,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4e2ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - LEARNING PLAN POLICY + CONTEXT READ-ONLY
 * Step: 4H-1
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * Purpose:
 * - Define safety policy for Parent Controls + Learning Plan.
 * - Build read-only context for Parent Learning Plan UI.
 * - Prepare data for:
 *   + Daily Goal suggestion
 *   + Subject priority suggestion
 *   + Lesson assignment suggestion
 *
 * Safety:
 * - Không ghi DATA_DailyGoals.
 * - Không ghi DATA_Assignments.
 * - Không ghi DATA_LessonProgress.
 * - Không ghi DATA_Responses.
 * - Không ghi LOG_Audit.
 * - Không ghi Google Drive.
 * - Chỉ ghi ScriptProperties trạng thái kỹ thuật 4H-1.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4H1_STATUS',
  LAST_PREVIEW_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4H1_LAST_PREVIEW_AT',
  LAST_CHECK_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4H1_LAST_CHECK_AT',
  LAST_READY_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4H1_LAST_READY_AT',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4H1_LAST_RESULT_JSON',
  POLICY_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4H1_POLICY_JSON',
  WRITE_GATE_MODE: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4H_LEARNING_PLAN_WRITE_GATE_MODE'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_STATUS = {
  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  PREVIEWED: 'PREVIEWED',
  CHECK_PASSED: 'CHECK_PASSED',
  READY_FOR_4H_2: 'READY_FOR_4H_2',
  FAILED: 'FAILED'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_GATE_MODE = {
  CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY: 'CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY',
  OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED: 'OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG = {
  PHASE: '4H-1',
  PARENT_PHASE: '4H',
  PREVIOUS_PHASE: '4G',
  NEXT_BUNDLE: '4H-2',
  NEXT_STAGE: 'PARENT_LEARNING_PLAN_UI_DRY_RUN',
  CONTEXT_NAME: 'LEARNING_PLAN_POLICY_CONTEXT_READ_ONLY',
  DEFAULT_PARENT_ID: 'PARENT',
  DEFAULT_CHILD_ID: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
  DEFAULT_DAILY_GOAL_MINUTES: 20,
  MIN_DAILY_GOAL_MINUTES: 10,
  MAX_DAILY_GOAL_MINUTES: 60,
  MAX_LESSON_SUGGESTIONS: 24,
  PROD_WRITE_ALLOWED: false,
  REAL_SHEET_WRITE_ALLOWED_NOW: false,
  REAL_DRIVE_WRITE_ALLOWED_NOW: false
};


/**
 * Public: get policy only.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getLearningPlanPolicy4H1V3() {
  var policy =
    kidlearnV3_4h1BuildPolicy_();

  console.log(JSON.stringify(policy, null, 2));
  return policy;
}


/**
 * Public: get learning plan context for UI.
 *
 * options:
 * {
 *   parentId: 'PARENT',
 *   childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT'
 * }
 */
function kidlearnV3_getLearningPlanContext4H1V3(options) {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_4h1BuildLearningPlanContext_(options || {});

  result.action =
    'GET_LEARNING_PLAN_CONTEXT_4H_1_V3';

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4H-1 learning plan context failed. Errors=' +
      result.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Preview 4H-1.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewLearningPlanPolicyContext4H1V3() {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_4h1BuildLearningPlanContext_({});

  result.action =
    'PREVIEW_LEARNING_PLAN_POLICY_CONTEXT_4H_1_V3';

  result.status =
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_STATUS.PREVIEWED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_STATUS.FAILED;

  kidlearnV3_4h1SaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.status,
    KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  kidlearnV3_4h1SavePolicy_(result.policy);

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4H-1 preview failed. Errors=' +
      result.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Check 4H-1.
 */
function kidlearnV3_checkLearningPlanPolicyContext4H1V3() {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_4h1BuildLearningPlanContext_({});

  result.action =
    'CHECK_LEARNING_PLAN_POLICY_CONTEXT_4H_1_V3';

  result.status =
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_STATUS.CHECK_PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_STATUS.FAILED;

  kidlearnV3_4h1SaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.status,
    KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.LAST_CHECK_AT
  );

  kidlearnV3_4h1SavePolicy_(result.policy);

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4H-1 check failed. Errors=' +
      result.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Mark ready for 4H-2.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markLearningPlanPolicyContext4H1ReadyV3() {
  var check =
    kidlearnV3_checkLearningPlanPolicyContext4H1V3();

  if (!check.success) {
    throw new Error('4H-1 check chưa pass.');
  }

  kidlearnV3_4h1EnsureDefaultGateMode_();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_LEARNING_PLAN_POLICY_CONTEXT_4H_1_READY_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_STATUS.READY_FOR_4H_2,
    contextName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.CONTEXT_NAME,
    gateMode:
      kidlearnV3_4h1GetCurrentGateMode_(),
    childId:
      check.child ? check.child.childId : '',
    planSummary:
      check.planSummary || {},
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    message:
      '4H-1 ready. Có thể qua 4H-2 để tạo Parent Learning Plan UI dry-run.',
    markedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_4h1SaveStatus_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_STATUS.READY_FOR_4H_2,
    KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


/**
 * Get 4H-1 status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getLearningPlanPolicyContext4H1StatusV3() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'GET_LEARNING_PLAN_POLICY_CONTEXT_4H_1_STATUS_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    status:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.STATUS
      ) ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_STATUS.NOT_RUN,
    gateMode:
      kidlearnV3_4h1GetCurrentGateMode_(),
    lastPreviewAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
      ) || '',
    lastCheckAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.LAST_CHECK_AT
      ) || '',
    lastReadyAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
      ) || '',
    lastResult:
      kidlearnV3_4h1ReadJsonProperty_(
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON
      ),
    policy:
      kidlearnV3_4h1ReadJsonProperty_(
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.POLICY_JSON
      ),
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertLearningPlanPolicyContext4H1ReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getLearningPlanPolicyContext4H1StatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_STATUS.READY_FOR_4H_2
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '4H-1 chưa READY_FOR_4H_2. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    status.gateMode !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_GATE_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '4H learning plan gate không ở CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY. Current=' +
      status.gateMode
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'ASSERT_LEARNING_PLAN_POLICY_CONTEXT_4H_1_READY_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      status.status,
    gateMode:
      status.gateMode,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    errors:
      errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(errors.join(' | '));
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * QA batch 4H-1.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaBatch4H1V3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewLearningPlanPolicyContext4H1V3();

  var check =
    kidlearnV3_checkLearningPlanPolicyContext4H1V3();

  var ready =
    kidlearnV3_markLearningPlanPolicyContext4H1ReadyV3();

  var assertReady =
    kidlearnV3_assertLearningPlanPolicyContext4H1ReadyV3();

  var result = {
    success:
      preview.success === true &&
      check.success === true &&
      ready.success === true &&
      assertReady.success === true,
    suiteName:
      'PHASE_4H_1_LEARNING_PLAN_POLICY_CONTEXT_READ_ONLY',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_STATUS.READY_FOR_4H_2,
    gateMode:
      kidlearnV3_4h1GetCurrentGateMode_(),
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    results: {
      preview: preview.success,
      check: check.success,
      ready: ready.success,
      assertReady: assertReady.success
    }
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error('4H-1 QA batch failed.');
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Build Learning Plan Context.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4h1BuildLearningPlanContext_(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var parentId =
    String(
      options.parentId ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PARENT_ID
    ).trim();

  var childId =
    String(
      options.childId ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID
    ).trim();

  var todayKey =
    kidlearnV3_4h1TodayKey_();

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4h1CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var phase4G =
    kidlearnV3_4h1SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4GClosedLockedV3'
    );

  if (!phase4G.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4G chưa closed locked: ' +
      phase4G.message
    );
  }

  kidlearnV3_4h1EnsureDefaultGateMode_();

  var policy =
    kidlearnV3_4h1BuildPolicy_();

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4h1OpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (errorOpen) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được DEV spreadsheet: ' +
      String(errorOpen.message || errorOpen)
    );
  }

  var availability = {};
  var data = {
    childMap: {},
    subjects: [],
    lessons: [],
    dailyGoals: [],
    assignments: [],
    lessonProgress: [],
    studySessions: []
  };

  if (spreadsheet) {
    data.childMap =
      kidlearnV3_4h1BuildChildMap_(spreadsheet, availability, errors);

    data.subjects =
      kidlearnV3_4h1ReadSubjects_(spreadsheet, availability, errors);

    data.lessons =
      kidlearnV3_4h1ReadLessons_(spreadsheet, availability, errors);

    data.dailyGoals =
      kidlearnV3_4h1ReadDailyGoals_(spreadsheet, childId, availability, errors);

    data.assignments =
      kidlearnV3_4h1ReadAssignments_(spreadsheet, childId, availability, errors);

    data.lessonProgress =
      kidlearnV3_4h1ReadLessonProgress_(spreadsheet, childId, availability, warnings);

    data.studySessions =
      kidlearnV3_4h1ReadStudySessions_(spreadsheet, childId, availability, warnings);
  }

  var dashboardContext = null;

  try {
    if (typeof kidlearnV3_getParentDashboardContext4G1V3 === 'function') {
      dashboardContext =
        kidlearnV3_getParentDashboardContext4G1V3({
          parentId:
            parentId,
          childId:
            childId,
          recentLimit:
            20
        });
    }
  } catch (errorDashboard) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không đọc được dashboard context 4G-1 để gợi ý kế hoạch: ' +
      String(errorDashboard.message || errorDashboard)
    );
  }

  var child =
    kidlearnV3_4h1ResolveChild_(
      childId,
      data.childMap,
      dashboardContext
    );

  var todayGoal =
    kidlearnV3_4h1FindTodayGoal_(
      data.dailyGoals,
      todayKey
    );

  var activeAssignments =
    kidlearnV3_4h1FindActiveAssignments_(
      data.assignments,
      todayKey
    );

  var subjectRecommendations =
    kidlearnV3_4h1BuildSubjectRecommendations_(
      data.subjects,
      data.lessonProgress,
      data.studySessions,
      dashboardContext
    );

  var lessonSuggestions =
    kidlearnV3_4h1BuildLessonSuggestions_(
      data.lessons,
      data.lessonProgress,
      data.assignments,
      subjectRecommendations
    );

  var defaultPlan =
    kidlearnV3_4h1BuildDefaultPlan_(
      todayGoal,
      subjectRecommendations,
      lessonSuggestions
    );

  var planSummary = {
    todayKey:
      todayKey,
    hasTodayGoal:
      !!todayGoal,
    todayGoalMinutes:
      todayGoal ? todayGoal.targetMinutes : 0,
    activeAssignmentCount:
      activeAssignments.length,
    subjectOptionCount:
      data.subjects.length,
    subjectRecommendationCount:
      subjectRecommendations.items.length,
    lessonSuggestionCount:
      lessonSuggestions.items.length,
    defaultDailyGoalMinutes:
      defaultPlan.dailyGoalMinutes
  };

  var learningPlanContext = {
    title:
      'Lập kế hoạch học',
    subtitle:
      'Phụ huynh đặt mục tiêu và giao bài cho bé',
    parentId:
      parentId,
    child:
      child,
    todayKey:
      todayKey,
    policy:
      policy,
    existingPlan: {
      todayGoal:
        todayGoal,
      activeAssignments:
        activeAssignments
    },
    subjectOptions:
      data.subjects,
    subjectRecommendations:
      subjectRecommendations,
    lessonSuggestions:
      lessonSuggestions,
    defaultPlan:
      defaultPlan,
    planSummary:
      planSummary,
    dataAvailability:
      availability,
    uiPolicy: {
      readOnlyNow:
        true,
      dryRunInNextStep:
        true,
      controlledWriteStep:
        '4H-3',
      parentOnly:
        true,
      childVisibilityStep:
        '4H-3',
      showDailyGoalMinutes:
        true,
      showSubjectPriority:
        true,
      showLessonAssignment:
        true
    }
  };

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_LEARNING_PLAN_POLICY_CONTEXT_4H_1_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    contextName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.CONTEXT_NAME,
    gateMode:
      kidlearnV3_4h1GetCurrentGateMode_(),
    parentId:
      parentId,
    child:
      child,
    todayKey:
      todayKey,
    policy:
      policy,
    planSummary:
      planSummary,
    learningPlanContext:
      learningPlanContext,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4h1UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4h1UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Read DATA_Children.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4h1BuildChildMap_(spreadsheet, availability, errors) {
  availability.DATA_Children = {
    exists: false,
    rows: 0
  };

  var map = {};

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4h1GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Children'
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    errors.push('Thiếu sheet DATA_Children.');
    return map;
  }

  availability.DATA_Children.exists = true;
  availability.DATA_Children.rows =
    Math.max(0, sheet.getLastRow() - 1);

  if (sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return map;
  }

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4h1ReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var id =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4h1ReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['childId', 'id']
        ) || ''
      ).trim();

    if (!id) continue;

    map[id] = {
      childId:
        id,
      name:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4h1ReadValueByAliases_(
            row,
            headers,
            ['childName', 'fullName', 'name', 'displayName']
          ) || 'Bé'
        ).trim(),
      grade:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4h1ReadValueByAliases_(
            row,
            headers,
            ['grade', 'class', 'level']
          ) || ''
        ).trim()
    };
  }

  return map;
}


/**
 * Read MST_Subjects.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4h1ReadSubjects_(spreadsheet, availability, errors) {
  availability.MST_Subjects = {
    exists: false,
    rows: 0
  };

  var rows = [];

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4h1GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'MST_Subjects'
    );

    );

  availability.MST_Lessons.exists = true;

  }

  var headers =

      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var lessonId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4h1ReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['lessonId', 'id']
        ) || ''
      ).trim();

    if (!lessonId) continue;

    var status =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4h1ReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['status', 'isActive']
        ) || ''
      ).trim().toUpperCase();

    if (
      status === 'INACTIVE' ||
      status === 'ARCHIVED' ||
      status === 'FALSE'
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    rows.push({
      lessonId:
        lessonId,
      lessonTitle:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4h1ReadValueByAliases_(
            row,
            headers,
            ['lessonTitle', 'title', 'name']
          ) || lessonId
        ).trim(),
      subjectCode:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4h1ReadValueByAliases_(
            row,
            headers,
            ['subjectCode', 'subjectId']
          ) || ''
        ).trim(),
      topicId:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4h1ReadValueByAliases_(
            row,
            headers,
            ['topicId']
          ) || ''
        ).trim(),
      grade:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4h1ReadValueByAliases_(
            row,
            headers,
            ['grade', 'level', 'class']
          ) || ''
        ).trim(),
      sortOrder:
        kidlearnV3_4h1ToNumber_(
          kidlearnV3_4h1ReadValueByAliases_(
            row,
            headers,
            ['sortOrder', 'order', 'lessonOrder']
          )
        )
    });
  }

  rows.sort(function (a, b) {
    if (String(a.subjectCode) !== String(b.subjectCode)) {
      return String(a.subjectCode).localeCompare(String(b.subjectCode));
    }

    return Number(a.sortOrder || 0) - Number(b.sortOrder || 0);
  });

  return rows;
}

/**
 * Build context components.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4h1ResolveChild_(childId, childMap, dashboardContext) {
  childMap =
    childMap || {};

  var fromMap =
    childMap[childId] || {};

  var dashboard =
    dashboardContext && dashboardContext.parentDashboard
      ? dashboardContext.parentDashboard
      : {};

  var fromDashboard =
    dashboard.child || {};

  return {
    childId:
      childId,
    name:
      fromMap.name ||
      fromDashboard.name ||
      fromDashboard.displayName ||
      'Bé',
    displayName:
      fromMap.name ||
      fromDashboard.displayName ||
      fromDashboard.name ||
      'Bé',
    grade:
      fromMap.grade ||
      fromDashboard.grade ||
      ''
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1FindTodayGoal_(dailyGoals, todayKey) {
  for (var i = 0; i < dailyGoals.length; i++) {
    if (dailyGoals[i].goalDate === todayKey) {
      return dailyGoals[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1FindActiveAssignments_(assignments, todayKey) {
  var rows = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < assignments.length; i++) {
    var status =
      String(assignments[i].status || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    var dueDate =
      assignments[i].dueDate || '';

    var active =
      status === '' ||
      status === 'ASSIGNED' ||
      status === 'OPEN' ||
      status === 'IN_PROGRESS' ||
      status === 'PENDING';

    if (!active) {
      continue;
    }

    if (dueDate && dueDate < todayKey) {
      continue;
    }

    rows.push(assignments[i]);
  }

  return rows;
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1BuildSubjectRecommendations_(subjects, lessonProgress, sessions, dashboardContext) {
  var map = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < subjects.length; i++) {
    map[subjects[i].subjectCode] = {
      subjectCode:
        subjects[i].subjectCode,
      subjectName:
        subjects[i].subjectName,
      reason:
        'Môn học trong chương trình',
      priorityScore:
        50,
      completedLessons:
        0,
      inProgressLessons:
        0,
      sessionCount:
        0,
      averageProgressPercent:
        0
    };
  }

  var percentSum = {};
  var progressCount = {};

  for (var j = 0; j < lessonProgress.length; j++) {
    var p =
      lessonProgress[j];

    var code =
      String(p.subjectCode || '').trim();

    if (!code) continue;

    if (!map[code]) {
      map[code] = {
        subjectCode:
          code,
        subjectName:
          code,
        reason:
          'Có dữ liệu tiến độ',
        priorityScore:
          60,
        completedLessons:
          0,
        inProgressLessons:
          0,
        sessionCount:
          0,
        averageProgressPercent:
          0
      };
    }

    var percent =
      Number(p.progressPercent || 0);

    if (
      String(p.status || '').toUpperCase() === 'COMPLETED' ||
      percent >= 100
    ) {
      map[code].completedLessons++;
    } else {
      map[code].inProgressLessons++;
      map[code].priorityScore += 12;
      map[code].reason = 'Có bài đang học dở';
    }

    if (!percentSum[code]) percentSum[code] = 0;
    if (!progressCount[code]) progressCount[code] = 0;

    percentSum[code] += percent;
    progressCount[code]++;
  }

  for (var k = 0; k < sessions.length; k++) {
    var sessionCode =
      String(sessions[k].subjectCode || '').trim();

    if (!sessionCode) continue;

    if (!map[sessionCode]) {
      map[sessionCode] = {
        subjectCode:
          sessionCode,
        subjectName:
          sessionCode,
        reason:
          'Có hoạt động học gần đây',
        priorityScore:
          55,
        completedLessons:
          0,
        inProgressLessons:
          0,
        sessionCount:
          0,
        averageProgressPercent:
          0
      };
    }

    map[sessionCode].sessionCount++;
  }

  for (var code in map) {
    if (map.hasOwnProperty(code)) {
      if (progressCount[code]) {
        map[code].averageProgressPercent =
          Math.round(percentSum[code] / progressCount[code]);
      }

      if (map[code].averageProgressPercent > 0 && map[code].averageProgressPercent < 70) {
        map[code].priorityScore += 8;
        map[code].reason = 'Nên củng cố thêm';
      }
    }
  }

  var dashboard =
    dashboardContext && dashboardContext.parentDashboard
      ? dashboardContext.parentDashboard
      : {};

  var progressBySubject =
    dashboard.progressBySubject && dashboard.progressBySubject.items
      ? dashboard.progressBySubject.items
      : [];

  for (var d = 0; d < progressBySubject.length; d++) {
    var item =
      progressBySubject[d];

    var dashboardCode =
      String(item.subjectCode || '').trim();

    if (!dashboardCode) continue;

    if (!map[dashboardCode]) {
      map[dashboardCode] = {
        subjectCode:
          dashboardCode,
        subjectName:
          item.subjectName || dashboardCode,
        reason:
          'Có dữ liệu dashboard',
        priorityScore:
          50,
        completedLessons:
          0,
        inProgressLessons:
          0,
        sessionCount:
          0,
        averageProgressPercent:
          0
      };
    }

    map[dashboardCode].completedLessons =
      Math.max(
        map[dashboardCode].completedLessons || 0,
        Number(item.completedLessons || 0)
      );

    map[dashboardCode].inProgressLessons =
      Math.max(
        map[dashboardCode].inProgressLessons || 0,
        Number(item.inProgressLessons || 0)
      );

    map[dashboardCode].sessionCount =
      Math.max(
        map[dashboardCode].sessionCount || 0,
        Number(item.sessionCount || 0)
      );

    map[dashboardCode].averageProgressPercent =
      Math.max(
        map[dashboardCode].averageProgressPercent || 0,
        Number(item.averageProgressPercent || 0)
      );
  }

  var items = [];

  for (var subjectCode in map) {
    if (map.hasOwnProperty(subjectCode)) {
      items.push(map[subjectCode]);
    }
  }

  items.sort(function (a, b) {
    return Number(b.priorityScore || 0) - Number(a.priorityScore || 0);
  });

  return {
    itemCount:
      items.length,
    items:
      items,
    recommendedSubjectCode:
      items.length > 0 ? items[0].subjectCode : '',
    emptyState: {
      show:
        items.length === 0,
      title:
        'Chưa có môn học để gợi ý',
      message:
        'Khi có dữ liệu môn học, hệ thống sẽ gợi ý môn ưu tiên.'
    }
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1BuildLessonSuggestions_(lessons, lessonProgress, assignments, subjectRecommendations) {
  var progressMap = {};
  var assignedMap = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < lessonProgress.length; i++) {
    if (lessonProgress[i].lessonId) {
      progressMap[lessonProgress[i].lessonId] = lessonProgress[i];
    }
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < assignments.length; j++) {
    if (assignments[j].lessonId) {
      var status =
        String(assignments[j].status || '').toUpperCase();

      if (
        status === '' ||
        status === 'ASSIGNED' ||
        status === 'OPEN' ||
        status === 'IN_PROGRESS' ||
        status === 'PENDING'
      ) {
        assignedMap[assignments[j].lessonId] = true;
      }
    }
  }

  var prioritySubject =
    subjectRecommendations.recommendedSubjectCode || '';

  var items = [];

  for (var k = 0; k < lessons.length; k++) {
    var lesson =
      lessons[k];

    var progress =
      progressMap[lesson.lessonId] || null;

    var alreadyAssigned =
      assignedMap[lesson.lessonId] === true;

    var score = 50;
    var reason = 'Bài học có thể giao cho bé';

    if (lesson.subjectCode === prioritySubject) {
      score += 25;
      reason = 'Thuộc môn ưu tiên';
    }

    if (!progress) {
      score += 15;
      reason = 'Bài mới chưa học';
    } else if (
      String(progress.status || '').toUpperCase() !== 'COMPLETED' &&
      Number(progress.progressPercent || 0) < 100
    ) {
      score += 20;
      reason = 'Bài đang học dở';
    } else {
      score -= 20;
      reason = 'Bài đã hoàn thành';
    }

    if (alreadyAssigned) {
      score -= 60;
      reason = 'Đã có assignment đang mở';
    }

    items.push({
      lessonId:
        lesson.lessonId,
      lessonTitle:
        lesson.lessonTitle,
      subjectCode:
        lesson.subjectCode,
      topicId:
        lesson.topicId,
      grade:
        lesson.grade,
      progressStatus:
        progress ? progress.status : '',
      progressPercent:
        progress ? progress.progressPercent : 0,
      alreadyAssigned:
        alreadyAssigned,
      suggestionScore:
        score,
      reason:
        reason
    });
  }

  items.sort(function (a, b) {
    return Number(b.suggestionScore || 0) - Number(a.suggestionScore || 0);
  });

  if (items.length > KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.MAX_LESSON_SUGGESTIONS) {
    items =
      items.slice(
        0,
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.MAX_LESSON_SUGGESTIONS
      );
  }

  return {
    itemCount:
      items.length,
    items:
      items,
    recommendedLessonId:
      items.length > 0 ? items[0].lessonId : '',
    emptyState: {
      show:
        items.length === 0,
      title:
        'Chưa có bài học để gợi ý',
      message:
        'Khi có danh sách bài học, phụ huynh có thể chọn bài giao cho bé.'
    }
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1BuildDefaultPlan_(todayGoal, subjectRecommendations, lessonSuggestions) {
  var goalMinutes =
    todayGoal && todayGoal.targetMinutes
      ? Number(todayGoal.targetMinutes)
      : KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.DEFAULT_DAILY_GOAL_MINUTES;

  if (
    goalMinutes < KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.MIN_DAILY_GOAL_MINUTES
  ) {
    goalMinutes =
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.MIN_DAILY_GOAL_MINUTES;
  }

  if (
    goalMinutes > KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.MAX_DAILY_GOAL_MINUTES
  ) {
    goalMinutes =
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.MAX_DAILY_GOAL_MINUTES;
  }

  return {
    dailyGoalMinutes:
      goalMinutes,
    prioritySubjectCode:
      subjectRecommendations.recommendedSubjectCode || '',
    selectedLessonIds:
      lessonSuggestions.recommendedLessonId
        ? [lessonSuggestions.recommendedLessonId]
        : [],
    dryRunOnly:
      true,
    message:
      'Đây là kế hoạch gợi ý read-only. 4H-2 sẽ cho phụ huynh preview dry-run.'
  };
}


/**
 * Gate helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4h1EnsureDefaultGateMode_() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var current =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.WRITE_GATE_MODE
    );

  if (!current) {
    properties.setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.WRITE_GATE_MODE,
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_GATE_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY
    );
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1GetCurrentGateMode_() {
  var mode =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.WRITE_GATE_MODE
      ) ||
    KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_GATE_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY;

  if (
    mode !== KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_GATE_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY &&
    mode !== KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_GATE_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_GATE_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY;
  }

  return mode;
}


/**
 * Spreadsheet helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4h1OpenSpreadsheet_() {
  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) {
    return active;
  }

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DEV spreadsheet id.');
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1GetSheetByExactName_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1ReadHeaders_(sheet) {
  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastColumn() < 1) {
    return [];
  }

  return sheet
    .getRange(1, 1, 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
    .getValues()[0];
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1FindColumnIndexByAliases_(headers, aliases) {
  headers =
    headers || [];

  aliases =
    aliases || [];

  var aliasMap = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    aliasMap[
      kidlearnV3_4h1NormalizeHeader_(aliases[i])
    ] = true;
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < headers.length; j++) {
    var normalized =
      kidlearnV3_4h1NormalizeHeader_(headers[j]);

    if (aliasMap[normalized]) {
      return j;
    }
  }

  return -1;
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, aliases) {
  var index =
    kidlearnV3_4h1FindColumnIndexByAliases_(
      headers,
      aliases
    );

  if (index < 0) return '';

  return row[index];
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1NormalizeHeader_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '');
}


/**
 * Date and value helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4h1TodayKey_() {
  try {
    return Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyy-MM-dd'
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1ToDateKey_(value) {
  if (!value) return '';

  if (Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Date]') {
    try {
      return Utilities.formatDate(
        value,
        Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
        'yyyy-MM-dd'
      );
    } catch (errorDate) {
      return value.toISOString().substring(0, 10);
    }
  }

  var text =
    String(value || '').trim();

  if (!text) return '';

  if (text.length >= 10 && text.charAt(4) === '-') {
    return text.substring(0, 10);
  }

  var date =
    new Date(text);

  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return '';
  }

  try {
    return Utilities.formatDate(
      date,
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyy-MM-dd'
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return date.toISOString().substring(0, 10);
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1ToIso_(value) {
  if (!value) return '';

  if (Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Date]') {
    return value.toISOString();
  }

  var text =
    String(value || '').trim();

  if (!text) return '';

  var date =
    new Date(text);

  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return text;
  }

  return date.toISOString();
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1ToNumber_(value) {
  var number =
    Number(value || 0);

  return isNaN(number) ? 0 : number;
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1SafeJsonParse_(text) {
  text =
    String(text || '').trim();

  if (!text) {
    return {
      success: true,
      value: {},
      raw: ''
    };
  }

  try {
    return {
      success: true,
      value: JSON.parse(text),
      raw: text
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      value: {},
      raw: text,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4h1CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      errors
  };
}


/**
 * Safe call helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4h1SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName:
          functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      nextPhase:
        output && output.nextPhase ? output.nextPhase : '',
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4h1PreviewValue_(JSON.stringify(output || {})),
      output:
        output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output:
        null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1PreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 350) {
    return text.substring(0, 350) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Save helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4h1SavePolicy_(policy) {
  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.POLICY_JSON,
      JSON.stringify(policy || {})
    );
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success:
        result.success,
      action:
        result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.PHASE,
      parentPhase:
        result.parentPhase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status:
        status,
      contextName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.CONTEXT_NAME,
      gateMode:
        result.gateMode ||
        kidlearnV3_4h1GetCurrentGateMode_(),
      childId:
        result.child ? result.child.childId : '',
      planSummary:
        result.planSummary || {},
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed:
        false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4h1ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}
