 * Optional debug helper: no write.
 */
function kidlearnV3_debugLearningPlanSheetHeaders4H3P2V3() {
  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_4h3OpenSpreadsheet_();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'DEBUG_LEARNING_PLAN_SHEET_HEADERS_4H_3P2_V3',
    phase: '4H-3P2',
    DATA_DailyGoals:
      kidlearnV3_4h3DebugSheetHeaderResolution4H3P2_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_DailyGoals',
        [
          {
            field: 'childId',
            aliases: ['childId', 'studentId', 'learnerId']
          },
          {
            field: 'goalDate',
            aliases: ['goalDate', 'date', 'planDate']
          },
          {
            field: 'targetMinutes',
            aliases: ['targetMinutes', 'targetMinute', 'minutes']
          }
        ]
      ),
    DATA_Assignments:
      kidlearnV3_4h3DebugSheetHeaderResolution4H3P2_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_Assignments',
        [
          {
            field: 'childId',
            aliases: ['childId', 'studentId', 'learnerId']
          },
          {
            field: 'lessonId',
            aliases: ['lessonId']
          },
          {
            field: 'status',
            aliases: ['status']
          }
        ]
      ),
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    checkedAt: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3DebugSheetHeaderResolution4H3P2_(spreadsheet, sheetName, requiredFields) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4h3GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      success: false,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      exists: false,
      headers: [],
      resolved: [],
      errors: ['Thiếu sheet ' + sheetName]
    };
  }

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4h3ReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var resolved = [];
  var errors = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < requiredFields.length; i++) {
    var field =
      requiredFields[i];

    var index =
      kidlearnV3_4h3FindColumnIndexByAliases_(
        headers,
        field.aliases
      );

    resolved.push({
      field: field.field,
      columnIndex: index,
      columnNumber: index >= 0 ? index + 1 : null,
      headerName: index >= 0 ? headers[index] : '',
      success: index >= 0
    });

    if (index < 0) {
      errors.push(
        sheetName + ' chưa resolve được field ' + field.field
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    sheetName: sheetName,
    exists: true,
    lastRow: sheet.getLastRow(),
    lastColumn: sheet.getLastColumn(),
    headers: headers,
    resolved: resolved,
    errors: errors
  };
}


/**
 * ================================================================
 * Generic helpers
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_4h3WriteGatePropertyKey_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS &&
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.WRITE_GATE_MODE
    ) {
      return KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.WRITE_GATE_MODE;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  return 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4H_LEARNING_PLAN_WRITE_GATE_MODE';
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3NormalizeStringArray_(value) {
  var raw =
    Array.isArray(value)
      ? value
      : String(value || '').split(',');

  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
    var item =
      String(raw[i] || '').trim();

    if (!item) continue;

    if (!map[item]) {
      map[item] = true;
      result.push(item);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3TodayKey_() {
  try {
    return Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyy-MM-dd'
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3ToDateKey_(value) {
  if (!value) return '';

  if (Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Date]') {
    try {
      return Utilities.formatDate(
        value,
        Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
        'yyyy-MM-dd'
      );
    } catch (errorDate) {
      return value.toISOString().substring(0, 10);
    }
  }

  var text =
    String(value || '').trim();

  if (!text) return '';

  if (text.length >= 10 && text.charAt(4) === '-') {
    return text.substring(0, 10);
  }

  var date =
    new Date(text);

  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return '';
  }

  try {
    return Utilities.formatDate(
      date,
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyy-MM-dd'
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return date.toISOString().substring(0, 10);
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3ToIso_(value) {
  if (!value) return '';

  if (Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Date]') {
    return value.toISOString();
  }

  var text =
    String(value || '').trim();

  if (!text) return '';

  var date =
    new Date(text);

  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return text;
  }

  return date.toISOString();
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3ToNumber_(value) {
  var number =
    Number(value || 0);

  return isNaN(number) ? 0 : number;
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3GetGateMode_() {
  var mode =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        kidlearnV3_4h3WriteGatePropertyKey_()
      ) ||
    KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H3_CONFIG.DEFAULT_GATE_MODE;

  if (
    mode !== KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H3_GATE_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY &&
    mode !== KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H3_GATE_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H3_GATE_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY;
  }

  return mode;
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3AssertDev_() {
  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4h3CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    throw new Error(dev.errors.join(' | '));
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  try {
    if (typeof kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_ === 'function') {
      kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

      return {
        success: true,
        environment: 'DEV',
        prodWriteAllowed: false,
        errors: []
      };
    }
  } catch (errorAssertDev) {
    errors.push(String(errorAssertDev.message || errorAssertDev));
  }

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      kidlearnV3_4h3UniqueArray_(errors)
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName:
          functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      nextBundle:
        output && output.nextBundle ? output.nextBundle : '',
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4h3PreviewValue_(JSON.stringify(output || {}))
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3PreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 350) {
    return text.substring(0, 350) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  items =
    items || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H3_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H3_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success:
        result.success,
      action:
        result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H3_CONFIG.PHASE,
      status:
        status,
      gateMode:
        result.gateMode || kidlearnV3_4h3GetGateMode_(),
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H3_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H3_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed:
        false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
        result.realSheetWriteAllowedNow === true,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        result.actualSheetWritePerformed === true,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3SaveSubmission_(result) {
  var properties =

  properties.setProperty(

      writeSummary:

      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        result.actualSheetWritePerformed === true,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:

}


function kidlearnV3_4h3ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * PATCH 4H-3P3
 * Auto Repair Required Headers for Learning Plan Write.
 *
 * Purpose:
 * - Add missing required columns to DATA_DailyGoals and DATA_Assignments.
 * - Header/schema repair only.
 * - No Daily Goal data write.
 * - No Assignment data write.
 * - No Drive write.
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_repairLearningPlanRequiredHeaders4H3P3ConfirmV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_repairLearningPlanRequiredHeaders4H3P3V3({
    confirm: 'REPAIR_LEARNING_PLAN_HEADERS_4H3P3'
  });
}


function kidlearnV3_repairLearningPlanRequiredHeaders4H3P3V3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var confirmText =
    String(options.confirm || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  if (confirmText !== 'REPAIR_LEARNING_PLAN_HEADERS_4H3P3') {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm. Cần confirm=REPAIR_LEARNING_PLAN_HEADERS_4H3P3'
    );
  }

  kidlearnV3_4h3AssertDev_();

  var lock =
    LockService.getScriptLock();

  var locked =
    lock.tryLock(30000);

  if (!locked) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không lấy được script lock sau 30 giây. Vui lòng chạy lại.'
    );
  }

  try {
    var spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4h3OpenSpreadsheet_();

    var before =
      kidlearnV3_debugLearningPlanSheetHeaders4H3P2V3();

    var dailyGoalsRepair =
      kidlearnV3_4h3RepairSheetHeaders4H3P3_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_DailyGoals',
        [
          {
            canonical: 'goalId',
            aliases: ['goalId', 'dailyGoalId', 'id']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'childId',
            aliases: ['childId', 'studentId', 'learnerId']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'goalDate',
            aliases: ['goalDate', 'date', 'planDate']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'targetMinutes',
            aliases: ['targetMinutes', 'targetMinute', 'minutes']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'completedMinutes',
            aliases: ['completedMinutes', 'actualMinutes', 'doneMinutes']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'status',
            aliases: ['status']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'createdAt',
            aliases: ['createdAt']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'updatedAt',
            aliases: ['updatedAt', 'lastUpdatedAt']
          }
        ]
      );

    var assignmentsRepair =
      kidlearnV3_4h3RepairSheetHeaders4H3P3_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_Assignments',
        [
          {
            canonical: 'assignmentId',
            aliases: ['assignmentId', 'id']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'childId',
            aliases: ['childId', 'studentId', 'learnerId']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'lessonId',
            aliases: ['lessonId']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'subjectCode',
            aliases: ['subjectCode', 'subjectId']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'status',
            aliases: ['status']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'dueDate',
            aliases: ['dueDate', 'planDate', 'assignedDate', 'date']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'assignedAt',
            aliases: ['assignedAt', 'createdAt']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'updatedAt',
            aliases: ['updatedAt', 'lastUpdatedAt']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'source',
            aliases: ['source', 'assignmentSource']
          },
          {
            canonical: 'createdBy',
            aliases: ['createdBy', 'parentId']
          }
        ]
      );

    var after =
      kidlearnV3_debugLearningPlanSheetHeaders4H3P2V3();

    var result = {
      success:
        after.DATA_DailyGoals &&
        after.DATA_DailyGoals.success === true &&
        after.DATA_Assignments &&
        after.DATA_Assignments.success === true,
      action:
        'REPAIR_LEARNING_PLAN_REQUIRED_HEADERS_4H_3P3_V3',
      phase:
        '4H-3P3',
      parentPhase:
        '4H',
      repairSummary: {
        DATA_DailyGoals:
          dailyGoalsRepair,
        DATA_Assignments:
          assignmentsRepair
      },
      debugBefore:
        before,
      debugAfter:
        after,
      prodWriteAllowed:
        false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        true,
      actualLearningDataWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      message:
        'Đã repair header/cột cần thiết. Không ghi Daily Goal hoặc Assignment.',
      repairedAt:
        new Date().toISOString()
    };

    console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

    if (!result.success) {
      throw new Error(
        '4H-3P3 repair xong nhưng debug vẫn chưa pass. Vui lòng gửi debugAfter.headers để kiểm tra.'
      );
    }

    return result;

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3RepairSheetHeaders4H3P3_(spreadsheet, sheetName, definitions) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4h3GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  var createdSheet = false;

  if (!sheet) {
    sheet =
      spreadsheet.insertSheet(sheetName);

    createdSheet = true;
  }

  var headers =
    sheet.getLastColumn() > 0
      ? kidlearnV3_4h3ReadHeaders_(sheet)
      : [];

  var existing = [];
  var missing = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < definitions.length; i++) {
    var definition =
      definitions[i];

    var index =
      kidlearnV3_4h3FindColumnIndexByAliases_(
        headers,
        definition.aliases
      );

    if (index >= 0) {
      existing.push({
        canonical:
          definition.canonical,
        columnNumber:
          index + 1,
        headerName:
          headers[index]
      });
    } else {
      missing.push(definition.canonical);
    }
  }

  var added = [];

  if (missing.length > 0) {
    var lastColumn =
      sheet.getLastColumn();

    var startColumn =
      lastColumn > 0
        ? lastColumn + 1
        : 1;

    var neededMaxColumn =
      startColumn + missing.length - 1;

    var maxColumns =
      sheet.getMaxColumns();

    if (neededMaxColumn > maxColumns) {
      sheet.insertColumnsAfter(
        maxColumns,
        neededMaxColumn - maxColumns
      );
    }

    sheet
      .getRange(1, startColumn, 1, missing.length)
      .setValues([missing]);

    for (var j = 0; j < missing.length; j++) {
      added.push({
        canonical:
          missing[j],
        columnNumber:
          startColumn + j,
        headerName:
          missing[j]
      });
    }
  }

  var finalHeaders =
    sheet.getLastColumn() > 0
      ? kidlearnV3_4h3ReadHeaders_(sheet)
      : [];

  return {
    success:
      true,
    sheetName:
      sheetName,
    createdSheet:
      createdSheet,
    existingCount:
      existing.length,
    addedCount:
      added.length,
    existing:
      existing,
    added:
      added,
    finalHeaders:
      finalHeaders,
    actualSheetStructureWritePerformed:
      added.length > 0 || createdSheet === true,
    actualLearningDataWritePerformed:
      false
  };
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * PATCH 4H-3P6
 * Force targetMinutes header and debug today Daily Goal.
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_4h3EnsureExactHeader4H3P6_(sheet, headerName) {
  var headers =
    sheet.getLastColumn() > 0
      ? kidlearnV3_4h3ReadHeaders_(sheet)
      : [];

  var exactIndex =
    kidlearnV3_4h3FindExactHeaderIndex4H3P6_(
      headers,
      headerName
    );

  if (exactIndex >= 0) {
    return {
      added:
        false,
      columnNumber:
        exactIndex + 1,
      headerName:
        headers[exactIndex]
    };
  }

  var startColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn() > 0
      ? sheet.getLastColumn() + 1
      : 1;

  if (startColumn > sheet.getMaxColumns()) {
    sheet.insertColumnsAfter(
      sheet.getMaxColumns(),
      1
    );
  }

  sheet
    .getRange(1, startColumn)
    .setValue(headerName);

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  return {
    added:
      true,
    columnNumber:
      startColumn,
    headerName:
      headerName
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4h3FindExactHeaderIndex4H3P6_(headers, headerName) {
  var target =
    kidlearnV3_4h3NormalizeHeader_(headerName);

  for (var i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
    if (
      kidlearnV3_4h3NormalizeHeader_(headers[i]) === target
    ) {
      return i;
    }
  }

  return -1;
}


function kidlearnV3_debugTodayDailyGoalTarget4H3P6V3() {
  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_4h3OpenSpreadsheet_();

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4h3GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_DailyGoals'
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    throw new Error('Thiếu sheet DATA_DailyGoals.');
  }

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4h3ReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var childId =
    KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H3_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID;

  var todayKey =
    kidlearnV3_4h3TodayKey_();

  var rowIndex =
    kidlearnV3_4h3FindDailyGoalRow_(
      sheet,
      headers,
      childId,
      todayKey
    );

  var result = {
    success:
      rowIndex > 0,
    action:
      'DEBUG_TODAY_DAILY_GOAL_TARGET_4H_3P6_V3',
    phase:
      '4H-3P6',
    sheetName:
      'DATA_DailyGoals',
    childId:
      childId,
    todayKey:
      todayKey,
    rowIndex:
      rowIndex,
    resolvedColumns:
      {},
    rowValues:
      {},
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    checkedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  var fields = [
    {
      key: 'goalId',
      aliases: ['goalId', 'dailyGoalId', 'id']
    },
    {
      key: 'childId',
      aliases: ['childId', 'studentId', 'learnerId']
    },
    {
      key: 'goalDate',
      aliases: ['goalDate', 'date', 'planDate']
    },
    {
      key: 'targetMinutes',
      aliases: ['targetMinutes', 'targetMinute', 'minutes']
    },
    {
      key: 'completedMinutes',
      aliases: ['completedMinutes', 'actualMinutes', 'doneMinutes']
    },
    {
      key: 'status',
      aliases: ['status']
    }
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) {
    var index =
      kidlearnV3_4h3FindColumnIndexByAliases_(
        headers,
        fields[i].aliases
      );

    result.resolvedColumns[fields[i].key] = {
      success:
        index >= 0,
      columnNumber:
        index >= 0 ? index + 1 : null,
      headerName:
        index >= 0 ? headers[index] : ''
    };
  }

  if (rowIndex > 0) {
    var row =
      sheet
        .getRange(rowIndex, 1, 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
        .getValues()[0];

    for (var j = 0; j < fields.length; j++) {
      var col =
        result.resolvedColumns[fields[j].key];

      result.rowValues[fields[j].key] =
        col.success
          ? row[col.columnNumber - 1]
          : '';
    }
  }

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không tìm thấy Daily Goal hôm nay cho childId=' +
      childId +
      ', todayKey=' +
      todayKey
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**

function kidlearnV3_dryRunSubmitAnswer4C5V3(payload) {

/**
 * Technical check.
 */
function kidlearnV3_checkLessonInteractionDryRun4C5V3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var c4 =
    kidlearnV3_4c5SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertLessonPlayerUi4C4ReadyV3'
    );

  if (!c4.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4C-4 chưa READY_FOR_4C_5: ' +
      c4.message
    );
  }

  var start =
    kidlearnV3_4c5SafeCallWithPayload_(
      'kidlearnV3_dryRunStartLesson4C5V3',
      {
        lessonId: 'MATH_L1',
        subjectCode: 'MATH',
        childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT'
      }
    );

  if (!start.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Dry-run start lesson failed: ' +
      start.message
    );
  }

  var submit =
    kidlearnV3_4c5SafeCallWithPayload_(
      'kidlearnV3_dryRunSubmitAnswer4C5V3',
      {
        lessonId: 'MATH_L1',
        activityId: 'MATH_L1_ACT_1',
        subjectCode: 'MATH',
        childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
        answerMode: 'BUTTON_INPUT',
        answerText: '13',
        expectedAnswer: '13'
      }
    );

  if (!submit.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Dry-run submit answer failed: ' +
      submit.message
    );
  }

  var complete =
    kidlearnV3_4c5SafeCallWithPayload_(
      'kidlearnV3_dryRunCompleteLesson4C5V3',
      {
        lessonId: 'MATH_L1',
        subjectCode: 'MATH',
        childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
        completedStepCount: 4
      }
    );

  if (!complete.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Dry-run complete lesson failed: ' +
      complete.message
    );
  }

  var uiMarker =
    kidlearnV3_4c5InspectUiMarkers_();

  if (!uiMarker.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(uiMarker.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(uiMarker.warnings || []);

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'CHECK_LESSON_INTERACTION_DRY_RUN_4C_5_V3',
    phase: '4C-5',
    interactionName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_INTERACTION_4C5_CONFIG.INTERACTION_NAME,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    serverDryRunChecks: {
      startLesson: start.success,
      submitAnswer: submit.success,
      completeLesson: complete.success
    },
    uiMarkerCheck: uiMarker,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_4c5SaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_INTERACTION_4C5_STATUS.CHECK_PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_INTERACTION_4C5_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_INTERACTION_4C5_KEYS.LAST_CHECK_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4C-5 dry-run check failed. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * UI marker inspection.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4c5InspectUiMarkers_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var shell = '';
  var client = '';
  var styles = '';

  try {
    shell =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Shell_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Shell_4A: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  try {
    client =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Client_LessonInteraction_DryRun_4C5')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error2) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_LessonInteraction_DryRun_4C5: ' +
      String(error2.message || error2)
    );
  }

  try {
    styles =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Styles_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error3) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Styles_4A: ' +
      String(error3.message || error3)
    );
  }

  var shellMarkers = [
    'UI_Product_Client_LessonInteraction_DryRun_4C5'
  ];

  var clientMarkers = [
    'KIDLEARN_LESSON_INTERACTION_DRY_RUN_4C5',
    'kidlearnV3_dryRunStartLesson4C5V3',
    'kidlearnV3_dryRunSaveAnswerDraft4C5V3',
    'kidlearnV3_dryRunSubmitAnswer4C5V3',
    'kidlearnV3_dryRunCompleteLesson4C5V3',
    'collectAnswerPayload4C5',
    'dryRunSubmitAnswer4C5',
    'dryRunCompleteLesson4C5',
    'showDryRunFeedback4C5'
  ];

  var styleMarkers = [
    '.kl-dryrun-badge-4c5',
    '.kl-dryrun-feedback-4c5',
    '.kl-dryrun-feedback-4c5.is-success',
    '.kl-dryrun-feedback-4c5.is-warning',
    '.kl-dryrun-feedback-4c5.is-info'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < shellMarkers.length; i++) {
    if (shell.indexOf(shellMarkers[i]) === -1) {
      errors.push('Shell thiếu marker: ' + shellMarkers[i]);
    }
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < clientMarkers.length; j++) {
    if (client.indexOf(clientMarkers[j]) === -1) {
      errors.push('Client 4C-5 thiếu marker: ' + clientMarkers[j]);
    }
  }

  for (var k = 0; k < styleMarkers.length; k++) {
    if (styles.indexOf(styleMarkers[k]) === -1) {
      errors.push('CSS 4C-5 thiếu marker: ' + styleMarkers[k]);
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'INSPECT_LESSON_INTERACTION_DRY_RUN_4C_5_MARKERS_V3',
    phase: '4C-5',
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4c5AssertDryRunGuard_() {
  return {
    dryRunOnly: true,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    dataResponsesWriteAllowed: false,
    lessonProgressWriteAllowed: false,
    studySessionWriteAllowed: false,
    message:
      '4C-5 is dry-run only. No learning data write is allowed.'
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4c5NormalizeAnswerPayload_(payload) {
  payload = payload || {};

  var answerMode =
    String(payload.answerMode || 'UNKNOWN')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  var answerText =
    String(payload.answerText || '').trim();

  var answerMeta =
    payload.answerMeta || {};

  return {
    childId:
      String(payload.childId || 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT').trim(),
    lessonId:
      String(payload.lessonId || '').trim(),
    activityId:
      String(payload.activityId || '').trim(),
    subjectCode:
      String(payload.subjectCode || payload.subjectKey || '').trim(),
    answerMode: answerMode,
    answerText: answerText,
    expectedAnswer:
      String(payload.expectedAnswer || '').trim(),
    selectedOptionId:
      String(payload.selectedOptionId || '').trim(),
    selectedOptionLabel:
      String(payload.selectedOptionLabel || '').trim(),
    canvasHasInk:
      payload.canvasHasInk === true,
    canvasDataUrlLength:
      Number(payload.canvasDataUrlLength || 0),
    answerMeta: answerMeta
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4c5ValidateAnswer_(answer) {
  var errors = [];

  if (!answer.activityId) {
    errors.push('Thiếu activityId.');
  }

  if (!answer.answerMode || answer.answerMode === 'UNKNOWN') {
    errors.push('Thiếu answerMode.');
  }

  if (
    answer.answerMode === 'HANDWRITE_INPUT'
  ) {
    if (!answer.canvasHasInk && answer.canvasDataUrlLength <= 2000) {
      errors.push('Bài viết tay chưa có nét viết.');
    }
  } else {
    if (!answer.answerText) {
      errors.push('Thiếu answerText.');
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errors: errors
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4c5EvaluateAnswerDryRun_(answer) {
  if (answer.answerMode === 'HANDWRITE_INPUT') {
    return {
      isAutoGradable: false,
      isCorrect: null,
      score: null,
      childMessage:
        'Cô đã nhận bài viết tay thử. Bước này chưa lưu và chưa chấm tự động.'
    };
  }

  if (!answer.expectedAnswer) {
    return {
      isAutoGradable: true,
      isCorrect: null,
      score: null,
      childMessage:
        'Cô đã nhận câu trả lời thử. Bước sau sẽ lưu dry-run chi tiết hơn.'
    };
  }

  var normalizedAnswer =
    kidlearnV3_4c5NormalizeAnswerText_(answer.answerText);

  var normalizedExpected =
    kidlearnV3_4c5NormalizeAnswerText_(answer.expectedAnswer);

  var isCorrect =
    normalizedAnswer === normalizedExpected;

  return {
    isAutoGradable: true,
    isCorrect: isCorrect,
    score: isCorrect ? 1 : 0,
    childMessage:
      isCorrect
        ? 'Tốt lắm! Câu trả lời của con đúng trong bản dry-run.'
        : 'Con gần đúng rồi. Đây là bản dry-run, mình có thể thử lại nhé.'
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4c5NormalizeAnswerText_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}


function kidlearnV3_4c5BuildDryRunId_(prefix) {
  return (
    'DRY_' +
    prefix +
    '_' +
    new Date().getTime()
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4c5SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4c5SafeCallWithPayload_(functionName, payload) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn(payload || {});

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4c5SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_INTERACTION_4C5_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_INTERACTION_4C5_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase: result.phase,
      status: status,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_INTERACTION_4C5_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_INTERACTION_4C5_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4c5ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - LESSON PLAYER CONTEXT
 * Step: 4C-3
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * Purpose:
 * - Build read-only context for Lesson Player.
 * - Prepare lesson blocks, activities, answer modes.
 * - Prepare handwriting canvas metadata for 4C-4.
 *
 * Safety:
 * - Không ghi Google Sheet dữ liệu học.
 * - Không ghi PROD.
 * - Không submit answer.
 * - Không complete lesson.
 * - Chỉ ghi ScriptProperties trạng thái kỹ thuật 4C-3.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C3_STATUS',
  LAST_PREVIEW_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C3_LAST_PREVIEW_AT',
  LAST_SMOKE_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C3_LAST_SMOKE_AT',
  LAST_READY_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C3_LAST_READY_AT',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C3_LAST_RESULT_JSON'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_STATUS = {
  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  PREVIEWED: 'PREVIEWED',
  SMOKE_PASSED: 'SMOKE_PASSED',
  READY_FOR_4C_4: 'READY_FOR_4C_4',
  FAILED: 'FAILED'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_CONFIG = {
  PHASE: '4C-3',
  PARENT_PHASE: '4C',
  PREVIOUS_BUNDLE: '4C-2',
  NEXT_BUNDLE: '4C-4',
  NEXT_STAGE: 'LESSON_PLAYER_UI_WITH_ANSWER_INPUT_MODES',
  CONTEXT_NAME: 'LESSON_PLAYER_CONTEXT_READ_ONLY',
  MAX_ROWS_PER_SHEET: 900,
  PROD_WRITE_ALLOWED: false,
  REAL_WRITE_ALLOWED: false
};


/**
 * Main public context function.
 * Future 4C-4 UI will call this.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getLessonPlayerContext4C3V3(payload) {
  payload = payload || {};

  var startedAt = new Date();
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var phase4C2 =
    kidlearnV3_4c3SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertSubjectDashboardUi4C2ReadyV3'
    );

  if (!phase4C2.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4C-2 chưa READY_FOR_4C_3: ' +
      phase4C2.message
    );
  }

  /**
   * 4C-2P là patch UI, không bắt buộc cho context.
   * Nhưng nếu có thì kiểm tra để cảnh báo.
   */
  var phase4C2P =
    kidlearnV3_4c3SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertSubjectDashboardUiPatch4C2PReadyV3'
    );

  if (!phase4C2P.success) {
    warnings.push(
      '4C-2P patch chưa ready hoặc chưa có assert. Context vẫn có thể chạy. Chi tiết: ' +
      phase4C2P.message
    );
  }

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4c3OpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được DEV spreadsheet: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var tables = {};

  if (spreadsheet) {
    tables =
      kidlearnV3_4c3ReadLessonPlayerTables_(
        spreadsheet,
        warnings
      );
  }

  var child =
    kidlearnV3_4c3ResolveChild_(
      payload,
      tables.DATA_Children || []
    );

  var subjectKey =
    kidlearnV3_4c3ResolveSubjectKey_(
      payload.subjectCode ||
        payload.subjectKey ||
        payload.subjectId ||
        '',
      payload.subjectName || ''
    );

  if (subjectKey === 'DEFAULT') {
    subjectKey = 'MATH';
  }

  var lesson =
    kidlearnV3_4c3ResolveLesson_(
      payload,
      subjectKey,
      tables.MST_Lessons || [],
      tables.MST_Topics || []
    );

  if (!lesson) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy lesson thật. Dùng fallback lesson demo cho ' +
      subjectKey +
      '.'
    );

    lesson =
      kidlearnV3_4c3BuildFallbackLesson_(subjectKey);
  }

  subjectKey =
    lesson.subjectKey || subjectKey;

  var theme =
    kidlearnV3_4c3ResolveTheme_(subjectKey);

  var blocks =
    kidlearnV3_4c3BuildLessonBlocks_(
      lesson,
      subjectKey,
      tables.MST_LessonBlocks || []
    );

  var activities =
    kidlearnV3_4c3BuildActivities_(
      lesson,
      subjectKey,
      tables.MST_Activities || [],
      tables.MST_Questions || [],
      tables.MST_QuestionOptions || []
    );

  if (blocks.length === 0 && activities.length === 0) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không có lesson blocks/activities thật. Dùng fallback lesson content.'
    );

    var fallback =
      kidlearnV3_4c3BuildFallbackLessonContent_(lesson, subjectKey);

    blocks =
      fallback.blocks;

    activities =
      fallback.activities;
  }

  var playerSteps =
    kidlearnV3_4c3BuildPlayerSteps_(
      blocks,
      activities
    );

  var progress =
    kidlearnV3_4c3ResolveLessonProgress_(
      lesson,
      child,
      tables.DATA_LessonProgress || []
    );

  var context = {
    child: child,
    lesson: lesson,
    subjectKey: subjectKey,
    subjectTheme: theme,
    player: {
      lessonId: lesson.lessonId,
      title: lesson.lessonTitle,
      subtitle:
        lesson.topicName +
        ' · ' +
        lesson.estimatedMinutes +
        ' phút',
      breadcrumb: [
        {
          label: lesson.subjectName,
          type: 'SUBJECT',
          value: subjectKey
        },
        {
          label: lesson.topicName,
          type: 'TOPIC',
          value: lesson.topicId
        },
        {
          label: lesson.lessonTitle,
          type: 'LESSON',
          value: lesson.lessonId
        }
      ],
      progress: progress,
      blocks: blocks,
      activities: activities,
      playerSteps: playerSteps,
      supportedAnswerModes:
        kidlearnV3_4c3GetSupportedAnswerModes_(),
      handwritingPolicy: {
        enabledIn4C4: true,
        autoGradeInMvp: false,
        saveAsImageLater: true,
        saveStrokeDataLater: true,
        childFriendlyMessage:
          'Con có thể viết bằng tay hoặc dùng bút cảm ứng.',
        plannedStorage:
          'DATA_Responses or Drive asset in later write phase'
      },
      safetyPolicy: {
        readOnlyContext: true,
        submitAnswerAllowedNow: false,
        saveProgressAllowedNow: false,
        completeLessonAllowedNow: false,
        dryRunStartsIn: '4C-5'
      }
    },
    sourceInfo: {
      mode: 'READ_ONLY',
      tableNames: Object.keys(tables),
      generatedAt:
        new Date().toISOString(),
      durationMs:
        new Date().getTime() - startedAt.getTime()
    }
  };

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'GET_LESSON_PLAYER_CONTEXT_4C_3_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    contextName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_CONFIG.CONTEXT_NAME,
    selectedSubjectKey: subjectKey,
    lessonId: lesson.lessonId,
    lessonTitle: lesson.lessonTitle,
    blockCount: blocks.length,
    activityCount: activities.length,
    playerStepCount: playerSteps.length,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    context: context,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    success: result.success,
    action: result.action,
    phase: result.phase,
    selectedSubjectKey: result.selectedSubjectKey,
    lessonId: result.lessonId,
    lessonTitle: result.lessonTitle,
    blockCount: result.blockCount,
    activityCount: result.activityCount,
    playerStepCount: result.playerStepCount,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: result.errorCount,
    warningCount: result.warningCount,
    errors: result.errors,
    warnings: result.warnings
  }, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4C-3 lesson player context failed. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Smoke test 4 subject contexts.
 */
function kidlearnV3_smokeTestLessonPlayerContext4C3V3() {
  var subjects = [
    'MATH',
    'VIETNAMESE',
    'ENGLISH',
    'SCIENCE'
  ];

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var results = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < subjects.length; i++) {
    try {
      var output =
        kidlearnV3_getLessonPlayerContext4C3V3({
          subjectCode: subjects[i]
        });

      results.push({
        subjectCode: subjects[i],
        success: output.success === true,
        lessonId: output.lessonId,
        lessonTitle: output.lessonTitle,
        blockCount: output.blockCount,
        activityCount: output.activityCount,
        playerStepCount: output.playerStepCount,
        warningCount: output.warningCount
      });

      warnings =
        warnings.concat(output.warnings || []);

      if (!output.success) {
        errors.push(
          subjects[i] + ' context returned success=false.'
        );
      }

    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(
        subjects[i] + ': ' +
        String(error.message || error)
      );

      results.push({
        subjectCode: subjects[i],
        success: false,
        error: String(error.message || error)
      });
    }
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'SMOKE_TEST_LESSON_PLAYER_CONTEXT_4C_3_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    subjectCount: subjects.length,
    results: results,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_4c3SaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_STATUS.SMOKE_PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_KEYS.LAST_SMOKE_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4C-3 smoke failed. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Data readers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4c3ReadLessonPlayerTables_(spreadsheet, warnings) {
  var names = [
    'DATA_Children',
    'MST_Subjects',
    'MST_Topics',
    'MST_Lessons',
    'MST_LessonBlocks',
    'MST_Activities',
    'MST_Questions',
    'MST_QuestionOptions',
    'DATA_LessonProgress'
  ];

  var tables = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    tables[names[i]] =
      kidlearnV3_4c3ReadSheetObjects_(
        spreadsheet,
        names[i],
        warnings
      );
  }

  return tables;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3ReadSheetObjects_(spreadsheet, sheetName, warnings) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4c3GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy sheet ' + sheetName + '.'
    );
    return [];
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 2 || lastColumn < 1) {
    return [];
  }

  var rowCount =
    Math.min(
      lastRow,
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_CONFIG.MAX_ROWS_PER_SHEET
    );

  var values =
    sheet.getRange(1, 1, rowCount, lastColumn).getValues();

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4c3BuildHeaders_(values);

  var objects = [];

  for (var r = headers.startRowIndex; r < values.length; r++) {
    var row = values[r];

    if (kidlearnV3_4c3IsBlankRow_(row)) continue;

    var obj = {};

    for (var c = 0; c < headers.keys.length; c++) {
      var key = headers.keys[c] || 'col' + (c + 1);
      obj[key] = row[c];
    }

    obj.__rowNumber = r + 1;
    objects.push(obj);
  }

  return objects;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3BuildHeaders_(values) {
  var row1 = values[0] || [];
  var row2 = values.length > 1 ? values[1] || [] : [];

  var useRow2 =
    kidlearnV3_4c3RowLooksLikeFieldKeys_(row2);

  var source =
    useRow2 ? row2 : row1;

  var keys = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < source.length; i++) {
    keys.push(
      kidlearnV3_4c3NormalizeKey_(source[i])
    );
  }

  return {
    keys: keys,
    startRowIndex: useRow2 ? 2 : 1
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3RowLooksLikeFieldKeys_(row) {
  var score = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    var value = String(row[i] || '');

    if (
      /^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/.test(value) ||
      value.indexOf('Id') >= 0 ||
      value.indexOf('Code') >= 0 ||
      value.indexOf('Name') >= 0
    ) {
      score++;
    }
  }

  return score >= 3;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3NormalizeKey_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/[^\wÀ-ỹ]/g, '');
}


/**
 * Context builders.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4c3ResolveChild_(payload, childRows) {
  var childId =
    String(payload.childId || '');

  if (childId) {
    for (var i = 0; i < childRows.length; i++) {
      var row = childRows[i];

      var rowChildId =
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
            'childId',
            'childid',
            'machild',
            'id'
          ]) || ''
        );

      if (rowChildId === childId) {
        return {
          childId: rowChildId,
          childName:
            String(
              kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
                'childName',
                'childname',
                'tenbe',
                'name'
              ]) || 'Lịch Khê'
            ),
          grade:
            String(
              kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
                'grade',
                'lop',
                'class'
              ]) || '2'
            )
        };
      }
    }
  }

  if (childRows.length > 0) {
    var first = childRows[0];

    return {
      childId:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(first, [
            'childId',
            'childid',
            'machild',
            'id'
          ]) || 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT'
        ),
      childName:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(first, [
            'childName',
            'childname',
            'tenbe',
            'name'
          ]) || 'Lịch Khê'
        ),
      grade:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(first, [
            'grade',
            'lop',
            'class'
          ]) || '2'
        )
    };
  }

  return {
    childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
    childName: 'Lịch Khê',
    grade: '2'
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3ResolveLesson_(payload, subjectKey, lessonRows, topicRows) {
  var requestedLessonId =
    String(payload.lessonId || '');

  var lessons =
    kidlearnV3_4c3NormalizeLessons_(
      lessonRows,
      topicRows
    );

  if (requestedLessonId) {
    for (var i = 0; i < lessons.length; i++) {
      if (lessons[i].lessonId === requestedLessonId) {
        return lessons[i];
      }
    }
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < lessons.length; j++) {
    if (lessons[j].subjectKey === subjectKey) {
      return lessons[j];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3NormalizeLessons_(lessonRows, topicRows) {
  var topics =
    kidlearnV3_4c3NormalizeTopics_(topicRows);

  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < lessonRows.length; i++) {
    var row = lessonRows[i];

    var lessonId =
      kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
        'lessonId',
        'lessonid',
        'mabaihoc',
        'Mãbàihọc',
        'id'
      ]);

    var lessonTitle =
      kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
        'lessonTitle',
        'lessonName',
        'lessonname',
        'title',
        'name',
        'tenbaihoc',
        'Tênbàihọc'
      ]);

    if (!lessonId && !lessonTitle) continue;

    var subjectKey =
      kidlearnV3_4c3ResolveSubjectKey_(
        kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
          'subjectCode',
          'subjectId',
          'mamonhoc',
          'Mãmônhọc'
        ]),
        ''
      );

    if (subjectKey === 'DEFAULT') {
      subjectKey = 'MATH';
    }

    var topicId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
          'topicId',
          'topicid',
          'machude',
          'Mãchủđề'
        ]) || ''
      );

    var topic =
      kidlearnV3_4c3FindBy_(
        topics,
        'topicId',
        topicId
      );

    result.push({
      lessonId:
        String(lessonId || 'LESSON_' + subjectKey + '_' + (i + 1)),
      lessonTitle:
        String(lessonTitle || 'Bài học ' + (i + 1)),
      subjectKey: subjectKey,
      subjectName:
        kidlearnV3_4c3SubjectNameFromKey_(subjectKey),
      subjectCode: subjectKey,
      topicId:
        topicId || subjectKey + '_TOPIC_GENERAL',
      topicName:
        topic ? topic.topicName : 'Chủ đề chung',
      estimatedMinutes:
        kidlearnV3_4c3ToNumber_(
          kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
            'estimatedMinutes',
            'durationMinutes',
            'minutes',
            'thoiluong',
            'Thờilượng'
          ]),
          8
        ),
      order:
        kidlearnV3_4c3ToNumber_(
          kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
            'displayOrder',
            'order',
            'sortOrder',
            'thutu'
          ]),
          i + 1
        ),
      difficulty:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
            'difficulty',
            'level',
            'mucdo'
          ]) || 'Dễ'
        )
    });
  }

  result.sort(function (a, b) {
    return a.order - b.order;
  });

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3NormalizeTopics_(rows) {
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var row = rows[i];

    var topicId =
      kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
        'topicId',
        'topicid',
        'machude',
        'Mãchủđề',
        'id'
      ]);

    var topicName =
      kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
        'topicName',
        'topicname',
        'tenchude',
        'Tênchủđề',
        'name',
        'title'
      ]);

    if (!topicId && !topicName) continue;

    result.push({
      topicId:
        String(topicId || 'TOPIC_' + (i + 1)),
      topicName:
        String(topicName || 'Chủ đề ' + (i + 1))
    });
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3BuildLessonBlocks_(lesson, subjectKey, rows) {
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var row = rows[i];

    var lessonId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
          'lessonId',
          'lessonid',
          'mabaihoc'
        ]) || ''
      );

    if (lessonId && lessonId !== lesson.lessonId) continue;

    var blockId =
      kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
        'blockId',
        'blockid',
        'lessonBlockId',
        'id'
      ]);

    var blockType =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
          'blockType',
          'type',
          'contentType'
        ]) || 'CONTENT'
      )
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();

    var title =
      kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
        'title',
        'blockTitle',
        'name',
        'tieude'
      ]);

    var content =
      kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
        'content',
        'text',
        'body',
        'noidung'
      ]);

    if (!blockId && !title && !content) continue;

    result.push({
      blockId:
        String(blockId || lesson.lessonId + '_BLOCK_' + (i + 1)),
      lessonId: lesson.lessonId,
      blockType: blockType,
      title:
        String(title || 'Nội dung bài học'),
      content:
        String(content || ''),
      illustrationHint:
        kidlearnV3_4c3IllustrationHint_(subjectKey),
      order:
        kidlearnV3_4c3ToNumber_(
          kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
            'displayOrder',
            'order',
            'sortOrder',
            'thutu'
          ]),
          i + 1
        )
    });
  }

  result.sort(function (a, b) {
    return a.order - b.order;
  });

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3BuildActivities_(
  lesson,
  subjectKey,
  activityRows,
  questionRows,
  optionRows
) {
  var activities = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < activityRows.length; i++) {
    var row = activityRows[i];

    var lessonId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
          'lessonId',
          'lessonid',
          'mabaihoc'
        ]) || ''
      );

    if (lessonId && lessonId !== lesson.lessonId) continue;

    var activityId =
      kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
        'activityId',
        'activityid',
        'id'
      ]);

    var activityType =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
          'activityType',
          'type',
          'questionType'
        ]) || ''
      )
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();

    var prompt =
      kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
        'prompt',
        'question',
        'title',
        'content',
        'noidung'
      ]);

    if (!activityId && !prompt) continue;

    var answerMode =
      kidlearnV3_4c3ResolveAnswerMode_(
        activityType,
        subjectKey,
        prompt
      );

    activities.push({
      activityId:
        String(activityId || lesson.lessonId + '_ACT_' + (i + 1)),
      lessonId: lesson.lessonId,
      activityType:
        activityType || answerMode.activityType,
      answerMode: answerMode.answerMode,
      title:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
            'activityTitle',
            'title',
            'name'
          ]) || answerMode.title
        ),
      prompt:
        String(prompt || answerMode.prompt),
      instruction:
        answerMode.instruction,
      options:
        kidlearnV3_4c3BuildActivityOptions_(
          row,
          questionRows,
          optionRows
        ),
      buttonInput:
        kidlearnV3_4c3BuildButtonInputConfig_(answerMode.answerMode, subjectKey),
      textInput:
        kidlearnV3_4c3BuildTextInputConfig_(answerMode.answerMode, subjectKey),
      handwriting:
        kidlearnV3_4c3BuildHandwritingConfig_(answerMode.answerMode, subjectKey),
      autoGrade:
        answerMode.autoGrade,
      expectedAnswer:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
            'expectedAnswer',
            'answer',
            'correctAnswer',
            'dapan'
          ]) || answerMode.expectedAnswer || ''
        ),
      order:
        kidlearnV3_4c3ToNumber_(
          kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
            'displayOrder',
            'order',
            'sortOrder',
            'thutu'
          ]),
          i + 1
        )
    });
  }

  activities.sort(function (a, b) {
    return a.order - b.order;
  });

  return activities;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3BuildActivityOptions_(activityRow, questionRows, optionRows) {
  var activityId =
    String(
      kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(activityRow, [
        'activityId',
        'activityid',
        'id'
      ]) || ''
    );

  var questionId =
    String(
      kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(activityRow, [
        'questionId',
        'questionid',
        'maquestion'
      ]) || ''
    );

  var options = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < optionRows.length; i++) {
    var row = optionRows[i];

    var rowQuestionId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
          'questionId',
          'questionid',
          'maquestion'
        ]) || ''
      );

    if (
      questionId &&
      rowQuestionId &&
      rowQuestionId !== questionId
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    var optionText =
      kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
        'optionText',
        'text',
        'label',
        'content',
        'noidung'
      ]);

    if (!optionText) continue;

    options.push({
      optionId:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
            'optionId',
            'optionid',
            'id'
          ]) || 'OPT_' + (i + 1)
        ),
      label:
        String(optionText),
      isCorrect:
        kidlearnV3_4c3ToBool_(
          kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
            'isCorrect',
            'correct',
            'dung'
          ]),
          false
        )
    });
  }

  if (options.length > 0) return options;

  var inlineOptions =
    String(
      kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(activityRow, [
        'options',
        'choices',
        'luaChon',
        'luachon'
      ]) || ''
    );

  if (inlineOptions) {
    var parts =
      inlineOptions.split('|');

    for (var j = 0; j < parts.length; j++) {
      if (!parts[j]) continue;

      options.push({
        optionId:
          activityId + '_OPT_' + (j + 1),
        label:
          String(parts[j]).trim(),
        isCorrect: false
      });
    }
  }

  return options;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3BuildPlayerSteps_(blocks, activities) {
  var steps = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
    steps.push({
      stepId:
        'STEP_BLOCK_' + blocks[i].blockId,
      stepType: 'CONTENT_BLOCK',
      refId: blocks[i].blockId,
      title: blocks[i].title,
      order:
        steps.length + 1
    });
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < activities.length; j++) {
    steps.push({
      stepId:
        'STEP_ACTIVITY_' + activities[j].activityId,
      stepType: 'ACTIVITY',
      refId: activities[j].activityId,
      title: activities[j].title,
      answerMode: activities[j].answerMode,
      order:
        steps.length + 1
    });
  }

  return steps;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3ResolveLessonProgress_(lesson, child, progressRows) {
  for (var i = 0; i < progressRows.length; i++) {
    var row = progressRows[i];

    var lessonId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
          'lessonId',
          'lessonid',
          'mabaihoc'
        ]) || ''
      );

    var childId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
          'childId',
          'childid',
          'machild'
        ]) || ''
      );

    if (
      lessonId === lesson.lessonId &&
      (!child.childId || !childId || childId === child.childId)
    ) {
      var percent =
        kidlearnV3_4c3Clamp_(
          kidlearnV3_4c3ToNumber_(
            kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, [
              'progressPercent',
              'percent',
              'completionPercent',
              'tiendo'
            ]),
            0
          ),
          0,
          100
        );

      return {
        status:
          percent >= 100
            ? 'COMPLETED'
            : percent > 0
              ? 'IN_PROGRESS'
              : 'NOT_STARTED',
        progressPercent: percent,
        currentStepIndex: 0,
        readOnly: true
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    status: 'NOT_STARTED',
    progressPercent: 0,
    currentStepIndex: 0,
    readOnly: true
  };
}

/**
 * Answer mode configs.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4c3GetSupportedAnswerModes_() {
  return [
    {
      answerMode: 'MULTIPLE_CHOICE',
      label: 'Chọn đáp án',
      enabledIn4C4: true,
      autoGradePossible: true
    },
    {
      answerMode: 'BUTTON_INPUT',
      label: 'Bấm nút nhập đáp án',
      enabledIn4C4: true,
      autoGradePossible: true
    },
    {
      answerMode: 'TEXT_INPUT',
      label: 'Gõ câu trả lời',
      enabledIn4C4: true,
      autoGradePossible: true
    },
    {
      answerMode: 'HANDWRITE_INPUT',
      label: 'Viết bằng tay / pen',
      enabledIn4C4: true,
      autoGradePossible: false
    }
  ];
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3ResolveAnswerMode_(activityType, subjectKey, prompt) {
  var type =
    String(activityType || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (type.indexOf('HAND') >= 0 || type.indexOf('WRITE') >= 0) {
    return {
      activityType: 'HANDWRITE_INPUT',
      answerMode: 'HANDWRITE_INPUT',
      title: 'Viết bằng tay',
      prompt: prompt || 'Con viết câu trả lời ở đây.',
      instruction: 'Con có thể dùng tay hoặc bút cảm ứng.',
      autoGrade: false,
      expectedAnswer: ''
    };
  }

  if (type.indexOf('TEXT') >= 0 || type.indexOf('TYPING') >= 0) {
    return {
      activityType: 'TEXT_INPUT',
      answerMode: 'TEXT_INPUT',
      title: 'Gõ câu trả lời',
      prompt: prompt || 'Con gõ câu trả lời.',
      instruction: 'Con nhập đáp án bằng bàn phím.',
      autoGrade: true,
      expectedAnswer: ''
    };
  }

  if (type.indexOf('BUTTON') >= 0 || type.indexOf('NUMBER') >= 0) {
    return {
      activityType: 'BUTTON_INPUT',
      answerMode: 'BUTTON_INPUT',
      title: 'Bấm nút nhập đáp án',
      prompt: prompt || 'Con bấm nút để trả lời.',
      instruction: 'Con dùng các nút lớn để nhập đáp án.',
      autoGrade: true,
      expectedAnswer: ''
    };
  }

  return {
    activityType: 'MULTIPLE_CHOICE',
    answerMode: 'MULTIPLE_CHOICE',
    title: 'Chọn đáp án',
    prompt: prompt || 'Con chọn đáp án đúng.',
    instruction: 'Con chọn một đáp án.',
    autoGrade: true,
    expectedAnswer: ''
  };
}

  if (answerMode !== 'BUTTON_INPUT') return null;

  if (subjectKey === 'VIETNAMESE') {

function kidlearnV3_4c3OpenSpreadsheet_() {
  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) return active;

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DEV spreadsheet.');
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3GetSheetByExactName_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (typeof kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_ === 'function') {
    return kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3ResolveSubjectKey_(code, name) {
  var text =
    String(code || '') +
    ' ' +
    String(name || '');

  text =
    text
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase()
      .normalize('NFD')
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
      .replace(/\s+/g, '')
      .replace(/-/g, '_');

  if (
    text.indexOf('MATH') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('TOAN') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('SUB_T') >= 0
  ) {
    return 'MATH';
  }

  if (
    text.indexOf('VIET') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('TIENGVIET') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('SUB_TV') >= 0
  ) {
    return 'VIETNAMESE';
  }

  if (
    text.indexOf('ENGLISH') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('TIENGANH') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('SUB_E') >= 0
  ) {
    return 'ENGLISH';
  }

  if (
    text.indexOf('SCIENCE') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('KHOAHOC') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('SUB_K') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('SUB_S') >= 0
  ) {
    return 'SCIENCE';
  }

  return 'DEFAULT';
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3SubjectNameFromKey_(key) {
  var map = {
    MATH: 'Toán học',
    VIETNAMESE: 'Tiếng Việt',
    ENGLISH: 'Tiếng Anh',
    SCIENCE: 'Khoa học',
    DEFAULT: 'Môn học'
  };

  return map[key] || map.DEFAULT;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3IllustrationHint_(subjectKey) {
  var map = {
    MATH: 'math_numbers',
    VIETNAMESE: 'book_pencil',
    ENGLISH: 'abc_words',
    SCIENCE: 'science_lab'
  };

  return map[subjectKey] || 'lesson';
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3GetAny_(row, keys) {
  if (!row) return '';

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var key = keys[i];

    if (
      row.hasOwnProperty(key) &&
      row[key] !== null &&
      row[key] !== undefined &&
      String(row[key]).trim() !== ''
    ) {
      return row[key];
    }

    var normalized =
      kidlearnV3_4c3NormalizeLookupKey_(key);

    for (var actual in row) {
      if (!row.hasOwnProperty(actual)) continue;

      if (
        kidlearnV3_4c3NormalizeLookupKey_(actual) ===
        normalized
      ) {
        if (
          row[actual] !== null &&
          row[actual] !== undefined &&
          String(row[actual]).trim() !== ''
        ) {
          return row[actual];
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return '';
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3NormalizeLookupKey_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '')
    .replace(/[^\w]/g, '');
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3IsBlankRow_(row) {
  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    if (
      row[i] !== null &&
      row[i] !== undefined &&
      String(row[i]).trim() !== ''
    ) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  return true;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3FindBy_(items, field, value) {
  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    if (String(items[i][field]) === String(value)) {
      return items[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3ToNumber_(value, fallback) {
  var number = Number(value);

  if (isNaN(number)) {
    return fallback || 0;
  }

  return number;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3ToBool_(value, fallback) {
  if (
    value === null ||
    value === undefined ||
    String(value).trim() === ''
  ) {
    return fallback;
  }

  var text =
    String(value)
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    text === 'TRUE' ||
    text === 'YES' ||
    text === 'ACTIVE' ||
    text === '1' ||
    text === 'ĐÚNG' ||
    text === 'DUNG'
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  if (
    text === 'FALSE' ||
    text === 'NO' ||
    text === 'INACTIVE' ||
    text === '0' ||
    text === 'SAI'
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  return fallback;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3Clamp_(value, min, max) {
  var number =
    kidlearnV3_4c3ToNumber_(value, min);

  if (number < min) return min;
  if (number > max) return max;

  return number;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase: result.phase,
      parentPhase:
        result.parentPhase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status: status,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_4C3_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      selectedSubjectKey:
        result.selectedSubjectKey || '',
      lessonId:
        result.lessonId || '',
      lessonTitle:
        result.lessonTitle || '',
      blockCount:
        result.blockCount || 0,
      activityCount:
        result.activityCount || 0,
      playerStepCount:
        result.playerStepCount || 0,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4c3ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

};

function kidlearnV3_previewLessonPlayerUi4C4V3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var c3 =
    kidlearnV3_4c4SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertLessonPlayerContext4C3ReadyV3'
    );

  if (!c3.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4C-3 chưa READY_FOR_4C_4: ' +
      c3.message
    );
  }

  var context =
    kidlearnV3_4c4SafeCallWithPayload_(
      'kidlearnV3_getLessonPlayerContext4C3V3',
      {
        subjectCode: 'MATH'
      }
    );

  if (!context.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không lấy được lesson player context 4C-3: ' +
      context.message
    );
  }

  var marker =
    kidlearnV3_4c4InspectUiMarkers_();

  if (!marker.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(marker.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(marker.warnings || []);

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C_4_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4_STATUS.PREVIEWED
        : KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4_STATUS.FAILED,
    uiName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4_CONFIG.UI_NAME,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    answerModes: [
      'MULTIPLE_CHOICE',
      'BUTTON_INPUT',
      'TEXT_INPUT',
      'HANDWRITE_INPUT'
    ],
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    markerCheck: marker,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_4c4SaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.status,
    KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4C-4 preview failed. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

function kidlearnV3_4c4SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4c4SafeCallWithPayload_(functionName, payload) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn(payload || {});

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4c4SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase: result.phase,
      parentPhase:
        result.parentPhase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status: status,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4c4ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}
