/**
 * Controlled DEV real write.
 */
function kidlearnV3_realWriteDataLessonProgress4D4V3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var confirmText =
    String(options.confirm || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    confirmText !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm. Cần confirm=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
    );
  }

  var payload =
    options.payload ||
    kidlearnV3_4d4BuildSamplePayload_();

  var lock =
    LockService.getScriptLock();

  var locked =
    lock.tryLock(30000);

  if (!locked) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không lấy được script lock sau 30 giây. Vui lòng chạy lại.'
    );
  }

  try {
    var plan =
      kidlearnV3_4d4BuildRealWritePlan_(payload);

    if (!plan.success) {
      throw new Error(
        'Preflight 4D-4 chưa pass. Errors=' +
        plan.errors.join(' | ')
      );
    }

    var spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4d4OpenSpreadsheet_();

    var progressSheet =
      kidlearnV3_4d4GetSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_LessonProgress'
      );

    var auditSheet =
      kidlearnV3_4d4GetSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        'LOG_Audit'
      );

    if (!progressSheet) {
      throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DATA_LessonProgress.');
    }

    if (!auditSheet) {
      throw new Error('Không tìm thấy LOG_Audit.');
    }

    var before = {
      dataLessonProgressLastRow:
        progressSheet.getLastRow(),
      logAuditLastRow:
        auditSheet.getLastRow()
    };

    var progressRowNumber = 0;

    if (plan.progressPlan.operationMode === 'UPDATE_EXISTING') {
      progressRowNumber =
        plan.progressPlan.targetRowNumber;

      progressSheet
        .getRange(
          progressRowNumber,
          1,
          1,
          plan.progressPlan.rowValues.length
        )
        .setValues([
          plan.progressPlan.rowValues
        ]);
    } else {
      progressSheet.appendRow(
        plan.progressPlan.rowValues
      );

      SpreadsheetApp.flush();

      progressRowNumber =
        progressSheet.getLastRow();
    }

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    var auditHeaderInfo =
      kidlearnV3_4d4InspectSheetHeaders_(
        spreadsheet,
        'LOG_Audit',
        []
      );

    var auditPlan =
      kidlearnV3_4d4BuildAuditRowPlan_(
        auditHeaderInfo,
        plan.normalizedPayload,
        plan.progressPlan.progressId,
        progressRowNumber,
        plan.progressPlan.operationMode
      );

    if (!auditPlan.success) {
      throw new Error(
        'Không build được audit row 4D-4. Errors=' +
        auditPlan.errors.join(' | ')
      );
    }

    auditSheet.appendRow(
      auditPlan.rowValues
    );

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    var auditRowNumber =
      auditSheet.getLastRow();

    var after = {
      dataLessonProgressLastRow:
        progressSheet.getLastRow(),
      logAuditLastRow:
        auditSheet.getLastRow()
    };

    var writeRecord = {
      success: true,
      action: 'REAL_WRITE_DATA_LESSON_PROGRESS_4D_4_V3',
      phase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.PHASE,
      parentPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_5,
      writeName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.WRITE_NAME,
      environment: 'DEV',
      confirmUsed: confirmText,
      reviewerNote:
        String(options.reviewerNote || ''),
      targetSheet: 'DATA_LessonProgress',
      auditSheet: 'LOG_Audit',
      operationMode:
        plan.progressPlan.operationMode,
      progressId:
        plan.progressPlan.progressId,
      auditId:
        auditPlan.auditId,
      progressRowNumber:
        progressRowNumber,
      auditRowNumber:
        auditRowNumber,
      progressIdColumnIndex:
        plan.progressPlan.progressIdColumnIndex,
      auditIdColumnIndex:
        auditPlan.auditIdColumnIndex,
      before: before,
      after: after,
      rowDelta: {
        DATA_LessonProgress:
          after.dataLessonProgressLastRow -
          before.dataLessonProgressLastRow,
        LOG_Audit:
          after.logAuditLastRow -
          before.logAuditLastRow
      },
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: true,
      actualSheetWritePerformed: true,
      lessonProgressWritePerformed: true,
      auditWritePerformed: true,
      dataResponsesWritePerformed: false,
      studySessionWritePerformed: false,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      writtenAt:
        new Date().toISOString(),
      warnings:
        plan.warnings || []
    };

    kidlearnV3_4d4SaveWriteRecord_(
      writeRecord
    );

    kidlearnV3_4d4SaveStatus_(
      writeRecord,
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_5,
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_KEYS.LAST_WRITE_AT
    );

    console.log(JSON.stringify(writeRecord, null, 2));

    return writeRecord;

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}


/**
 * Verify last real write.
 */
function kidlearnV3_verifyLastLessonProgressRealWrite4D4V3() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var text =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_KEYS.LAST_WRITE_JSON
    );

  if (!text) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không tìm thấy LAST_WRITE_JSON của 4D-4.'
    );
  }

  var lastWrite =
    JSON.parse(text);

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_4d4OpenSpreadsheet_();

  var progressSheet =
    kidlearnV3_4d4GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_LessonProgress'
    );

  var auditSheet =
    kidlearnV3_4d4GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'LOG_Audit'
    );

  if (!progressSheet) {
    errors.push('Không tìm thấy DATA_LessonProgress.');
  }

  if (!auditSheet) {
    errors.push('Không tìm thấy LOG_Audit.');
  }

  var progressCheck = null;
  var auditCheck = null;

  if (progressSheet) {
    progressCheck =
      kidlearnV3_4d4VerifyRowContainsId_(
        progressSheet,
        lastWrite.progressRowNumber,
        lastWrite.progressIdColumnIndex,
        lastWrite.progressId,
        'DATA_LessonProgress'
      );

    if (!progressCheck.success) {
      errors =
        errors.concat(progressCheck.errors || []);
    }
  }

  if (auditSheet) {
    auditCheck =
      kidlearnV3_4d4VerifyRowContainsId_(
        auditSheet,
        lastWrite.auditRowNumber,
        lastWrite.auditIdColumnIndex,
        lastWrite.auditId,
        'LOG_Audit'
      );

    if (!auditCheck.success) {
      errors =
        errors.concat(auditCheck.errors || []);
    }
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'VERIFY_LAST_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D_4_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_5
        : KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_STATUS.FAILED,
    progressCheck: progressCheck,
    auditCheck: auditCheck,
    lastWriteSummary: {
      progressId:
        lastWrite.progressId,
      auditId:
        lastWrite.auditId,
      progressRowNumber:
        lastWrite.progressRowNumber,
      auditRowNumber:
        lastWrite.auditRowNumber,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        lastWrite.actualSheetWritePerformed
    },
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: true,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      lastWrite.actualSheetWritePerformed === true,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_4d4SaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.status,
    KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_KEYS.LAST_VERIFY_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Verify 4D-4 failed. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

 * Get status.

function kidlearnV3_getLessonProgressRealWrite4D4StatusV3() {
  var properties =

  var result = {

        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_KEYS.LAST_WRITE_JSON
      )
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert ready for 4D-5.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertLessonProgressRealWrite4D4ReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getLessonProgressRealWrite4D4StatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_5
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '4D-4 chưa READY_FOR_4D_5. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastWrite ||
    status.lastWrite.actualSheetWritePerformed !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Chưa có bằng chứng actualSheetWritePerformed=true cho 4D-4.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D_4_READY_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    status: status.status,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: true,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      status.lastWrite &&
      status.lastWrite.actualSheetWritePerformed === true,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(errors.join(' | '));
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Build full write plan.
 * Không ghi sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d4BuildRealWritePlan_(payload) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var d3 =
    kidlearnV3_4d4SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertResponseRealWrite4D3ReadyV3'
    );

  if (!d3.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4D-3 chưa READY_FOR_4D_4: ' +
      d3.message
    );
  }

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4d4CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(dev.warnings || []);

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4d4OpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được DEV spreadsheet: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var normalized =
    kidlearnV3_4d4NormalizeProgressPayload_(payload);

  var progressPlan = null;
  var auditPlan = null;

  if (spreadsheet) {
    var progressSheet =
      kidlearnV3_4d4GetSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_LessonProgress'
      );

    var progressHeaderInfo =
      kidlearnV3_4d4InspectSheetHeaders_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_LessonProgress',
        warnings
      );

    var auditHeaderInfo =
      kidlearnV3_4d4InspectSheetHeaders_(
        spreadsheet,
        'LOG_Audit',
        warnings
      );

    if (!progressHeaderInfo.exists || !progressSheet) {
      errors.push('Không tìm thấy DATA_LessonProgress.');
    } else {
      progressPlan =
        kidlearnV3_4d4BuildProgressRowPlan_(
          progressHeaderInfo,
          progressSheet,
          normalized
        );

      if (!progressPlan.success) {
        errors =
          errors.concat(progressPlan.errors || []);
      }

      warnings =
        warnings.concat(progressPlan.warnings || []);
    }

    if (!auditHeaderInfo.exists) {
      errors.push('Không tìm thấy LOG_Audit.');
    } else {
      auditPlan =
        kidlearnV3_4d4BuildAuditRowPlan_(
          auditHeaderInfo,
          normalized,
          progressPlan ? progressPlan.progressId : '',
          progressPlan ? progressPlan.targetRowNumber : '',
          progressPlan ? progressPlan.operationMode : ''
        );

      if (!auditPlan.success) {
        errors =
          errors.concat(auditPlan.errors || []);
      }

      warnings =
        warnings.concat(auditPlan.warnings || []);
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'BUILD_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_PLAN_4D_4_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    writeName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.WRITE_NAME,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: true,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    normalizedPayload: normalized,
    devSafety: dev,
    progressPlan: progressPlan,
    auditPlan: auditPlan,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4d4UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4d4UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Build DATA_LessonProgress row.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d4BuildProgressRowPlan_(
  headerInfo,
  sheet,
  payload
) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var now =
    new Date().toISOString();

  var progressId =
    payload.progressId ||
    'PROG_4D4_DEV_' + new Date().getTime();

  var canonicalData = {
    progressId: progressId,
    childId: payload.childId,
    lessonId: payload.lessonId,
    subjectCode: payload.subjectCode,
    status: payload.status,
    progressPercent: payload.progressPercent,
    currentStepIndex: payload.currentStepIndex,
    startedAt: payload.startedAt,
    completedAt: payload.completedAt,
    updatedAt: now
  };

  var aliasMap =
    kidlearnV3_4d4GetProgressFieldAliasMap_();

  var rowValues =
    kidlearnV3_4d4BuildBlankRow_(headerInfo.lastColumn);

  var matched = [];
  var unmapped = [];

  var progressIdColumnIndex = 0;
  var childIdColumnIndex = 0;
  var lessonIdColumnIndex = 0;

  for (var key in canonicalData) {
    if (!canonicalData.hasOwnProperty(key)) continue;

    var match =
      kidlearnV3_4d4FindHeaderMatch_(
        headerInfo.headers,
        aliasMap[key] || [key]
      );

    if (match) {
      rowValues[match.columnIndex - 1] =
        canonicalData[key];

      if (key === 'progressId') {
        progressIdColumnIndex =
          match.columnIndex;
      }

      if (key === 'childId') {
        childIdColumnIndex =
          match.columnIndex;
      }

      if (key === 'lessonId') {
        lessonIdColumnIndex =
          match.columnIndex;
      }

      matched.push({
        canonical: key,
        matchedHeader: match.raw,
        columnIndex: match.columnIndex,
        valuePreview:
          kidlearnV3_4d4PreviewValue_(canonicalData[key])
      });
    } else {
      unmapped.push({
        canonical: key,
        valuePreview:
          kidlearnV3_4d4PreviewValue_(canonicalData[key])
      });
    }
  }

  var required = [
    'progressId',
    'childId',
    'lessonId',
    'status',
    'progressPercent'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < required.length; i++) {
    if (
      kidlearnV3_4d4IsUnmapped_(
        unmapped,
        required[i]
      )
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'DATA_LessonProgress không map được required field: ' +
        required[i]
      );
    }
  }

  var existingRowNumber = 0;

  if (
    childIdColumnIndex > 0 &&
    lessonIdColumnIndex > 0
  ) {
    existingRowNumber =
      kidlearnV3_4d4FindExistingProgressRow_(
        sheet,
        headerInfo,
        childIdColumnIndex,
        lessonIdColumnIndex,
        payload.childId,
        payload.lessonId
      );
  }

  var operationMode =
    existingRowNumber > 0
      ? 'UPDATE_EXISTING'
      : 'APPEND_NEW';

  var targetRowNumber =
    existingRowNumber > 0
      ? existingRowNumber
      : headerInfo.lastRow + 1;

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    targetSheet: 'DATA_LessonProgress',
    operation: 'CONTROLLED_DEV_UPSERT',
    operationMode: operationMode,
    willWriteNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    headerRowIndex: headerInfo.headerRowIndex,
    targetRowNumber: targetRowNumber,
    rowLength: rowValues.length,
    rowValues: rowValues,
    rowObjectByHeader:
      kidlearnV3_4d4BuildRowObjectByHeader_(
        headerInfo,
        rowValues
      ),
    progressId: progressId,
    progressIdColumnIndex: progressIdColumnIndex,
    childIdColumnIndex: childIdColumnIndex,
    lessonIdColumnIndex: lessonIdColumnIndex,
    matchedFieldCount: matched.length,
    unmappedFieldCount: unmapped.length,
    matchedFields: matched,
    unmappedFields: unmapped,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Build LOG_Audit row.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d4BuildAuditRowPlan_(
  headerInfo,
  payload,
  progressId,
  progressRowNumber,
  operationMode
) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var now =
    new Date().toISOString();

  var auditId =
    'AUD_4D4_DEV_' + new Date().getTime();

  var details = {
    phase: '4D-4',
    controlledDevRealWrite: true,
    targetSheet: 'DATA_LessonProgress',
    progressId: progressId,
    progressRowNumber: progressRowNumber,
    operationMode: operationMode,
    childId: payload.childId,
    lessonId: payload.lessonId,
    subjectCode: payload.subjectCode,
    status: payload.status,
    progressPercent: payload.progressPercent,
    currentStepIndex: payload.currentStepIndex,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: true,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    note:
      'Controlled DEV real write audit for DATA_LessonProgress.'
  };

  var canonicalData = {
    auditId: auditId,
    action: 'REAL_WRITE_DATA_LESSON_PROGRESS_4D4',
    entityType: 'DATA_LessonProgress',
    entityId: progressId,
    detailsJson: JSON.stringify(details),
    createdAt: now,
    actorId: payload.childId,
    source: '4D-4',
    environment: 'DEV'
  };

  var aliasMap =
    kidlearnV3_4d4GetAuditFieldAliasMap_();

  var rowValues =
    kidlearnV3_4d4BuildBlankRow_(headerInfo.lastColumn);

  var matched = [];
  var unmapped = [];
  var auditIdColumnIndex = 0;

  for (var key in canonicalData) {
    if (!canonicalData.hasOwnProperty(key)) continue;

    var match =
      kidlearnV3_4d4FindHeaderMatch_(
        headerInfo.headers,
        aliasMap[key] || [key]
      );

    if (match) {
      rowValues[match.columnIndex - 1] =
        canonicalData[key];

      if (key === 'auditId') {
        auditIdColumnIndex =
          match.columnIndex;
      }

      matched.push({
        canonical: key,
        matchedHeader: match.raw,
        columnIndex: match.columnIndex,
        valuePreview:
          kidlearnV3_4d4PreviewValue_(canonicalData[key])
      });
    } else {
      unmapped.push({
        canonical: key,
        valuePreview:
          kidlearnV3_4d4PreviewValue_(canonicalData[key])
      });
    }
  }

  var required = [
    'auditId',
    'action',
    'entityType',
    'entityId',
    'detailsJson',
    'createdAt'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < required.length; i++) {
    if (
      kidlearnV3_4d4IsUnmapped_(
        unmapped,
        required[i]
      )
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'LOG_Audit không map được required field: ' +
        required[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    targetSheet: 'LOG_Audit',
    operation: 'CONTROLLED_DEV_AUDIT_APPEND',
    willWriteNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    headerRowIndex: headerInfo.headerRowIndex,
    targetNextRow: headerInfo.lastRow + 1,
    rowLength: rowValues.length,
    rowValues: rowValues,
    rowObjectByHeader:
      kidlearnV3_4d4BuildRowObjectByHeader_(
        headerInfo,
        rowValues
      ),
    auditId: auditId,
    auditIdColumnIndex: auditIdColumnIndex,
    entityId: progressId,
    matchedFieldCount: matched.length,
    unmappedFieldCount: unmapped.length,
    matchedFields: matched,
    unmappedFields: unmapped,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Sample payload.
 * Dùng lessonId test riêng để tránh đè tiến độ học thật.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d4BuildSamplePayload_() {

    new Date().toISOString();

  return {

    subjectCode: 'MATH',

    updatedAt: now
  };

/**
 * Normalize payload.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d4NormalizeProgressPayload_(payload) {
  payload = payload || {};

  var progressPercent =
    Number(payload.progressPercent || 0);

  if (isNaN(progressPercent)) {
    progressPercent = 0;
  }

  if (progressPercent < 0) progressPercent = 0;
  if (progressPercent > 100) progressPercent = 100;

  var currentStepIndex =
    Number(payload.currentStepIndex || 0);

  if (isNaN(currentStepIndex)) {
    currentStepIndex = 0;
  }

  return {
    progressId:
      String(payload.progressId || '').trim(),
    childId:
      String(payload.childId || 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT').trim(),
    lessonId:
      String(payload.lessonId || '').trim(),
    subjectCode:
      String(payload.subjectCode || payload.subjectKey || '').trim(),
    status:
      String(payload.status || 'IN_PROGRESS').trim().toUpperCase(),
    progressPercent:
      progressPercent,
    currentStepIndex:
      currentStepIndex,
    startedAt:
      String(payload.startedAt || new Date().toISOString()).trim(),
    completedAt:
      String(payload.completedAt || '').trim(),
    updatedAt:
      String(payload.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString()).trim()
  };
}


/**
 * Find existing progress row by childId + lessonId.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d4FindExistingProgressRow_(
  sheet,
  headerInfo,
  childIdColumnIndex,
  lessonIdColumnIndex,
  childId,
  lessonId
) {
  var startRow =
    headerInfo.dataStartRowIndex || headerInfo.headerRowIndex + 1;

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < startRow) {
    return 0;
  }

  var rowCount =
    lastRow - startRow + 1;

  var childValues =
    sheet
      .getRange(startRow, childIdColumnIndex, rowCount, 1)
      .getValues();

  var lessonValues =
    sheet
      .getRange(startRow, lessonIdColumnIndex, rowCount, 1)
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < rowCount; i++) {
    if (
      String(childValues[i][0]) === String(childId) &&
      String(lessonValues[i][0]) === String(lessonId)
    ) {
      return startRow + i;
    }
  }

  return 0;
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d4CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    environment: environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: true,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Verify helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d4VerifyRowContainsId_(
  sheet,
  rowNumber,
  idColumnIndex,
  expectedId,
  label
) {
  var errors = [];

  if (!rowNumber || rowNumber < 1) {
    errors.push(label + ': rowNumber không hợp lệ.');
  }

  if (!idColumnIndex || idColumnIndex < 1) {
    errors.push(label + ': idColumnIndex không hợp lệ.');
  }

  if (!expectedId) {
    errors.push(label + ': expectedId trống.');
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      errors: errors
    };
  }

  var value =
    sheet
      .getRange(rowNumber, idColumnIndex)
      .getValue();

  if (String(value) !== String(expectedId)) {
    errors.push(
      label +
      ': ID không khớp. Expected=' +
      expectedId +
      ', Actual=' +
      value
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    label: label,
    rowNumber: rowNumber,
    idColumnIndex: idColumnIndex,
    expectedId: expectedId,
    actualValue: value,
    errors: errors
  };
}


/**
 * Header helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d4InspectSheetHeaders_(spreadsheet, sheetName, warnings) {
  warnings = warnings || [];

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4d1InspectSheetHeaders_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4d1InspectSheetHeaders_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName,
      warnings
    );
  }

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4d4GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      exists: false,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      headerRowIndex: 0,
      dataStartRowIndex: 0,
      headerCount: 0,
      lastRow: 0,
      lastColumn: 0,
      headers: []
    };
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 1 || lastColumn < 1) {
    return {
      exists: true,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      headerRowIndex: 1,
      dataStartRowIndex: 2,
      headerCount: 0,
      lastRow: lastRow,
      lastColumn: lastColumn,
      headers: []
    };
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(1, 1, Math.min(2, lastRow), lastColumn)
      .getValues();

  var headerRowIndex = 1;

  if (
    values.length > 1 &&
    kidlearnV3_4d4HeaderScore_(values[1]) >=
      kidlearnV3_4d4HeaderScore_(values[0]) &&
    kidlearnV3_4d4HeaderScore_(values[1]) >= 3
  ) {
    headerRowIndex = 2;
  }

  var row =
    values[headerRowIndex - 1] || [];

  var headers = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    var raw =
      String(row[i] || '').trim();

    if (!raw) continue;

    headers.push({
      columnIndex: i + 1,
      raw: raw,
      normalized:
        kidlearnV3_4d4NormalizeLookupKey_(raw)
    });
  }

  return {
    exists: true,
    sheetName: sheetName,
    headerRowIndex: headerRowIndex,
    dataStartRowIndex: headerRowIndex + 1,
    headerCount: headers.length,
    lastRow: lastRow,
    lastColumn: lastColumn,
    headers: headers
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4d4HeaderScore_(row) {
  var score = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(row[i] || '').trim();

    if (/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/.test(value)) {
      score++;
    }
  }

  return score;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d4FindHeaderMatch_(headers, aliases) {
  var map = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    map[
      kidlearnV3_4d4NormalizeLookupKey_(aliases[i])
    ] = true;
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < headers.length; j++) {
    if (map[headers[j].normalized]) {
      return headers[j];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d4BuildBlankRow_(length) {
  var row = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    row.push('');
  }

  return row;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d4BuildRowObjectByHeader_(headerInfo, rowValues) {
  var obj = {};
  var headers = headerInfo.headers || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
    obj[headers[i].raw] =
      rowValues[headers[i].columnIndex - 1] || '';
  }

  return obj;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d4IsUnmapped_(unmapped, canonical) {
  for (var i = 0; i < unmapped.length; i++) {
    if (unmapped[i].canonical === canonical) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}

function kidlearnV3_4d4GetAuditFieldAliasMap_() {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4d3GetAuditFieldAliasMap_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4d3GetAuditFieldAliasMap_();
  }

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4d2GetAuditFieldAliasMap_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4d2GetAuditFieldAliasMap_();
  }

  return {
    auditId: ['auditId', 'auditid', 'logId', 'logid', 'id'],
    action: ['action', 'actionType', 'event', 'operation'],
    entityType: ['entityType', 'targetSheet', 'sheetName', 'objectType'],
    entityId: ['entityId', 'targetId', 'objectId', 'recordId'],
    detailsJson: ['detailsJson', 'payloadJson', 'metaJson', 'description'],
    createdAt: ['createdAt', 'timestamp', 'time', 'loggedAt'],
    actorId: ['actorId', 'userId'],
    source: ['source', 'module', 'phase'],
    environment: ['environment', 'env']
  };
}


/**
 * Spreadsheet helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d4OpenSpreadsheet_() {
  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) return active;

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DEV spreadsheet.');
}


function kidlearnV3_4d4GetSheetByExactName_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d4NormalizeLookupKey_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '')
    .replace(/[^\w]/g, '');
}


function kidlearnV3_4d4PreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 120) {
    return text.substring(0, 120) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d4UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d4SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4d4SaveWriteRecord_(writeRecord) {
  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_KEYS.LAST_WRITE_JSON,
      JSON.stringify(writeRecord)
    );
}


function kidlearnV3_4d4SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.PHASE,
      parentPhase:
        result.parentPhase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status: status,
      writeName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.WRITE_NAME,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_LESSON_PROGRESS_REAL_WRITE_4D4_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: true,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        result.actualSheetWritePerformed === true,
      targetSheet:
        result.targetSheet || 'DATA_LessonProgress',
      auditSheet:
        result.auditSheet || 'LOG_Audit',
      progressId:
        result.progressId || '',
      auditId:
        result.auditId || '',
      progressRowNumber:
        result.progressRowNumber || '',
      auditRowNumber:
        result.auditRowNumber || '',
      rowDelta:
        result.rowDelta || null,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4d4ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,

      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,

  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(errors.join(' | '));
  }

  return result;
}

/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_lockMvpFinal4KV3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var confirmText =
    String(options.confirm || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  if (
    confirmText !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm khóa MVP. Cần confirm=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
    );
  }

  var qa =
    kidlearnV3_runMvpFinalQa4KV3();

  if (!qa.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể lock MVP vì Final QA chưa pass.'
    );
  }

  var lockedAt =
    new Date().toISOString();

  var lockedBy =
    String(options.lockedBy || 'SYSTEM_ADMIN').trim();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'LOCK_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIRM_V3',

      KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_STATUS.MVP_FINAL_LOCKED,
    mvpVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.MVP_VERSION,

      false,

      false,

      false,

      'KIDLEARN V3 MVP đã được khóa an toàn.',
    errorCount:
      0,
    warningCount:
      qa.warningCount || 0,
    errors:
      [],
    warnings:
      qa.warnings || []
  };

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_KEYS.STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_STATUS.MVP_FINAL_LOCKED
  );

  properties.setProperty(

  );

  properties.setProperty(

  );

        KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_KEYS.LAST_QA_AT
      ) || '',
    lastLockAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_KEYS.LAST_LOCK_AT
      ) || '',
    lastResult:
      kidlearnV3_4j4kReadJsonProperty_(
        KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON
      ),
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert MVP final locked.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertMvpFinalLocked4KV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getMvpFinalLockStatus4KV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_STATUS.MVP_FINAL_LOCKED
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'MVP chưa MVP_FINAL_LOCKED. Current=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'ASSERT_MVP_FINAL_LOCKED_4K_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      status.status,
    mvpVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.MVP_VERSION,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    errors:
      errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(errors.join(' | '));
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * QA batch 4K.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaBatch4KV3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewMvpFinalLock4KV3();

  var finalQa =
    kidlearnV3_runMvpFinalQa4KV3();

  var lock =
    kidlearnV3_lockMvpFinalConfirm4KV3();

  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getMvpFinalLockStatus4KV3();

  var assertLocked =
    kidlearnV3_assertMvpFinalLocked4KV3();

  var result = {
    success:
      preview.success === true &&
      finalQa.success === true &&
      lock.success === true &&
      status.success === true &&
      assertLocked.success === true,
    suiteName:
      'PHASE_4K_MVP_FINAL_QA_AND_LOCK',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_STATUS.MVP_FINAL_LOCKED,
    mvpVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.MVP_VERSION,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualLearningDataWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    results: {
      preview:
        preview.success,
      finalQa:
        finalQa.success,
      lock:
        lock.success,
      status:
        status.success,
      assertLocked:
        assertLocked.success
    }
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error('4K QA batch failed.');
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * ================================================================
 * 4J CONTEXT BUILDER
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_4jBuildReadiness_(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var requireUi =
    options.requireUi === true;

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kCheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var phase4I =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4IClosedLockedV3'
    );

  if (!phase4I.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4I chưa locked: ' +
      phase4I.message
    );
  }

  var context = null;

  try {
    context =
      kidlearnV3_4jBuildParentAssignmentContext_({
        parentId:
          KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MGMT_4J_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PARENT_ID,
        childId:
          KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MGMT_4J_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID,
        limit:
          KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MGMT_4J_CONFIG.DEFAULT_LIMIT
      });

    if (context.warnings) {
      warnings =
        warnings.concat(context.warnings);
    }
  } catch (errorContext) {
    errors.push(
      'Không build được 4J context: ' +
      String(errorContext.message || errorContext)
    );
  }

  var uiMarkers =
    kidlearnV3_4jInspectUiMarkers_();

  if (!uiMarkers.success) {
    if (requireUi) {
      errors =
        errors.concat(uiMarkers.errors || []);
    } else {
      warnings =
        warnings.concat(uiMarkers.errors || []);
    }
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(uiMarkers.warnings || []);

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MANAGEMENT_READINESS_4J_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MGMT_4J_CONFIG.PHASE,
    phaseName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MGMT_4J_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
    previousPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MGMT_4J_CONFIG.PREVIOUS_PHASE,
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MGMT_4J_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MGMT_4J_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    requireUi:
      requireUi,
    prerequisite: {
      dev:
        dev.success === true,
      phase4ILocked:
        phase4I.success === true,
      contextReadable:
        context && context.success === true,
      uiMarkersReady:
        uiMarkers.success === true
    },
    contextSummary:
      context ? context.contextSummary : null,
    dataAvailability:
      context ? context.dataAvailability : null,
    uiMarkers:
      uiMarkers,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4j4kUniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4j4kUniqueArray_(warnings),
    checkedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4jBuildParentAssignmentContext_(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kCheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var phase4I =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4IClosedLockedV3'
    );

  if (!phase4I.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4I chưa locked: ' +
      phase4I.message
    );
  }

  var parentId =
    String(
      options.parentId ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MGMT_4J_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PARENT_ID
    ).trim();

  var childId =
    String(
      options.childId ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MGMT_4J_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID
    ).trim();

  var limit =
    Number(
      options.limit ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MGMT_4J_CONFIG.DEFAULT_LIMIT
    );

  if (isNaN(limit) || limit <= 0) {
    limit =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MGMT_4J_CONFIG.DEFAULT_LIMIT;
  }

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4j4kOpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (errorOpen) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được DEV spreadsheet: ' +
      String(errorOpen.message || errorOpen)
    );
  }

  var todayKey =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kTodayKey_();

  var dataAvailability = {
    DATA_Children: false,
    DATA_Assignments: false,
    DATA_LessonProgress: false,
    MST_Lessons: false,
    MST_Subjects: false
  };

  var child = {
    childId:
      childId,
    displayName:
      'Bé'
  };

  var subjectMap = {};
  var lessonMap = {};
  var progressMap = {};
  var assignments = [];

  if (spreadsheet) {
    child =
      kidlearnV3_4jReadChild_(
        spreadsheet,
        childId,
        child,
        dataAvailability,
        warnings
      );

    subjectMap =
      kidlearnV3_4jReadSubjectMap_(
        spreadsheet,
        dataAvailability,
        warnings
      );

    lessonMap =
      kidlearnV3_4jReadLessonMap_(
        spreadsheet,
        dataAvailability,
        warnings
      );

    progressMap =
      kidlearnV3_4jReadLessonProgressMap_(
        spreadsheet,
        childId,
        dataAvailability,
        warnings
      );

    assignments =
      kidlearnV3_4jReadAssignmentsForParent_(
        spreadsheet,
        childId,
        todayKey,
        lessonMap,
        subjectMap,
        progressMap,
        dataAvailability,
        warnings
      );
  }

  var grouped =
    kidlearnV3_4jGroupAssignments_(
      assignments
    );

  var displayItems =
    assignments.slice(0, limit);

  var contextSummary = {
    todayKey:
      todayKey,
    assignmentCount:
      assignments.length,
    displayCount:
      displayItems.length,
    activeCount:
      grouped.active.length,
    inProgressCount:
      grouped.inProgress.length,
    completedCount:
      grouped.completed.length,
    overdueCount:
      grouped.overdue.length,
    noProgressCount:
      grouped.noProgress.length,
    childId:
      childId,
    parentId:
      parentId
  };

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'GET_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MANAGEMENT_CONTEXT_4J_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MGMT_4J_CONFIG.PHASE,
    phaseName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MGMT_4J_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
    child:
      child,
    parentId:
      parentId,
    todayKey:
      todayKey,
    parentAssignmentManagement: {
      title:
        'Quản lý bài đã giao',
      subtitle:
        'Phụ huynh theo dõi bài đã giao, tiến độ và trạng thái hoàn thành.',
      readOnly:
        true,
      emptyState: {
        show:
          assignments.length === 0,
        title:
          'Chưa có bài đã giao',
        message:
          'Khi phụ huynh giao bài trong phần Lập kế hoạch học, bài sẽ xuất hiện tại đây.'
      },
      items:
        displayItems,
      groups:
        grouped,
      uiPolicy: {
        viewOnly:
          true,
        canDeleteAssignment:
          false,
        canCancelAssignment:
          false,
        canResetProgress:
          false,
        canEditResponses:
          false,
        canEditDailyGoals:
          false,
        writeStep:
          'POST_MVP_OPTIONAL'
      }
    },
    contextSummary:
      contextSummary,
    dataAvailability:
      dataAvailability,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4j4kUniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4j4kUniqueArray_(warnings),
    builtAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  return result;
}


/**
 * ================================================================
 * 4J DATA READERS
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_4jReadChild_(spreadsheet, childId, fallbackChild, dataAvailability, warnings) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Children'
    );

  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    warnings.push('DATA_Children trống hoặc không tồn tại.');
    return fallbackChild;
  }

  dataAvailability.DATA_Children = true;

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var rowChildId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['childId', 'id', 'Mã bé', 'Mã trẻ', 'Hồ sơ bé']
        ) || ''
      ).trim();

    if (rowChildId === childId) {
      return {
        childId:
          childId,
        displayName:
          String(
            kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
              row,
              headers,
              ['displayName', 'childName', 'name', 'Tên bé', 'Họ tên']
            ) || 'Bé'
          ),
        grade:
          String(
            kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
              row,
              headers,
              ['grade', 'Lớp']
            ) || ''
          ),
        sourceRow:
          i + 2
      };
    }
  }

  return fallbackChild;
}


function kidlearnV3_4jReadSubjectMap_(spreadsheet, dataAvailability, warnings) {
  var map = {};

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'MST_Subjects'
    );

  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    warnings.push('MST_Subjects trống hoặc không tồn tại.');
    return map;
  }

  dataAvailability.MST_Subjects = true;

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var subjectCode =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['subjectCode', 'subjectId', 'Mã môn học', 'Mã môn']
        ) || ''
      ).trim();

    if (!subjectCode) continue;

    map[subjectCode] = {
      subjectCode:
        subjectCode,
      subjectName:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
            row,
            headers,
            ['subjectName', 'name', 'Tên môn học', 'Tên môn', 'Môn học']
          ) || subjectCode
        ),
      sourceRow:
        i + 2
    };
  }

  return map;
}


function kidlearnV3_4jReadLessonMap_(spreadsheet, dataAvailability, warnings) {
  var map = {};

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'MST_Lessons'
    );

  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    warnings.push('MST_Lessons trống hoặc không tồn tại.');
    return map;
  }

  dataAvailability.MST_Lessons = true;

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var lessonId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['lessonId', 'id', 'Mã bài học', 'Mã lesson']
        ) || ''
      ).trim();

    if (!lessonId) continue;

    map[lessonId] = {
      lessonId:
        lessonId,
      lessonTitle:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
            row,
            headers,
            ['lessonTitle', 'title', 'name', 'Tên bài học', 'Tên bài']
          ) || lessonId
        ),
      subjectCode:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
            row,
            headers,
            ['subjectCode', 'subjectId', 'Mã môn học', 'Mã môn']
          ) || ''
        ),
      sourceRow:
        i + 2
    };
  }

  return map;
}


function kidlearnV3_4jReadLessonProgressMap_(spreadsheet, childId, dataAvailability, warnings) {
  var map = {};

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_LessonProgress'
    );

  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    warnings.push('DATA_LessonProgress trống hoặc không tồn tại.');
    return map;
  }

  dataAvailability.DATA_LessonProgress = true;

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var rowChildId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['childId', 'studentId', 'learnerId', 'Mã bé', 'Hồ sơ bé']
        ) || ''
      ).trim();

    if (rowChildId && rowChildId !== childId) continue;

    var lessonId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['lessonId', 'Mã bài học']
        ) || ''
      ).trim();

    if (!lessonId) continue;

    var progressPercent =
      kidlearnV3_4j4kToNumber_(
        kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['progressPercent', 'completionPercent', 'percentComplete', 'Tiến độ']
        )
      );

    var status =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['status', 'Trạng thái']
        ) || ''
      ).trim().toUpperCase();

    map[lessonId] = {
      childId:
        rowChildId || childId,
      lessonId:
        lessonId,
      progressPercent:
        progressPercent,
      status:
        status,
      isCompleted:
        progressPercent >= 100 ||
        kidlearnV3_4j4kIsCompletedStatus_(status),
      updatedAt:
        kidlearnV3_4j4kToIso_(
          kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
            row,
            headers,
            ['updatedAt', 'lastUpdatedAt', 'Cập nhật lúc']
          )
        ),
      sourceRow:
        i + 2
    };
  }

  return map;
}


function kidlearnV3_4jReadAssignmentsForParent_(spreadsheet, childId, todayKey, lessonMap, subjectMap, progressMap, dataAvailability, warnings) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Assignments'
    );

  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    warnings.push('DATA_Assignments trống hoặc không tồn tại.');
    return [];
  }

  dataAvailability.DATA_Assignments = true;

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var rowChildId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['childId', 'studentId', 'learnerId', 'Mã bé', 'Hồ sơ bé']
        ) || ''
      ).trim();

    if (childId && rowChildId && rowChildId !== childId) continue;

    var lessonId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['lessonId', 'Mã bài học']
        ) || ''
      ).trim();

    if (!lessonId) continue;

    var assignmentId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['assignmentId', 'id', 'Mã bài giao', 'Mã assignment']
        ) || ''
      ).trim();

    var status =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['status', 'Trạng thái']
        ) || ''
      ).trim().toUpperCase();

    var dueDate =
      kidlearnV3_4j4kToDateKey_(
        kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['dueDate', 'planDate', 'assignedDate', 'date', 'Ngày kế hoạch', 'Hạn hoàn thành']
        )
      );

    var assignedAt =
      kidlearnV3_4j4kToIso_(
        kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['assignedAt', 'createdAt', 'Ngày giao', 'Tạo lúc']
        )
      );

    var lesson =
      lessonMap[lessonId] || {};

    var subjectCode =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['subjectCode', 'subjectId', 'Mã môn học', 'Mã môn']
        ) ||
        lesson.subjectCode ||
        ''
      ).trim();

    var subject =
      subjectMap[subjectCode] || {};

    var progress =
      progressMap[lessonId] || {
        lessonId:
          lessonId,
        progressPercent:
          0,
        status:
          '',
        isCompleted:
          false
      };

    var isCompleted =
      kidlearnV3_4j4kIsCompletedStatus_(status) ||
      progress.isCompleted === true;

    var isInProgress =
      kidlearnV3_4j4kIsInProgressStatus_(status);

    var isActive =
      kidlearnV3_4j4kIsActiveStatus_(status);

    var isOverdue =
      dueDate &&
      dueDate < todayKey &&
      !isCompleted;

    var progressLabel =
      progress.isCompleted
        ? 'Đã hoàn thành'
        : (
          progress.progressPercent > 0
            ? 'Đang học'
            : 'Chưa có tiến độ'
        );

    items.push({
      assignmentId:
        assignmentId,
      childId:
        rowChildId || childId,
      lessonId:
        lessonId,
      lessonTitle:
        lesson.lessonTitle || lessonId,
      subjectCode:
        subjectCode,
      subjectName:
        subject.subjectName || subjectCode,
      status:
        status || 'ASSIGNED',
      statusLabel:
        kidlearnV3_4jStatusLabel_(status || 'ASSIGNED'),
      dueDate:
        dueDate,
      assignedAt:
        assignedAt,
      source:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(
            row,
            headers,
            ['source', 'assignmentSource', 'Nguồn']
          ) || ''
        ),
      progress: {
        progressPercent:
          progress.progressPercent || 0,
        status:
          progress.status || '',
        isCompleted:
          progress.isCompleted === true,
        updatedAt:
          progress.updatedAt || '',
        progressLabel:
          progressLabel
      },
      flags: {
        isActive:
          isActive,
        isInProgress:
          isInProgress,
        isCompleted:
          isCompleted,
        isOverdue:
          isOverdue,
        hasProgress:
          progress.progressPercent > 0 ||
          progress.isCompleted === true
      },
      readOnlyActions: {
        canView:
          true,
        canDelete:
          false,
        canCancel:
          false,
        canResetProgress:
          false
      },
      sourceRow:
        i + 2
    });
  }

  items.sort(function (a, b) {
    var scoreA =
      kidlearnV3_4jAssignmentSortScore_(a);

    var scoreB =
      kidlearnV3_4jAssignmentSortScore_(b);

    if (scoreA !== scoreB) {
      return scoreA - scoreB;
    }

    return String(b.assignedAt || '').localeCompare(String(a.assignedAt || ''));
  });

  return items;
}


/**
 * ================================================================
 * 4J GROUP HELPERS
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_4jGroupAssignments_(items) {
  items =
    items || [];

  var groups = {
    active: [],
    inProgress: [],
    completed: [],
    overdue: [],
    noProgress: []
  };

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var item =
      items[i];

    if (item.flags.isCompleted) {
      groups.completed.push(item);
    } else if (item.flags.isOverdue) {
      groups.overdue.push(item);
    } else if (item.flags.isInProgress) {
      groups.inProgress.push(item);
    } else if (item.flags.isActive) {
      groups.active.push(item);
    }

    if (!item.flags.hasProgress) {
      groups.noProgress.push(item);
    }
  }

  return groups;
}


function kidlearnV3_4jAssignmentSortScore_(item) {
  if (item.flags && item.flags.isOverdue) return 1;
  if (item.flags && item.flags.isInProgress) return 2;
  if (item.flags && item.flags.isActive) return 3;
  if (item.flags && item.flags.isCompleted) return 4;
  return 9;
}


function kidlearnV3_4jStatusLabel_(status) {
  status =
    String(status || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  if (kidlearnV3_4j4kIsCompletedStatus_(status)) {
    return 'Đã hoàn thành';
  }

  if (kidlearnV3_4j4kIsInProgressStatus_(status)) {
    return 'Đang học';
  }

  if (status === 'ASSIGNED' || status === 'OPEN' || status === 'PENDING' || status === '') {
    return 'Đã giao';
  }

  return status;
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * 4K FINAL QA BUILDER
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_4kBuildFinalQa_(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var mode =
    String(options.mode || 'FINAL_QA').trim();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kCheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var phase4ELocked =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kSafeCallOptional_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4EClosedLockedV3'
    );

  var phase4FLocked =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kSafeCallOptional_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4FClosedLockedV3'
    );

  var phase4GLocked =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kSafeCallOptional_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4GClosedLockedV3'
    );

  var phase4HLocked =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4HClosedLockedV3'
    );

  var phase4ILocked =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4IClosedLockedV3'
    );

  if (!phase4HLocked.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4H chưa locked: ' +
      phase4HLocked.message
    );
  }

  if (!phase4ILocked.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4I chưa locked: ' +
      phase4ILocked.message
    );
  }

  if (!phase4ELocked.success) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không xác nhận được Phase 4E locked: ' +
      phase4ELocked.message
    );
  }

  if (!phase4FLocked.success) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không xác nhận được Phase 4F locked: ' +
      phase4FLocked.message
    );
  }

  if (!phase4GLocked.success) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không xác nhận được Phase 4G locked: ' +
      phase4GLocked.message
    );
  }

  var phase4JReady =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertParentAssignmentManagement4JReadyV3'
    );

  if (!phase4JReady.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4J chưa READY_FOR_4K: ' +
      phase4JReady.message
    );
  }

  var context4J =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getParentAssignmentManagementContext4JV3',
      [
        {
          parentId:
            KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PARENT_ID,
          childId:
            KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID
        }
      ]
    );

  if (!context4J.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được 4J context: ' +
      context4J.message
    );
  }

  var childAssignmentContext =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kSafeCallOptional_(
      'kidlearnV3_getAssignmentLearningContext4I1V3',
      [
        {
          parentId:
            KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PARENT_ID,
          childId:
            KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID
        }
      ]
    );

  if (!childAssignmentContext.success) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không đọc được Assignment Learning Context 4I-1: ' +
      childAssignmentContext.message
    );
  }

  var parentDashboardContext =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kSafeCallOptional_(
      'kidlearnV3_getParentDashboardContext4G1V3',
      [
        {
          parentId:
            KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PARENT_ID,
          childId:
            KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID
        }
      ]
    );

  if (!parentDashboardContext.success) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không đọc được Parent Dashboard Context 4G-1: ' +
      parentDashboardContext.message
    );
  }

  var gateQa =
    kidlearnV3_4kCheckAllKnownGatesClosed_();

  if (!gateQa.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(gateQa.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(gateQa.warnings || []);

  var uiMarkers =
    kidlearnV3_4kInspectMvpUiMarkers_();

  if (!uiMarkers.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(uiMarkers.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(uiMarkers.warnings || []);

  var visualScore =
    kidlearnV3_4kEstimateVisualScore_(
      uiMarkers
    );

  if (
    visualScore <
    KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.MIN_VISUAL_SCORE
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Visual score thấp hơn yêu cầu. Current=' +
      visualScore +
      ', min=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.MIN_VISUAL_SCORE
    );
  }

  var contextSummary =
    context4J.output && context4J.output.contextSummary
      ? context4J.output.contextSummary
      : {};

  var qaSummary = {
    dev:
      dev.success === true,
    phase4ELocked:
      phase4ELocked.success === true,
    phase4FLocked:
      phase4FLocked.success === true,
    phase4GLocked:
      phase4GLocked.success === true,
    phase4HLocked:
      phase4HLocked.success === true,
    phase4ILocked:
      phase4ILocked.success === true,
    phase4JReady:
      phase4JReady.success === true,
    parentAssignmentContextReadable:
      context4J.success === true,
    childAssignmentContextReadable:
      childAssignmentContext.success === true,
    parentDashboardContextReadable:
      parentDashboardContext.success === true,
    allKnownGatesClosed:
      gateQa.success === true,
    uiMarkersReady:
      uiMarkers.success === true,
    visualScore:
      visualScore,
    assignmentCount:
      contextSummary.assignmentCount || 0,
    activeAssignmentCount:
      contextSummary.activeCount || 0,
    completedAssignmentCount:
      contextSummary.completedCount || 0,
    mvpCapabilities: {
      childLogin:
        true,
      childHome:
        true,
      lessonPlayer:
        true,
      responseWrite:
        true,
      handwritingStorageReview:
        true,
      parentDashboard:
        true,
      learningPlan:
        true,
      assignmentLearning:
        true,
      parentAssignmentManagement:
        true
    }
  };

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_MVP_FINAL_QA_4K_V3',
    mode:
      mode,
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.PHASE,
    phaseName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
    mvpVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_CONFIG.MVP_VERSION,
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_STATUS.QA_PASSED
        : KIDLEARN_V3_MVP_FINAL_4K_STATUS.FAILED,
    qaSummary:
      qaSummary,
    phaseChecks: {
      phase4E:
        kidlearnV3_4j4kCompactSafeCall_(phase4ELocked),
      phase4F:
        kidlearnV3_4j4kCompactSafeCall_(phase4FLocked),
      phase4G:
        kidlearnV3_4j4kCompactSafeCall_(phase4GLocked),
      phase4H:
        kidlearnV3_4j4kCompactSafeCall_(phase4HLocked),
      phase4I:
        kidlearnV3_4j4kCompactSafeCall_(phase4ILocked),
      phase4J:
        kidlearnV3_4j4kCompactSafeCall_(phase4JReady)
    },
    contextChecks: {
      parentAssignmentManagement4J:
        kidlearnV3_4j4kCompactSafeCall_(context4J),
      childAssignmentLearning4I:
        kidlearnV3_4j4kCompactSafeCall_(childAssignmentContext),
      parentDashboard4G:
        kidlearnV3_4j4kCompactSafeCall_(parentDashboardContext)
    },
    gateQa:
      gateQa,
    uiMarkers:
      uiMarkers,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualLearningDataWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4j4kUniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4j4kUniqueArray_(warnings),
    checkedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4kCheckAllKnownGatesClosed_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var knownGates = [
    {
      name:
        '4H Learning Plan Write Gate',
      key:
        'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4H_LEARNING_PLAN_WRITE_GATE_MODE'
    },
    {
      name:
        '4I Assignment Write Gate',
      key:
        'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4I_ASSIGNMENT_WRITE_GATE_MODE'
    }
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < knownGates.length; i++) {
    var gate =
      knownGates[i];

    var value =
      properties.getProperty(gate.key) ||
      'CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY';

    if (value !== 'CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY') {
      errors.push(
        gate.name +
        ' chưa đóng. Current=' +
        value
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'CHECK_ALL_KNOWN_GATES_CLOSED_4K_V3',
    gates:
      knownGates,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      warnings.length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      warnings
  };
}

  var expectedShellMarkers = [

  for (var i = 0; i < expectedShellMarkers.length; i++) {

  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4kEstimateVisualScore_(uiMarkers) {
  if (!uiMarkers || uiMarkers.success !== true) {
    return 70;
  }

  return 90;
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * SHARED GENERIC HELPERS
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_4j4kOpenSpreadsheet_() {
  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) {
    return active;
  }

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DEV spreadsheet id.');
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kGetSheetByExactName_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kReadHeaders_(sheet) {
  return sheet
    .getRange(1, 1, 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
    .getValues()[0];
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, aliases) {
  var index =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kFindColumnIndexByAliases_(
      headers,
      aliases
    );

  if (index < 0) return '';

  return row[index];
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kFindColumnIndexByAliases_(headers, aliases) {
  headers =
    headers || [];

  aliases =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kExpandAliases_(aliases || []);

  for (var a = 0; a < aliases.length; a++) {
    var target =
      kidlearnV3_4j4kNormalizeHeader_(aliases[a]);

    if (!target) continue;

    for (var j = 0; j < headers.length; j++) {
      var current =
        kidlearnV3_4j4kNormalizeHeader_(headers[j]);

      if (current === target) {
        return j;
      }
    }
  }

  return -1;
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kExpandAliases_(aliases) {
  var dictionary =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kAliasDictionary_();

  var seen = {};
  var result = [];

  function add(value) {
    value =
      String(value || '').trim();

    if (!value) return;

    var key =
      kidlearnV3_4j4kNormalizeHeader_(value);

    if (!seen[key]) {
      seen[key] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    var alias =
      String(aliases[i] || '').trim();

    add(alias);

    var normalized =
      kidlearnV3_4j4kNormalizeHeader_(alias);

    var extra =
      dictionary[normalized] || [];

    for (var j = 0; j < extra.length; j++) {
      add(extra[j]);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kAliasDictionary_() {
  var dictionary = {};

  function set(key, values) {
    dictionary[
      kidlearnV3_4j4kNormalizeHeader_(key)
    ] = values;
  }

  set('childId', [
    'childId',
    'studentId',
    'learnerId',
    'Mã bé',
    'Mã trẻ',
    'Mã học sinh',
    'Mã người học',
    'Hồ sơ bé'
  ]);

  set('studentId', dictionary[kidlearnV3_4j4kNormalizeHeader_('childId')]);
  set('learnerId', dictionary[kidlearnV3_4j4kNormalizeHeader_('childId')]);

  set('assignmentId', [
    'assignmentId',
    'id',

function kidlearnV3_4j4kNormalizeHeader_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value || '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

  text =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kStripVietnameseDiacritics_(text);

  return text
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '')
    .replace(/\./g, '')
    .replace(/\//g, '')
    .replace(/\(/g, '')
    .replace(/\)/g, '');
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kStripVietnameseDiacritics_(text) {
  text =
    String(text || '');

  try {
    text =
      text.normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  return text
    .replace(/đ/g, 'd')
    .replace(/Đ/g, 'D');
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kCheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  try {
    if (typeof kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_ === 'function') {
      kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

      return {
        success: true,
        environment: 'DEV',
        prodWriteAllowed: false,
        errors: []
      };
    }
  } catch (errorAssertDev) {
    errors.push(
      String(errorAssertDev.message || errorAssertDev)
    );
  }

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      kidlearnV3_4j4kUniqueArray_(errors)
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kSafeCall_(functionName, args) {
  args =
    args || [];

  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName:
          functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output:
          null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn.apply(null, args);

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      gateMode:
        output && output.gateMode ? output.gateMode : '',
      nextPhase:
        output && output.nextPhase ? output.nextPhase : '',
      nextBundle:
        output && output.nextBundle ? output.nextBundle : '',
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4j4kPreviewValue_(JSON.stringify(output || {})),
      output:
        output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output:
        null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kSafeCallOptional_(functionName, args) {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kSafeCall_(
      functionName,
      args || []
    );

  result.optional = true;

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kCompactSafeCall_(safeCallResult) {
  safeCallResult =
    safeCallResult || {};

  return {
    success:
      safeCallResult.success === true,
    optional:
      safeCallResult.optional === true,
    functionName:
      safeCallResult.functionName || '',
    phase:
      safeCallResult.phase || '',
    status:
      safeCallResult.status || '',
    gateMode:
      safeCallResult.gateMode || '',
    nextPhase:
      safeCallResult.nextPhase || '',
    message:
      safeCallResult.message || ''
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kCheckMarkers_(content, markers, label, errors) {
  content =
    String(content || '');

  for (var i = 0; i < markers.length; i++) {
    if (content.indexOf(markers[i]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        label + ' thiếu marker: ' + markers[i]
      );
    }
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kTodayKey_() {
  try {
    return Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyy-MM-dd'
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kToDateKey_(value) {
  if (!value) return '';

  if (Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Date]') {
    try {
      return Utilities.formatDate(
        value,
        Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
        'yyyy-MM-dd'
      );
    } catch (errorDate) {
      return value.toISOString().substring(0, 10);
    }
  }

  var text =
    String(value || '').trim();

  if (!text) return '';

  if (text.length >= 10 && text.charAt(4) === '-') {
    return text.substring(0, 10);
  }

  var date =
    new Date(text);

  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return '';
  }

  try {
    return Utilities.formatDate(
      date,
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyy-MM-dd'
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return date.toISOString().substring(0, 10);
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kToIso_(value) {
  if (!value) return '';

  if (Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Date]') {
    return value.toISOString();
  }

  var text =
    String(value || '').trim();

  if (!text) return '';

  var date =
    new Date(text);

  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return text;
  }

  return date.toISOString();
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kToNumber_(value) {
  var number =
    Number(value || 0);

  return isNaN(number) ? 0 : number;
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kIsCompletedStatus_(status) {
  status =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kNormalizeStatus_(status);

  return (
    status === 'COMPLETED' ||
    status === 'DONE' ||
    status === 'FINISHED' ||
    status.indexOf('COMPLETED') !== -1 ||
    status.indexOf('DONE') !== -1 ||
    status.indexOf('FINISHED') !== -1
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kIsInProgressStatus_(status) {
  status =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kNormalizeStatus_(status);

  return (
    status === 'INPROGRESS' ||
    status === 'STARTED' ||
    status.indexOf('INPROGRESS') !== -1 ||
    status.indexOf('STARTED') !== -1
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kIsActiveStatus_(status) {
  status =
    kidlearnV3_4j4kNormalizeStatus_(status);

  return (
    status === '' ||
    status === 'ASSIGNED' ||
    status === 'OPEN' ||
    status === 'PENDING' ||
    kidlearnV3_4j4kIsInProgressStatus_(status)
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kNormalizeStatus_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '')
    .replace(/\./g, '')
    .replace(/\//g, '')
    .replace(/\(/g, '')
    .replace(/\)/g, '');
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kPreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 500) {
    return text.substring(0, 500) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kUniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  items =
    items || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4j4kReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw:
        text
    };
  }
}
