/**
 * Build readiness.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g4BuildReadiness_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4g4CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var g3 =
    kidlearnV3_4g4SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertParentSubjectProgressDetail4G3ReadyV3'
    );

  if (!g3.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4G-3 chưa READY_FOR_4G_4: ' +
      g3.message
    );
  }

  var timelineContext = null;

  try {
    timelineContext =
      kidlearnV3_getParentActivityTimeline4G4V3({
        parentId:
          KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PARENT_ID,
        childId:
          KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID,
        limit:
          KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.DEFAULT_LIMIT
      });
  } catch (errorTimeline) {
    errors.push(
      'Không build được timeline context 4G-4: ' +
      String(errorTimeline.message || errorTimeline)
    );
  }

  if (
    timelineContext &&
    timelineContext.timelineSummary &&
    timelineContext.timelineSummary.itemCount === 0
  ) {
    warnings.push(

  return {

      errors.length === 0,

      'BUILD_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_READINESS_4G_4_V3',

      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.PHASE,

    },

  };
}


/**
 * Build timeline context.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g4BuildTimelineContext_(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var parentId =
    String(
      options.parentId ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PARENT_ID
    ).trim();

  var childId =
    String(
      options.childId ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID
    ).trim();

  var limit =
    Number(
      options.limit ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.DEFAULT_LIMIT
    );

  if (isNaN(limit) || limit <= 0) {
    limit =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.DEFAULT_LIMIT;
  }

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4g4CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var g3 =
    kidlearnV3_4g4SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertParentSubjectProgressDetail4G3ReadyV3'
    );

  if (!g3.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4G-3 chưa READY_FOR_4G_4: ' +
      g3.message
    );
  }

  var dashboardContext = null;

  try {
    dashboardContext =
      kidlearnV3_getParentDashboardContext4G1V3({
        parentId:
          parentId,
        childId:
          childId,
        recentLimit:
          limit
      });
  } catch (errorContext) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được Parent Dashboard Context 4G-1: ' +
      String(errorContext.message || errorContext)
    );
  }

  var dashboard =
    dashboardContext && dashboardContext.parentDashboard
      ? dashboardContext.parentDashboard
      : {};

  var recent =
    dashboard.recentActivities || {};

  var rawItems =
    recent.items || [];

  var normalizedItems =
    kidlearnV3_4g4NormalizeTimelineItems_(
      rawItems,
      limit
    );

  var grouped =
    kidlearnV3_4g4GroupItemsByDate_(
      normalizedItems
    );

  var typeSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4g4BuildTypeSummary_(
      normalizedItems
    );

  var timelineSummary = {
    itemCount:
      normalizedItems.length,
    groupCount:
      grouped.groups.length,
    typeCount:
      typeSummary.types.length,
    latestAt:
      normalizedItems.length > 0
        ? normalizedItems[0].at || ''
        : '',
    empty:
      normalizedItems.length === 0
  };

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_CONTEXT_4G_4_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    timelineName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.TIMELINE_NAME,
    parentId:
      parentId,
    child:
      dashboard.child || {
        childId: childId,
        displayName: 'Bé'
      },
    timelineSummary:
      timelineSummary,
    timeline: {
      title:
        'Dòng thời gian hoạt động',
      subtitle:
        'Theo dõi các hoạt động học tập gần đây của bé',
      items:
        normalizedItems,
      groupedByDate:
        grouped,
      typeSummary:
        typeSummary,
      emptyState: {
        show:
          normalizedItems.length === 0,
        title:
          'Chưa có hoạt động học tập',
        message:
          'Khi bé học bài, nộp bài hoặc đạt thành tích, hoạt động sẽ hiển thị ở đây.'
      }
    },
    uiPolicy: {
      parentOnly:
        true,
      readOnlyNow:
        true,
      showFilter:
        true,
      showGroupedByDate:
        true,
      showActivityTypeBadge:
        true,
      nextUiStep:
        '4G-5'
    },
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4g4UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4g4UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4g4NormalizeTimelineItems_(items, limit) {
  items =
    items || [];

  var normalized = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var item =
      items[i] || {};

    normalized.push({
      timelineId:
        'TL_4G4_' + i + '_' + String(item.type || 'ACTIVITY'),
      type:
        String(item.type || 'ACTIVITY').trim() || 'ACTIVITY',
      typeLabel:
        kidlearnV3_4g4ActivityTypeLabel_(item.type),
      title:
        String(item.title || 'Hoạt động học tập'),
      subtitle:
        String(item.subtitle || ''),
      subjectCode:
        String(item.subjectCode || ''),
      icon:
        String(item.icon || '📌'),
      at:
        kidlearnV3_4g4ToIso_(item.at || ''),
      dateKey:
        kidlearnV3_4g4ToDateKey_(item.at || ''),
      displayTime:
        kidlearnV3_4g4DisplayDateTime_(item.at || ''),
      source:
        'PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1',
      readOnly:
        true
    });
  }

  normalized.sort(function (a, b) {
    return kidlearnV3_4g4DateValue_(b.at) -
      kidlearnV3_4g4DateValue_(a.at);
  });

  if (normalized.length > limit) {
    normalized =
      normalized.slice(0, limit);
  }

  return normalized;
}


function kidlearnV3_4g4GroupItemsByDate_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var groups = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var dateKey =
      items[i].dateKey || 'UNKNOWN_DATE';

    if (!map[dateKey]) {
      map[dateKey] = {
        dateKey:
          dateKey,
        dateLabel:
          kidlearnV3_4g4DateLabel_(dateKey),
        itemCount:
          0,
        items:
          []
      };

      groups.push(map[dateKey]);
    }

    map[dateKey].items.push(items[i]);
    map[dateKey].itemCount++;
  }

  groups.sort(function (a, b) {
    return kidlearnV3_4g4DateValue_(b.dateKey) -
      kidlearnV3_4g4DateValue_(a.dateKey);
  });

  return {
    groupCount:
      groups.length,
    groups:
      groups
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4g4BuildTypeSummary_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var types = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var type =
      items[i].type || 'ACTIVITY';

    if (!map[type]) {
      map[type] = {
        type:
          type,
        typeLabel:
          kidlearnV3_4g4ActivityTypeLabel_(type),
        count:
          0
      };

      types.push(map[type]);
    }

    map[type].count++;
  }

  types.sort(function (a, b) {
    return b.count - a.count;
  });

  return {
    types:
      types
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4g4ActivityTypeLabel_(type) {
  type =
    String(type || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  var labels = {
    STUDY_SESSION: 'Buổi học',
    LESSON_COMPLETED: 'Hoàn thành bài',
    HANDWRITING_RESPONSE: 'Bài viết tay',
    RESPONSE: 'Bài nộp',
    ACHIEVEMENT: 'Thành tích',
    ACTIVITY: 'Hoạt động'
  };

  return labels[type] || type || 'Hoạt động';
}

function kidlearnV3_4g4CheckMarkers_(content, markers, label, errors) {
  content =
    String(content || '');

  for (var i = 0; i < markers.length; i++) {
    if (content.indexOf(markers[i]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        label + ' thiếu marker: ' + markers[i]
      );
    }
  }
}


/**
 * Date helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g4ToIso_(value) {
  if (!value) return '';

  if (Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Date]') {
    return value.toISOString();
  }

  var text =
    String(value || '').trim();

  if (!text) return '';

  var date =
    new Date(text);

  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return text;
  }

  return date.toISOString();
}


function kidlearnV3_4g4ToDateKey_(value) {
  var iso =
    kidlearnV3_4g4ToIso_(value);

  if (!iso) return '';

  if (iso.length >= 10 && iso.charAt(4) === '-') {
    return iso.substring(0, 10);
  }

  return '';
}


function kidlearnV3_4g4DateValue_(value) {
  if (!value) return 0;

  var date =
    new Date(value);

  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return 0;
  }

  return date.getTime();
}


function kidlearnV3_4g4DateLabel_(dateKey) {
  if (!dateKey || dateKey === 'UNKNOWN_DATE') {
    return 'Không rõ ngày';
  }

  var today =
    new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);

  if (dateKey === today) {
    return 'Hôm nay';
  }

  var date =
    new Date(dateKey + 'T00:00:00');

  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return dateKey;
  }

  return date.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN', {
    weekday: 'long',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: '2-digit',
    day: '2-digit'
  });
}


function kidlearnV3_4g4DisplayDateTime_(value) {
  if (!value) return '';

  var date =
    new Date(value);

  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return String(value).substring(0, 16);
  }

  return date.toLocaleDateString('vi-VN') +
    ' ' +
    date.toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN', {
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit'
    });
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g4CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      errors
  };
}


/**
 * Safe call helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g4SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName:
          functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      nextBundle:
        output && output.nextBundle ? output.nextBundle : '',
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4g4PreviewValue_(JSON.stringify(output || {})),
      output:
        output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output:
        null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4g4PreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 350) {
    return text.substring(0, 350) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4g4UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4g4SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success:
        result.success,
      action:
        result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.PHASE,
      parentPhase:
        result.parentPhase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status:
        status,
      timelineName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.TIMELINE_NAME,
      timelineSummary:
        result.timelineSummary ||
        (
          result.timelineContext
            ? result.timelineContext.timelineSummary || {}
            : {}
        ),
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_4G4_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed:
        false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4g4ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

      '4G-1 preview failed. Errors=' +
      result.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Check 4G-1.
 */
function kidlearnV3_checkParentDashboardContext4G1V3() {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_4g1BuildParentDashboardContext_({});

  result.action =
    'CHECK_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G_1_V3';

  result.status =
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_STATUS.CHECK_PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_STATUS.FAILED;

  kidlearnV3_4g1SaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.status,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_KEYS.LAST_CHECK_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4G-1 check failed. Errors=' +
      result.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

  kidlearnV3_4g1SaveStatus_(

    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}

/**
 * Assert ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertParentDashboardContext4G1ReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getParentDashboardContext4G1StatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_STATUS.READY_FOR_4G_2
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '4G-1 chưa READY_FOR_4G_2. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'ASSERT_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G_1_READY_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      status.status,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    errors:
      errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(errors.join(' | '));
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * QA batch 4G-1.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaBatch4G1V3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewParentDashboardContext4G1V3();

  var check =
    kidlearnV3_checkParentDashboardContext4G1V3();

  var ready =
    kidlearnV3_markParentDashboardContext4G1ReadyV3();

  var assertReady =
    kidlearnV3_assertParentDashboardContext4G1ReadyV3();

  var result = {
    success:
      preview.success === true &&
      check.success === true &&
      ready.success === true &&
      assertReady.success === true,
    suiteName:
      'PHASE_4G_1_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_READ_ONLY',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_STATUS.READY_FOR_4G_2,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    results: {
      preview: preview.success,
      check: check.success,
      ready: ready.success,
      assertReady: assertReady.success
    }
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error('4G-1 QA batch failed.');
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Build Parent Dashboard Context.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g1BuildParentDashboardContext_(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var parentId =
    String(
      options.parentId ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PARENT_ID
    ).trim();

  var childId =
    String(
      options.childId ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID
    ).trim();

  var recentLimit =
    Number(
      options.recentLimit ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.RECENT_ACTIVITY_LIMIT
    );

  if (isNaN(recentLimit) || recentLimit <= 0) {
    recentLimit = KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.RECENT_ACTIVITY_LIMIT;
  }

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4g1CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var phase4F =
    kidlearnV3_4g1SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4FClosedLockedV3'
    );

  if (!phase4F.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4F chưa closed locked: ' +
      phase4F.message
    );
  }

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4g1OpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (errorOpen) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được DEV spreadsheet: ' +
      String(errorOpen.message || errorOpen)
    );
  }

  var data = {
    childMap: {},
    subjectMap: {},
    sessions: [],
    lessonProgress: [],
    responses: [],
    dailyGoals: [],
    achievements: []
  };

  var dataAvailability = {};

  if (spreadsheet) {
    data.childMap =
      kidlearnV3_4g1BuildChildMap_(spreadsheet, dataAvailability);

    data.subjectMap =
      kidlearnV3_4g1BuildSubjectMap_(spreadsheet, dataAvailability);

    data.sessions =
      kidlearnV3_4g1ReadStudySessions_(spreadsheet, childId, dataAvailability, warnings);

    data.lessonProgress =
      kidlearnV3_4g1ReadLessonProgress_(spreadsheet, childId, dataAvailability, warnings);

    data.responses =
      kidlearnV3_4g1ReadResponses_(spreadsheet, childId, dataAvailability, warnings);

    data.dailyGoals =
      kidlearnV3_4g1ReadDailyGoals_(spreadsheet, childId, dataAvailability, warnings);

    data.achievements =
      kidlearnV3_4g1ReadAchievements_(spreadsheet, childId, dataAvailability, warnings);
  }

  var child =
    kidlearnV3_4g1ResolveChildInfo_(
      childId,
      data.childMap
    );

  var overviewToday =
    kidlearnV3_4g1BuildTodayOverview_(
      data.sessions,
      data.responses,
      data.dailyGoals
    );

  var progressBySubject =
    kidlearnV3_4g1BuildSubjectProgressOverview_(
      data.subjectMap,
      data.lessonProgress,
      data.sessions,
      data.responses
    );

  var handwritingSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4g1BuildHandwritingSummary_(
      data.responses
    );

  var reviewSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4g1BuildReviewSummary_(
      handwritingSummary
    );

  var retrySummary =
    kidlearnV3_4g1BuildRetrySummary_(
      data.responses
    );

  var recentActivities =
    kidlearnV3_4g1BuildRecentActivities_(
      data.sessions,
      data.lessonProgress,
      data.responses,
      data.achievements,
      recentLimit
    );

  var dashboardSummary = {
    todaySessionCount:
      overviewToday.todaySessionCount,
    todayDurationMinutes:
      overviewToday.todayDurationMinutes,
    completedLessonCount:
      kidlearnV3_4g1CountCompletedLessons_(data.lessonProgress),
    subjectCount:
      progressBySubject.subjectCount,
    pendingReviewCount:
      reviewSummary.pendingReviewCount,
    retryCount:
      retrySummary.retryCount,
    recentActivityCount:
      recentActivities.items.length
  };

  var parentDashboard = {
    title:
      'Dashboard phụ huynh',
    subtitle:
      'Theo dõi tiến độ học tập của bé',
    parentId:
      parentId,
    child:
      child,
    dashboardSummary:
      dashboardSummary,
    overviewToday:
      overviewToday,
    progressBySubject:
      progressBySubject,
    handwritingSummary:
      handwritingSummary,
    reviewSummary:
      reviewSummary,
    retrySummary:
      retrySummary,
    recentActivities:
      recentActivities,
    dataAvailability:
      dataAvailability,
    uiPolicy: {
      readOnlyNow:
        true,
      parentOnly:
        true,
      childCanSeeParentDashboard:
        false,
      showTodayOverview:
        true,
      showSubjectProgress:
        true,
      showPendingReview:
        true,
      showRetrySummary:
        true,
      showRecentActivities:
        true,
      nextUiStep:
        '4G-2'
    }
  };

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G_1_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    contextName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.CONTEXT_NAME,
    parentId:
      parentId,
    child:
      child,
    dashboardSummary:
      dashboardSummary,
    parentDashboard:
      parentDashboard,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4g1UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4g1UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Child map.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g1BuildChildMap_(spreadsheet, availability) {
  availability.DATA_Children = {
    exists: false,
    rows: 0
  };

  var map = {};

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4g1GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Children'
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return map;
  }

  availability.DATA_Children.exists = true;
  availability.DATA_Children.rows =
    Math.max(0, sheet.getLastRow() - 1);

  if (sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return map;
  }

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4g1ReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var childId =
      kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(
        row,
        headers,
        ['childId', 'id']
      );

    var name =
      kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(
        row,
        headers,
        ['childName', 'fullName', 'name', 'displayName']
      );

    var grade =
      kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(
        row,
        headers,
        ['grade', 'class', 'level']
      );

    childId =
      String(childId || '').trim();

    if (childId) {
      map[childId] = {
        childId:
          childId,
        name:
          String(name || 'Bé').trim() || 'Bé',
        grade:
          String(grade || '').trim()
      };
    }
  }

  return map;
}


/**
 * Subject map.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g1BuildSubjectMap_(spreadsheet, availability) {
  availability.MST_Subjects = {
    exists: false,
    rows: 0
  };

  var map = {};

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4g1GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'MST_Subjects'
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return map;
  }

  availability.MST_Subjects.exists = true;
  availability.MST_Subjects.rows =
    Math.max(0, sheet.getLastRow() - 1);

  if (sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return map;
  }

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4g1ReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var code =
      kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(
        row,
        headers,
        ['subjectCode', 'subjectId', 'code', 'id']
      );

    var name =
      kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(
        row,
        headers,
        ['subjectName', 'name', 'title']
      );

    code =
      String(code || '').trim();

    if (code) {
      map[code] = {
        subjectCode:
          code,
        subjectName:
          String(name || code).trim()
      };
    }
  }

  return map;
}


/**
 * Read DATA_StudySessions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g1ReadStudySessions_(spreadsheet, childId, availability, warnings) {
  availability.DATA_StudySessions = {
    exists: false,
    rows: 0
  };

  var rows = [];

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4g1GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_StudySessions'
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    warnings.push('DATA_StudySessions chưa có hoặc không tìm thấy.');
    return rows;
  }

  availability.DATA_StudySessions.exists = true;
  availability.DATA_StudySessions.rows =
    Math.max(0, sheet.getLastRow() - 1);

  if (sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return rows;
  }

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4g1ReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var itemChildId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['childId', 'studentId', 'learnerId']
        ) || ''
      ).trim();

    if (childId && itemChildId && itemChildId !== childId) {
      continue;
    }

    rows.push({
      sessionId:
        String(kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['sessionId', 'id']) || ''),
      childId:
        itemChildId || childId,
      lessonId:
        String(kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['lessonId']) || ''),
      subjectCode:
        String(kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['subjectCode', 'subjectId']) || ''),
      status:
        String(kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['status']) || ''),
      startedAt:
        kidlearnV3_4g1ToIso_(
          kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['startedAt', 'startAt', 'createdAt'])
        ),
      endedAt:
        kidlearnV3_4g1ToIso_(
          kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['endedAt', 'endAt'])
        ),
      durationSeconds:
        kidlearnV3_4g1ToNumber_(
          kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['durationSeconds', 'durationSec', 'duration'])
        ),
      sourceRow:
        i + 2
    });
  }

  return rows;
}

/**
 * Read DATA_Responses with metadata.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g1ReadResponses_(spreadsheet, childId, availability, warnings) {
  availability.DATA_Responses = {
    exists: false,
    rows: 0,
    metadataColumn: ''
  };

  var rows = [];

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4g1GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Responses'
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    warnings.push('DATA_Responses chưa có hoặc không tìm thấy.');
    return rows;
  }

  availability.DATA_Responses.exists = true;
  availability.DATA_Responses.rows =
    Math.max(0, sheet.getLastRow() - 1);

  if (sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return rows;
  }

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4g1ReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var metaIndex =
    kidlearnV3_4g1ResolveMetadataColumnIndex_(sheet, headers);

  availability.DATA_Responses.metadataColumn =
    metaIndex >= 0 ? String(headers[metaIndex] || '') : '';

  if (metaIndex < 0) {
    warnings.push(
      'DATA_Responses chưa tìm được metadata column. Handwriting summary có thể bằng 0.'
    );
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var metaText =
      metaIndex >= 0
        ? String(row[metaIndex] || '')
        : '';

    var parsed =
      kidlearnV3_4g1SafeJsonParse_(metaText);

    var meta =
      parsed.success ? parsed.value || {} : {};

    var asset =
      meta.handwritingAsset || {};

    var review =
      meta.handwritingReview || {};

    var itemChildId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['childId', 'studentId', 'learnerId']
        ) ||
        meta.childId ||
        asset.childId ||
        ''
      ).trim();

    if (childId && itemChildId && itemChildId !== childId) {
      continue;
    }

    var reviewStatus =
      String(
        review.status ||
        asset.reviewStatus ||
        ''
      ).trim().toUpperCase();

    rows.push({
      responseId:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['responseId', 'id']) ||
          meta.responseId ||
          asset.responseId ||
          ''
        ),
      childId:
        itemChildId || childId,
      lessonId:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['lessonId']) ||
          meta.lessonId ||
          asset.lessonId ||
          ''
        ),
      activityId:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['activityId']) ||
          meta.activityId ||
          asset.activityId ||
          ''
        ),
      subjectCode:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['subjectCode', 'subjectId']) ||
          meta.subjectCode ||
          asset.subjectCode ||
          ''
        ),
      answerMode:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['answerMode']) ||
          meta.answerMode ||
          asset.answerMode ||
          ''
        ),
      status:
        String(kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['status']) || ''),
      isCorrect:
        kidlearnV3_4g1ToBoolean_(
          kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['isCorrect', 'correct'])
        ),
      score:
        kidlearnV3_4g1ToNumber_(
          kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['score', 'points'])
        ),
      createdAt:
        kidlearnV3_4g1ToIso_(
          kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['createdAt', 'submittedAt', 'updatedAt']) ||
          meta.createdAt ||
          meta.updatedAt ||
          asset.createdAt ||
          review.reviewedAt
        ),
      hasHandwritingAsset:
        !!asset.fileId || !!asset.fileUrl,
      handwritingReviewStatus:
        reviewStatus,
      reviewerNote:
        String(review.reviewerNote || ''),
      reviewedAt:
        String(review.reviewedAt || ''),
      reviewedBy:
        String(review.reviewedBy || ''),
      fileId:
        String(asset.fileId || ''),
      fileUrl:
        String(asset.fileUrl || ''),
      sourceRow:
        i + 2
    });
  }

  return rows;
}


/**
 * Read DATA_DailyGoals.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g1ReadDailyGoals_(spreadsheet, childId, availability, warnings) {
  availability.DATA_DailyGoals = {
    exists: false,
    rows: 0
  };

  var rows = [];

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4g1GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_DailyGoals'
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    warnings.push('DATA_DailyGoals chưa có hoặc không tìm thấy.');
    return rows;
  }

  availability.DATA_DailyGoals.exists = true;
  availability.DATA_DailyGoals.rows =
    Math.max(0, sheet.getLastRow() - 1);

  if (sheet.getLastRow() < 2) {
    return rows;
  }

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4g1ReadHeaders_(sheet);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var itemChildId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(
          row,
          headers,
          ['childId', 'studentId', 'learnerId']
        ) || ''
      ).trim();

    if (childId && itemChildId && itemChildId !== childId) {
      continue;
    }

    rows.push({
      goalId:
        String(kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['goalId', 'dailyGoalId', 'id']) || ''),
      childId:
        itemChildId || childId,
      goalDate:
        kidlearnV3_4g1ToDateKey_(
          kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['goalDate', 'date', 'createdAt'])
        ),
      targetMinutes:
        kidlearnV3_4g1ToNumber_(
          kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['targetMinutes', 'targetMinute', 'minutes'])
        ),
      completedMinutes:
        kidlearnV3_4g1ToNumber_(
          kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['completedMinutes', 'actualMinutes', 'doneMinutes'])
        ),
      status:
        String(kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, ['status']) || ''),
      sourceRow:
        i + 2
    });
  }

  return rows;
}

/**
 * Dashboard calculations.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g1BuildTodayOverview_(sessions, responses, dailyGoals) {
  var todayKey =
    kidlearnV3_4g1TodayKey_();

  var todaySessions = [];
  var todayDurationSeconds = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < sessions.length; i++) {
    var dateKey =
      kidlearnV3_4g1ToDateKey_(sessions[i].startedAt || sessions[i].endedAt);

    if (dateKey === todayKey) {
      todaySessions.push(sessions[i]);
      todayDurationSeconds += Number(sessions[i].durationSeconds || 0);
    }
  }

  var todayResponses = [];

  for (var j = 0; j < responses.length; j++) {
    if (kidlearnV3_4g1ToDateKey_(responses[j].createdAt) === todayKey) {
      todayResponses.push(responses[j]);
    }
  }

  var todayGoal = null;

  for (var k = 0; k < dailyGoals.length; k++) {
    if (dailyGoals[k].goalDate === todayKey) {
      todayGoal = dailyGoals[k];
      break;
    }
  }

  return {
    date:
      todayKey,
    todaySessionCount:
      todaySessions.length,
    todayDurationMinutes:
      Math.round(todayDurationSeconds / 60),
    todayResponseCount:
      todayResponses.length,
    todayGoal:
      todayGoal,
    goalProgressPercent:
      todayGoal && todayGoal.targetMinutes
        ? Math.min(
            100,
            Math.round(
              Number(todayGoal.completedMinutes || 0) /
              Number(todayGoal.targetMinutes || 1) *
              100
            )
          )
        : 0,
    emptyState: {
      show:
        todaySessions.length === 0 && todayResponses.length === 0,
      title:
        'Hôm nay bé chưa có hoạt động học',
      message:
        'Khi bé học bài hoặc nộp bài, thông tin sẽ hiển thị ở đây.'
    }
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1BuildSubjectProgressOverview_(subjectMap, lessonProgress, sessions, responses) {
  var map = {};

  for (var code in subjectMap) {
    if (subjectMap.hasOwnProperty(code)) {
      map[code] = {
        subjectCode:
          code,
        subjectName:
          subjectMap[code].subjectName || code,
        completedLessons:
          0,
        inProgressLessons:
          0,
        totalProgressItems:
          0,
        averageProgressPercent:
          0,
        sessionCount:
          0,
        responseCount:
          0,
        handwritingCount:
          0
      };
    }
  }

  function ensureSubject(code) {
    code =
      String(code || '').trim() || 'UNKNOWN';

    if (!map[code]) {
      map[code] = {
        subjectCode:
          code,
        subjectName:
          code === 'UNKNOWN' ? 'Chưa rõ môn học' : code,
        completedLessons:
          0,
        inProgressLessons:
          0,
        totalProgressItems:
          0,
        averageProgressPercent:
          0,
        sessionCount:
          0,
        responseCount:
          0,
        handwritingCount:
          0
      };
    }

    return map[code];
  }

  var percentSumBySubject = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < lessonProgress.length; i++) {
    var progress =
      lessonProgress[i];

    var item =
      ensureSubject(progress.subjectCode);

    item.totalProgressItems++;

    var status =
      String(progress.status || '').toUpperCase();

    var percent =
      Number(progress.progressPercent || 0);

    if (
      status === 'COMPLETED' ||
      percent >= 100
    ) {
      item.completedLessons++;
    } else {
      item.inProgressLessons++;
    }

    if (!percentSumBySubject[item.subjectCode]) {
      percentSumBySubject[item.subjectCode] = 0;
    }

    percentSumBySubject[item.subjectCode] += percent;
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < sessions.length; j++) {
    ensureSubject(sessions[j].subjectCode).sessionCount++;
  }

  for (var k = 0; k < responses.length; k++) {
    var responseSubject =
      ensureSubject(responses[k].subjectCode);

    responseSubject.responseCount++;

    if (responses[k].hasHandwritingAsset) {
      responseSubject.handwritingCount++;
    }
  }

  var items = [];

  for (var subjectCode in map) {
    if (map.hasOwnProperty(subjectCode)) {
      var entry =
        map[subjectCode];

      if (entry.totalProgressItems > 0) {
        entry.averageProgressPercent =
          Math.round(
            Number(percentSumBySubject[subjectCode] || 0) /
            entry.totalProgressItems
          );
      }

      items.push(entry);
    }
  }

  items.sort(function (a, b) {
    return String(a.subjectName).localeCompare(String(b.subjectName));
  });

  return {
    subjectCount:
      items.length,
    items:
      items,
    emptyState: {
      show:
        items.length === 0,
      title:
        'Chưa có dữ liệu tiến độ theo môn',
      message:
        'Khi bé học bài, tiến độ theo môn sẽ hiển thị ở đây.'
    }
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1BuildHandwritingSummary_(responses) {
  var summary = {
    totalHandwritingCount: 0,
    pendingReviewCount: 0,
    acceptedCount: 0,
    retryCount: 0,
    capturedCount: 0,
    otherStatusCount: 0,
    statsByStatus: {}
  };

  for (var i = 0; i < responses.length; i++) {
    if (!responses[i].hasHandwritingAsset) {
      continue;
    }

    summary.totalHandwritingCount++;

    var status =
      String(responses[i].handwritingReviewStatus || '')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();

    if (!status) {
      status = 'UNKNOWN';
    }

    if (!summary.statsByStatus[status]) {
      summary.statsByStatus[status] = 0;
    }

    summary.statsByStatus[status]++;

    if (
      status === 'NEEDS_REVIEW' ||
      status === 'HANDWRITING_CAPTURED'
    ) {
      summary.pendingReviewCount++;
    } else if (status === 'REVIEWED_ACCEPTED') {
      summary.acceptedCount++;
    } else if (status === 'REVIEWED_RETRY') {
      summary.retryCount++;
    } else {
      summary.otherStatusCount++;
    }

    if (status === 'HANDWRITING_CAPTURED') {
      summary.capturedCount++;
    }
  }

  return summary;
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1BuildReviewSummary_(handwritingSummary) {
  return {
    title:
      'Bài viết tay cần duyệt',
    pendingReviewCount:
      handwritingSummary.pendingReviewCount,
    totalHandwritingCount:
      handwritingSummary.totalHandwritingCount,
    acceptedCount:
      handwritingSummary.acceptedCount,
    retryCount:
      handwritingSummary.retryCount,
    statsByStatus:
      handwritingSummary.statsByStatus,
    hasPendingReview:
      handwritingSummary.pendingReviewCount > 0,
    uiAction:
      'OPEN_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE',
    emptyState: {
      show:
        handwritingSummary.pendingReviewCount === 0,
      title:
        'Không có bài viết tay chờ duyệt',
      message:
        'Khi bé nộp bài viết tay mới, bài sẽ xuất hiện trong mục duyệt.'
    }
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1BuildRetrySummary_(responses) {
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < responses.length; i++) {
    var status =
      String(responses[i].handwritingReviewStatus || '')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase();

    if (status === 'REVIEWED_RETRY') {
      items.push({
        responseId:
          responses[i].responseId,
        lessonId:
          responses[i].lessonId,
        subjectCode:
          responses[i].subjectCode,
        reviewerNote:
          responses[i].reviewerNote,
        reviewedAt:
          responses[i].reviewedAt
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    title:
      'Bài bé cần làm lại',
    retryCount:
      items.length,
    items:
      items,
    hasRetry:
      items.length > 0,
    uiAction:
      'OPEN_CHILD_RETRY_VIEW',
    emptyState: {
      show:
        items.length === 0,
      title:
        'Bé chưa có bài cần làm lại',
      message:
        'Khi phụ huynh yêu cầu làm lại, bài sẽ xuất hiện trên màn hình bé.'
    }
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1BuildRecentActivities_(sessions, progress, responses, achievements, limit) {
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < sessions.length; i++) {
    items.push({
      type:
        'STUDY_SESSION',
      title:
        'Bé đã học bài',
      subtitle:
        sessions[i].lessonId || sessions[i].subjectCode || '',
      at:
        sessions[i].endedAt || sessions[i].startedAt || '',
      subjectCode:
        sessions[i].subjectCode || '',
      icon:
        '📘'
    });
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < progress.length; j++) {
    var status =
      String(progress[j].status || '').toUpperCase();

    if (status === 'COMPLETED' || Number(progress[j].progressPercent || 0) >= 100) {
      items.push({
        type:
          'LESSON_COMPLETED',
        title:
          'Hoàn thành bài học',
        subtitle:
          progress[j].lessonId || '',
        at:
          progress[j].updatedAt || '',
        subjectCode:
          progress[j].subjectCode || '',
        icon:
          '✅'
      });
    }
  }

  for (var k = 0; k < responses.length; k++) {
    if (responses[k].hasHandwritingAsset) {
      items.push({
        type:
          'HANDWRITING_RESPONSE',
        title:
          'Nộp bài viết tay',
        subtitle:
          responses[k].handwritingReviewStatus || 'HANDWRITING',
        at:
          responses[k].createdAt || responses[k].reviewedAt || '',
        subjectCode:
          responses[k].subjectCode || '',
        icon:
          '✍️'
      });
    }
  }

  for (var a = 0; a < achievements.length; a++) {
    items.push({
      type:
        'ACHIEVEMENT',
      title:
        achievements[a].title || 'Bé đạt thành tích mới',
      subtitle:
        achievements[a].achievementId || '',
      at:
        achievements[a].earnedAt || '',
      subjectCode:
        '',
      icon:
        '🏆'
    });
  }

  items.sort(function (x, y) {
    return kidlearnV3_4g1DateValue_(y.at) - kidlearnV3_4g1DateValue_(x.at);
  });

  if (items.length > limit) {
    items = items.slice(0, limit);
  }

  return {
    title:
      'Hoạt động gần đây',
    itemCount:
      items.length,
    items:
      items,
    emptyState: {
      show:
        items.length === 0,
      title:
        'Chưa có hoạt động gần đây',
      message:
        'Hoạt động học tập của bé sẽ hiển thị ở đây.'
    }
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1CountCompletedLessons_(lessonProgress) {
  var count = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < lessonProgress.length; i++) {
    var status =
      String(lessonProgress[i].status || '').toUpperCase();

    if (
      status === 'COMPLETED' ||
      Number(lessonProgress[i].progressPercent || 0) >= 100
    ) {
      count++;
    }
  }

  return count;
}


/**
 * Metadata column helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g1ResolveMetadataColumnIndex_(sheet, headers) {
  var direct =
    kidlearnV3_4g1FindColumnIndexByAliases_(
      headers,
      [
        'answerMetaJson',
        'answerMetaJSON',
        'answerMetadataJson',
        'responseMetaJson',
        'responseMetadataJson',
        'detailsJson',
        'metaJson',
        'payloadJson',
        'metadataJson',
        'metadata',
        'answerMeta',
        'details',
        'payload'
      ]
    );

  if (direct >= 0) {
    return direct;
  }

  var scanned =
    kidlearnV3_4g1ScanMetadataColumnByJson_(sheet, headers);

  if (scanned >= 0) {
    return scanned;
  }

  return -1;
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1ScanMetadataColumnByJson_(sheet, headers) {
  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 2 || lastColumn < 1) {
    return -1;
  }

  var rowCount =
    Math.min(lastRow - 1, 80);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(2, 1, rowCount, lastColumn)
      .getValues();

  var scores = [];

  for (var c = 0; c < lastColumn; c++) {
    scores[c] = 0;
  }

  for (var r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
    for (var col = 0; col < lastColumn; col++) {
      var text =
        String(values[r][col] || '').trim();

      if (!text) continue;

      if (
        text.indexOf('{') !== 0 &&
        text.indexOf('[') !== 0
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      var parsed =
        kidlearnV3_4g1SafeJsonParse_(text);

      if (!parsed.success) continue;

      var meta =
        parsed.value || {};

      if (
        meta.handwritingAsset ||
        meta.handwritingReview ||
        meta.answerMode ||
        meta.updatedAt
      ) {
        scores[col]++;
      }
    }
  }

  var bestIndex = -1;
  var bestScore = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < scores.length; i++) {
    if (scores[i] > bestScore) {
      bestScore = scores[i];
      bestIndex = i;
    }
  }

  return bestScore > 0 ? bestIndex : -1;
}


/**
 * Resolve child.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g1ResolveChildInfo_(childId, childMap) {
  childMap =
    childMap || {};

  var info =
    childMap[childId] || {};

  return {
    childId:
      childId,
    name:
      info.name || 'Bé',
    displayName:
      info.name || 'Bé',
    grade:
      info.grade || ''
  };
}


/**
 * Spreadsheet helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g1OpenSpreadsheet_() {
  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) {
    return active;
  }

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DEV spreadsheet id.');
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1GetSheetByExactName_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1ReadHeaders_(sheet) {
  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastColumn() < 1) {
    return [];
  }

  return sheet
    .getRange(1, 1, 1, sheet.getLastColumn())
    .getValues()[0];
}


/**
 * Header helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g1FindColumnIndexByAliases_(headers, aliases) {
  headers =
    headers || [];

  aliases =
    aliases || [];

  var normalizedAliases = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    normalizedAliases[
      kidlearnV3_4g1NormalizeHeader_(aliases[i])
    ] = true;
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < headers.length; j++) {
    var normalized =
      kidlearnV3_4g1NormalizeHeader_(headers[j]);

    if (normalizedAliases[normalized]) {
      return j;
    }
  }

  return -1;
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1ReadValueByAliases_(row, headers, aliases) {
  var index =
    kidlearnV3_4g1FindColumnIndexByAliases_(
      headers,
      aliases
    );

  if (index < 0) return '';

  return row[index];
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1NormalizeHeader_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '');
}


/**
 * Date / value helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g1ToIso_(value) {
  if (!value) return '';

  if (Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Date]') {
    return value.toISOString();
  }

  var text =
    String(value || '').trim();

  if (!text) return '';

  var date =
    new Date(text);

  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return text;
  }

  return date.toISOString();
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1ToDateKey_(value) {
  if (!value) return '';

  var iso =
    kidlearnV3_4g1ToIso_(value);

  if (!iso) return '';

  if (iso.length >= 10 && iso.charAt(4) === '-') {
    return iso.substring(0, 10);
  }

  var date =
    new Date(iso);

  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return '';
  }

  return date.toISOString().substring(0, 10);
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1TodayKey_() {
  return new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 10);
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1DateValue_(value) {
  if (!value) return 0;

  var date =
    new Date(value);

  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {

function kidlearnV3_4g1ToNumber_(value) {
  var number =
    Number(value || 0);

  return isNaN(number) ? 0 : number;
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1ToBoolean_(value) {
  if (value === true) return true;
  if (value === false) return false;

  var text =
    String(value || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  return (
    text === 'TRUE' ||
    text === 'YES' ||
    text === 'Y' ||
    text === '1'
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1SafeJsonParse_(text) {
  text =
    String(text || '').trim();

  if (!text) {
    return {
      success: true,
      value: {},
      raw: ''
    };
  }

  try {
    return {
      success: true,
      value: JSON.parse(text),
      raw: text
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      value: {},
      raw: text,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g1CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      errors
  };
}


/**
 * Safe call helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g1SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName:
          functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      nextPhase:
        output && output.nextPhase ? output.nextPhase : '',
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4g1PreviewValue_(JSON.stringify(output || {})),
      output:
        output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output:
        null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1PreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 350) {
    return text.substring(0, 350) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_4g1SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =

  properties.setProperty(

    JSON.stringify({

        result.success,

        result.action,

        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.PHASE,
      parentPhase:
        result.parentPhase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status:
        status,
      contextName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.CONTEXT_NAME,
      childId:
        result.child ? result.child.childId : '',
      dashboardSummary:
        result.dashboardSummary || {},
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4G1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed:
        false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,

        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:

    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4g1ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var dev =

  if (!dev.success) {

  }

  var f1 =

  var ui5b =
    kidlearnV3_4f2SafeCall_(

    );

  if (!ui5b.success) {
    errors.push(

      ui5b.message
    );
  }

  var policy =
    kidlearnV3_4f2SafeCall_(

    );

    );
  }

  var markers =
    kidlearnV3_4f2InspectUiMarkers_();

  if (!markers.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(markers.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(markers.warnings || []);

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_BUTTONS_UI_READINESS_4F_2_V3',

    prerequisite: {

    },

  };

function kidlearnV3_4f2InspectUiMarkers_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var shell = '';
  var client = '';
  var styles = '';

  try {
    shell =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Shell_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Shell_4A: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  try {
    client =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Client_ParentReviewActions_4F2')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error2) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_ParentReviewActions_4F2: ' +
      String(error2.message || error2)
    );
  }

  try {
    styles =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Styles_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error3) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Styles_4A: ' +
      String(error3.message || error3)
    );
  }

  var shellMarkers = [
    'UI_Product_Client_ParentReviewActions_4F2'
  ];

  var clientMarkers = [
    'KIDLEARN_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_BUTTONS_UI_4F2',
    'injectParentReviewActionButtons4F2',
    'renderParentReviewDryRunFeedback4F2',
    'kidlearnV3_getParentReviewActionUiPolicy4F1V3',
    'kl-parent-review-actions-4f2',
    'parent-review-accept-4f2',
    'parent-review-retry-4f2'
  ];

  var styleMarkers = [
    '.kl-parent-review-actions-4f2',
    '.kl-parent-review-action-button-4f2',
    '.kl-parent-review-accept-4f2',
    '.kl-parent-review-retry-4f2',
    '.kl-parent-review-feedback-4f2',
    '.kl-parent-review-gate-badge-4f2'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < shellMarkers.length; i++) {
    if (shell.indexOf(shellMarkers[i]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        'Shell thiếu include marker: ' +
        shellMarkers[i]
      );
    }
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < clientMarkers.length; j++) {
    if (client.indexOf(clientMarkers[j]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        'Client 4F-2 thiếu marker: ' +
        clientMarkers[j]
      );
    }
  }

  for (var k = 0; k < styleMarkers.length; k++) {
    if (styles.indexOf(styleMarkers[k]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        'CSS 4F-2 thiếu marker: ' +
        styleMarkers[k]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'INSPECT_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_BUTTONS_UI_MARKERS_4F_2_V3',
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      warnings.length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      warnings
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4f2CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      errors
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4f2SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      nextBundle:
        output && output.nextBundle ? output.nextBundle : '',
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4f2PreviewValue_(JSON.stringify(output || {})),
      output:
        output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output:
        null
    };
  }
}

  result.status =
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_STATUS.PREVIEWED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_STATUS.FAILED;

  kidlearnV3_4f1SaveStatus_(

    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT

  if (!result.success) {

/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_assertParentReviewActionUiContract4F1ReadyV3() {
  var status =

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_STATUS.READY_FOR_4F_2
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '4F-1 chưa READY_FOR_4F_2. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    status.gateMode !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_GATE_4F1_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '4F-1 gate phải mặc định CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY. Current=' +
      status.gateMode
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_UI_CONTRACT_4F_1_READY_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      status.status,
    gateMode:
      status.gateMode,
    retryFlowMode:
      status.retryFlowMode,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    errors:
      errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(errors.join(' | '));
  }

  return result;
}

  var preview =

  var check =

  var ready =
    kidlearnV3_markParentReviewActionUiContract4F1ReadyV3();

  var assertReady =
    kidlearnV3_assertParentReviewActionUiContract4F1ReadyV3();

  var result = {
    success:
      preview.success === true &&
      check.success === true &&
      ready.success === true &&
      assertReady.success === true,
    suiteName:
      'PHASE_4F_1_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_UI_CONTRACT_SAFETY_GATE',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_STATUS.READY_FOR_4F_2,
    gateMode:
      kidlearnV3_4f1GetCurrentGateMode_(),
    retryFlowMode:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_CONFIG.RETRY_FLOW_MODE,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    results: {
      preview: preview.success,
      check: check.success,
      ready: ready.success,
      assertReady: assertReady.success
    }
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error('4F-1 QA batch failed.');
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Build readiness.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f1BuildReadiness_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4f1CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var phase4E =
    kidlearnV3_4f1SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4EClosedLockedV3'
    );

  if (!phase4E.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4E chưa closed locked: ' +
      phase4E.message
    );
  }

  var requiredFunctions = [
    'kidlearnV3_getParentReviewQueueContext4E5AV3',
    'kidlearnV3_assertParentReviewQueueUi4E5BReadyV3',
    'kidlearnV3_writeHandwritingReviewAction4E5CV3',
    'kidlearnV3_previewHandwritingReviewAction4E5CV3',
    'kidlearnV3_assertHandwritingReviewAction4E5CReadyV3'
  ];

  var functionChecks =
    kidlearnV3_4f1CheckRequiredFunctions_(
      requiredFunctions
    );

  if (!functionChecks.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(functionChecks.errors || []);
  }

  var queueSnapshot =
    kidlearnV3_4f1InspectQueueSnapshot_();

  if (!queueSnapshot.success) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không đọc được review queue snapshot: ' +
      queueSnapshot.message
    );
  }

  var contract =
    kidlearnV3_4f1BuildContract_();

  var gateMode =
    kidlearnV3_4f1GetCurrentGateMode_();

  if (!gateMode) {
    gateMode =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_CONFIG.DEFAULT_GATE_MODE;
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'BUILD_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_UI_CONTRACT_READINESS_4F_1_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    contractName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_CONFIG.CONTRACT_NAME,
    devSafety:
      dev,
    phase4E:
      phase4E,
    functionChecks:
      functionChecks,
    queueSnapshot:
      queueSnapshot,
    gateMode:
      gateMode,
    contract:
      contract,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4f1UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4f1UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Contract for 4F UI.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f1BuildContract_() {
  return {
    contractVersion: '4F-1.0',
    phase: '4F-1',
    uiScope: {
      parentReviewQueueUi: true,
      childLessonPlayerUi: false,
      parentOnly: true,
      childCanSeeActions: false
    },
    actionButtons: {
      accept: {
        label: 'Chấp nhận bài viết',
        actionType: 'ACCEPT',
        targetReviewStatus: 'REVIEWED_ACCEPTED',
        backendPhase: '4E-5C',
        enabledIn4F2: false,
        enabledIn4F3: true
      },
      retry: {
        label: 'Yêu cầu bé làm lại',
        actionType: 'RETRY',
        targetReviewStatus: 'REVIEWED_RETRY',
        backendPhase: '4E-5C',
        enabledIn4F2: false,
        enabledIn4F3: true
      }
    },
    safetyGate: {
      defaultMode: 'CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY',
      openMode: 'OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED',
      uiWriteAllowedIn4F1: false,
      uiWriteAllowedIn4F2: false,
      uiWriteAllowedIn4F3: true,
      prodWriteAllowed: false
    },
    retryFlowPolicy: {
      selectedOption: 'OPTION_A_MVP_STATUS_ONLY',
      createsDataAssignmentsNow: false,
      resetsLessonProgressNow: false,
      createsNewLessonAttemptNow: false,
      childRetryVisibilityPhase: '4F-4',
      note:
        '4F-1 to 4F-3 chỉ đổi reviewStatus. Retry flow cho bé xử lý riêng ở 4F-4.'
    },
    dataWritePolicy: {
      targetSheet: 'DATA_Responses',
      targetField: 'answerMetaJson',
      auditSheet: 'LOG_Audit',
      driveWriteAllowedNow: false,
      assignmentWriteAllowedNow: false,
      lessonProgressWriteAllowedNow: false
    },
    uiReadPolicy: {
      sourceContextFunction:
        'kidlearnV3_getParentReviewQueueContext4E5AV3',
      openDriveLinkOnly: true,
      inlineImagePreviewNow: false
    }
  };
}


/**
 * Function existence checks.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f1CheckRequiredFunctions_(functionNames) {
  var errors = [];
  var results = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < functionNames.length; i++) {
    var name =
      functionNames[i];

    var exists =
      kidlearnV3_4f1FunctionExists_(name);

    results.push({
      functionName:
        name,
      exists:
        exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu required function: ' + name
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    results:
      results,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    errors:
      errors
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4f1FunctionExists_(functionName) {
  try {
    return eval(
      'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
    ) === true;
  } catch (error) {
    return false;
  }
}


/**
 * Queue snapshot.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f1InspectQueueSnapshot_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getParentReviewQueueContext4E5AV3 !== 'function'
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Thiếu kidlearnV3_getParentReviewQueueContext4E5AV3'
      };
    }

    var context =
      kidlearnV3_getParentReviewQueueContext4E5AV3({
        limit: 100
      });

    var queue =
      context.reviewQueue || {};

    return {
      success:
        context.success === true,
      sourcePhase:
        context.phase || '4E-5A',
      itemCount:
        queue.itemCount || 0,
      pendingCount:
        queue.pendingCount || 0,
      statsByStatus:
        queue.statsByStatus || {},
      note:
        'pendingCount có thể bằng 0 nếu item test đã được ACCEPT/RETRY ở 4E-5C.',
      message:
        context.success === true ? 'OK' : JSON.stringify(context)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Gate helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f1GetCurrentGateMode_() {
  return (
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_KEYS.UI_GATE_MODE
      ) ||
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_CONFIG.DEFAULT_GATE_MODE
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4f1EnsureDefaultGateMode_() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var current =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_KEYS.UI_GATE_MODE
    );

  if (!current) {
    properties.setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_CONTRACT_4F1_KEYS.UI_GATE_MODE,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_GATE_4F1_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY
    );
  }
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f1CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      errors
  };
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f1SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      nextPhase:
        output && output.nextPhase ? output.nextPhase : '',
      nextBundle:
        output && output.nextBundle ? output.nextBundle : '',
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4f1PreviewValue_(JSON.stringify(output || {})),
      outputSummary:
        kidlearnV3_4f1SummarizeOutput_(output)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4f1SummarizeOutput_(output) {
  output = output || {};

  return {
    success:
      output.success === true,
    action:
      output.action || '',
    phase:
      output.phase || '',
    status:
      output.status || '',
    nextPhase:
      output.nextPhase || '',
    nextBundle:
      output.nextBundle || '',
    errorCount:
      output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount:
      output.warningCount || 0
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4f1PreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 350) {
    return text.substring(0, 350) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4f1UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}

function kidlearnV3_4f1ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =

      .getScriptProperties()

    };

 * Safety:

};
