/**
 * Controlled real write.
 *
 * options:
 * {
 *   confirm: '...',
 *   responseId: '...',
 *   actionType: 'ACCEPT' | 'RETRY',
 *   reviewerId: 'PARENT',
 *   reviewerNote: '...'
 * }
 */
function kidlearnV3_writeHandwritingReviewAction4E5CV3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var normalizedAction =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cNormalizeActionType_(
      options.actionType
    );

  var confirmText =
    String(options.confirm || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    normalizedAction ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.ACTION_ACCEPT &&
    confirmText !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.ACCEPT_CONFIRM_TEXT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm accept. Cần confirm=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.ACCEPT_CONFIRM_TEXT
    );
  }

  if (
    normalizedAction ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.ACTION_RETRY &&
    confirmText !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.RETRY_CONFIRM_TEXT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm retry. Cần confirm=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.RETRY_CONFIRM_TEXT
    );
  }

  var lock =
    LockService.getScriptLock();

  var locked =
    lock.tryLock(30000);

  if (!locked) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không lấy được script lock sau 30 giây. Vui lòng chạy lại.'
    );
  }

  try {
    var plan =
      kidlearnV3_4e5cBuildReviewActionPlan_(options);

    if (!plan.success) {
      throw new Error(
        'Preflight 4E-5C chưa pass. Errors=' +
        plan.errors.join(' | ')
      );
    }

    var spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4e5cOpenSpreadsheet_();

    var responseSheet =
      kidlearnV3_4e5cGetSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_Responses'
      );

    if (!responseSheet) {
      throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DATA_Responses.');
    }

    responseSheet
      .getRange(
        plan.targetRowNumber,
        plan.metadataColumn.columnIndex
      )
      .setValue(plan.proposedMetaJson);

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    var auditWrite =
      kidlearnV3_4e5cAppendAuditRow_(
        plan,
        options
      );

    var result = {
      success: true,
      action: 'WRITE_HANDWRITING_REVIEW_ACTION_4E_5C_V3',
      phase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.PHASE,
      parentPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_STATUS.READY_FOR_4E_5D,
      responseId:
        plan.responseId,
      responseRowNumber:
        plan.targetRowNumber,
      reviewAction:
        plan.reviewAction,
      targetReviewStatus:
        plan.targetReviewStatus,
      previousReviewStatus:
        plan.previousReviewStatus,
      reviewerId:
        plan.reviewerId,
      reviewerNote:
        plan.reviewerNote,
      fileId:
        plan.fileId,
      fileUrl:
        plan.fileUrl,
      metadataColumn:
        plan.metadataColumn.raw,
      metadataColumnIndex:
        plan.metadataColumn.columnIndex,
      auditId:
        auditWrite.auditId,
      auditRowNumber:
        auditWrite.auditRowNumber,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realSheetWriteAllowed: true,
      realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed: true,
      dataResponsesWritePerformed: true,
      logAuditWritePerformed: true,
      actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      writtenAt:
        new Date().toISOString()
    };

    kidlearnV3_4e5cSaveReviewActionRecord_(result);

    kidlearnV3_4e5cSaveStatus_(
      result,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_STATUS.READY_FOR_4E_5D,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_KEYS.LAST_WRITE_AT
    );

    console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
    return result;

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}


/**
 * Verify last review action.
 */
function kidlearnV3_verifyLastHandwritingReviewAction4E5CV3() {
  var record =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cReadJsonProperty_(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_KEYS.LAST_REVIEW_ACTION_JSON
    );

  if (!record) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không tìm thấy LAST_REVIEW_ACTION_JSON của 4E-5C.'
    );
  }

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cOpenSpreadsheet_();

  var responseSheet =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Responses'
    );

  if (!responseSheet) {
    errors.push('Không tìm thấy DATA_Responses.');
  }

  var actualMetaText = '';

  if (
    responseSheet &&
    record.responseRowNumber &&
    record.metadataColumnIndex
  ) {
    actualMetaText =
      String(
        responseSheet
          .getRange(
            record.responseRowNumber,
            record.metadataColumnIndex
          )
          .getValue() || ''
      );
  }

  var parsed =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cSafeJsonParse_(
      actualMetaText
    );

  if (!parsed.success) {
    errors.push(
      'answerMetaJson sau review action không phải JSON hợp lệ.'
    );
  } else {
    var meta =
      parsed.value || {};

    var asset =
      meta.handwritingAsset || {};

    var review =
      meta.handwritingReview || {};

    var assetStatus =
      String(asset.reviewStatus || '').toUpperCase();

    var reviewStatus =
      String(review.status || '').toUpperCase();

    if (
      reviewStatus !== String(record.targetReviewStatus).toUpperCase()
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'handwritingReview.status không khớp. Expected=' +
        record.targetReviewStatus +
        ', Actual=' +
        reviewStatus
      );
    }

    if (
      assetStatus !== String(record.targetReviewStatus).toUpperCase()
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'handwritingAsset.reviewStatus không khớp. Expected=' +
        record.targetReviewStatus +
        ', Actual=' +
        assetStatus
      );
    }

    if (!review.reviewedAt) {
      errors.push('Thiếu handwritingReview.reviewedAt.');
    }

    if (!review.reviewedBy) {
      errors.push('Thiếu handwritingReview.reviewedBy.');
    }
  }

  var auditCheck =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cVerifyAuditRow_(
      record.auditRowNumber,
      record.auditId
    );

  if (!auditCheck.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(auditCheck.errors || []);
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'VERIFY_LAST_HANDWRITING_REVIEW_ACTION_4E_5C_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_STATUS.READY_FOR_4E_5D
        : KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_STATUS.FAILED,
    responseId:
      record.responseId,
    reviewAction:
      record.reviewAction,
    targetReviewStatus:
      record.targetReviewStatus,
    auditCheck:
      auditCheck,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      record.actualSheetWritePerformed === true,
    dataResponsesWritePerformed:
      record.dataResponsesWritePerformed === true,
    logAuditWritePerformed:
      record.logAuditWritePerformed === true,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      warnings.length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_4e5cSaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.status,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_KEYS.LAST_VERIFY_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Verify 4E-5C failed. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Build review action plan.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5cBuildReviewActionPlan_(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var e5b =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertParentReviewQueueUi4E5BReadyV3'
    );

  if (!e5b.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4E-5B chưa READY_FOR_4E_5C: ' +
      e5b.message
    );
  }

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cCheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var actionType =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cNormalizeActionType_(
      options.actionType
    );

  if (!actionType) {
    errors.push(
      'actionType không hợp lệ. Cần ACCEPT hoặc RETRY.'
    );
  }

  var targetReviewStatus =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cResolveTargetReviewStatus_(
      actionType
    );

  var responseId =
    String(options.responseId || '').trim();

  var reviewerId =
    String(options.reviewerId || 'PARENT').trim();

  var reviewerNote =
    String(options.reviewerNote || '').trim();

  var context = null;

  try {
    context =
      kidlearnV3_getParentReviewQueueContext4E5AV3({
        limit: 100
      });
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được review queue context: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var targetItem = null;

  if (context && context.reviewQueue) {
    var items =
      context.reviewQueue.items || [];

    if (!responseId && items.length > 0) {
      responseId =
        items[0].responseId;

      warnings.push(
        'Không truyền responseId. Dùng pending item đầu tiên: ' +
        responseId
      );
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
      if (
        String(items[i].responseId) === String(responseId)
      ) {
        targetItem =
          items[i];
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  if (!responseId) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu responseId và không tìm thấy pending item.'
    );
  }

  if (!targetItem) {
    errors.push(
      'Không tìm thấy responseId trong pending review queue: ' +
      responseId
    );
  }

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4e5cOpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (error2) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được DEV spreadsheet: ' +
      String(error2.message || error2)
    );
  }

  var headerInfo = null;
  var metadataColumn = null;
  var responseIdColumn = null;
  var targetRowNumber = 0;
  var existingMetaText = '';
  var proposedMetaJson = '';
  var previousReviewStatus = '';

  if (spreadsheet && targetItem) {
    var responseSheet =
      kidlearnV3_4e5cGetSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_Responses'
      );

    if (!responseSheet) {
      errors.push('Không tìm thấy DATA_Responses.');
    } else {
      headerInfo =
        kidlearnV3_4e5cInspectSheetHeaders_(
          spreadsheet,
          'DATA_Responses',
          warnings
        );

      metadataColumn =
        kidlearnV3_4e5cFindHeaderMatch_(
          headerInfo.headers || [],
          [
            'answerMetaJson',
            'detailsJson',
            'metaJson',
            'payloadJson',
            'metadataJson'
          ]
        );

      responseIdColumn =
        kidlearnV3_4e5cFindHeaderMatch_(
          headerInfo.headers || [],
          [
            'responseId',
            'responseid',
            'id',
            'responseKey',
            'maPhanHoi',
            'maTraLoi'
          ]
        );

      if (!metadataColumn) {
        errors.push(
          'DATA_Responses thiếu answerMetaJson/detailsJson/metaJson.'
        );
      }

      if (!responseIdColumn) {
        errors.push(
          'DATA_Responses không map được responseId/id.'
        );
      }

      if (metadataColumn && responseIdColumn) {
        targetRowNumber =
          kidlearnV3_4e5cFindRowById_(
            responseSheet,
            headerInfo,
            responseIdColumn.columnIndex,
            responseId
          );

        if (!targetRowNumber && targetItem.responseRowNumber) {
          targetRowNumber =
            Number(targetItem.responseRowNumber || 0);

          warnings.push(
            'Không tìm thấy bằng scan responseId. Dùng responseRowNumber từ context.'
          );
        }

        if (!targetRowNumber) {
          errors.push(
            'Không tìm thấy row DATA_Responses cho responseId=' +
            responseId
          );
        } else {
          existingMetaText =
            String(
              responseSheet
                .getRange(
                  targetRowNumber,
                  metadataColumn.columnIndex
                )
                .getValue() || ''
            );

          var parsed =
            kidlearnV3_4e5cSafeJsonParse_(
              existingMetaText
            );

          if (!parsed.success) {
            errors.push(
              'answerMetaJson hiện tại không phải JSON hợp lệ.'
            );
          } else {
            previousReviewStatus =
              kidlearnV3_4e5cExtractReviewStatus_(
                parsed.value
              );

            if (
              previousReviewStatus !==
              KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.PENDING_STATUS
            ) {
              warnings.push(
                'Review status hiện tại không phải NEEDS_REVIEW. Current=' +
                previousReviewStatus
              );
            }

            proposedMetaJson =
              kidlearnV3_4e5cBuildReviewedMetaJson_(
                parsed.value,
                targetReviewStatus,
                reviewerId,
                reviewerNote,
                actionType
              );
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'BUILD_HANDWRITING_REVIEW_ACTION_PLAN_4E_5C_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    writeName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.WRITE_NAME,
    responseId:
      responseId,
    reviewAction:
      actionType,
    targetReviewStatus:
      targetReviewStatus,
    previousReviewStatus:
      previousReviewStatus,
    reviewerId:
      reviewerId,
    reviewerNote:
      reviewerNote,
    targetRowNumber:
      targetRowNumber,
    metadataColumn:
      metadataColumn,
    responseIdColumn:
      responseIdColumn,
    fileId:
      targetItem && targetItem.handwritingAsset
        ? targetItem.handwritingAsset.fileId
        : '',
    fileUrl:
      targetItem && targetItem.handwritingAsset
        ? targetItem.handwritingAsset.fileUrl
        : '',
    existingMetaPreview:
      kidlearnV3_4e5cPreviewValue_(
        existingMetaText
      ),
    proposedMetaPreview:
      kidlearnV3_4e5cPreviewValue_(
        proposedMetaJson
      ),
    proposedMetaJson:
      proposedMetaJson,
    targetItem:
      targetItem,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowed: true,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    dataResponsesWritePerformed: false,
    logAuditWritePerformed: false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4e5cUniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4e5cUniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Build sample options from first pending item.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5cBuildSampleReviewActionOptions_(actionType) {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_getParentReviewQueueContext4E5AV3({
      limit: 1
    });

  var responseId = '';

  if (
    context &&
    context.reviewQueue &&
    context.reviewQueue.items &&
    context.reviewQueue.items.length > 0
  ) {
    responseId =
      context.reviewQueue.items[0].responseId;
  }

  return {
    responseId:
      responseId,
    actionType:
      actionType,
    reviewerId:
      'PARENT',
    reviewerNote:
      actionType ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.ACTION_RETRY
        ? 'Yêu cầu bé làm lại bài viết tay.'
        : 'Chấp nhận bài viết tay của bé.'
  };
}


/**
 * Merge review status into answerMetaJson.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5cBuildReviewedMetaJson_(
  meta,
  targetReviewStatus,
  reviewerId,
  reviewerNote,
  actionType
) {
  meta = meta || {};

  if (!meta.handwritingAsset) {
    meta.handwritingAsset = {};
  }

  if (!meta.handwritingReview) {
    meta.handwritingReview = {};
  }

  meta.handwritingAsset.reviewStatus =
    targetReviewStatus;

  meta.handwritingAsset.reviewedAt =
    new Date().toISOString();

  meta.handwritingReview.status =
    targetReviewStatus;

  meta.handwritingReview.reviewAction =
    actionType;

  meta.handwritingReview.reviewedBy =
    reviewerId || 'PARENT';

  meta.handwritingReview.reviewedAt =
    new Date().toISOString();

  meta.handwritingReview.reviewerNote =
    reviewerNote || '';

  meta.handwritingReview.parentReviewRequired =
    false;

  meta.updatedAt =
    new Date().toISOString();

  return JSON.stringify(meta);
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5cExtractReviewStatus_(meta) {
  meta = meta || {};

  var review =
    meta.handwritingReview || {};

  var asset =
    meta.handwritingAsset || {};

  return String(
    review.status ||
    asset.reviewStatus ||
    ''
  ).trim().toUpperCase();
}


/**
 * Append audit row.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5cAppendAuditRow_(plan, options) {
  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cOpenSpreadsheet_();

  var auditSheet =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'LOG_Audit'
    );

  if (!auditSheet) {
    throw new Error('Không tìm thấy LOG_Audit.');
  }

  var headerInfo =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cInspectSheetHeaders_(
      spreadsheet,
      'LOG_Audit',
      []
    );

  var auditId =
    'AUD_4E5C_DEV_' + new Date().getTime();

  var details = {
    phase: '4E-5C',
    action: 'CONTROLLED_HANDWRITING_REVIEW_ACTION',
    responseId:
      plan.responseId,
    responseRowNumber:
      plan.targetRowNumber,
    reviewAction:
      plan.reviewAction,
    previousReviewStatus:
      plan.previousReviewStatus,
    targetReviewStatus:
      plan.targetReviewStatus,
    reviewerId:
      plan.reviewerId,
    reviewerNote:
      plan.reviewerNote,
    fileId:
      plan.fileId,
    fileUrl:
      plan.fileUrl,
    metadataColumn:
      plan.metadataColumn ? plan.metadataColumn.raw : '',
    actualSheetWritePerformed: true,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false
  };

  var canonicalData = {
    auditId:
      auditId,
    action:
      'HANDWRITING_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C',
    entityType:
      'DATA_Responses',
    entityId:
      plan.responseId,
    detailsJson:
      JSON.stringify(details),
    createdAt:
      new Date().toISOString(),
    actorId:
      plan.reviewerId || 'PARENT',
    source:
      '4E-5C',
    environment:
      'DEV'
  };

  var aliasMap =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cGetAuditFieldAliasMap_();

  var rowValues =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cBuildBlankRow_(
      headerInfo.lastColumn
    );

  var auditIdColumnIndex = 0;
  var errors = [];

  for (var key in canonicalData) {
    if (!canonicalData.hasOwnProperty(key)) continue;

    var match =
      kidlearnV3_4e5cFindHeaderMatch_(
        headerInfo.headers || [],
        aliasMap[key] || [key]
      );

    if (match) {
      rowValues[match.columnIndex - 1] =
        canonicalData[key];

      if (key === 'auditId') {
        auditIdColumnIndex =
          match.columnIndex;
      }
    }
  }

  var required = [
    'auditId',
    'action',
    'entityType',
    'entityId',
    'detailsJson',
    'createdAt'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < required.length; i++) {
    var requiredMatch =
      kidlearnV3_4e5cFindHeaderMatch_(
        headerInfo.headers || [],
        aliasMap[required[i]] || [required[i]]
      );

    if (!requiredMatch) {
      errors.push(
        'LOG_Audit thiếu required field: ' +
        required[i]
      );
    }
  }

  if (!auditIdColumnIndex) {
    errors.push('LOG_Audit không map được auditId.');
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không append audit 4E-5C. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  auditSheet.appendRow(rowValues);
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  return {
    success: true,
    auditId: auditId,
    auditRowNumber:
      auditSheet.getLastRow()
  };
}


/**
 * Verify audit row.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5cVerifyAuditRow_(rowNumber, auditId) {
  var errors = [];

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cOpenSpreadsheet_();

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'LOG_Audit'
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    errors.push('Không tìm thấy LOG_Audit.');
  }

  var headerInfo =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cInspectSheetHeaders_(
      spreadsheet,
      'LOG_Audit',
      []
    );

  var auditIdColumn =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cFindHeaderMatch_(
      headerInfo.headers || [],
      ['auditId', 'logId', 'id']
    );

  if (!auditIdColumn) {
    errors.push('Không map được auditId column.');
  }

  var actual = '';

  if (
    errors.length === 0 &&
    sheet &&
    rowNumber &&
    auditIdColumn
  ) {
    actual =
      String(
        sheet
          .getRange(rowNumber, auditIdColumn.columnIndex)
          .getValue() || ''
      );

    if (actual !== String(auditId)) {
      errors.push(
        'Audit ID không khớp. Expected=' +
        auditId +
        ', Actual=' +
        actual
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    auditRowNumber: rowNumber,
    auditId: auditId,
    actualAuditId: actual,
    errors: errors
  };
}


/**
 * Action helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5cNormalizeActionType_(actionType) {
  var text =
    String(actionType || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    text === 'ACCEPT' ||
    text === 'ACCEPTED' ||
    text === 'REVIEWED_ACCEPTED'
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.ACTION_ACCEPT;
  }

  if (
    text === 'RETRY' ||
    text === 'REQUEST_RETRY' ||
    text === 'REVIEWED_RETRY'
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.ACTION_RETRY;
  }

  return '';
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5cResolveTargetReviewStatus_(actionType) {
  if (
    actionType ===
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.ACTION_ACCEPT
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.STATUS_ACCEPTED;
  }

  if (
    actionType ===
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.ACTION_RETRY
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_4E5C_CONFIG.STATUS_RETRY;
  }

  return '';
}


/**
 * Header helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5cInspectSheetHeaders_(spreadsheet, sheetName, warnings) {
  warnings = warnings || [];

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4e5aInspectSheetHeaders_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4e5aInspectSheetHeaders_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName,
      warnings
    );
  }

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4e4InspectSheetHeaders_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4e4InspectSheetHeaders_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName,
      warnings
    );
  }

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4e5cGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      exists: false,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      headerRowIndex: 0,
      dataStartRowIndex: 0,
      lastRow: 0,
      lastColumn: 0,
      headers: []
    };
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 1 || lastColumn < 1) {
    return {
      exists: true,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      headerRowIndex: 1,
      dataStartRowIndex: 2,
      lastRow: lastRow,
      lastColumn: lastColumn,
      headers: []
    };
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(1, 1, Math.min(2, lastRow), lastColumn)
      .getValues();

  var headerRowIndex = 1;

  if (
    values.length > 1 &&
    kidlearnV3_4e5cHeaderScore_(values[1]) >=
      kidlearnV3_4e5cHeaderScore_(values[0]) &&
    kidlearnV3_4e5cHeaderScore_(values[1]) >= 3
  ) {
    headerRowIndex = 2;
  }

  var row =
    values[headerRowIndex - 1] || [];

  var headers = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    var raw =
      String(row[i] || '').trim();

    if (!raw) continue;

    headers.push({
      columnIndex:
        i + 1,
      raw:
        raw,
      normalized:
        kidlearnV3_4e5cNormalizeLookupKey_(raw)
    });
  }

  return {
    exists: true,
    sheetName:
      sheetName,
    headerRowIndex:
      headerRowIndex,
    dataStartRowIndex:
      headerRowIndex + 1,
    lastRow:
      lastRow,
    lastColumn:
      lastColumn,
    headers:
      headers
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5cHeaderScore_(row) {
  var score = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(row[i] || '').trim();

    if (/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/.test(value)) {
      score++;
    }
  }

  return score;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5cFindHeaderMatch_(headers, aliases) {
  var map = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    map[
      kidlearnV3_4e5cNormalizeLookupKey_(aliases[i])
    ] = true;
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < headers.length; j++) {
    if (map[headers[j].normalized]) {
      return headers[j];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5cFindRowById_(
  sheet,
  headerInfo,
  idColumnIndex,
  expectedId
) {
  if (!sheet || !idColumnIndex || !expectedId) return 0;

  var startRow =
    headerInfo.dataStartRowIndex || headerInfo.headerRowIndex + 1;

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < startRow) return 0;

  var rowCount =
    lastRow - startRow + 1;

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(startRow, idColumnIndex, rowCount, 1)
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < rowCount; i++) {
    if (
      String(values[i][0]) === String(expectedId)
    ) {
      return startRow + i;
    }
  }

  return 0;
}


/**
 * Spreadsheet helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5cOpenSpreadsheet_() {
  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) return active;

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DEV spreadsheet.');
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5cGetSheetByExactName_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Audit alias.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5cGetAuditFieldAliasMap_() {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4e4GetAuditFieldAliasMap_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4e4GetAuditFieldAliasMap_();
  }

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4e3GetAuditFieldAliasMap_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4e3GetAuditFieldAliasMap_();
  }

  return {
    auditId: ['auditId', 'auditid', 'logId', 'logid', 'id'],
    action: ['action', 'actionType', 'event', 'operation'],
    entityType: ['entityType', 'targetSheet', 'sheetName', 'objectType'],
    entityId: ['entityId', 'targetId', 'objectId', 'recordId'],
    detailsJson: ['detailsJson', 'payloadJson', 'metaJson', 'description'],
    createdAt: ['createdAt', 'timestamp', 'time', 'loggedAt'],
    actorId: ['actorId', 'userId'],
    source: ['source', 'module', 'phase'],
    environment: ['environment', 'env']
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5cBuildBlankRow_(length) {
  var row = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    row.push('');
  }

  return row;
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5cCheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    errors: errors
  };
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5cNormalizeLookupKey_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '')
    .replace(/[^\w]/g, '');
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5cPreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 220) {
    return text.substring(0, 220) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5cSafeJsonParse_(text) {
  text =
    String(text || '').trim();

  if (!text) {
    return {
      success: true,
      value: {},
      raw: ''
    };
  }

  try {
    return {
      success: true,
      value: JSON.parse(text),
      raw: text
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      value: {},
      raw: text,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5cUniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5cSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {

        )
    },
    {

      label: 'Controlled Review Action Write',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4e5dSafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertHandwritingReviewAction4E5CReadyV3'
        )
    }
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < componentChecks.length; i++) {
    if (
      componentChecks[i].required &&

    ) {
      errors.push(

        ' chưa ready: ' +
        componentChecks[i].check.message
      );

    );

    );

  if (!reviewActionStatus.success) {

function kidlearnV3_4e5dBuildComponentSummary_(componentChecks) {
  var summary = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < componentChecks.length; i++) {
    summary.push({
      key:
        componentChecks[i].key,
      label:
        componentChecks[i].label,
      required:
        componentChecks[i].required === true,
      success:
        componentChecks[i].check.success === true,
      phase:
        componentChecks[i].check.phase || '',
      status:
        componentChecks[i].check.status || '',
      nextBundle:
        componentChecks[i].check.nextBundle || '',
      message:
        componentChecks[i].check.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : componentChecks[i].check.message
    });
  }

  return summary;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5dBuildReviewActionSummary_(
  statusCall,
  verifyCall
) {
  var summary = {
    statusReadable:
      statusCall.success === true,
    verifyPassed:
      verifyCall.success === true,
    status:
      statusCall.status || '',
    responseId:
      statusCall.responseId || '',
    reviewAction:
      statusCall.reviewAction || '',
    targetReviewStatus:
      statusCall.targetReviewStatus || '',
    nextBundle:
      statusCall.nextBundle || '',
    verifyStatus:
      verifyCall.status || '',
    verifyMessage:
      verifyCall.success === true ? 'OK' : verifyCall.message
  };

  if (
    statusCall.outputSummary &&
    statusCall.outputSummary.lastReviewAction
  ) {
    summary.responseId =
      statusCall.outputSummary.lastReviewAction.responseId || summary.responseId;

    summary.reviewAction =
      statusCall.outputSummary.lastReviewAction.reviewAction || summary.reviewAction;

    summary.targetReviewStatus =
      statusCall.outputSummary.lastReviewAction.targetReviewStatus || summary.targetReviewStatus;
  }

  return summary;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5dInspectCurrentQueue_() {
  try {
    if (

    ) {

      };
    }

    var context =
      kidlearnV3_getParentReviewQueueContext4E5AV3({
        limit: 100
      });

    var queue =

    return {
      success:
        context.success === true,
      phase:
        '4E-5D',
      sourcePhase:
        context.phase || '4E-5A',
      itemCount:
        queue.itemCount || 0,
      pendingCount:
        queue.pendingCount || 0,
      statsByStatus:
        queue.statsByStatus || {},
      note:
        'pendingCount có thể bằng 0 sau khi 4E-5C đã ACCEPT/RETRY item đầu tiên. Đây là trạng thái hợp lệ.',
      message:
        context.success === true ? 'OK' : JSON.stringify(context)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      phase: '4E-5D',
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5dCheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      errors
  };
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5dSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        outputSummary: null
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    var summary =
      kidlearnV3_4e5dSummarizeOutput_(
        output
      );

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      nextBundle:
        output && output.nextBundle ? output.nextBundle : '',
      responseId:

      reviewAction:

/**
 * Build parent review queue context.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5aBuildContext_(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

    /**
   * IMPORTANT 4E-5A-P1:
   * Không dùng strict 4E-4 READY_FOR_4E_5 nữa,
   * vì sau 4E-5C trạng thái có thể đã đổi từ NEEDS_REVIEW
   * sang REVIEWED_ACCEPTED hoặc REVIEWED_RETRY.
   *
   * Parent Review Queue context phải vẫn đọc được và hiển thị empty state.
   */
  var prerequisite =
    kidlearnV3_4e5aCheckReviewQueuePrerequisite4E5AP1_();

  if (!prerequisite.success) {
    warnings.push(
      '4E-5A prerequisite warning: ' +
      prerequisite.message +
      '. Vẫn tiếp tục đọc DATA_Responses để hiển thị queue.'
    );
  }

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4e5aCheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4e5aOpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được DEV spreadsheet: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var childMap = {};

  if (spreadsheet) {
    childMap =
      kidlearnV3_4e5aBuildChildMap_(
        spreadsheet,
        warnings
      );
  }

  var responseRead = null;

  if (spreadsheet) {
    responseRead =
      kidlearnV3_4e5aReadHandwritingReviewItems_(
        spreadsheet,
        childMap,
        options,
        warnings
      );

    if (!responseRead.success) {
      errors =
        errors.concat(responseRead.errors || []);
    }

    warnings =
      warnings.concat(responseRead.warnings || []);
  }

  var items =
    responseRead && responseRead.items
      ? responseRead.items
      : [];

  var stats =
    kidlearnV3_4e5aBuildStats_(items);

  if (items.length === 0) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy bài viết tay NEEDS_REVIEW. UI 4E-5B sẽ hiển thị trạng thái trống.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'GET_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_CONTEXT_4E_5A_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    contextName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_CONFIG.CONTEXT_NAME,
    generatedAt:
      new Date().toISOString(),
    rolePolicy: {
      childCanSeeReviewQueue: false,
      familyAdminCanSeeReviewQueue: true,
      familyAdminCanOpenDriveLink: true,
      reviewActionWriteEnabledNow: false,
      reviewActionWritePhase: '4E-5C'
    },
    uiPolicy: {
      readOnlyNow: true,
      imageEmbedEnabledNow: false,
      openDriveLinkOnlyNow: true,
      showAcceptRetryButtonsNow: false,
      nextUiStep:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE
    },
    reviewQueue: {
      title: 'Bài viết tay chờ duyệt',
      description:
        'Danh sách bài viết tay cần phụ huynh/admin xem lại.',
      pendingStatuses:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_CONFIG.PENDING_STATUSES,
      itemCount:
        items.length,
      pendingCount:
        stats.pendingCount,
      statsByStatus:
        stats.statsByStatus,
      items:
        items,
      emptyState: {
        visible:
          items.length === 0,
        title:
          'Chưa có bài viết tay cần duyệt',
        message:
          'Khi bé nộp bài viết tay và hệ thống lưu ảnh, danh sách sẽ hiển thị tại đây.'
      }
    },
    sourceInfo: {
      dataSource:
        'DATA_Responses.answerMetaJson',
      childSource:
        'DATA_Children',
      responseRead:

      childMapCount:
        kidlearnV3_4e5aObjectKeyCount_(childMap)
    },
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,

/**
 * Read DATA_Responses and build review queue items.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5aReadHandwritingReviewItems_(
  spreadsheet,
  childMap,
  options,
  warnings
) {
  options = options || {};
  warnings = warnings || [];

  var errors = [];
  var localWarnings = [];

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4e5aGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Responses'
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      success: false,
      sheetName: 'DATA_Responses',
      items: [],
      errors: ['Không tìm thấy DATA_Responses.'],
      warnings: []
    };
  }

    kidlearnV3_4e5aInspectSheetHeaders_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Responses',
      localWarnings
    );

  var metadataColumn =
    kidlearnV3_4e5aFindHeaderMatch_(
      headerInfo.headers || [],
      [
        'answerMetaJson',
        'detailsJson',
        'metaJson',
        'payloadJson',
        'metadataJson'
      ]
    );

  var responseIdColumn =
    kidlearnV3_4e5aFindHeaderMatch_(
      headerInfo.headers || [],
      [
        'responseId',
        'responseid',
        'id',
        'responseKey',
        'maPhanHoi',
        'maTraLoi'
      ]
    );

  if (!metadataColumn) {
    errors.push(
      'DATA_Responses thiếu answerMetaJson/detailsJson/metaJson.'
    );
  }

  if (!responseIdColumn) {
    errors.push(
      'DATA_Responses không map được responseId/id.'
    );
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    return {
      success: false,
      sheetName: 'DATA_Responses',
      headerInfo: headerInfo,
      metadataColumn: metadataColumn,
      responseIdColumn: responseIdColumn,
      items: [],
      errorCount: errors.length,
      warningCount: localWarnings.length,
      errors: errors,
      warnings: localWarnings
    };
  }

  var startRow =
    headerInfo.dataStartRowIndex || headerInfo.headerRowIndex + 1;

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < startRow) {
    return {
      success: true,
      sheetName: 'DATA_Responses',
      headerInfo: headerInfo,
      metadataColumn: metadataColumn,
      responseIdColumn: responseIdColumn,
      items: [],
      scannedRowCount: 0,
      errorCount: 0,
      warningCount: localWarnings.length,
      errors: [],
      warnings: localWarnings
    };
  }

  var rowCount =
    lastRow - startRow + 1;

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(startRow, 1, rowCount, lastColumn)
      .getValues();

  var limit =
    Number(options.limit || KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_CONFIG.MAX_ITEMS);

  if (isNaN(limit) || limit < 1) {
    limit =
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_CONFIG.MAX_ITEMS;
  }

  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var rowValues =
      values[i];

    var rowNumber =
      startRow + i;

    var rowObject =
      kidlearnV3_4e5aBuildRowObjectByHeader_(
        headerInfo,
        rowValues
      );

    var metaText =
      String(
        rowValues[metadataColumn.columnIndex - 1] || ''
      ).trim();

    if (!metaText) continue;

    var parsed =
      kidlearnV3_4e5aSafeJsonParse_(
        metaText
      );

    if (!parsed.success) {
      localWarnings.push(
        'Row ' + rowNumber + ': answerMetaJson không phải JSON hợp lệ.'
      );
      continue;
    }

    var meta =
      parsed.value || {};

    var asset =
      meta.handwritingAsset || {};

    var review =
      meta.handwritingReview || {};

    var reviewStatus =
      String(
        review.status ||
        asset.reviewStatus ||
        ''
      ).trim().toUpperCase();

    if (
      !kidlearnV3_4e5aIsPendingReviewStatus_(
        reviewStatus
      )
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    if (!asset.fileId && !asset.fileUrl) {
      localWarnings.push(
        'Row ' + rowNumber + ': có reviewStatus pending nhưng thiếu fileId/fileUrl.'
      );
      continue;
    }

    var responseId =
      String(
        rowValues[responseIdColumn.columnIndex - 1] ||
        kidlearnV3_4e5aDeepFindValue_(
          meta,
          ['responseId', 'responseid']
        ) ||
        ''
      ).trim();

    var childId =
      kidlearnV3_4e5aResolveField_(
        rowObject,
        meta,
        [
          'childId',
          'childid',
          'studentId',
          'studentid'
        ]
      ) || '';

    var lessonId =
      kidlearnV3_4e5aResolveField_(
        rowObject,
        meta,
        [
          'lessonId',
          'lessonid',
          'lessonKey'
        ]
      ) ||
      kidlearnV3_4e5aGuessLessonIdFromDrivePath_(
        asset.drivePath
      );

    var activityId =
      kidlearnV3_4e5aResolveField_(
        rowObject,
        meta,
        [
          'activityId',
          'activityid',
          'questionId',
          'questionid'
        ]
      ) || '';

    var subjectCode =
      kidlearnV3_4e5aResolveField_(
        rowObject,
        meta,
        [
          'subjectCode',
          'subjectKey',
          'subjectId',
          'subject'
        ]
      ) ||
      kidlearnV3_4e5aGuessSubjectFromLessonId_(
        lessonId
      );

    var childInfo =
      childMap[childId] || {};

    var item = {
      queueItemId:
        'HW_REVIEW_' + responseId,
      responseId:
        responseId,
      responseRowNumber:
        rowNumber,
      childId:
        childId,
      childName:
        childInfo.childName ||
        childInfo.displayName ||
        childId ||
        'Bé',
      lessonId:
        lessonId,
      activityId:
        activityId,
      subjectCode:
        subjectCode,
      subjectLabel:
        kidlearnV3_4e5aSubjectLabel_(
          subjectCode
        ),
      answerMode:
        meta.answerMode || 'HANDWRITE_INPUT',
      reviewStatus:
        reviewStatus ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PENDING_STATUS,
      handwritingAsset: {
        assetId:
          asset.assetId || '',
        fileId:
          asset.fileId || '',
        fileUrl:
          asset.fileUrl || '',
        fileName:
          asset.fileName || '',
        mimeType:
          asset.mimeType || 'image/png',
        drivePath:
          asset.drivePath || '',
        fileSizeBytes:
          asset.fileSizeBytes || '',
        createdAt:
          asset.createdAt || ''
      },
      handwritingReview: {
        status:
          review.status || asset.reviewStatus || '',
        parentReviewRequired:
          review.parentReviewRequired !== false,
        autoOcrEnabled:
          review.autoOcrEnabled === true,
        aiAutoGradingEnabled:
          review.aiAutoGradingEnabled === true,
        reviewedAt:
          review.reviewedAt || '',
        reviewedBy:
          review.reviewedBy || '',
        reviewerNote:
          review.reviewerNote || ''
      },
      uiActions: {
        canOpenDriveLink: true,
        canPreviewImageInlineNow: false,
        canAcceptNow: false,
        canRequestRetryNow: false,
        reviewWritePhase: '4E-5C'
      },
      metadata: {
        metadataColumn:
          metadataColumn.raw,
        metadataColumnIndex:
          metadataColumn.columnIndex,
        answerMetaPreview:
          kidlearnV3_4e5aPreviewValue_(
            metaText
          )
      },
      sortKey:
        asset.createdAt ||
        meta.updatedAt ||
        ''
    };

    items.push(item);

    if (items.length >= limit) {
      localWarnings.push(
        'Đã đạt giới hạn ' + limit + ' items. Có thể còn dữ liệu chưa hiển thị.'
      );
      break;
    }
  }

  items.sort(function (a, b) {
    return String(b.sortKey || '').localeCompare(
      String(a.sortKey || '')
    );
  });

  return {
    success: true,
    sheetName: 'DATA_Responses',
    headerInfo: {
      headerRowIndex:
        headerInfo.headerRowIndex,
      dataStartRowIndex:
        headerInfo.dataStartRowIndex,
      lastRow:
        headerInfo.lastRow,
      lastColumn:
        headerInfo.lastColumn
    },
    metadataColumn:
      metadataColumn,
    responseIdColumn:
      responseIdColumn,
    scannedRowCount:
      values.length,
    itemCount:
      items.length,
    items:
      items,
    errorCount:
      0,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4e5aUniqueArray_(localWarnings).length,
    errors:
      [],
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4e5aUniqueArray_(localWarnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Build child map from DATA_Children.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5aBuildChildMap_(spreadsheet, warnings) {
  warnings = warnings || [];

  var map = {};

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4e5aGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Children'
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy DATA_Children. Review Queue sẽ dùng childId thay tên bé.'
    );
    return map;
  }

  var headerInfo =
    kidlearnV3_4e5aInspectSheetHeaders_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Children',
      warnings
    );

  if (!headerInfo.exists || headerInfo.headers.length === 0) {
    warnings.push(
      'DATA_Children chưa có header hợp lệ.'
    );
    return map;
  }

  var childIdColumn =
    kidlearnV3_4e5aFindHeaderMatch_(
      headerInfo.headers || [],
      [
        'childId',
        'childid',
        'id',
        'studentId',
        'learnerId'
      ]
    );

  var childNameColumn =
    kidlearnV3_4e5aFindHeaderMatch_(
      headerInfo.headers || [],
      [
        'childName',
        'displayName',
        'fullName',
        'name',
        'nickname',
        'tenBe',
        'hoTen'
      ]
    );

  if (!childIdColumn) {
    warnings.push(
      'DATA_Children không map được childId.'
    );
    return map;
  }

  var startRow =
    headerInfo.dataStartRowIndex || headerInfo.headerRowIndex + 1;

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < startRow) {
    return map;
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        startRow,
        1,
        lastRow - startRow + 1,
        sheet.getLastColumn()
      )
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    var row =
      values[i];

    var childId =
      String(row[childIdColumn.columnIndex - 1] || '').trim();

    if (!childId) continue;

    var childName =
      childNameColumn
        ? String(row[childNameColumn.columnIndex - 1] || '').trim()
        : childId;

    map[childId] = {
      childId:
        childId,
      childName:
        childName,
      displayName:
        childName
    };
  }

  return map;
}


/**
 * Stats.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5aBuildStats_(items) {
  var statsByStatus = {};
  var pendingCount = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var status =
      String(items[i].reviewStatus || 'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase();

    if (!statsByStatus[status]) {
      statsByStatus[status] = 0;
    }

    statsByStatus[status]++;

    if (
      kidlearnV3_4e5aIsPendingReviewStatus_(status)
    ) {
      pendingCount++;
    }
  }

  return {
    pendingCount:
      pendingCount,
    statsByStatus:
      statsByStatus
  };
}


/**
 * Status helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5aIsPendingReviewStatus_(status) {
  status =
    String(status || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  var allowed =
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_CONFIG.PENDING_STATUSES;

  for (var i = 0; i < allowed.length; i++) {
    if (status === String(allowed[i]).toUpperCase()) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}


/**
 * Field resolve helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5aResolveField_(rowObject, meta, aliases) {
  rowObject = rowObject || {};
  meta = meta || {};

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    var key =
      kidlearnV3_4e5aNormalizeLookupKey_(aliases[i]);

    for (var rawKey in rowObject) {
      if (!rowObject.hasOwnProperty(rawKey)) continue;

      if (
        kidlearnV3_4e5aNormalizeLookupKey_(rawKey) === key &&
        rowObject[rawKey]
      ) {
        return String(rowObject[rawKey]).trim();
      }
    }
  }

  return kidlearnV3_4e5aDeepFindValue_(
    meta,
    aliases
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aDeepFindValue_(obj, aliases) {
  var aliasMap = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    aliasMap[
      kidlearnV3_4e5aNormalizeLookupKey_(aliases[i])
    ] = true;
  }

  return kidlearnV3_4e5aDeepFindValueInternal_(
    obj,
    aliasMap,
    0
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aDeepFindValueInternal_(obj, aliasMap, depth) {
  if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return '';

  if (depth > 5) return '';

  for (var key in obj) {
    if (!obj.hasOwnProperty(key)) continue;

    if (
      aliasMap[
        kidlearnV3_4e5aNormalizeLookupKey_(key)
      ] &&
      obj[key] !== null &&
      obj[key] !== undefined &&
      typeof obj[key] !== 'object'
    ) {
      return String(obj[key]).trim();
    }
  }

  for (var key2 in obj) {
    if (!obj.hasOwnProperty(key2)) continue;

    if (obj[key2] && typeof obj[key2] === 'object') {
      var found =
        kidlearnV3_4e5aDeepFindValueInternal_(
          obj[key2],
          aliasMap,
          depth + 1
        );

      if (found) return found;
    }
  }

  return '';
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aGuessLessonIdFromDrivePath_(drivePath) {
  var text =
    String(drivePath || '');

  var parts =
    text.split('/');

  if (parts.length >= 2) {
    return parts[parts.length - 2] || '';
  }

  return '';
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aGuessSubjectFromLessonId_(lessonId) {
  var text =
    String(lessonId || '').toUpperCase();

  if (text.indexOf('MATH') >= 0) return 'MATH';
  if (text.indexOf('TV') >= 0 || text.indexOf('VIET') >= 0) return 'VIETNAMESE';
  if (text.indexOf('ENG') >= 0) return 'ENGLISH';
  if (text.indexOf('SCI') >= 0) return 'SCIENCE';

  return '';
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aSubjectLabel_(subjectCode) {
  var key =
    String(subjectCode || '').toUpperCase();

  if (key === 'MATH') return 'Toán học';
  if (key === 'VIETNAMESE' || key === 'TV') return 'Tiếng Việt';
  if (key === 'ENGLISH' || key === 'ENG') return 'Tiếng Anh';
  if (key === 'SCIENCE' || key === 'SCI') return 'Khoa học';

  return subjectCode || '';
}


/**
 * Header helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5aInspectSheetHeaders_(spreadsheet, sheetName, warnings) {
  warnings = warnings || [];

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4e4InspectSheetHeaders_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4e4InspectSheetHeaders_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName,
      warnings
    );
  }

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4e3InspectSheetHeaders_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4e3InspectSheetHeaders_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName,
      warnings
    );
  }

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4e5aGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      exists: false,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      headerRowIndex: 0,
      dataStartRowIndex: 0,
      lastRow: 0,
      lastColumn: 0,
      headers: []
    };
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 1 || lastColumn < 1) {
    return {
      exists: true,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      headerRowIndex: 1,
      dataStartRowIndex: 2,
      lastRow: lastRow,
      lastColumn: lastColumn,
      headers: []
    };
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(1, 1, Math.min(2, lastRow), lastColumn)
      .getValues();

  var headerRowIndex = 1;

  if (
    values.length > 1 &&
    kidlearnV3_4e5aHeaderScore_(values[1]) >=
      kidlearnV3_4e5aHeaderScore_(values[0]) &&
    kidlearnV3_4e5aHeaderScore_(values[1]) >= 3
  ) {
    headerRowIndex = 2;
  }

  var row =
    values[headerRowIndex - 1] || [];

  var headers = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    var raw =
      String(row[i] || '').trim();

    if (!raw) continue;

    headers.push({
      columnIndex:
        i + 1,
      raw:
        raw,
      normalized:
        kidlearnV3_4e5aNormalizeLookupKey_(raw)
    });
  }

  return {
    exists: true,
    sheetName:
      sheetName,
    headerRowIndex:
      headerRowIndex,
    dataStartRowIndex:
      headerRowIndex + 1,
    lastRow:
      lastRow,
    lastColumn:
      lastColumn,
    headers:
      headers
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aHeaderScore_(row) {
  var score = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(row[i] || '').trim();

    if (/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/.test(value)) {
      score++;
    }
  }

  return score;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aFindHeaderMatch_(headers, aliases) {
  var map = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    map[
      kidlearnV3_4e5aNormalizeLookupKey_(aliases[i])
    ] = true;
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < headers.length; j++) {
    if (map[headers[j].normalized]) {
      return headers[j];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aBuildRowObjectByHeader_(headerInfo, rowValues) {
  var obj = {};
  var headers =
    headerInfo.headers || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
    obj[headers[i].raw] =
      rowValues[headers[i].columnIndex - 1] || '';
  }

  return obj;
}


/**
 * Spreadsheet helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5aOpenSpreadsheet_() {
  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) return active;

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DEV spreadsheet.');
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aGetSheetByExactName_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5aCheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      errors
  };
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5aNormalizeLookupKey_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '')
    .replace(/[^\w]/g, '');
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aPreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 220) {
    return text.substring(0, 220) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aSafeJsonParse_(text) {
  text =
    String(text || '').trim();

  if (!text) {
    return {
      success: true,
      value: {},
      raw: ''
    };
  }

  try {
    return {
      success: true,
      value: JSON.parse(text),
      raw: text
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      value: {},
      raw: text,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aUniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aObjectKeyCount_(obj) {
  var count = 0;

  obj = obj || {};

  for (var key in obj) {
    if (obj.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
      count++;
    }
  }

  return count;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output:
        output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output:
        null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aGetCurrentStatus_() {
  return (
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_KEYS.STATUS
      ) ||
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_STATUS.NOT_RUN
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aResolveStatusAfterCheck_(statusBefore, proposedStatus) {
  if (
    statusBefore ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_STATUS.READY_FOR_4E_5B &&
    proposedStatus !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_STATUS.FAILED
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_STATUS.READY_FOR_4E_5B;
  }

  return proposedStatus;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5aSaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_4E5A_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(

/**
 * 4E-5A-P1
 * Flexible prerequisite check for Parent Review Queue.
 *
 * Valid cases:
 * - Phase 4E already locked.
 * - 4E-4 current state is valid after review.
 * - 4E-5C review action is ready.
 * - Old 4E-4 NEEDS_REVIEW state is still valid.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e5aCheckReviewQueuePrerequisite4E5AP1_() {
  var checks = [
    {
      name: 'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4EClosedLockedV3',
      label: 'Phase 4E closed locked'
    },
    {
      name: 'kidlearnV3_assertHandwritingAssetLinkCurrentState4E6P2V3',
      label: '4E-4 current state after review'
    },
    {
      name: 'kidlearnV3_assertHandwritingReviewAction4E5CReadyV3',
      label: '4E-5C review action ready'
    },
    {
      name: 'kidlearnV3_assertHandwritingAssetLink4E4ReadyV3',
      label: '4E-4 original NEEDS_REVIEW ready'
    }
  ];

  var attempts = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < checks.length; i++) {
    var call =
      kidlearnV3_4e5aSafeCall_(
        checks[i].name
      );

    attempts.push({
      functionName:
        checks[i].name,
      label:
        checks[i].label,
      success:
        call.success === true,
      message:
        call.message || ''
    });

    if (call.success === true) {
      return {
        success: true,
        action: 'CHECK_REVIEW_QUEUE_PREREQUISITE_4E_5A_P1',
        phase: '4E-5A',
        method:
          checks[i].name,
        label:
          checks[i].label,
        message:
          'OK',
        attempts:
          attempts
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    success: false,
    action: 'CHECK_REVIEW_QUEUE_PREREQUISITE_4E_5A_P1',
    phase: '4E-5A',
    method: '',
    label: '',
    message:
      'Không có prerequisite nào pass. Có thể 4E chưa hoàn tất hoặc helper current state chưa được dán.',
    attempts:
      attempts
  };
}

function kidlearnV3_4e5bBuildReadiness_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var e5a =
    kidlearnV3_4e5bSafeCall_(

    );

  if (!e5a.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4E-5A chưa READY_FOR_4E_5B: ' +
      e5a.message
    );
  }

  var context =
    kidlearnV3_4e5bSafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getParentReviewQueueContext4E5AV3'
    );

  if (!context.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được context 4E-5A: ' +
      context.message
    );
  }

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4e5bCheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var uiMarkers =
    kidlearnV3_4e5bInspectUiMarkers_();

  if (!uiMarkers.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(uiMarkers.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(uiMarkers.warnings || []);

  var itemCount = 0;
  var pendingCount = 0;

  if (
    context.success &&
    context.output &&
    context.output.reviewQueue
  ) {
    itemCount =
      context.output.reviewQueue.itemCount || 0;

    pendingCount =
      context.output.reviewQueue.pendingCount || 0;
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'BUILD_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_UI_READINESS_4E_5B_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_UI_4E5B_CONFIG.PHASE,

    uiName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_UI_4E5B_CONFIG.UI_NAME,
    itemCount: itemCount,
    pendingCount: pendingCount,
    prerequisite: {
      phase4E5AReady:
        e5a.success === true,
      contextReadable:
        context.success === true
    },
    devSafety: dev,
    uiMarkers: uiMarkers,
    rolePolicy: {
      childCanSeeReviewQueue: false,
      familyAdminCanSeeReviewQueue: true,
      reviewActionWriteEnabledNow: false
    },
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_UI_4E5B_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_UI_4E5B_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4e5bUniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4e5bUniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}

function kidlearnV3_4e5bCheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    environment: environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    errors: errors
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5bSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output:
        output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output:
        null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5bUniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e5bSaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_UI_4E5B_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_UI_4E5B_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_UI_4E5B_CONFIG.PHASE,
      parentPhase:
        result.parentPhase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_UI_4E5B_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status: status,
      uiName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_UI_4E5B_CONFIG.UI_NAME,
      itemCount:
        result.itemCount || 0,
      pendingCount:
        result.pendingCount || 0,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_UI_4E5B_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_QUEUE_UI_4E5B_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
      realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}

/**

 * No data writes.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewParentReviewUiWriteGate4F3V3() {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_4f3BuildReadiness_();

  result.action =
    'PREVIEW_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F_3_V3';

  result.status =
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_STATUS.PREVIEWED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_STATUS.FAILED;

  kidlearnV3_4f3SaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.status,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4F-3 preview failed. Errors=' +
      result.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,

/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_openParentReviewUiWriteGate4F3ConfirmV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_setParentReviewUiWriteGate4F3V3({

      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED,

  });
}


/**

 * ScriptProperties only.
 */
function kidlearnV3_closeParentReviewUiWriteGate4F3ConfirmV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_setParentReviewUiWriteGate4F3V3({
    mode:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY,
    confirm:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_CONFIG.CLOSE_CONFIRM_TEXT
  });
}


/**
 * Set UI write gate.
 */
function kidlearnV3_setParentReviewUiWriteGate4F3V3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var targetMode =
    String(options.mode || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  var confirmText =
    String(options.confirm || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    targetMode !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY &&
    targetMode !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Gate mode không hợp lệ. Current=' + targetMode
    );
  }

  if (
    targetMode ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED &&
    confirmText !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_CONFIG.OPEN_CONFIRM_TEXT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm mở gate. Cần confirm=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_CONFIG.OPEN_CONFIRM_TEXT
    );
  }

  if (
    targetMode ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY &&
    confirmText !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_CONFIG.CLOSE_CONFIRM_TEXT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm đóng gate. Cần confirm=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_CONFIG.CLOSE_CONFIRM_TEXT
    );
  }

  var readiness =
    kidlearnV3_4f3BuildReadiness_();

  if (!readiness.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4F-3 readiness chưa pass. Errors=' +
      readiness.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      kidlearnV3_4f3GetGatePropertyKey_(),
      targetMode
    );

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'SET_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F_3_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_STATUS.READY_FOR_4F_4,
    gateMode:
      targetMode,
    writeAllowedNow:
      targetMode ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    changedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_4f3SaveStatus_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_STATUS.READY_FOR_4F_4,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PARENT_REVIEW_UI_WRITE_GATE_4F3_KEYS.LAST_GATE_CHANGE_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}
