function kidlearnV3_4bLockSafeCheck_(label, functionName, required) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        label: label,
        functionName: functionName,
        required: required === true,
        success: false,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      label: label,
      functionName: functionName,
      required: required === true,
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      outputSummary:
        kidlearnV3_4bLockSummarizeOutput_(output)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      label: label,
      functionName: functionName,
      required: required === true,
      success: false,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4bLockSummarizeOutput_(output) {
  if (!output) return null;

  return {
    success: output.success === true,
    action: output.action || '',
    phase: output.phase || '',
    status: output.status || '',
    nextBundle: output.nextBundle || '',
    nextPhase: output.nextPhase || '',
    errorCount: output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount: output.warningCount || 0
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4bLockSaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4B_LOCK_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4B_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase: result.phase,
      lockStep: result.lockStep || '4B-3',
      status: status,
      lockName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4B_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_NAME,
      nextPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4B_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4B_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      prodDeployNow: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4bLockReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

      'Real write reward transactions',
      'Store handwriting image/stroke data',
      'Asset loading from Google Drive / MST_MediaAssets',
      'Advanced AI/OCR handwriting review later'
    ],
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_4cLockSaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.status,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4C lock preview failed. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Run final QA before lock.
 *
 * Important:
 * - Không gọi lại smoke/check cũ có thể ghi lùi status.
 * - Chỉ dùng assert + marker check + dry-run server test.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runPhase4CFinalQaV3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewPhase4CLockV3();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  if (!preview.success) {
    errors.push('Preview 4C lock chưa pass.');
  }

  var dryRun =
    kidlearnV3_4cLockRunServerDryRunExercise_();

  if (!dryRun.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dryRun.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(dryRun.warnings || []);

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'RUN_PHASE_4C_FINAL_QA_V3',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
    lockStep: KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_STATUS.QA_PASSED
        : KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_STATUS.FAILED,
    qaMode:
      'ASSERT_MARKER_AND_SERVER_DRY_RUN_ONLY_NO_LEGACY_SMOKE_REPLAY',
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    preview: {
      success: preview.success,
      errorCount: preview.errorCount,
      warningCount: preview.warningCount
    },
    dryRunExercise: dryRun,
    skippedLegacySmokeTests: [
      'kidlearnV3_smokeTestSubjectDashboardContext4C1V3',
      'kidlearnV3_smokeTestLessonPlayerContext4C3V3',
      'kidlearnV3_checkLessonInteractionDryRun4C5V3'
    ],
    skipReason:
      'Final lock uses current READY asserts and read-only marker checks to avoid downgrading previous statuses.',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_4cLockSaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.status,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_QA_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4C final QA failed. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**

  return kidlearnV3_lockPhase4CV3({
    confirm: 'LOCK_PHASE_4C_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_LESSON_PLAYER',
    acceptedVisualScorePercent: 85,

  });

/**
 * Lock Phase 4C.
 */
function kidlearnV3_lockPhase4CV3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var confirmText =
    String(options.confirm || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    confirmText !==
    'LOCK_PHASE_4C_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_LESSON_PLAYER'
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm. Cần confirm=LOCK_PHASE_4C_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_LESSON_PLAYER'
    );
  }

  var qa =
    kidlearnV3_runPhase4CFinalQaV3();

  if (!qa.success) {
    throw new Error('Final QA 4C chưa pass.');
  }

  var score =
    Number(options.acceptedVisualScorePercent || 0);

  if (isNaN(score) || score < 85) {
    throw new Error(
      'Visual score cần >= 85 để lock Phase 4C. Current=' +
      score
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'LOCK_PHASE_4C_V3',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
    lockStep: KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
    lockName: KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_NAME,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4C_CLOSED_LOCKED,
    acceptedVisualScorePercent: score,
    reviewerDecision:
      String(options.reviewerDecision || ''),
    note:
      String(options.note || ''),
    finalMode:
      'PHASE_4C_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_LESSON_PLAYER_CLOSED_LOCKED',
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    prodDeployNow: false,
    lockedScope: [
      'Subject Dashboard Context',
      'Subject Dashboard UI',
      'Subject color map: Math blue, Vietnamese orange, English green, Science red',
      'Subject Dashboard Routing Patch',
      'Lesson Player Context',
      'Lesson Player UI',
      'Multiple choice input',
      'Button input',
      'Text input',
      'Handwriting canvas input',
      'Lesson interaction dry-run server calls',
      'No real learning data writes'
    ],
    nextRecommendedAction:
      'Start Phase 4D — Controlled Lesson Progress and Response Writes.',
    lockedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_4cLockSaveStatus_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4C_CLOSED_LOCKED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_LOCK_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}

  try {
    styles =

        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Styles_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error2) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Styles_4A: ' +
      String(error2.message || error2)
    );
  }

  try {
    subjectClient =
      HtmlService

        .getContent();
  } catch (error3) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_SubjectDashboard_4C2: ' +
      String(error3.message || error3)
    );
  }

  try {

      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Client_SubjectDashboard_Patch_4C2P')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error4) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_SubjectDashboard_Patch_4C2P: ' +

    );

  try {

        .getContent();
  } catch (error5) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_LessonPlayer_4C4: ' +

    );
  }

  try {

  } catch (error6) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_LessonInteraction_DryRun_4C5: ' +
      String(error6.message || error6)
    );
  }

  var shellMarkers = [
    'UI_Product_Client_SubjectDashboard_4C2',
    'UI_Product_Client_SubjectDashboard_Patch_4C2P',
    'UI_Product_Client_LessonPlayer_4C4',
    'UI_Product_Client_LessonInteraction_DryRun_4C5'
  ];

  var clientMarkers = [
    {
      source: subjectClient,

      markers: [

        'openSubjectDashboard4C2',
        'renderSubjectDashboard4C2',
        'supportedAnswerModes'
      ]
    },
    {
      source: subjectPatch,
      label: 'Subject Dashboard Patch 4C2P',
      markers: [
        'KIDLEARN_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_PATCH_4C2P',
        'applySubjectThemeToAllCards4C2P',
        'routeSubjectClick4C2P',
        'openSubjectDetail4B'
      ]
    },
    {
      source: lessonPlayer,
      label: 'Lesson Player 4C4',
      markers: [
        'KIDLEARN_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4',
        'openLessonPlayer4C4',
        'renderLessonPlayer4C4',
        'renderMultipleChoice4C4',
        'renderButtonInput4C4',
        'renderTextInput4C4',
        'renderHandwritingInput4C4',
        'lessonHandwritingCanvas4C4'
      ]
    },
    {
      source: dryRunClient,
      label: 'Dry-run Interaction 4C5',
      markers: [
        'KIDLEARN_LESSON_INTERACTION_DRY_RUN_4C5',
        'collectAnswerPayload4C5',
        'dryRunSubmitAnswer4C5',
        'dryRunCompleteLesson4C5',
        'showDryRunFeedback4C5'
      ]
    }
  ];

  var styleMarkers = [
    '.kl-subject-dashboard-4c2',
    '.kl-subject-card-4b.subject-orange',
    '.kl-subject-card-4b.subject-red',
    '.kl-lesson-player-4c4',
    '.kl-answer-option-4c4',
    '.kl-button-pad-4c4',
    '.kl-text-answer-4c4',
    '.kl-handwriting-canvas-4c4',
    '.kl-dryrun-badge-4c5',
    '.kl-dryrun-feedback-4c5'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < shellMarkers.length; i++) {
    if (shell.indexOf(shellMarkers[i]) === -1) {
      errors.push('Shell thiếu marker: ' + shellMarkers[i]);
    }
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < clientMarkers.length; j++) {

    for (var k = 0; k < group.markers.length; k++) {

/**
 * Helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4cLockSafeCheck_(label, functionName, required) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        label: label,
        functionName: functionName,
        required: required === true,
        success: false,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      label: label,
      functionName: functionName,
      required: required === true,
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      outputSummary:
        kidlearnV3_4cLockSummarizeOutput_(output)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      label: label,
      functionName: functionName,
      required: required === true,
      success: false,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4cLockSafeCallWithPayload_(functionName, payload) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn(payload || {});

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4cLockSummarizeOutput_(output) {
  if (!output) return null;

  return {
    success: output.success === true,
    action: output.action || '',
    phase: output.phase || '',
    status: output.status || '',
    nextBundle: output.nextBundle || '',
    nextPhase: output.nextPhase || '',
    errorCount: output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount: output.warningCount || 0
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4cLockSaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase: result.phase,
      lockStep: result.lockStep || '4C-6',
      status: status,
      lockName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_NAME,
      nextPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      prodDeployNow: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at:

    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4cLockReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Lock Phase 4D.
 * Chỉ ghi ScriptProperties.
 */
function kidlearnV3_lockPhase4DV3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var confirmText =
    String(options.confirm || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    confirmText !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm. Cần confirm=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
    );
  }

  var visualScore =
    Number(options.acceptedVisualScorePercent || 0);

  if (
    isNaN(visualScore) ||
    visualScore <
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.MIN_VISUAL_SCORE_PERCENT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Visual score chưa đủ để lock 4D. Cần >= ' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.MIN_VISUAL_SCORE_PERCENT +
      '%. Current=' +
      visualScore
    );
  }

  var finalQa =
    kidlearnV3_4d7BuildFinalQaReadiness_();

  if (!finalQa.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Final QA 4D chưa pass. Errors=' +
      finalQa.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var gateMode =
    finalQa.gateStatus &&
    finalQa.gateStatus.output
      ? finalQa.gateStatus.output.gateMode
      : '';

  if (
    gateMode !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.REQUIRED_GATE_MODE_FOR_LOCK
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không lock 4D khi UI gate đang mở. Current gateMode=' +
      gateMode +
      '. Hãy chạy kidlearnV3_closeUiControlledWriteGate4D6ConfirmV3 trước.'
    );
  }

  var lockRecord = {
    success: true,
    action: 'LOCK_PHASE_4D_CONTROLLED_WRITES_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
    lockStep:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4D_CLOSED_LOCKED,
    lockName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_NAME,
    reviewerDecision:
      String(options.reviewerDecision || ''),
    acceptedVisualScorePercent:
      visualScore,
    reviewerNote:
      String(options.note || ''),
    gateFinalMode:
      gateMode,
    completedBundles: [
      '4D-1 Write Contract + Schema Readiness Check',
      '4D-2 Response Write Dry-run Row Preview',
      '4D-3 Controlled DEV Real Write DATA_Responses',
      '4D-3P DATA_Responses answerMetaJson Schema Patch',
      '4D-4 Controlled DEV Real Write DATA_LessonProgress',
      '4D-5 Controlled DEV Real Write DATA_StudySessions',
      '4D-6 UI Controlled Write Gate',
      '4D-6P UI Write Gate Stability Patch',
      '4D-7 QA + 4D Lock'
    ],
    finalQaSummary:
      finalQa.finalQaSummary,
    writeEvidence:
      finalQa.writeEvidence,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    lockOnlyScriptPropertiesWrite: true,
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    lockedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_KEYS.LOCK_JSON,
      JSON.stringify(lockRecord)
    );

  kidlearnV3_4d7SaveStatus_(
    lockRecord,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4D_CLOSED_LOCKED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_LOCK_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(lockRecord, null, 2));

  return lockRecord;
}

/**
 * Build final QA readiness.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d7BuildFinalQaReadiness_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4d7CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(dev.warnings || []);

  var prerequisiteChecks =
    kidlearnV3_4d7RunPrerequisiteChecks_();

  if (!prerequisiteChecks.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(prerequisiteChecks.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(prerequisiteChecks.warnings || []);

  var writeEvidence =
    kidlearnV3_4d7CollectWriteEvidence_();

  if (!writeEvidence.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(writeEvidence.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(writeEvidence.warnings || []);

  var gateStatus =
    kidlearnV3_4d7SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getUiControlledWriteGate4D6StatusV3'
    );

  if (!gateStatus.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI write gate status: ' +
      gateStatus.message
    );
  } else {
    var mode =
      gateStatus.output &&
      gateStatus.output.gateMode
        ? gateStatus.output.gateMode
        : '';

    if (
      mode !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.REQUIRED_GATE_MODE_FOR_LOCK
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'UI write gate chưa đóng. Current gateMode=' +
        mode +
        '. Cần GATE_CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY trước khi lock.'
      );
    }
  }

  var uiMarkers =
    kidlearnV3_4d7InspectUiMarkers_();

  if (!uiMarkers.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(uiMarkers.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(uiMarkers.warnings || []);

  var finalQaSummary = {
    phase4CClosed:
      prerequisiteChecks.results.phase4CClosed === true,
    phase4D1Ready:
      prerequisiteChecks.results.phase4D1Ready === true,
    phase4D2Ready:
      prerequisiteChecks.results.phase4D2Ready === true,
    phase4D3Ready:
      prerequisiteChecks.results.phase4D3Ready === true,
    phase4D4Ready:
      prerequisiteChecks.results.phase4D4Ready === true,
    phase4D5Ready:
      prerequisiteChecks.results.phase4D5Ready === true,
    phase4D6Ready:
      prerequisiteChecks.results.phase4D6Ready === true,
    gateClosed:
      gateStatus.success === true &&
      gateStatus.output &&
      gateStatus.output.gateMode ===
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.REQUIRED_GATE_MODE_FOR_LOCK,
    responseWriteEvidence:
      writeEvidence.responseWriteEvidence,
    lessonProgressWriteEvidence:
      writeEvidence.lessonProgressWriteEvidence,
    studySessionWriteEvidence:
      writeEvidence.studySessionWriteEvidence,
    uiWriteGatePatchDetected:
      uiMarkers.uiWriteGatePatchDetected === true
  };

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'BUILD_PHASE_4D_FINAL_QA_READINESS_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
    lockStep:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
    lockName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_NAME,
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    devSafety: dev,
    prerequisiteChecks: prerequisiteChecks,
    writeEvidence: writeEvidence,
    gateStatus: gateStatus,
    uiMarkers: uiMarkers,
    finalQaSummary: finalQaSummary,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4d7UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4d7UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Prerequisite checks.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d7RunPrerequisiteChecks_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var checks = {
    phase4CClosed:
      kidlearnV3_4d7SafeCall_(
        'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4CClosedLockedV3'
      ),
    phase4D1Ready:
      kidlearnV3_4d7SafeCall_(
        'kidlearnV3_assertWriteContract4D1ReadyV3'
      ),
    phase4D2Ready:
      kidlearnV3_4d7SafeCall_(
        'kidlearnV3_assertResponseWriteDryRun4D2ReadyV3'
      ),
    phase4D3Ready:
      kidlearnV3_4d7SafeCall_(
        'kidlearnV3_assertResponseRealWrite4D3ReadyV3'
      ),
    phase4D4Ready:
      kidlearnV3_4d7SafeCall_(
        'kidlearnV3_assertLessonProgressRealWrite4D4ReadyV3'
      ),
    phase4D5Ready:
      kidlearnV3_4d7SafeCall_(
        'kidlearnV3_assertStudySessionRealWrite4D5ReadyV3'
      ),
    phase4D6Ready:
      kidlearnV3_4d7SafeCall_(
        'kidlearnV3_assertUiControlledWriteGate4D6ReadyV3'
      )
  };

  var results = {};

  for (var key in checks) {
    if (!checks.hasOwnProperty(key)) continue;

    results[key] =
      checks[key].success === true;

    if (!checks[key].success) {
      errors.push(
        key +
        ' failed: ' +
        checks[key].message
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'RUN_PHASE_4D_PREREQUISITE_CHECKS_V3',
    results: results,
    rawChecks: checks,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Collect write evidence from 4D-3, 4D-4, 4D-5.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d7CollectWriteEvidence_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var responseStatus =
    kidlearnV3_4d7SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getResponseRealWrite4D3StatusV3'
    );

  var progressStatus =
    kidlearnV3_4d7SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getLessonProgressRealWrite4D4StatusV3'
    );

  var sessionStatus =
    kidlearnV3_4d7SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getStudySessionRealWrite4D5StatusV3'
    );

  var responseEvidence =
    kidlearnV3_4d7ExtractWriteEvidence_(
      responseStatus,
      'DATA_Responses',
      'responseId'
    );

  var progressEvidence =
    kidlearnV3_4d7ExtractWriteEvidence_(
      progressStatus,
      'DATA_LessonProgress',
      'progressId'
    );

  var sessionEvidence =
    kidlearnV3_4d7ExtractWriteEvidence_(
      sessionStatus,
      'DATA_StudySessions',
      'sessionId'
    );

  if (!responseEvidence.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(responseEvidence.errors || []);
  }

  if (!progressEvidence.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(progressEvidence.errors || []);
  }

  if (!sessionEvidence.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(sessionEvidence.errors || []);
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'COLLECT_PHASE_4D_WRITE_EVIDENCE_V3',
    responseWriteEvidence:
      responseEvidence,
    lessonProgressWriteEvidence:
      progressEvidence,
    studySessionWriteEvidence:
      sessionEvidence,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4d7ExtractWriteEvidence_(
  statusCall,
  label,
  idKey
) {
  var errors = [];

  if (!statusCall.success) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      errors: [
        'Không đọc được status cho ' +
        label +
        ': ' +
        statusCall.message
      ]
    };
  }

  var output =
    statusCall.output || {};

  var lastWrite =
    output.lastWrite || null;

  if (!lastWrite) {
    errors.push(
      label + ': thiếu lastWrite.'
    );
  } else {
    if (lastWrite.actualSheetWritePerformed !== true) {
      errors.push(
        label +
        ': actualSheetWritePerformed không phải true.'
      );
    }

    if (!lastWrite[idKey]) {
      errors.push(
        label +
        ': thiếu ' +
        idKey +
        ' trong lastWrite.'
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    label: label,
    status:
      output.status || '',
    idKey: idKey,
    idValue:
      lastWrite && lastWrite[idKey]
        ? lastWrite[idKey]
        : '',
    rowNumber:
      lastWrite
        ? (
            lastWrite.responseRowNumber ||
            lastWrite.progressRowNumber ||
            lastWrite.sessionRowNumber ||
            ''
          )
        : '',
    auditId:
      lastWrite && lastWrite.auditId
        ? lastWrite.auditId
        : '',
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      lastWrite &&
      lastWrite.actualSheetWritePerformed === true,
    rowDelta:
      lastWrite && lastWrite.rowDelta
        ? lastWrite.rowDelta
        : null,
    errors: errors
  };
}


/**
 * Inspect UI markers after 4D-6P.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d7InspectUiMarkers_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var shell = '';
  var client4D6 = '';
  var styles = '';

  try {
    shell =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Shell_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Shell_4A: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  try {
    client4D6 =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Client_WriteGate_4D6')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error2) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_WriteGate_4D6: ' +
      String(error2.message || error2)
    );
  }

  try {
    styles =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Styles_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error3) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Styles_4A: ' +
      String(error3.message || error3)
    );
  }

  var shellMarkers = [
    'UI_Product_Client_WriteGate_4D6',

  ];

  var clientMarkers = [
    'KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6',
    'Phase 4D-6P',
    'refreshWriteGateStatus4D6',
    'collectAnswerPayloadForWriteGate4D6',
    'submitAnswerThroughWriteGate4D6',
    'completeLessonThroughWriteGate4D6',

  ];

  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < shellMarkers.length; i++) {

    shellIncludeOrderChecked: true,

/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d7CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'CHECK_DEV_SAFETY_4D_7_V3',
    environment: environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d7SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4d7UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d7SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
      lockStep:
        result.lockStep ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
      status: status,
      lockName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_NAME,
      nextPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        result.actualSheetWritePerformed === true,
      gateFinalMode:
        result.gateFinalMode || '',
      finalQaSummary:
        result.finalQaSummary || null,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4d7ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

 */

};

};

/**

 * Chạy function này để lock Phase 4E.
 */
function kidlearnV3_lockPhase4EConfirmV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_lockPhase4EV3({
    confirm:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT,
    visualScore: 90,
    visualNote:
      'Parent Review Queue UI read-only was visually checked in DEV.'
  });
}


/**
 * Lock Phase 4E.
 */
function kidlearnV3_lockPhase4EV3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var confirmText =
    String(options.confirm || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    confirmText !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm. Cần confirm=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
    );
  }

  var visualScore =
    Number(options.visualScore || 0);

  if (
    isNaN(visualScore) ||
    visualScore < KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.MIN_VISUAL_SCORE
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'visualScore chưa đạt. Cần >= ' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.MIN_VISUAL_SCORE
    );
  }

  var lock =
    LockService.getScriptLock();

  var locked =
    lock.tryLock(30000);

  if (!locked) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không lấy được script lock sau 30 giây. Vui lòng chạy lại.'
    );
  }

  try {
    var qa =
      kidlearnV3_runPhase4EFinalQaV3();

    if (!qa.success) {
      throw new Error(
        'Final QA 4E chưa pass. Không thể lock.'
      );
    }

    var result = {
      success: true,
      action: 'LOCK_PHASE_4E_4E_6_V3',
      phase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
      lockStep:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
      phaseName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
      status:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4E_CLOSED_LOCKED,
      locked: true,
      finalQaPassed: true,
      componentSummary:
        qa.componentSummary,
      assetSummary:
        qa.assetSummary,
      reviewSummary:
        qa.reviewSummary,
      queueSnapshot:
        qa.queueSnapshot,
      visualScore:
        visualScore,
      visualNote:
        String(options.visualNote || ''),
      minVisualScore:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.MIN_VISUAL_SCORE,
      nextPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
      realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
      lockedAt:
        new Date().toISOString()
    };

    kidlearnV3_4e6SaveLock_(result);

    kidlearnV3_4e6SaveStatus_(
      result,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4E_CLOSED_LOCKED,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_KEYS.LOCKED_AT
    );

    console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
    return result;

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

  var properties =

  var result = {

function kidlearnV3_assertPhase4EClosedLockedV3() {
  var status =

  var result = {

    prodWriteAllowed: false,

    errorCount:

  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {

  }

/**
 * Build final QA.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e6BuildFinalQa_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4e6CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var phase4D =
    kidlearnV3_4e6CheckPhase4D_();

  if (!phase4D.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4D chưa closed locked: ' +
      phase4D.message
    );
  }

  var componentChecks = [
    {
      key: '4E-3P',
      label: 'Manual Drive Folder Config',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertHandwritingDriveFolderConfig4E3PReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4E-1',
      label: 'Handwriting Storage Policy + Drive Readiness',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertHandwritingStorageReadiness4E1ReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4E-2',
      label: 'Handwriting Upload Dry-run Preview',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertHandwritingUploadDryRun4E2ReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4E-3',
      label: 'Controlled DEV Drive Write',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertHandwritingDriveWrite4E3ReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4E-4',
      label: 'Link Handwriting Asset to DATA_Responses - Current State After Review',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertHandwritingAssetLinkCurrentState4E6P2V3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4E-5A',
      label: 'Parent Review Queue Context Read-only',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertParentReviewQueueContext4E5AReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4E-5B',
      label: 'Parent Review Queue UI Read-only',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertParentReviewQueueUi4E5BReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4E-5C',
      label: 'Controlled Review Action Write',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertHandwritingReviewAction4E5CReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4E-5D',
      label: 'QA Ready for 4E-6',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertParentReviewQaReady4E5DReadyV3'
        )
    }
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < componentChecks.length; i++) {
    if (
      componentChecks[i].required &&
      componentChecks[i].check.success !== true
    ) {
      errors.push(
        componentChecks[i].key +
        ' chưa ready: ' +
        componentChecks[i].check.message
      );
    }
  }

  var verifyDrive =
    kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_verifyLastHandwritingDriveWrite4E3V3'
    );

  if (!verifyDrive.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Verify 4E-3 Drive write chưa pass: ' +
      verifyDrive.message
    );
  }

  /**
   * IMPORTANT 4E-6P1:
   * Không dùng strict verify của 4E-4 ở final lock,
   * vì sau 4E-5C reviewStatus đã được đổi từ NEEDS_REVIEW
   * sang REVIEWED_ACCEPTED hoặc REVIEWED_RETRY.
   */
  var verifyLink =
    kidlearnV3_4e6VerifyHandwritingLinkCurrentState_();

  if (!verifyLink.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Verify 4E-4 current response link chưa pass: ' +
      verifyLink.message
    );
  }

  var verifyReview =
    kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_verifyLastHandwritingReviewAction4E5CV3'
    );

  if (!verifyReview.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Verify 4E-5C review action chưa pass: ' +
      verifyReview.message
    );
  }

  var assetStatus =
    kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getHandwritingDriveWrite4E3StatusV3'
    );

  var linkStatus =
    kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getHandwritingAssetLink4E4StatusV3'
    );

  var reviewStatus =
    kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getHandwritingReviewAction4E5CStatusV3'
    );

  var queueSnapshot =
    kidlearnV3_4e6InspectQueueSnapshot_();

  if (!queueSnapshot.success) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không đọc được queue snapshot: ' +
      queueSnapshot.message
    );
  }

  var uiMarkerCheck =
    kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_4e5bInspectUiMarkers_'
    );

  if (!uiMarkerCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      'UI marker 4E-5B chưa pass: ' +
      uiMarkerCheck.message
    );
  }

  var componentSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4e6BuildComponentSummary_(
      componentChecks
    );

  var assetSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4e6BuildAssetSummary_(
      assetStatus,
      verifyDrive,

    );

  return {

      reviewSummary,

      queueSnapshot,
    uiMarkerCheck: {

        uiMarkerCheck.success === true,

        uiMarkerCheck.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        uiMarkerCheck.warningCount || 0
    },
    readyForLock:
      errors.length === 0,
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,

    errorCount:

    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4e6UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4e6CheckPhase4D_() {
  var primary =
    kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4DClosedLockedV3'
    );

  if (primary.success) {
    return {
      success: true,
      method:
        'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4DClosedLockedV3',
      message:
        'OK'
    };
  }

  var fallback =
    kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4DClosedV3'
    );

  if (fallback.success) {
    return {
      success: true,
      method:
        'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4DClosedV3',
      message:
        'OK'
    };
  }

  return {
    success: false,
    method:
      '4D assertions',
    message:
      primary.message + ' | ' + fallback.message
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4e6InspectQueueSnapshot_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getParentReviewQueueContext4E5AV3 !== 'function'
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Thiếu function kidlearnV3_getParentReviewQueueContext4E5AV3'
      };
    }

    var context =
      kidlearnV3_getParentReviewQueueContext4E5AV3({
        limit: 100
      });

    var queue =
      context.reviewQueue || {};

    return {
      success:
        context.success === true,
      phase:
        '4E-6',
      sourcePhase:
        context.phase || '4E-5A',
      itemCount:
        queue.itemCount || 0,
      pendingCount:
        queue.pendingCount || 0,
      statsByStatus:
        queue.statsByStatus || {},
      note:
        'pendingCount có thể bằng 0 sau khi 4E-5C đã ACCEPT/RETRY. Đây là trạng thái hợp lệ.',
      message:
        context.success === true ? 'OK' : JSON.stringify(context)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      phase:
        '4E-6',
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4e6BuildComponentSummary_(componentChecks) {
  var summary = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < componentChecks.length; i++) {
    summary.push({
      key:
        componentChecks[i].key,
      label:
        componentChecks[i].label,
      required:
        componentChecks[i].required === true,
      success:
        componentChecks[i].check.success === true,
      phase:
        componentChecks[i].check.phase || '',
      status:
        componentChecks[i].check.status || '',
      nextBundle:
        componentChecks[i].check.nextBundle || '',
      message:
        componentChecks[i].check.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : componentChecks[i].check.message
    });
  }

  return summary;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e6BuildAssetSummary_(
  assetStatus,
  verifyDrive,
  linkStatus,
  verifyLink
) {
  var assetLast =
    assetStatus.outputSummary && assetStatus.outputSummary.lastAsset
      ? assetStatus.outputSummary.lastAsset
      : {};

  var linkLast =
    linkStatus.outputSummary && linkStatus.outputSummary.lastLink
      ? linkStatus.outputSummary.lastLink
      : {};

  return {
    driveStatusReadable:
      assetStatus.success === true,
    driveVerifyPassed:
      verifyDrive.success === true,
    linkStatusReadable:
      linkStatus.success === true,
    linkVerifyPassed:
      verifyLink.success === true,
    fileId:
      assetLast.fileId || linkLast.fileId || '',
    fileUrl:
      assetLast.fileUrl || linkLast.fileUrl || '',
    responseId:
      assetLast.responseId || linkLast.responseId || '',
    driveWritePerformed:
      assetLast.actualDriveWritePerformed === true,
    dataResponsesLinked:
      linkLast.dataResponsesWritePerformed === true
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4e6BuildReviewSummary_(
  reviewStatus,
  verifyReview
) {
  var last =
    reviewStatus.outputSummary && reviewStatus.outputSummary.lastReviewAction
      ? reviewStatus.outputSummary.lastReviewAction
      : {};

  return {
    reviewStatusReadable:
      reviewStatus.success === true,
    reviewVerifyPassed:
      verifyReview.success === true,
    responseId:
      last.responseId || reviewStatus.responseId || '',
    reviewAction:
      last.reviewAction || reviewStatus.reviewAction || '',
    targetReviewStatus:
      last.targetReviewStatus || reviewStatus.targetReviewStatus || '',
    dataResponsesWritePerformed:
      last.dataResponsesWritePerformed === true,
    logAuditWritePerformed:
      last.logAuditWritePerformed === true
  };
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e6CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      errors
  };
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e6SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        outputSummary: null
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    var summary =
      kidlearnV3_4e6SummarizeOutput_(
        output
      );

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      nextBundle:
        output && output.nextBundle ? output.nextBundle : '',
      responseId:
        output && output.responseId ? output.responseId : '',
      reviewAction:
        output && output.reviewAction ? output.reviewAction : '',
      targetReviewStatus:
        output && output.targetReviewStatus ? output.targetReviewStatus : '',
      errorCount:
        output && output.errorCount ? output.errorCount : 0,
      warningCount:
        output && output.warningCount ? output.warningCount : 0,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4e6PreviewValue_(
              JSON.stringify(summary)
            ),
      outputSummary:
        summary
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      outputSummary:
        null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4e6SummarizeOutput_(output) {
  output = output || {};

  var summary = {
    success:
      output.success === true,
    action:
      output.action || '',
    phase:
      output.phase || '',
    status:
      output.status || '',
    nextBundle:
      output.nextBundle || '',
    nextStage:
      output.nextStage || '',
    responseId:
      output.responseId || '',
    reviewAction:
      output.reviewAction || '',
    targetReviewStatus:
      output.targetReviewStatus || '',
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      output.actualSheetWritePerformed === true,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      output.actualDriveWritePerformed === true,
    errorCount:
      output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount:
      output.warningCount || 0,
    errors:
      output.errors || [],
    warnings:
      output.warnings || []
  };

  if (output.lastAsset) {
    summary.lastAsset = {
      responseId:
        output.lastAsset.responseId || '',
      fileId:
        output.lastAsset.fileId || '',
      fileUrl:
        output.lastAsset.fileUrl || '',
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        output.lastAsset.actualDriveWritePerformed === true
    };
  }

  if (output.lastLink) {
    summary.lastLink = {
      responseId:
        output.lastLink.responseId || '',
      fileId:
        output.lastLink.fileId || '',
      fileUrl:
        output.lastLink.fileUrl || '',
      reviewStatus:
        output.lastLink.reviewStatus || '',
      dataResponsesWritePerformed:
        output.lastLink.dataResponsesWritePerformed === true
    };
  }

  if (output.lastReviewAction) {
    summary.lastReviewAction = {
      responseId:
        output.lastReviewAction.responseId || '',
      reviewAction:
        output.lastReviewAction.reviewAction || '',
      targetReviewStatus:
        output.lastReviewAction.targetReviewStatus || '',
      dataResponsesWritePerformed:
        output.lastReviewAction.dataResponsesWritePerformed === true,
      logAuditWritePerformed:
        output.lastReviewAction.logAuditWritePerformed === true
    };
  }

  if (output.lock) {
    summary.lock = {
      locked:
        output.lock.locked === true,
      status:
        output.lock.status || '',
      lockedAt:
        output.lock.lockedAt || ''
    };
  }

  return summary;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e6PreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 400) {
    return text.substring(0, 400) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e6UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e6SaveLock_(result) {
  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_KEYS.LOCK_JSON,
      JSON.stringify(result)
    );
}


function kidlearnV3_4e6SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success:
        result.success,
      action:
        result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
      lockStep:
        result.lockStep ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
      phaseName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
      status:
        status,
      locked:
        result.locked === true,
      readyForLock:
        result.readyForLock === true,
      finalQaPassed:
        result.finalQaPassed === true,
      nextPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4E_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed:
        false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4e6ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {

  } catch (error) {

      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * 4E-6P1
 * Verify current response link state after parent review.
 *
 * This replaces strict 4E-4 verify during final 4E lock.
 * Valid current statuses:
 * - NEEDS_REVIEW
 * - REVIEWED_ACCEPTED
 * - REVIEWED_RETRY
 */
function kidlearnV3_4e6VerifyHandwritingLinkCurrentState_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var status = null;

  try {
    status =
      kidlearnV3_getHandwritingAssetLink4E4StatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: 'kidlearnV3_4e6VerifyHandwritingLinkCurrentState_',
      phase: '4E-6',
      status: 'FAILED',
      message:
        'Không đọc được 4E-4 link status: ' +
        String(error.message || error),
      errors: [
        String(error.message || error)
      ],
      outputSummary: null
    };
  }

  var lastLink =
    status && status.lastLink
      ? status.lastLink
      : null;

  if (!lastLink) {
    errors.push(
      'Không tìm thấy lastLink từ 4E-4.'
    );
  }

  if (lastLink && !lastLink.responseId) {
    errors.push(
      'lastLink thiếu responseId.'
    );
  }

  if (lastLink && !lastLink.fileId) {
    errors.push(
      'lastLink thiếu fileId.'
    );
  }

  if (
    lastLink &&
    (!lastLink.responseRowNumber || !lastLink.metadataColumnIndex)
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'lastLink thiếu responseRowNumber hoặc metadataColumnIndex.'
    );
  }

  var currentReviewStatus = '';
  var currentFileId = '';
  var actualMetaText = '';

  if (errors.length === 0) {
    try {
      var spreadsheet =
        kidlearnV3_4e6OpenSpreadsheetForCurrentState_();

      var responseSheet =
        kidlearnV3_4e6GetSheetByExactNameForCurrentState_(
          spreadsheet,
          'DATA_Responses'
        );

      if (!responseSheet) {
        errors.push('Không tìm thấy DATA_Responses.');
      } else {
        actualMetaText =
          String(
            responseSheet
              .getRange(
                Number(lastLink.responseRowNumber),
                Number(lastLink.metadataColumnIndex)
              )
              .getValue() || ''
          );

        var parsed =
          kidlearnV3_4e6SafeJsonParseForCurrentState_(
            actualMetaText
          );

        if (!parsed.success) {
          errors.push(
            'answerMetaJson hiện tại không phải JSON hợp lệ.'
          );
        } else {
          var meta =
            parsed.value || {};

          var asset =
            meta.handwritingAsset || {};

          var review =
            meta.handwritingReview || {};

          currentFileId =
            String(asset.fileId || '').trim();

          currentReviewStatus =
            String(
              review.status ||
              asset.reviewStatus ||
              ''
            ).trim().toUpperCase();

          if (currentFileId !== String(lastLink.fileId || '').trim()) {
            errors.push(
              'fileId hiện tại không khớp với 4E-4 link. Expected=' +
              lastLink.fileId +
              ', Actual=' +
              currentFileId
            );
          }

          var validStatuses = {
            NEEDS_REVIEW: true,
            REVIEWED_ACCEPTED: true,
            REVIEWED_RETRY: true
          };

          if (!validStatuses[currentReviewStatus]) {
            errors.push(
              'reviewStatus hiện tại không hợp lệ cho final lock. Current=' +
              currentReviewStatus
            );
          }

          if (
            currentReviewStatus === 'REVIEWED_ACCEPTED' ||
            currentReviewStatus === 'REVIEWED_RETRY'
          ) {
            warnings.push(
              'reviewStatus đã được cập nhật sau 4E-5C: ' +
              currentReviewStatus +
              '. Đây là trạng thái hợp lệ.'
            );
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (error2) {
      errors.push(
        'Không verify được current DATA_Responses link state: ' +
        String(error2.message || error2)
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    functionName: 'kidlearnV3_4e6VerifyHandwritingLinkCurrentState_',
    action: 'VERIFY_HANDWRITING_LINK_CURRENT_STATE_4E_6P1_V3',
    phase: '4E-6',
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? 'LINK_CURRENT_STATE_OK'
        : 'FAILED',
    responseId:
      lastLink ? lastLink.responseId : '',
    fileId:
      lastLink ? lastLink.fileId : '',
    currentFileId:
      currentFileId,
    currentReviewStatus:
      currentReviewStatus,
    message:
      errors.length === 0 ? 'OK' : errors.join(' | '),
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      warnings.length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      warnings,
    outputSummary: {
      lastLink: lastLink || {},
      currentReviewStatus: currentReviewStatus,
      currentFileId: currentFileId
    }
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4e6OpenSpreadsheetForCurrentState_() {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4e5cOpenSpreadsheet_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4e5cOpenSpreadsheet_();
  }

  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) return active;

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DEV spreadsheet.');
}


function kidlearnV3_4e6GetSheetByExactNameForCurrentState_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4e6SafeJsonParseForCurrentState_(text) {
  text =
    String(text || '').trim();

  if (!text) {
    return {
      success: true,
      value: {},
      raw: ''
    };
  }

  try {
    return {
      success: true,
      value: JSON.parse(text),
      raw: text
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      value: {},
      raw: text,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}

/**
 * 4E-6P2
 * Public assert wrapper for current 4E-4 link state.
 *
 * Reason:
 * - 4E-4 originally links handwriting asset with NEEDS_REVIEW.
 * - After 4E-5C, status can correctly become REVIEWED_ACCEPTED or REVIEWED_RETRY.
 * - Final 4E lock must validate current state, not old NEEDS_REVIEW-only state.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertHandwritingAssetLinkCurrentState4E6P2V3() {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4e6VerifyHandwritingLinkCurrentState_ !== 'function'
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu helper kidlearnV3_4e6VerifyHandwritingLinkCurrentState_. Vui lòng dán patch 4E-6P1 trước.'
    );
  }

  var check =
    kidlearnV3_4e6VerifyHandwritingLinkCurrentState_();

  var result = {
    success:
      check.success === true,
    action:
      'ASSERT_HANDWRITING_ASSET_LINK_CURRENT_STATE_4E_6P2_V3',
    phase:
      '4E-4',
    status:
      check.success === true
        ? 'READY_FOR_4E_LOCK_CURRENT_STATE'
        : 'FAILED',
    responseId:
      check.responseId || '',
    fileId:
      check.fileId || '',
    currentReviewStatus:
      check.currentReviewStatus || '',
    validCurrentStatuses: [
      'NEEDS_REVIEW',
      'REVIEWED_ACCEPTED',
      'REVIEWED_RETRY'
    ],
    nextBundle:
      '4E-6',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      check.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount:
      check.warningCount || 0,
    errors:
      check.errors || [],
    warnings:
      check.warnings || []
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4E-4 current state chưa hợp lệ cho 4E lock: ' +
      result.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - PHASE 4F QA + LOCK
 * Step: 4F-5
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * Purpose:
 * - Final QA for Phase 4F.
 * - Confirm Parent Review Action UI + Child Retry Flow are ready.
 * - Lock Phase 4F.
 *
 * Safety:
 * - Không ghi DATA_Responses.
 * - Không ghi LOG_Audit.
 * - Không ghi Google Drive.
 * - Không tạo DATA_Assignments.
 * - Không reset DATA_LessonProgress.
 * - Chỉ ghi ScriptProperties trạng thái lock.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4F_LOCK_STATUS',
  LAST_PREVIEW_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4F_LOCK_LAST_PREVIEW_AT',
  LAST_QA_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4F_LOCK_LAST_QA_AT',
  LOCKED_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4F_LOCKED_AT',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4F_LOCK_LAST_RESULT_JSON',
  LOCK_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4F_LOCK_JSON'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_STATUS = {

  PREVIEWED: 'PREVIEWED',
  QA_PASSED: 'QA_PASSED',
  PHASE_4F_CLOSED_LOCKED: 'PHASE_4F_CLOSED_LOCKED',
  FAILED: 'FAILED'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG = {
  PHASE: '4F',
  LOCK_STEP: '4F-5',
  PHASE_NAME: 'PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_UI_AND_RETRY_FLOW',
  NEXT_PHASE: '4G',
  NEXT_STAGE: 'NEXT_PRODUCT_INCREMENT_TO_BE_CONFIRMED',
  CONFIRM_TEXT: 'LOCK_PHASE_4F_PARENT_REVIEW_ACTION_UI_RETRY_FLOW',
  MIN_VISUAL_SCORE: 85,
  EXPECTED_GATE_MODE: 'CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY',
  PROD_WRITE_ALLOWED: false,
  REAL_SHEET_WRITE_ALLOWED_NOW: false,
  REAL_DRIVE_WRITE_ALLOWED_NOW: false
};

    );
