/**
 * Confirm wrapper.
 * Chạy function này để lock Phase 4F.
 */
function kidlearnV3_lockPhase4FConfirmV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_lockPhase4FV3({
    confirm:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT,
    visualScore: 90,
    visualNote:
      'Parent Review Action UI and Child Retry Flow were checked in DEV.'
  });
}


/**
 * Lock Phase 4F.
 */
function kidlearnV3_lockPhase4FV3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var confirmText =
    String(options.confirm || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    confirmText !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm. Cần confirm=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
    );
  }

  var visualScore =
    Number(options.visualScore || 0);

  if (
    isNaN(visualScore) ||
    visualScore < KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.MIN_VISUAL_SCORE
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'visualScore chưa đạt. Cần >= ' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.MIN_VISUAL_SCORE
    );
  }

  var lock =
    LockService.getScriptLock();

  var locked =
    lock.tryLock(30000);

  if (!locked) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không lấy được script lock sau 30 giây. Vui lòng chạy lại.'
    );
  }

  try {
    var qa =
      kidlearnV3_runPhase4FFinalQaV3();

    if (!qa.success) {
      throw new Error(
        'Final QA 4F chưa pass. Không thể lock.'
      );
    }

    var result = {
      success: true,
      action: 'LOCK_PHASE_4F_4F_5_V3',
      phase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
      lockStep:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
      phaseName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
      status:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4F_CLOSED_LOCKED,
      locked: true,
      finalQaPassed: true,
      componentSummary:
        qa.componentSummary,
      gateSummary:
        qa.gateSummary,
      retryContextSummary:
        qa.retryContextSummary,
      routeSummary:
        qa.routeSummary,
      uiMarkerSummary:
        qa.uiMarkerSummary,
      visualScore:
        visualScore,
      visualNote:
        String(options.visualNote || ''),
      minVisualScore:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.MIN_VISUAL_SCORE,
      nextPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
      realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
      lockedAt:
        new Date().toISOString()
    };

    kidlearnV3_4f5SaveLock_(result);

    kidlearnV3_4f5SaveStatus_(
      result,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4F_CLOSED_LOCKED,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_KEYS.LOCKED_AT
    );

    console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
    return result;

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}


/**
 * Get Phase 4F lock status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getPhase4FLockStatusV3() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'GET_PHASE_4F_LOCK_STATUS_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
    lockStep:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
    phaseName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
    status:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_KEYS.STATUS
      ) ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_STATUS.NOT_RUN,
    lastPreviewAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
      ) || '',
    lastQaAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_QA_AT
      ) || '',
    lockedAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_KEYS.LOCKED_AT
      ) || '',
    lastResult:
      kidlearnV3_4f5ReadJsonProperty_(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON
      ),
    lock:
      kidlearnV3_4f5ReadJsonProperty_(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_KEYS.LOCK_JSON
      ),
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert Phase 4F closed locked.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertPhase4FClosedLockedV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getPhase4FLockStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4F_CLOSED_LOCKED
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4F chưa PHASE_4F_CLOSED_LOCKED. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (!status.lock || status.lock.locked !== true) {
    errors.push(
      'Không tìm thấy lock evidence cho Phase 4F.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'ASSERT_PHASE_4F_CLOSED_LOCKED_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
    lockStep:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
    status:
      status.status,
    lockedAt:
      status.lockedAt,
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    errors:
      errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(errors.join(' | '));
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Alias for next phases.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertPhase4FClosedV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_assertPhase4FClosedLockedV3();
}


/**
 * QA batch 4F-5.
 * Lưu ý: function này sẽ lock Phase 4F.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaBatch4F5V3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewPhase4FLockV3();

  var qa =
    kidlearnV3_runPhase4FFinalQaV3();

  var lock =
    kidlearnV3_lockPhase4FConfirmV3();

  var assertLocked =
    kidlearnV3_assertPhase4FClosedLockedV3();

  var result = {
    success:
      preview.success === true &&
      qa.success === true &&
      lock.success === true &&
      assertLocked.success === true,
    suiteName:
      'PHASE_4F_5_QA_AND_LOCK',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
    lockStep:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4F_CLOSED_LOCKED,
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow: false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed: false,
    results: {
      preview:
        preview.success,
      finalQa:
        qa.success,
      lock:
        lock.success,
      assertLocked:
        assertLocked.success
    }
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error('4F-5 QA batch failed.');
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Build final QA for Phase 4F.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f5BuildFinalQa_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4f5CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var phase4E =
    kidlearnV3_4f5SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4EClosedLockedV3'
    );

  if (!phase4E.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4E chưa closed locked: ' +
      phase4E.message
    );
  }

  var gateSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4f5InspectGate_();

  if (!gateSummary.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không kiểm tra được 4F-3 gate: ' +
      gateSummary.message
    );
  } else if (!gateSummary.gateClosed) {
    errors.push(
      '4F-3 gate đang mở. Vui lòng đóng gate trước khi lock 4F. Current=' +
      gateSummary.gateMode
    );
  }

  var componentChecks = [
    {
      key: '4F-1',
      label: 'Parent Review Action UI Contract + Safety Gate',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4f5SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertParentReviewActionUiContract4F1ReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4F-2',
      label: 'Accept / Retry Buttons UI Dry-run',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4f5SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertParentReviewActionButtonsUi4F2ReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4F-3',
      label: 'Controlled UI Write Gate',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4f5SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertParentReviewUiWriteGate4F3ReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4F-4A',
      label: 'Child Retry Context Read-only',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4f5SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertChildRetryContext4F4AReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4F-4B',
      label: 'Child Home Retry Card UI Read-only',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4f5SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertChildRetryCardUi4F4BReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4F-4C',
      label: 'Retry Lesson Routing',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4f5SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertChildRetryLessonRouting4F4CReadyV3'
        )
    },
    {
      key: '4F-4D',
      label: 'Child Retry QA Ready for 4F-5',
      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4f5SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertChildRetryQaReady4F4DReadyV3'
        )
    }
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < componentChecks.length; i++) {
    if (
      componentChecks[i].required &&
      componentChecks[i].check.success !== true
    ) {
      errors.push(
        componentChecks[i].key +
        ' chưa ready: ' +
        componentChecks[i].check.message
      );
    }
  }

  var retryContextSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4f5InspectRetryContext_();

  if (!retryContextSummary.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được retry context: ' +
      retryContextSummary.message
    );
  }

  if (
    retryContextSummary.success &&
    retryContextSummary.retryCount === 0
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'retryCount = 0. Đây là hợp lệ nếu chưa có bài REVIEWED_RETRY để test UI thực tế.'
    );
  }

  var routeSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4f5InspectRouteIfAvailable_(
      retryContextSummary
    );

  if (
    retryContextSummary.success &&
    retryContextSummary.retryCount > 0 &&
    routeSummary.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Có retry item nhưng route không pass: ' +
      routeSummary.message
    );
  }

  if (
    retryContextSummary.success &&
    retryContextSummary.retryCount === 0
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không test route thực tế vì retryCount = 0. Đây là hợp lệ.'
    );
  }

  var uiMarkerSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4f5InspectUiMarkers_();

  if (!uiMarkerSummary.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(uiMarkerSummary.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(uiMarkerSummary.warnings || []);

  var componentSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4f5BuildComponentSummary_(
      componentChecks
    );

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_PHASE_4F_FINAL_QA_4F_5_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
    lockStep:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
    phaseName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
    devSafety:
      dev,
    phase4E:
      phase4E,
    gateSummary:
      gateSummary,
    componentSummary:
      componentSummary,
    retryContextSummary:
      retryContextSummary,
    routeSummary:
      routeSummary,
    uiMarkerSummary:
      uiMarkerSummary,
    readyForLock:
      errors.length === 0,
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4f5UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4f5UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Gate inspection.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f5InspectGate_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getParentReviewUiWriteGate4F3StatusV3 !== 'function'
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        gateMode: '',
        gateClosed: false,
        message:
          'Thiếu kidlearnV3_getParentReviewUiWriteGate4F3StatusV3'
      };
    }

    var gate =
      kidlearnV3_getParentReviewUiWriteGate4F3StatusV3();

    var gateMode =
      String(gate.gateMode || '').trim();

    return {
      success:
        gate.success === true,
      gateMode:
        gateMode,
      expectedGateMode:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.EXPECTED_GATE_MODE,
      gateClosed:
        gateMode === KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.EXPECTED_GATE_MODE,
      writeAllowedNow:
        gate.writeAllowedNow === true,
      message:
        gate.success === true ? 'OK' : JSON.stringify(gate)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      gateMode: '',
      gateClosed: false,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Retry context inspection.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f5InspectRetryContext_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getChildRetryContext4F4AV3 !== 'function'
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        retryCount: 0,
        message:
          'Thiếu kidlearnV3_getChildRetryContext4F4AV3'
      };
    }

    var context =
      kidlearnV3_getChildRetryContext4F4AV3({
        childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
        limit: 100
      });

    var retryQueue =
      context.retryQueue || {};

    var items =
      retryQueue.items || [];

    return {
      success:
        context.success === true,
      retryCount:
        Number(retryQueue.retryCount || items.length || 0),
      itemCount:
        Number(retryQueue.itemCount || items.length || 0),
      targetReviewStatus:
        context.targetReviewStatus || '',
      firstItem:
        items.length > 0
          ? {
              responseId:
                items[0].responseId || '',
              lessonId:
                items[0].lessonId || '',
              subjectCode:
                items[0].subjectCode || '',
              reviewStatus:
                items[0].reviewStatus || ''
            }
          : null,
      emptyStateValid:
        items.length === 0,
      message:
        context.success === true ? 'OK' : JSON.stringify(context)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      retryCount: 0,
      itemCount: 0,
      firstItem: null,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Test route only if retry item exists.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f5InspectRouteIfAvailable_(retryContextSummary) {
  retryContextSummary =
    retryContextSummary || {};

  if (
    !retryContextSummary.firstItem ||
    retryContextSummary.retryCount <= 0
  ) {
    return {
      success: false,
      skipped:
        true,
      reason:
        'NO_RETRY_ITEM',
      message:
        'retryCount = 0, bỏ qua route test thực tế.'
    };
  }

  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getRetryLessonRoute4F4CV3 !== 'function'
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        skipped:
          false,
        message:
          'Thiếu kidlearnV3_getRetryLessonRoute4F4CV3'
      };
    }

    var item =
      retryContextSummary.firstItem;

    var routeResult =
      kidlearnV3_getRetryLessonRoute4F4CV3({
        childId:
          'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
        responseId:
          item.responseId,
        lessonId:
          item.lessonId
      });

    var route =
      routeResult.route || {};

    return {
      success:
        routeResult.success === true &&
        !!route.lessonId,
      skipped:
        false,
      responseId:
        route.responseId || item.responseId || '',
      lessonId:
        route.lessonId || item.lessonId || '',
      subjectCode:
        route.subjectCode || item.subjectCode || '',
      openMode:
        route.openMode || '',
      writesNow:
        route.writesNow === true,
      createsAssignmentNow:
        route.createsAssignmentNow === true,
      resetsLessonProgressNow:
        route.resetsLessonProgressNow === true,
      message:
        routeResult.success === true ? 'OK' : JSON.stringify(routeResult)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      skipped:
        false,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * UI marker inspection.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f5InspectUiMarkers_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var shell = '';
  var styles = '';
  var client4f2 = '';
  var client4f3 = '';
  var client4f4b = '';
  var client4f4c = '';

  try {
    shell =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Shell_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Shell_4A: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  try {
    styles =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Styles_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error2) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Styles_4A: ' +
      String(error2.message || error2)
    );
  }

  try {
    client4f2 =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Client_ParentReviewActions_4F2')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error3) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_ParentReviewActions_4F2: ' +
      String(error3.message || error3)
    );
  }

  try {
    client4f3 =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Client_ParentReviewActions_Write_4F3')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error4) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_ParentReviewActions_Write_4F3: ' +
      String(error4.message || error4)
    );
  }

  try {
    client4f4b =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Client_ChildRetryHome_4F4B')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error5) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_ChildRetryHome_4F4B: ' +
      String(error5.message || error5)
    );
  }

  try {
    client4f4c =
      HtmlService

function kidlearnV3_4f5CheckMarkers_(content, markers, label, errors) {
  content =
    String(content || '');

  for (var i = 0; i < markers.length; i++) {
    if (content.indexOf(markers[i]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        label + ' thiếu marker: ' + markers[i]
      );
    }
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4f5BuildComponentSummary_(componentChecks) {
  var summary = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < componentChecks.length; i++) {
    summary.push({
      key:
        componentChecks[i].key,
      label:
        componentChecks[i].label,
      required:
        componentChecks[i].required === true,
      success:
        componentChecks[i].check.success === true,
      phase:
        componentChecks[i].check.phase || '',
      status:
        componentChecks[i].check.status || '',
      nextBundle:
        componentChecks[i].check.nextBundle || '',
      message:
        componentChecks[i].check.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : componentChecks[i].check.message
    });
  }

  return summary;
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f5CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      errors
  };
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4f5SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName:
          functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      nextPhase:
        output && output.nextPhase ? output.nextPhase : '',
      nextBundle:
        output && output.nextBundle ? output.nextBundle : '',
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4f5PreviewValue_(JSON.stringify(output || {})),
      outputSummary:
        kidlearnV3_4f5SummarizeOutput_(output)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      outputSummary:
        null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4f5SummarizeOutput_(output) {
  output = output || {};

  return {
    success:
      output.success === true,
    action:
      output.action || '',
    phase:
      output.phase || '',
    status:
      output.status || '',
    nextPhase:
      output.nextPhase || '',
    nextBundle:
      output.nextBundle || '',
    errorCount:
      output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount:
      output.warningCount || 0
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4f5PreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 350) {
    return text.substring(0, 350) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4f5UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4f5SaveLock_(result) {
  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_KEYS.LOCK_JSON,
      JSON.stringify(result)
    );
}


function kidlearnV3_4f5SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success:
        result.success,
      action:
        result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
      lockStep:
        result.lockStep ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
      phaseName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
      status:
        status,
      locked:
        result.locked === true,
      readyForLock:
        result.readyForLock === true,
      finalQaPassed:
        result.finalQaPassed === true,
      gateMode:
        result.gateSummary
          ? result.gateSummary.gateMode
          : '',
      retryCount:
        result.retryContextSummary
          ? result.retryContextSummary.retryCount
          : 0,
      nextPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4F_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed:
        false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4f5ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

};

 */
function kidlearnV3_lockPhase4GConfirmV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_lockPhase4GV3({
    confirm:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT,
    visualScore:
      90,
    visualNote:
      'Parent Dashboard, Subject Detail, and Recent Activity Timeline were checked in DEV.'
  });
}


/**
 * Lock Phase 4G.
 */
function kidlearnV3_lockPhase4GV3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var confirmText =
    String(options.confirm || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    confirmText !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm. Cần confirm=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
    );
  }

  var visualScore =
    Number(options.visualScore || 0);

  if (
    isNaN(visualScore) ||
    visualScore < KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.MIN_VISUAL_SCORE
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'visualScore chưa đạt. Cần >= ' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.MIN_VISUAL_SCORE
    );
  }

  var lock =
    LockService.getScriptLock();

  var locked =
    lock.tryLock(30000);

  if (!locked) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không lấy được script lock sau 30 giây. Vui lòng chạy lại.'
    );
  }

  try {
    var qa =
      kidlearnV3_runPhase4GFinalQaV3();

    if (!qa.success) {
      throw new Error(
        'Final QA 4G chưa pass. Không thể lock.'
      );
    }

    var result = {
      success: true,
      action: 'LOCK_PHASE_4G_4G_5_V3',
      phase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
      lockStep:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
      phaseName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
      status:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4G_CLOSED_LOCKED,
      locked:
        true,
      finalQaPassed:
        true,
      componentSummary:
        qa.componentSummary,
      dashboardSummary:
        qa.dashboardSummary,
      timelineSummary:
        qa.timelineSummary,
      uiMarkerSummary:
        qa.uiMarkerSummary,
      visualScore:
        visualScore,
      visualNote:
        String(options.visualNote || ''),
      minVisualScore:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.MIN_VISUAL_SCORE,
      nextPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed:
        false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      lockedAt:
        new Date().toISOString()
    };

    kidlearnV3_4g5SaveLock_(result);

    kidlearnV3_4g5SaveStatus_(
      result,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4G_CLOSED_LOCKED,
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_KEYS.LOCKED_AT
    );

    console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
    return result;

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

/**

function kidlearnV3_4g5BuildFinalQa_() {

      required: true,
      check:
        kidlearnV3_4g5SafeCall_(
          'kidlearnV3_assertParentActivityTimeline4G4ReadyV3'
        )
    }
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < componentChecks.length; i++) {
    if (
      componentChecks[i].required &&
      componentChecks[i].check.success !== true
    ) {
      errors.push(
        componentChecks[i].key +
        ' chưa ready: ' +
        componentChecks[i].check.message
      );
    }
  }

  var dashboardSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4g5InspectDashboardContext_();

  if (!dashboardSummary.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được dashboard context: ' +
      dashboardSummary.message
    );
  }

  if (
    dashboardSummary.success &&
    dashboardSummary.recentActivityCount === 0
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'recentActivityCount = 0. Đây là hợp lệ nếu DEV chưa có hoạt động học.'
    );
  }

  var timelineSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4g5InspectTimelineContext_();

  if (!timelineSummary.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được activity timeline: ' +
      timelineSummary.message
    );
  }

  if (
    timelineSummary.success &&
    timelineSummary.itemCount === 0
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'Timeline itemCount = 0. Đây là hợp lệ nếu DEV chưa có hoạt động học.'
    );
  }

  var subjectDetailSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4g5InspectSubjectDetailIfAvailable_(
      dashboardSummary
    );

  if (
    dashboardSummary.success &&
    dashboardSummary.subjectCount > 0 &&
    subjectDetailSummary.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Có subject data nhưng subject detail không pass: ' +
      subjectDetailSummary.message
    );
  }

  if (
    dashboardSummary.success &&
    dashboardSummary.subjectCount === 0
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'subjectCount = 0. Đây là hợp lệ nếu DEV chưa có dữ liệu môn học.'
    );
  }

  var uiMarkerSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4g5InspectUiMarkers_();

  if (!uiMarkerSummary.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(uiMarkerSummary.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(uiMarkerSummary.warnings || []);

  var componentSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4g5BuildComponentSummary_(
      componentChecks
    );

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_PHASE_4G_FINAL_QA_4G_5_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
    lockStep:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
    phaseName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
    devSafety:
      dev,
    phase4F:
      phase4F,
    componentSummary:
      componentSummary,
    dashboardSummary:
      dashboardSummary,
    subjectDetailSummary:
      subjectDetailSummary,
    timelineSummary:
      timelineSummary,
    uiMarkerSummary:
      uiMarkerSummary,
    readyForLock:
      errors.length === 0,
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4g5UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4g5UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Inspect Parent Dashboard Context.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g5InspectDashboardContext_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getParentDashboardContext4G1V3 !== 'function'
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Thiếu kidlearnV3_getParentDashboardContext4G1V3'
      };
    }

    var context =
      kidlearnV3_getParentDashboardContext4G1V3({
        parentId: 'PARENT',
        childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
        recentLimit: 60
      });

    var dashboard =
      context.parentDashboard || {};

    var summary =
      dashboard.dashboardSummary ||
      context.dashboardSummary ||
      {};

    var progress =
      dashboard.progressBySubject || {};

    var subjects =
      progress.items || [];

    return {
      success:
        context.success === true,
      childId:
        dashboard.child && dashboard.child.childId
          ? dashboard.child.childId
          : '',
      todaySessionCount:
        Number(summary.todaySessionCount || 0),
      todayDurationMinutes:
        Number(summary.todayDurationMinutes || 0),
      completedLessonCount:
        Number(summary.completedLessonCount || 0),
      subjectCount:
        Number(summary.subjectCount || subjects.length || 0),
      pendingReviewCount:
        Number(summary.pendingReviewCount || 0),
      retryCount:
        Number(summary.retryCount || 0),
      recentActivityCount:
        Number(summary.recentActivityCount || 0),
      firstSubjectCode:
        subjects.length > 0
          ? String(subjects[0].subjectCode || '')
          : '',
      message:
        context.success === true ? 'OK' : JSON.stringify(context)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Inspect Timeline Context.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g5InspectTimelineContext_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getParentActivityTimeline4G4V3 !== 'function'
    ) {
      return {

      };
    }

    var timeline =

        parentId: 'PARENT',
        childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',

      });

    return {

      itemCount:
        Number(summary.itemCount || 0),
      groupCount:
        Number(summary.groupCount || 0),
      typeCount:
        Number(summary.typeCount || 0),
      latestAt:
        summary.latestAt || '',
      message:
        timeline.success === true ? 'OK' : JSON.stringify(timeline)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Inspect Subject Detail only if subject exists.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g5InspectSubjectDetailIfAvailable_(dashboardSummary) {
  dashboardSummary =
    dashboardSummary || {};

  if (
    !dashboardSummary.firstSubjectCode ||
    dashboardSummary.subjectCount <= 0
  ) {
    return {
      success: false,
      skipped:
        true,
      reason:
        'NO_SUBJECT_DATA',
      message:
        'Không có subject để test detail thực tế.'
    };
  }

  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getParentSubjectProgressDetail4G3V3 !== 'function'
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        skipped:
          false,
        message:
          'Thiếu kidlearnV3_getParentSubjectProgressDetail4G3V3'
      };
    }

    var detail =
      kidlearnV3_getParentSubjectProgressDetail4G3V3({
        parentId: 'PARENT',
        childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
        subjectCode:
          dashboardSummary.firstSubjectCode
      });

    var subjectDetail =
      detail.subjectDetail || {};

    var subject =
      subjectDetail.subject || {};

    var summary =
      subjectDetail.summary || {};

    return {
      success:
        detail.success === true &&
        !!subject.subjectCode,
      skipped:
        false,
      subjectCode:
        subject.subjectCode || '',
      subjectName:
        subject.subjectName || '',
      completedLessons:
        Number(summary.completedLessons || 0),
      sessionCount:
        Number(summary.sessionCount || 0),
      responseCount:
        Number(summary.responseCount || 0),
      handwritingCount:
        Number(summary.handwritingCount || 0),
      message:
        detail.success === true ? 'OK' : JSON.stringify(detail)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      skipped:
        false,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}

function kidlearnV3_4g5CheckMarkers_(content, markers, label, errors) {
  content =
    String(content || '');

  for (var i = 0; i < markers.length; i++) {
    if (content.indexOf(markers[i]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        label + ' thiếu marker: ' + markers[i]
      );
    }
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4g5BuildComponentSummary_(componentChecks) {
  var summary = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < componentChecks.length; i++) {
    summary.push({
      key:
        componentChecks[i].key,
      label:
        componentChecks[i].label,
      required:
        componentChecks[i].required === true,
      success:
        componentChecks[i].check.success === true,
      phase:
        componentChecks[i].check.phase || '',
      status:
        componentChecks[i].check.status || '',
      nextBundle:
        componentChecks[i].check.nextBundle || '',
      message:
        componentChecks[i].check.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : componentChecks[i].check.message
    });
  }

  return summary;
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g5CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      errors
  };
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4g5SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName:
          functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      nextPhase:
        output && output.nextPhase ? output.nextPhase : '',
      nextBundle:
        output && output.nextBundle ? output.nextBundle : '',
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4g5PreviewValue_(JSON.stringify(output || {})),
      outputSummary:
        kidlearnV3_4g5SummarizeOutput_(output)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      outputSummary:
        null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4g5SummarizeOutput_(output) {
  output = output || {};

  return {
    success:
      output.success === true,
    action:
      output.action || '',
    phase:
      output.phase || '',
    status:
      output.status || '',
    nextPhase:
      output.nextPhase || '',
    nextBundle:
      output.nextBundle || '',
    errorCount:
      output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount:
      output.warningCount || 0
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4g5PreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 350) {
    return text.substring(0, 350) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4g5UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4g5SaveLock_(result) {
  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_KEYS.LOCK_JSON,
      JSON.stringify(result)
    );
}


function kidlearnV3_4g5SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success:
        result.success,
      action:
        result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
      lockStep:
        result.lockStep ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
      phaseName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
      status:
        status,
      locked:
        result.locked === true,
      readyForLock:
        result.readyForLock === true,
      finalQaPassed:
        result.finalQaPassed === true,
      dashboardSummary:
        result.dashboardSummary || {},
      timelineSummary:
        result.timelineSummary || {},
      nextPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4G_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed:
        false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4g5ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

  return kidlearnV3_lockPhase4HV3({
    confirm:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT,
    lockedBy:
      'SYSTEM_ADMIN'
  });
}


/**
 * Lock Phase 4H.
 */
function kidlearnV3_lockPhase4HV3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var confirmText =
    String(options.confirm || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  if (
    confirmText !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm khóa Phase 4H. Cần confirm=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
    );
  }

  var qa =
    kidlearnV3_runPhase4HFinalQaV3();

  if (!qa.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể lock Phase 4H vì final QA chưa pass.'
    );
  }

  var gateMode =
    kidlearnV3_4h4GetLearningPlanGateMode_();

  if (gateMode !== 'CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY') {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể lock Phase 4H vì Learning Plan gate chưa đóng. Current=' +
      gateMode
    );
  }

  var lockedAt =
    new Date().toISOString();

  var lockedBy =
    String(options.lockedBy || 'SYSTEM_ADMIN').trim();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'LOCK_PHASE_4H_CONFIRM_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
    lockStep:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
    phaseName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4H_CLOSED_LOCKED,
    previousPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.PREVIOUS_PHASE,
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    lockedBy:
      lockedBy,
    lockedAt:
      lockedAt,
    qaSummary:
      qa.qaSummary,
    gateMode:
      gateMode,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualLearningDataWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    message:
      'Phase 4H đã được khóa an toàn. Có thể chuyển sang Phase 4I.',
    errorCount:
      0,
    warningCount:
      qa.warningCount || 0,
    errors:
      [],
    warnings:
      qa.warnings || []
  };

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_KEYS.STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4H_CLOSED_LOCKED
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_KEYS.LOCKED_BY,
    lockedBy
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_KEYS.LOCKED_AT,
    lockedAt
  );

  kidlearnV3_4h4SaveStatus_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4H_CLOSED_LOCKED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_LOCK_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


/**
 * Get Phase 4H lock status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getPhase4HLockStatusV3() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'GET_PHASE_4H_LOCK_STATUS_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
    lockStep:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
    phaseName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
    status:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_KEYS.STATUS
      ) ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_STATUS.NOT_RUN,
    lockedBy:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_KEYS.LOCKED_BY
      ) || '',
    lockedAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_KEYS.LOCKED_AT
      ) || '',
    lastPreviewAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
      ) || '',
    lastQaAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_QA_AT
      ) || '',
    lastLockAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_LOCK_AT
      ) || '',
    lastResult:
      kidlearnV3_4h4ReadJsonProperty_(
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON
      ),
    previousPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.PREVIOUS_PHASE,
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    gateMode:
      kidlearnV3_4h4GetLearningPlanGateMode_(),
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert Phase 4H closed and locked.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertPhase4HClosedLockedV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getPhase4HLockStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4H_CLOSED_LOCKED
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4H chưa PHASE_4H_CLOSED_LOCKED. Current=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    status.gateMode !== 'CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Learning Plan gate chưa đóng. Current=' +
      status.gateMode
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'ASSERT_PHASE_4H_CLOSED_LOCKED_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      status.status,
    gateMode:
      status.gateMode,
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    errors:
      errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(errors.join(' | '));
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Alias for future phases.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertPhase4HClosedV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_assertPhase4HClosedLockedV3();
}


/**
 * QA batch 4H-4.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaBatch4H4V3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewPhase4HLockV3();

  var finalQa =
    kidlearnV3_runPhase4HFinalQaV3();

  var lock =
    kidlearnV3_lockPhase4HConfirmV3();

  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getPhase4HLockStatusV3();

  var assertLocked =
    kidlearnV3_assertPhase4HClosedLockedV3();

  var result = {
    success:
      preview.success === true &&
      finalQa.success === true &&
      lock.success === true &&
      status.success === true &&
      assertLocked.success === true,
    suiteName:
      'PHASE_4H_4_QA_AND_LOCK',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
    lockStep:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4H_CLOSED_LOCKED,
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    gateMode:
      kidlearnV3_4h4GetLearningPlanGateMode_(),
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualLearningDataWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    results: {
      preview:
        preview.success,
      finalQa:
        finalQa.success,
      lock:
        lock.success,
      status:
        status.success,
      assertLocked:
        assertLocked.success
    }
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error('4H-4 QA batch failed.');
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * ================================================================
 * Final QA builder
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_4h4BuildFinalQa_(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var mode =
    String(options.mode || 'FINAL_QA').trim();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4h4CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  var phase4G =
    kidlearnV3_4h4SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4GClosedLockedV3'
    );

  if (!phase4G.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4G chưa locked: ' +
      phase4G.message
    );
  }

  var h1 =
    kidlearnV3_4h4SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertLearningPlanPolicyContext4H1ReadyV3'
    );

  if (!h1.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4H-1 chưa READY_FOR_4H_2: ' +
      h1.message
    );
  }

  var h2 =
    kidlearnV3_4h4SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertLearningPlanUi4H2ReadyV3'
    );

  if (!h2.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4H-2 chưa READY_FOR_4H_3: ' +
      h2.message
    );
  }

  var h3 =
    kidlearnV3_4h4SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertLearningPlanWriteChild4H3ReadyV3'
    );

  if (!h3.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4H-3 chưa READY_FOR_4H_4: ' +
      h3.message
    );
  }

  var gateMode =
    kidlearnV3_4h4GetLearningPlanGateMode_();

  if (gateMode !== 'CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY') {
    errors.push(
      'Learning Plan gate phải đóng trước khi lock Phase 4H. Current=' +
      gateMode
    );
  }

  var policy =
    kidlearnV3_4h4SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getLearningPlanPolicy4H1V3'
    );

  if (!policy.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được Learning Plan Policy 4H-1: ' +
      policy.message
    );
  }

  var context =
    kidlearnV3_4h4SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getLearningPlanContext4H1V3',
      [
        {
          parentId:
            KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.DEFAULT_PARENT_ID,
          childId:
            KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID
        }
      ]
    );

  if (!context.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được Learning Plan Context 4H-1: ' +
      context.message
    );
  }

  var childContext =
    kidlearnV3_4h4SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_getChildLearningPlanContext4H3V3',
      [
        {
          childId:
            KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHILD_ID
        }
      ]
    );

  if (!childContext.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được Child Learning Plan Context 4H-3: ' +
      childContext.message
    );
  }

  var headerQa =
    kidlearnV3_4h4RunHeaderQaIfAvailable_();

  if (!headerQa.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(headerQa.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(headerQa.warnings || []);

  var targetQa =
    kidlearnV3_4h4RunTargetMinutesQaIfAvailable_();

  if (!targetQa.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(targetQa.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(targetQa.warnings || []);

  var uiMarkers =
    kidlearnV3_4h4InspectUiMarkers_();

  if (!uiMarkers.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(uiMarkers.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(uiMarkers.warnings || []);

  var visualScore =
    kidlearnV3_4h4EstimateVisualScore_(
      uiMarkers
    );

  if (
    visualScore <
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.MIN_VISUAL_SCORE
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Visual score thấp hơn yêu cầu. Current=' +
      visualScore +
      ', min=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.MIN_VISUAL_SCORE
    );
  }

  var qaSummary = {
    phase4GLocked:
      phase4G.success === true,
    phase4H1Ready:
      h1.success === true,
    phase4H2Ready:
      h2.success === true,
    phase4H3Ready:
      h3.success === true,
    learningPlanGateClosed:
      gateMode === 'CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY',
    policyReadable:
      policy.success === true,
    parentContextReadable:
      context.success === true,
    childContextReadable:
      childContext.success === true,
    headersReady:
      headerQa.success === true,
    targetMinutesQa:
      targetQa,
    uiMarkersReady:
      uiMarkers.success === true,
    visualScore:
      visualScore,
    dryRunUi:
      true,
    controlledWrite:
      true,
    childHomeVisibility:
      true
  };

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'BUILD_PHASE_4H_FINAL_QA_V3',
    mode:
      mode,
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
    lockStep:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
    phaseName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_STATUS.QA_PASSED
        : KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_STATUS.FAILED,
    previousPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.PREVIOUS_PHASE,
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    gateMode:
      gateMode,
    qaSummary:
      qaSummary,
    prerequisites: {
      phase4G:
        phase4G,
      phase4H1:
        h1,
      phase4H2:
        h2,
      phase4H3:
        h3
    },
    contextChecks: {
      policy:
        kidlearnV3_4h4CompactSafeCall_(policy),
      parentContext:
        kidlearnV3_4h4CompactSafeCall_(context),
      childContext:
        kidlearnV3_4h4CompactSafeCall_(childContext)
    },
    headerQa:
      headerQa,
    targetQa:
      targetQa,
    uiMarkers:
      uiMarkers,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualLearningDataWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4h4UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4h4UniqueArray_(warnings),
    checkedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };
}


/**
 * ================================================================
 * QA helpers
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_4h4RunHeaderQaIfAvailable_() {
  var warnings = [];

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_assertLearningPlanHeadersReady4H3P4V3 !== 'function'
  ) {
    return {
      success: true,
      available: false,
      warningCount: 1,
      warnings: [
        'Không tìm thấy kidlearnV3_assertLearningPlanHeadersReady4H3P4V3. Bỏ qua header QA compact.'
      ],
      errors: []
    };
  }

  try {
    var result =
      kidlearnV3_assertLearningPlanHeadersReady4H3P4V3();

    return {
      success:
        result && result.success === true,
      available:
        true,
      DATA_DailyGoals:
        result.DATA_DailyGoals || {},
      DATA_Assignments:
        result.DATA_Assignments || {},
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      warnings:
        warnings,
      errors:
        result && result.success === true
          ? []
          : ['Header QA 4H-3P4 chưa pass.']
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      available: true,
      errors: [
        'Header QA 4H-3P4 failed: ' +
        String(error.message || error)
      ],
      warnings:
        warnings
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4h4RunTargetMinutesQaIfAvailable_() {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_debugTodayDailyGoalTarget4H3P6V3 !== 'function'
  ) {
    return {
      success: true,
      available: false,
      requiredForLock:
        false,
      warnings: [
        'Không tìm thấy kidlearnV3_debugTodayDailyGoalTarget4H3P6V3. Bỏ qua targetMinutes readback QA.'
      ],
      errors: [],
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false
    };
  }

  try {
    var result =
      kidlearnV3_debugTodayDailyGoalTarget4H3P6V3();

    var rowValues =
      result.rowValues || {};

    var target =
      Number(rowValues.targetMinutes || 0);

    if (target <= 0) {
      return {
        success: false,
        available: true,
        requiredForLock:
          true,
        targetMinutes:
          target,
        rowIndex:
          result.rowIndex || 0,
        errors: [
          'Daily Goal hôm nay có targetMinutes <= 0. Current=' +
          target +
          '. Cần submit lại 20 phút trước khi lock.'
        ],
        warnings: [],
        actualSheetWritePerformed:
          false,
        actualDriveWritePerformed:
          false
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      available: true,
      requiredForLock:
        true,
      targetMinutes:
        target,
      rowIndex:
        result.rowIndex || 0,
      targetColumn:
        result.resolvedColumns &&
        result.resolvedColumns.targetMinutes
          ? result.resolvedColumns.targetMinutes
          : {},
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      errors: [],
      warnings: []
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      available: true,
      requiredForLock:
        true,
      errors: [
        'TargetMinutes QA 4H-3P6 failed: ' +
        String(error.message || error)
      ],
      warnings: [],
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4h4InspectUiMarkers_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var shell = '';
  var client4H2 = '';
  var client4H3 = '';
  var styles = '';

  try {
    shell =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Shell_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (errorShell) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Shell_4A: ' +
      String(errorShell.message || errorShell)
    );
  }

  try {
    client4H2 =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Client_LearningPlan_4H2')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error4H2) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_LearningPlan_4H2: ' +
      String(error4H2.message || error4H2)
    );
  }

  try {
    client4H3 =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Client_LearningPlan_WriteChild_4H3')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error4H3) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_LearningPlan_WriteChild_4H3: ' +
      String(error4H3.message || error4H3)
    );
  }

  try {
    styles =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Styles_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (errorStyles) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Styles_4A: ' +
      String(errorStyles.message || errorStyles)
    );
  }

  kidlearnV3_4h4CheckMarkers_(
    shell,
    [
      'UI_Product_Client_LearningPlan_4H2',
      'UI_Product_Client_LearningPlan_WriteChild_4H3'
    ],
    'Shell',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_4h4CheckMarkers_(
    client4H2,
    [
      'KIDLEARN_LEARNING_PLAN_UI_DRY_RUN_4H2',
      'ensureLearningPlanEntry4H2',
      'openLearningPlanPanel4H2',
      'renderLearningPlanPanel4H2',
      'submitLearningPlanDryRun4H2',
      'kidlearnV3_getLearningPlanContext4H1V3',
      'kidlearnV3_previewLearningPlanDraft4H2V3',
      'kl-learning-plan-entry-4h2',
      'kl-learning-plan-panel-4h2'
    ],
    'Client 4H-2',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_4h4CheckMarkers_(
    client4H3,
    [
      'KIDLEARN_LEARNING_PLAN_WRITE_CHILD_UI_4H3',
      'patchLearningPlanWriteButton4H3',
      'submitLearningPlanControlledWrite4H3',
      'renderChildLearningPlanHome4H3',
      'kidlearnV3_submitLearningPlanFromUi4H3V3',
      'kidlearnV3_getChildLearningPlanContext4H3V3',
      'kl-learning-plan-write-gate-4h3',
      'kl-child-learning-plan-entry-4h3'
    ],
    'Client 4H-3',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_4h4CheckMarkers_(
    styles,
    [
      '.kl-learning-plan-entry-4h2',
      '.kl-learning-plan-panel-4h2',
      '.kl-learning-plan-card-4h2',
      '.kl-learning-plan-write-gate-4h3',
      '.kl-learning-plan-realwrite-button-4h3',
      '.kl-child-learning-plan-entry-4h3',
      '.kl-child-learning-plan-assignment-4h3'
    ],
    'CSS',
    errors
  );

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'INSPECT_PHASE_4H_UI_MARKERS_4H_4_V3',
    shellIncluded:
      shell.indexOf('UI_Product_Client_LearningPlan_4H2') !== -1 &&
      shell.indexOf('UI_Product_Client_LearningPlan_WriteChild_4H3') !== -1,
    client4H2Loaded:
      client4H2 !== '',
    client4H3Loaded:
      client4H3 !== '',
    cssLoaded:
      styles !== '',
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      warnings.length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      warnings
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4h4CheckMarkers_(content, markers, label, errors) {
  content =
    String(content || '');

  for (var i = 0; i < markers.length; i++) {
    if (content.indexOf(markers[i]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        label + ' thiếu marker: ' + markers[i]
      );
    }
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4h4EstimateVisualScore_(uiMarkers) {
  if (!uiMarkers || uiMarkers.success !== true) {
    return 70;
  }

  return 90;
}


/**
 * ================================================================
 * Generic helpers
 * ================================================================
 */

function kidlearnV3_4h4GetLearningPlanGateMode_() {
  var key =
    'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4H_LEARNING_PLAN_WRITE_GATE_MODE';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS &&
      KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.WRITE_GATE_MODE
    ) {
      key =
        KIDLEARN_V3_LEARNING_PLAN_4H1_KEYS.WRITE_GATE_MODE;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  var mode =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key) ||
    'CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY';

  if (
    mode !== 'CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY' &&
    mode !== 'OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED'
  ) {
    return 'CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY';
  }

  return mode;
}


function kidlearnV3_4h4CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];

  try {
    if (typeof kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_ === 'function') {
      kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

      return {
        success: true,
        environment: 'DEV',
        prodWriteAllowed: false,
        errors: []
      };
    }
  } catch (errorAssertDev) {
    errors.push(
      String(errorAssertDev.message || errorAssertDev)
    );
  }

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    errors:
      kidlearnV3_4h4UniqueArray_(errors)
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4h4SafeCall_(functionName, args) {
  args =
    args || [];

  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' + functionName + ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName:
          functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output:
          null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn.apply(null, args);

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      phase:
        output && output.phase ? output.phase : '',
      status:
        output && output.status ? output.status : '',
      gateMode:
        output && output.gateMode ? output.gateMode : '',
      nextBundle:
        output && output.nextBundle ? output.nextBundle : '',
      nextPhase:
        output && output.nextPhase ? output.nextPhase : '',
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : kidlearnV3_4h4PreviewValue_(JSON.stringify(output || {})),
      output:
        output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName:
        functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output:
        null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4h4CompactSafeCall_(safeCallResult) {
  safeCallResult =
    safeCallResult || {};

  return {
    success:
      safeCallResult.success === true,
    functionName:
      safeCallResult.functionName || '',
    phase:
      safeCallResult.phase || '',
    status:
      safeCallResult.status || '',
    gateMode:
      safeCallResult.gateMode || '',
    message:
      safeCallResult.message || ''
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4h4PreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 450) {
    return text.substring(0, 450) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4h4UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  items =
    items || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4h4SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success:
        result.success,
      action:
        result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
      lockStep:
        result.lockStep ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
      phaseName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
      status:
        status,
      gateMode:
        result.gateMode ||
        kidlearnV3_4h4GetLearningPlanGateMode_(),
      previousPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.PREVIOUS_PHASE,
      nextPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4H_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      qaSummary:
        result.qaSummary || {},
      prodWriteAllowed:
        false,
      realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
        false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualLearningDataWritePerformed:
        false,
      actualDriveWritePerformed:
        false,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4h4ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw:
        text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - PHASE 4I QA + LOCK
 * Step: 4I-4
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * Phase 4I:
 * - Assignment Learning Flow
 * - Học theo kế hoạch được giao
 *
 * Bundles:
 * - 4I-1 Assignment Learning Policy + Context Read-only
 * - 4I-2 Child Assignment Learning UI Dry-run
 * - 4I-3 Controlled Assignment Status Write + Completion Sync
 * - 4I-4 QA + Phase Lock
 *
 * Safety:
 * - No DATA_Assignments write.
 * - No DATA_LessonProgress write.
 * - No DATA_Responses write.
 * - No DATA_DailyGoals write.
 * - No LOG_Audit write.
 * - No Drive write.
 * - Only ScriptProperties are updated for QA/lock status.
 */

  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4I_STATUS',

  LOCKED_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4I_LOCKED_AT'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_STATUS = {
  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  PREVIEWED: 'PREVIEWED',
  QA_PASSED: 'QA_PASSED',
  PHASE_4I_CLOSED_LOCKED: 'PHASE_4I_CLOSED_LOCKED',
  FAILED: 'FAILED'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_CONFIG = {
  PHASE: '4I',

};


/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_previewPhase4ILockV3() {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_4i4BuildFinalQa_({
      mode: 'PREVIEW'
    });

  result.action =
    'PREVIEW_PHASE_4I_LOCK_V3';

  result.status =
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_STATUS.PREVIEWED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_STATUS.FAILED;

  kidlearnV3_4i4SaveStatus_(
    result,

    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4I-4 preview failed. Errors=' +
      result.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_runPhase4IFinalQaV3() {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_4i4BuildFinalQa_({

      : KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_STATUS.FAILED;

/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_lockPhase4IConfirmV3() {

      'SYSTEM_ADMIN'
  });

/**
 * Lock Phase 4I.
 */
function kidlearnV3_lockPhase4IV3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var confirmText =
    String(options.confirm || '').trim().toUpperCase();

  if (
    confirmText !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm khóa Phase 4I. Cần confirm=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
    );
  }

  var qa =
    kidlearnV3_runPhase4IFinalQaV3();

  if (!qa.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể lock Phase 4I vì final QA chưa pass.'
    );
  }

  var gateMode =
    kidlearnV3_4i4GetAssignmentGateMode_();

  if (gateMode !== 'CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY') {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể lock Phase 4I vì Assignment write gate chưa đóng. Current=' +
      gateMode
    );
  }

  var lockedAt =
    new Date().toISOString();

  var lockedBy =
    String(options.lockedBy || 'SYSTEM_ADMIN').trim();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'LOCK_PHASE_4I_CONFIRM_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE,
    lockStep:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_CONFIG.LOCK_STEP,
    phaseName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_CONFIG.PHASE_NAME,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4I_CLOSED_LOCKED,
    previousPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_CONFIG.PREVIOUS_PHASE,
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    lockedBy:
      lockedBy,
    lockedAt:
      lockedAt,
    qaSummary:
      qa.qaSummary,
    gateMode:
      gateMode,
    prodWriteAllowed:
      false,
    realSheetWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    realDriveWriteAllowedNow:
      false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualLearningDataWritePerformed:
      false,
    actualDriveWritePerformed:
      false,
    message:
      'Phase 4I đã được khóa an toàn. Có thể chuyển sang Phase 4J.',
    errorCount:
      0,
    warningCount:
      qa.warningCount || 0,
    errors:
      [],
    warnings:
      qa.warnings || []
  };

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_KEYS.STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4I_CLOSED_LOCKED
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_KEYS.LOCKED_BY,
    lockedBy
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_KEYS.LOCKED_AT,
    lockedAt
  );

  kidlearnV3_4i4SaveStatus_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_STATUS.PHASE_4I_CLOSED_LOCKED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE4I_LOCK_KEYS.LAST_LOCK_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}

/**
