/**
 * Build response row preview.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d2BuildResponseRowPreview_(headerInfo, payload, warnings) {
  var errors = [];
  var localWarnings = [];

  var now =
    new Date().toISOString();

  var responseId =
    payload.responseId ||
    'RESP_4D2_DRY_' + new Date().getTime();

  var canonicalData = {
    responseId: responseId,
    childId: payload.childId,
    lessonId: payload.lessonId,
    activityId: payload.activityId,
    answerMode: payload.answerMode,
    answerText: payload.answerText,
    selectedOptionId: payload.selectedOptionId,
    selectedOptionLabel: payload.selectedOptionLabel,
    expectedAnswer: payload.expectedAnswer,
    isCorrect: payload.isCorrect,
    score: payload.score,
    status: 'SUBMITTED_DRY_RUN_PREVIEW',
    submittedAt: now,
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
    attemptId: payload.attemptId || 'ATT_4D2_DRY',
    answerMetaJson: JSON.stringify({
      phase: '4D-2',
      dryRunOnly: true,
      childId: payload.childId,
      lessonId: payload.lessonId,
      activityId: payload.activityId,
      answerMode: payload.answerMode,
      selectedOptionId: payload.selectedOptionId,
      selectedOptionLabel: payload.selectedOptionLabel,
      canvasHasInk: payload.canvasHasInk,
      canvasDataUrlLength: payload.canvasDataUrlLength,
      source: 'RESPONSE_WRITE_DRY_RUN_ROW_PREVIEW',
      note:
        'This preview is not written to DATA_Responses.'
    })
  };

  var aliasMap =
    kidlearnV3_4d2GetResponseFieldAliasMap_();

  var rowValues =
    kidlearnV3_4d2BuildBlankRow_(headerInfo.lastColumn);

  var matched = [];
  var unmapped = [];

  var metaColumn =
    kidlearnV3_4d2FindHeaderMatch_(
      headerInfo.headers,
      aliasMap.answerMetaJson
    );

  for (var key in canonicalData) {
    if (!canonicalData.hasOwnProperty(key)) continue;

    var match =
      kidlearnV3_4d2FindHeaderMatch_(
        headerInfo.headers,
        aliasMap[key] || [key]
      );

    if (match) {
      rowValues[match.columnIndex - 1] =
        canonicalData[key];

      matched.push({
        canonical: key,
        matchedHeader: match.raw,
        columnIndex: match.columnIndex,
        valuePreview:
          kidlearnV3_4d2PreviewValue_(canonicalData[key])
      });
    } else {
      unmapped.push({
        canonical: key,
        valuePreview:
          kidlearnV3_4d2PreviewValue_(canonicalData[key])
      });
    }
  }

  var criticalFields = [
    'childId',
    'lessonId',
    'activityId',
    'answerMode'
  ];

  var criticalUnmapped = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < criticalFields.length; i++) {
    if (
      kidlearnV3_4d2IsUnmapped_(
        unmapped,
        criticalFields[i]
      )
    ) {
      criticalUnmapped.push(criticalFields[i]);
    }
  }

  if (criticalUnmapped.length > 0) {
    if (metaColumn) {
      localWarnings.push(
        'DATA_Responses thiếu cột riêng cho ' +
        criticalUnmapped.join(', ') +
        '. Các field này đã nằm trong answerMetaJson/detailsJson.'
      );
    } else {
      localWarnings.push(
        'DATA_Responses thiếu cột riêng cho ' +
        criticalUnmapped.join(', ') +
        ' và chưa thấy metadata column. 4D-3 vẫn có thể ghi field cơ bản, nhưng nên bổ sung metadata column trước khi dùng lâu dài.'
      );
    }
  }

  var requiredForAppend = [
    'responseId',
    'answerText',
    'status'
  ];

  for (var r = 0; r < requiredForAppend.length; r++) {
    var requiredKey =
      requiredForAppend[r];

    if (
      kidlearnV3_4d2IsUnmapped_(
        unmapped,
        requiredKey
      )
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'DATA_Responses không map được required field cho append: ' +
        requiredKey
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    targetSheet: 'DATA_Responses',
    operation: 'DRY_RUN_APPEND_PREVIEW',
    willWriteNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    headerRowIndex: headerInfo.headerRowIndex,
    targetNextRow: headerInfo.lastRow + 1,
    rowLength: rowValues.length,
    rowValues: rowValues,
    rowObjectByHeader:
      kidlearnV3_4d2BuildRowObjectByHeader_(
        headerInfo,
        rowValues
      ),
    matchedFieldCount: matched.length,
    unmappedFieldCount: unmapped.length,
    matchedFields: matched,
    unmappedFields: unmapped,
    criticalUnmappedFields: criticalUnmapped,
    metadataColumnDetected: metaColumn
      ? {
          header: metaColumn.raw,
          columnIndex: metaColumn.columnIndex
        }
      : null,
    responseId: responseId,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: localWarnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: localWarnings
  };
}


/**
 * Build audit row preview.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d2BuildAuditRowPreview_(
  headerInfo,
  payload,
  responsePreview,
  warnings
) {
  var errors = [];

      )

      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    targetSheet: 'LOG_Audit',
    operation: 'DRY_RUN_AUDIT_APPEND_PREVIEW',
    willWriteNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    headerRowIndex: headerInfo.headerRowIndex,
    targetNextRow: headerInfo.lastRow + 1,
    rowLength: rowValues.length,
    rowValues: rowValues,
    rowObjectByHeader:
      kidlearnV3_4d2BuildRowObjectByHeader_(
        headerInfo,
        rowValues
      ),

function kidlearnV3_4d2NormalizeResponsePayload_(payload) {
  payload = payload || {};

  var answerMode =
    String(payload.answerMode || 'UNKNOWN')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  var answerText =
    String(payload.answerText || '').trim();

  var expectedAnswer =
    String(payload.expectedAnswer || '').trim();

  var isCorrect =
    payload.isCorrect;

  if (
    isCorrect === null ||
    isCorrect === undefined ||
    String(isCorrect) === ''
  ) {
    if (expectedAnswer && answerText) {
      isCorrect =
        kidlearnV3_4d2NormalizeAnswerText_(answerText) ===
        kidlearnV3_4d2NormalizeAnswerText_(expectedAnswer);
    } else {
      isCorrect = '';
    }
  }

  return {
    responseId:
      String(payload.responseId || '').trim(),
    childId:
      String(payload.childId || 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT').trim(),
    lessonId:
      String(payload.lessonId || '').trim(),
    activityId:
      String(payload.activityId || '').trim(),
    subjectCode:
      String(payload.subjectCode || payload.subjectKey || '').trim(),
    answerMode: answerMode,
    answerText: answerText,
    selectedOptionId:
      String(payload.selectedOptionId || '').trim(),
    selectedOptionLabel:
      String(payload.selectedOptionLabel || '').trim(),
    expectedAnswer: expectedAnswer,
    isCorrect: isCorrect,
    score:
      payload.score === null ||
      payload.score === undefined
        ? ''
        : payload.score,
    canvasHasInk:
      payload.canvasHasInk === true,
    canvasDataUrlLength:
      Number(payload.canvasDataUrlLength || 0),
    attemptId:
      String(payload.attemptId || '').trim()
  };
}


/**
 * Header helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d2InspectSheetHeaders_(spreadsheet, sheetName, warnings) {
  warnings = warnings || [];

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4d1InspectSheetHeaders_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4d1InspectSheetHeaders_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName,
      warnings
    );
  }

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4d2GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      exists: false,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      headerRowIndex: 0,
      dataStartRowIndex: 0,
      headerCount: 0,
      lastRow: 0,
      lastColumn: 0,
      headers: [],
      duplicateHeaders: []
    };
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 1 || lastColumn < 1) {
    warnings.push(sheetName + ': Sheet trống.');

    return {
      exists: true,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      headerRowIndex: 0,
      dataStartRowIndex: 0,
      headerCount: 0,
      lastRow: lastRow,
      lastColumn: lastColumn,
      headers: [],
      duplicateHeaders: []
    };
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(1, 1, Math.min(2, lastRow), lastColumn)
      .getValues();

  var headerRowIndex =
    kidlearnV3_4d2ChooseHeaderRow_(values);

  var row =
    values[headerRowIndex - 1] || [];

  var headers = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    var raw =
      String(row[i] || '').trim();

    if (!raw) continue;

    headers.push({
      columnIndex: i + 1,
      raw: raw,
      normalized:
        kidlearnV3_4d2NormalizeLookupKey_(raw)
    });
  }

  return {
    exists: true,
    sheetName: sheetName,
    headerRowIndex: headerRowIndex,
    dataStartRowIndex: headerRowIndex + 1,
    headerCount: headers.length,
    lastRow: lastRow,
    lastColumn: lastColumn,
    headers: headers,
    duplicateHeaders: []
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4d2ChooseHeaderRow_(values) {
  var row1 = values[0] || [];
  var row2 = values.length > 1 ? values[1] || [] : [];

  var row1Score =
    kidlearnV3_4d2HeaderScore_(row1);

  var row2Score =
    kidlearnV3_4d2HeaderScore_(row2);

  if (row2Score >= 3 && row2Score >= row1Score) {
    return 2;
  }

  return 1;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d2HeaderScore_(row) {
  var score = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(row[i] || '').trim();

    if (!value) continue;

    if (/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/.test(value)) {
      score++;
    }
  }

  return score;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d2FindHeaderMatch_(headers, aliases) {
  var map = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    map[
      kidlearnV3_4d2NormalizeLookupKey_(aliases[i])
    ] = true;
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < headers.length; j++) {
    if (map[headers[j].normalized]) {
      return headers[j];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d2BuildBlankRow_(length) {
  var row = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    row.push('');
  }

  return row;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d2BuildRowObjectByHeader_(headerInfo, rowValues) {
  var obj = {};

  var headers =
    headerInfo.headers || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
    obj[headers[i].raw] =
      rowValues[headers[i].columnIndex - 1] || '';
  }

  return obj;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d2IsUnmapped_(unmapped, canonical) {
  for (var i = 0; i < unmapped.length; i++) {
    if (unmapped[i].canonical === canonical) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}

/**
 * Spreadsheet helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d2OpenSpreadsheet_() {
  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) return active;

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DEV spreadsheet.');
}


function kidlearnV3_4d2GetSheetByExactName_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d2NormalizeLookupKey_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '')
    .replace(/[^\w]/g, '');
}


function kidlearnV3_4d2NormalizeAnswerText_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
}


function kidlearnV3_4d2PreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 120) {
    return text.substring(0, 120) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d2UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d2SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4d2GetCurrentStatus_() {
  return (
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_RESPONSE_DRYRUN_4D2_KEYS.STATUS
      ) ||
    KIDLEARN_V3_RESPONSE_DRYRUN_4D2_STATUS.NOT_RUN
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4d2ResolveStatusAfterCheck_(statusBefore, proposedStatus) {
  if (
    statusBefore ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_RESPONSE_DRYRUN_4D2_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_3 &&
    proposedStatus !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_RESPONSE_DRYRUN_4D2_STATUS.FAILED
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_RESPONSE_DRYRUN_4D2_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_3;
  }

  return proposedStatus;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d2SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_RESPONSE_DRYRUN_4D2_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_RESPONSE_DRYRUN_4D2_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_RESPONSE_DRYRUN_4D2_CONFIG.PHASE,
      parentPhase:
        result.parentPhase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_RESPONSE_DRYRUN_4D2_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status: status,
      dryRunName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_RESPONSE_DRYRUN_4D2_CONFIG.DRY_RUN_NAME,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_RESPONSE_DRYRUN_4D2_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_RESPONSE_DRYRUN_4D2_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
      responsePreviewSummary:
        result.responsePreview
          ? {
              targetSheet: result.responsePreview.targetSheet,
              targetNextRow: result.responsePreview.targetNextRow,
              matchedFieldCount: result.responsePreview.matchedFieldCount,
              unmappedFieldCount: result.responsePreview.unmappedFieldCount,
              criticalUnmappedFields: result.responsePreview.criticalUnmappedFields,
              metadataColumnDetected: result.responsePreview.metadataColumnDetected
            }
          : null,
      auditPreviewSummary:
        result.auditPreview
          ? {
              targetSheet: result.auditPreview.targetSheet,
              targetNextRow: result.auditPreview.targetNextRow,
              matchedFieldCount: result.auditPreview.matchedFieldCount,
              unmappedFieldCount: result.auditPreview.unmappedFieldCount
            }
          : null,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4d2ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Controlled DEV real write.
 */
function kidlearnV3_realWriteDataStudySessions4D5V3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var confirmText =
    String(options.confirm || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    confirmText !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirm. Cần confirm=' +
      KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.CONFIRM_TEXT
    );
  }

  var payload =
    options.payload ||
    kidlearnV3_4d5BuildSamplePayload_();

  var lock =
    LockService.getScriptLock();

  var locked =
    lock.tryLock(30000);

  if (!locked) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không lấy được script lock sau 30 giây. Vui lòng chạy lại.'
    );
  }

  try {
    var plan =
      kidlearnV3_4d5BuildRealWritePlan_(payload);

    if (!plan.success) {
      throw new Error(
        'Preflight 4D-5 chưa pass. Errors=' +
        plan.errors.join(' | ')
      );
    }

    var spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4d5OpenSpreadsheet_();

    var sessionSheet =
      kidlearnV3_4d5GetSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_StudySessions'
      );

    var auditSheet =
      kidlearnV3_4d5GetSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        'LOG_Audit'
      );

    if (!sessionSheet) {
      throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DATA_StudySessions.');
    }

    if (!auditSheet) {
      throw new Error('Không tìm thấy LOG_Audit.');
    }

    var before = {
      dataStudySessionsLastRow:
        sessionSheet.getLastRow(),
      logAuditLastRow:
        auditSheet.getLastRow()
    };

    var sessionRowNumber = 0;

    if (plan.sessionPlan.operationMode === 'UPDATE_EXISTING') {
      sessionRowNumber =
        plan.sessionPlan.targetRowNumber;

      sessionSheet
        .getRange(
          sessionRowNumber,
          1,
          1,
          plan.sessionPlan.rowValues.length
        )
        .setValues([
          plan.sessionPlan.rowValues
        ]);
    } else {
      sessionSheet.appendRow(
        plan.sessionPlan.rowValues
      );

      SpreadsheetApp.flush();

      sessionRowNumber =
        sessionSheet.getLastRow();
    }

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    var auditHeaderInfo =
      kidlearnV3_4d5InspectSheetHeaders_(
        spreadsheet,
        'LOG_Audit',
        []
      );

    var auditPlan =
      kidlearnV3_4d5BuildAuditRowPlan_(
        auditHeaderInfo,
        plan.normalizedPayload,
        plan.sessionPlan.sessionId,
        sessionRowNumber,
        plan.sessionPlan.operationMode
      );

    if (!auditPlan.success) {
      throw new Error(
        'Không build được audit row 4D-5. Errors=' +
        auditPlan.errors.join(' | ')
      );
    }

    auditSheet.appendRow(
      auditPlan.rowValues
    );

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    var auditRowNumber =
      auditSheet.getLastRow();

    var after = {
      dataStudySessionsLastRow:
        sessionSheet.getLastRow(),
      logAuditLastRow:
        auditSheet.getLastRow()
    };

    var writeRecord = {
      success: true,
      action: 'REAL_WRITE_DATA_STUDY_SESSIONS_4D_5_V3',
      phase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.PHASE,
      parentPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status:
        KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_6,
      writeName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.WRITE_NAME,
      environment: 'DEV',
      confirmUsed: confirmText,
      reviewerNote:
        String(options.reviewerNote || ''),
      targetSheet: 'DATA_StudySessions',
      auditSheet: 'LOG_Audit',
      operationMode:
        plan.sessionPlan.operationMode,
      sessionId:
        plan.sessionPlan.sessionId,
      auditId:
        auditPlan.auditId,
      sessionRowNumber:
        sessionRowNumber,
      auditRowNumber:
        auditRowNumber,
      sessionIdColumnIndex:
        plan.sessionPlan.sessionIdColumnIndex,
      auditIdColumnIndex:
        auditPlan.auditIdColumnIndex,
      before: before,
      after: after,
      rowDelta: {
        DATA_StudySessions:
          after.dataStudySessionsLastRow -
          before.dataStudySessionsLastRow,
        LOG_Audit:
          after.logAuditLastRow -
          before.logAuditLastRow
      },
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: true,
      actualSheetWritePerformed: true,
      studySessionWritePerformed: true,
      auditWritePerformed: true,
      dataResponsesWritePerformed: false,
      lessonProgressWritePerformed: false,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      writtenAt:
        new Date().toISOString(),
      warnings:
        plan.warnings || []
    };

    kidlearnV3_4d5SaveWriteRecord_(
      writeRecord
    );

    kidlearnV3_4d5SaveStatus_(
      writeRecord,
      KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_6,
      KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_KEYS.LAST_WRITE_AT
    );

    console.log(JSON.stringify(writeRecord, null, 2));

    return writeRecord;

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}


/**
 * Verify last real write.
 */
function kidlearnV3_verifyLastStudySessionRealWrite4D5V3() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var text =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_KEYS.LAST_WRITE_JSON
    );

  if (!text) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không tìm thấy LAST_WRITE_JSON của 4D-5.'
    );
  }

  var lastWrite =
    JSON.parse(text);

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_4d5OpenSpreadsheet_();

  var sessionSheet =
    kidlearnV3_4d5GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_StudySessions'
    );

  var auditSheet =
    kidlearnV3_4d5GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      'LOG_Audit'
    );

  if (!sessionSheet) {
    errors.push('Không tìm thấy DATA_StudySessions.');
  }

  if (!auditSheet) {
    errors.push('Không tìm thấy LOG_Audit.');
  }

  var sessionCheck = null;
  var auditCheck = null;

  if (sessionSheet) {
    sessionCheck =
      kidlearnV3_4d5VerifyRowContainsId_(
        sessionSheet,
        lastWrite.sessionRowNumber,
        lastWrite.sessionIdColumnIndex,
        lastWrite.sessionId,
        'DATA_StudySessions'
      );

    if (!sessionCheck.success) {
      errors =
        errors.concat(sessionCheck.errors || []);
    }
  }

  if (auditSheet) {
    auditCheck =
      kidlearnV3_4d5VerifyRowContainsId_(
        auditSheet,
        lastWrite.auditRowNumber,
        lastWrite.auditIdColumnIndex,
        lastWrite.auditId,
        'LOG_Audit'
      );

    if (!auditCheck.success) {
      errors =
        errors.concat(auditCheck.errors || []);
    }
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'VERIFY_LAST_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D_5_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      errors.length === 0
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_6
        : KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_STATUS.FAILED,
    sessionCheck: sessionCheck,
    auditCheck: auditCheck,
    lastWriteSummary: {
      sessionId:
        lastWrite.sessionId,
      auditId:
        lastWrite.auditId,
      sessionRowNumber:
        lastWrite.sessionRowNumber,
      auditRowNumber:
        lastWrite.auditRowNumber,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        lastWrite.actualSheetWritePerformed
    },
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: true,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      lastWrite.actualSheetWritePerformed === true,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_4d5SaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.status,
    KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_KEYS.LAST_VERIFY_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Verify 4D-5 failed. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Assert ready for 4D-6.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertStudySessionRealWrite4D5ReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getStudySessionRealWrite4D5StatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_6
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '4D-5 chưa READY_FOR_4D_6. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    !status.lastWrite ||
    status.lastWrite.actualSheetWritePerformed !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Chưa có bằng chứng actualSheetWritePerformed=true cho 4D-5.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D_5_READY_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    status: status.status,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: true,
    actualSheetWritePerformed:
      status.lastWrite &&
      status.lastWrite.actualSheetWritePerformed === true,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(errors.join(' | '));
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Build full write plan.
 * Không ghi sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d5BuildRealWritePlan_(payload) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var d4 =
    kidlearnV3_4d5SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertLessonProgressRealWrite4D4ReadyV3'
    );

  if (!d4.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4D-4 chưa READY_FOR_4D_5: ' +
      d4.message
    );
  }

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4d5CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(dev.warnings || []);

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4d5OpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được DEV spreadsheet: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var normalized =
    kidlearnV3_4d5NormalizeSessionPayload_(payload);

  var sessionPlan = null;
  var auditPlan = null;

  if (spreadsheet) {
    var sessionSheet =
      kidlearnV3_4d5GetSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_StudySessions'
      );

    var sessionHeaderInfo =
      kidlearnV3_4d5InspectSheetHeaders_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_StudySessions',
        warnings
      );

    var auditHeaderInfo =
      kidlearnV3_4d5InspectSheetHeaders_(
        spreadsheet,
        'LOG_Audit',
        warnings
      );

    if (!sessionHeaderInfo.exists || !sessionSheet) {
      errors.push('Không tìm thấy DATA_StudySessions.');
    } else {
      sessionPlan =
        kidlearnV3_4d5BuildSessionRowPlan_(
          sessionHeaderInfo,
          sessionSheet,
          normalized
        );

      if (!sessionPlan.success) {
        errors =
          errors.concat(sessionPlan.errors || []);
      }

      warnings =
        warnings.concat(sessionPlan.warnings || []);
    }

    if (!auditHeaderInfo.exists) {
      errors.push('Không tìm thấy LOG_Audit.');
    } else {
      auditPlan =
        kidlearnV3_4d5BuildAuditRowPlan_(
          auditHeaderInfo,
          normalized,
          sessionPlan ? sessionPlan.sessionId : '',
          sessionPlan ? sessionPlan.targetRowNumber : '',
          sessionPlan ? sessionPlan.operationMode : ''
        );

      if (!auditPlan.success) {
        errors =
          errors.concat(auditPlan.errors || []);
      }

      warnings =
        warnings.concat(auditPlan.warnings || []);
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'BUILD_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_PLAN_4D_5_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    writeName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.WRITE_NAME,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: true,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    normalizedPayload: normalized,
    devSafety: dev,
    sessionPlan: sessionPlan,
    auditPlan: auditPlan,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4d5UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4d5UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Build DATA_StudySessions row.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d5BuildSessionRowPlan_(
  headerInfo,
  sheet,
  payload
) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var now =
    new Date().toISOString();

  var sessionId =
    payload.sessionId ||
    'SESS_4D5_DEV_' + new Date().getTime();

  var canonicalData = {
    sessionId: sessionId,
    childId: payload.childId,
    lessonId: payload.lessonId,
    subjectCode: payload.subjectCode,
    status: payload.status,
    startedAt: payload.startedAt,
    endedAt: payload.endedAt,
    durationSeconds: payload.durationSeconds,
    updatedAt: now
  };

  var aliasMap =
    kidlearnV3_4d5GetSessionFieldAliasMap_();

  var rowValues =
    kidlearnV3_4d5BuildBlankRow_(headerInfo.lastColumn);

  var matched = [];
  var unmapped = [];

  var sessionIdColumnIndex = 0;

  for (var key in canonicalData) {
    if (!canonicalData.hasOwnProperty(key)) continue;

    var match =
      kidlearnV3_4d5FindHeaderMatch_(
        headerInfo.headers,
        aliasMap[key] || [key]
      );

    if (match) {
      rowValues[match.columnIndex - 1] =
        canonicalData[key];

      if (key === 'sessionId') {
        sessionIdColumnIndex =
          match.columnIndex;
      }

      matched.push({
        canonical: key,
        matchedHeader: match.raw,
        columnIndex: match.columnIndex,
        valuePreview:
          kidlearnV3_4d5PreviewValue_(canonicalData[key])
      });
    } else {
      unmapped.push({
        canonical: key,
        valuePreview:
          kidlearnV3_4d5PreviewValue_(canonicalData[key])
      });
    }
  }

  var required = [
    'sessionId',
    'childId',
    'lessonId',
    'status',
    'startedAt'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < required.length; i++) {
    if (
      kidlearnV3_4d5IsUnmapped_(
        unmapped,
        required[i]
      )
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'DATA_StudySessions không map được required field: ' +
        required[i]
      );
    }
  }

  var existingRowNumber = 0;

  if (sessionIdColumnIndex > 0) {
    existingRowNumber =
      kidlearnV3_4d5FindExistingSessionRow_(
        sheet,
        headerInfo,
        sessionIdColumnIndex,
        sessionId
      );
  }

  var operationMode =
    existingRowNumber > 0
      ? 'UPDATE_EXISTING'
      : 'APPEND_NEW';

  var targetRowNumber =
    existingRowNumber > 0
      ? existingRowNumber
      : headerInfo.lastRow + 1;

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    targetSheet: 'DATA_StudySessions',
    operation: 'CONTROLLED_DEV_APPEND_OR_UPDATE',
    operationMode: operationMode,
    willWriteNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    headerRowIndex: headerInfo.headerRowIndex,
    targetRowNumber: targetRowNumber,
    rowLength: rowValues.length,
    rowValues: rowValues,
    rowObjectByHeader:
      kidlearnV3_4d5BuildRowObjectByHeader_(
        headerInfo,
        rowValues
      ),
    sessionId: sessionId,
    sessionIdColumnIndex: sessionIdColumnIndex,
    matchedFieldCount: matched.length,
    unmappedFieldCount: unmapped.length,
    matchedFields: matched,
    unmappedFields: unmapped,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Build LOG_Audit row.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d5BuildAuditRowPlan_(
  headerInfo,
  payload,
  sessionId,
  sessionRowNumber,

  var errors = [];

  for (var key in canonicalData) {

      );

    if (match) {
      rowValues[match.columnIndex - 1] =
        canonicalData[key];

      if (key === 'auditId') {
        auditIdColumnIndex =
          match.columnIndex;
      }

      matched.push({
        canonical: key,
        matchedHeader: match.raw,
        columnIndex: match.columnIndex,
        valuePreview:
          kidlearnV3_4d5PreviewValue_(canonicalData[key])
      });
    } else {
      unmapped.push({
        canonical: key,
        valuePreview:
          kidlearnV3_4d5PreviewValue_(canonicalData[key])
      });
    }
  }

  var required = [
    'auditId',
    'action',
    'entityType',
    'entityId',
    'detailsJson',
    'createdAt'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < required.length; i++) {
    if (
      kidlearnV3_4d5IsUnmapped_(
        unmapped,
        required[i]
      )
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'LOG_Audit không map được required field: ' +

      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    targetSheet: 'LOG_Audit',
    operation: 'CONTROLLED_DEV_AUDIT_APPEND',
    willWriteNow: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    headerRowIndex: headerInfo.headerRowIndex,
    targetNextRow: headerInfo.lastRow + 1,
    rowLength: rowValues.length,
    rowValues: rowValues,
    rowObjectByHeader:
      kidlearnV3_4d5BuildRowObjectByHeader_(
        headerInfo,
        rowValues
      ),
    auditId: auditId,
    auditIdColumnIndex: auditIdColumnIndex,
    entityId: sessionId,
    matchedFieldCount: matched.length,
    unmappedFieldCount: unmapped.length,
    matchedFields: matched,
    unmappedFields: unmapped,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Sample payload.
 * Dùng sessionId test riêng để tránh đè phiên học thật.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d5BuildSamplePayload_() {
  var now =
    new Date();

  var startedAt =
    new Date(now.getTime() - 6 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();

  var endedAt =
    now.toISOString();

  return {
    sessionId: '',
    childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
    lessonId: 'MATH_L1_4D5_DEV_TEST_' + now.getTime(),
    subjectCode: 'MATH',
    status: 'COMPLETED',
    startedAt: startedAt,
    endedAt: endedAt,
    durationSeconds: 360,
    updatedAt: endedAt
  };
}


/**
 * Normalize payload.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d5NormalizeSessionPayload_(payload) {
  payload = payload || {};

  var durationSeconds =
    Number(payload.durationSeconds || 0);

  if (isNaN(durationSeconds)) {
    durationSeconds = 0;
  }

  if (durationSeconds < 0) {
    durationSeconds = 0;
  }

  return {
    sessionId:
      String(payload.sessionId || '').trim(),
    childId:
      String(payload.childId || 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT').trim(),
    lessonId:
      String(payload.lessonId || '').trim(),
    subjectCode:
      String(payload.subjectCode || payload.subjectKey || '').trim(),
    status:
      String(payload.status || 'COMPLETED').trim().toUpperCase(),
    startedAt:
      String(payload.startedAt || new Date().toISOString()).trim(),
    endedAt:
      String(payload.endedAt || '').trim(),
    durationSeconds:
      durationSeconds,
    updatedAt:
      String(payload.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString()).trim()
  };
}


/**
 * Find existing session row by sessionId.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d5FindExistingSessionRow_(
  sheet,
  headerInfo,
  sessionIdColumnIndex,
  sessionId
) {
  var startRow =
    headerInfo.dataStartRowIndex || headerInfo.headerRowIndex + 1;

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < startRow) {
    return 0;
  }

  var rowCount =
    lastRow - startRow + 1;

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(startRow, sessionIdColumnIndex, rowCount, 1)
      .getValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < rowCount; i++) {
    if (
      String(values[i][0]) === String(sessionId)
    ) {
      return startRow + i;
    }
  }

  return 0;
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d5CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    environment: environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: true,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Verify helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d5VerifyRowContainsId_(
  sheet,
  rowNumber,
  idColumnIndex,
  expectedId,
  label
) {
  var errors = [];

  if (!rowNumber || rowNumber < 1) {
    errors.push(label + ': rowNumber không hợp lệ.');
  }

  if (!idColumnIndex || idColumnIndex < 1) {
    errors.push(label + ': idColumnIndex không hợp lệ.');
  }

  if (!expectedId) {
    errors.push(label + ': expectedId trống.');
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      errors: errors
    };
  }

  var value =
    sheet
      .getRange(rowNumber, idColumnIndex)
      .getValue();

  if (String(value) !== String(expectedId)) {
    errors.push(
      label +
      ': ID không khớp. Expected=' +
      expectedId +
      ', Actual=' +
      value
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    label: label,
    rowNumber: rowNumber,
    idColumnIndex: idColumnIndex,
    expectedId: expectedId,
    actualValue: value,
    errors: errors
  };
}


/**
 * Header helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d5InspectSheetHeaders_(spreadsheet, sheetName, warnings) {
  warnings = warnings || [];

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4d1InspectSheetHeaders_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_4d1InspectSheetHeaders_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName,
      warnings
    );
  }

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4d5GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      exists: false,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      headerRowIndex: 0,
      dataStartRowIndex: 0,
      headerCount: 0,
      lastRow: 0,
      lastColumn: 0,
      headers: []
    };
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 1 || lastColumn < 1) {
    return {
      exists: true,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      headerRowIndex: 1,
      dataStartRowIndex: 2,
      headerCount: 0,
      lastRow: lastRow,
      lastColumn: lastColumn,
      headers: []
    };
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(1, 1, Math.min(2, lastRow), lastColumn)
      .getValues();

  var headerRowIndex = 1;

  if (
    values.length > 1 &&
    kidlearnV3_4d5HeaderScore_(values[1]) >=
      kidlearnV3_4d5HeaderScore_(values[0]) &&
    kidlearnV3_4d5HeaderScore_(values[1]) >= 3
  ) {
    headerRowIndex = 2;
  }

  var row =
    values[headerRowIndex - 1] || [];

  var headers = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    var raw =
      String(row[i] || '').trim();

    if (!raw) continue;

    headers.push({
      columnIndex: i + 1,
      raw: raw,
      normalized:
        kidlearnV3_4d5NormalizeLookupKey_(raw)
    });
  }

  return {
    exists: true,
    sheetName: sheetName,
    headerRowIndex: headerRowIndex,
    dataStartRowIndex: headerRowIndex + 1,
    headerCount: headers.length,
    lastRow: lastRow,
    lastColumn: lastColumn,
    headers: headers
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4d5HeaderScore_(row) {
  var score = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(row[i] || '').trim();

    if (/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/.test(value)) {
      score++;
    }
  }

  return score;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d5FindHeaderMatch_(headers, aliases) {
  var map = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    map[
      kidlearnV3_4d5NormalizeLookupKey_(aliases[i])
    ] = true;
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < headers.length; j++) {
    if (map[headers[j].normalized]) {
      return headers[j];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d5BuildBlankRow_(length) {
  var row = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < length; i++) {
    row.push('');
  }

  return row;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d5BuildRowObjectByHeader_(headerInfo, rowValues) {
  var obj = {};
  var headers = headerInfo.headers || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < headers.length; i++) {
    obj[headers[i].raw] =
      rowValues[headers[i].columnIndex - 1] || '';
  }

  return obj;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d5IsUnmapped_(unmapped, canonical) {
  for (var i = 0; i < unmapped.length; i++) {
    if (unmapped[i].canonical === canonical) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}

/**
 * Spreadsheet helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d5OpenSpreadsheet_() {
  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) return active;

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DEV spreadsheet.');
}


function kidlearnV3_4d5GetSheetByExactName_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d5NormalizeLookupKey_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '')
    .replace(/[^\w]/g, '');
}


function kidlearnV3_4d5PreviewValue_(value) {
  var text =
    String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value);

  if (text.length > 120) {
    return text.substring(0, 120) + '...';
  }

  return text;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d5UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d5SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4d5SaveWriteRecord_(writeRecord) {
  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_KEYS.LAST_WRITE_JSON,
      JSON.stringify(writeRecord)
    );
}

  properties.setProperty(

  );

    );
  }

      nextBundle:

      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_STUDY_SESSION_REAL_WRITE_4D5_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: true,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        result.actualSheetWritePerformed === true,
      targetSheet:
        result.targetSheet || 'DATA_StudySessions',
      auditSheet:
        result.auditSheet || 'LOG_Audit',
      sessionId:
        result.sessionId || '',
      auditId:

      sessionRowNumber:
        result.sessionRowNumber || '',
      auditRowNumber:

      rowDelta:

      warnings:

    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4d5ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - SUBJECT DASHBOARD CONTEXT
 * Step: 4C-1
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * Purpose:
 * - Build read-only context for Subject Dashboard.
 * - Prepare subject theme colors.
 * - Prepare answer modes for future Lesson Player.
 *
 * Safety:
 * - Không ghi Google Sheet dữ liệu học.
 * - Không ghi PROD.
 * - Không deploy.
 * - Chỉ ghi ScriptProperties trạng thái kỹ thuật 4C-1.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C1_STATUS',
  LAST_PREVIEW_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C1_LAST_PREVIEW_AT',
  LAST_SMOKE_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C1_LAST_SMOKE_AT',
  LAST_READY_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C1_LAST_READY_AT',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4C1_LAST_RESULT_JSON'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_STATUS = {
  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  PREVIEWED: 'PREVIEWED',
  SMOKE_PASSED: 'SMOKE_PASSED',
  READY_FOR_4C_2: 'READY_FOR_4C_2',
  FAILED: 'FAILED'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG = {
  PHASE: '4C-1',
  PARENT_PHASE: '4C',
  PREVIOUS_PHASE: '4B',
  NEXT_BUNDLE: '4C-2',
  NEXT_STAGE: 'SUBJECT_THEME_MAP_AND_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_UI',
  CONTEXT_NAME: 'SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_READ_ONLY',
  MAX_ROWS_PER_SHEET: 700,
  PROD_WRITE_ALLOWED: false,
  REAL_WRITE_ALLOWED: false
};


/**
 * Main public context function.
 * Future UI 4C-2 can call this through google.script.run.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getSubjectDashboardContext4C1V3(payload) {
  payload = payload || {};

  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var phase4B =
    kidlearnV3_4c1SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4BClosedLockedV3'
    );

  if (!phase4B.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4B chưa closed locked: ' +
      phase4B.message
    );
  }

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4c1OpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được DEV spreadsheet: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var tables = {};

  if (spreadsheet) {
    tables =
      kidlearnV3_4c1ReadSubjectDashboardTables_(
        spreadsheet,
        warnings
      );
  }

  var child =
    kidlearnV3_4c1ResolveChild_(
      payload,
      tables.DATA_Children || []
    );

  var subjects =
    kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeSubjects_(
      tables.MST_Subjects || []
    );

  if (subjects.length === 0) {
    warnings.push(
      'MST_Subjects không có dữ liệu usable. Dùng fallback 4 môn mặc định.'
    );

    subjects =
      kidlearnV3_4c1BuildFallbackSubjects_();
  }

  var selectedSubject =
    kidlearnV3_4c1ResolveSelectedSubject_(
      payload,
      subjects
    );

  var topics =
    kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeTopics_(
      tables.MST_Topics || [],
      selectedSubject
    );

  var lessons =
    kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeLessons_(
      tables.MST_Lessons || [],
      selectedSubject,
      topics
    );

  if (lessons.length === 0) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy lessons cho subject hiện tại. Dùng fallback lesson demo.'
    );

    lessons =
      kidlearnV3_4c1BuildFallbackLessons_(
        selectedSubject
      );
  }

  var progressRows =
    kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeLessonProgress_(
      tables.DATA_LessonProgress || [],
      child
    );

  var skillRows =
    kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeSkills_(
      tables.MST_Skills || [],
      selectedSubject
    );

  var lessonSkillRows =
    kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeLessonSkills_(
      tables.MST_LessonSkills || []
    );

  var skillProgressRows =
    kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeSkillProgress_(
      tables.DATA_SkillProgress || [],
      child
    );

  var assignments =
    kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeAssignments_(
      tables.DATA_Assignments || [],
      child,
      selectedSubject
    );

  var reviewQueue =
    kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeReviewQueue_(
      tables.DATA_ReviewQueue || [],
      child,
      selectedSubject
    );

  var lessonCards =
    kidlearnV3_4c1BuildLessonCards_(
      lessons,
      topics,
      progressRows,
      assignments,
      reviewQueue
    );

  var progressSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4c1BuildProgressSummary_(
      lessonCards
    );

  var nextLesson =
    kidlearnV3_4c1PickNextLesson_(
      lessonCards
    );

  var lessonGroups =
    kidlearnV3_4c1BuildLessonGroups_(
      lessonCards
    );

  var skills =
    kidlearnV3_4c1BuildSkillCards_(
      skillRows,
      lessonSkillRows,
      skillProgressRows,
      lessonCards,
      selectedSubject
    );

  var reviewItems =
    kidlearnV3_4c1BuildReviewItems_(
      reviewQueue,
      lessonCards,
      selectedSubject
    );

  var themeMap =
    kidlearnV3_getSubjectThemeMap4C1V3();

  var theme =
    kidlearnV3_4c1ResolveSubjectTheme_(
      selectedSubject,
      themeMap
    );

  var context = {
    child: child,
    selectedSubject: selectedSubject,
    subjectThemeMap: themeMap,
    selectedTheme: theme,
    supportedAnswerModes:
      kidlearnV3_getSupportedAnswerModes4C1V3(),
    subjectDashboard: {
      subject: selectedSubject,
      theme: theme,
      hero:
        kidlearnV3_4c1BuildHero_(
          child,
          selectedSubject,
          theme,
          progressSummary,
          nextLesson
        ),
      nextLesson: nextLesson,
      lessonGroups: lessonGroups,
      lessonCards: lessonCards,
      skills: skills,
      reviewItems: reviewItems,
      progressSummary: progressSummary,
      uiPolicy: {
        primaryAction: 'Học tiếp',
        secondaryAction: 'Ôn tập nhanh',
        showOneMainAction: true,
        childFriendlyFeedback: true,
        handwritingSupportedLater: true
      }
    },
    sourceInfo: {
      mode: 'READ_ONLY',
      tableNames: Object.keys(tables),
      generatedAt:
        new Date().toISOString(),
      durationMs:
        new Date().getTime() - startedAt.getTime()
    }
  };

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'GET_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4C_1_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    contextName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.CONTEXT_NAME,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    selectedSubjectCode:
      selectedSubject.subjectCode,
    selectedSubjectName:
      selectedSubject.subjectName,
    lessonCount:
      lessonCards.length,
    skillCount:
      skills.length,
    reviewItemCount:
      reviewItems.length,
    context: context,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    success: result.success,
    action: result.action,
    phase: result.phase,
    selectedSubjectCode: result.selectedSubjectCode,
    selectedSubjectName: result.selectedSubjectName,
    lessonCount: result.lessonCount,
    skillCount: result.skillCount,
    reviewItemCount: result.reviewItemCount,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: result.errorCount,
    warningCount: result.warningCount,
    errors: result.errors,
    warnings: result.warnings
  }, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4C-1 context failed. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Preview 4C-1.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewSubjectDashboardContext4C1V3() {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_getSubjectDashboardContext4C1V3({
      subjectCode: 'MATH'
    });

  var status =
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_STATUS.PREVIEWED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_STATUS.FAILED;

  kidlearnV3_4c1SaveStatus_(
    result,
    status,
    KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    success: result.success,
    action: 'PREVIEW_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4C_1_V3',
    phase: '4C-1',
    status: status,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    selectedSubjectCode: result.selectedSubjectCode,
    lessonCount: result.lessonCount,
    skillCount: result.skillCount,
    reviewItemCount: result.reviewItemCount,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: result.errorCount,
    warningCount: result.warningCount,
    warnings: result.warnings
  }, null, 2));

  return {
    success: result.success,
    action: 'PREVIEW_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4C_1_V3',
    phase: '4C-1',
    status: status,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    selectedSubjectCode: result.selectedSubjectCode,
    lessonCount: result.lessonCount,
    skillCount: result.skillCount,
    reviewItemCount: result.reviewItemCount,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: result.errorCount,
    warningCount: result.warningCount,
    warnings: result.warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Smoke test all 4 subjects.
 */
function kidlearnV3_smokeTestSubjectDashboardContext4C1V3() {
  var subjects = [
    'MATH',
    'VIETNAMESE',
    'ENGLISH',
    'SCIENCE'
  ];

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var results = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < subjects.length; i++) {
    try {
      var output =
        kidlearnV3_getSubjectDashboardContext4C1V3({
          subjectCode: subjects[i]
        });

      results.push({
        subjectCode: subjects[i],
        success: output.success === true,
        subjectName: output.selectedSubjectName,
        lessonCount: output.lessonCount,
        skillCount: output.skillCount,
        warningCount: output.warningCount
      });

      warnings =
        warnings.concat(output.warnings || []);

      if (!output.success) {
        errors.push(
          subjects[i] + ' context returned success=false.'
        );
      }

    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(
        subjects[i] + ': ' +
        String(error.message || error)
      );

      results.push({
        subjectCode: subjects[i],
        success: false,
        error: String(error.message || error)
      });
    }
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'SMOKE_TEST_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4C_1_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    subjectCount: subjects.length,
    results: results,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_4c1SaveStatus_(
    result,
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_STATUS.SMOKE_PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_KEYS.LAST_SMOKE_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4C-1 smoke failed. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Mark ready for 4C-2.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markSubjectDashboardContext4C1ReadyV3() {
  var smoke =
    kidlearnV3_smokeTestSubjectDashboardContext4C1V3();

  if (!smoke.success) {
    throw new Error('Smoke 4C-1 chưa pass.');
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4C_1_READY_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_STATUS.READY_FOR_4C_2,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    message:
      'Subject Dashboard Context 4C-1 ready. Có thể qua 4C-2 Subject Theme Map + Subject Dashboard UI.',
    markedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_4c1SaveStatus_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_STATUS.READY_FOR_4C_2,
    KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}

  var result = {

      properties.getProperty(

      ) || '',

      ) || '',

/**
 * Assert 4C-1 ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertSubjectDashboardContext4C1ReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getSubjectDashboardContext4C1StatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_STATUS.READY_FOR_4C_2
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '4C-1 chưa READY_FOR_4C_2. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_4C_1_READY_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    status: status.status,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(errors.join(' | '));
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * QA batch 4C-1.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaBatch4C1V3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewSubjectDashboardContext4C1V3();

  var smoke =
    kidlearnV3_smokeTestSubjectDashboardContext4C1V3();

  var ready =
    kidlearnV3_markSubjectDashboardContext4C1ReadyV3();

  var assertReady =
    kidlearnV3_assertSubjectDashboardContext4C1ReadyV3();

  var result = {
    success:
      preview.success === true &&
      smoke.success === true &&
      ready.success === true &&
      assertReady.success === true,
    suiteName:
      'PHASE_4C_1_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_CONTEXT_READ_ONLY',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    results: {
      preview: preview.success,
      smoke: smoke.success,
      ready: ready.success,
      assertReady: assertReady.success
    }
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error('4C-1 QA batch failed.');
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Data readers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4c1ReadSubjectDashboardTables_(spreadsheet, warnings) {
  var names = [
    'DATA_Children',
    'MST_Subjects',
    'MST_Topics',
    'MST_Lessons',
    'MST_LessonBlocks',
    'MST_Activities',
    'MST_Skills',
    'MST_LessonSkills',
    'DATA_LessonProgress',
    'DATA_SkillProgress',
    'DATA_Assignments',
    'DATA_ReviewQueue',
    'DATA_DailyGoals'
  ];

  var tables = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    tables[names[i]] =
      kidlearnV3_4c1ReadSheetObjects_(
        spreadsheet,
        names[i],
        warnings
      );
  }

  return tables;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1ReadSheetObjects_(spreadsheet, sheetName, warnings) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4c1GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy sheet ' + sheetName + '.'
    );
    return [];
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 2 || lastColumn < 1) {
    return [];
  }

  var rowCount =
    Math.min(
      lastRow,
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_4C1_CONFIG.MAX_ROWS_PER_SHEET
    );

  var values =
    sheet.getRange(1, 1, rowCount, lastColumn).getValues();

  var headers =
    kidlearnV3_4c1BuildHeaders_(values);

  var startRowIndex =
    headers.startRowIndex;

  var objects = [];

  for (var r = startRowIndex; r < values.length; r++) {
    var row =
      values[r];

    if (kidlearnV3_4c1IsBlankRow_(row)) continue;

    var obj = {};

    for (var c = 0; c < headers.keys.length; c++) {
      var key =
        headers.keys[c];

      if (!key) {
        key = 'col' + (c + 1);
      }

      obj[key] =
        row[c];
    }

    obj.__rowNumber =
      r + 1;

    objects.push(obj);
  }

  return objects;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1BuildHeaders_(values) {
  var row1 =
    values[0] || [];

  var row2 =
    values.length > 1 ? values[1] || [] : [];

  var row2LooksLikeFieldKeys =
    kidlearnV3_4c1RowLooksLikeFieldKeys_(row2);

  var source =
    row2LooksLikeFieldKeys ? row2 : row1;

  var startRowIndex =
    row2LooksLikeFieldKeys ? 2 : 1;

  var keys = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < source.length; i++) {
    keys.push(
      kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeKey_(source[i])
    );
  }

  return {
    keys: keys,
    startRowIndex: startRowIndex
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1RowLooksLikeFieldKeys_(row) {
  var score = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(row[i] || '');

    if (
      /^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/.test(value) ||
      value.indexOf('Id') >= 0 ||
      value.indexOf('Code') >= 0 ||
      value.indexOf('Name') >= 0
    ) {
      score++;
    }
  }

  return score >= 3;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeKey_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/[^\wÀ-ỹ]/g, '');
}


/**
 * Normalizers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeSubjects_(rows) {
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var row =
      rows[i];

    var subjectId =
      kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
        'subjectId',
        'subjectid',
        'mamondb',
        'mamonhoc',
        'Mãmônhọc',
        'Mamonhoc',
        'id'
      ]);

    var subjectCode =
      kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
        'subjectCode',
        'subjectcode',
        'code',
        'mamondb',
        'mamonhoc',
        'Mãmônhọc',
        'Mamonhoc'
      ]);

    var subjectName =
      kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
        'subjectName',
        'subjectname',
        'name',
        'tenmonhoc',
        'Tênmônhọc',
        'Tenmonhoc',
        'title'
      ]);

    if (!subjectName && !subjectCode) continue;

    var key =
      kidlearnV3_4c1ResolveSubjectKey_(
        subjectCode,
        subjectName
      );

    result.push({
      subjectId:
        String(subjectId || subjectCode || key),
      subjectCode:
        String(subjectCode || key),
      subjectKey: key,
      subjectName:
        String(subjectName || kidlearnV3_4c1SubjectNameFromKey_(key)),
      order:
        kidlearnV3_4c1ToNumber_(
          kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
            'displayOrder',
            'order',
            'sortOrder',
            'thutu',
            'Thứtự'
          ]),
          i + 1
        ),
      isActive:
        kidlearnV3_4c1ToBool_(
          kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
            'isActive',
            'active',
            'trangthai',
            'status'
          ]),
          true
        )
    });
  }

  result =
    result.filter(function (item) {
      return item.isActive !== false;
    });

  result.sort(function (a, b) {
    return a.order - b.order;
  });

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeTopics_(rows, subject) {
  var result = [];
  var subjectKey =
    subject.subjectKey;

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var row =
      rows[i];

    var rowSubjectKey =
      kidlearnV3_4c1ResolveSubjectKey_(
        kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
          'subjectCode',
          'subjectId',
          'mamonhoc',
          'Mãmônhọc'
        ]),
        ''
      );

    if (
      rowSubjectKey !== 'DEFAULT' &&
      rowSubjectKey !== subjectKey
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    var topicId =
      kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
        'topicId',
        'topicid',
        'machude',
        'Mãchủđề',
        'id'
      ]);

    var topicName =
      kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
        'topicName',
        'topicname',
        'tenchude',
        'Tênchủđề',
        'name',
        'title'
      ]);

    if (!topicId && !topicName) continue;

    result.push({
      topicId:
        String(topicId || 'TOPIC_' + (i + 1)),
      topicName:
        String(topicName || 'Chủ đề ' + (i + 1)),
      subjectKey: subjectKey,
      order:
        kidlearnV3_4c1ToNumber_(
          kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
            'displayOrder',
            'order',
            'sortOrder',
            'thutu'
          ]),
          i + 1
        )
    });
  }

  result.sort(function (a, b) {
    return a.order - b.order;
  });

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeLessons_(rows, subject, topics) {
  var result = [];
  var subjectKey =
    subject.subjectKey;

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var row =
      rows[i];

    var rowSubjectKey =
      kidlearnV3_4c1ResolveSubjectKey_(
        kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
          'subjectCode',
          'subjectId',
          'mamonhoc',
          'Mãmônhọc'
        ]),
        ''
      );

    if (
      rowSubjectKey !== 'DEFAULT' &&
      rowSubjectKey !== subjectKey
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    var lessonId =
      kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
        'lessonId',
        'lessonid',
        'mabaihoc',
        'Mãbàihọc',
        'id'
      ]);

    var lessonTitle =
      kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
        'lessonTitle',
        'lessonName',
        'lessonname',
        'title',
        'name',
        'tenbaihoc',
        'Tênbàihọc'
      ]);

    if (!lessonId && !lessonTitle) continue;

    var topicId =
      String(
        kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
          'topicId',
          'topicid',
          'machude',
          'Mãchủđề'
        ]) ||
        (
          topics[0]
            ? topics[0].topicId
            : 'TOPIC_GENERAL'
        )
      );

    var topic =
      kidlearnV3_4c1FindBy_(
        topics,
        'topicId',
        topicId
      );

    result.push({
      lessonId:
        String(lessonId || 'LESSON_' + subjectKey + '_' + (i + 1)),
      lessonTitle:
        String(lessonTitle || 'Bài học ' + (i + 1)),
      subjectKey: subjectKey,
      subjectCode: subject.subjectCode,
      topicId: topicId,
      topicName:
        topic ? topic.topicName : 'Chủ đề chung',
      estimatedMinutes:
        kidlearnV3_4c1ToNumber_(
          kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
            'estimatedMinutes',
            'durationMinutes',
            'minutes',
            'thoiluong',
            'Thờilượng'
          ]),
          8
        ),
      order:
        kidlearnV3_4c1ToNumber_(
          kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
            'displayOrder',
            'order',
            'sortOrder',
            'thutu'
          ]),
          i + 1
        ),
      difficulty:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
            'difficulty',
            'level',
            'mucdo',
            'Mứcđộ'
          ]) || 'Dễ'
        )
    });
  }

  result.sort(function (a, b) {
    return a.order - b.order;
  });

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeLessonProgress_(rows, child) {
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var row =

function kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeSkills_(rows, subject) {

    var rowSubjectKey =
      kidlearnV3_4c1ResolveSubjectKey_(
        kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
          'subjectCode',
          'subjectId',
          'mamonhoc'
        ]),
        ''
      );

    if (
      rowSubjectKey !== 'DEFAULT' &&
      rowSubjectKey !== subject.subjectKey
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    var skillId =
      kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
        'skillId',
        'skillid',
        'makynang',

        'id'
      ]);

    var skillName =
      kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
        'skillName',
        'skillname',
        'tenkynang',
        'Tênkỹnăng',
        'name',
        'title'
      ]);

    if (!skillId && !skillName) continue;

    result.push({
      skillId:
        String(skillId || 'SKILL_' + (i + 1)),
      skillName:
        String(skillName || 'Kỹ năng ' + (i + 1)),
      subjectKey:
        subject.subjectKey,
      order:
        kidlearnV3_4c1ToNumber_(

            'displayOrder',
            'order',
            'sortOrder',
            'thutu'
          ]),
          i + 1
        )
    });
  }

  if (result.length === 0) {
    result =
      kidlearnV3_4c1BuildFallbackSkills_(
        subject
      );
  }

  result.sort(function (a, b) {
    return a.order - b.order;
  });

  return result;
}

/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_4c1ResolveChild_(payload, childRows) {
  var childId =
    String(payload.childId || '');

  if (childId) {
    for (var i = 0; i < childRows.length; i++) {
      var row =
        childRows[i];

      var rowChildId =
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
            'childId',
            'childid',
            'machild',
            'id'
          ]) || ''
        );

      if (rowChildId === childId) {
        return {
          childId: rowChildId,
          childName:
            String(
              kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
                'childName',
                'childname',
                'tenbe',
                'name'
              ]) || 'Lịch Khê'
            ),
          grade:
            String(
              kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, [
                'grade',
                'lop',
                'class'
              ]) || '2'
            )
        };
      }
    }
  }

  if (childRows.length > 0) {
    var first =
      childRows[0];

    return {
      childId:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(first, [
            'childId',
            'childid',
            'machild',
            'id'
          ]) || 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT'
        ),
      childName:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(first, [
            'childName',

            'tenbe',
            'name'
          ]) || 'Lịch Khê'
        ),
      grade:
        String(
          kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(first, [
            'grade',
            'lop',
            'class'
          ]) || '2'
        )
    };
  }

  return {
    childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
    childName: 'Lịch Khê',
    grade: '2'
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1ResolveSelectedSubject_(payload, subjects) {
  var requestedKey =
    kidlearnV3_4c1ResolveSubjectKey_(
      payload.subjectCode || payload.subjectId || '',
      payload.subjectName || ''
    );

  for (var i = 0; i < subjects.length; i++) {
    if (subjects[i].subjectKey === requestedKey) {
      return subjects[i];
    }
  }

  return subjects[0] || kidlearnV3_4c1BuildFallbackSubjects_()[0];
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1BuildLessonCards_(
  lessons,
  topics,
  progressRows,
  assignments,
  reviewQueue
) {
  var cards = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < lessons.length; i++) {
    var lesson =
      lessons[i];

    var progress =
      kidlearnV3_4c1FindBy_(
        progressRows,
        'lessonId',
        lesson.lessonId
      );

    var assignment =
      kidlearnV3_4c1FindBy_(
        assignments,
        'lessonId',
        lesson.lessonId
      );

    var review =
      kidlearnV3_4c1FindBy_(
        reviewQueue,
        'lessonId',
        lesson.lessonId
      );

    var percent =
      progress
        ? kidlearnV3_4c1Clamp_(
            progress.progressPercent,
            0,
            100
          )
        : 0;

    var status =
      kidlearnV3_4c1ResolveLessonStatus_(
        progress,
        percent
      );

    cards.push({
      lessonId: lesson.lessonId,
      lessonTitle: lesson.lessonTitle,
      subjectKey: lesson.subjectKey,
      subjectCode: lesson.subjectCode,
      topicId: lesson.topicId,
      topicName: lesson.topicName,
      estimatedMinutes: lesson.estimatedMinutes,
      difficulty: lesson.difficulty,
      order: lesson.order,
      status: status,
      statusLabel:
        kidlearnV3_4c1StatusLabel_(status),
      progressPercent: percent,
      isAssigned: assignment !== null,
      isReviewDue: review !== null,
      reviewReason:
        review ? review.reviewReason : '',
      primaryAction:
        status === 'COMPLETED'
          ? 'Ôn lại'
          : status === 'IN_PROGRESS'
            ? 'Học tiếp'
            : 'Vào học'
    });
  }

  return cards;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1BuildProgressSummary_(lessonCards) {
  var total =
    lessonCards.length;

  var completed = 0;
  var inProgress = 0;
  var notStarted = 0;
  var sum = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < lessonCards.length; i++) {
    var card =
      lessonCards[i];

    sum +=
      kidlearnV3_4c1ToNumber_(
        card.progressPercent,
        0
      );

    if (card.status === 'COMPLETED') {
      completed++;
    } else if (card.status === 'IN_PROGRESS') {
      inProgress++;
    } else {
      notStarted++;
    }
  }

  return {
    totalLessons: total,
    completedLessons: completed,
    inProgressLessons: inProgress,
    notStartedLessons: notStarted,
    overallProgressPercent:
      total > 0
        ? Math.round(sum / total)
        : 0
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1PickNextLesson_(lessonCards) {
  if (lessonCards.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < lessonCards.length; i++) {
    if (lessonCards[i].status === 'IN_PROGRESS') {
      return lessonCards[i];
    }
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < lessonCards.length; j++) {
    if (lessonCards[j].status !== 'COMPLETED') {
      return lessonCards[j];
    }
  }

  return lessonCards[0];
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1BuildLessonGroups_(lessonCards) {
  var map = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < lessonCards.length; i++) {
    var card =
      lessonCards[i];

    var key =
      card.topicId || 'TOPIC_GENERAL';

    if (!map[key]) {
      map[key] = {
        topicId: key,
        topicName: card.topicName || 'Chủ đề chung',
        lessons: []
      };
    }

    map[key].lessons.push(card);
  }

  var groups = [];

  for (var topicId in map) {
    if (map.hasOwnProperty(topicId)) {
      groups.push(map[topicId]);
    }
  }

  return groups;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1BuildSkillCards_(
  skills,
  lessonSkillRows,
  skillProgressRows,
  lessonCards,
  subject
) {
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < skills.length; i++) {
    var skill =
      skills[i];

    var progress =
      kidlearnV3_4c1FindBy_(
        skillProgressRows,
        'skillId',
        skill.skillId
      );

    var relatedLessonCount = 0;

    for (var j = 0; j < lessonSkillRows.length; j++) {
      if (lessonSkillRows[j].skillId === skill.skillId) {
        relatedLessonCount++;
      }
    }

    result.push({
      skillId: skill.skillId,
      skillName: skill.skillName,
      subjectKey: subject.subjectKey,
      masteryPercent:
        progress
          ? kidlearnV3_4c1Clamp_(
              progress.masteryPercent,
              0,
              100
            )
          : 0,
      relatedLessonCount: relatedLessonCount,
      label:
        progress && progress.masteryPercent >= 80
          ? 'Rất tốt'
          : progress && progress.masteryPercent > 0
            ? 'Đang luyện'
            : 'Sắp học'
    });
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1BuildReviewItems_(
  reviewQueue,
  lessonCards,
  subject
) {
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < reviewQueue.length; i++) {
    var item =
      reviewQueue[i];

    var lesson =
      kidlearnV3_4c1FindBy_(
        lessonCards,
        'lessonId',
        item.lessonId
      );

    result.push({
      lessonId: item.lessonId,
      lessonTitle:
        lesson ? lesson.lessonTitle : 'Bài cần ôn',
      subjectKey: subject.subjectKey,
      reviewReason: item.reviewReason,
      priority: item.priority,
      actionLabel: 'Ôn tập'
    });
  }

  if (result.length === 0 && lessonCards.length > 0) {
    result.push({
      lessonId: lessonCards[0].lessonId,
      lessonTitle: lessonCards[0].lessonTitle,
      subjectKey: subject.subjectKey,
      reviewReason: 'Ôn nhẹ để nhớ lâu hơn',
      priority: 1,
      actionLabel: 'Ôn nhanh'
    });
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1BuildHero_(
  child,
  subject,
  theme,
  progressSummary,
  nextLesson
) {
  return {
    title:
      subject.subjectName,
    greeting:
      'Mình học ' + subject.subjectName + ' nhé, ' + child.childName + '!',
    subtitle:
      progressSummary.completedLessons > 0
        ? 'Con đã hoàn thành ' +
          progressSummary.completedLessons +

        : 'Bắt đầu từ bài đầu tiên và học từng bước thật vui.',
    primaryAction:
      nextLesson
        ? nextLesson.primaryAction
        : 'Bắt đầu học',
    primaryLessonId:
      nextLesson ? nextLesson.lessonId : '',
    progressPercent:
      progressSummary.overallProgressPercent,
    themeColor:
      theme.primary,
    themeGradient:
      theme.gradient
  };
}
