/**
 * Utility helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4c1ResolveSubjectTheme_(subject, themeMap) {
  var key =
    subject.subjectKey || 'DEFAULT';

  return themeMap[key] || themeMap.DEFAULT;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1ResolveSubjectKey_(code, name) {
  var text =
    String(code || '') +
    ' ' +
    String(name || '');

  text =
    text
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase()
      .normalize('NFD')
      .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
      .replace(/\s+/g, '')
      .replace(/-/g, '_');

  if (
    text.indexOf('MATH') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('TOAN') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('SUB_T') >= 0
  ) {
    return 'MATH';
  }

  if (
    text.indexOf('VIET') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('TIENGVIET') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('SUB_TV') >= 0
  ) {
    return 'VIETNAMESE';
  }

  if (
    text.indexOf('ENGLISH') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('TIENGANH') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('SUB_E') >= 0
  ) {
    return 'ENGLISH';
  }

  if (
    text.indexOf('SCIENCE') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('KHOAHOC') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('SUB_K') >= 0 ||
    text.indexOf('SUB_S') >= 0
  ) {
    return 'SCIENCE';
  }

  return 'DEFAULT';
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1SubjectNameFromKey_(key) {
  var map = {
    MATH: 'Toán học',
    VIETNAMESE: 'Tiếng Việt',
    ENGLISH: 'Tiếng Anh',
    SCIENCE: 'Khoa học',
    DEFAULT: 'Môn học'
  };

  return map[key] || map.DEFAULT;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1ResolveLessonStatus_(progress, percent) {
  if (!progress && percent <= 0) {
    return 'NOT_STARTED';
  }

  var raw =
    String(progress ? progress.status : '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    raw.indexOf('COMPLETE') >= 0 ||
    raw.indexOf('DONE') >= 0 ||
    raw.indexOf('HOANTHANH') >= 0 ||
    percent >= 100
  ) {
    return 'COMPLETED';
  }

  if (
    raw.indexOf('PROGRESS') >= 0 ||
    raw.indexOf('DANGHOC') >= 0 ||
    percent > 0
  ) {
    return 'IN_PROGRESS';
  }

  return 'NOT_STARTED';
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1StatusLabel_(status) {
  if (status === 'COMPLETED') return 'Hoàn thành';
  if (status === 'IN_PROGRESS') return 'Đang học';
  return 'Chưa học';
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1OpenSpreadsheet_() {
  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) return active;

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DEV spreadsheet.');
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1GetSheetByExactName_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1GetAny_(row, keys) {
  if (!row) return '';

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var key =
      keys[i];

    if (
      row.hasOwnProperty(key) &&
      row[key] !== null &&
      row[key] !== undefined &&
      String(row[key]).trim() !== ''
    ) {
      return row[key];
    }

    var normalized =
      kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeLookupKey_(key);

    for (var actual in row) {
      if (!row.hasOwnProperty(actual)) continue;

      if (
        kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeLookupKey_(actual) ===
        normalized
      ) {
        if (
          row[actual] !== null &&
          row[actual] !== undefined &&
          String(row[actual]).trim() !== ''
        ) {
          return row[actual];
        }
      }
    }
  }

  return '';
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1NormalizeLookupKey_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '')
    .replace(/[^\w]/g, '');
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1IsBlankRow_(row) {
  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    if (
      row[i] !== null &&
      row[i] !== undefined &&
      String(row[i]).trim() !== ''
    ) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  return true;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1FindBy_(items, field, value) {
  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    if (String(items[i][field]) === String(value)) {
      return items[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1ToNumber_(value, fallback) {
  var number =
    Number(value);

  if (isNaN(number)) {
    return fallback || 0;
  }

  return number;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1ToBool_(value, fallback) {
  if (
    value === null ||
    value === undefined ||
    String(value).trim() === ''
  ) {
    return fallback;
  }

  var text =
    String(value)
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    text === 'TRUE' ||
    text === 'YES' ||
    text === 'ACTIVE' ||
    text === '1' ||
    text === 'ĐÚNG' ||
    text === 'DUNG'
  ) {
    return true;
  }

  if (
    text === 'FALSE' ||
    text === 'NO' ||
    text === 'INACTIVE' ||
    text === '0' ||
    text === 'SAI'
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  return fallback;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1Clamp_(value, min, max) {
  var number =
    kidlearnV3_4c1ToNumber_(value, min);

  if (number < min) return min;
  if (number > max) return max;

  return number;
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4c1SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =

      errors:

    })

function kidlearnV3_4c1ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =

      context.message

    kidlearnV3_4c2InspectUiMarkers_();

    uiName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_UI_4C2_CONFIG.UI_NAME,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_UI_4C2_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    subjectThemeDecision: {
      math: 'blue',
      vietnamese: 'orange',
      english: 'green',
      science: 'red'
    },
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    markerCheck: marker,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  }

  return {

  };

function kidlearnV3_4c2pSafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4c2pSaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_PATCH_4C2P_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_PATCH_4C2P_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase: result.phase,
      status: status,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}

  var errors = [];

  try {

  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Styles_4A: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  /**
   * Chỉ kiểm tra marker CSS chức năng thật.
   * Không bắt buộc comment marker vì comment có thể bị mất khi copy/paste.
   */
  var requiredMarkers = [
    '.kl-hero-card .kl-hero-kicker',
    '.kl-hero-card .kl-primary-btn',
    '.kl-hero-card .kl-secondary-btn:hover',
    '.kl-subject-card-4b.subject-blue',
    '.kl-subject-card-4b.subject-purple',
    '.kl-subject-card-4b.subject-pink',
    '.kl-subject-card-4b.subject-green',
    '--kl-card-blue-pastel',
    '--kl-card-green-pastel',
    '--kl-card-yellow-pastel',
    '--kl-card-purple-pastel',
    '--kl-contrast-dark',
    '--kl-contrast-white'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < requiredMarkers.length; i++) {
    if (styles.indexOf(requiredMarkers[i]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        'CSS thiếu contrast patch marker: ' +
        requiredMarkers[i]
      );
    }
  }

  if (styles.indexOf('KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4B-2R-3P') === -1) {
    warnings.push(
      'CSS không thấy comment marker KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4B-2R-3P, nhưng không ảnh hưởng UI nếu marker chức năng đã đủ.'
    );
  }

  if (styles.indexOf('contrast-pass-4b2r3p') === -1) {
    warnings.push(
      'CSS không thấy comment marker contrast-pass-4b2r3p, nhưng không ảnh hưởng UI nếu marker chức năng đã đủ.'
    );
  }

  if (styles.indexOf('#0F172A') === -1) {
    warnings.push('CSS chưa thấy màu chữ đậm #0F172A.');
  }

  if (styles.indexOf('#FFFFFF') === -1) {
    warnings.push('CSS chưa thấy màu trắng #FFFFFF.');
  }

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var statusBefore =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_COLOR_PATCH_4B2R3P_KEYS.STATUS
    ) ||
    KIDLEARN_V3_COLOR_PATCH_4B2R3P_STATUS.NOT_RUN;

  /**
   * Quan trọng:
   * Nếu trước đó đã READY_FOR_VISUAL_REVIEW,
   * thì check lại không được kéo status lùi về CHECK_PASSED.
   */
  var statusAfter;

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    statusAfter =
      KIDLEARN_V3_COLOR_PATCH_4B2R3P_STATUS.FAILED;
  } else if (
    statusBefore ===
    KIDLEARN_V3_COLOR_PATCH_4B2R3P_STATUS.READY_FOR_VISUAL_REVIEW
  ) {
    statusAfter =
      KIDLEARN_V3_COLOR_PATCH_4B2R3P_STATUS.READY_FOR_VISUAL_REVIEW;
  } else {
    statusAfter =
      KIDLEARN_V3_COLOR_PATCH_4B2R3P_STATUS.CHECK_PASSED;
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'CHECK_COLOR_CONTRAST_PATCH_4B_2R_3P_V3',
    phase: '4B-2R-3P',
    patch: 'COLOR_CONTRAST_AND_PASTEL_SUBJECT_CARDS',
    statusBefore: statusBefore,
    statusAfter: statusAfter,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  kidlearnV3_4b2r3pSaveStatus_(
    result,
    statusAfter,
    KIDLEARN_V3_COLOR_PATCH_4B2R3P_KEYS.LAST_CHECK_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Color contrast patch check failed. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

    reviewName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_POLISH_REVIEW_4B2R6_CONFIG.REVIEW_NAME,
    scorePercent: score,
    decision:
      String(options.decision || ''),
    reviewerNote:
      String(options.reviewerNote || ''),
    acceptedForCurrentPhase: true,
    moveFurtherPolishToFutureBacklog: true,
    futureUiBacklog: [
      'Replace hero emoji/visual with approved mascot or illustration.',
      'Use approved Google Drive assets from MST_MediaAssets.',

  kidlearnV3_4b2r6SaveStatus_(

/**
 * Helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4b2r6SafeCheck_(label, functionName, required) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        label: label,
        functionName: functionName,
        required: required === true,
        success: false,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      label: label,
      functionName: functionName,
      required: required === true,
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? 'OK'
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      outputSummary:
        kidlearnV3_4b2r6SummarizeOutput_(output)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      label: label,
      functionName: functionName,
      required: required === true,
      success: false,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r6SummarizeOutput_(output) {
  if (!output) return null;

  return {
    success: output.success === true,
    action: output.action || '',
    phase: output.phase || '',
    status: output.status || '',
    nextBundle: output.nextBundle || '',
    errorCount: output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount: output.warningCount || 0
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r6SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_POLISH_REVIEW_4B2R6_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_POLISH_REVIEW_4B2R6_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase: result.phase,
      parentPhase: result.parentPhase || '4B-2R',
      status: status,
      reviewName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_POLISH_REVIEW_4B2R6_CONFIG.REVIEW_NAME,
      scorePercent:
        result.scorePercent || '',
      decision:
        result.decision || '',
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_POLISH_REVIEW_4B2R6_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_POLISH_REVIEW_4B2R6_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r6ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

function kidlearnV3_checkLoginFullScreen4B2RV3() {

    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Styles_4A: ' +

    );

  var shellMarkers = [
    'kl-login-fullscreen',

    warnings.push('CSS không thấy Nunito Sans.');

/**
 * Helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4b2r2SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r2SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REVISION_4B2R2_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REVISION_4B2R2_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase: result.phase,
      parentPhase: result.parentPhase || '4B-2R',
      status: status,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REVISION_4B2R2_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REVISION_4B2R2_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r2ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r2RunLocalBatch_(suiteName, steps) {
  var results = [];
  var failed = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) {
    var step =
      steps[i];

    try {
      var fn =
        eval(step.functionName);

      var output =
        fn();

      var ok =
        output && output.success === true;

      if (!ok) failed++;

      results.push({
        label: step.label,
        functionName: step.functionName,
        success: ok,
        output: output
      });

      if (!ok) break;

    } catch (error) {
      failed++;

      results.push({
        label: step.label,
        functionName: step.functionName,
        success: false,
        error:
          String(error.message || error)
      });

      break;
    }
  }

  var result = {
    success: failed === 0,
    suiteName: suiteName,
    phase: '4B-2R-2',
    stepCount: steps.length,
    failedStepCount: failed,
    results: results
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      suiteName +
      ' failed. failedStepCount=' +
      failed
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Internal marker inspection.
 * Revised: kiểm tra token thật, không bắt buộc comment marker.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4b2r3InspectBlueTokens_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var styles = '';

  try {
    styles =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Styles_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Styles_4A: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var requiredMarkers = [
    'kl-blue-identity-token',
    '--kl-primary: #2F80ED',
    '--kl-primary-deep: #1D4ED8',
    '--kl-sky-blue: #38BDF8',
    '--kl-soft-blue-bg: #EAF4FF',
    '--kl-reward-yellow: #FBBF24',
    '--kl-green-accent: #22C55E',
    'linear-gradient(135deg, #2F80ED, #38BDF8)',
    '.kl-login-fullscreen',
    '.kl-primary-btn',
    '.kl-hero-card',
    '.kl-next-lesson-card'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < requiredMarkers.length; i++) {
    if (styles.indexOf(requiredMarkers[i]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        'CSS thiếu blue token marker: ' +
        requiredMarkers[i]
      );
    }
  }

  /**
   * Comment marker chỉ là warning, không phải lỗi.
   * Một số lần copy/paste CSS có thể mất comment,
   * nhưng miễn token màu thật còn đầy đủ thì UI vẫn đúng.
   */
  if (styles.indexOf('KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4B-2R-3') === -1) {
    warnings.push(
      'CSS không thấy comment marker 4B-2R-3, nhưng không ảnh hưởng UI nếu token màu đã đủ.'
    );
  }

  if (styles.indexOf('Be Vietnam Pro') === -1) {
    warnings.push('CSS không thấy Be Vietnam Pro.');
  }

  if (styles.indexOf('Nunito Sans') === -1) {
    warnings.push('CSS không thấy Nunito Sans.');
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,

}


/**
 * Helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4b2r3SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r3SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REVISION_4B2R3_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REVISION_4B2R3_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase: result.phase,
      parentPhase: result.parentPhase || '4B-2R',
      status: status,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REVISION_4B2R3_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REVISION_4B2R3_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r3ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2r3RunLocalBatch_(suiteName, steps) {
  var results = [];
  var failed = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) {
    var step =
      steps[i];

    try {
      var fn =
        eval(step.functionName);

      var output =
        fn();

      var ok =
        output && output.success === true;

      if (!ok) failed++;

      results.push({
        label: step.label,
        functionName: step.functionName,
        success: ok,
        output: output
      });

      if (!ok) break;

    } catch (error) {
      failed++;

      results.push({
        label: step.label,
        functionName: step.functionName,
        success: false,
        error:
          String(error.message || error)
      });

      break;
    }
  }

  var result = {
    success: failed === 0,
    suiteName: suiteName,
    phase: '4B-2R-3',
    stepCount: steps.length,
    failedStepCount: failed,
    results: results
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      suiteName +
      ' failed. failedStepCount=' +
      failed
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Internal marker inspection.
 * Revised: kiểm tra marker chức năng thật, không bắt buộc comment marker.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4b2r4InspectSubjectSvgIcons_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var shell = '';
  var clientAssets = '';
  var styles = '';

  try {
    shell =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Shell_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Shell_4A: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  try {
    clientAssets =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Client_Assets_4B2R4')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error2) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_Assets_4B2R4: ' +
      String(error2.message || error2)
    );
  }

  try {
    styles =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Styles_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error3) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Styles_4A: ' +
      String(error3.message || error3)
    );
  }

  var shellMarkers = [
    'UI_Product_Client_Assets_4B2R4',
    'UI_Product_Client_4A'
  ];

  var clientMarkers = [
    'KIDLEARN_SUBJECT_ASSETS_4B2R4',
    'subject_math_builtin_svg',
    'subject_vietnamese_builtin_svg',
    'subject_english_builtin_svg',
    'subject_science_builtin_svg',
    'resolveSubjectAsset4B2R4',
    'applySubjectAssets4B2R4',
    'MutationObserver',
    'has-svg-4b2r4'
  ];

  var styleMarkers = [
    'kl-asset-svg-4b2r4',
    'kl-subject-icon.has-svg-4b2r4',
    'kl-next-icon.has-svg-4b2r4',
    'kl-subject-detail-icon.has-svg-4b2r4',
    'kl-svg-subject-icon-4b2r4'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < shellMarkers.length; i++) {
    if (shell.indexOf(shellMarkers[i]) === -1) {
      errors.push('Shell thiếu marker: ' + shellMarkers[i]);
    }
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < clientMarkers.length; j++) {
    if (clientAssets.indexOf(clientMarkers[j]) === -1) {
      errors.push('Client asset thiếu marker: ' + clientMarkers[j]);
    }
  }

  for (var k = 0; k < styleMarkers.length; k++) {
    if (styles.indexOf(styleMarkers[k]) === -1) {
      errors.push('CSS thiếu marker: ' + styleMarkers[k]);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Comment marker chỉ là warning.
   * Một số lần copy/paste HTML có thể mất comment,
   * nhưng miễn marker chức năng còn đủ thì icon vẫn hoạt động.
   */
  if (clientAssets.indexOf('KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4B-2R-4') === -1) {
    warnings.push(
      'Client asset không thấy comment marker 4B-2R-4, nhưng không ảnh hưởng UI nếu các marker chức năng đã đủ.'
    );
  }

  if (styles.indexOf('Be Vietnam Pro') === -1) {
    warnings.push('CSS không thấy Be Vietnam Pro.');
  }

  if (styles.indexOf('Nunito Sans') === -1) {
    warnings.push('CSS không thấy Nunito Sans.');
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'INSPECT_SUBJECT_SVG_ICONS_4B_2R_4_V3',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REVISION_4B2R4_CONFIG.PHASE,
    uiRevision:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_REVISION_4B2R4_CONFIG.UI_REVISION,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    builtInAssets: [
      'subject_math_builtin_svg',
      'subject_vietnamese_builtin_svg',
      'subject_english_builtin_svg',
      'subject_science_builtin_svg'
    ],
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}

/**
 * Check UI markers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4b2CheckUiMarkers_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var shell = '';
  var client = '';
  var styles = '';

  try {
    shell =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Shell_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Shell_4A: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  try {
    client =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Client_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error2) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_4A: ' +
      String(error2.message || error2)
    );
  }

  try {
    styles =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Styles_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error3) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Styles_4A: ' +
      String(error3.message || error3)
    );
  }

  var requiredShellMarkers = [
    'nextLessonCard',
    'courseSummaryGrid',
    'recommendedLessonsList',
    'subjectDetailScreen',
    'subjectDetailTitle'
  ];

  var requiredClientMarkers = [
    'kidlearnV3_getChildHomeCourseContext4BV3',
    'renderChildHome4B',
    'renderCourses4B',
    'openSubjectDetail4B'
  ];

  var requiredStyleMarkers = [
    'kl-next-lesson-card',
    'kl-course-summary-grid',
    'kl-recommended-list',
    'kl-subject-detail-hero'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < requiredShellMarkers.length; i++) {
    if (shell.indexOf(requiredShellMarkers[i]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        'Shell thiếu marker: ' +
        requiredShellMarkers[i]
      );
    }
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < requiredClientMarkers.length; j++) {
    if (client.indexOf(requiredClientMarkers[j]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        'Client thiếu marker: ' +
        requiredClientMarkers[j]
      );
    }
  }

  for (var k = 0; k < requiredStyleMarkers.length; k++) {
    if (styles.indexOf(requiredStyleMarkers[k]) === -1) {
      errors.push(
        'CSS thiếu marker: ' +
        requiredStyleMarkers[k]
      );
    }
  }

  if (styles.indexOf('Be Vietnam Pro') === -1) {
    warnings.push('CSS không thấy Be Vietnam Pro.');
  }

  if (styles.indexOf('Nunito Sans') === -1) {
    warnings.push('CSS không thấy Nunito Sans.');
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Safe call.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4b2SafeCall_(functionName, arg) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      typeof arg === 'undefined'
        ? fn()
        : fn(arg);

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Save status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4b2SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_UPGRADE_4B2_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_UPGRADE_4B2_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase: result.phase,
      parentPhase: result.parentPhase || '4B',
      status: status,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_UPGRADE_4B2_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4b2ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed:
      kidlearnV3_4d6GetGateMode_() ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED,
    message:
      'UI Controlled Write Gate ready. Gate mặc định có thể vẫn đóng dry-run.',
    markedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_4d6SaveStatus_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_7,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


/**
 * Open UI controlled write gate.
 * Không ghi sheet ngay tại function này.
 * Sau khi mở, thao tác từ UI mới có thể ghi DEV.
 */
function kidlearnV3_openUiControlledWriteGate4D6ConfirmV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_setUiControlledWriteGate4D6V3({
    confirm:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.OPEN_CONFIRM_TEXT,
    gateMode:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED,
    reviewerNote:
      'Open UI controlled write gate for DEV only.'
  });
}


/**
 * Close UI controlled write gate.
 */
function kidlearnV3_closeUiControlledWriteGate4D6ConfirmV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_setUiControlledWriteGate4D6V3({
    confirm:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.CLOSE_CONFIRM_TEXT,
    gateMode:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY,
    reviewerNote:
      'Close UI controlled write gate. UI returns to dry-run only.'
  });
}


/**
 * Set gate mode.
 */
function kidlearnV3_setUiControlledWriteGate4D6V3(options) {
  options = options || {};

  var requestedMode =
    String(options.gateMode || '').trim();

  var confirmText =
    String(options.confirm || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (
    requestedMode ===
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED
  ) {
    if (
      confirmText !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.OPEN_CONFIRM_TEXT
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        'Thiếu confirm mở gate. Cần confirm=' +
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.OPEN_CONFIRM_TEXT
      );
    }
  } else if (
    requestedMode ===
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY
  ) {
    if (
      confirmText !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.CLOSE_CONFIRM_TEXT
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        'Thiếu confirm đóng gate. Cần confirm=' +
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.CLOSE_CONFIRM_TEXT
      );
    }
  } else {
    throw new Error(
      'gateMode không hợp lệ: ' + requestedMode
    );
  }

  var readiness =
    kidlearnV3_4d6BuildGateReadiness_();

  if (!readiness.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4D-6 readiness chưa pass. Errors=' +
      readiness.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_KEYS.GATE_MODE,
      requestedMode
    );

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'SET_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D_6_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_7,
    gateMode: requestedMode,
    previousGateMode:
      readiness.gateMode,
    reviewerNote:
      String(options.reviewerNote || ''),
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed:
      requestedMode ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    message:
      requestedMode ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED
        ? 'UI write gate opened for controlled DEV real writes.'
        : 'UI write gate closed. UI is dry-run only.',
    changedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_4d6SaveStatus_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_7,
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_KEYS.LAST_GATE_CHANGE_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


/**
 * UI submits one answer.
 * Gate closed: dry-run only.
 * Gate open: write DATA_Responses + DATA_LessonProgress on DEV.
 */
function kidlearnV3_submitLessonActivityFromUi4D6V3(payload) {
  payload = payload || {};

  var guard =
    kidlearnV3_4d6BuildRuntimeGuard_();

  var normalized =
    kidlearnV3_4d6NormalizeUiAnswerPayload_(payload);

  if (
    guard.gateMode !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED
  ) {
    var dryRun =
      kidlearnV3_dryRunSubmitAnswer4C5V3(normalized);

    return {
      success: true,
      action: 'UI_SUBMIT_LESSON_ACTIVITY_4D_6_DRY_RUN_ONLY_V3',
      phase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.PHASE,
      gateMode: guard.gateMode,
      mode: 'DRY_RUN_ONLY',
      dryRun: dryRun,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
      childMessage:
        dryRun.childMessage ||
        'Đã nhận câu trả lời thử. Chưa lưu dữ liệu thật.',
      parentMessage:
        'Gate is closed. UI submit used dry-run only.'
    };
  }

  var responseWrite =
    kidlearnV3_realWriteDataResponses4D3V3({
      confirm: 'CONFIRM_REAL_WRITE_DATA_RESPONSES_4D3',
      payload: normalized,
      reviewerNote:
        '4D-6 UI controlled write: submit answer from Lesson Player.'
    });

  var progressPayload =
    kidlearnV3_4d6BuildProgressPayloadFromAnswer_(
      normalized
    );

  var progressWrite =
    kidlearnV3_realWriteDataLessonProgress4D4V3({
      confirm:
        'CONFIRM_REAL_WRITE_DATA_LESSON_PROGRESS_4D4',
      payload:
        progressPayload,
      reviewerNote:
        '4D-6 UI controlled write: update lesson progress after answer submit.'
    });

  var result = {
    success:
      responseWrite.success === true &&
      progressWrite.success === true,
    action: 'UI_SUBMIT_LESSON_ACTIVITY_4D_6_REAL_WRITE_DEV_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.PHASE,
    gateMode: guard.gateMode,
    mode: 'OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED',
    childId: normalized.childId,
    lessonId: normalized.lessonId,
    activityId: normalized.activityId,
    answerMode: normalized.answerMode,
    writes: {
      DATA_Responses: {
        success: responseWrite.success,
        responseId: responseWrite.responseId,
        rowNumber: responseWrite.responseRowNumber,
        rowDelta:
          responseWrite.rowDelta
            ? responseWrite.rowDelta.DATA_Responses
            : ''
      },
      DATA_LessonProgress: {
        success: progressWrite.success,
        progressId: progressWrite.progressId,
        rowNumber: progressWrite.progressRowNumber,
        operationMode: progressWrite.operationMode,
        rowDelta:
          progressWrite.rowDelta
            ? progressWrite.rowDelta.DATA_LessonProgress
            : ''
      },
      LOG_Audit: {
        responseAuditId: responseWrite.auditId,
        progressAuditId: progressWrite.auditId
      }
    },
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: true,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: true,
    childMessage:
      'Đã lưu câu trả lời vào DEV. Giỏi lắm!',
    parentMessage:
      'UI controlled DEV write completed for response and lesson progress.',
    writtenAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


/**
 * UI completes lesson.
 * Gate closed: dry-run only.
 * Gate open: write DATA_LessonProgress + DATA_StudySessions on DEV.
 */
function kidlearnV3_completeLessonFromUi4D6V3(payload) {
  payload = payload || {};

        durationSeconds: normalized.durationSeconds,
        updatedAt: normalized.completedAt
      },
      reviewerNote:
        '4D-6 UI controlled write: complete study session.'
    });

  var result = {
    success:
      progressWrite.success === true &&
      sessionWrite.success === true,
    action: 'UI_COMPLETE_LESSON_4D_6_REAL_WRITE_DEV_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.PHASE,
    gateMode: guard.gateMode,
    mode: 'OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED',
    childId: normalized.childId,
    lessonId: normalized.lessonId,
    writes: {
      DATA_LessonProgress: {
        success: progressWrite.success,
        progressId: progressWrite.progressId,
        rowNumber: progressWrite.progressRowNumber,
        operationMode: progressWrite.operationMode
      },
      DATA_StudySessions: {
        success: sessionWrite.success,
        sessionId: sessionWrite.sessionId,
        rowNumber: sessionWrite.sessionRowNumber,
        operationMode: sessionWrite.operationMode
      },
      LOG_Audit: {
        progressAuditId: progressWrite.auditId,
        sessionAuditId: sessionWrite.auditId
      }
    },
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: true,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: true,
    childMessage:
      'Đã lưu hoàn thành bài học vào DEV. Con rất cố gắng!',
    parentMessage:
      'UI controlled DEV write completed for lesson completion.',
    writtenAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}

      )
  };

/**
 * Assert 4D-6 ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertUiControlledWriteGate4D6ReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getUiControlledWriteGate4D6StatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_7
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '4D-6 chưa READY_FOR_4D_7. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D_6_READY_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status: status.status,
    gateMode: status.gateMode,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: status.realWriteAllowed,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(errors.join(' | '));
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * QA batch 4D-6.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaBatch4D6V3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewUiControlledWriteGate4D6V3();

  var ready =
    kidlearnV3_markUiControlledWriteGate4D6ReadyV3();

  var assertReady =
    kidlearnV3_assertUiControlledWriteGate4D6ReadyV3();

  var result = {
    success:
      preview.success === true &&
      ready.success === true &&
      assertReady.success === true,
    suiteName:
      'PHASE_4D_6_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.PHASE,
    gateMode:
      kidlearnV3_4d6GetGateMode_(),
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed:
      kidlearnV3_4d6GetGateMode_() ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED,
    results: {
      preview: preview.success,
      ready: ready.success,
      assertReady: assertReady.success
    }
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error('4D-6 QA batch failed.');
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Readiness.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d6BuildGateReadiness_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var d5 =
    kidlearnV3_4d6SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertStudySessionRealWrite4D5ReadyV3'
    );

  if (!d5.success) {
    errors.push(
      '4D-5 chưa READY_FOR_4D_6: ' +
      d5.message
    );
  }

  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4d6CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(dev.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(dev.warnings || []);

  var marker =
    kidlearnV3_4d6InspectUiMarkers_();

  if (!marker.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(marker.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(marker.warnings || []);

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'BUILD_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_READINESS_4D_6_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.PHASE,
    gateName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.GATE_NAME,
    gateMode:
      kidlearnV3_4d6GetGateMode_(),
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed:
      kidlearnV3_4d6GetGateMode_() ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    prerequisite: {
      phase4D5Ready: d5.success
    },
    devSafety: dev,
    uiMarkerCheck: marker,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount:
      kidlearnV3_4d6UniqueArray_(warnings).length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings:
      kidlearnV3_4d6UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };
}


/**
 * Inspect UI markers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d6InspectUiMarkers_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var shell = '';
  var client = '';
  var styles = '';

  try {
    shell =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Shell_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Shell_4A: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  try {
    client =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Client_WriteGate_4D6')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error2) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Client_WriteGate_4D6: ' +
      String(error2.message || error2)
    );
  }

  try {
    styles =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile('UI_Product_Styles_4A')
        .getContent();
  } catch (error3) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được UI_Product_Styles_4A: ' +
      String(error3.message || error3)
    );
  }

  var shellMarkers = [
    'UI_Product_Client_WriteGate_4D6',
    'UI_Product_Client_LessonInteraction_DryRun_4C5'
  ];

  var clientMarkers = [
    'KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6',
    'kidlearnV3_getUiControlledWriteGate4D6StatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_submitLessonActivityFromUi4D6V3',
    'kidlearnV3_completeLessonFromUi4D6V3',
    'collectAnswerPayloadForWriteGate4D6',
    'submitAnswerThroughWriteGate4D6',
    'completeLessonThroughWriteGate4D6',
    'showWriteGateFeedback4D6'
  ];

  var styleMarkers = [
    '.kl-write-gate-badge-4d6',
    '.kl-write-gate-feedback-4d6',
    '.kl-write-gate-feedback-4d6.is-real',
    '.kl-write-gate-feedback-4d6.is-dryrun',
    '.kl-write-gate-feedback-4d6.is-error'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < shellMarkers.length; i++) {
    if (shell.indexOf(shellMarkers[i]) === -1) {
      errors.push('Shell thiếu marker: ' + shellMarkers[i]);
    }
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < clientMarkers.length; j++) {
    if (client.indexOf(clientMarkers[j]) === -1) {
      errors.push('Client 4D-6 thiếu marker: ' + clientMarkers[j]);
    }
  }

  for (var k = 0; k < styleMarkers.length; k++) {
    if (styles.indexOf(styleMarkers[k]) === -1) {
      errors.push('CSS 4D-6 thiếu marker: ' + styleMarkers[k]);
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'INSPECT_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_MARKERS_4D_6_V3',
    phase: '4D-6',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Runtime guard.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d6BuildRuntimeGuard_() {
  var dev =
    kidlearnV3_4d6CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!dev.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'DEV safety failed: ' +
      dev.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var d5 =
    kidlearnV3_4d6SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertStudySessionRealWrite4D5ReadyV3'
    );

  if (!d5.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4D-5 chưa READY_FOR_4D_6: ' +
      d5.message
    );
  }

  return {
    success: true,
    gateMode:
      kidlearnV3_4d6GetGateMode_(),
    environment:
      dev.environment,
    prodWriteAllowed: false
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4d6GetGateMode_() {
  var mode =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_KEYS.GATE_MODE
      );

  if (!mode) {
    mode =
      KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_MODE.CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY;

    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .setProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_KEYS.GATE_MODE,
        mode
      );
  }

  return mode;
}


/**
 * Payload helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d6NormalizeUiAnswerPayload_(payload) {
  payload = payload || {};

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_4d3NormalizeResponsePayload_ === 'function'
  ) {
    var normalized =
      kidlearnV3_4d3NormalizeResponsePayload_(payload);

    normalized.progressPercent =
      Number(payload.progressPercent || 50);

    normalized.currentStepIndex =
      Number(payload.currentStepIndex || 0);

    normalized.startedAt =
      String(payload.startedAt || new Date().toISOString());

    return normalized;
  }

  return {
    childId:
      String(payload.childId || 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT'),
    lessonId:
      String(payload.lessonId || ''),
    activityId:
      String(payload.activityId || ''),
    subjectCode:
      String(payload.subjectCode || payload.subjectKey || ''),
    answerMode:
      String(payload.answerMode || 'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase(),
    answerText:
      String(payload.answerText || ''),
    expectedAnswer:
      String(payload.expectedAnswer || ''),
    selectedOptionId:
      String(payload.selectedOptionId || ''),
    selectedOptionLabel:
      String(payload.selectedOptionLabel || ''),
    isCorrect:
      payload.isCorrect === undefined ? '' : payload.isCorrect,
    score:
      payload.score === undefined ? '' : payload.score,
    canvasHasInk:
      payload.canvasHasInk === true,
    canvasDataUrlLength:
      Number(payload.canvasDataUrlLength || 0),
    progressPercent:
      Number(payload.progressPercent || 50),
    currentStepIndex:
      Number(payload.currentStepIndex || 0),
    startedAt:
      String(payload.startedAt || new Date().toISOString())
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4d6BuildProgressPayloadFromAnswer_(answer) {
  var percent =
    Number(answer.progressPercent || 50);

  if (isNaN(percent)) percent = 50;
  if (percent < 1) percent = 1;
  if (percent > 99) percent = 99;

  return {
    childId:
      answer.childId,
    lessonId:
      answer.lessonId,
    subjectCode:
      answer.subjectCode,
    status:
      'IN_PROGRESS',
    progressPercent:
      percent,
    currentStepIndex:
      Number(answer.currentStepIndex || 0),
    startedAt:
      answer.startedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
    completedAt:
      '',
    updatedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4d6NormalizeUiCompletePayload_(payload) {
  payload = payload || {};

  var now =
    new Date();

  var startedAt =
    String(
      payload.startedAt ||
      new Date(now.getTime() - 5 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()
    );

  var completedAt =
    String(payload.completedAt || now.toISOString());

  var durationSeconds =
    Number(payload.durationSeconds || 300);

  if (isNaN(durationSeconds) || durationSeconds < 0) {
    durationSeconds = 300;
  }

  return {
    sessionId:
      String(payload.sessionId || ''),
    childId:
      String(payload.childId || 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT'),
    lessonId:
      String(payload.lessonId || ''),
    subjectCode:
      String(payload.subjectCode || payload.subjectKey || ''),
    completedStepCount:
      Number(payload.completedStepCount || 0),
    startedAt:
      startedAt,
    completedAt:
      completedAt,
    durationSeconds:
      durationSeconds
  };
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d6CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        PropertiesService
          .getScriptProperties()
          .getProperty(
            KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
          ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      PropertiesService
        .getScriptProperties()
        .getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (
    String(environment || '').toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
      (environment || 'UNKNOWN')
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    environment: environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d6SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName
      };
    }

    var output =
      eval(functionName)();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4d6UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d6SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.PHASE,
      status: status,
      gateMode:
        result.gateMode || kidlearnV3_4d6GetGateMode_(),
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed:
        kidlearnV3_4d6GetGateMode_() ===
        KIDLEARN_V3_UI_WRITE_GATE_4D6_MODE.OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED,
      actualSheetWritePerformed:
        result.actualSheetWritePerformed === true,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4d6ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - PRODUCT WEB APP SHELL
 * Phase: 4A-1C
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * File này được Web App Gateway 4A-1A gọi.
 *
 * Safety:
 * - Không tạo doGet mới.
 * - Không ghi PROD.
 * - Không ghi Google Sheet.
 * - Không gọi Safe Write.
 * - Không gọi Gemini/API.
 */


/**
 * Hàm này được Gateway 4A-1A gọi.
 *
 * @param {Object} e Apps Script event object
 * @return {HtmlOutput}
 */
function kidlearnV3_productDoGet4A(e) {
  var request =
    kidlearnV3_productNormalizeRequest4A_(e);

  var context;

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_buildInitialProductShellContext4A1CV3 === 'function'
  ) {
    context =
      kidlearnV3_buildInitialProductShellContext4A1CV3(request);
  } else {
    context =
      kidlearnV3_buildFallbackProductShellContext4A_(request);
  }

  var template =
    HtmlService.createTemplateFromFile('UI_Product_Shell_4A');

  template.bootstrapJson =
    JSON.stringify(context)
      .replace(/</g, '\\u003c')
      .replace(/>/g, '\\u003e')
      .replace(/&/g, '\\u0026');

  return template
    .evaluate()
    .setTitle('KID LEARN - Học vui mỗi ngày')
    .addMetaTag(
      'viewport',
      'width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1'
    )
    .setXFrameOptionsMode(
      HtmlService.XFrameOptionsMode.ALLOWALL
    );
}


/**
 * Preview Product Shell.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewProductShell4A1BV3() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_productDoGet4A({
      parameter: {
        app: 'v3'
      }
    });

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'PREVIEW_PRODUCT_SHELL_4A_V3',
    phase: '4A-1C',
    productShellInstalled: true,
    htmlOutputCreated: context ? true : false,
    writeMode: 'READ_ONLY_UI_SHELL',
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  return result;
}


/**
 * Smoke test Product Shell files.
 */
function kidlearnV3_smokeTestProductShell4A1BV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  if (typeof kidlearnV3_productDoGet4A !== 'function') {
    errors.push('Thiếu kidlearnV3_productDoGet4A.');
  }

  var htmlFiles = [
    'UI_Product_Shell_4A',
    'UI_Product_Styles_4A',
    'UI_Product_Client_4A'
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < htmlFiles.length; i++) {
    try {
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile(htmlFiles[i])
        .getContent();
    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(
        'Không tải được HTML file: ' +
        htmlFiles[i] +
        '. ' +
        String(error.message || error)
      );
    }
  }

  if (typeof kidlearnV3_webAppGateway4A !== 'function') {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy kidlearnV3_webAppGateway4A. Cần kiểm tra lại 4A-1A.'
    );
  }

  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_buildInitialProductShellContext4A1CV3 !== 'function'
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'Chưa có Product Auth Context 4A-1C. Sau khi tạo Product_Auth_Context_4A_V3.gs warning này sẽ hết.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'SMOKE_TEST_PRODUCT_SHELL_4A_V3',
    phase: '4A-1C',
    productShellInstalled:
      typeof kidlearnV3_productDoGet4A === 'function',
    authContextInstalled:
      typeof kidlearnV3_buildInitialProductShellContext4A1CV3 === 'function',
    htmlFiles: htmlFiles,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Product Shell smoke failed. Errors=' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Normalize product request.
 *
 * @param {Object} e Apps Script event object
 * @return {Object}
 */
function kidlearnV3_productNormalizeRequest4A_(e) {
  var parameter =
    e && e.parameter
      ? e.parameter
      : {};

  var app =
    String(parameter.app || 'v3')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

  var role =
    String(parameter.role || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  var page =
    String(parameter.page || '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();

  return {
    app: app,
    role: role,
    page: page,
    rawParameter: parameter
  };
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - WRITE CONTRACT + SCHEMA READINESS CHECK
 * Step: 4D-1
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * Purpose:
 * - Check schema readiness before controlled DEV real writes.
 * - Validate write contracts for:
 *   1. DATA_Responses
 *   2. DATA_LessonProgress
 *   3. DATA_StudySessions
 *   4. LOG_Audit
 *
 * Safety:
 * - Không ghi Google Sheet dữ liệu học.
 * - Không append/update/delete bất kỳ row nào.
 * - Không ghi PROD.
 * - Chỉ ghi ScriptProperties trạng thái kỹ thuật 4D-1.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D1_STATUS',
  LAST_PREVIEW_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D1_LAST_PREVIEW_AT',
  LAST_CHECK_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D1_LAST_CHECK_AT',
  LAST_READY_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D1_LAST_READY_AT',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_4D1_LAST_RESULT_JSON'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_STATUS = {
  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  PREVIEWED: 'PREVIEWED',
  CHECK_PASSED: 'CHECK_PASSED',
  READY_FOR_4D_2: 'READY_FOR_4D_2',
  FAILED: 'FAILED'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_CONFIG = {
  PHASE: '4D-1',
  PARENT_PHASE: '4D',
  PREVIOUS_PHASE: '4C',
  NEXT_BUNDLE: '4D-2',
  NEXT_STAGE: 'RESPONSE_WRITE_DRY_RUN_ROW_PREVIEW',
  CONTRACT_NAME: 'CONTROLLED_LESSON_PROGRESS_AND_RESPONSE_WRITES',
  PROD_WRITE_ALLOWED: false,
  REAL_WRITE_ALLOWED: false
};


/**
 * Preview write contract.
 * Không ghi sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewWriteContract4D1V3() {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_4d1BuildWriteContractReadiness_();

  var statusBefore =
    kidlearnV3_4d1GetCurrentStatus_();

  var statusAfter =
    kidlearnV3_4d1ResolveStatusAfterCheck_(
      statusBefore,
      result.success
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_STATUS.PREVIEWED
        : KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_STATUS.FAILED
    );

  result.action =
    'PREVIEW_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D_1_V3';

  result.statusBefore =
    statusBefore;

  result.statusAfter =
    statusAfter;

  kidlearnV3_4d1SaveStatus_(
    result,
    statusAfter,
    KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '4D-1 preview failed. Errors=' +
      result.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Check write contract.
 * Không ghi sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_checkWriteContract4D1V3() {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_4d1BuildWriteContractReadiness_();

  var statusBefore =
    kidlearnV3_4d1GetCurrentStatus_();

  var statusAfter =
    kidlearnV3_4d1ResolveStatusAfterCheck_(
      statusBefore,
      result.success
        ? KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_STATUS.CHECK_PASSED
        : KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_STATUS.FAILED
    );

  result.action =
    'CHECK_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D_1_V3';

  result.statusBefore =
    statusBefore;

  result.statusAfter =
    statusAfter;

  kidlearnV3_4d1SaveStatus_(
    result,
    statusAfter,
    KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_KEYS.LAST_CHECK_AT
  );

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {

  return result;

  var check =

  var properties =

/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_assertWriteContract4D1ReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getWriteContract4D1StatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_2
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '4D-1 chưa READY_FOR_4D_2. Status=' +

    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D_1_READY_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:

    status: status.status,

      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(errors.join(' | '));
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Optional debug: chỉ đọc headers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_debugWriteContractHeaders4D1V3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4d1OpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được spreadsheet: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var sheetNames = [
    'DATA_Responses',
    'DATA_LessonProgress',
    'DATA_StudySessions',
    'LOG_Audit'
  ];

  var sheets = [];

  if (spreadsheet) {
    for (var i = 0; i < sheetNames.length; i++) {
      sheets.push(
        kidlearnV3_4d1InspectSheetHeaders_(
          spreadsheet,
          sheetNames[i],
          warnings
        )
      );
    }
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'DEBUG_WRITE_CONTRACT_HEADERS_4D_1_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    sheets: sheets,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(errors.join(' | '));
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Core readiness builder.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d1BuildWriteContractReadiness_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var phase4C =
    kidlearnV3_4d1SafeCall_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase4CClosedLockedV3'
    );

  if (!phase4C.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 4C chưa closed locked: ' +
      phase4C.message
    );
  }

  var devSafety =
    kidlearnV3_4d1CheckDevSafety_();

  if (!devSafety.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(devSafety.errors || []);
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(devSafety.warnings || []);

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_4d1OpenSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được DEV spreadsheet: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var contracts =
    kidlearnV3_4d1GetWriteContracts_();

  var sheetResults = [];

  if (spreadsheet) {
    for (var i = 0; i < contracts.length; i++) {
      var sheetResult =
        kidlearnV3_4d1EvaluateSheetContract_(
          spreadsheet,
          contracts[i]
        );

      sheetResults.push(sheetResult);

      if (!sheetResult.success) {
        errors =
          errors.concat(sheetResult.errors || []);
      }

      warnings =
        warnings.concat(sheetResult.warnings || []);
    }
  }

  var readinessSummary =
    kidlearnV3_4d1BuildReadinessSummary_(
      sheetResults
    );

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'BUILD_WRITE_CONTRACT_READINESS_4D_1_V3',
    phase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_CONFIG.PHASE,
    parentPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
    contractName:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_CONFIG.CONTRACT_NAME,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    nextStage:
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    targetSheets: [
      'DATA_Responses',
      'DATA_LessonProgress',
      'DATA_StudySessions',
      'LOG_Audit'
    ],
    writePlan: {
      phase4D2: 'Dry-run row preview only',
      phase4D3: 'Controlled DEV real write DATA_Responses',
      phase4D4: 'Controlled DEV real write DATA_LessonProgress',
      phase4D5: 'Controlled DEV real write DATA_StudySessions',
      auditRequired: true,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowedNow: false
    },
    devSafety: devSafety,
    readinessSummary: readinessSummary,
    sheetResults: sheetResults,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: kidlearnV3_4d1UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };

  return result;
}
