/**
 * Evaluate one sheet contract.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d1EvaluateSheetContract_(spreadsheet, contract) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var headerInfo =
    kidlearnV3_4d1InspectSheetHeaders_(
      spreadsheet,
      contract.sheetName,
      warnings
    );

  if (!headerInfo.exists) {
    errors.push(
      contract.sheetName + ': Không tìm thấy sheet.'
    );

    return {
      success: false,
      sheetName: contract.sheetName,
      contractType: contract.contractType,
      operationPlanned: contract.operationPlanned,
      exists: false,
      errorCount: errors.length,
      warningCount: warnings.length,
      errors: errors,
      warnings: warnings
    };
  }

  if (headerInfo.headerCount === 0) {
    errors.push(
      contract.sheetName + ': Không đọc được header.'
    );
  }

  var required =
    kidlearnV3_4d1MatchFields_(
      headerInfo,
      contract.requiredFields || []
    );

  var optional =
    kidlearnV3_4d1MatchFields_(
      headerInfo,
      contract.optionalFields || []
    );

  for (var i = 0; i < required.missing.length; i++) {
    errors.push(
      contract.sheetName +
      ': Thiếu required field ' +
      required.missing[i].canonical
    );
  }

  if (optional.missing.length > 0) {
    warnings.push(
      contract.sheetName +
      ': Có ' +
      optional.missing.length +
      ' optional field chưa match. Có thể bổ sung sau nếu cần.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    sheetName: contract.sheetName,
    contractType: contract.contractType,
    operationPlanned: contract.operationPlanned,
    uniqueKey: contract.uniqueKey,
    exists: headerInfo.exists,
    headerRowIndex: headerInfo.headerRowIndex,
    dataStartRowIndex: headerInfo.dataStartRowIndex,
    headerCount: headerInfo.headerCount,
    lastRow: headerInfo.lastRow,
    lastColumn: headerInfo.lastColumn,
    headers: headerInfo.headers,
    duplicateHeaders: headerInfo.duplicateHeaders,
    required: required,
    optional: optional,
    writeSafety: {
      willWriteNow: false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowedNow: false
    },
    readyForDryRunPreview:
      errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: kidlearnV3_4d1UniqueArray_(warnings)
  };

  return result;
}


/**
 * Inspect sheet headers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d1InspectSheetHeaders_(spreadsheet, sheetName, warnings) {
  warnings = warnings || [];

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_4d1GetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      exists: false,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      headerRowIndex: 0,
      dataStartRowIndex: 0,
      headerCount: 0,
      lastRow: 0,
      lastColumn: 0,
      headers: [],
      duplicateHeaders: []
    };
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastRow < 1 || lastColumn < 1) {
    warnings.push(
      sheetName + ': Sheet trống.'
    );

    return {
      exists: true,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      headerRowIndex: 0,
      dataStartRowIndex: 0,
      headerCount: 0,
      lastRow: lastRow,
      lastColumn: lastColumn,
      headers: [],
      duplicateHeaders: []
    };
  }

  var inspectRows =
    Math.min(2, lastRow);

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(1, 1, inspectRows, lastColumn)
      .getValues();

  var headerDecision =
    kidlearnV3_4d1ChooseHeaderRow_(values);

  var headerRow =
    values[headerDecision.headerRowIndex - 1] || [];

  var headers = [];
  var normalizedMap = {};
  var duplicateHeaders = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < headerRow.length; i++) {
    var raw =
      String(headerRow[i] || '').trim();

    var normalized =
      kidlearnV3_4d1NormalizeLookupKey_(raw);

    if (!raw) {
      continue;
    }

    if (normalizedMap[normalized]) {
      duplicateHeaders.push({
        normalized: normalized,
        firstColumnIndex:
          normalizedMap[normalized].columnIndex,
        duplicateColumnIndex:
          i + 1,
        raw: raw
      });
    } else {
      normalizedMap[normalized] = {
        columnIndex: i + 1,
        raw: raw
      };
    }

    headers.push({
      columnIndex: i + 1,
      raw: raw,
      normalized: normalized
    });
  }

  if (duplicateHeaders.length > 0) {
    warnings.push(
      sheetName +
      ': Có duplicate normalized headers=' +
      duplicateHeaders.length
    );
  }

  return {
    exists: true,
    sheetName: sheetName,
    headerRowIndex: headerDecision.headerRowIndex,
    dataStartRowIndex: headerDecision.headerRowIndex + 1,
    headerCount: headers.length,
    lastRow: lastRow,
    lastColumn: lastColumn,
    headers: headers,
    duplicateHeaders: duplicateHeaders
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4d1ChooseHeaderRow_(values) {
  var row1 = values[0] || [];
  var row2 = values.length > 1 ? values[1] || [] : [];

  var row1Score =
    kidlearnV3_4d1HeaderKeyScore_(row1);

  var row2Score =
    kidlearnV3_4d1HeaderKeyScore_(row2);

  if (row2Score >= 3 && row2Score >= row1Score) {
    return {
      headerRowIndex: 2,
      reason: 'ROW_2_LOOKS_LIKE_FIELD_KEYS'
    };
  }

  return {
    headerRowIndex: 1,
    reason: 'ROW_1_USED_AS_HEADER'
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4d1HeaderKeyScore_(row) {
  var score = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(row[i] || '').trim();

    if (!value) continue;

    if (/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$/.test(value)) {
      score++;
      continue;
    }

    if (
      value.indexOf('Id') >= 0 ||
      value.indexOf('Code') >= 0 ||
      value.indexOf('Name') >= 0 ||
      value.indexOf('At') >= 0 ||
      value.indexOf('Json') >= 0
    ) {
      score++;
    }
  }

  return score;
}


/**
 * Field matching.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d1MatchFields_(headerInfo, fields) {
  var matched = [];
  var missing = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) {
    var field =
      fields[i];

    var match =
      kidlearnV3_4d1FindHeaderMatch_(
        headerInfo.headers || [],
        field.aliases || []
      );

    if (match) {
      matched.push({
        canonical: field.canonical,
        matchedHeader: match.raw,
        columnIndex: match.columnIndex,
        normalized: match.normalized
      });
    } else {
      missing.push({
        canonical: field.canonical,
        aliases: field.aliases || []
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    matchedCount: matched.length,
    missingCount: missing.length,
    matched: matched,
    missing: missing
  };
}


function kidlearnV3_4d1FindHeaderMatch_(headers, aliases) {
  var aliasMap = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < aliases.length; i++) {
    aliasMap[
      kidlearnV3_4d1NormalizeLookupKey_(aliases[i])
    ] = true;
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < headers.length; j++) {
    if (aliasMap[headers[j].normalized]) {
      return headers[j];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Summary.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d1BuildReadinessSummary_(sheetResults) {
  var totalSheets =
    sheetResults.length;

  var readySheets = 0;
  var missingRequiredTotal = 0;
  var matchedRequiredTotal = 0;
  var matchedOptionalTotal = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < sheetResults.length; i++) {
    var item =
      sheetResults[i];

    if (item.success) readySheets++;

    if (item.required) {
      missingRequiredTotal +=
        item.required.missingCount || 0;

      matchedRequiredTotal +=
        item.required.matchedCount || 0;
    }

    if (item.optional) {
      matchedOptionalTotal +=
        item.optional.matchedCount || 0;
    }
  }

  return {
    totalSheets: totalSheets,
    readySheets: readySheets,
    allTargetSheetsReady:
      totalSheets > 0 && readySheets === totalSheets,
    matchedRequiredTotal: matchedRequiredTotal,
    missingRequiredTotal: missingRequiredTotal,
    matchedOptionalTotal: matchedOptionalTotal,
    readyFor4D2DryRunRowPreview:
      totalSheets > 0 &&
      readySheets === totalSheets &&
      missingRequiredTotal === 0
  };
}


/**
 * DEV safety.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d1CheckDevSafety_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var environment = '';

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
    ) {
      environment =
        properties.getProperty(
          KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.ENVIRONMENT
        ) || '';
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  if (!environment) {
    environment =
      properties.getProperty('KIDLEARN_V3_ENVIRONMENT') ||
      properties.getProperty('ENVIRONMENT') ||
      '';
  }

  if (environment) {
    if (
      String(environment).toUpperCase() !== 'DEV'
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'Environment không phải DEV. Current=' +
        environment
      );
    }
  } else {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy ScriptProperty environment. Tiếp tục nhưng chỉ cho phép read-only check.'
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'CHECK_DEV_SAFETY_4D_1_V3',
    environment:
      environment || 'UNKNOWN',
    prodWriteAllowed: false,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Spreadsheet helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d1OpenSpreadsheet_() {
  var active =
    SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();

  if (active) return active;

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var keys = [
    'KIDLEARN_V3_DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID',
    'DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID'
  ];

  try {
    if (
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3 !== 'undefined' &&
      KIDLEARN_V3 &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES &&
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
    ) {
      keys.unshift(
        KIDLEARN_V3.SCRIPT_PROPERTIES.DEV_SPREADSHEET_ID
      );
    }
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore
  }

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var id =
      properties.getProperty(keys[i]);

    if (id) {
      return SpreadsheetApp.openById(id);
    }
  }

  throw new Error('Không tìm thấy DEV spreadsheet.');
}


function kidlearnV3_4d1GetSheetByExactName_(spreadsheet, sheetName) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Generic helpers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_4d1NormalizeLookupKey_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, '')
    .replace(/_/g, '')
    .replace(/-/g, '')
    .replace(/[^\w]/g, '');
}


function kidlearnV3_4d1UniqueArray_(items) {
  var map = {};
  var result = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(items[i] || '');

    if (!value) continue;

    if (!map[value]) {
      map[value] = true;
      result.push(value);
    }
  }

  return result;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d1SafeCall_(functionName) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        functionName: functionName,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName,
        output: null
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        output && output.success === true,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        output && output.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(output),
      output: output
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      functionName: functionName,
      message:
        String(error.message || error),
      output: null
    };
  }
}


function kidlearnV3_4d1GetCurrentStatus_() {
  return (
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_KEYS.STATUS
      ) ||
    KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_STATUS.NOT_RUN
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4d1ResolveStatusAfterCheck_(statusBefore, proposedStatus) {
  if (
    statusBefore ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_2 &&
    proposedStatus !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_STATUS.FAILED
  ) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_STATUS.READY_FOR_4D_2;
  }

  return proposedStatus;
}


function kidlearnV3_4d1SaveStatus_(result, status, dateKey) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      phase:
        result.phase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_CONFIG.PHASE,
      parentPhase:
        result.parentPhase ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_CONFIG.PARENT_PHASE,
      status: status,
      contractName:
        KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_CONFIG.CONTRACT_NAME,
      nextBundle:
        KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
      nextStage:
        KIDLEARN_V3_WRITE_CONTRACT_4D1_CONFIG.NEXT_STAGE,
      prodWriteAllowed: false,
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      actualSheetWritePerformed: false,
      readinessSummary:
        result.readinessSummary || null,
      errorCount:
        result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount:
        result.warningCount || 0,
      errors:
        result.errors || [],
      warnings:
        result.warnings || [],
      at:
        new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


function kidlearnV3_4d1ReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) return null;

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - QA ASYNC RUNNER
 * Bundle: 3M-A
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * Mục tiêu:
 * - Chạy QA nhiều bước nhưng không vượt giới hạn thời gian Apps Script.
 * - Mỗi execution chỉ chạy vài step.
 * - Nếu chưa xong, tự tạo time trigger chạy tiếp.
 * - Không chạy real write.
 * - Không chạy rollback.
 * - Không chạy migration.
 * - Không create/delete sheet.
 * - Không close phase tự động.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS',
  STATE_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATE_JSON',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_LAST_RESULT_JSON',
  LAST_RUN_ID: 'KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_LAST_RUN_ID',

  PHASE_3MA_STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MA_STATUS',
  PHASE_3MA_LAST_READY_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MA_LAST_READY_AT',
  PHASE_3MA_LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MA_LAST_RESULT_JSON'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS = {
  NOT_STARTED: 'NOT_STARTED',
  QUEUED: 'QUEUED',
  RUNNING: 'RUNNING',
  PAUSED: 'PAUSED',
  COMPLETED: 'COMPLETED',
  FAILED: 'FAILED',
  CANCELLED: 'CANCELLED'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3MA_STATUS = {
  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  ASYNC_TESTED: 'ASYNC_TESTED',
  READY_FOR_3M_B: 'READY_FOR_3M_B',
  FAILED: 'FAILED'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG = {
  VERSION: '3M-A',
  NEXT_BUNDLE: '3M-B',
  WORKER_FUNCTION: 'kidlearnV3_runQaAsyncWorker3MAV3',

  /**
   * Mỗi lần worker chỉ chạy tối đa 2 step.
   * Sau này dự án lớn hơn, có thể giảm còn 1.
   */
  DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE: 2,

  /**
   * Dừng chunk trước 70 giây để tránh đụng giới hạn execution.
   */
  DEFAULT_CHUNK_MAX_MS: 70000,

  /**
   * Trigger tiếp theo sau 1 phút.
   */
  NEXT_TRIGGER_AFTER_MS: 60 * 1000,

  MAX_ITEMS_TO_KEEP: 120
};


/**
 * Preview QA Async 3M-A.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewQaAsync3MAV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var functionChecks =
    kidlearnV3_3maCheckFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3LClosedV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_',
      'kidlearnV3_assertAppShell3LAReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_assertLessonContent3LBReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_assertLearningInteraction3LCReadyV3'
    ]);

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      functionChecks.errors
    );

  var phase3L =
    kidlearnV3_3maSafeAssert_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3LClosedV3',
      'Phase 3L'
    );

  if (!phase3L.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 3L chưa CLOSED_LOCKED: ' +
      phase3L.message
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3maSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'QA Async yêu cầu Safe Write DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3maControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write đang ENABLED. Không được chạy QA Async.'
    );
  }

  var triggerCount =
    kidlearnV3_3maCountWorkerTriggers_();

  if (triggerCount > 0) {
    warnings.push(
      'Đang có ' +
      triggerCount +
      ' trigger QA Async worker. Nếu bị kẹt, chạy kidlearnV3_cancelQaAsync3MAV3.'
    );
  }

  var currentSafeSteps =
    kidlearnV3_3maGetSuiteSteps_(
      'CURRENT_SAFE_ASSERT'
    );

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_QA_ASYNC_3MA_V3',
    bundle: '3M-A',
    version:
      KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.VERSION,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3L: phase3L,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite,
    controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite,
    workerTriggerCount: triggerCount,
    defaultSuite: {
      suiteName: 'CURRENT_SAFE_ASSERT',
      stepCount: currentSafeSteps.length,
      steps: currentSafeSteps
    },
    functionChecks: functionChecks.items,
    note:
      'QA Async chạy từng chunk bằng trigger. Không chạy real write, rollback, migration, create sheet, close phase.'
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Start QA Async mặc định cho toàn bộ project hiện tại.
 *
 * Đây là hàm chị dùng chính.
 */
function kidlearnV3_startQaAsyncCurrentSafe3MAV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_startQaAsyncSuite3MAV3({
    suiteName: 'CURRENT_SAFE_ASSERT',
    chunkSize:
      KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE,
    chunkMaxMs:
      KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHUNK_MAX_MS
  });
}


/**
 * Start QA Async cho regression 3L.
 *
 * Dùng khi sửa UI 3L-A / 3L-B / 3L-C.
 */
function kidlearnV3_startQaAsyncPhase3LRegression3MAV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_startQaAsyncSuite3MAV3({
    suiteName: 'PHASE_3L_REGRESSION',
    chunkSize: 1,
    chunkMaxMs:
      KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHUNK_MAX_MS
  });
}


/**
 * Start QA Async theo suite name.
 */
function kidlearnV3_startQaAsyncSuite3MAV3(options) {
  var req =
    kidlearnV3_3maNormalizeOptions_(
      options
    );

  var suiteName =
    req.suiteName ||
    'CURRENT_SAFE_ASSERT';

  var steps =
    kidlearnV3_3maGetSuiteSteps_(
      suiteName
    );

  if (!steps || steps.length < 1) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không tìm thấy QA Async suite: ' +
      suiteName
    );
  }

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewQaAsync3MAV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể start QA Async vì preview chưa đạt. Errors=' +
      preview.errorCount +
      '. ' +
      preview.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  kidlearnV3_3maDeleteWorkerTriggers_();

  var now =
    new Date();

  var runId =
    kidlearnV3_3maMakeRunId_();

  var state = {
    success: true,
    runId: runId,
    suiteName: suiteName,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.QUEUED,
    startedAt:
      now.toISOString(),
    updatedAt:
      now.toISOString(),
    finishedAt: '',
    nextIndex: 0,
    totalStepCount: steps.length,
    executedStepCount: 0,
    passedStepCount: 0,
    failedStepCount: 0,
    errorCount: 0,
    warningCount: 0,
    errors: [],
    warnings: [],
    chunkSize:
      Number(
        req.chunkSize ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE
      ),
    chunkMaxMs:
      Number(
        req.chunkMaxMs ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHUNK_MAX_MS
      ),
    steps: steps,
    items: [],
    lastWorkerAt: '',
    nextTriggerScheduledAt: '',
    safeMode: {
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      rollbackAllowed: false,
      migrationAllowed: false,
      createSheetAllowed: false,
      closePhaseAllowed: false
    }
  };

  kidlearnV3_3maSaveState_(
    state
  );

  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_KEYS.LAST_RUN_ID,
      runId
    );

  /**
   * Chạy chunk đầu tiên ngay.
   * Nếu chưa xong, worker sẽ tự tạo trigger cho chunk tiếp theo.
   */
  return kidlearnV3_runQaAsyncWorker3MAV3();
}


/**
 * Worker function.
 *
 * Hàm này được gọi:
 * - trực tiếp bởi Start
 * - hoặc bởi time trigger
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaAsyncWorker3MAV3() {
  var lock =
    LockService.getScriptLock();

  var locked =
    lock.tryLock(10000);

  if (!locked) {
    return {
      success: false,
      action: 'RUN_QA_ASYNC_WORKER_3MA_V3',
      status: 'LOCK_BUSY',
      message:
        'QA Async worker đang chạy ở execution khác.'
    };
  }

  try {
    kidlearnV3_3maDeleteWorkerTriggers_();

    var state =
      kidlearnV3_3maReadState_();

    if (!state) {
      throw new Error(
        'Không có QA Async state để worker chạy.'
      );
    }

    if (
      state.status === KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.COMPLETED ||
      state.status === KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.FAILED ||
      state.status === KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.CANCELLED
    ) {
      return kidlearnV3_3maBuildWorkerReturn_(
        state,
        'NO_ACTION_FINAL_STATUS'
      );
    }

    if (
      state.status === KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.PAUSED
    ) {
      return kidlearnV3_3maBuildWorkerReturn_(
        state,
        'NO_ACTION_PAUSED'
      );
    }

    var startedAt =
      new Date();

    state.status =
      KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.RUNNING;

    state.lastWorkerAt =
      startedAt.toISOString();

    state.updatedAt =
      startedAt.toISOString();

    kidlearnV3_3maSaveState_(
      state
    );

    var stepsThisChunk = 0;
    var chunkSize =
      Number(
        state.chunkSize ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHUNK_SIZE
      );

    var chunkMaxMs =
      Number(
        state.chunkMaxMs ||
        KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.DEFAULT_CHUNK_MAX_MS
      );

    while (
      state.nextIndex < state.steps.length &&
      stepsThisChunk < chunkSize
    ) {
      var now =
        new Date();

      var elapsedMs =
        now.getTime() -
        startedAt.getTime();

      if (elapsedMs >= chunkMaxMs) {
        break;
      }

      var step =
        state.steps[state.nextIndex];

      var item =
        kidlearnV3_3maRunStep_(
          step,
          state.nextIndex + 1,
          state.steps.length
        );

      state.items.push(
        item
      );

      if (
        state.items.length >
        KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.MAX_ITEMS_TO_KEEP
      ) {
        state.items =
          state.items.slice(
            state.items.length -
            KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.MAX_ITEMS_TO_KEEP
          );
      }

      state.executedStepCount =
        Number(state.executedStepCount || 0) + 1;

      if (item.success) {
        state.passedStepCount =
          Number(state.passedStepCount || 0) + 1;
      } else {
        state.failedStepCount =
          Number(state.failedStepCount || 0) + 1;

        state.errorCount =
          Number(state.errorCount || 0) + 1;

        state.errors.push(
          '[' +
          item.stepNo +
          '] ' +
          item.functionName +
          ': ' +
          item.errorMessage
        );

        state.status =
          KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.FAILED;

        state.finishedAt =
          new Date().toISOString();

        state.updatedAt =
          state.finishedAt;

        kidlearnV3_3maSaveState_(
          state
        );

        kidlearnV3_3maSaveLastResult_(
          state
        );

        return kidlearnV3_3maBuildWorkerReturn_(
          state,
          'FAILED'
        );
      }

      if (item.warningCount > 0) {
        state.warningCount =
          Number(state.warningCount || 0) +
          item.warningCount;

        state.warnings =
          state.warnings.concat(
            item.warnings || []
          );
      }

      state.nextIndex =
        Number(state.nextIndex || 0) + 1;

      stepsThisChunk =
        stepsThisChunk + 1;

      state.updatedAt =
        new Date().toISOString();

      kidlearnV3_3maSaveState_(
        state
      );
    }

    if (
      state.nextIndex >= state.steps.length
    ) {
      state.status =
        KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.COMPLETED;

      state.finishedAt =
        new Date().toISOString();

      state.updatedAt =
        state.finishedAt;

      kidlearnV3_3maSaveState_(
        state
      );

      kidlearnV3_3maSaveLastResult_(
        state
      );

      return kidlearnV3_3maBuildWorkerReturn_(
        state,
        'COMPLETED'
      );
    }

    state.status =
      KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.QUEUED;

    var triggerInfo =
      kidlearnV3_3maScheduleNextWorker_();

    state.nextTriggerScheduledAt =
      triggerInfo.scheduledAt;

    state.updatedAt =
      new Date().toISOString();

    kidlearnV3_3maSaveState_(
      state
    );

    kidlearnV3_3maSaveLastResult_(
      state
    );

    return kidlearnV3_3maBuildWorkerReturn_(
      state,
      'CHUNK_DONE_NEXT_TRIGGER_SCHEDULED'
    );

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}


/**
 * Chạy tiếp 1 chunk ngay lập tức.
 *
 * Dùng khi chị không muốn đợi trigger hoặc trigger bị delay.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaAsyncNextChunkNow3MAV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_runQaAsyncWorker3MAV3();
}


/**
 * Pause QA Async.
 */
function kidlearnV3_pauseQaAsync3MAV3() {
  var state =
    kidlearnV3_3maReadState_();

  if (!state) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không có QA Async state để pause.'
    );
  }

  kidlearnV3_3maDeleteWorkerTriggers_();

  state.status =
    KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.PAUSED;

  state.updatedAt =
    new Date().toISOString();

  kidlearnV3_3maSaveState_(
    state
  );

  return kidlearnV3_getQaAsyncStatus3MAV3();
}


/**
 * Resume QA Async.
 */
function kidlearnV3_resumeQaAsync3MAV3() {
  var state =
    kidlearnV3_3maReadState_();

  if (!state) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không có QA Async state để resume.'
    );
  }

  if (
    state.status === KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.COMPLETED
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_getQaAsyncStatus3MAV3();
  }

  if (
    state.status === KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.FAILED
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'QA Async đang FAILED. Hãy xem lỗi, sửa code, rồi start lại suite mới.'
    );
  }

  state.status =
    KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.QUEUED;

  state.updatedAt =
    new Date().toISOString();

  kidlearnV3_3maSaveState_(
    state
  );

  return kidlearnV3_runQaAsyncWorker3MAV3();
}


/**
 * Cancel QA Async.
 */
function kidlearnV3_cancelQaAsync3MAV3() {
  var state =
    kidlearnV3_3maReadState_();

  kidlearnV3_3maDeleteWorkerTriggers_();

  if (!state) {
    var emptyResult = {
      success: true,
      action: 'CANCEL_QA_ASYNC_3MA_V3',
      status:
        KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.CANCELLED,
      message:
        'Không có state cũ. Đã clear worker triggers.'
    };

    console.log(
      JSON.stringify(emptyResult, null, 2)
    );

    return emptyResult;
  }

  state.status =
    KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.CANCELLED;

  state.updatedAt =
    new Date().toISOString();

  state.finishedAt =
    state.updatedAt;

  kidlearnV3_3maSaveState_(
    state
  );

  kidlearnV3_3maSaveLastResult_(
    state
  );

  return kidlearnV3_getQaAsyncStatus3MAV3();
}


/**
 * Clear QA Async state.
 */
function kidlearnV3_clearQaAsyncState3MAV3() {
  kidlearnV3_3maDeleteWorkerTriggers_();

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.deleteProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_KEYS.STATUS
  );

  properties.deleteProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_KEYS.STATE_JSON
  );

  properties.deleteProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON
  );

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'CLEAR_QA_ASYNC_STATE_3MA_V3',
    message:
      'Đã clear QA Async state và worker triggers.'
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Get QA Async status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getQaAsyncStatus3MAV3() {
  var state =
    kidlearnV3_3maReadState_();

  var triggerCount =
    kidlearnV3_3maCountWorkerTriggers_();

  if (!state) {
    var empty = {
      success: true,
      action: 'GET_QA_ASYNC_STATUS_3MA_V3',
      status:
        KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.NOT_STARTED,
      workerTriggerCount: triggerCount,
      lastResult:
        kidlearnV3_3maReadLastResult_()
    };

    console.log(
      JSON.stringify(empty, null, 2)
    );

    return empty;
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'GET_QA_ASYNC_STATUS_3MA_V3',
    runId: state.runId,
    suiteName: state.suiteName,
    status: state.status,
    startedAt: state.startedAt,
    updatedAt: state.updatedAt,
    finishedAt: state.finishedAt || '',
    nextIndex: state.nextIndex,
    totalStepCount: state.totalStepCount,
    executedStepCount: state.executedStepCount,
    passedStepCount: state.passedStepCount,
    failedStepCount: state.failedStepCount,
    errorCount: state.errorCount,
    warningCount: state.warningCount,
    errors: state.errors || [],
    warnings: state.warnings || [],
    workerTriggerCount: triggerCount,
    nextTriggerScheduledAt:
      state.nextTriggerScheduledAt || '',
    progressPercent:
      state.totalStepCount > 0
        ? Math.round(
            Number(state.executedStepCount || 0) /
            Number(state.totalStepCount || 1) *
            100
          )
        : 0,
    lastItems:
      (state.items || []).slice(-8),
    safeMode: state.safeMode
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert QA Async completed.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertQaAsyncCompleted3MAV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getQaAsyncStatus3MAV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.COMPLETED
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'QA Async chưa COMPLETED. Status=' +
      status.status +
      ', progress=' +
      status.progressPercent +
      '%'
    );
  }

  if (Number(status.errorCount || 0) > 0) {
    errors.push(
      'QA Async có errorCount=' +
      status.errorCount
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_QA_ASYNC_COMPLETED_3MA_V3',
    bundle: '3M-A',
    status: status.status,
    suiteName: status.suiteName || '',
    progressPercent: status.progressPercent || 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'QA Async chưa completed. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Default suite steps.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maGetSuiteSteps_(suiteName) {
  var name =
    String(suiteName || '').trim();

  if (name === 'CURRENT_SAFE_ASSERT') {
    return [
      {
        label: 'Assert Phase 3J closed',
        functionName: 'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3JClosedV3'
      },
      {
        label: 'Assert Phase 3K closed',
        functionName: 'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3KClosedV3'
      },
      {
        label: 'Assert Phase 3L closed',
        functionName: 'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3LClosedV3'
      },
      {
        label: 'Assert Safe Write DRY_RUN',
        functionName: 'kidlearnV3_asyncQaAssertSafeWriteDryRun3MAV3'
      },
      {
        label: 'Assert Controlled Write disabled',
        functionName: 'kidlearnV3_asyncQaAssertControlledWriteDisabled3MAV3'
      },
      {
        label: 'Assert 3L-A ready',
        functionName: 'kidlearnV3_assertAppShell3LAReadyV3'
      },
      {
        label: 'Assert 3L-B ready',
        functionName: 'kidlearnV3_assertLessonContent3LBReadyV3'
      },
      {
        label: 'Assert 3L-C ready',
        functionName: 'kidlearnV3_assertLearningInteraction3LCReadyV3'
      },
      {
        label: 'Get Phase 3L close status',
        functionName: 'kidlearnV3_getPhase3LCloseStatusV3'
      }
    ];
  }

  if (name === 'PHASE_3L_REGRESSION') {
    var steps = [];

    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getQaBatchSteps3LAV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      steps =
        steps.concat(
          kidlearnV3_getQaBatchSteps3LAV3()
        );
    }

    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getQaBatchSteps3LBV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      steps =
        steps.concat(
          kidlearnV3_getQaBatchSteps3LBV3()
        );
    }

    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getQaBatchSteps3LCV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      steps =
        steps.concat(
          kidlearnV3_getQaBatchSteps3LCV3()
        );
    }

    steps.push({
      label: 'Assert Phase 3L closed',
      functionName: 'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3LClosedV3'
    });

    return steps;
  }

  return [];
}


/**
 * Custom assert: Safe Write phải DRY_RUN.
 */
function kidlearnV3_asyncQaAssertSafeWriteDryRun3MAV3() {
  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3maSafeWriteStatus_();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write phải DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASYNC_QA_ASSERT_SAFE_WRITE_DRY_RUN_3MA_V3',
    bundle: '3M-A',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Custom assert: Controlled Write không ENABLED.
 */
function kidlearnV3_asyncQaAssertControlledWriteDisabled3MAV3() {
  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3maControlledWriteStatus_();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write đang ENABLED.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASYNC_QA_ASSERT_CONTROLLED_WRITE_DISABLED_3MA_V3',
    bundle: '3M-A',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Run one step.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maRunStep_(
  step,
  stepNo,
  totalSteps
) {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var functionName =
    step.functionName;

  var result = {
    success: false,
    stepNo: stepNo,
    totalSteps: totalSteps,
    label: step.label || '',
    functionName: functionName,
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt: '',
    durationMs: 0,
    errorMessage: '',
    warningCount: 0,
    warnings: [],
    outputSummary: null
  };

  try {
    kidlearnV3_3maAssertFunctionAllowed_(
      functionName
    );

    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      throw new Error(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        functionName
      );
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    var summary =
      kidlearnV3_3maSummarizeOutput_(
        output
      );

    result.outputSummary =
      summary;

    result.warningCount =
      summary.warningCount || 0;

    result.warnings =
      summary.warnings || [];

    if (
      output &&
      output.success === false
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        kidlearnV3_3maGetOutputErrorMessage_(
          output
        )
      );
    }

    result.success = true;

  } catch (error) {
    result.success = false;
    result.errorMessage =
      String(error.message || error);
  }

  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  result.finishedAt =
    finishedAt.toISOString();

  result.durationMs =
    finishedAt.getTime() -
    startedAt.getTime();

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Guard: chặn hàm nguy hiểm trong QA Async.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maAssertFunctionAllowed_(functionName) {
  var name =
    String(functionName || '');

  var blockedExact = {
    kidlearnV3_createV3Sheets: true,
    kidlearnV3_migrateLegacyV2SheetsToV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_migrateV2DataToV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_enableControlledWriteDevV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_armControlledWriteDevV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_runUiRealWriteTrial3JBCleanV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_uiRealWriteTrial3JBExecuteV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_confirmRollbackUiRealWriteTrial3JBV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_rollbackUiRealWriteTrial3JBV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_closePhase3JV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_closePhase3JCompatV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_closePhase3KV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_closePhase3LV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_applyDataValidationAllSheets: true,
    kidlearnV3_clearDataValidationAllSheets: true
  };

  if (blockedExact[name]) {
    throw new Error(
      'QA Async không được chạy hàm nguy hiểm: ' +
      name
    );
  }

  var blockedPatterns = [
    /Rollback/i,
    /rollback/i,
    /Migrate/i,
    /migrate/i,
    /CreateV3Sheets/i,
    /createV3Sheets/i,
    /EnableControlledWrite/i,
    /ArmControlledWrite/i,
    /RealWriteTrial/i,
    /realWriteTrial/i,
    /ClosePhase/i,
    /closePhase/i,
    /ApplyDataValidation/i,
    /ClearDataValidation/i,
    /Delete/i,
    /delete/i
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < blockedPatterns.length; i++) {
    if (blockedPatterns[i].test(name)) {
      throw new Error(
        'QA Async chặn function theo pattern an toàn: ' +
        name
      );
    }
  }
}


/**
 * Summarize output.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maSummarizeOutput_(output) {
  if (!output || typeof output !== 'object') {
    return {
      rawType: typeof output,
      warningCount: 0,
      warnings: []
    };
  }

  var summary = {
    success:
      output.success,
    action:
      output.action || '',
    bundle:
      output.bundle || '',
    phase:
      output.phase || '',
    status:
      output.status || '',
    nextBundle:
      output.nextBundle || '',
    nextPhase:
      output.nextPhase || '',
    errorCount:
      output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount:
      output.warningCount || 0,
    errors:
      output.errors || [],
    warnings:
      output.warnings || []
  };

  if (output.decision) {
    summary.decision =
      output.decision;
  }

  if (output.progressPercent) {
    summary.progressPercent =
      output.progressPercent;
  }

  if (output.safeWriteStatus) {
    summary.safeWriteStatus = {
      mode:
        output.safeWriteStatus.mode,
      enabled:
        output.safeWriteStatus.enabled
    };
  }

  if (output.controlledWriteStatus) {
    summary.controlledWriteStatus = {
      available:
        output.controlledWriteStatus.available,
      status:
        output.controlledWriteStatus.status
    };
  }

  return summary;
}


/**
 * Output error helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maGetOutputErrorMessage_(output) {
  if (!output) {
    return 'Không có output.';
  }

  if (
    output.errors &&
    output.errors.length
  ) {
    return output.errors.join(' | ');
  }

  if (
    output.error &&
    output.error.message
  ) {
    return output.error.message;
  }

  if (output.error) {
    return String(output.error);
  }

  return 'Function trả success=false nhưng không có message.';
}


/**
 * Save state.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maSaveState_(state) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_KEYS.STATUS,
    state.status
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_KEYS.STATE_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(state)
  );
}


/**
 * Read state.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maReadState_() {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_KEYS.STATE_JSON
      );

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không parse được QA Async state JSON: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Save last result compact.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maSaveLastResult_(state) {
  var compact = {
    success:
      state.status === KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.COMPLETED,
    action: 'QA_ASYNC_3MA_LAST_RESULT',
    runId: state.runId,
    suiteName: state.suiteName,
    status: state.status,
    startedAt: state.startedAt,
    updatedAt: state.updatedAt,
    finishedAt: state.finishedAt,
    totalStepCount: state.totalStepCount,
    executedStepCount: state.executedStepCount,
    passedStepCount: state.passedStepCount,
    failedStepCount: state.failedStepCount,
    errorCount: state.errorCount,
    warningCount: state.warningCount,
    errors: state.errors || [],
    lastItems:
      (state.items || []).slice(-10)
  };

  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
      JSON.stringify(compact)
    );
}


/**
 * Read last result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maReadLastResult_() {
  return kidlearnV3_3maReadJsonProperty_(
    KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON
  );
}


/**
 * Schedule next worker.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maScheduleNextWorker_() {
  kidlearnV3_3maDeleteWorkerTriggers_();

  var scheduledAt =
    new Date(
      new Date().getTime() +
      KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.NEXT_TRIGGER_AFTER_MS
    );

  var trigger =
    ScriptApp
      .newTrigger(
        KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.WORKER_FUNCTION
      )
      .timeBased()
      .after(
        KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.NEXT_TRIGGER_AFTER_MS
      )
      .create();

  return {
    success: true,
    scheduledAt:
      scheduledAt.toISOString(),
    triggerId:
      trigger.getUniqueId
        ? trigger.getUniqueId()
        : ''
  };
}


/**
 * Delete worker triggers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maDeleteWorkerTriggers_() {
  var triggers =
    ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers();

  for (var i = 0; i < triggers.length; i++) {
    if (
      triggers[i].getHandlerFunction &&
      triggers[i].getHandlerFunction() ===
        KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.WORKER_FUNCTION
    ) {
      ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(
        triggers[i]
      );
    }
  }
}


/**
 * Count worker triggers.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maCountWorkerTriggers_() {
  var triggers =
    ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers();

  var count = 0;

  for (var i = 0; i < triggers.length; i++) {
    if (
      triggers[i].getHandlerFunction &&
      triggers[i].getHandlerFunction() ===
        KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_CONFIG.WORKER_FUNCTION
    ) {
      count++;
    }
  }

  return count;
}


/**
 * Build worker return.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maBuildWorkerReturn_(
  state,
  workerStatus
) {
  var result = {
    success:
      state.status === KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.COMPLETED ||
      state.status === KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.QUEUED ||
      state.status === KIDLEARN_V3_QA_ASYNC_3MA_STATUS.RUNNING,
    action: 'RUN_QA_ASYNC_WORKER_3MA_V3',
    workerStatus: workerStatus,
    runId: state.runId,
    suiteName: state.suiteName,
    status: state.status,
    progressPercent:
      state.totalStepCount > 0
        ? Math.round(
            Number(state.executedStepCount || 0) /
            Number(state.totalStepCount || 1) *
            100
          )
        : 0,
    nextIndex: state.nextIndex,
    totalStepCount: state.totalStepCount,
    executedStepCount: state.executedStepCount,
    passedStepCount: state.passedStepCount,
    failedStepCount: state.failedStepCount,
    errorCount: state.errorCount,
    errors: state.errors || [],
    lastItems:
      (state.items || []).slice(-5),
    nextTriggerScheduledAt:
      state.nextTriggerScheduledAt || ''
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Safe assert helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maSafeAssert_(
  functionName,
  label
) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var result =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        result && result.success === true,
      label: label,
      message:
        result && result.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(result)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maSafeWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Controlled Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maControlledWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      var result =
        kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

      result.available = true;

      return result;
    }

    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      safeWriteMode: '',
      safeWriteEnabled: false,
      error:
        'Missing kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      safeWriteMode: '',
      safeWriteEnabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maCheckFunctions_(names) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          names[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: names[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        names[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Make run ID.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maMakeRunId_() {
  var text =
    Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss_SSS'
    );

  var random =
    Math.floor(
      Math.random() * 100000
    );

  return (
    'QA_ASYNC_3MA_' +
    text +
    '_' +
    random
  );
}


/**
 * Normalize options.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maNormalizeOptions_(options) {
  if (!options) {
    return {};
  }

  if (typeof options !== 'object') {
    return {
      suiteName: String(options || '')
    };
  }

  return options;
}


/**
 * Read JSON property.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3maReadJsonProperty_(key) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - QA BATCH TEST RUNNER
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * File: QA_Batch_Test_Runner_V3.gs
 * ================================================================
 *
 * Mục tiêu:
 * - Chạy nhiều hàm test trong 1 lần.
 * - Ưu tiên READ_ONLY / DRY_RUN.
 * - Không chạy real write.
 * - Không chạy rollback.
 * - Không chạy migration.
 * - Không create/delete sheet.
 * - Không close phase tự động.
 *
 * Bản cập nhật:
 * - 3K-C dùng LITE suite để tránh timeout.
 * - Có Provided Steps Runner cho các phase mới.
 * - Có helper mark 3K-C ready lite cho QA batch.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_QA_BATCH_KEYS = {
  LAST_RUN_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_QA_BATCH_LAST_RUN_AT',
  LAST_SUITE: 'KIDLEARN_V3_QA_BATCH_LAST_SUITE',
  LAST_STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_QA_BATCH_LAST_STATUS',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_QA_BATCH_LAST_RESULT_JSON'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_QA_BATCH_CONFIG = {
  VERSION: 'QA_BATCH_V3',
  MAX_RUNTIME_MS: 300000,
  STOP_ON_FAILURE_DEFAULT: true
};


/**
 * Daily fast test.
 *
 * Chạy nhanh để kiểm tra hệ thống hiện tại:
 * - Phase 3J đã closed
 * - 3K-A ready
 * - 3K-B ready
 * - 3K-C chạy LITE DRY_RUN
 *
 * Không ghi thật DB.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaBatchFastCurrentV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_runQaBatchSuiteV3({
    suiteName: 'FAST_CURRENT',
    stopOnFailure: true
  });
}


/**
 * Full safe regression test.
 *
 * Chạy nhiều bước hơn, nhưng vẫn chỉ READ_ONLY / DRY_RUN.
 * Nếu bị timeout, dùng các suite theo phase.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaBatchFullSafeV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_runQaBatchSuiteV3({
    suiteName: 'FULL_SAFE',
    stopOnFailure: true
  });
}


/**
 * Test riêng 3K-A.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaBatch3KAV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_runQaBatchSuiteV3({
    suiteName: 'PHASE_3K_A',
    stopOnFailure: true
  });
}


/**
 * Test riêng 3K-B.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaBatch3KBV3() {

    suiteName: 'PHASE_3K_B',
    stopOnFailure: true
  });
}


/**
 * Test riêng 3K-C - LITE VERSION.
 *
 * Bản này tránh chạy lặp:
 * - Không chạy từng action riêng lẻ nếu đã có runAll.
 * - Không gọi smokeTest 3K-C vì smokeTest lại gọi runAll thêm lần nữa.
 * - Mark ready bằng QA lite helper sau khi runAll đã pass.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaBatch3KCV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_runQaBatchProvidedStepsV3(
    'PHASE_3K_C_LITE',
    kidlearnV3_getQaBatchSteps3KCV3(),
    {
      stopOnFailure: true
    }
  );
}


/**
 * Chạy toàn bộ suite theo tên.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaBatchSuiteV3(options) {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var req =
    kidlearnV3_qaBatchNormalizeOptions_(
      options
    );

  var suiteName =
    req.suiteName || 'FAST_CURRENT';

  var stopOnFailure =
    typeof req.stopOnFailure === 'boolean'
      ? req.stopOnFailure
      : KIDLEARN_V3_QA_BATCH_CONFIG.STOP_ON_FAILURE_DEFAULT;

  var steps =
    kidlearnV3_qaBatchGetSuiteSteps_(
      suiteName
    );

  if (!steps || steps.length < 1) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không tìm thấy QA batch suite: ' +
      suiteName
    );
  }

  return kidlearnV3_runQaBatchProvidedStepsV3(
    suiteName,
    steps,
    {
      stopOnFailure: stopOnFailure,
      startedAt: startedAt
    }
  );
}


/**
 * ================================================================
 * QA Batch - Provided Steps Runner
 * ================================================================
 *
 * Dùng cho các phase mới.
 * Mỗi bundle mới chỉ cần tự định nghĩa:
 * - kidlearnV3_getQaBatchSteps3KDV3
 * - kidlearnV3_runQaBatch3KDV3
 *
 * Không cần sửa lại toàn bộ kidlearnV3_qaBatchGetSuiteSteps_ cũ.
 */


/**
 * Chạy QA batch bằng danh sách steps được truyền vào.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runQaBatchProvidedStepsV3(
  suiteName,
  steps,
  options
) {
  var startedAt =
    options && options.startedAt
      ? options.startedAt
      : new Date();

  var req =
    options || {};

  var stopOnFailure =
    typeof req.stopOnFailure === 'boolean'
      ? req.stopOnFailure
      : true;

  if (
    !steps ||
    !Array.isArray(steps) ||
    steps.length < 1
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không có steps để chạy QA batch suite=' +
      suiteName
    );
  }

  var items = [];
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) {
    var now =
      new Date();

    var elapsedMs =
      now.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime();

    if (
      elapsedMs >
      KIDLEARN_V3_QA_BATCH_CONFIG.MAX_RUNTIME_MS
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'QA Batch gần vượt giới hạn thời gian Apps Script. Dừng tại step ' +
        (i + 1) +
        '/' +
        steps.length
      );

      break;
    }

    var step =
      steps[i];

    var item =
      kidlearnV3_qaBatchRunStep_(
        step,
        i + 1,
        steps.length
      );

    items.push(item);

    if (item.warningCount > 0) {
      warnings =
        warnings.concat(
          item.warnings || []
        );
    }

    if (!item.success) {
      errors.push(
        '[' +
        item.stepNo +
        '] ' +
        item.functionName +
        ': ' +
        item.errorMessage
      );

      if (stopOnFailure) {
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'RUN_QA_BATCH_PROVIDED_STEPS_V3',
    version:
      KIDLEARN_V3_QA_BATCH_CONFIG.VERSION,
    suiteName: suiteName,
    stopOnFailure: stopOnFailure,
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    totalStepCount:
      steps.length,
    executedStepCount:
      items.length,
    passedStepCount:
      items.filter(function(item) {
        return item.success;
      }).length,
    failedStepCount:
      items.filter(function(item) {
        return !item.success;
      }).length,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    items: items,
    safeMode: {
      realWriteAllowed: false,
      rollbackAllowed: false,
      migrationAllowed: false,
      createSheetAllowed: false,
      closePhaseAllowed: false
    }
  };

  kidlearnV3_qaBatchSaveResult_(
    result
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'QA Batch failed. Suite=' +
      suiteName +
      ', Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**

 *
 * Không gọi smokeTestLearningActions3KCV3 để tránh chạy lại runAll.
 * Chỉ cho phép mark nếu 3K-C đã ở DRY_RUN_TESTED / SMOKE_TESTED / READY_FOR_3K_D.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markLearningActions3KCReadyLiteForBatchV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getLearningActions3KCStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  var allowed = {
    DRY_RUN_TESTED: true,
    SMOKE_TESTED: true,
    READY_FOR_3K_D: true
  };

  if (!allowed[status.status]) {
    errors.push(
      'Không thể mark 3K-C ready lite. Status hiện tại=' +
      status.status +
      '. Cần chạy kidlearnV3_runAllLearningActionsDryRun3KCV3 pass trước.'
    );
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    var failed = {
      success: false,
      action: 'MARK_LEARNING_ACTIONS_3KC_READY_LITE_FOR_BATCH_V3',
      bundle: '3K-C',
      phase: '3K.6_3K.7_3K.8_3K.9',
      errorCount: errors.length,
      errors: errors,
      currentStatus: status.status
    };

    console.log(
      JSON.stringify(failed, null, 2)
    );

    return failed;
  }

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var now =
    new Date();

  var readyStatus =
    'READY_FOR_3K_D';

  var lastResult = {
    success: true,

    bundle: '3K-C',
    phase: '3K.6_3K.7_3K.8_3K.9',

    at:

    note:

  };

  properties.setProperty(

  );

  );

  return lastResult;
}


/**
 * Run one step.
 */
function kidlearnV3_qaBatchRunStep_(
  step,
  stepNo,
  totalSteps
) {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var functionName =
    step.functionName;

  var result = {
    success: false,
    stepNo: stepNo,
    totalSteps: totalSteps,
    label: step.label || '',
    functionName: functionName,
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt: '',
    durationMs: 0,
    errorMessage: '',
    warningCount: 0,
    warnings: [],
    outputSummary: null
  };

  try {
    kidlearnV3_qaBatchAssertFunctionAllowed_(
      functionName
    );

    var fnExists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!fnExists) {
      throw new Error(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        functionName
      );
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var output =
      fn();

    var summary =
      kidlearnV3_qaBatchSummarizeOutput_(
        output
      );

    result.outputSummary =
      summary;

    result.warningCount =
      summary.warningCount || 0;

    result.warnings =
      summary.warnings || [];

    if (
      output &&
      output.success === false
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        kidlearnV3_qaBatchGetOutputErrorMessage_(
          output
        )
      );
    }

    result.success = true;

  } catch (error) {
    result.success = false;
    result.errorMessage =
      String(error.message || error);
  }

  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  result.finishedAt =
    finishedAt.toISOString();

  result.durationMs =
    finishedAt.getTime() -
    startedAt.getTime();

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Guard: không cho batch chạy các hàm nguy hiểm.
 */
function kidlearnV3_qaBatchAssertFunctionAllowed_(
  functionName
) {
  var name =
    String(functionName || '');

  var blockedExact = {
    kidlearnV3_createV3Sheets: true,
    kidlearnV3_migrateLegacyV2SheetsToV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_migrateV2DataToV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_enableControlledWriteDevV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_armControlledWriteDevV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_runUiRealWriteTrial3JBCleanV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_uiRealWriteTrial3JBExecuteV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_confirmRollbackUiRealWriteTrial3JBV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_rollbackUiRealWriteTrial3JBV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_closePhase3JV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_closePhase3JCompatV3: true,
    kidlearnV3_createV3Sheets: true,
    kidlearnV3_applyDataValidationAllSheets: true,
    kidlearnV3_clearDataValidationAllSheets: true
  };

  if (blockedExact[name]) {
    throw new Error(
      'QA Batch không được chạy hàm nguy hiểm: ' +
      name
    );
  }

  var blockedPatterns = [
    /Rollback/i,
    /rollback/i,
    /Migrate/i,
    /migrate/i,
    /CreateV3Sheets/i,
    /createV3Sheets/i,
    /EnableControlledWrite/i,
    /ArmControlledWrite/i,
    /RealWriteTrial/i,
    /realWriteTrial/i,
    /ClosePhase/i,
    /closePhase/i,
    /ApplyDataValidation/i,
    /ClearDataValidation/i,
    /Delete/i,
    /delete/i
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < blockedPatterns.length; i++) {
    if (blockedPatterns[i].test(name)) {
      throw new Error(
        'QA Batch chặn function theo pattern an toàn: ' +
        name
      );
    }
  }
}


/**
 * Summarize output để log gọn.
 */
function kidlearnV3_qaBatchSummarizeOutput_(
  output
) {
  if (!output || typeof output !== 'object') {
    return {
      rawType: typeof output,
      warningCount: 0,
      warnings: []
    };
  }

  var summary = {
    success:
      output.success,
    action:
      output.action || '',
    bundle:
      output.bundle || '',
    phase:
      output.phase || '',
    status:
      output.status || '',
    nextBundle:
      output.nextBundle || '',
    nextPhase:
      output.nextPhase || '',
    errorCount:
      output.errorCount || 0,
    warningCount:
      output.warningCount || 0,
    errors:
      output.errors || [],
    warnings:
      output.warnings || []
  };

  if (output.decision) {
    summary.decision =
      output.decision;
  }

  if (output.noWriteCheck) {
    summary.noWriteCheck = {
      success:
        output.noWriteCheck.success,
      changedSheetCount:
        output.noWriteCheck.changedSheetCount || 0,
      changedSheets:
        output.noWriteCheck.changedSheets || []
    };
  }

  if (output.diagnostics) {
    summary.diagnostics =
      output.diagnostics;
  }

  if (output.safeWriteStatus) {
    summary.safeWriteStatus = {
      mode:
        output.safeWriteStatus.mode,
      enabled:
        output.safeWriteStatus.enabled
    };
  }

  if (output.runAllSummary) {
    summary.runAllSummary =
      output.runAllSummary;
  }

  if (output.dashboard) {
    summary.dashboard =
      output.dashboard;
  }

  return summary;
}


/**
 * Extract error message from output.
 */
function kidlearnV3_qaBatchGetOutputErrorMessage_(
  output
) {
  if (!output) {
    return 'Không có output.';
  }

  if (
    output.errors &&
    output.errors.length
  ) {
    return output.errors.join(' | ');
  }

  if (
    output.error &&
    output.error.message
  ) {
    return output.error.message;
  }

  if (output.error) {
    return String(output.error);
  }

  return 'Function trả success=false nhưng không có message.';
}


/**
 * Save compact result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_qaBatchSaveResult_(
  result
) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var status =
    result.success
      ? 'PASSED'
      : 'FAILED';

  var compact = {
    success: result.success,
    action: result.action,
    version: result.version,
    suiteName: result.suiteName,
    status: status,
    startedAt: result.startedAt,
    finishedAt: result.finishedAt,
    durationMs: result.durationMs,
    totalStepCount: result.totalStepCount,
    executedStepCount: result.executedStepCount,
    passedStepCount: result.passedStepCount,
    failedStepCount: result.failedStepCount,
    errorCount: result.errorCount,
    warningCount: result.warningCount,
    errors: result.errors,
    warnings: result.warnings,
    items: result.items.map(function(item) {
      return {
        stepNo: item.stepNo,
        totalSteps: item.totalSteps,
        label: item.label,
        functionName: item.functionName,
        success: item.success,
        durationMs: item.durationMs,
        errorMessage: item.errorMessage,
        outputSummary: item.outputSummary
      };
    }),
    safeMode: result.safeMode
  };

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_QA_BATCH_KEYS.LAST_RUN_AT,
    new Date().toISOString()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_QA_BATCH_KEYS.LAST_SUITE,
    result.suiteName
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_QA_BATCH_KEYS.LAST_STATUS,
    status
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_QA_BATCH_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(compact)
  );
}


/**
 * Read last compact result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_qaBatchReadLastResult_() {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_QA_BATCH_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON
      );

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Normalize options.
 */
function kidlearnV3_qaBatchNormalizeOptions_(
  options
) {
  if (!options) {
    return {};
  }

  if (typeof options !== 'object') {
    return {
      suiteName: String(options || '')
    };
  }

  return options;
}

/**
 * Preview checklist 3J.5.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewDryRunNoWriteChecklistV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions = [
    'kidlearnV3_previewLearningWriteDryRunUiV3',
    'kidlearnV3_smokeTestLearningWriteDryRunUiV3',
    'kidlearnV3_previewWriteRouterV3',

    'kidlearnV3_writeRouterLessonProgressSaveV3',
    'kidlearnV3_writeRouterDailyGoalSaveV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3',
    'kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_'
  ];

  var functionChecks =
    kidlearnV3_dryRunCheckFunctions_(
      requiredFunctions
    );

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      functionChecks.errors
    );

  var htmlChecks =
    kidlearnV3_dryRunCheckHtmlFiles_([
      'UI_Write_Router_Client_V3',
      'UI_Learning_Write_Client_V3',
      'UI_Dev_Learning_DryRun_V3'
    ]);

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      htmlChecks.errors
    );

  var phase3I =
    kidlearnV3_dryRunSafePhase3IAssert_();

  if (!phase3I.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 3I chưa CLOSED_LOCKED cho 3J: ' +
      phase3I.message
    );
  }

  var safeWriteStatus =
    kidlearnV3_dryRunSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (safeWriteStatus.mode !== 'DRY_RUN') {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write Layer phải ở DRY_RUN trước khi kiểm tra no-write. Mode hiện tại: ' +
      safeWriteStatus.mode
    );
  }

  if (safeWriteStatus.enabled !== false) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write Layer enabled phải là false trước khi kiểm tra no-write.'
    );
  }

  var routerStatus =
    kidlearnV3_dryRunSafeRouterStatus_();

  var routerDryRunOnly =
    routerStatus.success &&
    routerStatus.data
      ? routerStatus.data.dryRunOnly
      : null;

  if (routerDryRunOnly !== true) {
    errors.push(
      'Write Router phải ở DRY_RUN_ONLY=true.'
    );
  }

  var targetCheck =
    kidlearnV3_dryRunCheckTargetSheets_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      targetCheck.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      targetCheck.warnings
    );

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_DRY_RUN_NO_WRITE_CHECKLIST_V3',
    phase: '3J.5',
    dryRunOnly: true,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3I: phase3I,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWriteStatus,
    routerStatus: {
      success: routerStatus.success === true,
      dryRunOnly: routerDryRunOnly
    },
    targetSheets: targetCheck.items,
    functionChecks: functionChecks.items,
    htmlChecks: htmlChecks.items
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Chạy checklist xác nhận DRY_RUN không đổi Database V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runDryRunNoWriteChecklistV3() {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewDryRunNoWriteChecklistV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể chạy 3J.5 vì preview chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      preview.errorCount
    );
  }

  var targetSheets =
    KIDLEARN_V3_DRY_RUN_TARGET_SHEETS.slice();

  var beforeSnapshot =
    kidlearnV3_dryRunSnapshotSheets_(
      targetSheets
    );

  var scenario =
    kidlearnV3_dryRunExecuteScenario_();

  if (!scenario.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Dry-run scenario có lỗi. Errors: ' +
      scenario.errorCount
    );
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      scenario.warnings
    );

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  Utilities.sleep(500);

  var afterSnapshot =
    kidlearnV3_dryRunSnapshotSheets_(
      targetSheets
    );

  var diff =
    kidlearnV3_dryRunCompareSnapshots_(
      beforeSnapshot,
      afterSnapshot
    );

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      diff.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      diff.warnings
    );

  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'RUN_DRY_RUN_NO_WRITE_CHECKLIST_V3',
    phase: '3J.5',
    dryRunOnly: true,
    startedAt: startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt: finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    targetSheets: targetSheets,
    beforeSnapshot: beforeSnapshot.summary,
    afterSnapshot: afterSnapshot.summary,
    diff: diff,
    scenario: scenario,
    checklist:
      kidlearnV3_dryRunBuildChecklist_(
        errors,
        warnings,
        diff,
        scenario
      )
  };

  kidlearnV3_dryRunSaveResult_(
    result
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'DRY_RUN đã làm thay đổi Database V3 hoặc scenario có lỗi. Errors: ' +
      result.errorCount
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Đánh dấu 3J.5 sẵn sàng review trước khi cân nhắc bật ghi thật.
