/**
 * Chạy dry-run scenario đầy đủ qua Write Router.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunExecuteScenario_() {
  var warnings = [];
  var steps = [];

  var sample =
    kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetSampleContextV3({});

  var context =
    sample.success && sample.data
      ? sample.data.sampleContext || {}
      : {};

  if (!sample.success) {
    steps.push({
      name: 'SAMPLE_CONTEXT',
      success: false,
      error:
        kidlearnV3_dryRunGetErrorMessage_(
          sample
        )
    });
  }

  var childId =
    context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID';

  var subjectId =
    context.subjectId || '';

  var lessonId =
    context.lessonId || 'DRY_RUN_LESSON_ID';

  var studySessionId =
    'DRY_RUN_NOWRITE_' +
    Utilities.formatDate(
      new Date(),
      Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
      'yyyyMMddHHmmss'
    );

  kidlearnV3_dryRunScenarioStep_(
    steps,
    'AUDIT_EVENT',
    function() {
      return kidlearnV3_writeRouterAuditEventV3({
        payload: {
          eventType: 'DRY_RUN_NO_WRITE_CHECK',
          message: 'Dry-run no-write check from 3J.5',
          entityType: 'PHASE',
          entityId: '3J.5',
          childId: childId
        },
        dryRun: true
      });
    }
  );

  kidlearnV3_dryRunScenarioStep_(
    steps,
    'STUDY_START',
    function() {
      return kidlearnV3_writeRouterStudyStartV3({
        payload: {
          studySessionId: studySessionId,
          childId: childId,
          subjectId: subjectId,
          lessonId: lessonId
        },
        dryRun: true
      });
    }
  );

  kidlearnV3_dryRunScenarioStep_(
    steps,
    'LESSON_PROGRESS_SAVE',
    function() {
      return kidlearnV3_writeRouterLessonProgressSaveV3({
        payload: {
          childId: childId,
          subjectId: subjectId,
          lessonId: lessonId,
          progressPercent: 40
        },
        dryRun: true
      });
    }
  );

  kidlearnV3_dryRunScenarioStep_(
    steps,
    'DAILY_GOAL_SAVE',
    function() {
      return kidlearnV3_writeRouterDailyGoalSaveV3({
        payload: {
          childId: childId,
          goalDate: kidlearnV3_dryRunToday_(),
          targetMinutes: 20,
          completedMinutes: 8
        },
        dryRun: true
      });
    }
  );

  kidlearnV3_dryRunScenarioStep_(
    steps,
    'STUDY_FINISH',
    function() {
      return kidlearnV3_writeRouterStudyFinishV3({
        payload: {
          studySessionId: studySessionId,
          durationSeconds: 300
        },
        dryRun: true
      });
    }
  );

  if (context.assignmentId) {
    kidlearnV3_dryRunScenarioStep_(
      steps,
      'ASSIGNMENT_START',
      function() {
        return kidlearnV3_writeRouterAssignmentStartV3({
          payload: {
            assignmentId: context.assignmentId
          },
          dryRun: true
        });
      }
    );

    kidlearnV3_dryRunScenarioStep_(
      steps,
      'ASSIGNMENT_PROGRESS',
      function() {
        return kidlearnV3_writeRouterAssignmentProgressV3({
          payload: {
            assignmentId: context.assignmentId,
            progressPercent: 60
          },
          dryRun: true
        });
      }
    );

    kidlearnV3_dryRunScenarioStep_(
      steps,
      'ASSIGNMENT_COMPLETE',
      function() {
        return kidlearnV3_writeRouterAssignmentCompleteV3({
          payload: {
            assignmentId: context.assignmentId
          },
          dryRun: true
        });
      }
    );

  } else {
    warnings.push(
      'Không có assignmentId mẫu nên bỏ qua assignment dry-run scenario.'
    );
  }

  var errors = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) {
    if (steps[i].success !== true) {
      errors.push(
        steps[i].name + ': ' + steps[i].error
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'DRY_RUN_SCENARIO_V3',
    dryRunOnly: true,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    sampleContext: context,
    studySessionId: studySessionId,
    steps: steps
  };
}


/**
 * Scenario step wrapper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunScenarioStep_(
  steps,
  name,
  handler
) {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  try {
    var response =
      handler();

    var success =
      response &&
      response.success === true;

    steps.push({
      name: name,
      success: success,
      startedAt: startedAt.toISOString(),
      finishedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      dryRun:
        kidlearnV3_dryRunExtractDryRunFlag_(
          response
        ),
      executed:
        kidlearnV3_dryRunExtractExecutedFlag_(
          response
        ),
      serviceName:
        response && response.serviceName
          ? response.serviceName
          : '',
      error:
        success
          ? ''
          : kidlearnV3_dryRunGetErrorMessage_(
              response
            )
    });

    return response;

  } catch (error) {
    steps.push({
      name: name,
      success: false,
      startedAt: startedAt.toISOString(),
      finishedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      dryRun: true,
      executed: false,
      error:
        String(
          error &&
          error.message
            ? error.message
            : error
        )
    });

    return null;
  }
}


/**
 * Snapshot nhiều sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunSnapshotSheets_(
  sheetNames
) {
  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_dryRunGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  var items = [];
  var summary = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < sheetNames.length; i++) {
    var item =
      kidlearnV3_dryRunSnapshotSheet_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetNames[i]
      );

    items.push(item);

    summary.push({
      sheetName: item.sheetName,
      exists: item.exists,
      lastRow: item.lastRow,
      lastColumn: item.lastColumn,
      dataRowCount: item.dataRowCount,
      checksum: item.checksum
    });
  }

  return {
    spreadsheetId:
      spreadsheet.getId(),
    spreadsheetName:
      spreadsheet.getName(),
    capturedAt:
      new Date().toISOString(),
    items:
      items,
    summary:
      summary
  };
}


/**
 * Snapshot một sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunSnapshotSheet_(
  spreadsheet,
  sheetName
) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_dryRunGetSheet_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      sheetName: sheetName,
      exists: false,
      lastRow: 0,
      lastColumn: 0,
      dataRowCount: 0,
      checksum: ''
    };
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  var values = [];

  if (
    lastRow > 0 &&
    lastColumn > 0
  ) {
    values =
      sheet
        .getRange(
          1,
          1,
          lastRow,
          lastColumn
        )
        .getDisplayValues();
  }

  var text =
    JSON.stringify({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      lastRow: lastRow,
      lastColumn: lastColumn,
      values: values
    });

  return {
    sheetName: sheetName,
    exists: true,
    lastRow: lastRow,
    lastColumn: lastColumn,
    dataRowCount:
      Math.max(0, lastRow - 2),
    checksum:
      kidlearnV3_dryRunMd5_(
        text
      )
  };
}


/**
 * So sánh snapshot before/after.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunCompareSnapshots_(
  beforeSnapshot,
  afterSnapshot
) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var beforeMap =
    kidlearnV3_dryRunMapSnapshots_(
      beforeSnapshot.items
    );

  var afterMap =
    kidlearnV3_dryRunMapSnapshots_(
      afterSnapshot.items
    );

  var sheetNames =
    Object.keys(beforeMap);

  var changedSheets = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < sheetNames.length; i++) {
    var name =
      sheetNames[i];

    var before =
      beforeMap[name];

    var after =
      afterMap[name];

    if (!after) {
      errors.push(
        'Sheet biến mất sau dry-run: ' +
        name
      );

      changedSheets.push(name);

      continue;
    }

    var changed = false;
    var changes = [];

    if (before.exists !== after.exists) {
      changed = true;
      changes.push(
        'exists ' +
        before.exists +
        ' -> ' +
        after.exists
      );
    }

    if (before.lastRow !== after.lastRow) {
      changed = true;
      changes.push(
        'lastRow ' +
        before.lastRow +
        ' -> ' +
        after.lastRow
      );
    }

    if (before.lastColumn !== after.lastColumn) {
      changed = true;
      changes.push(
        'lastColumn ' +
        before.lastColumn +
        ' -> ' +
        after.lastColumn
      );
    }

    if (before.dataRowCount !== after.dataRowCount) {
      changed = true;
      changes.push(
        'dataRowCount ' +
        before.dataRowCount +
        ' -> ' +
        after.dataRowCount
      );
    }

    if (before.checksum !== after.checksum) {
      changed = true;
      changes.push(
        'checksum changed'
      );
    }

    if (changed) {
      changedSheets.push(name);

      errors.push(
        'DRY_RUN làm thay đổi sheet ' +
        name +
        ': ' +
        changes.join(', ')
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    checkedSheetCount: sheetNames.length,
    changedSheetCount: changedSheets.length,
    changedSheets: changedSheets,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Build checklist summary.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunBuildChecklist_(
  errors,
  warnings,
  diff,
  scenario
) {
  return [
    {
      item: 'Safe Write Layer giữ DRY_RUN',
      status:
        kidlearnV3_dryRunSafeWriteStatus_().mode === 'DRY_RUN'
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'Write Router giữ DRY_RUN_ONLY',
      status:
        kidlearnV3_dryRunRouterDryRunOnly_()
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'Dry-run scenario chạy qua Write Router',
      status:
        scenario.success
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'Target sheets không đổi row count',
      status:
        diff.changedSheetCount === 0
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'Target sheets không đổi checksum',
      status:
        diff.changedSheetCount === 0
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'Kết luận 3J.5',
      status:
        errors.length === 0
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED',
      warningCount:
        warnings.length
    }
  ];
}


/**
 * Check target sheets.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunCheckTargetSheets_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var items = [];

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_dryRunGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();
  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được Database V3: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );

    return {
      errors: errors,
      warnings: warnings,
      items: items
    };
  }

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < KIDLEARN_V3_DRY_RUN_TARGET_SHEETS.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sheetName =
      KIDLEARN_V3_DRY_RUN_TARGET_SHEETS[i];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_dryRunGetSheet_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetName
      );

    if (!sheet) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu target sheet: ' +
        sheetName
      );

      items.push({
        sheetName: sheetName,
        exists: false
      });

      continue;
    }

    items.push({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      exists: true,
      lastRow: sheet.getLastRow(),
      lastColumn: sheet.getLastColumn()
    });
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Save result gọn vào ScriptProperties.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunSaveResult_(
  result
) {
  var status =
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_DRY_RUN_CHECK_STATUS.PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_DRY_RUN_CHECK_STATUS.FAILED;

  var compact = {
    success: result.success,
    action: result.action,
    phase: result.phase,
    dryRunOnly: result.dryRunOnly,
    finishedAt: result.finishedAt,
    durationMs: result.durationMs,
    errorCount: result.errorCount,
    warningCount: result.warningCount,
    changedSheetCount:
      result.diff
        ? result.diff.changedSheetCount
        : null,
    changedSheets:
      result.diff
        ? result.diff.changedSheets
        : [],
    checklist: result.checklist
  };

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_DRY_RUN_CHECK_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_DRY_RUN_CHECK_KEYS.LAST_RUN_AT,
    new Date().toISOString()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_DRY_RUN_CHECK_KEYS.LAST_ERROR_COUNT,
    String(result.errorCount)
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_DRY_RUN_CHECK_KEYS.LAST_WARNING_COUNT,
    String(result.warningCount)
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_DRY_RUN_CHECK_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(compact)
  );
}


/**
 * Read last result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunReadLastResult_() {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_DRY_RUN_CHECK_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON
      );

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Map snapshot.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunMapSnapshots_(
  items
) {
  var map = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    map[items[i].sheetName] =
      items[i];
  }

  return map;
}


/**
 * Get database spreadsheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_() {
  var database =
    kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_();

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_dryRunResolveSpreadsheet_(
      database
    );

  if (!spreadsheet) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không resolve được Spreadsheet object từ Database V3.'
    );
  }

  return spreadsheet;
}


/**
 * Resolve database wrapper thành Spreadsheet object.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunResolveSpreadsheet_(
  value
) {
  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (
    typeof value.getSheets === 'function' &&
    typeof value.getId === 'function'
  ) {
    return value;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheet &&
    typeof value.spreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheet;
  }

  if (
    value.database &&
    typeof value.database.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.database;
  }

  if (
    value.db &&
    typeof value.db.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.db;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheetObject &&
    typeof value.spreadsheetObject.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheetObject;
  }

  if (
    value.activeSpreadsheet &&
    typeof value.activeSpreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.activeSpreadsheet;
  }

  if (value.spreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.spreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (value.databaseSpreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.databaseSpreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (
    value.id &&
    typeof value.id === 'string'
  ) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.id
    );
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Get sheet exact name.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunGetSheet_(
  spreadsheet,
  sheetName
) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunCheckFunctions_(
  functionNames
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < functionNames.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          functionNames[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: functionNames[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        functionNames[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Check HTML files.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunCheckHtmlFiles_(
  filenames
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < filenames.length; i++) {
    try {
      var content =
        HtmlService
          .createHtmlOutputFromFile(
            filenames[i]
          )
          .getContent();

      items.push({
        name: filenames[i],
        exists: true,
        length: content.length
      });

    } catch (error) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu HTML file: ' +
        filenames[i]
      );

      items.push({
        name: filenames[i],
        exists: false,
        error:
          String(error.message || error)
      });
    }
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}

 * Safe Phase 3I assert.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunSafePhase3IAssert_() {
  try {
    var result =
      kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3();

    return {
      success: result.success === true,

    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        String(
          error &&
          error.message
            ? error.message
            : error
        )
    };
  }
}


/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunSafeWriteStatus_() {
  try {

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:

    };
  }
}


/**

 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunSafeRouterStatus_() {

  } catch (error) {

      }

/**

  );

/**
 * Extract dryRun flag.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunExtractDryRunFlag_(
  response
) {
  try {
    return (
      response.data &&
      response.data.writeService &&
      response.data.writeService.data &&
      response.data.writeService.data.dryRun === true
    );
  } catch (error) {
    return true;
  }
}


/**
 * Extract executed flag.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunExtractExecutedFlag_(
  response
) {
  try {
    return (
      response.data &&
      response.data.writeService &&
      response.data.writeService.data &&
      response.data.writeService.data.executed === true
    );

/**
 * Error message helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunGetErrorMessage_(
  response
) {
  if (
    response &&
    response.error &&
    response.error.message
  ) {
    return response.error.message;
  }

  if (
    response &&
    response.details &&
    response.details.writeResponse &&
    response.details.writeResponse.error &&
    response.details.writeResponse.error.message
  ) {
    return response.details.writeResponse.error.message;
  }

  return 'Không rõ lỗi.';
}


/**
 * MD5 checksum.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunMd5_(
  text
) {
  var digest =
    Utilities.computeDigest(
      Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.MD5,
      text,
      Utilities.Charset.UTF_8
    );

  var result = '';

  for (var i = 0; i < digest.length; i++) {
    var value =
      digest[i];

    if (value < 0) {
      value += 256;
    }

    result +=
      ('0' + value.toString(16)).slice(-2);
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Today yyyy-MM-dd.
 */
function kidlearnV3_dryRunToday_() {
  return Utilities.formatDate(
    new Date(),
    Session.getScriptTimeZone(),
    'yyyy-MM-dd'
  );
}

var KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS = {
  PHASE_STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_STATUS',
  LAST_RUN_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LAST_RUN_AT',
  LAST_READY_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_READY_AT',
  LAST_ERROR_COUNT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LAST_ERROR_COUNT',
  LAST_WARNING_COUNT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LAST_WARNING_COUNT',
  LAST_SUMMARY_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3I_LAST_SUMMARY_JSON'
};

var KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_STATUS = {
  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  PASSED: 'PASSED',
  FAILED: 'FAILED',
  READY_TO_CLOSE: 'READY_TO_CLOSE'
};


/**
 * Preview E2E UI DEV V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewEndToEndUiDevV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions = [
    'kidlearnV3_getAppDevConnectionV3Status',
    'kidlearnV3_previewAppServiceFacadeV3',
    'kidlearnV3_previewUiDevSwitchV3',
    'kidlearnV3_previewUiScreenMapperV3',
    'kidlearnV3_previewUiRouterDevV3',
    'kidlearnV3_previewLegacyCallReplacementV3',
    'kidlearnV3_uiSwitchGetModeV3',
    'kidlearnV3_servicePingV3',
    'kidlearnV3_serviceGetBootstrapV3',
    'kidlearnV3_uiRouterGetInitialStateV3',
    'kidlearnV3_uiRouterLoadScreenV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getHomeDataV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getSubjectsDataV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getChildrenDataV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getAssignmentsDataV3'
  ];

  var requiredHtmlFiles = [
    'UI_Legacy_Call_Adapter_V3',
    'UI_Dev_App_Router_V3',
    'UI_Router_Dev_Client_V3',
    'UI_Router_Dev_Shell_V3'
  ];

  var functionChecks = [];
  var htmlChecks = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < requiredFunctions.length; i++) {
    var functionCheck =
      kidlearnV3_e2eCheckFunction_(
        requiredFunctions[i]
      );

    functionChecks.push(functionCheck);

    if (!functionCheck.exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        functionCheck.name
      );
    }
  }

  for (var h = 0; h < requiredHtmlFiles.length; h++) {
    var htmlCheck =
      kidlearnV3_e2eCheckHtmlFile_(
        requiredHtmlFiles[h]
      );

    htmlChecks.push(htmlCheck);

    if (!htmlCheck.exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu HTML file: ' +
        htmlCheck.name
      );
    }
  }

  var mode =
    kidlearnV3_e2eSafeSwitchMode_();

  if (mode !== 'V3') {
    errors.push(
      'DEV_SWITCH chưa bật V3. Mode hiện tại: ' +
      mode
    );
  }

  var connection =
    kidlearnV3_e2eSafeConnectionStatus_();

  if (
    connection.databaseMode !== 'V3' ||
    connection.connectionStatus !== 'CONNECTED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'App DEV chưa CONNECTED với Database V3.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'PREVIEW_E2E_UI_DEV_V3',
    phase:
      '3I.9',
    mode:
      mode,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      warnings.length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      warnings,
    connection:
      connection,
    functionChecks:
      functionChecks,
    htmlChecks:
      htmlChecks
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Run full E2E UI DEV V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runEndToEndUiDevV3() {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var steps = [];
  var warnings = [];

  kidlearnV3_e2eStep_(
    steps,
    '01_PREVIEW_E2E_DEPENDENCIES',
    function() {
      var result =
        kidlearnV3_previewEndToEndUiDevV3();

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssert_(
        result.success,
        'Preview E2E chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
        result.errorCount
      );

      return result;
    }
  );

  kidlearnV3_e2eStep_(
    steps,
    '02_SERVICE_PING',
    function() {
      var response =
        kidlearnV3_servicePingV3({});

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssertResponse_(
        response,
        'Service ping thất bại.'
      );

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssert_(
        response.data.databaseMode === 'V3',
        'Service ping không ở databaseMode V3.'
      );

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssert_(
        response.data.connectionStatus === 'CONNECTED',
        'Service ping chưa CONNECTED.'
      );

      return response;
    }
  );

  kidlearnV3_e2eStep_(
    steps,
    '03_SERVICE_BOOTSTRAP',
    function() {
      var response =
        kidlearnV3_serviceGetBootstrapV3({});

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssertResponse_(
        response,
        'Service bootstrap thất bại.'
      );

      var counts =
        response.data.counts || {};

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssert_(
        Number(counts.subjects || 0) >= 4,
        'Bootstrap phải có ít nhất 4 subjects.'
      );

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssert_(
        Number(counts.children || 0) >= 1,
        'Bootstrap phải có ít nhất 1 child.'
      );

      if (Number(counts.assignments || 0) < 1) {
        warnings.push(
          'Bootstrap assignments đang trống hoặc chưa gắn với child hiện tại.'
        );
      }

      return response;
    }
  );

  kidlearnV3_e2eStep_(
    steps,
    '04_ROUTER_INITIAL_HOME',
    function() {
      var response =
        kidlearnV3_uiRouterGetInitialStateV3({
          screen: 'HOME'
        });

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssertResponse_(
        response,
        'Router initial HOME thất bại.'
      );

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssert_(
        response.currentScreen === 'HOME',
        'Initial screen không phải HOME.'
      );

      return response;
    }
  );

  kidlearnV3_e2eStep_(
    steps,
    '05_ROUTER_SUBJECTS',
    function() {
      var response =
        kidlearnV3_uiRouterLoadScreenV3({
          screen: 'SUBJECTS'
        });

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssertResponse_(
        response,
        'Router SUBJECTS thất bại.'
      );

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssert_(
        Number(response.data.count || 0) >= 4,
        'SUBJECTS phải có ít nhất 4 môn học.'
      );

      return response;
    }
  );

  kidlearnV3_e2eStep_(
    steps,
    '06_ROUTER_CHILDREN',
    function() {
      var response =
        kidlearnV3_uiRouterLoadScreenV3({
          screen: 'CHILDREN'
        });

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssertResponse_(
        response,
        'Router CHILDREN thất bại.'
      );

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssert_(
        Number(response.data.count || 0) >= 1,
        'CHILDREN phải có ít nhất 1 child.'
      );

      return response;
    }
  );

  kidlearnV3_e2eStep_(
    steps,
    '07_ROUTER_ASSIGNMENTS',
    function() {
      var response =
        kidlearnV3_uiRouterLoadScreenV3({
          screen: 'ASSIGNMENTS',
          limit: 100
        });

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssertResponse_(
        response,
        'Router ASSIGNMENTS thất bại.'
      );

      if (Number(response.data.count || 0) < 1) {
        warnings.push(
          'Router ASSIGNMENTS đang trống hoặc chưa gắn với child hiện tại.'
        );
      }

      return response;
    }
  );

  kidlearnV3_e2eStep_(
    steps,
    '08_LEGACY_REPLACEMENT_HOME',
    function() {
      var response =
        kidlearnV3_getHomeDataV3({});

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssertResponse_(
        response,
        'Legacy replacement HOME thất bại.'
      );

      var counts =
        response.data.counts || {};

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssert_(
        Number(counts.subjects || 0) >= 4,
        'Legacy HOME phải có ít nhất 4 subjects.'
      );

      return response;
    }
  );

  kidlearnV3_e2eStep_(
    steps,
    '09_LEGACY_REPLACEMENT_SUBJECTS',
    function() {
      var response =
        kidlearnV3_getSubjectsDataV3({});

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssertResponse_(
        response,
        'Legacy replacement SUBJECTS thất bại.'
      );

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssert_(
        Number(response.data.count || 0) >= 4,
        'Legacy SUBJECTS phải có ít nhất 4 subjects.'
      );

      return response;
    }
  );

  kidlearnV3_e2eStep_(
    steps,
    '10_LEGACY_REPLACEMENT_CHILDREN',
    function() {
      var response =
        kidlearnV3_getChildrenDataV3({});

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssertResponse_(
        response,
        'Legacy replacement CHILDREN thất bại.'
      );

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssert_(
        Number(response.data.count || 0) >= 1,
        'Legacy CHILDREN phải có ít nhất 1 child.'
      );

      return response;
    }
  );

  kidlearnV3_e2eStep_(
    steps,
    '11_LEGACY_REPLACEMENT_ASSIGNMENTS',
    function() {
      var response =
        kidlearnV3_getAssignmentsDataV3({
          limit: 100
        });

      kidlearnV3_e2eAssertResponse_(
        response,
        'Legacy replacement ASSIGNMENTS thất bại.'
      );

      if (Number(response.data.count || 0) < 1) {
        warnings.push(
          'Legacy ASSIGNMENTS đang trống hoặc chưa gắn với child hiện tại.'
        );
      }

      return response;
    }
  );

  var errors =
    kidlearnV3_e2eCollectStepErrors_(
      steps
    );

  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action:
      'RUN_E2E_UI_DEV_V3',
    phase:
      '3I.9',
    mode:
      kidlearnV3_e2eSafeSwitchMode_(),
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      warnings.length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      warnings,
    steps:
      steps,
    checklist:
      kidlearnV3_e2eBuildChecklist_(
        steps,
        errors,
        warnings
      )
  };

  kidlearnV3_e2eSaveStatus_(
    result
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'E2E UI DEV V3 chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      result.errorCount
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Đánh dấu Phase 3I đã sẵn sàng đóng.
 *
 * Hàm này sẽ chạy E2E trước.
 * Chỉ khi E2E pass mới đánh dấu READY_TO_CLOSE.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markPhase3IReadyForCloseV3() {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_runEndToEndUiDevV3();

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể đóng phase 3I vì E2E chưa pass.'
    );
  }

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS.PHASE_STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_STATUS.READY_TO_CLOSE
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT,
    new Date().toISOString()
  );

  var finalResult = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_PHASE_3I_READY_FOR_CLOSE_V3',
    phase: '3I',
    status: KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_STATUS.READY_TO_CLOSE,
    message: 'Phase 3I đã sẵn sàng đóng.',
    e2eSummary: {
      errorCount: result.errorCount,
      warningCount: result.warningCount,
      durationMs: result.durationMs
    }
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(finalResult, null, 2)
  );

  return finalResult;
}


/**
 * Xem trạng thái Phase 3I.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getPhase3IStatusV3() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'GET_PHASE_3I_STATUS_V3',
    phase: '3I',
    status:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS.PHASE_STATUS
      ) ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_STATUS.NOT_RUN,
    lastRunAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS.LAST_RUN_AT
      ) ||
      '',
    lastReadyAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
      ) ||
      '',
    lastErrorCount:
      Number(
        properties.getProperty(
          KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS.LAST_ERROR_COUNT
        ) ||
        0
      ),
    lastWarningCount:
      Number(
        properties.getProperty(
          KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS.LAST_WARNING_COUNT
        ) ||
        0
      ),
    lastSummary:
      kidlearnV3_e2eReadLastSummary_()
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Step wrapper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_e2eStep_(
  steps,
  name,
  handler
) {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  try {
    var output =
      handler();

    var finishedAt =
      new Date();

    steps.push({
      name: name,
      success: true,
      startedAt: startedAt.toISOString(),
      finishedAt: finishedAt.toISOString(),
      durationMs:
        finishedAt.getTime() -
        startedAt.getTime(),
      summary:
        kidlearnV3_e2eSummarizeOutput_(
          output
        )
    });

    return output;

  } catch (error) {
    var failedAt =
      new Date();

    steps.push({
      name: name,
      success: false,
      startedAt: startedAt.toISOString(),
      finishedAt: failedAt.toISOString(),
      durationMs:
        failedAt.getTime() -
        startedAt.getTime(),
      error: {
        message:
          String(
            error &&
            error.message
              ? error.message
              : error
          )
      }
    });

    return null;
  }
}


/**
 * Assert boolean.
 */
function kidlearnV3_e2eAssert_(
  condition,
  message
) {
  if (!condition) {
    throw new Error(message);
  }
}


/**
 * Assert response success.
 */
function kidlearnV3_e2eAssertResponse_(
  response,
  message
) {
  if (!response) {
    throw new Error(
      message + ' Response trống.'
    );
  }

  if (response.success !== true) {
    var errorMessage =
      response.error &&
      response.error.message
        ? response.error.message
        : 'Không rõ lỗi.';

    throw new Error(
      message + ' ' + errorMessage
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Collect step errors.
 */
function kidlearnV3_e2eCollectStepErrors_(
  steps
) {
  var errors = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) {
    if (steps[i].success) {
      continue;
    }

    errors.push(
      steps[i].name +
      ': ' +
      steps[i].error.message
    );
  }

  return errors;
}


/**
 * Build checklist.
 */
function kidlearnV3_e2eBuildChecklist_(
  steps,
  errors,
  warnings
) {
  return [
    {
      item: 'Database V3 connection',
      status:
        kidlearnV3_e2eStepPassed_(
          steps,
          '02_SERVICE_PING'
        )
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'Service Facade bootstrap',
      status:
        kidlearnV3_e2eStepPassed_(
          steps,
          '03_SERVICE_BOOTSTRAP'
        )
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'UI Router initial HOME',
      status:
        kidlearnV3_e2eStepPassed_(
          steps,
          '04_ROUTER_INITIAL_HOME'
        )
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'SUBJECTS screen',
      status:
        kidlearnV3_e2eStepPassed_(
          steps,
          '05_ROUTER_SUBJECTS'
        )
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'CHILDREN screen',
      status:
        kidlearnV3_e2eStepPassed_(
          steps,
          '06_ROUTER_CHILDREN'
        )
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'ASSIGNMENTS screen',
      status:
        kidlearnV3_e2eStepPassed_(
          steps,
          '07_ROUTER_ASSIGNMENTS'
        )
          ? 'PASSED_WITH_OPTIONAL_DATA'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'Legacy call replacement',
      status:
        kidlearnV3_e2eStepPassed_(
          steps,
          '08_LEGACY_REPLACEMENT_HOME'
        ) &&
        kidlearnV3_e2eStepPassed_(
          steps,
          '09_LEGACY_REPLACEMENT_SUBJECTS'
        ) &&
        kidlearnV3_e2eStepPassed_(
          steps,
          '10_LEGACY_REPLACEMENT_CHILDREN'
        ) &&
        kidlearnV3_e2eStepPassed_(
          steps,
          '11_LEGACY_REPLACEMENT_ASSIGNMENTS'
        )
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'Phase 3I result',
      status:
        errors.length === 0
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED',
      warnings:
        warnings.length
    }
  ];
}


/**
 * Check step passed.
 */
function kidlearnV3_e2eStepPassed_(
  steps,
  name
) {
  for (var i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) {
    if (
      steps[i].name === name &&
      steps[i].success === true
    ) {
      return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}


/**
 * Save compact status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_e2eSaveStatus_(
  result
) {
  var status =
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_STATUS.PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_STATUS.FAILED;

  var summary = {
    success: result.success,
    action: result.action,
    phase: result.phase,
    mode: result.mode,
    finishedAt: result.finishedAt,
    durationMs: result.durationMs,
    errorCount: result.errorCount,
    warningCount: result.warningCount,
    checklist: result.checklist
  };

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS.PHASE_STATUS,
    status
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS.LAST_RUN_AT,
    new Date().toISOString()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS.LAST_ERROR_COUNT,
    String(result.errorCount)
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS.LAST_WARNING_COUNT,
    String(result.warningCount)
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS.LAST_SUMMARY_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(summary)
  );
}


/**
 * Read last summary.
 */
function kidlearnV3_e2eReadLastSummary_() {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_E2E_KEYS.LAST_SUMMARY_JSON
      );

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Summary output để log gọn.
 */
function kidlearnV3_e2eSummarizeOutput_(
  output
) {
  if (!output) {
    return {};
  }

  var summary = {
    success:
      output.success === true
  };

  if (output.action) {
    summary.action =
      output.action;
  }

  if (output.serviceName) {
    summary.serviceName =
      output.serviceName;
  }

  if (output.screen) {
    summary.screen =
      output.screen;
  }

  if (output.currentScreen) {
    summary.currentScreen =
      output.currentScreen;
  }

  if (output.mode) {
    summary.mode =
      output.mode;
  }

  if (
    output.data &&
    output.data.counts
  ) {
    summary.counts =
      output.data.counts;
  }

  if (
    output.data &&
    output.data.count !== undefined
  ) {
    summary.count =
      output.data.count;
  }

  if (
    output.error &&
    output.error.message
  ) {
    summary.error =
      output.error.message;
  }

  return summary;
}


/**
 * Check function tồn tại.
 */
function kidlearnV3_e2eCheckFunction_(
  functionName
) {
  var exists = false;

  try {
    exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );
  } catch (error) {
    exists = false;
  }

  return {
    name: functionName,
    exists: exists
  };
}


/**
 * Check HTML file tồn tại.
 */
function kidlearnV3_e2eCheckHtmlFile_(
  filename
) {
  try {
    var content =
      HtmlService
        .createHtmlOutputFromFile(
          filename
        )
        .getContent();

    return {
      name: filename,
      exists: true,
      length: content.length
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      name: filename,
      exists: false,
      error:
        String(
          error.message || error
        )
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe switch mode.
 */
function kidlearnV3_e2eSafeSwitchMode_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_uiSwitchGetModeV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return 'UNKNOWN';
  }
}


/**
 * Safe connection status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_e2eSafeConnectionStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getAppDevConnectionV3Status();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      databaseMode: '',
      connectionStatus: '',
      error:
        String(
          error.message || error
        )
    };
  }
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - POST REAL WRITE REVIEW
 * Step: 3J.9
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * File này kiểm tra dữ liệu sau real write/reset và quyết định
 * có đủ điều kiện để thiết kế real write qua UI DEV hay chưa.
 *
 * 3J.9 KHÔNG ghi thêm dữ liệu.
 * 3J.9 KHÔNG mở real write trực tiếp qua UI.
 * 3J.9 chỉ review, snapshot, verify và ra quyết định.
 *
 * KHÔNG sửa PROD.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J9_STATUS',
  LAST_RUN_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J9_LAST_RUN_AT',
  LAST_READY_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J9_READY_AT',
  LAST_DECISION: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J9_LAST_DECISION',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J9_LAST_RESULT_JSON'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_STATUS = {
  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  PASSED: 'PASSED',
  FAILED: 'FAILED',
  HOLD: 'HOLD',
  READY_TO_DESIGN_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE: 'READY_TO_DESIGN_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_DECISION = {
  HOLD_KEEP_UI_DRY_RUN: 'HOLD_KEEP_UI_DRY_RUN',
  DO_NOT_OPEN_UI_REAL_WRITE: 'DO_NOT_OPEN_UI_REAL_WRITE',
  READY_TO_DESIGN_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE: 'READY_TO_DESIGN_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE'
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_CONFIG = {
  VERSION: '3J.9',
  NEXT_PHASE: '3J.10',
  OPEN_REAL_WRITE_UI_NOW: false
};


var KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_TARGET_SHEETS = [
  'LOG_Audit',
  'DATA_StudySessions',
  'DATA_LessonProgress',
  'DATA_DailyGoals',
  'DATA_Assignments'
];


/**
 * Preview 3J.9.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewPostRealWriteReviewV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions = [
    'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getDryRunNoWriteChecklistStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getRealWriteSmallTransactionStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getRealWriteLearningFlowStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getAppDevConnectionV3Status',
    'kidlearnV3_writeRouterGetStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_'
  ];

  var functionChecks =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckFunctions_(
      requiredFunctions
    );

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      functionChecks.errors
    );

  var phase3I =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewSafePhase3I_();

  if (!phase3I.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 3I chưa CLOSED_LOCKED: ' +
      phase3I.message
    );
  }

  var connection =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewSafeConnection_();

  if (
    connection.databaseMode !== 'V3' ||
    connection.connectionStatus !== 'CONNECTED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'App DEV chưa CONNECTED với Database V3.'
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Sau real write, Safe Write Layer phải reset về DRY_RUN và enabled=false. Hiện tại mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewSafeControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED') {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write DEV vẫn đang ENABLED. Cần reset về DRY_RUN trước khi review 3J.9.'
    );
  }

  if (controlledWrite.status === 'ARMED') {
    warnings.push(
      'Controlled Write đang ARMED. Nên để DISABLED/DRY_RUN trước khi mở UI write gate.'
    );
  }

  var dryRunStatus =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewSafe3J5Status_();

  if (
    dryRunStatus.status !== 'READY_FOR_WRITE_REVIEW' &&
    dryRunStatus.status !== 'PASSED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3J.5 chưa READY_FOR_WRITE_REVIEW/PASSED. Hiện tại: ' +
      dryRunStatus.status
    );
  }

  var smallWriteStatus =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewSafe3J7Status_();

  if (
    smallWriteStatus.status !== 'PASSED' &&
    smallWriteStatus.status !== 'ROLLED_BACK' &&
    smallWriteStatus.status !== 'READY_FOR_NEXT'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3J.7 chưa PASSED/ROLLED_BACK/READY_FOR_NEXT. Hiện tại: ' +
      smallWriteStatus.status
    );
  }

  var learningFlowStatus =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewSafe3J8Status_();

  if (
    learningFlowStatus.status !== 'PASSED' &&
    learningFlowStatus.status !== 'ROLLED_BACK' &&
    learningFlowStatus.status !== 'READY_FOR_NEXT'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3J.8 chưa PASSED/ROLLED_BACK/READY_FOR_NEXT. Hiện tại: ' +
      learningFlowStatus.status
    );
  }

  var routerStatus =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewSafeRouterStatus_();

  var routerDryRunOnly =
    routerStatus.success &&
    routerStatus.data
      ? routerStatus.data.dryRunOnly
      : null;

  if (routerDryRunOnly !== true) {
    errors.push(
      'Write Router V3 phải còn DRY_RUN_ONLY=true ở 3J.9. Không mở UI real write khi router đã mở.'
    );
  }

  var targetCheck =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckTargetSheets_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      targetCheck.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      targetCheck.warnings
    );

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_POST_REAL_WRITE_REVIEW_V3',
    phase: '3J.9',
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    openRealWriteUiNow: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3I: phase3I,
    connection: connection,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite,
    controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite,
    dryRunChecklist3J5: {
      status: dryRunStatus.status || ''
    },
    realWriteSmall3J7: {
      status: smallWriteStatus.status || ''
    },
    realWriteLearningFlow3J8: {
      status: learningFlowStatus.status || ''
    },
    routerStatus: {
      success: routerStatus.success === true,
      dryRunOnly: routerDryRunOnly
    },
    targetSheets: targetCheck.items,
    functionChecks: functionChecks.items
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Reset về DRY_RUN trước khi review 3J.9.
 */
function kidlearnV3_resetWriteToDryRunForPostRealWriteReviewV3() {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_resetControlledWriteDevToDryRunV3 !== 'function'
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu function kidlearnV3_resetControlledWriteDevToDryRunV3 từ 3J.6.'
    );

    action: 'RESET_WRITE_TO_DRY_RUN_FOR_POST_REAL_WRITE_REVIEW_V3',
    phase: '3J.9',
    reset: reset,
    status: status,
    message:
      'Đã đưa Controlled Write/Safe Write về DRY_RUN để review 3J.9.'
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Chạy review chính 3J.9.
 *
 * Không ghi dữ liệu.

 */
function kidlearnV3_runPostRealWriteReviewV3() {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewPostRealWriteReviewV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể chạy 3J.9 vì preview chưa đạt. Errors: ' +

    );
  }

    );

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      learningFlowCheck.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      learningFlowCheck.warnings
    );

  var decision =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewBuildDecision_(
      errors,
      warnings,
      learningFlowCheck
    );

  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,
    action: 'RUN_POST_REAL_WRITE_REVIEW_V3',
    phase: '3J.9',
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    startedAt:
      startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt:
      finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      warnings.length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      warnings,
    openRealWriteUiNow:
      false,
    snapshot:
      currentSnapshot.summary,
    learningFlowCheck:
      learningFlowCheck,
    decision:
      decision,
    checklist:
      kidlearnV3_postReviewBuildChecklist_(
        errors,
        warnings,
        learningFlowCheck,
        decision
      )
  };

  kidlearnV3_postReviewSaveResult_(
    result
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3J.9 Post Real Write Review chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      result.errorCount
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Mark 3J.9 ready cho bước thiết kế UI real write gate.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markPostRealWriteReviewReadyV3() {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_runPostRealWriteReviewV3();

  if (
    !result.success ||
    !result.decision ||
    result.decision.decisionCode !==
      KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_DECISION.READY_TO_DESIGN_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark 3J.9 READY. Decision hiện tại chưa sẵn sàng.'
    );
  }

  var now =
    new Date();

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_KEYS.STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_STATUS.READY_TO_DESIGN_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT,
    now.toISOString()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_KEYS.LAST_DECISION,
    result.decision.decisionCode
  );

  var finalResult = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_POST_REAL_WRITE_REVIEW_READY_V3',
    phase: '3J.9',
    status: 'READY_TO_DESIGN_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE',
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    openRealWriteUiNow: false,
    decision:
      result.decision,
    message:
      '3J.9 đã pass. Có thể chuyển sang 3J.10 để thiết kế UI real write gate, nhưng chưa mở ghi thật trực tiếp qua UI.'
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(finalResult, null, 2)
  );

  return finalResult;
}


/**
 * Xem trạng thái 3J.9.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getPostRealWriteReviewStatusV3() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'GET_POST_REAL_WRITE_REVIEW_STATUS_V3',
    phase: '3J.9',
    status:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_KEYS.STATUS
      ) ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_STATUS.NOT_RUN,
    lastRunAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_KEYS.LAST_RUN_AT
      ) ||
      '',
    lastReadyAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
      ) ||
      '',
    lastDecision:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_KEYS.LAST_DECISION
      ) ||
      '',
    lastResult:
      kidlearnV3_postReviewReadLastResult_()
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert cho bước 3J.10.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertReadyToDesignUiRealWriteGateV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getPostRealWriteReviewStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_STATUS.READY_TO_DESIGN_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3J.9 chưa READY_TO_DESIGN_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE. Status hiện tại: ' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (
    status.lastDecision !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_DECISION.READY_TO_DESIGN_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3J.9 lastDecision chưa đúng. Hiện tại: ' +
      status.lastDecision
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Trước khi thiết kế UI real write gate, Safe Write phải ở DRY_RUN.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_READY_TO_DESIGN_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE_V3',
    phase: '3J.9',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    status: status.status,
    lastDecision: status.lastDecision,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Chưa đủ điều kiện chuyển sang 3J.10. Errors: ' +
      errors.length
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra trạng thái dữ liệu của transaction 3J.8.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewCheck3J8DataState_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var checks = [];

  var flowStatus =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewSafe3J8Status_();

  var last =
    flowStatus.lastResult || {};

  var ids =
    last.ids || {};

  var transactionId =
    last.transactionId ||
    flowStatus.lastTransactionId ||
    ids.transactionId ||
    '';

  if (!transactionId) {
    errors.push(
      'Không tìm thấy transactionId của 3J.8.'
    );
  }

  if (!ids.studySessionId) {
    errors.push(
      'Không tìm thấy studySessionId của 3J.8.'
    );
  }

  if (!ids.lessonProgressId) {
    errors.push(
      'Không tìm thấy lessonProgressId của 3J.8.'
    );
  }

  if (!ids.dailyGoalId) {
    errors.push(
      'Không tìm thấy dailyGoalId của 3J.8.'
    );
  }

  var rolledBack =
    flowStatus.status === 'ROLLED_BACK';

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    return {
      success: false,
      status: flowStatus.status || '',
      rolledBack: rolledBack,
      transactionId: transactionId,
      ids: ids,
      errorCount: errors.length,
      warningCount: warnings.length,
      errors: errors,
      warnings: warnings,
      checks: checks
    };
  }

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  checks.push(
    kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckDataRow_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_StudySessions',
      'studySessionId',
      ids.studySessionId,
      transactionId,
      rolledBack
    )
  );

  checks.push(
    kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckDataRow_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_LessonProgress',
      'lessonProgressId',
      ids.lessonProgressId,
      transactionId,
      rolledBack
    )
  );

  checks.push(
    kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckDataRow_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_DailyGoals',
      'dailyGoalId',
      ids.dailyGoalId,
      transactionId,
      rolledBack
    )
  );

  checks.push(
    kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckAssignmentNotChanged_(
      spreadsheet,
      transactionId
    )
  );

  checks.push(
    kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckAuditRows_(
      spreadsheet,
      [
        transactionId,
        ids.studySessionId,
        ids.lessonProgressId,
        ids.dailyGoalId
      ],
      rolledBack
    )
  );

  for (var i = 0; i < checks.length; i++) {
    if (checks[i].success !== true) {
      errors =
        errors.concat(
          checks[i].errors || []
        );
    }

    warnings =
      warnings.concat(
        checks[i].warnings || []
      );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    status: flowStatus.status || '',
    rolledBack: rolledBack,
    transactionId: transactionId,
    ids: ids,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    checks: checks
  };
}


/**
 * Check data row theo key.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckDataRow_(
  spreadsheet,
  sheetName,
  keyField,
  keyValue,
  transactionId,
  rolledBack
) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewGetSheet_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      success: false,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      errors: [
        'Không tìm thấy sheet: ' + sheetName
      ],
      warnings: []
    };
  }

  var rowsByKey =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewFindRowsByKey_(
      sheet,
      keyField,
      keyValue
    );

  var rowsByToken =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewFindRowsContainingTokens_(
      sheet,
      [
        transactionId,
        keyValue
      ]
    );

  if (rolledBack) {
    if (
      rowsByKey.length > 0 ||
      rowsByToken.length > 0
    ) {
      errors.push(
        sheetName +
        ' vẫn còn row test sau rollback. key=' +
        keyValue
      );
    }

  } else {
    if (rowsByKey.length !== 1) {
      errors.push(
        sheetName +
        ' phải có đúng 1 row test theo ' +
        keyField +
        '. Found=' +
        rowsByKey.length +
        ', key=' +
        keyValue
      );
    }

    if (rowsByToken.length < 1) {
      warnings.push(
        sheetName +
        ' không tìm thấy token transactionId trong row display. Vẫn chấp nhận nếu key match đúng.'
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    sheetName: sheetName,
    keyField: keyField,
    keyValue: keyValue,
    rolledBack: rolledBack,
    foundByKeyCount: rowsByKey.length,
    rowsByKey: rowsByKey,
    foundByTokenCount: rowsByToken.length,
    rowsByToken: rowsByToken,
    lastRow: sheet.getLastRow(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * DATA_Assignments không được chứa transactionId 3J.8.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckAssignmentNotChanged_(
  spreadsheet,
  transactionId
) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewGetSheet_(
      spreadsheet,
      'DATA_Assignments'
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      success: false,
      sheetName: 'DATA_Assignments',
      errors: [
        'Không tìm thấy sheet DATA_Assignments.'
      ],
      warnings: []
    };
  }

  var rows =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewFindRowsContainingTokens_(
      sheet,
      [
        transactionId
      ]
    );

  if (rows.length > 0) {
    errors.push(
      'DATA_Assignments không được chứa transactionId 3J.8. Found=' +
      rows.length
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    sheetName: 'DATA_Assignments',
    foundTokenCount: rows.length,
    rows: rows,
    lastRow: sheet.getLastRow(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Check LOG_Audit rows.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckAuditRows_(
  spreadsheet,
  tokens,
  rolledBack
) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewGetSheet_(
      spreadsheet,
      'LOG_Audit'
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      success: false,
      sheetName: 'LOG_Audit',
      errors: [
        'Không tìm thấy LOG_Audit.'
      ],
      warnings: []
    };
  }

  var rows =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewFindRowsContainingTokens_(
      sheet,
      tokens
    );

  if (rolledBack) {
    if (rows.length > 0) {
      errors.push(
        'LOG_Audit vẫn còn audit rows của 3J.8 sau rollback. Found=' +
        rows.length
      );
    }

  } else {
    if (rows.length < 2) {
      errors.push(
        'LOG_Audit phải có ít nhất 2 rows liên quan transaction 3J.8. Found=' +
        rows.length
      );
    }

    if (rows.length !== 6) {
      warnings.push(
        'LOG_Audit có ' +
        rows.length +
        ' rows liên quan 3J.8. Chấp nhận vì audit tự động có thể khác số kỳ vọng cũ.'
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    sheetName: 'LOG_Audit',
    rolledBack: rolledBack,
    foundRowCount: rows.length,
    rows: rows,
    lastRow: sheet.getLastRow(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Build decision.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewBuildDecision_(
  errors,
  warnings,
  learningFlowCheck
) {
  if (errors.length > 0) {
    return {
      decisionCode:
        KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_DECISION.DO_NOT_OPEN_UI_REAL_WRITE,
      openRealWriteUiNow: false,
      canDesignUiGate: false,
      nextPhase: '',
      reason:
        'Còn lỗi sau real write review. Giữ UI ở DRY_RUN.'
    };
  }

  if (
    learningFlowCheck &&
    learningFlowCheck.success === true
  ) {
    return {
      decisionCode:
        KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_DECISION.READY_TO_DESIGN_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE,
      openRealWriteUiNow: false,
      canDesignUiGate: true,
      nextPhase:
        KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
      reason:
        'Dữ liệu sau real write/reset đúng phạm vi. Có thể thiết kế UI real write gate ở 3J.10, nhưng chưa mở ghi thật trực tiếp qua UI trong 3J.9.'
    };
  }

  return {
    decisionCode:
      KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_DECISION.HOLD_KEEP_UI_DRY_RUN,
    openRealWriteUiNow: false,
    canDesignUiGate: false,
    nextPhase: '',
    reason:
      'Chưa đủ điều kiện. Giữ UI ở DRY_RUN.'
  };
}


/**
 * Build checklist.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewBuildChecklist_(
  errors,
  warnings,
  learningFlowCheck,
  decision
) {
  return [
    {
      item: 'Controlled Write đã reset về DRY_RUN',
      status:
        kidlearnV3_postReviewSafeWriteStatus_().mode === 'DRY_RUN'
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: '3J.8 data rows đúng trạng thái',
      status:
        learningFlowCheck.success
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'DATA_Assignments không bị tác động bởi 3J.8',
      status:
        kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckAssignmentStatusFromChecks_(
          learningFlowCheck
        )
    },
    {
      item: 'LOG_Audit rows được account',
      status:
        kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckAuditStatusFromChecks_(
          learningFlowCheck
        )
    },
    {
      item: 'Không mở real write trực tiếp qua UI ở 3J.9',
      status:
        decision.openRealWriteUiNow === false
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED'
    },
    {
      item: 'Decision',
      status:
        decision.decisionCode ===
        KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_DECISION.READY_TO_DESIGN_UI_REAL_WRITE_GATE
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'HOLD',
      decisionCode:
        decision.decisionCode
    },
    {
      item: '3J.9 result',
      status:
        errors.length === 0
          ? 'PASSED'
          : 'FAILED',
      warningCount:
        warnings.length
    }
  ];
}


/**
 * Helper: assignment status từ checks.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckAssignmentStatusFromChecks_(
  learningFlowCheck
) {
  var checks =
    learningFlowCheck.checks || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < checks.length; i++) {
    if (checks[i].sheetName === 'DATA_Assignments') {
      return checks[i].success
        ? 'PASSED'
        : 'FAILED';
    }
  }

  return 'FAILED';
}


/**
 * Helper: audit status từ checks.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckAuditStatusFromChecks_(
  learningFlowCheck
) {
  var checks =
    learningFlowCheck.checks || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < checks.length; i++) {
    if (checks[i].sheetName === 'LOG_Audit') {
      return checks[i].success
        ? 'PASSED'
        : 'FAILED';
    }
  }

  return 'FAILED';
}


/**
 * Snapshot nhiều sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewSnapshotSheets_(
  sheetNames
) {
  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  var items = [];
  var summary = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < sheetNames.length; i++) {
    var item =
      kidlearnV3_postReviewSnapshotSheet_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetNames[i]
      );

    items.push(item);

    summary.push({
      sheetName: item.sheetName,
      exists: item.exists,
      lastRow: item.lastRow,
      lastColumn: item.lastColumn,
      dataRowCount: item.dataRowCount,
      checksum: item.checksum
    });
  }

  return {
    spreadsheetId:
      spreadsheet.getId(),
    spreadsheetName:
      spreadsheet.getName(),
    capturedAt:
      new Date().toISOString(),
    items:
      items,
    summary:
      summary
  };
}


/**
 * Snapshot một sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewSnapshotSheet_(
  spreadsheet,
  sheetName
) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewGetSheet_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return {
      sheetName: sheetName,
      exists: false,
      lastRow: 0,
      lastColumn: 0,
      dataRowCount: 0,
      checksum: ''
    };
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  var values = [];

  if (
    lastRow > 0 &&
    lastColumn > 0
  ) {
    values =
      sheet
        .getRange(
          1,
          1,
          lastRow,
          lastColumn
        )
        .getDisplayValues();
  }

  var text =
    JSON.stringify({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      lastRow: lastRow,
      lastColumn: lastColumn,
      values: values
    });

  return {
    sheetName: sheetName,
    exists: true,
    lastRow: lastRow,
    lastColumn: lastColumn,
    dataRowCount:
      Math.max(0, lastRow - 2),
    checksum:
      kidlearnV3_postReviewMd5_(
        text
      )
  };
}


/**
 * Check target sheets.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckTargetSheets_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var items = [];

  var spreadsheet = null;

  try {
    spreadsheet =
      kidlearnV3_postReviewGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không mở được Database V3: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );

    return {
      errors: errors,
      warnings: warnings,
      items: items
    };
  }

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_TARGET_SHEETS.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sheetName =
      KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_TARGET_SHEETS[i];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_postReviewGetSheet_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetName
      );

    if (!sheet) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu target sheet: ' +
        sheetName
      );

      items.push({
        sheetName: sheetName,
        exists: false
      });

      continue;
    }

    items.push({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      exists: true,
      lastRow: sheet.getLastRow(),
      lastColumn: sheet.getLastColumn()
    });
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Find rows by key field.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewFindRowsByKey_(
  sheet,
  keyField,
  keyValue
) {
  var rows = [];

  var key =
    String(keyField || '').trim();

  var value =
    String(keyValue || '').trim();

  if (!key || !value) {
    return rows;
  }

  var header =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewGetHeader_(
      sheet
    );

  var columnIndex =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewGetColumnIndex_(
      header.keys,
      key
    );

  if (columnIndex < 0) {
    return rows;
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  if (lastRow < 3) {
    return rows;
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        3,
        columnIndex + 1,
        lastRow - 2,
        1
      )
      .getDisplayValues();

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    if (
      String(values[i][0] || '').trim() === value
    ) {
      rows.push(i + 3);
    }
  }

  return rows;
}


/**
 * Find rows containing any tokens.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewFindRowsContainingTokens_(
  sheet,
  tokens
) {
  var cleanTokens = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
    var token =
      String(tokens[i] || '').trim();

    if (token) {
      cleanTokens.push(token);
    }
  }

  var rows = [];

  if (cleanTokens.length === 0) {
    return rows;
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (
    lastRow < 3 ||
    lastColumn < 1
  ) {
    return rows;
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        3,
        1,
        lastRow - 2,
        lastColumn
      )
      .getDisplayValues();

  var rowMap = {};

  for (var r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
    var rowText =
      values[r].join(' | ');

    for (var t = 0; t < cleanTokens.length; t++) {
      if (rowText.indexOf(cleanTokens[t]) >= 0) {
        rowMap[String(r + 3)] = true;
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  var keys =
    Object.keys(rowMap);

  for (var k = 0; k < keys.length; k++) {
    rows.push(
      Number(keys[k])
    );
  }

  rows.sort(
    function(a, b) {
      return a - b;
    }
  );

  return rows;
}


/**
 * Header row 2.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewGetHeader_(
  sheet
) {
  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (lastColumn < 1) {
    return {
      keys: []
    };
  }

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        2,
        1,
        1,
        lastColumn
      )
      .getDisplayValues()[0];

  var keys = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
    keys.push(
      String(values[i] || '').trim()
    );
  }

  return {
    keys: keys
  };
}


/**
 * Column index.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewGetColumnIndex_(
  keys,
  key
) {
  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    if (keys[i] === key) {
      return i;
    }
  }

  return -1;
}


/**
 * Get database spreadsheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_() {
  var database =
    kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_();

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_postReviewResolveSpreadsheet_(
      database
    );

  if (!spreadsheet) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không resolve được Spreadsheet object từ Database V3.'
    );
  }

  return spreadsheet;
}


/**
 * Resolve wrapper thành Spreadsheet object.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewResolveSpreadsheet_(
  value
) {
  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (
    typeof value.getSheets === 'function' &&
    typeof value.getId === 'function'
  ) {
    return value;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheet &&
    typeof value.spreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheet;
  }

  if (
    value.database &&
    typeof value.database.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.database;
  }

  if (
    value.db &&
    typeof value.db.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.db;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheetObject &&
    typeof value.spreadsheetObject.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheetObject;
  }

  if (
    value.activeSpreadsheet &&
    typeof value.activeSpreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.activeSpreadsheet;
  }

  if (value.spreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.spreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (value.databaseSpreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.databaseSpreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (
    value.id &&
    typeof value.id === 'string'
  ) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.id
    );
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Get sheet exact name.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewGetSheet_(
  spreadsheet,
  sheetName
) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Save result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewSaveResult_(
  result
) {
  var status =
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_STATUS.PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_STATUS.FAILED;

  if (
    result.decision &&
    result.decision.decisionCode ===
      KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_DECISION.HOLD_KEEP_UI_DRY_RUN
  ) {
    status =
      KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_STATUS.HOLD;
  }

  var compact = {
    success: result.success,
    action: result.action,
    phase: result.phase,
    finishedAt: result.finishedAt,
    durationMs: result.durationMs,
    errorCount: result.errorCount,
    warningCount: result.warningCount,
    errors: result.errors,
    warnings: result.warnings,
    openRealWriteUiNow: result.openRealWriteUiNow,
    decision: result.decision,
    learningFlowCheck: {
      success: result.learningFlowCheck.success,
      status: result.learningFlowCheck.status,
      rolledBack: result.learningFlowCheck.rolledBack,
      transactionId: result.learningFlowCheck.transactionId,
      errorCount: result.learningFlowCheck.errorCount,
      warningCount: result.learningFlowCheck.warningCount,
      errors: result.learningFlowCheck.errors,
      warnings: result.learningFlowCheck.warnings
    },
    checklist: result.checklist
  };

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_KEYS.STATUS,
    status
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_KEYS.LAST_RUN_AT,
    new Date().toISOString()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_KEYS.LAST_DECISION,
    result.decision
      ? result.decision.decisionCode
      : ''
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(compact)
  );
}


/**

function kidlearnV3_postReviewReadLastResult_() {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_POST_REAL_REVIEW_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON
      );

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewCheckFunctions_(
  functionNames
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < functionNames.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          functionNames[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: functionNames[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        functionNames[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}

/**
 * MD5 checksum.
 */
function kidlearnV3_postReviewMd5_(
  text
) {
  var digest =
    Utilities.computeDigest(
      Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.MD5,
      text,
      Utilities.Charset.UTF_8
    );

  var result = '';

  for (var i = 0; i < digest.length; i++) {
    var value =
      digest[i];

    if (value < 0) {
      value += 256;
    }

    result +=
      ('0' + value.toString(16)).slice(-2);
  }

  return result;
}

/**

 * Flow test:
 * - LOG_Audit: append audit start
 * - DATA_StudySessions: append study session
 * - DATA_LessonProgress: upsert lesson progress test
 * - DATA_DailyGoals: upsert daily goal test
 * - DATA_StudySessions: update session completed
 * - LOG_Audit: append audit complete
 *
 * Có snapshot before/after.
 * Có rollback plan.
 * Có rollback script nếu cần.
 *
 * KHÔNG sửa PROD.
 * CHỈ chạy khi Controlled Write DEV đã ENABLED.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_REAL_FLOW_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J8_STATUS',
  LAST_RUN_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J8_LAST_RUN_AT',
  LAST_READY_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J8_LAST_READY_AT',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J8_LAST_RESULT_JSON',
  LAST_TRANSACTION_ID: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J8_LAST_TRANSACTION_ID',
  LAST_ROLLBACK_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J8_LAST_ROLLBACK_AT',
  LAST_ROLLBACK_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_PHASE_3J8_LAST_ROLLBACK_JSON'
};

var KIDLEARN_V3_REAL_FLOW_STATUS = {
  NOT_RUN: 'NOT_RUN',
  PASSED: 'PASSED',
  FAILED: 'FAILED',
  ROLLED_BACK: 'ROLLED_BACK',
  READY_FOR_NEXT: 'READY_FOR_NEXT'
};

var KIDLEARN_V3_REAL_FLOW_CONFIG = {
  VERSION: '3J.8',
  CONFIRM_WRITE_TOKEN: 'CONFIRM_WRITE_V3',
  CONFIRM_ROLLBACK_TOKEN: 'CONFIRM_ROLLBACK_3J8',

};

var KIDLEARN_V3_REAL_FLOW_TARGET_SHEETS = [

  'DATA_Assignments'
];


/**
 * Preview trước khi chạy real write learning flow.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewRealWriteLearningFlowDevV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions = [
    'kidlearnV3_assertControlledWriteDevEnabledV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_writeServiceSubmitV3',
    'kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetSampleContextV3',
    'kidlearnV3_assertDryRunNoDatabaseChangesV3',
    'kidlearnV3_assertRealWriteSmallTransactionDevPassedV3',
    'kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_'
  ];

  var functionChecks =
    kidlearnV3_realFlowCheckFunctions_(
      requiredFunctions
    );

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      functionChecks.errors
    );

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_realFlowSafeControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.status !== 'ENABLED' ||
    controlledWrite.safeWriteMode !== 'ENABLED' ||
    controlledWrite.safeWriteEnabled !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write DEV chưa ENABLED. Hãy chạy ARM + ENABLE ở 3J.6 trước.'
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_realFlowSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'ENABLED' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write Layer chưa ENABLED.'
    );
  }

  var dryRunCheck =
    kidlearnV3_realFlowSafe3J5Assert_();

  if (!dryRunCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3J.5 chưa xác nhận DRY_RUN no-write: ' +
      dryRunCheck.message
    );
  }

  var smallWriteCheck =
    kidlearnV3_realFlowSafe3J7Assert_();

  if (!smallWriteCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3J.7 chưa pass real write nhỏ: ' +
      smallWriteCheck.message
    );
  }

  var context =
    kidlearnV3_realFlowGetSampleContext_();

  if (!context.childId) {
    errors.push(
      'Không tìm thấy childId mẫu. Không nên ghi learning flow thật nếu thiếu childId.'
    );
  }

  if (!context.subjectId) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không tìm thấy subjectId mẫu. Flow vẫn có thể chạy nhưng subjectId sẽ trống.'
    );
  }

  var targetCheck =
    kidlearnV3_realFlowCheckTargetSheets_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      targetCheck.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      targetCheck.warnings
    );

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_REAL_WRITE_LEARNING_FLOW_DEV_V3',
    phase: '3J.8',
    canRunRealWriteFlow: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite,
    dryRunCheck3J5: dryRunCheck,
    realWriteSmall3J7: smallWriteCheck,
    sampleContext: context,
    targetSheets: targetCheck.items,
    functionChecks: functionChecks.items
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Chạy một learning flow ghi thật nhỏ trong DEV.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runRealWriteLearningFlowDevV3() {
  var startedAt =
    new Date();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewRealWriteLearningFlowDevV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể chạy 3J.8. Preview chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      preview.errorCount
    );
  }

  var transactionId =
    kidlearnV3_realFlowMakeTransactionId_();

  var ids =
    kidlearnV3_realFlowBuildIds_(
      transactionId,
      preview.sampleContext
    );

  var beforeSnapshot =
    kidlearnV3_realFlowSnapshotSheets_(
      KIDLEARN_V3_REAL_FLOW_TARGET_SHEETS
    );

  var steps =
    kidlearnV3_realFlowExecuteSteps_(
      transactionId,
      ids
    );

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      steps.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      steps.warnings
    );

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  Utilities.sleep(500);

  var afterSnapshot =
    kidlearnV3_realFlowSnapshotSheets_(
      KIDLEARN_V3_REAL_FLOW_TARGET_SHEETS
    );

  var diff =
    kidlearnV3_realFlowCompareExpectedChange_(
      beforeSnapshot,
      afterSnapshot
    );

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      diff.errors
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      diff.warnings
    );

  var rollbackPlan =
    kidlearnV3_realFlowBuildRollbackPlan_(
      transactionId,
      ids,
      steps
    );

  var finishedAt =
    new Date();

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'RUN_REAL_WRITE_LEARNING_FLOW_DEV_V3',
    phase: '3J.8',
    transactionId: transactionId,
    ids: ids,
    startedAt: startedAt.toISOString(),
    finishedAt: finishedAt.toISOString(),
    durationMs:
      finishedAt.getTime() -
      startedAt.getTime(),
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    beforeSnapshot: beforeSnapshot.summary,
    afterSnapshot: afterSnapshot.summary,
    diff: diff,
    steps: steps,
    rollbackPlan: rollbackPlan,
    checklist:
      kidlearnV3_realFlowBuildChecklist_(
        errors,
        warnings,
        diff,
        steps
      )
  };

  kidlearnV3_realFlowSaveResult_(
    result
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3J.8 real write learning flow chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      result.errorCount
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**

 * Cần confirmRollback token.
 */
function kidlearnV3_rollbackLastRealWriteLearningFlowDevV3(request) {
  var safeRequest =
    kidlearnV3_realFlowNormalizeRequest_(

  if (
    String(safeRequest.confirmRollback || '') !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_REAL_FLOW_CONFIG.CONFIRM_ROLLBACK_TOKEN
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Thiếu confirmRollback=CONFIRM_ROLLBACK_3J8. Không rollback.'
