/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - SCHEMA GROUP 03
 * CÂU HỎI, ĐÁNH GIÁ, ATTEMPTS VÀ RESPONSES
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 */


/**
 * Enum của nhóm câu hỏi và đánh giá.
 */
function kidlearnV3_enumGroup03Assessment_() {
  return {
    QUESTION_TYPE: [
      'SINGLE_CHOICE',
      'MULTIPLE_CHOICE',
      'TRUE_FALSE',
      'FILL_BLANK',
      'NUMBER_INPUT',
      'MATCHING',
      'ORDERING',
      'IMAGE_SELECT',
      'WORD_BUILDING',
      'DRAG_DROP',
      'SHORT_ANSWER',
      'FREE_RESPONSE',
      'READ_ALOUD',
      'SPEAKING',
      'DRAWING',
      'FILE_UPLOAD'
    ],

    QUESTION_GRADING_METHOD: [
      'EXACT_MATCH',
      'OPTION_KEY',
      'NUMERIC',
      'ORDER_MATCH',
      'PAIR_MATCH',
      'KEYWORD',
      'RUBRIC',
      'AI_ASSISTED',
      'MANUAL'
    ],

    QUESTION_SOURCE_TYPE: [
      'TEXTBOOK',
      'ADVANCED_MATERIAL',
      'PARENT_CREATED',
      'AI_GENERATED',
      'SYSTEM_TEMPLATE'
    ],

    ASSESSMENT_TYPE: [
      'LESSON_PRACTICE',
      'DAILY_REVIEW',
      'PERIODIC_REVIEW',
      'TOPIC_TEST',
      'DIAGNOSTIC',
      'CHALLENGE',
      'PARENT_ASSIGNED'
    ],

    QUESTION_SELECTION_MODE: [
      'FIXED',
      'RANDOM_FROM_POOL',
      'RANDOM_BY_SKILL',
      'RANDOM_BY_DIFFICULTY',
      'REVIEW_QUEUE'
    ],

    RESULT_POLICY: [
      'LATEST',
      'HIGHEST',
      'FIRST',
      'AVERAGE'
    ],

    ATTEMPT_STATUS: [
      'CREATED',
      'IN_PROGRESS',
      'SUBMITTED',
      'GRADING',
      'GRADED',
      'CANCELLED',
      'EXPIRED'
    ],

    AI_GRADING_STATUS: [
      'NOT_REQUIRED',
      'PENDING',
      'PROCESSING',
      'COMPLETED',
      'FAILED',
      'MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED'
    ],

    RESPONSE_STATUS: [
      'UNANSWERED',
      'ANSWERED',
      'PENDING_GRADING',
      'GRADED',
      'REVIEW_REQUIRED'
    ],

    RESPONSE_GRADING_SOURCE: [
      'NONE',
      'AUTO',
      'AI',
      'FAMILY',
      'MIXED'
    ],

    RESULT_LEVEL: [
      'NOT_PASSED',
      'PASSED',
      'MASTERED'
    ]
  };
}


/**
 * Schema của 6 Sheet nhóm câu hỏi và đánh giá.
 */
function kidlearnV3_schemaGroup03Assessment_() {
  var T = KIDLEARN_V3_DATA_TYPES;
  var D = KIDLEARN_V3_DEFAULTS;

  var C = kidlearnV3_column_;
  var E = kidlearnV3_validationEnum_;
  var ID = kidlearnV3_validationId_;
  var REF = kidlearnV3_validationReference_;
  var INTEGER = kidlearnV3_validationInteger_;
  var RANGE = kidlearnV3_validationRange_;
  var JSON_VALUE = kidlearnV3_validationJson_;
  var REGEX = kidlearnV3_validationRegex_;
  var SHEET = kidlearnV3_sheetDefinition_;

  var schema = {};


  /**
   * ==============================================================
   * 1. MST_Questions
   * ==============================================================
   */
  schema.MST_Questions = SHEET({
    group: 'ASSESSMENT',

    description:
      'Kho câu hỏi chính thức đã được duyệt hoặc xuất bản.',

    primaryKey: 'questionId',

    uniqueKeys: [
      ['questionId'],
      ['questionCode']
    ],

    logicalIndexes: [
      'questionId',
      'questionCode',
      'subjectId',
      'curriculumId',
      'topicId',
      'lessonId',
      'primarySkillId',
      'questionType',
      'difficultyLevel',
      'status'

  BOOLEAN: 'BOOLEAN',
  DATE: 'DATE',
  DATETIME: 'DATETIME',
  ENUM: 'ENUM',
  JSON: 'JSON',
  FILE_ID: 'FILE_ID',
  URL: 'URL'
};


/**
 * Các giá trị mặc định đặc biệt.
 *
 * Giá trị thật sẽ được chuyển đổi khi tạo Sheet hoặc ghi dữ liệu.
 */
var KIDLEARN_V3_DEFAULTS = {
  NOW: '@NOW',
  TODAY: '@TODAY',
  SYSTEM: 'SYSTEM',
  MIGRATION: 'MIGRATION',
  SEED_DATA: 'SEED_DATA',
  EMPTY_JSON_OBJECT: '{}',
  EMPTY_JSON_ARRAY: '[]'
};


/**
 * Khai báo một cột trong schema.
 *
 * @param {string} labelVi Tên tiếng Việt.
 * @param {string} key Khóa kỹ thuật camelCase.
 * @param {string} type Kiểu dữ liệu.
 * @param {boolean} required Có bắt buộc hay không.
 * @param {*} defaultValue Giá trị mặc định.
 * @param {Object|null} validation Cấu hình validation.
 * @param {Object=} options Cấu hình bổ sung.
 * @return {Object}
 */
function kidlearnV3_column_(
  labelVi,
  key,
  type,
  required,
  defaultValue,
  validation,
  options
) {
  var extra = options || {};

  return {
    labelVi: String(labelVi || '').trim(),
    key: String(key || '').trim(),
    type: type,
    required: required === true,

    defaultValue:
      typeof defaultValue === 'undefined'
        ? ''
        : defaultValue,

    validation: validation || null,

    description: extra.description || '',
    sensitive: extra.sensitive === true,
    immutable: extra.immutable === true,
    unique: extra.unique === true,
    indexed: extra.indexed === true,

    maxLength:
      typeof extra.maxLength === 'number'
        ? extra.maxLength
        : null
  };
}


/**
 * Validation dựa trên enum.
 */
function kidlearnV3_validationEnum_(enumKey) {
  return {
    kind: 'ENUM',
    enumKey: enumKey
  };
}


/**
 * Validation dựa trên danh sách trực tiếp.
 */
function kidlearnV3_validationList_(values) {
  return {
    kind: 'LIST',
    values: Array.isArray(values) ? values.slice() : []
  };
}


/**
 * Validation ID theo prefix.
 */
function kidlearnV3_validationId_(prefix) {
  return {
    kind: 'ID_PREFIX',
    prefix: prefix
  };
}


/**
 * Validation tham chiếu logic đến Sheet khác.
 */
function kidlearnV3_validationReference_(
  targetSheet,
  targetKey
) {
  return {
    kind: 'REFERENCE',
    targetSheet: targetSheet,
    targetKey: targetKey
  };
}


/**
 * Validation khoảng số.
 */
function kidlearnV3_validationRange_(min, max) {
  return {
    kind: 'NUMBER_RANGE',
    min: min,
    max: max
  };
}


/**
 * Validation số nguyên.
 */
function kidlearnV3_validationInteger_(min, max) {
  return {
    kind: 'INTEGER_RANGE',
    min: min,
    max: max
  };
}


/**
 * Validation email.
 */
function kidlearnV3_validationEmail_() {
  return {
    kind: 'EMAIL'
  };
}


/**
 * Validation URL HTTPS.
 */
function kidlearnV3_validationHttpsUrl_() {
  return {
    kind: 'HTTPS_URL'
  };
}


/**
 * Validation chuỗi JSON.
 */
function kidlearnV3_validationJson_() {
  return {
    kind: 'JSON'
  };
}


/**
 * Validation regex.
 */
function kidlearnV3_validationRegex_(pattern, message) {
  return {
    kind: 'REGEX',
    pattern: pattern,
    message: message || ''
  };
}


/**
 * Tạo định nghĩa một Sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_sheetDefinition_(config) {
  config = config || {};

  return {
    group: config.group || 'OTHER',
    description: config.description || '',

    headerViRow: KIDLEARN_V3.HEADER_VI_ROW,
    headerKeyRow: KIDLEARN_V3.HEADER_KEY_ROW,
    dataStartRow: KIDLEARN_V3.DATA_START_ROW,

    frozenRows: 2,
    createFilter: config.createFilter !== false,

    primaryKey: config.primaryKey || '',
    uniqueKeys: config.uniqueKeys || [],
    logicalIndexes: config.logicalIndexes || [],

    retentionPolicy: config.retentionPolicy || '',
    columns: config.columns || []
  };
}


/**
 * Gộp enum của các nhóm schema đã được khai báo.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildEnums_() {
  var result = {};
  var groups = [];

  if (typeof kidlearnV3_enumGroup01System_ === 'function') {
    groups.push(kidlearnV3_enumGroup01System_());
  }

  if (typeof kidlearnV3_enumGroup02Learning_ === 'function') {
    groups.push(kidlearnV3_enumGroup02Learning_());
  }

  if (typeof kidlearnV3_enumGroup03Assessment_ === 'function') {
    groups.push(kidlearnV3_enumGroup03Assessment_());
  }

  if (typeof kidlearnV3_enumGroup04Progress_ === 'function') {
    groups.push(kidlearnV3_enumGroup04Progress_());
  }

  if (typeof kidlearnV3_enumGroup05Engagement_ === 'function') {
    groups.push(kidlearnV3_enumGroup05Engagement_());
  }

  if (typeof kidlearnV3_enumGroup06AI_ === 'function') {
    groups.push(kidlearnV3_enumGroup06AI_());
  }

  groups.forEach(function (groupEnums) {
    groupEnums = groupEnums || {};

    Object.keys(groupEnums).forEach(function (enumKey) {
      if (
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          result,
          enumKey
        )
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          'Enum bị khai báo trùng: ' + enumKey
        );
      }

      result[enumKey] = groupEnums[enumKey];
    });
  });

  return result;
}


/**
 * Gộp schema của tất cả nhóm đã được khai báo.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildSchema_() {
  var schema = {};
  var groups = [];

  if (typeof kidlearnV3_schemaGroup01System_ === 'function') {
    groups.push(kidlearnV3_schemaGroup01System_());
  }

  if (typeof kidlearnV3_schemaGroup02Learning_ === 'function') {
    groups.push(kidlearnV3_schemaGroup02Learning_());
  }

  if (typeof kidlearnV3_schemaGroup03Assessment_ === 'function') {
    groups.push(kidlearnV3_schemaGroup03Assessment_());
  }

  if (typeof kidlearnV3_schemaGroup04Progress_ === 'function') {
    groups.push(kidlearnV3_schemaGroup04Progress_());
  }

  if (typeof kidlearnV3_schemaGroup05Engagement_ === 'function') {
    groups.push(kidlearnV3_schemaGroup05Engagement_());
  }

  if (typeof kidlearnV3_schemaGroup06AI_ === 'function') {
    groups.push(kidlearnV3_schemaGroup06AI_());
  }

  groups.forEach(function (groupSchema) {
    groupSchema = groupSchema || {};

    Object.keys(groupSchema).forEach(function (sheetName) {
      if (
        Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          schema,
          sheetName
        )
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          'Schema Sheet bị khai báo trùng: ' +
          sheetName
        );
      }

      schema[sheetName] = groupSchema[sheetName];
    });
  });

  return schema;
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra một định nghĩa cột.
 */
function kidlearnV3_validateColumnDefinition_(
  sheetName,
  column,
  columnNumber,
  enums,
  errors,
  warnings
) {
  var prefix =
    sheetName +
    ' - cột ' +
    columnNumber +
    ': ';

  if (!column || typeof column !== 'object') {
    errors.push(prefix + 'định nghĩa cột không hợp lệ.');
    return;
  }

  if (!column.labelVi) {
    errors.push(prefix + 'thiếu tên tiếng Việt.');
  }

  if (!column.key) {
    errors.push(prefix + 'thiếu key kỹ thuật.');
  }

  if (
    column.key &&
    !/^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9]*$/.test(column.key)
  ) {
    errors.push(
      prefix +
      'key không đúng camelCase: ' +
      column.key
    );
  }

  var validTypes = Object.keys(
    KIDLEARN_V3_DATA_TYPES
  ).map(function (typeKey) {
    return KIDLEARN_V3_DATA_TYPES[typeKey];
  });

  if (validTypes.indexOf(column.type) === -1) {
    errors.push(
      prefix +
      'kiểu dữ liệu không hợp lệ: ' +
      column.type
    );
  }

  if (!column.validation) {
    return;
  }

  if (column.validation.kind === 'ENUM') {
    var enumKey = column.validation.enumKey;

    if (
      !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
        enums,
        enumKey
      )
    ) {
      errors.push(
        prefix +
        'không tìm thấy enum: ' +
        enumKey
      );
    }
  }

  if (column.validation.kind === 'REFERENCE') {
    var targetSheet =
      column.validation.targetSheet;

    if (
      KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.indexOf(
        targetSheet
      ) === -1
    ) {
      errors.push(
        prefix +
        'tham chiếu đến Sheet không hợp lệ: ' +
        targetSheet
      );
    }
  }

  if (
    column.validation.kind === 'NUMBER_RANGE' ||
    column.validation.kind === 'INTEGER_RANGE'
  ) {
    if (
      typeof column.validation.min !== 'number' ||
      typeof column.validation.max !== 'number'
    ) {
      errors.push(
        prefix +
        'validation khoảng số không hợp lệ.'
      );
    }

    if (
      typeof column.validation.min === 'number' &&
      typeof column.validation.max === 'number' &&
      column.validation.min > column.validation.max
    ) {
      errors.push(
        prefix +
        'giá trị min lớn hơn max.'
      );
    }
  }

  if (
    column.validation.kind === 'REGEX' &&
    !column.validation.pattern
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      prefix +
      'validation REGEX chưa có pattern.'
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra schema.
 *
 * strict = false:
 * chỉ kiểm tra các nhóm đã khai báo.
 *
 * strict = true:
 * bắt buộc đủ 44 Sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_validateSchema_(strict) {
  kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  var schema = kidlearnV3_buildSchema_();
  var enums = kidlearnV3_buildEnums_();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var schemaSheetNames = Object.keys(schema);

  schemaSheetNames.forEach(function (sheetName) {
    if (
      KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.indexOf(
        sheetName
      ) === -1
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'Sheet không nằm trong danh sách V3: ' +
        sheetName
      );
    }

    var definition = schema[sheetName];

    if (
      !definition ||
      !Array.isArray(definition.columns)
    ) {
      errors.push(
        sheetName +
        ': không có danh sách columns hợp lệ.'
      );
      return;
    }

    if (definition.columns.length === 0) {
      errors.push(
        sheetName +
        ': chưa khai báo cột.'
      );
      return;
    }

    var columnKeys = {};
    var labels = {};

    definition.columns.forEach(
      function (column, index) {
        kidlearnV3_validateColumnDefinition_(
          sheetName,
          column,
          index + 1,
          enums,
          errors,
          warnings
        );

        if (!column) {
          return;
        }

        if (column.key) {
          if (columnKeys[column.key]) {
            errors.push(
              sheetName +
              ': key bị trùng: ' +
              column.key
            );
          }

          columnKeys[column.key] = true;
        }

        if (column.labelVi) {
          if (labels[column.labelVi]) {
            warnings.push(
              sheetName +
              ': tên tiếng Việt bị trùng: ' +
              column.labelVi
            );
          }

          labels[column.labelVi] = true;
        }
      }
    );

    if (
      definition.primaryKey &&
      !columnKeys[definition.primaryKey]
    ) {
      errors.push(
        sheetName +
        ': primaryKey không tồn tại: ' +
        definition.primaryKey
      );
    }

    (definition.uniqueKeys || []).forEach(
      function (uniqueGroup) {
        if (!Array.isArray(uniqueGroup)) {
          errors.push(
            sheetName +
            ': uniqueKeys phải là mảng.'
          );
          return;
        }

        uniqueGroup.forEach(function (key) {
          if (!columnKeys[key]) {
            errors.push(
              sheetName +
              ': unique key không tồn tại: ' +
              key
            );
          }
        });
      }
    );

    (definition.logicalIndexes || []).forEach(
      function (key) {
        if (!columnKeys[key]) {
          errors.push(
            sheetName +
            ': logical index không tồn tại: ' +
            key
          );
        }
      }
    );
  });

  var missingSheets =
    KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.filter(
      function (sheetName) {
        return !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          schema,
          sheetName
        );
      }
    );

  if (strict === true && missingSheets.length > 0) {
    errors.push(
      'Schema chưa đủ 44 Sheet. Còn thiếu: ' +
      missingSheets.join(', ')
    );
  }

  if (strict !== true && missingSheets.length > 0) {
    warnings.push(
      'Schema đang ở chế độ từng phần. Còn thiếu ' +
      missingSheets.length +
      ' Sheet.'
    );
  }

  var loadedSheets =
    KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.filter(
      function (sheetName) {
        return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          schema,
          sheetName
        );
      }
    );

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    strictMode: strict === true,

    loadedSheetCount: schemaSheetNames.length,
    targetSheetCount: KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.length,
    loadedEnumCount: Object.keys(enums).length,

    loadedSheets: loadedSheets,
    missingSheets: missingSheets,

    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,

    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Schema V3 có ' +
      errors.length +
      ' lỗi. Xem Execution log.'
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra schema từng phần.
 */
function kidlearnV3_validateSchemaPartial() {
  return kidlearnV3_validateSchema_(false);
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra schema cuối cùng.
 *
 * Chỉ chạy sau khi đã khai báo đủ 44 Sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_validateSchemaFinal() {
  return kidlearnV3_validateSchema_(true);
}


/**
 * Xem tóm tắt schema hiện tại.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewSchemaPartial() {
  kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  var schema = kidlearnV3_buildSchema_();
  var enums = kidlearnV3_buildEnums_();

  var sheetSummary = [];

  KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.forEach(
    function (sheetName) {
      if (
        !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
          schema,
          sheetName
        )
      ) {
        return;
      }

      var definition = schema[sheetName];

      sheetSummary.push({
        sheetName: sheetName,
        group: definition.group,
        primaryKey: definition.primaryKey,
        columnCount: definition.columns.length,
        uniqueKeyCount:
          definition.uniqueKeys.length,
        indexCount:
          definition.logicalIndexes.length
      });
    }
  );

  var result = {
    success: true,
    schemaVersion: KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,

    loadedSheetCount: sheetSummary.length,
    loadedEnumCount: Object.keys(enums).length,

    sheets: sheetSummary,
    enumKeys: Object.keys(enums).sort()
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Lấy schema của một Sheet.
 *
 * Chỉ dùng trong backend.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getSheetSchema_(sheetName) {
  var schema = kidlearnV3_buildSchema_();

  if (!schema[sheetName]) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không tìm thấy schema của Sheet: ' +
      sheetName
    );
  }

  return schema[sheetName];
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - FINAL SCHEMA REVIEW
 * Step: 3H.2G
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * File này chỉ rà soát schema trước khi viết engine tạo Sheet.
 *
 * KHÔNG tạo Sheet.
 * KHÔNG xóa Sheet.
 * KHÔNG đổi tên Sheet.
 * KHÔNG ghi dữ liệu vào Google Sheets.
 */


/**
 * Hàm chính: rà soát schema cuối trước khi tạo Sheet V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_reviewSchemaBeforeCreateSheets() {
  kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  var schemaValidation = kidlearnV3_validateSchema_(true);
  var schema = kidlearnV3_buildSchema_();
  var enums = kidlearnV3_buildEnums_();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var notes = [];

  kidlearnV3_reviewSheetCompleteness_(
    schema,
    errors,
    warnings
  );

  kidlearnV3_reviewOfficialRenames_(
    schema,
    errors,
    warnings
  );

  kidlearnV3_reviewPrimaryKeys_(
    schema,
    errors,
    warnings
  );

  kidlearnV3_reviewColumnLabels_(
    schema,
    errors,
    warnings
  );

  kidlearnV3_reviewEnums_(
    enums,
    errors,
    warnings
  );

  kidlearnV3_reviewSecurityColumns_(
    schema,
    errors,
    warnings
  );

  kidlearnV3_reviewActorColumns_(
    schema,
    errors,
    warnings
  );

  kidlearnV3_reviewJsonColumns_(
    schema,
    errors,
    warnings
  );

  kidlearnV3_reviewLegacyV2Blocked_(
    schema,
    errors,
    warnings
  );

  var creationPlan =
    kidlearnV3_buildSheetCreationPlan_(schema);

  notes.push(
    'Schema validation success: ' +
    schemaValidation.success
  );

  notes.push(
    'Tổng số Sheet trong creation plan: ' +
    creationPlan.length
  );

  notes.push(
    'Google Sheet chưa thay đổi ở bước 3H.2G.'
  );

  var passed =
    errors.length === 0 &&
    warnings.length === 0;

  var result = {
    success: passed,
    finalStatus: passed ? 'PASS' : 'NOT_READY',

    schemaVersion: KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
    appVersion: KIDLEARN_V3.APP_VERSION,

    loadedSheetCount: Object.keys(schema).length,
    targetSheetCount: KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.length,

    schemaValidation: {
      success: schemaValidation.success,
      strictMode: schemaValidation.strictMode,
      missingSheets: schemaValidation.missingSheets,
      errorCount: schemaValidation.errorCount,
      warningCount: schemaValidation.warningCount
    },

    reviewErrorCount: errors.length,
    reviewWarningCount: warnings.length,

    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    notes: notes,

    creationPlan: creationPlan
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!passed) {
    throw new Error(
      'Schema final review chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      errors.length +
      ', Warnings: ' +
      warnings.length +
      '. Xem Execution log.'
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * In kế hoạch tạo Sheet theo đúng thứ tự.
 */
function kidlearnV3_printSheetCreationPlan() {
  kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  var schema = kidlearnV3_buildSchema_();
  var plan = kidlearnV3_buildSheetCreationPlan_(schema);

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(plan, null, 2)
  );

  return plan;
}


/**
 * Tạo danh sách kế hoạch tạo 44 Sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildSheetCreationPlan_(schema) {
  var plan = [];

  KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.forEach(
    function (sheetName, index) {
      var definition = schema[sheetName];

      if (!definition) {
        plan.push({
          order: index + 1,
          sheetName: sheetName,
          status: 'MISSING'
        });

        return;
      }

      plan.push({
        order: index + 1,
        sheetName: sheetName,
        group: definition.group,
        primaryKey: definition.primaryKey,
        columnCount: definition.columns.length,
        frozenRows: definition.frozenRows,
        createFilter: definition.createFilter,
        status: 'READY'
      });
    }
  );

  return plan;
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra đủ 44 Sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_reviewSheetCompleteness_(
  schema,
  errors,
  warnings
) {
  var loadedSheetNames = Object.keys(schema);
  var expectedCount = KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.length;

  if (loadedSheetNames.length !== expectedCount) {
    errors.push(
      'Số lượng Sheet không khớp. Loaded: ' +
      loadedSheetNames.length +
      ', expected: ' +
      expectedCount
    );
  }

  KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.forEach(
    function (sheetName, index) {
      if (!schema[sheetName]) {
        errors.push(
          'Thiếu Sheet ở thứ tự ' +
          (index + 1) +
          ': ' +
          sheetName
        );
      }
    }
  );

  loadedSheetNames.forEach(
    function (sheetName) {
      if (
        KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.indexOf(sheetName) === -1
      ) {
        errors.push(
          'Sheet không nằm trong danh sách chính thức: ' +
          sheetName
        );
      }
    }
  );
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra các đổi tên bắt buộc ở bước 3G.
 */
function kidlearnV3_reviewOfficialRenames_(
  schema,
  errors,
  warnings
) {
  if (schema.DATA_StudentAchievements) {
    errors.push(
      'Không được dùng DATA_StudentAchievements. ' +
      'Tên chính thức là DATA_ChildAchievements.'
    );
  }

  if (!schema.DATA_ChildAchievements) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu Sheet DATA_ChildAchievements.'
    );
  }

  if (schema.MST_BookSeries) {
    errors.push(
      'Không được dùng MST_BookSeries. ' +
      'Tên chính thức là MST_Books.'
    );
  }

  if (!schema.MST_Books) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu Sheet MST_Books.'
    );
  }

  kidlearnV3_assertSheetHasColumn_(
    schema,
    'DATA_ChildAchievements',
    'childAchievementId',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_assertSheetNotHasColumn_(
    schema,
    'DATA_ChildAchievements',
    'studentAchievementId',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_assertSheetHasColumn_(
    schema,
    'MST_Books',
    'bookId',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_assertSheetHasColumn_(
    schema,
    'MST_Books',
    'bookSeriesCode',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_assertSheetHasColumn_(
    schema,
    'MST_Books',
    'bookSeriesName',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_assertSheetNotHasColumn_(
    schema,
    'MST_Books',
    'bookSeriesId',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_assertSheetNotHasColumn_(
    schema,
    'MST_Books',
    'seriesCode',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_assertSheetNotHasColumn_(
    schema,
    'MST_Books',
    'seriesName',
    errors
  );
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra primary key.
 */
function kidlearnV3_reviewPrimaryKeys_(
  schema,
  errors,
  warnings
) {
  Object.keys(schema).forEach(
    function (sheetName) {
      var definition = schema[sheetName];
      var columns = definition.columns || [];

      if (!definition.primaryKey) {
        errors.push(
          sheetName + ': thiếu primaryKey.'
        );

        return;
      }

      if (columns.length === 0) {
        errors.push(
          sheetName + ': chưa có cột.'
        );

        return;
      }

      if (columns[0].key !== definition.primaryKey) {
        warnings.push(
          sheetName +
          ': primaryKey không nằm ở cột đầu tiên. primaryKey=' +
          definition.primaryKey +
          ', cột đầu=' +
          columns[0].key
        );
      }

      var primaryColumn =
        kidlearnV3_findColumnByKey_(
          definition,
          definition.primaryKey
        );

      if (!primaryColumn) {
        errors.push(
          sheetName +
          ': primaryKey không tồn tại trong columns: ' +
          definition.primaryKey
        );

        return;
      }

      if (
        sheetName !== 'SYS_Config' &&
        primaryColumn.type !== KIDLEARN_V3_DATA_TYPES.ID
      ) {
        errors.push(
          sheetName +
          ': primaryKey nên có type ID. Key: ' +
          definition.primaryKey
        );
      }

      if (primaryColumn.unique !== true) {
        warnings.push(
          sheetName +
          ': primaryKey chưa đánh dấu unique: ' +
          definition.primaryKey
        );
      }

      if (primaryColumn.immutable !== true) {
        warnings.push(
          sheetName +
          ': primaryKey chưa đánh dấu immutable: ' +
          definition.primaryKey
        );
      }
    }
  );
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra trùng tên tiếng Việt và trùng key kỹ thuật.
 */
function kidlearnV3_reviewColumnLabels_(
  schema,
  errors,
  warnings
) {
  Object.keys(schema).forEach(
    function (sheetName) {
      var definition = schema[sheetName];
      var labels = {};
      var keys = {};

      definition.columns.forEach(
        function (column) {
          if (labels[column.labelVi]) {
            warnings.push(
              sheetName +
              ': tên tiếng Việt bị trùng: ' +
              column.labelVi
            );
          }

          labels[column.labelVi] = true;

          if (keys[column.key]) {
            errors.push(
              sheetName +
              ': key kỹ thuật bị trùng: ' +
              column.key
            );
          }

          keys[column.key] = true;
        }
      );
    }
  );
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra enum quan trọng.
 */
function kidlearnV3_reviewEnums_(
  enums,
  errors,
  warnings
) {
  if (!enums.USER_ROLE) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu enum USER_ROLE.'
    );
  } else {
    var roles = enums.USER_ROLE.slice().sort();
    var expectedRoles = [
      'CHILD',
      'FAMILY_ADMIN'
    ].sort();

    if (
      JSON.stringify(roles) !==
      JSON.stringify(expectedRoles)
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'USER_ROLE chỉ được gồm CHILD và FAMILY_ADMIN. Hiện tại: ' +
        roles.join(', ')
      );
    }
  }

  var requiredEnums = [
    'CONTENT_STATUS',
    'QUESTION_TYPE',
    'ASSESSMENT_TYPE',
    'ATTEMPT_STATUS',
    'LESSON_PROGRESS_STATUS',
    'ASSIGNMENT_STATUS',
    'REWARD_SOURCE_TYPE',
    'AI_JOB_STATUS'
  ];

  requiredEnums.forEach(
    function (enumKey) {
      if (!enums[enumKey]) {
        errors.push(
          'Thiếu enum bắt buộc: ' + enumKey
        );
      }
    }
  );
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra các cột bảo mật.
 */
function kidlearnV3_reviewSecurityColumns_(
  schema,
  errors,
  warnings
) {
  var forbiddenKeys = [
    'password',
    'rawPassword',
    'pin',
    'rawPin',
    'token',
    'rawToken',
    'apiKey',
    'secretKey'
  ];

  var sensitiveKeys = [
    'credentialHash',
    'credentialSalt',
    'tokenHash',
    'answerKeyJson',
    'acceptedAnswersJson',
    'rubricJson',
    'payloadSummary',
    'aiGradingJson',
    'draftAnswerKeyJson',
    'draftOptionsJson',
    'draftRubricJson',
    'inputSummary',
    'inputJson'
  ];

  Object.keys(schema).forEach(
    function (sheetName) {
      var definition = schema[sheetName];

      definition.columns.forEach(
        function (column) {
          if (forbiddenKeys.indexOf(column.key) !== -1) {
            errors.push(
              sheetName +
              ': không được khai báo cột nhạy cảm dạng thô: ' +
              column.key
            );
          }

          if (
            sensitiveKeys.indexOf(column.key) !== -1 &&
            column.sensitive !== true
          ) {
            warnings.push(
              sheetName +
              ': cột nên đánh dấu sensitive=true: ' +
              column.key
            );
          }
        }
      );
    }
  );

  kidlearnV3_assertSheetHasColumn_(
    schema,
    'DATA_Users',
    'credentialHash',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_assertSheetHasColumn_(
    schema,
    'DATA_Users',
    'credentialSalt',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_assertSheetHasColumn_(
    schema,
    'DATA_Sessions',
    'tokenHash',
    errors
  );

  kidlearnV3_assertSheetNotHasColumn_(
    schema,
    'DATA_Sessions',
    'token',
    errors
  );
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra các cột actor phải là STRING.
 */
function kidlearnV3_reviewActorColumns_(
  schema,
  errors,
  warnings
) {
  var actorKeys = [
    'createdBy',
    'updatedBy',
    'reviewedBy',
    'publishedBy',
    'assignedBy',
    'requestedBy',
    'executedBy',
    'appliedBy',
    'approvedBy'
  ];

  Object.keys(schema).forEach(
    function (sheetName) {
      var definition = schema[sheetName];

      definition.columns.forEach(
        function (column) {
          if (
            actorKeys.indexOf(column.key) !== -1 &&
            column.type !== KIDLEARN_V3_DATA_TYPES.STRING
          ) {
            errors.push(
              sheetName +
              ': cột actor phải là STRING: ' +
              column.key
            );
          }
        }
      );
    }
  );
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra các cột hậu tố Json phải là type JSON.
 */
function kidlearnV3_reviewJsonColumns_(
  schema,
  errors,
  warnings
) {
  Object.keys(schema).forEach(
    function (sheetName) {
      var definition = schema[sheetName];

      definition.columns.forEach(
        function (column) {
          if (
            /Json$/.test(column.key) &&
            column.type !== KIDLEARN_V3_DATA_TYPES.JSON
          ) {
            errors.push(
              sheetName +
              ': cột có hậu tố Json nhưng type không phải JSON: ' +
              column.key
            );
          }
        }
      );
    }
  );
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra không đưa Sheet V2 hoặc Legacy vào schema V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_reviewLegacyV2Blocked_(
  schema,
  errors,
  warnings
) {
  var forbiddenSheetNames = [
    'Data_Tasks',
    'Data_Scores',
    'Thiet_Lap',
    'Danh_Muc',
    'Log_HeThong',
    'LEGACY_V2_Data_Tasks',
    'LEGACY_V2_Data_Users',
    'LEGACY_V2_Data_Scores',
    'LEGACY_V2_Thiet_Lap',
    'LEGACY_V2_Danh_Muc',
    'LEGACY_V2_Log_HeThong'
  ];

  Object.keys(schema).forEach(
    function (sheetName) {
      if (forbiddenSheetNames.indexOf(sheetName) !== -1) {
        errors.push(
          'Không được đưa Sheet V2/Legacy vào schema V3 chính thức: ' +
          sheetName
        );
      }

      if (sheetName.indexOf('LEGACY_V2_') === 0) {
        errors.push(
          'Không được khai báo Legacy Sheet trong schema V3: ' +
          sheetName
        );
      }
    }
  );

  if (schema.Data_Scores) {
    errors.push(
      'Không được dùng Data_Scores làm nguồn bảng điểm V3. ' +
      'Nguồn chính thức là DATA_Attempts và DATA_Responses.'
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Tìm cột theo key trong một Sheet definition.
 */
function kidlearnV3_findColumnByKey_(
  definition,
  columnKey
) {
  var columns = definition.columns || [];

  for (var i = 0; i < columns.length; i++) {
    if (columns[i].key === columnKey) {
      return columns[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra Sheet phải có cột.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertSheetHasColumn_(
  schema,
  sheetName,
  columnKey,
  errors
) {
  if (!schema[sheetName]) {
    errors.push(
      'Không tìm thấy Sheet để kiểm tra cột: ' +
      sheetName
    );

    return;
  }

  var column =
    kidlearnV3_findColumnByKey_(
      schema[sheetName],
      columnKey
    );

  if (!column) {
    errors.push(
      sheetName +
      ': thiếu cột bắt buộc: ' +
      columnKey
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra Sheet không được có cột cũ.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertSheetNotHasColumn_(
  schema,
  sheetName,
  columnKey,
  errors
) {
  if (!schema[sheetName]) {
    return;
  }

  var column =
    kidlearnV3_findColumnByKey_(
      schema[sheetName],
      columnKey
    );

  if (column) {
    errors.push(
      sheetName +
      ': không được còn cột cũ: ' +
      columnKey
    );
  }
}

/**
 * Preview 3M-C.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewSecurityRoleGuard3MCV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var functionChecks =
    kidlearnV3_3mcCheckFunctions_([
      'kidlearnV3_assertPerformanceBaseline3MBReadyV3',
      'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
      'kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_',
      'kidlearnV3_runQaBatchProvidedStepsV3'
    ]);

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      functionChecks.errors
    );

  var phase3MB =
    kidlearnV3_3mcSafeAssert_(
      'kidlearnV3_assertPerformanceBaseline3MBReadyV3',
      '3M-B'
    );

  if (!phase3MB.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3M-B chưa READY_FOR_3M_C: ' +
      phase3MB.message
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3mcSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3M-C yêu cầu Safe Write DRY_RUN/enabled=false. mode=' +
      safeWrite.mode +
      ', enabled=' +
      safeWrite.enabled
    );
  }

  var controlledWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3mcControlledWriteStatus_();

  if (
    controlledWrite.available === true &&
    controlledWrite.status === 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write đang ENABLED. Không được chạy security review.'
    );
  }

  var dataSummary = null;

  try {
    dataSummary =
      kidlearnV3_3mcGetSecurityDataSummary_();

    if (dataSummary.usersCount < 1) {
      warnings.push(
        'DATA_Users chưa có user. Role guard sẽ dùng DEV fallback khi test.'
      );
    }

    if (dataSummary.childrenCount < 1) {
      warnings.push(
        'DATA_Children chưa có child. Child access guard sẽ dùng DEV fallback khi test.'
      );
    }

    if (dataSummary.accessCount < 1) {
      warnings.push(
        'DATA_UserChildAccess chưa có access row. FAMILY_ADMIN/CHILD access sẽ dùng DEV fallback trong test.'
      );
    }

  } catch (error) {
    errors.push(
      'Không đọc được security data summary: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_SECURITY_ROLE_GUARD_3MC_V3',
    bundle: '3M-C',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    writeMode: KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.WRITE_MODE,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    allowedRoles: KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.ALLOWED_ROLES,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    phase3MB: phase3MB,
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite,
    controlledWriteStatus: controlledWrite,
    functionChecks: functionChecks.items,
    dataSummary: dataSummary
  };

  kidlearnV3_3mcSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_STATUS.PREVIEWED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Run security review.
 */
function kidlearnV3_runSecurityReview3MCV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewSecurityRoleGuard3MCV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể chạy 3M-C security review vì preview chưa đạt. Errors=' +
      preview.errorCount +
      '. ' +
      preview.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var data =
    kidlearnV3_3mcReadSecurityData_();

  var roleAudit =
    kidlearnV3_3mcAuditUserRoles_(
      data.users
    );

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      roleAudit.errors || []
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      roleAudit.warnings || []
    );

  var accessAudit =
    kidlearnV3_3mcAuditUserChildAccess_(
      data.users,
      data.children,
      data.access
    );

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      accessAudit.errors || []
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      accessAudit.warnings || []
    );

  var policyAudit =
    kidlearnV3_3mcAuditRolePolicies_();

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      policyAudit.errors || []
    );

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      policyAudit.warnings || []
    );

  var guardSmoke =
    kidlearnV3_smokeTestRoleGuard3MCV3();

  if (!guardSmoke.success) {
    errors =
      errors.concat(
        guardSmoke.errors || []
      );
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      guardSmoke.warnings || []
    );

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'RUN_SECURITY_REVIEW_3MC_V3',
    bundle: '3M-C',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.PHASE,
    nextBundle: KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    writeMode: KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.WRITE_MODE,
    realWriteAllowed: false,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    dataSummary: {
      usersCount: data.users.length,
      childrenCount: data.children.length,
      accessCount: data.access.length
    },
    roleAudit: roleAudit,
    accessAudit: accessAudit,
    policyAudit: policyAudit,
    guardSmoke: {
      success: guardSmoke.success,
      testCount: guardSmoke.testCount,
      errorCount: guardSmoke.errorCount
    },
    reviewedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_3mcSaveReview_(
    result
  );

  kidlearnV3_3mcSaveResult_(
    result,
    result.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_STATUS.REVIEW_PASSED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_KEYS.LAST_REVIEW_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3M-C security review failed. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Public role guard.
 *
 * Request example:
 * {
 *   role: 'CHILD',
 *   userId: '...',
 *   childId: '...',
 *   screenId: 'LEARNING_HOME_V3',
 *   actionCode: 'VIEW_LEARNING'
 * }
 */
function kidlearnV3_roleGuard3MCV3(request) {
  var req =
    kidlearnV3_3mcNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var data =
    kidlearnV3_3mcReadSecurityData_();

  var role =
    kidlearnV3_3mcNormalizeRole_(
      req.role
    );

  if (!role) {
    errors.push(
      'Role không hợp lệ hoặc không được phép: ' +
      String(req.role || '')
    );
  }

  var activeUser =
    kidlearnV3_3mcResolveUser_(
      req,
      data,
      role
    );

  var activeChild =
    kidlearnV3_3mcResolveChild_(
      req,
      data
    );

  var policy =
    role
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_ROLE_POLICY[role]
      : null;

  if (!policy) {
    errors.push(
      'Không tìm thấy role policy cho role=' +
      role
    );
  }

  var screenCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3mcCheckScreenAccess_(
      policy,
      req.screenId
    );

  if (!screenCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      screenCheck.message
    );
  }

  var actionCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3mcCheckActionAccess_(
      policy,
      req.actionCode
    );

  if (!actionCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      actionCheck.message
    );
  }

  var childAccessCheck =
    kidlearnV3_3mcCheckChildAccess_(
      role,
      activeUser,
      activeChild,
      data.access
    );

  if (!childAccessCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      childAccessCheck.message
    );
  }

  warnings =
    warnings.concat(
      childAccessCheck.warnings || []
    );

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ROLE_GUARD_3MC_V3',
    bundle: '3M-C',
    role: role,
    requestedRole: req.role || '',
    screenId: req.screenId || '',
    actionCode: req.actionCode || '',
    userId:
      activeUser.userId || '',
    childId:
      activeChild.childId || '',
    canAccess: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    policySummary:
      policy
        ? {
            role: policy.role,
            canSwitchChild: policy.canSwitchChild,
            canManageChildren: policy.canManageChildren,
            canViewSettings: policy.canViewSettings,
            canUseLearningInteractionDryRun:
              policy.canUseLearningInteractionDryRun
          }
        : null,
    childAccessCheck: childAccessCheck,
    evaluatedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert role access.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertRoleAccess3MCV3(request) {
  var result =
    kidlearnV3_roleGuard3MCV3(
      request || {}
    );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Role guard denied. Errors=' +
      result.errorCount +
      '. ' +
      result.errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Get policy for UI.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getRolePolicy3MCV3(request) {
  var req =
    kidlearnV3_3mcNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  var role =
    kidlearnV3_3mcNormalizeRole_(
      req.role
    );

  if (!role) {
    return {
      success: false,
      action: 'GET_ROLE_POLICY_3MC_V3',
      error:
        'Role không hợp lệ: ' +
        String(req.role || '')
    };
  }

  return {
    success: true,
    action: 'GET_ROLE_POLICY_3MC_V3',
    bundle: '3M-C',
    role: role,
    policy:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_ROLE_POLICY[role]
  };
}


/**
 * Smoke test role guard.
 */
function kidlearnV3_smokeTestRoleGuard3MCV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var tests = [];

  var cases = [
    {
      name: 'FAMILY_ADMIN can view settings',
      request: {
        role: 'FAMILY_ADMIN',
        screenId: 'SETTINGS_HOME',
        actionCode: 'VIEW_SETTINGS'
      },
      expectSuccess: true
    },
    {
      name: 'CHILD can view learning',
      request: {
        role: 'CHILD',
        screenId: 'LEARNING_HOME_V3',
        actionCode: 'VIEW_LEARNING'
      },
      expectSuccess: true
    },
    {
      name: 'CHILD cannot view settings',
      request: {
        role: 'CHILD',
        screenId: 'SETTINGS_HOME',
        actionCode: 'VIEW_SETTINGS'
      },
      expectSuccess: false
    },
    {
      name: 'FAMILY_ADMIN can use dry-run interaction',
      request: {
        role: 'FAMILY_ADMIN',
        screenId: 'LEARNING_INTERACTION_3LC',
        actionCode: 'START_LESSON_DRY_RUN'
      },
      expectSuccess: true
    },
    {
      name: 'CHILD can submit dry-run answer',
      request: {
        role: 'CHILD',
        screenId: 'LEARNING_INTERACTION_3LC',
        actionCode: 'SUBMIT_ANSWER_DRY_RUN'
      },
      expectSuccess: true
    },
    {
      name: 'ADMIN role is blocked',
      request: {
        role: 'ADMIN',
        screenId: 'SETTINGS_HOME',
        actionCode: 'VIEW_SETTINGS'
      },
      expectSuccess: false
    },
    {
      name: 'TEACHER role is blocked',
      request: {
        role: 'TEACHER',
        screenId: 'LEARNING_HOME_V3',
        actionCode: 'VIEW_LEARNING'
      },
      expectSuccess: false
    }
  ];

  for (var i = 0; i < cases.length; i++) {
    var testCase =
      cases[i];

    var result =
      kidlearnV3_roleGuard3MCV3(
        testCase.request
      );

    var passed =
      result.success === testCase.expectSuccess;

    tests.push({
      name: testCase.name,
      expectSuccess: testCase.expectSuccess,
      actualSuccess: result.success,
      passed: passed,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || []
    });

    if (!passed) {
      errors.push(
        testCase.name +
        ' failed. Expected=' +
        testCase.expectSuccess +
        ', actual=' +
        result.success
      );
    }

    if (
      result.warnings &&
      result.warnings.length
    ) {
      warnings =
        warnings.concat(
          result.warnings
        );
    }
  }

  var resultFinal = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'SMOKE_TEST_ROLE_GUARD_3MC_V3',
    bundle: '3M-C',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.PHASE,
    testCount: cases.length,
    passedTestCount:
      tests.filter(function(item) {
        return item.passed;
      }).length,
    failedTestCount:
      tests.filter(function(item) {
        return !item.passed;
      }).length,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    tests: tests
  };

  kidlearnV3_3mcSaveResult_(
    resultFinal,
    resultFinal.success
      ? KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_STATUS.GUARD_TESTED
      : KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_STATUS.FAILED,
    KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_KEYS.LAST_SMOKE_TEST_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(resultFinal, null, 2)
  );

  return resultFinal;
}


/**
 * Mark 3M-C ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markSecurityRoleGuard3MCReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getSecurityRoleGuard3MCStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  var allowed = {
    REVIEW_PASSED: true,
    GUARD_TESTED: true,
    READY_FOR_3M_D: true
  };

  if (!allowed[status.status]) {
    errors.push(
      '3M-C chưa có security review/guard test hợp lệ. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  var lastReview =
    status.lastReview || {};

  if (
    !lastReview ||
    lastReview.success !== true
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Last security review chưa success=true.'
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_3mcSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' ||
    safeWrite.enabled !== false
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Khi mark 3M-C ready, Safe Write phải DRY_RUN/enabled=false.'
    );
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    var failed = {
      success: false,
      action: 'MARK_SECURITY_ROLE_GUARD_3MC_READY_V3',
      bundle: '3M-C',
      status: status.status,
      errorCount: errors.length,
      errors: errors
    };

    console.log(
      JSON.stringify(failed, null, 2)
    );

    throw new Error(
      'Không thể mark 3M-C ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'MARK_SECURITY_ROLE_GUARD_3MC_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3M-C',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_STATUS.READY_FOR_3M_D,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    message:
      '3M-C ready. Có thể chuyển sang 3M-D PROD candidate checklist.',
    safeWriteStatus: safeWrite,
    markedAt:
      new Date().toISOString()
  };

  kidlearnV3_3mcSaveResult_(
    result,
    KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_STATUS.READY_FOR_3M_D,
    KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_KEYS.LAST_READY_AT
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}

/**
 * Assert 3M-C ready.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertSecurityRoleGuard3MCReadyV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getSecurityRoleGuard3MCStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (
    status.status !==
    KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_STATUS.READY_FOR_3M_D
  ) {
    errors.push(
      '3M-C chưa READY_FOR_3M_D. Status=' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_SECURITY_ROLE_GUARD_3MC_READY_V3',
    bundle: '3M-C',
    phase: KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.PHASE,
    status: status.status,
    nextBundle:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.NEXT_BUNDLE,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      '3M-C chưa ready. Errors=' +
      errors.length +
      '. ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return result;
}

/**
 * Audit user roles.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcAuditUserRoles_(users) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < users.length; i++) {
    var rawRole =
      users[i].role || users[i].userRole || '';

    var normalized =
      kidlearnV3_3mcNormalizeRole_(
        rawRole
      );

    var userId =
      users[i].userId || '';

    var ok =
      normalized ? true : false;

    items.push({
      userId: userId,
      rawRole: rawRole,
      normalizedRole: normalized || '',
      allowed: ok
    });

    if (!ok) {
      errors.push(
        'DATA_Users có role không được phép. userId=' +
        userId +
        ', role=' +
        rawRole +
        '. Chỉ cho phép CHILD hoặc FAMILY_ADMIN.'
      );
    }
  }

  if (users.length < 1) {
    warnings.push(
      'Không có DATA_Users để audit role.'
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Audit user-child access.
 *
 * Patch 3M-C:
 * - Bỏ qua dòng access rỗng cả userId và childId.
 * - Dòng placeholder không làm fail DEV.
 * - Chỉ fail nếu dòng có một trong hai ID nhưng thiếu ID còn lại.
 * - Giới hạn số error message để tránh spam 500 lỗi.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcAuditUserChildAccess_(
  users,
  children,
  access
) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var items = [];

  var skippedEmptyRows = 0;
  var maxErrorsToShow = 20;

  var userMap =
    kidlearnV3_3mcMapByKey_(
      users,
      'userId'
    );

  var childMap =
    kidlearnV3_3mcMapByKey_(
      children,
      'childId'
    );

  for (var i = 0; i < access.length; i++) {
    var row =
      access[i] || {};

    var userId =
      String(row.userId || '').trim();

    var childId =
      String(row.childId || '').trim();

    /**
     * Quan trọng:
     * Nếu cả userId và childId đều trống thì coi là dòng rỗng / placeholder.
     * Không tính là lỗi.
     */
    if (!userId && !childId) {
      skippedEmptyRows++;

      continue;
    }

    var item = {
      rowIndexInReadRange: i + 3,
      userId: userId,
      childId: childId,
      userExists: userId && userMap[userId] ? true : false,
      childExists: childId && childMap[childId] ? true : false
    };

    items.push(item);

    if (!userId && childId) {
      if (errors.length < maxErrorsToShow) {
        errors.push(
          'DATA_UserChildAccess có dòng thiếu userId nhưng có childId=' +
          childId +
          '. Row=' +
          item.rowIndexInReadRange
        );
      }

      continue;
    }

    if (userId && !childId) {
      if (errors.length < maxErrorsToShow) {
        errors.push(
          'DATA_UserChildAccess có dòng thiếu childId nhưng có userId=' +
          userId +
          '. Row=' +
          item.rowIndexInReadRange
        );
      }

      continue;
    }

    if (userId && !userMap[userId]) {
      if (errors.length < maxErrorsToShow) {
        errors.push(
          'DATA_UserChildAccess tham chiếu userId không tồn tại: ' +
          userId +
          '. Row=' +
          item.rowIndexInReadRange
        );
      }
    }

    if (childId && !childMap[childId]) {
      if (errors.length < maxErrorsToShow) {
        errors.push(
          'DATA_UserChildAccess tham chiếu childId không tồn tại: ' +
          childId +
          '. Row=' +
          item.rowIndexInReadRange
        );
      }
    }
  }

  if (skippedEmptyRows > 0) {
    warnings.push(
      'DATA_UserChildAccess có ' +
      skippedEmptyRows +
      ' dòng rỗng/placeholder đã được bỏ qua trong DEV security review.'
    );
  }

  if (children.length > 0 && items.length < 1) {
    warnings.push(
      'Có child nhưng chưa có DATA_UserChildAccess hợp lệ. DEV vẫn test được bằng fallback, nhưng PROD cần access rõ ràng.'
    );
  }

  if (
    errors.length >= maxErrorsToShow &&
    access.length > maxErrorsToShow
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'Access audit chỉ hiển thị tối đa ' +
      maxErrorsToShow +
      ' lỗi đầu tiên để tránh log quá dài.'
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings,
    skippedEmptyRows: skippedEmptyRows,
    validAccessRowCount: items.length,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Audit role policies.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcAuditRolePolicies_() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var roles =
    KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.ALLOWED_ROLES;

  for (var i = 0; i < roles.length; i++) {
    var role =
      roles[i];

    var policy =
      KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_ROLE_POLICY[role];

    if (!policy) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu policy cho role=' +
        role
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (
      !policy.allowedScreens ||
      Object.keys(policy.allowedScreens).length < 1
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'Policy role=' +
        role +
        ' thiếu allowedScreens.'
      );
    }

    if (
      !policy.allowedActions ||
      Object.keys(policy.allowedActions).length < 1
    ) {
      errors.push(
        'Policy role=' +
        role +
        ' thiếu allowedActions.'
      );
    }
  }

  if (
    KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_ROLE_POLICY.CHILD &&
    KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_ROLE_POLICY.CHILD.allowedScreens.SETTINGS_HOME
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'CHILD không được phép vào SETTINGS_HOME.'
    );
  }

  if (
    KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_ROLE_POLICY.CHILD &&
    KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_ROLE_POLICY.CHILD.allowedActions.VIEW_SETTINGS
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'CHILD không được phép VIEW_SETTINGS.'
    );
  }

  return {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Normalize role.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcNormalizeRole_(role) {
  var value =
    String(role || '')
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();

  if (value === 'CHILD') {
    return 'CHILD';
  }

  if (
    value === 'FAMILY_ADMIN' ||
    value === 'FAMILY ADMIN' ||
    value === 'PARENT' ||
    value === 'GUARDIAN'
  ) {
    return 'FAMILY_ADMIN';
  }

  return '';
}


/**
 * Check screen access.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcCheckScreenAccess_(
  policy,
  screenId
) {
  var screen =
    String(screenId || '').trim();

  if (!screen) {
    return {
      success: true,
      message: ''
    };
  }

  if (
    policy &&
    policy.allowedScreens &&
    policy.allowedScreens[screen]
  ) {
    return {
      success: true,
      message: ''
    };
  }

  return {
    success: false,
    message:
      'Role ' +
      (policy ? policy.role : '') +
      ' không được phép mở screen=' +
      screen
  };
}


/**
 * Check action access.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcCheckActionAccess_(
  policy,
  actionCode
) {
  var action =
    String(actionCode || '').trim();

  if (!action) {
    return {
      success: true,
      message: ''
    };
  }

  if (
    policy &&
    policy.allowedActions &&
    policy.allowedActions[action]
  ) {
    return {
      success: true,
      message: ''
    };
  }

  return {
    success: false,
    message:
      'Role ' +
      (policy ? policy.role : '') +
      ' không được phép chạy action=' +
      action
  };
}


/**
 * Check child access.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcCheckChildAccess_(
  role,
  user,
  child,
  accessRows
) {
  var warnings = [];

  var userId =
    String(user.userId || '').trim();

  var childId =
    String(child.childId || '').trim();

  if (!childId) {
    return {
      success: true,
      mode: 'NO_CHILD_SELECTED',
      warnings: [
        'Không có childId để check access. DEV fallback.'
      ],
      message: ''
    };
  }

  if (!userId) {
    return {
      success: true,
      mode: 'NO_USER_SELECTED',
      warnings: [
        'Không có userId để check access. DEV fallback.'
      ],
      message: ''
    };
  }

  var userAccessRows = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < accessRows.length; i++) {
    if (
      String(accessRows[i].userId || '').trim() === userId
    ) {
      userAccessRows.push(
        accessRows[i]
      );
    }
  }

  if (userAccessRows.length < 1) {
    warnings.push(
      'User chưa có dòng DATA_UserChildAccess. DEV fallback allow. PROD cần access rõ ràng.'
    );

    return {
      success: true,
      mode: 'DEV_FALLBACK_NO_ACCESS_ROWS',
      warnings: warnings,
      message: ''
    };
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < userAccessRows.length; j++) {
    if (
      String(userAccessRows[j].childId || '').trim() === childId
    ) {
      return {
        success: true,
        mode: 'MATCHED_ACCESS_ROW',
        warnings: warnings,
        message: ''
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    success: false,
    mode: 'ACCESS_DENIED',
    warnings: warnings,
    message:
      'User ' +
      userId +
      ' không có quyền truy cập child ' +
      childId
  };
}


/**
 * Resolve user.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcResolveUser_(
  request,
  data,
  role
) {
  var userId =
    String(request.userId || '').trim();

  for (var i = 0; i < data.users.length; i++) {
    if (
      userId &&
      String(data.users[i].userId || '') === userId
    ) {
      return data.users[i];
    }
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < data.users.length; j++) {
    var rowRole =
      kidlearnV3_3mcNormalizeRole_(
        data.users[j].role || data.users[j].userRole || ''
      );

    if (role && rowRole === role) {
      return data.users[j];
    }
  }

  return data.users[0] || {
    userId: '',
    fullName: 'DEV User 3M-C',
    role:
      role ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.DEFAULT_DEV_ROLE
  };
}


/**
 * Resolve child.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcResolveChild_(
  request,
  data
) {
  var childId =
    String(request.childId || '').trim();

  for (var i = 0; i < data.children.length; i++) {
    if (
      childId &&
      String(data.children[i].childId || '') === childId
    ) {
      return data.children[i];
    }
  }

  return data.children[0] || {
    childId: '',
    childName: 'DEV Child 3M-C',
    gradeLevel: '2'
  };
}


/**
 * Get security data summary.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcGetSecurityDataSummary_() {
  var data =
    kidlearnV3_3mcReadSecurityData_();

  return {
    usersCount: data.users.length,
    childrenCount: data.children.length,
    accessCount: data.access.length,
    maxRowsPerSheet:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.MAX_ROWS_PER_SHEET
  };
}


/**
 * Read security data.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcReadSecurityData_() {
  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3mcGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_();

  return {
    users:
      kidlearnV3_3mcReadRowsLimited_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_Users',
        KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.MAX_ROWS_PER_SHEET
      ),
    children:
      kidlearnV3_3mcReadRowsLimited_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_Children',
        KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.MAX_ROWS_PER_SHEET
      ),
    access:
      kidlearnV3_3mcReadRowsLimited_(
        spreadsheet,
        'DATA_UserChildAccess',
        KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_CONFIG.MAX_ROWS_PER_SHEET
      )
  };
}


/**
 * Read rows limited using row 2 as keys.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcReadRowsLimited_(
  spreadsheet,
  sheetName,
  maxRows
) {
  var sheet =
    kidlearnV3_3mcGetSheet_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );

  if (!sheet) {
    return [];
  }

  var lastRow =
    sheet.getLastRow();

  var lastColumn =
    sheet.getLastColumn();

  if (
    lastRow < 3 ||
    lastColumn < 1
  ) {
    return [];
  }

  var limit =
    Math.min(
      Number(maxRows || 100),
      lastRow - 2
    );

  var keys =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        2,
        1,
        1,
        lastColumn
      )
      .getDisplayValues()[0];

  var values =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        3,
        1,
        limit,
        lastColumn
      )
      .getDisplayValues();

  var rows = [];

  for (var r = 0; r < values.length; r++) {
    var row = {};
    var hasValue = false;

    for (var c = 0; c < keys.length; c++) {
      var key =
        String(keys[c] || '').trim();

      if (!key) {
        continue;
      }

      row[key] =
        values[r][c];

      if (values[r][c] !== '') {
        hasValue = true;
      }
    }

    if (hasValue) {
      rows.push(row);
    }
  }

  return rows;
}


/**
 * Database spreadsheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcGetDatabaseSpreadsheet_() {
  var database =
    kidlearnV3_appGetActiveDatabaseV3_();

  var spreadsheet =
    kidlearnV3_3mcResolveSpreadsheet_(
      database
    );

  if (!spreadsheet) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không resolve được Spreadsheet object từ Database V3.'
    );
  }

  return spreadsheet;
}


/**
 * Resolve Spreadsheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcResolveSpreadsheet_(value) {
  if (!value) {
    return null;
  }

  if (
    typeof value.getSheets === 'function' &&
    typeof value.getId === 'function'
  ) {
    return value;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheet &&
    typeof value.spreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheet;
  }

  if (
    value.database &&
    typeof value.database.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.database;
  }

  if (
    value.db &&
    typeof value.db.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.db;
  }

  if (
    value.spreadsheetObject &&
    typeof value.spreadsheetObject.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.spreadsheetObject;
  }

  if (
    value.activeSpreadsheet &&
    typeof value.activeSpreadsheet.getSheets === 'function'
  ) {
    return value.activeSpreadsheet;
  }

  if (value.spreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.spreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (value.databaseSpreadsheetId) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.databaseSpreadsheetId
    );
  }

  if (
    value.id &&
    typeof value.id === 'string'
  ) {
    return SpreadsheetApp.openById(
      value.id
    );
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Get exact sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcGetSheet_(
  spreadsheet,
  sheetName
) {
  if (
    typeof kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_ === 'function'
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_appGetSheetByExactName_(
      spreadsheet,
      sheetName
    );
  }

  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  for (var i = 0; i < sheets.length; i++) {
    if (sheets[i].getName() === sheetName) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Map by key.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcMapByKey_(
  rows,
  key
) {
  var map = {};

  for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
    var value =
      String(rows[i][key] || '').trim();

    if (value) {
      map[value] =
        rows[i];
    }
  }

  return map;
}


/**
 * Safe assert helper.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcSafeAssert_(
  functionName,
  label
) {
  try {
    var exists =
      eval(
        'typeof ' +
        functionName +
        ' === "function"'
      );

    if (!exists) {
      return {
        success: false,
        label: label,
        message:
          'Thiếu function ' + functionName
      };
    }

    var fn =
      eval(functionName);

    var result =
      fn();

    return {
      success:
        result && result.success === true,
      label: label,
      message:
        result && result.success === true
          ? ''
          : JSON.stringify(result)
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      label: label,
      message:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Safe Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcSafeWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    return kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3();
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      mode: '',
      enabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Controlled Write status.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcControlledWriteStatus_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3 === 'function'
    ) {
      var result =
        kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

      result.available = true;

      return result;
    }

    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      safeWriteMode: '',
      safeWriteEnabled: false,
      error:
        'Missing kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3'
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      available: false,
      success: false,
      status: '',
      safeWriteMode: '',
      safeWriteEnabled: false,
      error:
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Check functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcCheckFunctions_(
  names
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          names[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: names[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        names[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Save review compact.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcSaveReview_(
  review
) {
  var compact = {
    success: review.success,
    action: review.action,
    bundle: review.bundle,
    phase: review.phase,
    reviewedAt: review.reviewedAt,
    errorCount: review.errorCount,
    warningCount: review.warningCount,
    errors: review.errors,
    warnings: review.warnings,
    dataSummary: review.dataSummary,
    roleAudit: {
      success: review.roleAudit.success,
      errorCount: review.roleAudit.errorCount,
      warningCount: review.roleAudit.warningCount,
      items: review.roleAudit.items
    },
    accessAudit: {
      success: review.accessAudit.success,
      errorCount: review.accessAudit.errorCount,
      warningCount: review.accessAudit.warningCount,
      items: review.accessAudit.items
    },
    policyAudit: review.policyAudit,
    guardSmoke: review.guardSmoke
  };

  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_KEYS.LAST_REVIEW_JSON,
      JSON.stringify(compact)
    );
}


/**
 * Save result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcSaveResult_(
  result,
  status,
  dateKey
) {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var currentStatus =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_KEYS.STATUS
    ) || '';

  var finalStatus =
    status;

  if (
    currentStatus === KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_STATUS.READY_FOR_3M_D &&
    (
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_STATUS.PREVIEWED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_STATUS.REVIEW_PASSED ||
      status === KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_STATUS.GUARD_TESTED
    )
  ) {
    finalStatus =
      KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_STATUS.READY_FOR_3M_D;
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_KEYS.STATUS,
    finalStatus
  );

  if (dateKey) {
    properties.setProperty(
      dateKey,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );
  }

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_SECURITY_3MC_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify({
      success: result.success,
      action: result.action,
      bundle: result.bundle,
      phase: result.phase,
      status: finalStatus,
      originalRequestedStatus: status,
      errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
      warningCount: result.warningCount || 0,
      errors: result.errors || [],
      warnings: result.warnings || [],
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  );
}


/**
 * Read JSON property.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcReadJsonProperty_(
  key
) {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(key);

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Normalize request.
 */
function kidlearnV3_3mcNormalizeRequest_(request) {
  if (!request) {
    return {};
  }

  if (typeof request !== 'object') {
    return {
      value: request
    };
  }

  return request;
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - INITIAL SEED DATA
 * Step: 3H.7
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * File này seed dữ liệu hệ thống ban đầu.
 *
 * KHÔNG xóa Sheet.
 * KHÔNG đổi tên Sheet.
 * KHÔNG migration dữ liệu V2.
 */


/**
 * Preview dữ liệu seed trước khi ghi.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewInitialSeedV3() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  kidlearnV3_validateCreatedSheets();

  var spreadsheet =
    context.spreadsheet;

  var schema =
    kidlearnV3_buildSchema_();

  var seedMap =
    kidlearnV3_getInitialSeedRows_();

  var report = [];

  var sheetNames =
    Object.keys(seedMap);

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < sheetNames.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sheetName =
      sheetNames[i];

    var definition =
      schema[sheetName];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetName
      );

    if (
      !definition ||
      !sheet
    ) {
      report.push({
        sheetName: sheetName,
        status: 'SKIPPED',
        reason: 'Sheet hoặc schema không tồn tại.'
      });

      continue;
    }

    var rows =
      seedMap[sheetName];

    var existingKeys =
      kidlearnV3_getExistingPrimaryKeys_(
        sheet,
        definition
      );

    var insertCount = 0;
    var updateCount = 0;

    for (
      var r = 0;
      r < rows.length;
      r++
    ) {
      var primaryValue =
        kidlearnV3_getSeedPrimaryValue_(
          definition,
          rows[r]
        );

      if (existingKeys[primaryValue]) {
        updateCount++;
      } else {
        insertCount++;
      }
    }

    report.push({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      status: 'READY',
      seedRowCount: rows.length,
      insertCount: insertCount,
      updateCount: updateCount,
      primaryKey: definition.primaryKey
    });
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    environment: context.environment,
    spreadsheetName: context.spreadsheetName,
    schemaVersion: KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
    targetSeedSheetCount: sheetNames.length,
    report: report
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Seed dữ liệu hệ thống ban đầu.
 *
 * Có thể chạy lại an toàn.
 * Nếu primary key đã tồn tại thì update row đó.
 */
function kidlearnV3_seedInitialDataV3() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  kidlearnV3_validateCreatedSheets();

  var lock =
    LockService.getDocumentLock();

  var locked =
    lock.tryLock(
      KIDLEARN_V3.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS
    );

  if (!locked) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không lấy được document lock. Có thể tiến trình khác đang chạy.'
    );
  }

  try {
    var spreadsheet =
      context.spreadsheet;

    var schema =
      kidlearnV3_buildSchema_();

    var seedMap =
      kidlearnV3_getInitialSeedRows_();

    var report = [];
    var totalInserted = 0;
    var totalUpdated = 0;
    var totalSkipped = 0;

    var sheetNames =
      Object.keys(seedMap);

    for (
      var i = 0;
      i < sheetNames.length;
      i++
    ) {
      var sheetName =
        sheetNames[i];

      var definition =
        schema[sheetName];

      var sheet =
        kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
          spreadsheet,
          sheetName
        );

      if (
        !definition ||
        !sheet
      ) {
        report.push({
          sheetName: sheetName,
          status: 'SKIPPED',
          insertedCount: 0,
          updatedCount: 0,
          skippedCount: 1
        });

        totalSkipped++;
        continue;
      }

      var result =
        kidlearnV3_seedSheetRows_(
          sheet,
          definition,
          seedMap[sheetName]
        );

      report.push(result);

      totalInserted +=
        result.insertedCount;

      totalUpdated +=
        result.updatedCount;

      totalSkipped +=
        result.skippedCount;
    }

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    kidlearnV3_markSeedAppliedSafe_();

    var finalResult = {
      success: true,
      environment: context.environment,
      spreadsheetName: context.spreadsheetName,
      schemaVersion: KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
      insertedCount: totalInserted,
      updatedCount: totalUpdated,
      skippedCount: totalSkipped,
      sheets: report
    };

    console.log(
      JSON.stringify(finalResult, null, 2)
    );

    return finalResult;

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra seed sau khi ghi.
 */
function kidlearnV3_verifyInitialSeedV3() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  var spreadsheet =
    context.spreadsheet;

  var schema =
    kidlearnV3_buildSchema_();

  var seedMap =
    kidlearnV3_getInitialSeedRows_();

  var errors = [];
  var report = [];

  var sheetNames =
    Object.keys(seedMap);

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < sheetNames.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sheetName =
      sheetNames[i];

    var definition =
      schema[sheetName];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetName
      );

    if (
      !definition ||
      !sheet
    ) {
      errors.push(
        sheetName +
        ': không tìm thấy Sheet hoặc schema.'
      );

      continue;
    }

    var existingKeys =
      kidlearnV3_getExistingPrimaryKeys_(
        sheet,
        definition
      );

    var rows =
      seedMap[sheetName];

    var missing = [];

    for (
      var r = 0;
      r < rows.length;
      r++
    ) {
      var primaryValue =
        kidlearnV3_getSeedPrimaryValue_(
          definition,
          rows[r]
        );

      if (!existingKeys[primaryValue]) {
        missing.push(primaryValue);
      }
    }

    if (missing.length > 0) {
      errors.push(
        sheetName +
        ': thiếu seed rows: ' +
        missing.join(', ')
      );
    }

    report.push({
      sheetName: sheetName,
      expectedCount: rows.length,
      missingCount: missing.length,
      missing: missing
    });
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    report: report
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Seed verification chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      errors.length
    );
  }

  return result;
}
