      <div class="toolbar">
        <button onclick="loadInitial()">Refresh UI</button>
        <button class="secondary" onclick="preview3KB()">Preview</button>
        <button class="secondary" onclick="status3KB()">Status</button>
        <button class="dryrun" onclick="smoke3KB()">Smoke Test</button>
        <button class="dryrun" onclick="markReady3KB()">Mark 3K-B Ready</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="warnings"></div>

    <div class="grid">
      <div class="panel">
        <div class="panel-title">Môn học</div>
        <div id="subjects"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="panel">
        <div class="panel-title">Lesson Player DEV</div>
        <div id="player"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="panel">
        <div class="panel-title">Bài học / Assignment</div>
        <div id="lessons"></div>
        <hr>
        <div id="assignments"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="status" class="status">Loading...</div>
  </div>

  <?!= kidlearnV3_uiInclude_('UI_Learning_Dev_3KB_Client_V3'); ?>

  <script>
    var currentPayload = null;
    var currentRequest = {};

    function setStatus(value) {
      document.getElementById('status').textContent =
        typeof value === 'string'
          ? value
          : JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
    }

    function setLoading(message) {
      setStatus(message || 'Loading...');
    }

    function showError(error) {
      setStatus({
        success: false,
        error: error && error.message ? error.message : String(error)
      });
    }

    function loadInitial(request) {
      setLoading('Loading Learning UI 3K-B...');

      currentRequest = request || currentRequest || {};

      KidlearnV3Learning3KB
        .getInitialPayload(currentRequest)
        .then(function(payload) {
          currentPayload = payload;
          render(payload);
          setStatus(payload);
        })
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function preview3KB() {
      setLoading('Preview 3K-B...');
      KidlearnV3Learning3KB
        .preview()
        .then(setStatus)
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function status3KB() {
      setLoading('Get status 3K-B...');
      KidlearnV3Learning3KB
        .getStatus()
        .then(setStatus)
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function smoke3KB() {
      setLoading('Smoke test 3K-B...');
      KidlearnV3Learning3KB
        .smokeTest()
        .then(setStatus)
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function markReady3KB() {
      setLoading('Mark 3K-B ready...');
      KidlearnV3Learning3KB
        .markReady()
        .then(setStatus)
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function render(payload) {
      renderWarnings(payload);
      renderSubjects(payload);
      renderLessons(payload);
      renderAssignments(payload);
      renderPlayer(payload);
    }

    function renderWarnings(payload) {
      var el = document.getElementById('warnings');
      var warnings = [];

      if (
        payload.lessonPlayer &&
        payload.lessonPlayer.warnings
      ) {
        warnings = payload.lessonPlayer.warnings;
      }

      if (!warnings.length) {
        el.innerHTML = '';
        return;
      }

      el.innerHTML =
        '<div class="warning">' +
        warnings.map(escapeHtml).join('<br>') +
        '</div>';
    }

    function renderSubjects(payload) {
      var el = document.getElementById('subjects');
      var items =
        payload.subjectRail && payload.subjectRail.items
          ? payload.subjectRail.items
          : [];

      var selectedId =
        payload.subjectRail
          ? payload.subjectRail.selectedSubjectId
          : '';

      if (!items.length) {
        el.innerHTML =
          '<div class="empty">Chưa có môn học.</div>';
        return;
      }

      el.innerHTML =
        items.map(function(item) {
          var active =
            item.subjectId === selectedId
              ? ' active'
              : '';

          return (
            '<div class="card' + active + '" onclick="selectSubject(\'' +
            escapeAttr(item.subjectId) +
            '\')">' +
              '<div class="card-title">' +
                escapeHtml(item.subjectName || item.subjectId) +
              '</div>' +
              '<div class="card-meta">' +
                escapeHtml(item.subjectCode || '') +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>'
          );
        }).join('');
    }

    function renderLessons(payload) {
      var el = document.getElementById('lessons');
      var items =
        payload.lessonList && payload.lessonList.items
          ? payload.lessonList.items
          : [];

      var selectedId =
        payload.lessonList
          ? payload.lessonList.selectedLessonId
          : '';

      if (!items.length) {
        el.innerHTML =
          '<div class="panel-title">Bài học</div>' +
          '<div class="empty">Chưa có bài học.</div>';
        return;
      }

      el.innerHTML =
        '<div class="panel-title">Bài học</div>' +
        items.map(function(item) {
          var active =
            item.lessonId === selectedId
              ? ' active'
              : '';

          return (
            '<div class="card' + active + '" onclick="selectLesson(\'' +
            escapeAttr(item.lessonId) +
            '\')">' +
              '<div class="card-title">' +
                escapeHtml(item.lessonTitle || item.lessonId) +
              '</div>' +
              '<div class="card-meta">' +
                'Progress: ' +
                escapeHtml(String(item.progressPercent || 0)) +
                '%' +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>'
          );
        }).join('');
    }

    function renderAssignments(payload) {
      var el = document.getElementById('assignments');
      var items =
        payload.assignmentPanel && payload.assignmentPanel.items
          ? payload.assignmentPanel.items
          : [];

      if (!items.length) {
        el.innerHTML =
          '<div class="panel-title">Assignment</div>' +
          '<div class="empty">Chưa có assignment.</div>';
        return;
      }

      el.innerHTML =
        '<div class="panel-title">Assignment</div>' +
        items.map(function(item) {
          return (
            '<div class="card">' +
              '<div class="card-title">' +
                escapeHtml(item.title || item.assignmentId) +
              '</div>' +
              '<div class="card-meta">' +
                escapeHtml(item.status || '') +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>'
          );
        }).join('');
    }

    function renderPlayer(payload) {
      var el = document.getElementById('player');
      var player = payload.lessonPlayer || {};

      if (!player.hasLesson) {
        el.innerHTML =
          '<div class="empty">Chưa có lesson để hiển thị.</div>';
        return;
      }

      var lesson = player.lesson || {};
      var blocks = player.blocks || [];
      var activities = player.activities || [];

      var html =
        '<div class="player-title">' +
          escapeHtml(lesson.lessonTitle || lesson.lessonId) +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="player-meta">' +
          '<span class="badge">READ ONLY</span>' +
          '<span class="badge">3K-B</span>' +
          '<span class="badge">' +
            escapeHtml(String(lesson.estimatedMinutes || 0)) +
            ' phút</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="toolbar">' +
          '<button disabled>Start Lesson</button>' +
          '<button disabled>Update Progress</button>' +
          '<button disabled>Finish Lesson</button>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<p class="card-meta">Các nút trên chỉ là layout. 3K-C mới gắn action DRY_RUN.</p>';

      if (!blocks.length) {
        html +=
          '<div class="empty">Lesson chưa có block nội dung.</div>';
      } else {
        html += blocks.map(function(block) {
          return (
            '<div class="block">' +
              '<div class="card-title">' +
                escapeHtml(block.title || block.blockType || 'Block') +
              '</div>' +
              '<div>' +
                escapeHtml(block.contentText || '') +
              '</div>' +
              '<div class="card-meta">' +
                escapeHtml(block.blockType || '') +
              '</div>' +
            '</div>'
          );
        }).join('');
      }

      if (activities.length) {
        html +=
          '<div class="panel-title">Activities</div>' +
          activities.map(function(activity) {
            return (
              '<div class="activity">' +
                '<div class="card-title">' +
                  escapeHtml(activity.activityType || 'Activity') +
                '</div>' +
                '<div>' +
                  escapeHtml(activity.prompt || '') +
                '</div>' +
              '</div>'
            );
          }).join('');
      }

      el.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function selectSubject(subjectId) {
      currentRequest = {
        subjectId: subjectId
      };
      loadInitial(currentRequest);
    }

    function selectLesson(lessonId) {
      currentRequest.lessonId = lessonId;
      loadInitial(currentRequest);
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return String(value || '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
    }

    function escapeAttr(value) {
      return escapeHtml(value).replace(/\\/g, '\\\\');
    }

    loadInitial({});
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
  window.KidlearnV3Learning3KB = {
    getInitialPayload: function(request) {
      return runServer3KB_(
        'kidlearnV3_uiLearning3KBGetInitialPayloadV3',
        request || {}
      );
    },

    preview: function() {
      return runServer3KB_(
        'kidlearnV3_previewLearningUi3KBV3'
      );
    },

    smokeTest: function() {
      return runServer3KB_(
        'kidlearnV3_smokeTestLearningUi3KBV3'
      );
    },

    markReady: function() {
      return runServer3KB_(
        'kidlearnV3_markLearningUi3KBReadyV3'
      );
    },

    getStatus: function() {
      return runServer3KB_(
        'kidlearnV3_getLearningUi3KBStatusV3'
      );
    }
  };


  function runServer3KB_(functionName, payload) {
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
      var runner =
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(resolve)
          .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
            reject(error);
          });

      if (typeof payload === 'undefined') {
        runner[functionName]();
      } else {
        runner[functionName](payload);
      }
    });
  }
</script>

  <script>
    var currentPayload = null;

    function setStatus(value) {
      document.getElementById('status').textContent =
        typeof value === 'string'
          ? value
          : JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
    }

    function showError(error) {
      setStatus({
        success: false,
        error: error && error.message ? error.message : String(error)
      });
    }

    function loadPayload() {
      setStatus('Loading Learning Interaction 3L-C...');

      KidlearnV3LearningInteraction3LC
        .getPayload({})
        .then(function(payload) {
          currentPayload = payload;
          render(payload);
          setStatus(payload);
        })
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function render(payload) {
      renderLesson(payload);
      renderBlocks(payload);
      renderDiagnostics(payload);
    }

    function renderLesson(payload) {
      var lesson =
        payload.lessonContent && payload.lessonContent.lesson
          ? payload.lessonContent.lesson
          : {};

      var el = document.getElementById('lesson');

      el.innerHTML =
        '<span class="badge">DRY_RUN ONLY</span>' +
        '<span class="badge">3L-C</span>' +
        '<div class="lesson-title">' +
          escapeHtml(lesson.lessonTitle || lesson.lessonId || 'Bài học') +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="meta">Lesson ID: ' +
          escapeHtml(lesson.lessonId || '-') +
        '</div>';
    }

    function renderBlocks(payload) {
      var blocks =
        payload.lessonContent && payload.lessonContent.blocks
          ? payload.lessonContent.blocks
          : [];

      var el = document.getElementById('blocks');

      if (!blocks.length) {
        el.innerHTML =
          '<div class="empty">Chưa có block nội dung. UI vẫn có thể test DRY_RUN bằng DEV fallback.</div>';
        return;
      }

      el.innerHTML =
        blocks.map(function(block, index) {
          var activities = block.activities || [];

          return (
            '<div class="block">' +
              '<b>' + escapeHtml(block.title || block.blockType || 'Nội dung') + '</b>' +
              '<div class="meta">' + escapeHtml(block.blockType || '') + '</div>' +
              '<div>' + escapeHtml(block.body || '') + '</div>' +
              activities.map(function(activity) {
                return (
                  '<div class="activity">' +
                    '<b>' + escapeHtml(activity.activityType || 'Activity') + '</b>' +
                    '<div>' + escapeHtml(activity.prompt || '') + '</div>' +
                    '<div class="small">Submit Answer sẽ chạy DRY_RUN, không ghi DATA_Responses thật.</div>' +
                  '</div>'
                );
              }).join('') +
            '</div>'
          );
        }).join('');
    }

    function renderDiagnostics(payload) {
      var d = payload.diagnostics || {};

      document.getElementById('diagnostics').innerHTML =
        'Lesson ID: ' + escapeHtml(d.lessonId || '-') + '<br>' +
        'Child ID: ' + escapeHtml(d.childId || '-') + '<br>' +
        'Blocks: ' + escapeHtml(String(d.blockCount || 0)) + '<br>' +
        'Actions: ' + escapeHtml(String(d.actionCount || 0));
    }

    function runAction3LC(actionCode) {
      var answerText =
        document.getElementById('answerText').value || '';

      setStatus('Running ' + actionCode + ' DRY_RUN...');

      KidlearnV3LearningInteraction3LC
        .runAction({
          actionCode: actionCode,
          answerText: answerText
        })
        .then(function(result) {
          setStatus(result);
          renderActionResult(result);
        })
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function renderActionResult(result) {
      var el = document.getElementById('actionResult');

      el.innerHTML =
        '<div class="result-box">' +
          '<b>' + escapeHtml(result.actionCode || '') + '</b><br>' +
          'Success: ' + escapeHtml(String(result.success)) + '<br>' +
          'No-write changed sheets: ' +
          escapeHtml(String(result.noWriteCheck ? result.noWriteCheck.changedSheetCount : 0)) +
        '</div>';
    }

    function preview3LC() {
      KidlearnV3LearningInteraction3LC
        .preview()
        .then(setStatus)
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function status3LC() {
      KidlearnV3LearningInteraction3LC
        .status()
        .then(setStatus)
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function runAll3LC() {
      KidlearnV3LearningInteraction3LC
        .runAll()
        .then(setStatus)
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function markReady3LC() {
      KidlearnV3LearningInteraction3LC
        .markReady()
        .then(setStatus)
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return String(value || '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
    }

    loadPayload();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
  window.KidlearnV3LearningInteraction3LC = {
    getPayload: function(request) {
      return runServer3LC_(
        'kidlearnV3_uiLearningInteraction3LCGetPayloadV3',
        request || {}
      );
    },

    runAction: function(request) {
      return runServer3LC_(
        'kidlearnV3_uiLearningInteraction3LCRunActionV3',
        request || {}
      );
    },

    preview: function() {
      return runServer3LC_(
        'kidlearnV3_previewLearningInteraction3LCV3'
      );
    },

    status: function() {
      return runServer3LC_(
        'kidlearnV3_getLearningInteraction3LCStatusV3'
      );
    },

    runAll: function() {
      return runServer3LC_(
        'kidlearnV3_runAllLearningInteractionsDryRunUltraLite3LCV3'
      );
    },

    markReady: function() {
      return runServer3LC_(
        'kidlearnV3_markLearningInteraction3LCReadyV3'
      );
    }
  };


  function runServer3LC_(functionName, payload) {
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
      var runner =
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(resolve)
          .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
            reject(error);
          });

      if (typeof payload === 'undefined') {
        runner[functionName]();
      } else {
        runner[functionName](payload);
      }
    });
  }
</script>

  function assignmentProgress(payload) {

    );
  }

  function assignmentComplete(payload) {

      payload || {}
    );
  }

  function unwrap(response) {
    return KidlearnV3WriteRouter.unwrap(
      response
    );
  }

  function makeDryRunSessionId() {
    var now =
      new Date();

    return (
      'DRY_RUN_SESSION_' +
      now.getFullYear() +
      String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') +
      String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0') +
      '_' +
      String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0') +
      String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0') +
      String(now.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0')
    );
  }

  function today() {
    var date =
      new Date();

    var year =
      date.getFullYear();

    var month =
      String(date.getMonth() + 1)
        .padStart(2, '0');

    var day =
      String(date.getDate())
        .padStart(2, '0');

    return year + '-' + month + '-' + day;
  }

  return {
    getStatus: getStatus,
    getSampleContext: getSampleContext,
    auditEvent: auditEvent,
    startStudy: startStudy,
    finishStudy: finishStudy,
    saveLessonProgress: saveLessonProgress,
    saveDailyGoal: saveDailyGoal,
    assignmentStart: assignmentStart,
    assignmentProgress: assignmentProgress,
    assignmentComplete: assignmentComplete,
    unwrap: unwrap,
    makeDryRunSessionId: makeDryRunSessionId,
    today: today
  };
})();
</script>

<script>
/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - LEGACY CALL ADAPTER CLIENT
 * Step: 3I.8
 * ================================================================
 *
 * File này dùng để thay các lệnh google.script.run cũ trong UI DEV.
 *
 * UI DEV gọi:
 * - KidlearnV3LegacyCalls.getHome(...)
 * - KidlearnV3LegacyCalls.getSubjects(...)
 * - KidlearnV3LegacyCalls.getChildren(...)
 * - KidlearnV3LegacyCalls.getAssignments(...)
 */

window.KidlearnV3LegacyCalls = (function() {
  var SERVER = {
    home: 'kidlearnV3_getHomeDataV3',
    subjects: 'kidlearnV3_getSubjectsDataV3',
    children: 'kidlearnV3_getChildrenDataV3',
    assignments: 'kidlearnV3_getAssignmentsDataV3'
  };

  function callServer(functionName, request) {
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
      if (
        !window.google ||
        !google.script ||
        !google.script.run
      ) {
        reject({
          success: false,
          message: 'google.script.run không khả dụng.'
        });

        return;
      }

      var runner =
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function(response) {
            resolve(response);
          })
          .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
            reject({
              success: false,
              message:
                error && error.message
                  ? error.message
                  : String(error || 'Unknown error')
            });
          });

      runner[functionName](request || {});
    });
  }

  function unwrap(response) {
    if (!response) {
      throw new Error('Response trống.');
    }

    if (response.success !== true) {
      var message =
        response.error && response.error.message
          ? response.error.message
          : 'Service trả về success=false.';

      throw new Error(message);
    }

    return response.data || {};
  }

  function getHome(onSuccess, onError, request) {
    return callAndHandle(
      SERVER.home,
      request || {},
      onSuccess,
      onError
    );
  }

  function getSubjects(onSuccess, onError, request) {
    return callAndHandle(
      SERVER.subjects,
      request || {},
      onSuccess,
      onError
    );
  }

  function getChildren(onSuccess, onError, request) {
    return callAndHandle(
      SERVER.children,
      request || {},
      onSuccess,
      onError
    );
  }

  function getAssignments(onSuccess, onError, request) {
    return callAndHandle(
      SERVER.assignments,
      request || {},
      onSuccess,
      onError
    );
  }

  function callAndHandle(
    functionName,
    request,
    onSuccess,
    onError
  ) {
    return callServer(
      functionName,
      request || {}
    )
      .then(function(response) {
        if (response.success !== true) {
          throw new Error(
            getResponseMessage(response)
          );
        }

        if (typeof onSuccess === 'function') {
          onSuccess(
            response.data || {},
            response
          );
        }

        return response;
      })
      .catch(function(error) {
        if (typeof onError === 'function') {
          onError(error);
          return null;
        }

        throw error;
      });
  }

  function getResponseMessage(response) {
    if (
      response &&
      response.error &&
      response.error.message
    ) {
      return response.error.message;
    }

    return 'Không rõ lỗi từ server.';
  }

  return {
    callServer: callServer,
    unwrap: unwrap,
    getHome: getHome,
    getSubjects: getSubjects,
    getChildren: getChildren,
    getAssignments: getAssignments
  };
})();
</script>

        );

      function setStatus(message, type) {

          document.getElementById('status');

        if (!element) {
          return;
        }

        element.className =
          'status ' + (type || '');

        element.textContent =
          message;
      }

      function setText(id, value) {
        var element =
          document.getElementById(id);

        if (element) {
          element.textContent = value;
        }
      }

      function setRaw(value) {
        var element =
          document.getElementById('rawResponse');

        if (!element) {
          return;
        }

        element.textContent =
          JSON.stringify(
            value,
            null,
            2
          );
      }

      function ping() {
        setStatus(
          'Đang ping DEV_SWITCH V3...',
          ''
        );

        KidlearnV3DevSwitch
          .ping()
          .then(function(response) {
            state.lastResponse =
              response;

            setRaw(response);

            if (!response.success) {
              throw new Error(
                getResponseMessage(response)
              );
            }

            setStatus(
              'Ping thành công. Service=' +
              response.serviceName +
              ', Schema=' +
              response.schemaVersion,
              'good'
            );
          })
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              'Ping lỗi: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );
          });
      }

      function loadBootstrap() {
        setStatus(
          'Đang gọi BOOTSTRAP qua DEV_SWITCH V3...',
          ''
        );

        KidlearnV3DevSwitch
          .bootstrap({})
          .then(function(response) {
            state.lastResponse =
              response;

            setRaw(response);

            if (!response.success) {
              throw new Error(
                getResponseMessage(response)
              );
            }

            var data =
              response.data;

            state.bootstrap =
              data;

            renderBootstrap(data);

            setStatus(
              'Load Bootstrap V3 thành công.',
              'good'
            );
          })
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              'Load Bootstrap lỗi: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );
          });
      }

      function loadSubjects() {
        setStatus(
          'Đang load Subjects...',
          ''
        );

        KidlearnV3DevSwitch
          .subjects()
          .then(function(response) {
            state.lastResponse =
              response;

            setRaw(response);

            if (!response.success) {
              throw new Error(
                getResponseMessage(response)
              );
            }

            renderSubjects(
              response.data.rows || []
            );

            setText(
              'subjectCount',
              response.data.count || 0
            );

            setStatus(
              'Load Subjects thành công.',
              'good'
            );
          })
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              'Load Subjects lỗi: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );
          });
      }

      function loadChildren() {
        setStatus(
          'Đang load Children...',
          ''
        );

        KidlearnV3DevSwitch
          .children('')
          .then(function(response) {
            state.lastResponse =
              response;

            setRaw(response);

            if (!response.success) {
              throw new Error(
                getResponseMessage(response)
              );
            }

            renderChildren(
              response.data.rows || []
            );

            setText(
              'childCount',
              response.data.count || 0
            );

            setStatus(
              'Load Children thành công.',
              'good'
            );
          })
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              'Load Children lỗi: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );
          });
      }

      function loadAssignments() {
        var childId =
          state.selectedChildId || '';

        setStatus(
          'Đang load Assignments cho childId=' +
          childId,
          ''
        );

        KidlearnV3DevSwitch
          .assignments(
            childId,
            100
          )
          .then(function(response) {
            state.lastResponse =
              response;

            setRaw(response);

            if (!response.success) {
              throw new Error(
                getResponseMessage(response)
              );
            }

            renderAssignments(
              response.data.rows || []
            );

            setText(
              'assignmentCount',
              response.data.count || 0
            );

            setStatus(
              'Load Assignments thành công.',
              'good'
            );
          })
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              'Load Assignments lỗi: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );
          });
      }

      function renderBootstrap(data) {
        var counts =
          data.counts || {};

        setText(
          'subjectCount',
          counts.subjects || 0
        );

        setText(
          'userCount',
          counts.users || 0
        );

        setText(
          'childCount',
          counts.children || 0
        );

        setText(
          'assignmentCount',
          counts.assignments || 0
        );

        document.getElementById('modeBadge').textContent =
          'V3 / ' + (data.schemaVersion || '');

        renderSelectedChild(
          data.selectedChild
        );

        renderSubjects(
          data.subjects || []
        );

        renderChildren(
          data.children || []
        );

        renderAssignments(
          data.assignments || []
        );
      }

      function renderSelectedChild(child) {
        var element =
          document.getElementById('selectedChild');

        if (!child) {
          element.innerHTML =
            '<span class="small">Chưa có selected child.</span>';

          state.selectedChildId =
            '';

          return;
        }

        state.selectedChildId =
          child.childId || '';

        element.innerHTML =
          '<div class="item-title">' +
          escapeHtml(
            child.displayName ||
            child.childName ||
            ''
          ) +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="small">' +
          'childId: ' +
          escapeHtml(child.childId || '') +
          ' | gradeLevel: ' +
          escapeHtml(child.gradeLevel || '') +
          ' | status: ' +
          escapeHtml(child.status || '') +
          '</div>';
      }

      function renderSubjects(rows) {
        var element =
          document.getElementById('subjectsList');

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
          element.innerHTML =
            '<span class="small">Chưa có Subjects.</span>';
          return;
        }

        var html = '';

        for (
          var i = 0;
          i < rows.length;
          i++
        ) {
          var row =
            rows[i];

          html +=
            '<div class="item">' +
            '<div class="item-title">' +
            escapeHtml(row.icon || '') +
            ' ' +
            escapeHtml(row.subjectName || '') +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="small">' +
            'subjectId: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.subjectId || '') +
            ' | code: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.subjectCode || '') +
            ' | status: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.status || '') +
            '</div>' +
            '</div>';
        }

        element.innerHTML =
          html;
      }

      function renderChildren(rows) {
        var element =
          document.getElementById('childrenList');

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
          element.innerHTML =
            '<span class="small">Chưa có Children.</span>';
          return;
        }

        var html = '';

        for (
          var i = 0;
          i < rows.length;
          i++
        ) {
          var row =
            rows[i];

          html +=
            '<div class="item">' +
            '<div class="item-title">' +
            escapeHtml(
              row.displayName ||
              row.childName ||
              ''
            ) +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="small">' +
            'childId: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.childId || '') +
            ' | gradeLevel: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.gradeLevel || '') +
            ' | status: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.status || '') +
            '</div>' +
            '</div>';
        }

        element.innerHTML =
          html;
      }

      function renderAssignments(rows) {
        var element =
          document.getElementById('assignmentsList');

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
          element.innerHTML =
            '<span class="small">Chưa có Assignments hoặc chưa gắn với child hiện tại.</span>';
          return;
        }

        var html = '';

        for (
          var i = 0;
          i < rows.length;
          i++
        ) {
          var row =
            rows[i];

          html +=
            '<div class="item">' +
            '<div class="item-title">' +
            escapeHtml(row.title || '') +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="small">' +
            'assignmentId: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.assignmentId || '') +
            ' | status: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.status || '') +
            ' | priority: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.priority || '') +
            ' | progress: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.progressPercent || 0) +
            '%</div>' +
            '</div>';
        }

        element.innerHTML =
          html;
      }

      function showRaw() {
        if (state.lastResponse) {
          setRaw(state.lastResponse);
          setStatus(
            'Raw response đã được cập nhật.',
            'good'
          );
          return;
        }

        setStatus(
          'Chưa có response. Hãy load Bootstrap trước.',
          'warn'
        );
      }

      function getResponseMessage(response) {
        if (
          response &&
          response.error &&
          response.error.message
        ) {
          return response.error.message;
        }

        return 'Service trả về success=false.';
      }

      function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value || '')
          .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
          .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
          .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
          .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
          .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
      }

      return {
        init: init,
        ping: ping,
        loadBootstrap: loadBootstrap,
        loadSubjects: loadSubjects,
        loadChildren: loadChildren,
        loadAssignments: loadAssignments,
        showRaw: showRaw
      };
    })();

    document.addEventListener(
      'DOMContentLoaded',
      function() {
        KidlearnLegacyDevV3.init();
      }
    );
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <script>
    var currentPayload = null;

    function setStatus(value) {
      document.getElementById('status').textContent =
        typeof value === 'string'
          ? value
          : JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
    }

    function showError(error) {
      setStatus({
        success: false,
        error: error && error.message ? error.message : String(error)
      });
    }

    function loadPayload() {
      setStatus('Loading Lesson Content 3L-B...');

      KidlearnV3LessonContent3LB
        .getPayload({})
        .then(function(payload) {
          currentPayload = payload;
          render(payload);
          setStatus(payload);
        })
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function render(payload) {
      renderLesson(payload);
      renderBlocks(payload);
      renderToc(payload);
      renderDiagnostics(payload);
    }

    function renderLesson(payload) {
      var lesson = payload.lesson || {};
      var el = document.getElementById('lesson');

      el.innerHTML =
        '<span class="badge">READ ONLY</span>' +
        '<span class="badge">3L-B</span>' +
        '<span class="badge">' +
          escapeHtml(String(lesson.estimatedMinutes || 0)) +
          ' phút</span>' +
        '<div class="lesson-title">' +
          escapeHtml(lesson.lessonTitle || lesson.lessonId || 'Bài học') +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="meta">Lesson ID: ' +
          escapeHtml(lesson.lessonId || '-') +
        '</div>';
    }

    function renderBlocks(payload) {
      var blocks = payload.blocks || [];
      var el = document.getElementById('blocks');

      if (!blocks.length) {
        el.innerHTML =
          '<div class="empty">' +
          escapeHtml(
            payload.emptyState && payload.emptyState.message
              ? payload.emptyState.message
              : 'Chưa có nội dung bài học.'
          ) +
          '</div>';
        return;
      }

      el.innerHTML =
        blocks.map(function(block, index) {
          var activities = block.activities || [];

          return (
            '<div class="block" id="block_' + index + '">' +
              '<div class="block-title">' +
                escapeHtml(block.title || block.blockType || 'Nội dung') +
              '</div>' +
              '<div class="meta">' +
                escapeHtml(block.blockType || '') +
                ' · order ' +
                escapeHtml(String(block.displayOrder || index + 1)) +
              '</div>' +
              '<div class="block-body">' +
                escapeHtml(block.body || '') +
              '</div>' +
              activities.map(function(activity) {
                return (
                  '<div class="activity">' +
                    '<div class="activity-title">' +
                      escapeHtml(activity.activityType || 'Activity') +
                    '</div>' +
                    '<div>' +
                      escapeHtml(activity.prompt || '') +
                    '</div>' +
                    '<div class="small">READ ONLY preview. Interaction nối ở 3L-C.</div>' +
                  '</div>'
                );
              }).join('') +
            '</div>'
          );
        }).join('');
    }

    function renderToc(payload) {
      var blocks = payload.blocks || [];
      var el = document.getElementById('toc');

      if (!blocks.length) {
        el.innerHTML =
          '<div class="small">Chưa có mục lục.</div>';
        return;
      }

      el.innerHTML =
        blocks.map(function(block, index) {
          return (
            '<div class="toc-item" onclick="scrollToBlock(' + index + ')">' +
              '<b>' + escapeHtml(String(index + 1)) + '.</b> ' +
              escapeHtml(block.title || block.blockType || 'Block') +
              '<br><span class="small">' +
              escapeHtml(block.blockType || '') +
              '</span>' +
            '</div>'
          );
        }).join('');
    }

    function renderDiagnostics(payload) {
      var d = payload.diagnostics || {};
      document.getElementById('diagnostics').innerHTML =
        'Lessons: ' + escapeHtml(String(d.lessonsCount || 0)) + '<br>' +
        'Blocks: ' + escapeHtml(String(d.lessonBlocksCount || 0)) + '<br>' +
        'Activities: ' + escapeHtml(String(d.activitiesCount || 0)) + '<br>' +
        'Renderable: ' + escapeHtml(String(d.renderableBlockCount || 0));
    }

    function scrollToBlock(index) {
      var el = document.getElementById('block_' + index);
      if (el) {
        el.scrollIntoView({
          behavior: 'smooth',
          block: 'start'
        });
      }
    }

    function preview3LB() {
      KidlearnV3LessonContent3LB
        .preview()
        .then(setStatus)
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function status3LB() {
      KidlearnV3LessonContent3LB
        .status()
        .then(setStatus)
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function smoke3LB() {
      KidlearnV3LessonContent3LB
        .smokeTest()
        .then(setStatus)
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function markReady3LB() {
      KidlearnV3LessonContent3LB
        .markReady()
        .then(setStatus)
        .catch(showError);
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return String(value || '')
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
    }

    loadPayload();
  </script>
</body>

<script>
  window.KidlearnV3LessonContent3LB = {
    getPayload: function(request) {
      return runServer3LB_(
        'kidlearnV3_uiLessonContent3LBGetPayloadV3',
        request || {}
      );
    },

    preview: function() {
      return runServer3LB_(
        'kidlearnV3_previewLessonContent3LBV3'
      );
    },

    status: function() {
      return runServer3LB_(
        'kidlearnV3_getLessonContent3LBStatusV3'
      );
    },

    smokeTest: function() {
      return runServer3LB_(
        'kidlearnV3_smokeTestLessonContent3LBUltraLiteV3'
      );
    },

    markReady: function() {
      return runServer3LB_(
        'kidlearnV3_markLessonContent3LBReadyV3'
      );
    }
  };


  function runServer3LB_(functionName, payload) {
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
      var runner =
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(resolve)
          .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
            reject(error);
          });

      if (typeof payload === 'undefined') {
        runner[functionName]();
      } else {
        runner[functionName](payload);
      }
    });
  }
</script>

<script>
  (function () {
    var state = {
      context: window.KIDLEARN_4A_BOOTSTRAP || {},
      courseContext: null,
      role: 'CHILD',
      page: 'login',
      loggedIn: false,
      selectedSubject: null
    };

    function byId(id) {
      return document.getElementById(id);
    }

    function qsa(selector) {
      return Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(selector));
    }

    function init() {
      state.role = state.context.defaultRole || 'CHILD';

      ensureLoginMessage();
      bindDemoData();
      renderNavigation();
      renderChildHome4B();
      renderCourses4B();
      renderParentSummary();
      bindEvents();

      selectLoginRole4B2R(state.role || 'CHILD');
      showLoginOnly4B2R();

      console.log('[KIDLEARN 4B-2R-2] Login Full Screen loaded', state.context);
    }

    function ensureLoginMessage() {
      var box = document.querySelector('.kl-login-box');
      if (!box || byId('loginMessage')) return;

      var div = document.createElement('div');
      div.id = 'loginMessage';
      div.style.marginTop = '12px';
      div.style.padding = '12px 14px';
      div.style.borderRadius = '14px';
      div.style.fontSize = '14px';
      div.style.lineHeight = '1.5';
      div.style.display = 'none';

      box.appendChild(div);
    }

    function selectLoginRole4B2R(role) {
      var normalizedRole =
        role === 'FAMILY_ADMIN'
          ? 'FAMILY_ADMIN'
          : 'CHILD';

      var select = byId('loginRole');
      if (select) {
        select.value = normalizedRole;
      }

      qsa('[data-login-role]').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.classList.toggle(
          'active',
          btn.getAttribute('data-login-role') === normalizedRole
        );
      });

      var loginCode = byId('loginCode');
      var loginPin = byId('loginPin');

      if (loginCode) {
        loginCode.value =
          normalizedRole === 'FAMILY_ADMIN'
            ? 'PARENT'
            : 'LICH_KHE';
      }

      if (loginPin) {
        loginPin.value = '1234';
      }

      state.role = normalizedRole;
    }

    function showLoginOnly4B2R() {
      var login = byId('loginScreen');
      var app = byId('kidlearnApp');

      if (login) login.classList.remove('hidden');
      if (app) app.classList.add('hidden');

      state.page = 'login';
    }

    function showAppShell4B2R() {
      var login = byId('loginScreen');
      var app = byId('kidlearnApp');

      if (login) login.classList.add('hidden');
      if (app) app.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function showLoginMessage(type, message) {
      var el = byId('loginMessage');
      if (!el) return;

      el.style.display = 'block';

      if (type === 'error') {
        el.style.background = '#fef2f2';
        el.style.border = '1px solid #fecaca';
        el.style.color = '#b91c1c';
      } else if (type === 'success') {
        el.style.background = '#f0fdf4';
        el.style.border = '1px solid #bbf7d0';

      } else {

    function setLoginLoading(isLoading) {

    }

    function applyContext(newContext) {

      state.role = state.context.defaultRole || state.role || 'CHILD';

      bindDemoData();
      renderNavigation();
      renderChildHome4B();
      renderCourses4B();
      renderParentSummary();

    function applyCourseContext(result) {
      if (!result || result.success !== true || !result.context) {
        renderChildHome4B();

      state.courseContext = result.context;

      renderChildHome4B();
      renderCourses4B();
      renderParentSummary();

    function fetchCourseContext4B(callback) {
      if (
        typeof google === 'undefined' ||
        !google.script ||
        !google.script.run
      ) {
        renderChildHome4B();
        renderCourses4B();
        if (callback) callback();
        return;
      }

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function (result) {
          applyCourseContext(result);
          if (callback) callback();

        .withFailureHandler(function (error) {

          renderChildHome4B();

        .kidlearnV3_getChildHomeCourseContext4BV3({

    function getChild() {

    function renderNavigation() {

    function renderSubjectGrid(containerId, subjects) {

    function subjectCardHtml4B(subject) {
      var progress = Number(subject.progress || 0);

      return [
        '<article class="kl-subject-card kl-subject-card-4b ' + escapeHtml(subject.colorClass || '') + '" data-subject-card data-subject-code="' + escapeHtml(subject.subjectCode || '') + '">',

    function renderTodayPlan4B(childHome) {

    function renderRecommendedList4B(containerId, items) {
      var container = byId(containerId);

      if (items.length === 0) {

          '<div class="kl-recommended-item">' +

    function openSubjectDetail4B(subjectCode) {
      var subjects = getSubjectCards();
      var subject = null;

      for (var i = 0; i < subjects.length; i++) {
        if (String(subjects[i].subjectCode || '') === String(subjectCode || '')) {
          subject = subjects[i];
          break;
        }
      }

      if (!subject && subjects.length > 0) {
        subject = subjects[0];
      }

      if (!subject) {
        showPlaceholder('subject', 'Màn hình môn học đang chuẩn bị');
        return;
      }

      state.selectedSubject = subject;

      setText('subjectDetailStatus', subject.subjectStatus || 'Đang học');
      setText('subjectDetailTitle', subject.subjectName || 'Môn học');
      setText(
        'subjectDetailSubtitle',
        (subject.accentLabel || 'Bài học') +
          ' · ' +
          (subject.currentTopic || 'Chủ đề mới')
      );
      setText('subjectDetailIcon', subject.icon || '📘');
      setText(
        'subjectDetailNextLesson',
        subject.nextLessonTitle || subject.nextAction || 'Bài học tiếp theo'
      );
      setText(
        'subjectDetailProgressText',
        (subject.progress || 0) +
          '% hoàn thành · ' +
          (subject.completedCount || 0) +
          '/' +
          (subject.lessonCount || 0) +
          ' bài'
      );

      var bar = byId('subjectDetailProgressBar');
      if (bar) {
        bar.style.width = Number(subject.progress || 0) + '%';
      }

      showScreen('subjectDetail');
      setHeader(subject.subjectName || 'Môn học', 'Màn hình môn học sẽ mở rộng ở 4C');
    }

    function renderParentSummary() {
      var summary = state.context.parentSummary || {};
      var subjects = getSubjectCards();

      if (state.courseContext && state.courseContext.courseDashboard) {
        var max = null;
        var min = null;

        subjects.forEach(function (subject) {
          if (!max || Number(subject.progress || 0) > Number(max.progress || 0)) {
            max = subject;
          }
          if (!min || Number(subject.progress || 0) < Number(min.progress || 0)) {
            min = subject;
          }
        });

        summary = {
          weekStudyDays: summary.weekStudyDays || 5,
          totalMinutes: summary.totalMinutes || 85,
          strongSubject: max ? max.subjectName : 'Tiếng Việt',
          reviewSubject: min ? min.subjectName : 'Toán',
          recommendation:
            'Tuần này nên ôn thêm các bài ngắn ở môn ' +
            (min ? min.subjectName : 'Toán') +
            '.'
        };
      }

      setText('weekStudyDays', summary.weekStudyDays || 0);
      setText('totalMinutes', summary.totalMinutes || 0);
      setText('strongSubject', summary.strongSubject || 'Tiếng Việt');
      setText('reviewSubject', summary.reviewSubject || 'Toán');
      setText('parentRecommendation', summary.recommendation || '');

      var container = byId('parentSubjectProgress');
      if (!container) return;

      container.innerHTML = subjects.map(function (subject) {
        var progress = Number(subject.progress || 0);
        return [
          '<div class="kl-progress-row">',
            '<div class="kl-progress-row-head">',

              '<span>' + progress + '%</span>',
            '</div>',

              '<span style="width:' + progress + '%"></span>',
            '</div>',

        ].join('');

    function setText(id, value) {
      var el = byId(id);
      if (el) el.textContent = value;

    function bindEvents() {
      qsa('[data-login-role]').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          selectLoginRole4B2R(btn.getAttribute('data-login-role') || 'CHILD');
        });
      });

      var loginButton = byId('loginButton');
      if (loginButton) {
        loginButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
          submitLogin();
        });
      }

      var skipLoginButton = byId('skipLoginButton');
      if (skipLoginButton) {
        skipLoginButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
          loadDemoContext();
        });
      }

      qsa('[data-role-switch]').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          var role = btn.getAttribute('data-role-switch') || 'CHILD';
          switchRole(role);
        });
      });

      document.body.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
        var subjectButton = event.target.closest('[data-subject-open]');
        if (subjectButton) {
          openSubjectDetail4B(subjectButton.getAttribute('data-subject-open'));
          event.preventDefault();
          return;
        }

        var subjectCard = event.target.closest('[data-subject-card]');
        if (subjectCard) {
          openSubjectDetail4B(subjectCard.getAttribute('data-subject-code'));
          event.preventDefault();
          return;
        }

        var target = event.target.closest('[data-page]');
        if (!target) return;
        navigate(target.getAttribute('data-page'));
      });

      var mobileMenuButton = byId('mobileMenuButton');
      if (mobileMenuButton) {
        mobileMenuButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
          var sidebar = document.querySelector('.kl-sidebar');
          if (sidebar) sidebar.classList.toggle('mobile-collapsed');
        });
      }
    }

    function submitLogin() {
      var role = byId('loginRole') ? byId('loginRole').value : 'CHILD';
      var loginCode = byId('loginCode') ? byId('loginCode').value : '';
      var pin = byId('loginPin') ? byId('loginPin').value : '';

      setLoginLoading(true);
      showLoginMessage('info', 'Đang kiểm tra tài khoản...');

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function (result) {
          setLoginLoading(false);

          if (!result || result.success !== true) {
            showLoginMessage(
              'error',
              result && result.message
                ? result.message
                : 'Đăng nhập không thành công.'
            );
            return;
          }

          applyContext(result.context);
          showLoginMessage('success', result.message || 'Đăng nhập thành công.');

          fetchCourseContext4B(function () {
            setTimeout(function () {
              enterApp(result.context.defaultRole || role);
            }, 150);
          });
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function (error) {
          setLoginLoading(false);
          showLoginMessage(
            'error',
            error && error.message
              ? error.message
              : String(error)
          );
        })
        .kidlearnV3_productLogin4A1CV3({
          role: role,
          loginCode: loginCode,
          pin: pin
        });
    }

    function loadDemoContext() {
      var role = byId('loginRole') ? byId('loginRole').value : state.role || 'CHILD';

      showLoginMessage('info', 'Đang mở giao diện demo...');

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function (result) {
          if (!result || result.success !== true) {
            showLoginMessage('error', 'Không mở được demo context.');
            return;
          }

          applyContext(result.context);

          fetchCourseContext4B(function () {
            enterApp(result.context.defaultRole || role);
          });
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function (error) {
          showLoginMessage(
            'error',
            error && error.message
              ? error.message
              : String(error)
          );
        })
        .kidlearnV3_getProductDemoContext4A1CV3({
          role: role
        });
    }

    function switchRole(role) {
      state.role = role === 'FAMILY_ADMIN' ? 'FAMILY_ADMIN' : 'CHILD';

      qsa('[data-role-switch]').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.classList.toggle(
          'active',
          btn.getAttribute('data-role-switch') === state.role
        );
      });

      renderNavigation();

      if (state.role === 'FAMILY_ADMIN') {
        navigate('parent-home');
      } else {
        navigate('home');
      }
    }

    function enterApp(role) {
      state.loggedIn = true;
      state.role = role === 'FAMILY_ADMIN' ? 'FAMILY_ADMIN' : 'CHILD';
      showAppShell4B2R();
      switchRole(state.role);
    }

    function navigate(page) {
      state.page = page;

      qsa('.kl-nav-item').forEach(function (btn) {
        btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.getAttribute('data-page') === page);
      });

      if (state.role === 'FAMILY_ADMIN') {
        if (page === 'parent-home') {
          showScreen('parentHome');
          setHeader('Tổng quan học tập', 'Khu phụ huynh / Family Admin');
          return;
        }

        showPlaceholder(page, 'Tính năng phụ huynh đang chuẩn bị');
        setHeader(getPageLabel(page), 'Khu phụ huynh / Family Admin');
        return;
      }

      if (page === 'home') {
        showScreen('childHome');
        setHeader('Trang chủ', 'Khu học tập của bé');
      } else if (page === 'courses') {
        showScreen('courses');
        setHeader('Khóa học', 'Chọn môn học yêu thích');
      } else {
        showPlaceholder(page, 'Tính năng đang chuẩn bị');
        setHeader(getPageLabel(page), 'Khu học tập của bé');
      }
    }

    function showScreen(name) {
      if (name === 'login') {
        showLoginOnly4B2R();
        return;
      }

      showAppShell4B2R();

      var map = {
        childHome: 'childHomeScreen',
        courses: 'coursesScreen',
        subjectDetail: 'subjectDetailScreen',
        parentHome: 'parentHomeScreen',
        placeholder: 'placeholderScreen'
      };

      Object.keys(map).forEach(function (key) {
        var el = byId(map[key]);
        if (el) el.classList.add('hidden');
      });

      var target = byId(map[name]);
      if (target) target.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function showPlaceholder(page, title) {
      showScreen('placeholder');
      var titleEl = byId('placeholderTitle');
      if (titleEl) {
        titleEl.textContent = title || getPageLabel(page);
      }
    }

    function setHeader(title, kicker) {
      var pageTitle = byId('pageTitle');
      var roleKicker = byId('roleKicker');

      if (pageTitle) pageTitle.textContent = title || 'KID LEARN';
      if (roleKicker) roleKicker.textContent = kicker || '';
    }

    function getPageLabel(page) {
      var items = getCurrentNavigation();
      for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        if (items[i].page === page) return items[i].label;
      }
      return 'Tính năng đang chuẩn bị';
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return String(value == null ? '' : value)
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  })();
</script>

      var lessonId = button.getAttribute('data-lesson-id') || '';

      if (resultBox) {
        resultBox.className = 'kl-assignment-learning-route-result-4i2 is-loading';
        resultBox.innerHTML = '<strong>Đang kiểm tra đường dẫn bài học...</strong>';
      }

      if (typeof google === 'undefined' || !google.script || !google.script.run) {

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function (result) {

        .withFailureHandler(function (error) {

      if (!resultBox) { return; }

      var route = result.routePreview || {};

      if (!route.canRoute) {
        resultBox.className = 'kl-assignment-learning-route-result-4i2 is-error';
        resultBox.innerHTML =
          '<strong>Chưa có bài để mở.</strong>' +
          '<p>Phụ huynh cần giao bài trước.</p>';
        return;
      }

      resultBox.className = 'kl-assignment-learning-route-result-4i2 is-success';
      resultBox.innerHTML =
        '<strong>Đã preview route — chưa ghi trạng thái Assignment.</strong>' +
        '<p>Lesson: ' + escapeHtml4I2(route.lessonId || '') + '</p>' +
        '<p>4I-3 mới xử lý ghi IN_PROGRESS / COMPLETED.</p>';

      openExistingLessonPlayerFromAssignment4I2(route.lessonId);
    }

    function renderAssignmentRouteError4I2(message) {
      var resultBox = document.querySelector('.kl-assignment-learning-route-result-4i2');
      if (!resultBox) { return; }

      resultBox.className = 'kl-assignment-learning-route-result-4i2 is-error';
      resultBox.innerHTML =
        '<strong>Không mở được bài học.</strong>' +
        '<p>' + escapeHtml4I2(message || 'Vui lòng thử lại.') + '</p>';
    }

    function openExistingLessonPlayerFromAssignment4I2(lessonId) {
      lessonId = String(lessonId || '').trim();
      if (!lessonId) { return; }

      var candidates = [
        'openLessonFromSubjectDashboard4C2',
        'openLessonPlayer4C',
        'openLesson4C',
        'openProductLesson4C',
        'kidlearnOpenLesson4C'
      ];

      for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
        var fn = window[candidates[i]];
        if (typeof fn === 'function') {
          try {
            fn(lessonId, { source: 'ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_4I2', dryRunOnly: true });
            return;
          } catch (error) {
            // Try next candidate
          }
        }
      }

      var resultBox = document.querySelector('.kl-assignment-learning-route-result-4i2');
      if (resultBox) {
        resultBox.innerHTML +=
          '<p class="kl-assignment-learning-route-note-4i2">' +
            'Đã xác nhận route. Chưa tìm thấy function mở Lesson Player 4C trên UI hiện tại.' +
          '</p>';
      }
    }

    function closeAssignmentLearningPanel4I2() {
      var existing = document.querySelector('.kl-assignment-learning-overlay-4i2');
      if (existing && existing.parentNode) {
        existing.parentNode.removeChild(existing);
      }
    }

    // ĐÃ SỬA LỖI Ở HÀM NÀY
    function kidlearnV3_findChildHomeAnchorForAssignment4I2P1_() {
      var elements = Array.prototype.slice.call(
        document.querySelectorAll('section, article, div, h1, h2, h3, h4')
      );

      for (var i = elements.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        var text = String(elements[i].innerText || '').toUpperCase();
        if (text.indexOf('HÔM NAY BÉ') !== -1 || text.indexOf('BÀI HỌC TIẾP THEO') !== -1) {
          return elements[i];
        }
      }

      for (var j = elements.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
        var text2 = String(elements[j].innerText || '').toUpperCase();
        if (text2.indexOf('4 MÔN HỌC CHÍNH') !== -1 || text2.indexOf('KHU HỌC TẬP CỦA BÉ') !== -1) {
          return elements[j];
        }
      }

      var subjectCard = document.querySelector('.kl-subject-card, .kl-course-card');
      if (subjectCard) {
        return subjectCard;
      }

      return null;
    } // <-- Đây là dấu đóng hàm đã được thêm vào đúng chỗ.

    // ĐÃ SỬA LỖI Ở SỰ KIỆN NÀY
    document.addEventListener(
      'click',
      function (event) {
        var actionEl = event.target.closest
          ? event.target.closest('[data-action]')
          : null;

        if (!actionEl) {
          return;
        }

        var action = actionEl.getAttribute('data-action');

        if (action === 'open-assignment-learning-4i2') {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopPropagation();
          openAssignmentLearningPanel4I2();
          return;
        }

        if (action === 'close-assignment-learning-4i2') {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopPropagation();
          closeAssignmentLearningPanel4I2();
          return;
        }

        if (action === 'preview-assignment-route-4i2') {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopPropagation();
          previewAssignmentRoute4I2(actionEl);
          return;
        }
      },
      true
    );

    function scheduleEnsureAssignmentLearningHome4I2() {
      if (KIDLEARN_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_DRY_RUN_4I2.injectTimer) {
        return;
      }

      KIDLEARN_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_DRY_RUN_4I2.injectTimer = setTimeout(function () {
        KIDLEARN_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_DRY_RUN_4I2.injectTimer = null;
        ensureAssignmentLearningHome4I2();

        if (
          !document.querySelector('.kl-assignment-learning-entry-4i2') &&
          KIDLEARN_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_DRY_RUN_4I2.retryCount < KIDLEARN_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_DRY_RUN_4I2.maxRetry
        ) {
          KIDLEARN_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_DRY_RUN_4I2.retryCount += 1;
          scheduleEnsureAssignmentLearningHome4I2();
        }
      }, 800);
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', scheduleEnsureAssignmentLearningHome4I2);
    } else {
      scheduleEnsureAssignmentLearningHome4I2();
    }

    var observer4I2 = new MutationObserver(function () {
      scheduleEnsureAssignmentLearningHome4I2();
    });

    observer4I2.observe(document.documentElement, {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true
    });

    window.ensureAssignmentLearningHome4I2 = ensureAssignmentLearningHome4I2;
    window.openAssignmentLearningPanel4I2 = openAssignmentLearningPanel4I2;
    window.renderAssignmentLearningPanel4I2 = renderAssignmentLearningPanel4I2;
    window.previewAssignmentRoute4I2 = previewAssignmentRoute4I2;
  })();
</script>

<script>
  /**
   * KIDLEARN_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_FORCE_CARD_4I2P2
   * Patch 4I-2P2
   *
   * Purpose:
   * - Force inject "Bài học được giao" card into child home.
   * - Does not write any DATA sheet.

   */

  (function () {
    var STATE_4I2P2 = {
      phase: '4I-2P2',
      marker: 'KIDLEARN_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_FORCE_CARD_4I2P2',
      timer: null,

      maxAttempts: 20
    };

    window.KIDLEARN_ASSIGNMENT_LEARNING_UI_FORCE_CARD_4I2P2 =
      STATE_4I2P2;

    function escapeHtml4I2P2(value) {
      return String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value)
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
    }

    function getBodyText4I2P2() {
      return document.body
        ? String(document.body.innerText || '')
        : '';
    }

    function isChildHomeVisible4I2P2() {
      var text =
        getBodyText4I2P2().toUpperCase();

      if (!text) {
        return false;
      }

      var isLogin =
        text.indexOf('ĐĂNG NHẬP') !== -1 &&
        text.indexOf('TRANG CHỦ') === -1;

      if (isLogin) {
        return false;
      }

      return (
        text.indexOf('KHU HỌC TẬP CỦA BÉ') !== -1 ||
        text.indexOf('HÔM NAY BÉ') !== -1 ||
        text.indexOf('4 MÔN HỌC CHÍNH') !== -1 ||
        text.indexOf('BÀI HỌC TIẾP THEO') !== -1 ||
        document.querySelector('.kl-subject-card') ||
        document.querySelector('.kl-course-card')
      );
    }

    function findBestAnchor4I2P2() {
      var elements =
        Array.prototype.slice.call(
          document.querySelectorAll('section, article, div, h1, h2, h3, h4')
        );

      for (var i = 0; i < elements.length; i++) {
        var text =
          String(elements[i].innerText || '').toUpperCase();

        if (
          text.indexOf('KHU HỌC TẬP CỦA BÉ') !== -1 &&
          text.indexOf('TRANG CHỦ') !== -1
        ) {
          return elements[i];
        }
      }

      for (var j = 0; j < elements.length; j++) {
        var text2 =
          String(elements[j].innerText || '').toUpperCase();

        if (
          text2.indexOf('HÔM NAY BÉ') !== -1 ||
          text2.indexOf('BÀI HỌC TIẾP THEO') !== -1
        ) {
          return elements[j];
        }
      }

      var subject =
        document.querySelector('.kl-subject-card, .kl-course-card');

      if (subject) {
        return subject;
      }

      return (
        document.querySelector('main') ||
        document.querySelector('#app') ||
        document.body
      );
    }

    function buildCard4I2P2() {
      var card =
        document.createElement('section');

      card.className =
        'kl-assignment-learning-entry-4i2 kl-assignment-learning-entry-force-4i2p2';

      card.setAttribute('data-phase', '4I-2P2');
      card.setAttribute('data-patch', 'FORCE_CARD');

      card.innerHTML =
        '<div class="kl-assignment-learning-entry-inner-4i2">' +
          '<div class="kl-assignment-learning-entry-icon-4i2">🎯</div>' +
          '<div class="kl-assignment-learning-entry-content-4i2">' +
            '<div class="kl-assignment-learning-badge-4i2">4I-2 Dry-run</div>' +
            '<h3>Bài học được giao</h3>' +
            '<p>Học theo kế hoạch phụ huynh đã lập • Chưa ghi dữ liệu</p>' +
            '<div class="kl-assignment-learning-empty-mini-4i2">' +
              'Nếu chưa có bài được giao, hệ thống sẽ hiển thị trạng thái trống an toàn.' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<button type="button" class="kl-assignment-learning-open-4i2" data-action="open-assignment-learning-4i2">' +
            'Xem bài học' +
          '</button>' +
        '</div>';

      var button =
        card.querySelector('[data-action="open-assignment-learning-4i2"]');

      if (button) {
        button.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopPropagation();

          if (typeof window.openAssignmentLearningPanel4I2 === 'function') {
            window.openAssignmentLearningPanel4I2();
            return;
          }

          alert(
            'UI 4I-2 đã có card, nhưng function mở panel chưa sẵn sàng. Vui lòng refresh lại Web App.'
          );
        });
      }

      return card;
    }

    function forceInjectAssignmentLearningCard4I2P2() {
      if (!isChildHomeVisible4I2P2()) {
        return {
          success: false,
          reason: 'CHILD_HOME_NOT_VISIBLE_YET',
          attempts: STATE_4I2P2.attempts
        };
      }

      var existing =
        document.querySelector('.kl-assignment-learning-entry-4i2');

      if (existing) {
        return {
          success: true,
          alreadyExists: true,
          cardFound: true,
          message: 'Card Bài học được giao đã tồn tại.'
        };
      }

      var anchor =
        findBestAnchor4I2P2();

      if (!anchor) {
        return {
          success: false,
          reason: 'NO_ANCHOR_FOUND'
        };
      }

      var card =
        buildCard4I2P2();

      if (anchor.parentNode && anchor !== document.body) {
        anchor.parentNode.insertBefore(card, anchor);
      } else if (document.body.firstChild) {
        document.body.insertBefore(card, document.body.firstChild);
      } else {
        document.body.appendChild(card);
      }

      return {
        success: true,
        inserted: true,
        cardFound: true,
        phase: '4I-2P2',
        message: 'Đã inject card Bài học được giao.'
      };
    }

    function scheduleForceInject4I2P2() {
      if (STATE_4I2P2.timer) {
        return;
      }

      STATE_4I2P2.timer =
        setTimeout(function () {
          STATE_4I2P2.timer = null;
          STATE_4I2P2.attempts += 1;

          var result =
            forceInjectAssignmentLearningCard4I2P2();

          if (
            !result.success &&
            STATE_4I2P2.attempts < STATE_4I2P2.maxAttempts
          ) {
            scheduleForceInject4I2P2();
          }

          if (window.console && console.log) {
            console.log('[4I-2P2 force inject]', result);
          }
        }, 700);
    }

    function debugAssignmentLearning4I2P2() {
      var result = {
        success: true,
        phase: '4I-2P2',
        childHomeVisible: isChildHomeVisible4I2P2(),
        cardExists:
          document.querySelector('.kl-assignment-learning-entry-4i2')
            ? true
            : false,
        originalFunctionExists:
          typeof window.ensureAssignmentLearningHome4I2 === 'function',
        openPanelFunctionExists:
          typeof window.openAssignmentLearningPanel4I2 === 'function',
        forceFunctionExists:
          typeof window.forceShowAssignmentLearningHome4I2 === 'function',
        attempts:
          STATE_4I2P2.attempts,
        bodyTextPreview:
          getBodyText4I2P2().substring(0, 500)
      };

      console.log('[4I-2P2 debug]', result);
      return result;
    }

    window.forceShowAssignmentLearningHome4I2 =
      function () {
        return forceInjectAssignmentLearningCard4I2P2();
      };

    window.debugAssignmentLearning4I2 =
      function () {
        return debugAssignmentLearning4I2P2();
      };

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', scheduleForceInject4I2P2);
    } else {
      scheduleForceInject4I2P2();
    }

    var observer4I2P2 =
      new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (
          !document.querySelector('.kl-assignment-learning-entry-4i2')
        ) {
          scheduleForceInject4I2P2();
        }
      });

    observer4I2P2.observe(
      document.documentElement,
      {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true
      }
    );
  })();
</script>

<script>
  /**
   * KIDLEARN_ASSIGNMENT_WRITE_UI_4I3
   * Phase 4I-3 — Controlled Assignment Status Write + Completion Sync
   *
   * Safety:
   * - Gate closed by default.
   * - UI calls backend controlled write.
   * - No DATA write when gate is CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY.
   */

  (function () {
    var KIDLEARN_ASSIGNMENT_WRITE_UI_4I3 = {
      phase: '4I-3',
      marker: 'KIDLEARN_ASSIGNMENT_WRITE_UI_4I3',
      timer: null,
      attempts: 0,
      maxAttempts: 30
    };

    window.KIDLEARN_ASSIGNMENT_WRITE_UI_4I3 =
      KIDLEARN_ASSIGNMENT_WRITE_UI_4I3;

    function escapeHtml4I3(value) {
      return String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value)
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
    }

    function patchAssignmentLearningWriteControls4I3() {
      var panel =
        document.querySelector('.kl-assignment-learning-panel-4i2');

      if (!panel) {
        return {
          success: false,
          reason: 'NO_ASSIGNMENT_PANEL_4I2'
        };
      }

      ensureAssignmentWriteGateBanner4I3(panel);

      var cards =
        Array.prototype.slice.call(
          panel.querySelectorAll('.kl-assignment-learning-card-4i2')
        );

      if (!cards.length) {
        return {
          success: true,
          phase: '4I-3',
          emptyState: true,
          patchedCount: 0,
          message: 'Không có assignment card. Empty state hợp lệ.'
        };
      }

      var patched = 0;

      for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
        if (cards[i].querySelector('.kl-assignment-write-control-4i3')) {
          continue;
        }

        cards[i].appendChild(
          buildAssignmentWriteControl4I3(cards[i])
        );

        patched++;
      }

      ensureAssignmentWriteResultBox4I3(panel);

      return {
        success: true,
        phase: '4I-3',
        patchedCount: patched,
        totalCards: cards.length
      };
    }

    function ensureAssignmentWriteGateBanner4I3(panel) {
      if (panel.querySelector('.kl-assignment-write-gate-4i3')) {
        return;
      }

      var banner =

      banner.className =

      banner.innerHTML =

      var head =
        panel.querySelector('.kl-assignment-learning-head-4i2');

      if (head && head.parentNode) {
        head.parentNode.insertBefore(
          banner,
          head.nextSibling
        );

        panel.insertBefore(
          banner,
          panel.firstChild
        );
      }
    }

    function buildAssignmentWriteControl4I3(card) {

      control.innerHTML =
        '<div class="kl-assignment-write-control-text-4i3">' +
          '<strong>Cập nhật trạng thái bài được giao</strong>' +
          '<span>START sẽ ghi IN_PROGRESS/STARTED nếu gate mở và enum cho phép.</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="kl-assignment-write-actions-4i3">' +
          '<button type="button" class="kl-assignment-write-button-4i3" data-action="assignment-start-write-4i3"' +
            ' data-assignment-id="' + escapeHtml4I3(assignmentId) + '"' +
            ' data-lesson-id="' + escapeHtml4I3(lessonId) + '"' +
          '>' +
            'Ghi bắt đầu học' +
          '</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="kl-assignment-write-button-4i3 is-complete" data-action="assignment-complete-write-4i3"' +
            ' data-assignment-id="' + escapeHtml4I3(assignmentId) + '"' +
            ' data-lesson-id="' + escapeHtml4I3(lessonId) + '"' +
          '>' +
            'Sync hoàn thành' +
          '</button>' +
        '</div>';

    }

    function ensureAssignmentWriteResultBox4I3(panel) {

    function setAssignmentWriteResult4I3(type, title, message, detail) {
      var panel =
        document.querySelector('.kl-assignment-learning-panel-4i2');

      var box =
        panel.querySelector('.kl-assignment-write-result-4i3');

<script>
  /**

        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')

        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');

      var cards =
        document.querySelectorAll('.kl-child-retry-card-4f4b');

        return;
      }

        patchRetryCard4F4C(cards[i]);
      }
    }

    function patchRetryCard4F4C(card) {
      if (!card) return;

        card.querySelector('[data-action="open-retry-lesson-placeholder-4f4b"]') ||
        card.querySelector('[data-action="open-retry-lesson-4f4c"]');

      var responseId =
        card.getAttribute('data-response-id') ||
        button.getAttribute('data-response-id') ||
        '';

      var lessonId =
        card.getAttribute('data-lesson-id') ||
        button.getAttribute('data-lesson-id') ||
        '';

      button.setAttribute(
        'data-action',
        'open-retry-lesson-4f4c'
      );

      button.setAttribute(
        'data-response-id',
        responseId
      );

      button.setAttribute(
        'data-lesson-id',
        lessonId
      );

      button.classList.add(
        'kl-child-retry-routing-4f4c'
      );

      button.textContent =
        'Làm lại bài này';

      var note =
        card.querySelector('.kl-child-retry-note-4f4b');

      if (note && !note.classList.contains('kl-child-retry-routing-feedback-4f4c')) {
        note.classList.add(
          'kl-child-retry-routing-feedback-4f4c'
        );

        note.innerHTML =
          '4F-4C: Bấm nút để mở lại Lesson Player. Không ghi dữ liệu ở bước này.';
      }

    function openRetryLesson4F4C(button) {
      if (!button) return;

      var card =
        button.closest('.kl-child-retry-card-4f4b');

      var responseId =
        button.getAttribute('data-response-id') ||
        (card ? card.getAttribute('data-response-id') : '') ||
        '';

      var lessonId =
        button.getAttribute('data-lesson-id') ||
        (card ? card.getAttribute('data-lesson-id') : '') ||
        '';

      var feedback =
        card
          ? card.querySelector('.kl-child-retry-routing-feedback-4f4c') ||
            card.querySelector('.kl-child-retry-note-4f4b')
          : null;

      if (!responseId && !lessonId) {
        renderRetryRoutingFeedback4F4C(
          feedback,
          false,
          'Thiếu responseId hoặc lessonId trên retry card.'
        );
        return;
      }

      if (
        KIDLEARN_CHILD_RETRY_ROUTING_UI_4F4C.routing[responseId || lessonId]

      }

      if (!feedback) return;

      feedback.classList.add(
        'kl-child-retry-routing-feedback-4f4c'

<script>
  /**
   * KIDLEARN_LESSON_INTERACTION_DRY_RUN_4C5
   * Phase 4C-5 — Lesson Activity Interaction Dry-run
   */

  (function () {
    var KIDLEARN_LESSON_INTERACTION_DRY_RUN_4C5 = {
      phase: '4C-5',
      mode: 'DRY_RUN_ONLY',
      marker: 'KIDLEARN_LESSON_INTERACTION_DRY_RUN_4C5'
    };

    window.KIDLEARN_LESSON_INTERACTION_DRY_RUN_4C5 =
      KIDLEARN_LESSON_INTERACTION_DRY_RUN_4C5;

    function escapeHtml4C5(value) {
      return String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value)
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
    }

    function normalizeText4C5(value) {
      return String(value || '')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase()
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, '')
        .replace(/-/g, '_');
    }
