      var text =
        normalizeText4C5(lessonId);

      if (text.indexOf('TV_') >= 0 || text.indexOf('VIET') >= 0) {
        return 'VIETNAMESE';
      }

      if (text.indexOf('ENG_') >= 0 || text.indexOf('ENGLISH') >= 0) {
        return 'ENGLISH';
      }

      if (text.indexOf('SCI_') >= 0 || text.indexOf('SCIENCE') >= 0) {
        return 'SCIENCE';
      }

      return 'MATH';
    }

    function parseLessonIdFromActivityId4C5(activityId) {
      activityId =
        String(activityId || '');

      var index =
        activityId.indexOf('_ACT_');

      if (index > 0) {
        return activityId.substring(0, index);
      }

      return '';
    }

    function getCurrentLessonId4C5(activityId) {
      var lessonId =
        parseLessonIdFromActivityId4C5(activityId);

      if (lessonId) return lessonId;

      var breadcrumb =
        document.querySelector('.kl-lesson-breadcrumb-4c4');

      if (breadcrumb) {
        return String(breadcrumb.textContent || '').trim();
      }

      return '';
    }

    function detectAnswerMode4C5(activityCard) {
      if (!activityCard) return 'UNKNOWN';

      var answerModeEl =
        activityCard.querySelector('[data-answer-mode]');

      if (answerModeEl) {
        return String(
          answerModeEl.getAttribute('data-answer-mode') || 'UNKNOWN'
        ).trim().toUpperCase();
      }

      if (activityCard.querySelector('.kl-answer-options-4c4')) {
        return 'MULTIPLE_CHOICE';
      }

      if (activityCard.querySelector('.kl-button-input-wrap-4c4')) {
        return 'BUTTON_INPUT';
      }

      if (activityCard.querySelector('.kl-text-input-wrap-4c4')) {
        return 'TEXT_INPUT';
      }

      if (activityCard.querySelector('.kl-handwriting-wrap-4c4')) {
        return 'HANDWRITE_INPUT';
      }

      return 'UNKNOWN';
    }

    function canvasHasInk4C5(canvas) {
      if (!canvas) return false;

      try {
        var ctx =
          canvas.getContext('2d');

        var data =
          ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height).data;

        for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
          var r = data[i];
          var g = data[i + 1];
          var b = data[i + 2];
          var a = data[i + 3];

          if (a > 0 && !(r > 245 && g > 245 && b > 245)) {
            return true;
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        return false;
      }

      return false;
    }

    function collectAnswerPayload4C5(activityId) {
      activityId =
        String(activityId || '');

      var activityCard =
        document.querySelector(
          '.kl-activity-card-4c4[data-activity-id="' +
          activityId.replace(/"/g, '\\"') +
          '"]'
        );

      if (!activityCard) {
        activityCard =
          document.querySelector('.kl-activity-card-4c4');
      }

      var answerMode =
        detectAnswerMode4C5(activityCard);

      var answerText = '';
      var selectedOptionId = '';
      var selectedOptionLabel = '';
      var answerMeta = {};
      var canvasHasInk = false;
      var canvasDataUrlLength = 0;

      if (answerMode === 'MULTIPLE_CHOICE') {
        var selected =
          activityCard
            ? activityCard.querySelector('.kl-answer-option-4c4.is-selected')
            : null;

        if (selected) {
          selectedOptionId =
            selected.getAttribute('data-option-id') || '';

          selectedOptionLabel =
            selected.getAttribute('data-option-label') ||
            selected.textContent ||
            '';

          answerText =
            selectedOptionLabel;
        }
      }

      if (answerMode === 'BUTTON_INPUT') {
        var display =
          document.getElementById('buttonAnswerDisplay4C4');

        answerText =
          display
            ? String(display.textContent || '').trim()
            : '';

        if (
          answerText === 'Con bấm nút để nhập đáp án'
        ) {
          answerText = '';
        }
      }

      if (answerMode === 'TEXT_INPUT') {
        var textInput =
          document.getElementById('textAnswer4C4');

        answerText =
          textInput
            ? String(textInput.value || '').trim()
            : '';
      }

      if (answerMode === 'HANDWRITE_INPUT') {
        var canvas =
          document.getElementById('lessonHandwritingCanvas4C4');

        canvasHasInk =
          canvasHasInk4C5(canvas);

        try {
          canvasDataUrlLength =
            canvas && canvas.toDataURL
              ? String(canvas.toDataURL('image/png') || '').length
              : 0;
        } catch (error) {
          canvasDataUrlLength = 0;
        }

        answerText =
          canvasHasInk
            ? '[HANDWRITING_CANVAS_DRY_RUN]'
            : '';

        answerMeta = {
          canvasHasInk: canvasHasInk,
          canvasDataUrlLength: canvasDataUrlLength,
          note:
            '4C-5 does not upload or store handwriting image.'
        };
      }

      var lessonId =
        getCurrentLessonId4C5(activityId);

      var subjectCode =
        resolveSubjectKeyFromLesson4C5(lessonId);

      return {
        childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
        lessonId: lessonId,
        activityId: activityId,
        subjectCode: subjectCode,
        answerMode: answerMode,
        answerText: answerText,
        selectedOptionId: selectedOptionId,
        selectedOptionLabel: selectedOptionLabel,
        canvasHasInk: canvasHasInk,
        canvasDataUrlLength: canvasDataUrlLength,
        answerMeta: answerMeta
      };
    }

    function ensureDryRunBadge4C5() {
      var player =
        document.querySelector('.kl-lesson-player-4c4');

      if (!player) return null;

      var badge =
        document.getElementById('lessonDryRunBadge4C5');

      if (!badge) {
        badge =
          document.createElement('div');

        badge.id =
          'lessonDryRunBadge4C5';

        badge.className =
          'kl-dryrun-badge-4c5';

        badge.textContent =
          'Dry-run: chưa lưu dữ liệu thật';

        player.insertBefore(badge, player.firstChild);
      }

      return badge;
    }

    function showDryRunFeedback4C5(message, type, detail) {
      ensureDryRunBadge4C5();

      var box =
        document.getElementById('lessonFeedback4C4');

      if (!box) {
        var card =
          document.querySelector('.kl-activity-card-4c4') ||
          document.querySelector('.kl-lesson-step-card-4c4');

        if (card) {
          box =
            document.createElement('div');

          box.id =
            'lessonFeedback4C4';

          card.appendChild(box);
        }
      }

      if (!box) return;

      box.className =
        'kl-lesson-feedback-4c4 kl-dryrun-feedback-4c5';

      if (type === 'success') {
        box.classList.add('is-success');
      } else if (type === 'warning') {
        box.classList.add('is-warning');
      } else {
        box.classList.add('is-info');
      }

      box.innerHTML =
        '<strong>' +
          escapeHtml4C5(message || 'Dry-run hoàn tất.') +
        '</strong>' +
        (
          detail
            ? '<span>' + escapeHtml4C5(detail) + '</span>'
            : ''
        );
    }

    function callDryRunServer4C5(functionName, payload, onSuccess) {
      if (
        typeof google === 'undefined' ||
        !google.script ||
        !google.script.run
      ) {
        showDryRunFeedback4C5(
          'Không gọi được server dry-run.',
          'warning',
          'Thiếu google.script.run trong môi trường hiện tại.'
        );
        return;
      }

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function (response) {
          if (onSuccess) {
            onSuccess(response);
          }
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function (error) {
          showDryRunFeedback4C5(
            'Dry-run chưa thành công.',
            'warning',
            error && error.message
              ? error.message
              : String(error || 'Unknown error')
          );
        })[functionName](payload || {});
    }

    function dryRunStartLesson4C5(lessonId) {
      var subjectCode =
        resolveSubjectKeyFromLesson4C5(lessonId);

      callDryRunServer4C5(
        'kidlearnV3_dryRunStartLesson4C5V3',
        {
          childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
          lessonId: lessonId || '',
          subjectCode: subjectCode
        },
        function () {
          ensureDryRunBadge4C5();
        }
      );
    }

    function dryRunSaveAnswerDraft4C5(activityId) {
      var payload =
        collectAnswerPayload4C5(activityId);

      callDryRunServer4C5(
        'kidlearnV3_dryRunSaveAnswerDraft4C5V3',
        payload,
        function (response) {
          showDryRunFeedback4C5(
            response.childMessage || 'Đã nhận bản nháp dry-run.',
            'info',
            'Không ghi Google Sheet.'
          );
        }
      );
    }

    function dryRunSubmitAnswer4C5(activityId) {
      var payload =
        collectAnswerPayload4C5(activityId);

      callDryRunServer4C5(
        'kidlearnV3_dryRunSubmitAnswer4C5V3',
        payload,
        function (response) {
          showDryRunFeedback4C5(
            response.childMessage || 'Đã gửi câu trả lời dry-run.',
            response.success ? 'success' : 'warning',
            'Không ghi DATA_Responses.'
          );
        }
      );
    }

    function dryRunCompleteLesson4C5() {
      var activityCard =
        document.querySelector('.kl-activity-card-4c4');

      var activityId =
        activityCard
          ? activityCard.getAttribute('data-activity-id') || ''
          : '';

      var lessonId =
        getCurrentLessonId4C5(activityId);

      var subjectCode =
        resolveSubjectKeyFromLesson4C5(lessonId);

      var steps =
        document.querySelectorAll('.kl-lesson-step-card-4c4');

      callDryRunServer4C5(
        'kidlearnV3_dryRunCompleteLesson4C5V3',
        {
          childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
          lessonId: lessonId || '',
          subjectCode: subjectCode,
          completedStepCount: steps ? steps.length : 0
        },
        function (response) {
          showDryRunFeedback4C5(
            response.childMessage || 'Hoàn thành dry-run.',
            'success',
            'Không ghi DATA_LessonProgress.'
          );
        }
      );
    }

    document.addEventListener(
      'click',
      function (event) {
        var actionEl =
          event.target.closest('[data-action]');

        if (!actionEl) return;

        var action =
          actionEl.getAttribute('data-action');

        if (action === 'lesson-open-4c2') {
          var lessonId =
            actionEl.getAttribute('data-lesson-id') || '';

          setTimeout(function () {
            dryRunStartLesson4C5(lessonId);
          }, 900);

          return;
        }

        if (action === 'lesson-submit-demo-4c4') {
          var activityId =
            actionEl.getAttribute('data-activity-id') || '';

          setTimeout(function () {
            dryRunSubmitAnswer4C5(activityId);
          }, 80);

          return;
        }

        if (action === 'lesson-next-step-4c4') {
          var currentActivity =
            document.querySelector('.kl-activity-card-4c4');

          if (currentActivity) {
            dryRunSaveAnswerDraft4C5(
              currentActivity.getAttribute('data-activity-id') || ''
            );
          }

          return;
        }

        if (action === 'lesson-complete-demo-4c4') {
          setTimeout(function () {
            dryRunCompleteLesson4C5();
          }, 80);

          return;
        }
      },
      true
    );

    window.collectAnswerPayload4C5 =
      collectAnswerPayload4C5;

    window.dryRunStartLesson4C5 =
      dryRunStartLesson4C5;

    window.dryRunSaveAnswerDraft4C5 =
      dryRunSaveAnswerDraft4C5;

    window.dryRunSubmitAnswer4C5 =
      dryRunSubmitAnswer4C5;

    window.dryRunCompleteLesson4C5 =
      dryRunCompleteLesson4C5;

    window.showDryRunFeedback4C5 =
      showDryRunFeedback4C5;
  })();
</script>

<script>
  /**
   * KIDLEARN_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4
   * Phase 4C-4 — Lesson Player UI with Answer Input Modes
   */

  (function () {
    var KIDLEARN_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4 = {
      phase: '4C-4',
      uiName: 'LESSON_PLAYER_UI_WITH_ANSWER_INPUT_MODES',
      marker: 'KIDLEARN_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4'
    };

    window.KIDLEARN_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4 =
      KIDLEARN_LESSON_PLAYER_UI_4C4;

    var lessonPlayerState4C4 = {
      context: null,
      currentStepIndex: 0,
      selectedAnswers: {},
      typedAnswers: {},
      buttonAnswers: {},
      handwriting: {},
      currentSubjectKey: 'MATH'
    };

    var themeClassMap4C4 = {
      MATH: 'kl-lesson-theme-blue-4c4',
      VIETNAMESE: 'kl-lesson-theme-orange-4c4',
      ENGLISH: 'kl-lesson-theme-green-4c4',
      SCIENCE: 'kl-lesson-theme-red-4c4',
      DEFAULT: 'kl-lesson-theme-blue-4c4'
    };

    function normalizeText4C4(value) {
      return String(value || '')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase()
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, '')
        .replace(/-/g, '_');
    }

    function resolveSubjectKey4C4(code, name, lessonId) {
      var text =
        normalizeText4C4(code) +
        ' ' +
        normalizeText4C4(name) +
        ' ' +
        normalizeText4C4(lessonId);

      if (
        text.indexOf('MATH') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('TOAN') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SUB_T') >= 0
      ) {
        return 'MATH';
      }

      if (
        text.indexOf('VIET') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('TIENGVIET') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SUB_TV') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('TV_') >= 0
      ) {
        return 'VIETNAMESE';
      }

      if (
        text.indexOf('ENGLISH') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('TIENGANH') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SUB_E') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('ENG_') >= 0
      ) {
        return 'ENGLISH';
      }

      if (
        text.indexOf('SCIENCE') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('KHOAHOC') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SUB_K') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SUB_S') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SCI_') >= 0
      ) {
        return 'SCIENCE';
      }

      return 'DEFAULT';
    }

    function escapeHtml4C4(value) {
      return String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value)
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
    }

    function safePercent4C4(value) {
      var number = Number(value || 0);
      if (isNaN(number)) number = 0;
      if (number < 0) number = 0;
      if (number > 100) number = 100;
      return Math.round(number);
    }

    function showSubjectDetailScreen4C4() {
      var screens = [
        'childHomeScreen',
        'coursesScreen',
        'subjectDetailScreen',
        'parentHomeScreen',
        'placeholderScreen'
      ];

      for (var i = 0; i < screens.length; i++) {
        var screen =
          document.getElementById(screens[i]);

        if (!screen) continue;

        if (screens[i] === 'subjectDetailScreen') {
          screen.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          screen.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      }

      window.scrollTo({
        top: 0,
        behavior: 'smooth'
      });
    }

    function ensureLessonPlayerRoot4C4() {
      showSubjectDetailScreen4C4();

      var screen =
        document.getElementById('subjectDetailScreen');

      if (!screen) return null;

      screen.innerHTML =
        '<div id="lessonPlayer4C4Root" class="kl-lesson-player-root-4c4"></div>';

      return document.getElementById('lessonPlayer4C4Root');
    }

    function setLessonPlayerLoading4C4(subjectKey) {
      var root =
        ensureLessonPlayerRoot4C4();

      if (!root) return;

      var themeClass =
        themeClassMap4C4[subjectKey] ||
        themeClassMap4C4.DEFAULT;

      root.innerHTML =
        '<section class="kl-lesson-player-4c4 ' + themeClass + '">' +
          '<div class="kl-lesson-loading-4c4">' +
            '<div class="kl-spinner-4c4"></div>' +
            '<strong>Đang mở bài học...</strong>' +
            '<p>Chờ một chút nhé.</p>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</section>';
    }

    function setLessonPlayerError4C4(message) {
      var root =
        ensureLessonPlayerRoot4C4();

      if (!root) return;

      root.innerHTML =
        '<section class="kl-lesson-player-4c4 kl-lesson-theme-blue-4c4">' +
          '<div class="kl-lesson-error-4c4">' +
            '<strong>Chưa mở được bài học</strong>' +
            '<p>' + escapeHtml4C4(message || 'Vui lòng thử lại.') + '</p>' +
            '<button class="kl-secondary-btn" data-action="lesson-back-subject-4c4">Quay lại môn học</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</section>';
    }

    function openLessonPlayer4C4(lessonId, subjectKey) {
      subjectKey =
        subjectKey ||
        lessonPlayerState4C4.currentSubjectKey ||
        resolveSubjectKey4C4('', '', lessonId);

      if (subjectKey === 'DEFAULT') {
        subjectKey = 'MATH';
      }

      lessonPlayerState4C4.currentSubjectKey =
        subjectKey;

      setLessonPlayerLoading4C4(subjectKey);

      if (
        typeof google === 'undefined' ||
        !google.script ||
        !google.script.run
      ) {
        setLessonPlayerError4C4(
          'Không tìm thấy google.script.run trong môi trường hiện tại.'
        );
        return;
      }

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function (response) {
          renderLessonPlayer4C4(response);
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function (error) {
          setLessonPlayerError4C4(
            error && error.message
              ? error.message
              : String(error || 'Unknown error')
          );
        })
        .kidlearnV3_getLessonPlayerContext4C3V3({
          lessonId: lessonId || '',
          subjectCode: subjectKey
        });
    }

    function renderLessonPlayer4C4(response) {
      if (!response || response.success !== true || !response.context) {
        setLessonPlayerError4C4(
          response && response.errors
            ? response.errors.join(' | ')
            : 'Lesson Player context không hợp lệ.'
        );
        return;
      }

      lessonPlayerState4C4.context =
        response.context;

      lessonPlayerState4C4.currentStepIndex =
        response.context.player &&
        response.context.player.progress
          ? Number(response.context.player.progress.currentStepIndex || 0)
          : 0;

      lessonPlayerState4C4.selectedAnswers = {};
      lessonPlayerState4C4.typedAnswers = {};
      lessonPlayerState4C4.buttonAnswers = {};
      lessonPlayerState4C4.handwriting = {};

      renderCurrentLessonStep4C4();
    }

    function renderCurrentLessonStep4C4() {
      var context =
        lessonPlayerState4C4.context;

      if (!context || !context.player) {
        setLessonPlayerError4C4('Không có dữ liệu bài học.');
        return;
      }

      var player =
        context.player;

      var subjectKey =
        context.subjectKey ||
        lessonPlayerState4C4.currentSubjectKey ||
        'MATH';

      lessonPlayerState4C4.currentSubjectKey =
        subjectKey;

      var theme =
        context.subjectTheme || {};

      var steps =
        player.playerSteps || [];

      var currentIndex =
        lessonPlayerState4C4.currentStepIndex;

      if (currentIndex < 0) currentIndex = 0;
      if (currentIndex >= steps.length) currentIndex = steps.length - 1;
      if (currentIndex < 0) currentIndex = 0;

      lessonPlayerState4C4.currentStepIndex =
        currentIndex;

      var currentStep =
        steps[currentIndex] || null;

      var themeClass =
        themeClassMap4C4[subjectKey] ||
        themeClassMap4C4.DEFAULT;

      var root =
        document.getElementById('lessonPlayer4C4Root');

      if (!root) {
        root =
          ensureLessonPlayerRoot4C4();
      }

      if (!root) return;

      root.innerHTML =
        '<section class="kl-lesson-player-4c4 ' + themeClass + '" style="' + buildLessonThemeStyle4C4(theme) + '">' +
          renderLessonHeader4C4(player, context, currentIndex, steps.length) +
          renderLessonStepBody4C4(player, currentStep, currentIndex) +
          renderLessonFooter4C4(currentIndex, steps.length) +
        '</section>';

      initCurrentStepAfterRender4C4();
    }

    function buildLessonThemeStyle4C4(theme) {
      return [
        '--lesson-primary:' + (theme.primary || '#2F80ED'),
        '--lesson-pastel:' + (theme.pastel || '#EFF6FF'),
        '--lesson-border:' + (theme.border || '#BFDBFE'),
        '--lesson-text:' + (theme.text || '#1D4ED8'),
        '--lesson-gradient:' + (theme.gradient || 'linear-gradient(135deg,#2F80ED,#38BDF8)')
      ].join(';');
    }

    function renderLessonHeader4C4(player, context, currentIndex, totalSteps) {
      var percent =
        totalSteps > 0
          ? Math.round(((currentIndex + 1) / totalSteps) * 100)
          : 0;

      var breadcrumb =
        player.breadcrumb || [];

      var crumbHtml =
        breadcrumb.map(function (item) {
          return '<span>' + escapeHtml4C4(item.label || '') + '</span>';
        }).join('<em>/</em>');

      return (
        '<header class="kl-lesson-header-4c4">' +
          '<div>' +
            '<div class="kl-lesson-breadcrumb-4c4">' +
              crumbHtml +
            '</div>' +
            '<h2>' + escapeHtml4C4(player.title || 'Bài học') + '</h2>' +
            '<p>' + escapeHtml4C4(player.subtitle || '') + '</p>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="kl-lesson-header-actions-4c4">' +
            '<button class="kl-secondary-btn kl-lesson-back-btn-4c4" data-action="lesson-back-subject-4c4">Quay lại môn học</button>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="kl-lesson-progress-wrap-4c4">' +
            '<div class="kl-lesson-progress-row-4c4">' +
              '<span>Bước ' + escapeHtml4C4(currentIndex + 1) + '/' + escapeHtml4C4(totalSteps || 1) + '</span>' +
              '<strong>' + escapeHtml4C4(percent) + '%</strong>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="kl-lesson-progress-track-4c4">' +
              '<div class="kl-lesson-progress-fill-4c4" style="width:' + safePercent4C4(percent) + '%"></div>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</header>'
      );
    }

    function renderLessonStepBody4C4(player, step, currentIndex) {
      if (!step) {
        return (
          '<main class="kl-lesson-step-card-4c4">' +
            '<h3>Chưa có nội dung bài học</h3>' +
            '<p>Bài học này sẽ được cập nhật sau.</p>' +
          '</main>'
        );
      }

      if (step.stepType === 'CONTENT_BLOCK') {
        var block =
          findBlockById4C4(player.blocks || [], step.refId);

        return renderContentBlock4C4(block, currentIndex);
      }

      if (step.stepType === 'ACTIVITY') {
        var activity =
          findActivityById4C4(player.activities || [], step.refId);

        return renderActivity4C4(activity, currentIndex);
      }

      return (
        '<main class="kl-lesson-step-card-4c4">' +
          '<h3>' + escapeHtml4C4(step.title || 'Bước học') + '</h3>' +
          '<p>Loại nội dung này sẽ được hỗ trợ sau.</p>' +
        '</main>'
      );
    }

    function renderContentBlock4C4(block, currentIndex) {
      block =
        block || {};

      return (
        '<main class="kl-lesson-step-card-4c4 kl-content-block-4c4">' +
          '<div class="kl-lesson-step-kicker-4c4">Nội dung bài học</div>' +
          '<div class="kl-content-layout-4c4">' +
            '<div>' +
              '<h3>' + escapeHtml4C4(block.title || 'Cùng học nhé') + '</h3>' +
              '<p>' + escapeHtml4C4(block.content || 'Nội dung đang được chuẩn bị.') + '</p>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="kl-content-illustration-4c4">' +
              renderIllustration4C4(block.illustrationHint || '') +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</main>'
      );
    }

    function renderIllustration4C4(hint) {
      var subjectKey =
        lessonPlayerState4C4.currentSubjectKey ||
        'MATH';

      var emojiMap = {
        MATH: '🔢',

        SCIENCE: '🧪'
      };

      return (

    function renderActivity4C4(activity, currentIndex) {
      activity =
        activity || {};

      var mode =
        String(activity.answerMode || activity.activityType || 'MULTIPLE_CHOICE')
          .trim()
          .toUpperCase();

      var inputHtml = '';

      if (mode === 'BUTTON_INPUT') {
        inputHtml =
          renderButtonInput4C4(activity);
      } else if (mode === 'TEXT_INPUT') {
        inputHtml =
          renderTextInput4C4(activity);
      } else if (mode === 'HANDWRITE_INPUT') {
        inputHtml =
          renderHandwritingInput4C4(activity);
      } else {
        inputHtml =
          renderMultipleChoice4C4(activity);
      }

      return (
        '<main class="kl-lesson-step-card-4c4 kl-activity-card-4c4" data-activity-id="' + escapeHtml4C4(activity.activityId || '') + '">' +
          '<div class="kl-lesson-step-kicker-4c4">Hoạt động</div>' +

          inputHtml +

        '</main>'

    function renderMultipleChoice4C4(activity) {

      if (options.length === 0) {
        options = [
          { optionId: 'A', label: 'Đáp án A' },
          { optionId: 'B', label: 'Đáp án B' },
          { optionId: 'C', label: 'Đáp án C' }
        ];
      }

      var html =
        '<div class="kl-answer-options-4c4" data-answer-mode="MULTIPLE_CHOICE">';

        html +=

            'data-option-label="' + escapeHtml4C4(options[i].label || '') + '">' +
            '<span>' + escapeHtml4C4(String.fromCharCode(65 + i)) + '</span>' +
            '<strong>' + escapeHtml4C4(options[i].label || '') + '</strong>' +
          '</button>';
      }

      html +=
        '</div>' +
        '<button class="kl-primary-btn kl-submit-demo-btn-4c4" data-action="lesson-submit-demo-4c4" data-activity-id="' + escapeHtml4C4(activity.activityId || '') + '">' +
          'Trả lời' +
        '</button>';

      return html;
    }

    function renderButtonInput4C4(activity) {
      var config =
        activity.buttonInput || {};

      var buttons =
        config.buttons || ['1', '2', '3', '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9', '0'];

      var activityId =

      var current =

      var html =
        '<div class="kl-button-input-wrap-4c4" data-answer-mode="BUTTON_INPUT">' +
          '<div class="kl-button-answer-display-4c4" id="buttonAnswerDisplay4C4">' +

          '<div class="kl-button-pad-4c4">';

      for (var i = 0; i < buttons.length; i++) {
        html +=
          '<button class="kl-button-key-4c4" ' +

            'data-activity-id="' + escapeHtml4C4(activityId) + '" ' +

          '</button>';
      }

      html +=
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="kl-button-pad-actions-4c4">' +
            '<button class="kl-secondary-btn" data-action="lesson-button-clear-4c4" data-activity-id="' + escapeHtml4C4(activityId) + '">Xóa</button>' +
            '<button class="kl-primary-btn" data-action="lesson-submit-demo-4c4" data-activity-id="' + escapeHtml4C4(activityId) + '">Trả lời</button>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>';

      return html;
    }

    function renderTextInput4C4(activity) {
      var config =
        activity.textInput || {};

      var activityId =

      var value =

      if (config.multiline === false) {
        return (
          '<div class="kl-text-input-wrap-4c4" data-answer-mode="TEXT_INPUT">' +
            '<input class="kl-text-answer-4c4" id="textAnswer4C4" ' +
              'data-activity-id="' + escapeHtml4C4(activityId) + '" ' +
              'maxlength="' + escapeHtml4C4(config.maxLength || 120) + '" ' +
              'placeholder="' + escapeHtml4C4(config.placeholder || 'Con nhập câu trả lời...') + '" ' +
              'value="' + escapeHtml4C4(value) + '">' +
            '<button class="kl-primary-btn kl-submit-demo-btn-4c4" data-action="lesson-submit-demo-4c4" data-activity-id="' + escapeHtml4C4(activityId) + '">Trả lời</button>' +
          '</div>'
        );
      }

      return (
        '<div class="kl-text-input-wrap-4c4" data-answer-mode="TEXT_INPUT">' +
          '<textarea class="kl-text-answer-4c4" id="textAnswer4C4" ' +
            'data-activity-id="' + escapeHtml4C4(activityId) + '" ' +
            'maxlength="' + escapeHtml4C4(config.maxLength || 180) + '" ' +
            'placeholder="' + escapeHtml4C4(config.placeholder || 'Con nhập câu trả lời...') + '">' +
            escapeHtml4C4(value) +
          '</textarea>' +
          '<button class="kl-primary-btn kl-submit-demo-btn-4c4" data-action="lesson-submit-demo-4c4" data-activity-id="' + escapeHtml4C4(activityId) + '">Trả lời</button>' +
        '</div>'
      );
    }

    function renderHandwritingInput4C4(activity) {
      var config =
        activity.handwriting || {};

      var activityId =
        activity.activityId || '';

      return (
        '<div class="kl-handwriting-wrap-4c4" data-answer-mode="HANDWRITE_INPUT">' +
          '<div class="kl-handwriting-toolbar-4c4">' +
            '<span>Viết bằng tay / pen</span>' +
            '<div>' +
              '<button class="kl-secondary-btn" data-action="lesson-handwriting-undo-4c4" data-activity-id="' + escapeHtml4C4(activityId) + '">Hoàn tác</button>' +
              '<button class="kl-secondary-btn" data-action="lesson-handwriting-clear-4c4" data-activity-id="' + escapeHtml4C4(activityId) + '">Xóa</button>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<canvas id="lessonHandwritingCanvas4C4" class="kl-handwriting-canvas-4c4" ' +
            'data-activity-id="' + escapeHtml4C4(activityId) + '" ' +
            'width="' + escapeHtml4C4(config.width || 720) + '" ' +
            'height="' + escapeHtml4C4(config.height || 280) + '">' +
          '</canvas>' +
          '<p class="kl-handwriting-note-4c4">Con có thể dùng tay, chuột hoặc bút cảm ứng để viết. Bước này chưa lưu thật.</p>' +
          '<button class="kl-primary-btn kl-submit-demo-btn-4c4" data-action="lesson-submit-demo-4c4" data-activity-id="' + escapeHtml4C4(activityId) + '">Gửi bài</button>' +
        '</div>'
      );
    }

    function renderLessonFooter4C4(currentIndex, totalSteps) {
      var isFirst =
        currentIndex <= 0;

      var isLast =
        totalSteps <= 0 || currentIndex >= totalSteps - 1;

      return (
        '<footer class="kl-lesson-footer-4c4">' +
          '<button class="kl-secondary-btn" data-action="lesson-prev-step-4c4" ' +
            (isFirst ? 'disabled' : '') +
          '>Quay lại</button>' +
          '<button class="kl-primary-btn" data-action="' + (isLast ? 'lesson-complete-demo-4c4' : 'lesson-next-step-4c4') + '">' +
            (isLast ? 'Hoàn thành demo' : 'Tiếp tục') +
          '</button>' +
        '</footer>'
      );
    }

    function findBlockById4C4(blocks, blockId) {
      for (var i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
        if (String(blocks[i].blockId) === String(blockId)) {
          return blocks[i];
        }
      }

      return null;
    }

    function findActivityById4C4(activities, activityId) {
      for (var i = 0; i < activities.length; i++) {
        if (String(activities[i].activityId) === String(activityId)) {
          return activities[i];
        }
      }

      return null;
    }

    function findCurrentActivity4C4(activityId) {
      var context =
        lessonPlayerState4C4.context;

      var activities =
        context && context.player
          ? context.player.activities || []
          : [];

      return findActivityById4C4(activities, activityId);
    }

    function showFeedback4C4(message, type) {
      var box =
        document.getElementById('lessonFeedback4C4');

      if (!box) return;

      box.classList.remove('hidden');
      box.classList.remove('is-good', 'is-soft', 'is-info');

      if (type === 'good') {
        box.classList.add('is-good');
      } else if (type === 'soft') {
        box.classList.add('is-soft');
      } else {
        box.classList.add('is-info');
      }

      box.innerHTML =
        escapeHtml4C4(message || 'Con làm tốt lắm!');
    }

    function demoSubmitAnswer4C4(activityId) {
      var activity =
        findCurrentActivity4C4(activityId);

      if (!activity) {
        showFeedback4C4('Chưa tìm thấy hoạt động này.', 'soft');
        return;
      }

      var mode =
        String(activity.answerMode || '').toUpperCase();

      if (mode === 'MULTIPLE_CHOICE') {
        var selected =
          lessonPlayerState4C4.selectedAnswers[activityId];

        if (!selected) {
          showFeedback4C4('Con chọn một đáp án trước nhé.', 'soft');
          return;
        }

        showFeedback4C4('Con đã chọn: ' + selected.label + '. Ở bước sau cô sẽ lưu kết quả.', 'good');
        return;
      }

      if (mode === 'BUTTON_INPUT') {
        var buttonAnswer =
          lessonPlayerState4C4.buttonAnswers[activityId] || '';

        if (!buttonAnswer) {
          showFeedback4C4('Con bấm nút để nhập đáp án trước nhé.', 'soft');
          return;
        }

        showFeedback4C4('Con đã nhập: ' + buttonAnswer + '. Bước này chưa lưu thật.', 'good');
        return;
      }

      if (mode === 'TEXT_INPUT') {
        var input =
          document.getElementById('textAnswer4C4');

        var text =
          input ? String(input.value || '').trim() : '';

        lessonPlayerState4C4.typedAnswers[activityId] =
          text;

        if (!text) {
          showFeedback4C4('Con nhập câu trả lời trước nhé.', 'soft');
          return;
        }

        showFeedback4C4('Con đã nhập câu trả lời. Bước sau sẽ lưu thử ở chế độ dry-run.', 'good');
        return;
      }

      if (mode === 'HANDWRITE_INPUT') {
        var strokes =
          lessonPlayerState4C4.handwriting[activityId] || [];

        if (strokes.length === 0) {
          showFeedback4C4('Con viết hoặc vẽ đáp án trước nhé.', 'soft');
          return;
        }

        showFeedback4C4('Con đã viết bài rồi. Bước này chưa lưu ảnh thật.', 'good');
        return;
      }

      showFeedback4C4('Con làm tốt lắm!', 'good');
    }

    function handleOptionClick4C4(button) {
      var activityId =
        button.getAttribute('data-activity-id') || '';

      var optionId =
        button.getAttribute('data-option-id') || '';

      var label =
        button.getAttribute('data-option-label') || button.textContent || '';

      lessonPlayerState4C4.selectedAnswers[activityId] = {
        optionId: optionId,
        label: label
      };

      var siblings =
        Array.prototype.slice.call(
          button.parentNode.querySelectorAll('.kl-answer-option-4c4')
        );

      siblings.forEach(function (item) {
        item.classList.remove('is-selected');
      });

      button.classList.add('is-selected');

      showFeedback4C4('Đã chọn đáp án. Con bấm “Trả lời” nhé.', 'info');
    }

    function handleButtonKey4C4(button) {
      var activityId =
        button.getAttribute('data-activity-id') || '';

      var value =
        button.getAttribute('data-key-value') || '';

      var current =
        lessonPlayerState4C4.buttonAnswers[activityId] || '';

      lessonPlayerState4C4.buttonAnswers[activityId] =
        current + value;

      var display =
        document.getElementById('buttonAnswerDisplay4C4');

      if (display) {
        display.textContent =
          lessonPlayerState4C4.buttonAnswers[activityId];
      }
    }

    function clearButtonAnswer4C4(activityId) {
      lessonPlayerState4C4.buttonAnswers[activityId] = '';

      var display =
        document.getElementById('buttonAnswerDisplay4C4');

      if (display) {
        display.textContent =
          'Con bấm nút để nhập đáp án';
      }
    }

    function initCurrentStepAfterRender4C4() {
      var canvas =
        document.getElementById('lessonHandwritingCanvas4C4');

      if (canvas) {
        initHandwritingCanvas4C4(canvas);
      }

      var textInput =
        document.getElementById('textAnswer4C4');

      if (textInput) {
        textInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
          var activityId =
            textInput.getAttribute('data-activity-id') || '';

          lessonPlayerState4C4.typedAnswers[activityId] =
            textInput.value || '';
        });
      }
    }

    function initHandwritingCanvas4C4(canvas) {
      var activityId =
        canvas.getAttribute('data-activity-id') || '';

      if (!lessonPlayerState4C4.handwriting[activityId]) {
        lessonPlayerState4C4.handwriting[activityId] = [];
      }

      var ctx =
        canvas.getContext('2d');

      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
      ctx.lineWidth = 5;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#0F172A';

      drawCanvasGuides4C4(canvas, ctx);

      var drawing = false;
      var currentStroke = [];

      function getPoint(event) {
        var rect =
          canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

        return {
          x:
            ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) *
            canvas.width,
          y:
            ((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) *
            canvas.height
        };
      }

      canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        drawing = true;
        currentStroke = [];

        var point =
          getPoint(event);

        currentStroke.push(point);

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(point.x, point.y);

        if (canvas.setPointerCapture) {
          canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
        }
      });

      canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', function (event) {
        if (!drawing) return;

        event.preventDefault();

        var point =
          getPoint(event);

        currentStroke.push(point);

        ctx.lineTo(point.x, point.y);
        ctx.stroke();
      });

      canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', function (event) {
        if (!drawing) return;

        event.preventDefault();

        drawing = false;

        if (currentStroke.length > 0) {
          lessonPlayerState4C4.handwriting[activityId].push(currentStroke);
        }

        currentStroke = [];
      });

      canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', function () {
        drawing = false;
        currentStroke = [];
      });
    }

    function drawCanvasGuides4C4(canvas, ctx) {
      ctx.save();

      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

      ctx.strokeStyle = '#E5E7EB';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;

      for (var y = 70; y < canvas.height; y += 70) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, y);
        ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, y);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      ctx.restore();
    }

    function redrawHandwriting4C4(activityId) {
      var canvas =
        document.getElementById('lessonHandwritingCanvas4C4');

      if (!canvas) return;

      var ctx =
        canvas.getContext('2d');

      drawCanvasGuides4C4(canvas, ctx);

      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
      ctx.lineWidth = 5;
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#0F172A';

      var strokes =
        lessonPlayerState4C4.handwriting[activityId] || [];

      for (var i = 0; i < strokes.length; i++) {
        var stroke =
          strokes[i];

        if (!stroke || stroke.length === 0) continue;

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(stroke[0].x, stroke[0].y);

        for (var j = 1; j < stroke.length; j++) {
          ctx.lineTo(stroke[j].x, stroke[j].y);
        }

        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }

    function clearHandwriting4C4(activityId) {
      lessonPlayerState4C4.handwriting[activityId] = [];
      redrawHandwriting4C4(activityId);
    }

    function undoHandwriting4C4(activityId) {
      var strokes =
        lessonPlayerState4C4.handwriting[activityId] || [];

      strokes.pop();

      lessonPlayerState4C4.handwriting[activityId] =
        strokes;

      redrawHandwriting4C4(activityId);
    }

    function nextStep4C4() {
      var context =
        lessonPlayerState4C4.context;

      var steps =
        context && context.player
          ? context.player.playerSteps || []
          : [];

      if (
        lessonPlayerState4C4.currentStepIndex <
        steps.length - 1
      ) {
        lessonPlayerState4C4.currentStepIndex++;
        renderCurrentLessonStep4C4();
      }
    }

    function prevStep4C4() {
      if (lessonPlayerState4C4.currentStepIndex > 0) {
        lessonPlayerState4C4.currentStepIndex--;
        renderCurrentLessonStep4C4();
      }
    }

    function completeDemo4C4() {
      showFeedback4C4(
        'Con đã hoàn thành bản demo bài học. Bước sau mình sẽ làm dry-run để lưu thử.',
        'good'
      );
    }

    function backToSubjectDashboard4C4() {
      var subjectKey =
        lessonPlayerState4C4.currentSubjectKey ||
        'MATH';

      if (typeof window.openSubjectDashboard4C2 === 'function') {
        window.openSubjectDashboard4C2(subjectKey);
        return;
      }

      var courses =
        document.getElementById('coursesScreen');

      var subject =
        document.getElementById('subjectDetailScreen');

      if (subject) subject.classList.add('hidden');
      if (courses) courses.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    /**
     * Override 4C-2 placeholder function.
     */
    window.openLessonFromSubjectDashboard4C2 = function (lessonId) {
      var subjectKey =
        lessonPlayerState4C4.currentSubjectKey ||
        resolveSubjectKey4C4('', '', lessonId);

      openLessonPlayer4C4(lessonId, subjectKey);
    };

    window.openLessonPlayer4C4 =
      openLessonPlayer4C4;

    window.renderLessonPlayer4C4 =
      renderLessonPlayer4C4;

    window.demoSubmitAnswer4C4 =
      demoSubmitAnswer4C4;

    document.addEventListener(
      'click',
      function (event) {
        var actionEl =
          event.target.closest('[data-action]');

        if (!actionEl) return;

        var action =
          actionEl.getAttribute('data-action');

        if (action === 'lesson-open-4c2') {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopPropagation();

          if (event.stopImmediatePropagation) {
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();
          }

          var lessonId =
            actionEl.getAttribute('data-lesson-id') || '';

          var subjectKey =
            lessonPlayerState4C4.currentSubjectKey ||
            resolveSubjectKey4C4('', '', lessonId);

          openLessonPlayer4C4(lessonId, subjectKey);
          return;
        }

        if (action === 'lesson-select-option-4c4') {
          event.preventDefault();
          handleOptionClick4C4(actionEl);
          return;
        }

        if (action === 'lesson-button-key-4c4') {
          event.preventDefault();
          handleButtonKey4C4(actionEl);
          return;
        }

        if (action === 'lesson-button-clear-4c4') {
          event.preventDefault();
          clearButtonAnswer4C4(
            actionEl.getAttribute('data-activity-id') || ''
          );
          return;
        }

        if (action === 'lesson-submit-demo-4c4') {
          event.preventDefault();
          demoSubmitAnswer4C4(
            actionEl.getAttribute('data-activity-id') || ''
          );
          return;
        }

        if (action === 'lesson-handwriting-clear-4c4') {
          event.preventDefault();
          clearHandwriting4C4(
            actionEl.getAttribute('data-activity-id') || ''
          );
          return;
        }

        if (action === 'lesson-handwriting-undo-4c4') {
          event.preventDefault();
          undoHandwriting4C4(
            actionEl.getAttribute('data-activity-id') || ''
          );
          return;
        }

        if (action === 'lesson-next-step-4c4') {
          event.preventDefault();
          nextStep4C4();
          return;
        }

        if (action === 'lesson-prev-step-4c4') {
          event.preventDefault();
          prevStep4C4();
          return;
        }

        if (action === 'lesson-complete-demo-4c4') {
          event.preventDefault();
          completeDemo4C4();
          return;
        }

        if (action === 'lesson-back-subject-4c4') {
          event.preventDefault();
          backToSubjectDashboard4C4();
          return;
        }
      },
      true
    );
  })();
</script>

<script>
  /**
   * KIDLEARN_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_UI_4G4
   * Phase 4G-4 — Recent Activity Timeline
   */

  (function () {
    var KIDLEARN_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_UI_4G4 = {
      phase: '4G-4',
      marker: 'KIDLEARN_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_UI_4G4',
      patchTimer: null,
      loading: false,
      context: null,
      currentFilter: 'ALL'
    };

    window.KIDLEARN_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_UI_4G4 =
      KIDLEARN_PARENT_ACTIVITY_TIMELINE_UI_4G4;

    function escapeHtml4G4(value) {
      return String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value)
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
    }

    function patchParentDashboardActivityTimeline4G4() {
      var dashboardPanel =
        document.querySelector('.kl-parent-dashboard-panel-4g2');

      if (!dashboardPanel) {
        return;
      }

      var sectionTitles =
        dashboardPanel.querySelectorAll('.kl-parent-dashboard-section-4g2 h4');

      for (var i = 0; i < sectionTitles.length; i++) {
        var title =
          sectionTitles[i];

        if (
          String(title.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase() ===
          'hoạt động gần đây'
        ) {

        '<div class="kl-parent-assignment-management-head-4j">' +
          '<div>' +
            '<div class="kl-parent-assignment-management-badge-4j">Parent Assignment Management • Read-only</div>' +
            '<h3>Quản lý bài đã giao</h3>' +
            '<p>' +
              escapeHtml4J(child.displayName || 'Bé') +
              ' — theo dõi bài phụ huynh đã giao cho con.' +
            '</p>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<button type="button" class="kl-parent-assignment-management-close-4j" data-action="close-parent-assignment-management-4j">×</button>' +
        '</div>'
      );
    }

    function renderParentAssignmentSummary4J(context) {
      var summary =
        context.contextSummary || {};

      return (
        '<div class="kl-parent-assignment-management-summary-4j">' +
          '<div>' +
            '<span>Tổng bài đã giao</span>' +
            '<strong>' +
              escapeHtml4J(summary.assignmentCount || 0) +
            '</strong>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div>' +
            '<span>Đang học</span>' +
            '<strong>' +
              escapeHtml4J(summary.inProgressCount || 0) +
            '</strong>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div>' +
            '<span>Đã hoàn thành</span>' +
            '<strong>' +
              escapeHtml4J(summary.completedCount || 0) +
            '</strong>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div>' +
            '<span>Quá hạn</span>' +
            '<strong>' +
              escapeHtml4J(summary.overdueCount || 0) +
            '</strong>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>'
      );
    }

    function renderParentAssignmentFilters4J() {
      return (
        '<div class="kl-parent-assignment-management-filters-4j">' +
          '<button type="button" class="is-active" data-action="filter-parent-assignment-4j" data-filter="ALL">Tất cả</button>' +
          '<button type="button" data-action="filter-parent-assignment-4j" data-filter="ACTIVE">Đã giao</button>' +
          '<button type="button" data-action="filter-parent-assignment-4j" data-filter="IN_PROGRESS">Đang học</button>' +
          '<button type="button" data-action="filter-parent-assignment-4j" data-filter="COMPLETED">Đã xong</button>' +
          '<button type="button" data-action="filter-parent-assignment-4j" data-filter="OVERDUE">Quá hạn</button>' +
        '</div>'
      );
    }

    function renderParentAssignmentCards4J(items) {
      items =
        items || [];

      if (!items.length) {
        return (
          '<div class="kl-parent-assignment-management-empty-4j">' +
            '<h4>Chưa có bài đã giao</h4>' +
            '<p>Khi phụ huynh giao bài trong phần Lập kế hoạch học, bài sẽ xuất hiện ở đây.</p>' +
          '</div>'
        );
      }

      var html =
        '<div class="kl-parent-assignment-management-list-4j">';

      for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        html +=
          renderParentAssignmentCard4J(items[i]);
      }

      html +=
        '</div>';

      return html;
    }

    function renderParentAssignmentCard4J(item) {
      var filter =
        'ACTIVE';

      if (item.flags && item.flags.isCompleted) {
        filter = 'COMPLETED';
      } else if (item.flags && item.flags.isOverdue) {
        filter = 'OVERDUE';
      } else if (item.flags && item.flags.isInProgress) {
        filter = 'IN_PROGRESS';
      }

      var progress =
        item.progress || {};

      var progressPercent =
        Math.max(
          0,
          Math.min(
            100,
            Number(progress.progressPercent || 0)
          )
        );

      return (
        '<article class="kl-parent-assignment-management-card-4j" data-filter="' +
          escapeHtml4J(filter) +
        '">' +
          '<div class="kl-parent-assignment-management-card-top-4j">' +
            '<div class="kl-parent-assignment-management-card-icon-4j">' +
              iconForAssignment4J(filter) +
            '</div>' +
            '<div>' +
              '<div class="kl-parent-assignment-management-status-4j is-' +
                escapeHtml4J(filter.toLowerCase()) +
              '">' +
                escapeHtml4J(item.statusLabel || item.status || 'Đã giao') +
              '</div>' +
              '<h4>' +
                escapeHtml4J(item.lessonTitle || item.lessonId || 'Bài học') +
              '</h4>' +
              '<p>' +
                escapeHtml4J(item.subjectName || item.subjectCode || '') +
              '</p>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="kl-parent-assignment-management-meta-4j">' +
            '<span>Mã bài: <strong>' +
              escapeHtml4J(item.lessonId || '') +
            '</strong></span>' +
            '<span>Hạn: <strong>' +
              escapeHtml4J(item.dueDate || 'Chưa đặt') +
            '</strong></span>' +
            '<span>Tiến độ: <strong>' +
              escapeHtml4J(progress.progressLabel || 'Chưa có tiến độ') +
            '</strong></span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="kl-parent-assignment-management-progress-4j">' +
            '<div class="kl-parent-assignment-management-progress-bar-4j">' +
              '<span style="width:' + escapeHtml4J(progressPercent) + '%"></span>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<small>' +
              escapeHtml4J(progressPercent) +
              '% hoàn thành</small>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="kl-parent-assignment-management-readonly-4j">' +
            'Read-only: không xóa, không hủy, không reset tiến độ.' +
          '</div>' +
        '</article>'
      );
    }

    function iconForAssignment4J(filter) {
      if (filter === 'COMPLETED') return '✅';
      if (filter === 'OVERDUE') return '⏰';
      if (filter === 'IN_PROGRESS') return '🚀';
      return '📘';
    }

    function renderParentAssignmentReadOnlyNote4J() {
      return (
        '<div class="kl-parent-assignment-management-note-4j">' +
          '<strong>Chế độ an toàn MVP</strong>' +
          '<p>4J chỉ cho phụ huynh xem bài đã giao. Không xóa assignment, không sửa tiến độ, không sửa câu trả lời của bé.</p>' +
        '</div>'
      );
    }

    function applyParentAssignmentFilter4J(filter) {
      filter =
        String(filter || 'ALL').toUpperCase();

      var buttons =
        Array.prototype.slice.call(
          document.querySelectorAll(
            '.kl-parent-assignment-management-filters-4j button'
          )
        );

      for (var i = 0; i < buttons.length; i++) {
        var buttonFilter =
          String(buttons[i].getAttribute('data-filter') || 'ALL').toUpperCase();

        if (buttonFilter === filter) {
          buttons[i].classList.add('is-active');
        } else {
          buttons[i].classList.remove('is-active');
        }
      }

      var cards =
        Array.prototype.slice.call(
          document.querySelectorAll(
            '.kl-parent-assignment-management-card-4j'
          )
        );

      for (var j = 0; j < cards.length; j++) {
        var cardFilter =
          String(cards[j].getAttribute('data-filter') || 'ACTIVE').toUpperCase();

        if (filter === 'ALL' || cardFilter === filter) {
          cards[j].style.display = '';
        } else {
          cards[j].style.display = 'none';
        }
      }
    }

    function closeParentAssignmentManagement4J() {
      var existing =
        document.querySelector(
          '.kl-parent-assignment-management-overlay-4j'
        );

      if (existing && existing.parentNode) {
        existing.parentNode.removeChild(existing);
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener(
      'click',
      function (event) {
        var actionEl =
          event.target.closest
            ? event.target.closest('[data-action]')
            : null;

        if (!actionEl) {
          return;
        }

        var action =
          actionEl.getAttribute('data-action');

        if (action === 'open-parent-assignment-management-4j') {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopPropagation();
          openParentAssignmentManagement4J();
          return;
        }

        if (action === 'close-parent-assignment-management-4j') {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopPropagation();
          closeParentAssignmentManagement4J();
          return;
        }

        if (action === 'filter-parent-assignment-4j') {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopPropagation();
          applyParentAssignmentFilter4J(
            actionEl.getAttribute('data-filter') || 'ALL'
          );
          return;
        }
      },
      true
    );

    function scheduleEnsureParentAssignmentManagement4J() {
      if (KIDLEARN_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MANAGEMENT_UI_4J.timer) {
        return;
      }

      KIDLEARN_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MANAGEMENT_UI_4J.timer =
        setTimeout(function () {
          KIDLEARN_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MANAGEMENT_UI_4J.timer =
            null;

          KIDLEARN_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MANAGEMENT_UI_4J.attempts +=
            1;

          ensureParentAssignmentManagementEntry4J();

          if (
            !document.querySelector(
              '.kl-parent-assignment-management-entry-4j'
            ) &&
            KIDLEARN_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MANAGEMENT_UI_4J.attempts <
              KIDLEARN_PARENT_ASSIGNMENT_MANAGEMENT_UI_4J.maxAttempts
          ) {
            scheduleEnsureParentAssignmentManagement4J();
          }
        }, 700);
    }

    var observer4J =
      new MutationObserver(function () {
        scheduleEnsureParentAssignmentManagement4J();
      });

    observer4J.observe(
      document.documentElement,
      {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true
      }
    );

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
      document.addEventListener(
        'DOMContentLoaded',
        scheduleEnsureParentAssignmentManagement4J
      );
    } else {
      scheduleEnsureParentAssignmentManagement4J();
    }

    window.ensureParentAssignmentManagementEntry4J =
      ensureParentAssignmentManagementEntry4J;

    window.openParentAssignmentManagement4J =
      openParentAssignmentManagement4J;

    window.renderParentAssignmentManagementPanel4J =
      renderParentAssignmentManagementPanel4J;

    window.applyParentAssignmentFilter4J =
      applyParentAssignmentFilter4J;
  })();
</script>

<script>
  /**
   * KIDLEARN_PARENT_DASHBOARD_UI_4G2
   * Phase 4G-2 — Parent Dashboard UI Overview
   */

  (function () {
    var KIDLEARN_PARENT_DASHBOARD_UI_4G2 = {
      phase: '4G-2',
      marker: 'KIDLEARN_PARENT_DASHBOARD_UI_4G2',
      contextLoaded: false,
      contextLoading: false,
      context: null,
      injectTimer: null,
      panelOpen: false
    };

    window.KIDLEARN_PARENT_DASHBOARD_UI_4G2 =
      KIDLEARN_PARENT_DASHBOARD_UI_4G2;

    function escapeHtml4G2(value) {
      return String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value)
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
    }

    function isLikelyParentView4G2() {
      var bodyText =
        document.body ? document.body.innerText || '' : '';

      var upper =
        bodyText.toUpperCase();

      if (
        upper.indexOf('LICH_KHE') !== -1 &&
        upper.indexOf('PHỤ HUYNH') === -1 &&
        upper.indexOf('PARENT') === -1
      ) {
        return false;
      }

      if (
        upper.indexOf('PARENT') !== -1 ||
        upper.indexOf('PHỤ HUYNH') !== -1 ||
        upper.indexOf('BÀI VIẾT TAY CHỜ DUYỆT') !== -1 ||
        document.querySelector('.kl-parent-review-entry-4e5b')
      ) {
        return true;
      }

      return false;
    }

    function loadParentDashboardContext4G2(callback, force) {
      if (
        KIDLEARN_PARENT_DASHBOARD_UI_4G2.contextLoaded &&
        !force
      ) {
        if (callback) callback();
        return;
      }

      if (
        KIDLEARN_PARENT_DASHBOARD_UI_4G2.contextLoading
      ) {
        if (callback) {
          setTimeout(callback, 600);
        }
        return;
      }

      if (
        typeof google === 'undefined' ||
        !google.script ||
        !google.script.run
      ) {
        KIDLEARN_PARENT_DASHBOARD_UI_4G2.contextLoaded = true;
        KIDLEARN_PARENT_DASHBOARD_UI_4G2.context = {
          success: true,
          parentDashboard: {
            title: 'Dashboard phụ huynh',
            child: { displayName: 'Bé' },
            dashboardSummary: {},
            overviewToday: {},
            progressBySubject: { items: [] },
            reviewSummary: {},
            retrySummary: {},
            recentActivities: { items: [] }
          }
        };

<script>
  /**
   * KIDLEARN_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_UI_4C2
   * Phase 4C-2 — Subject Theme Map + Subject Dashboard UI
   */

  (function () {
    var KIDLEARN_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_UI_4C2 = {
      phase: '4C-2',
      uiName: 'SUBJECT_THEME_MAP_AND_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_UI',
      marker: 'KIDLEARN_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_UI_4C2'
    };

    window.KIDLEARN_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_UI_4C2 =
      KIDLEARN_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_UI_4C2;

    var subjectThemeClassMap4C2 = {
      MATH: 'kl-subject-theme-blue-4c2',
      VIETNAMESE: 'kl-subject-theme-orange-4c2',
      ENGLISH: 'kl-subject-theme-green-4c2',
      SCIENCE: 'kl-subject-theme-red-4c2',
      DEFAULT: 'kl-subject-theme-blue-4c2'
    };

    function normalizeText4C2(value) {
      return String(value || '')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase()
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, '')
        .replace(/-/g, '_');
    }

    function resolveSubjectKey4C2(value, name) {
      var text =
        normalizeText4C2(value) + ' ' + normalizeText4C2(name);

      if (
        text.indexOf('MATH') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('TOAN') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SUB_T') >= 0
      ) {
        return 'MATH';
      }

      if (
        text.indexOf('VIET') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('TIENGVIET') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SUB_TV') >= 0
      ) {
        return 'VIETNAMESE';
      }

      if (
        text.indexOf('ENGLISH') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('TIENGANH') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SUB_E') >= 0
      ) {
        return 'ENGLISH';
      }

      if (
        text.indexOf('SCIENCE') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('KHOAHOC') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SUB_K') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SUB_S') >= 0
      ) {
        return 'SCIENCE';
      }

      return 'DEFAULT';
    }

    function resolveSubjectCodeFromInput4C2(subjectInput) {
      if (!subjectInput) return 'MATH';

      if (typeof subjectInput === 'string') {
        return resolveSubjectKey4C2(subjectInput, '');
      }

      return resolveSubjectKey4C2(
        subjectInput.subjectCode ||
          subjectInput.subjectKey ||
          subjectInput.subjectId ||
          subjectInput.code ||
          '',
        subjectInput.subjectName ||
          subjectInput.name ||
          subjectInput.title ||
          ''
      );
    }

    function escapeHtml4C2(value) {
      return String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value)
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
    }

    function safePercent4C2(value) {
      var number = Number(value || 0);
      if (isNaN(number)) number = 0;
      if (number < 0) number = 0;
      if (number > 100) number = 100;
      return Math.round(number);
    }

    function getSubjectAssetSvg4C2(subjectKey) {
      var assets =
        window.KIDLEARN_SUBJECT_ASSETS_4B2R4 || {};

      var asset =
        assets[subjectKey] ||
        assets.DEFAULT ||
        null;

      return asset && asset.svg ? asset.svg : '';
    }

    function applySubjectIcon4C2(iconEl, subjectKey) {
      if (!iconEl) return;

      var svg =
        getSubjectAssetSvg4C2(subjectKey);

      if (svg) {
        iconEl.innerHTML = svg;
        iconEl.classList.add('has-svg-4b2r4');
      }
    }

    function showScreen4C2(screenId) {
      var screens = [
        'childHomeScreen',
        'coursesScreen',
        'subjectDetailScreen',
        'parentHomeScreen',
        'placeholderScreen'
      ];

      for (var i = 0; i < screens.length; i++) {
        var screen =
          document.getElementById(screens[i]);

        if (!screen) continue;

        if (screens[i] === screenId) {
          screen.classList.remove('hidden');
        } else {
          screen.classList.add('hidden');
        }
      }

      html +=

    function renderAnswerModeChips4C2(modes) {

          '</span>';

    function openLessonFromSubjectDashboard4C2(lessonId) {

      if (!message && root) {
        message =
          document.createElement('div');

        message.id =
          'lessonPlaceholderMessage4C2';

        message.className =
          'kl-lesson-placeholder-message-4c2';

        root.insertBefore(message, root.firstChild);
      }

      if (message) {
        message.innerHTML =
          '<strong>Lesson Player sẽ mở ở 4C-4.</strong>' +
          '<span> Bài đã chọn: ' +
          escapeHtml4C2(lessonId || 'bài học') +
          '. Ở 4C-3 mình sẽ chuẩn bị context bài học trước.</span>';
      }
    }

    function openReviewFromSubjectDashboard4C2() {
      var firstReview =
        document.querySelector(
          '#subjectDashboard4C2Root [data-action="lesson-open-4c2"]'
        );

      if (firstReview) {
        openLessonFromSubjectDashboard4C2(
          firstReview.getAttribute('data-lesson-id') || ''
        );
      }
    }

    function applySubjectThemeClassesToCourseCards4C2() {
      var cards =
        Array.prototype.slice.call(
          document.querySelectorAll('[data-subject-card]')
        );

      cards.forEach(function (card) {
        var code =
          card.getAttribute('data-subject-code') ||
          card.getAttribute('data-code') ||
          '';

        var titleEl =
          card.querySelector('h3');

        var title =
          titleEl ? titleEl.textContent || '' : '';

        var key =
          resolveSubjectKey4C2(code, title);

        card.classList.remove(
          'subject-blue',
          'subject-purple',
          'subject-pink',
          'subject-green',
          'subject-orange',
          'subject-red'
        );

        if (key === 'MATH') {
          card.classList.add('subject-blue');
        } else if (key === 'VIETNAMESE') {
          card.classList.add('subject-orange');
        } else if (key === 'ENGLISH') {
          card.classList.add('subject-green');
        } else if (key === 'SCIENCE') {
          card.classList.add('subject-red');
        } else {
          card.classList.add('subject-blue');
        }
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
      var actionEl =
        event.target.closest('[data-action]');

      if (!actionEl) return;

      var action =
        actionEl.getAttribute('data-action');

      if (action === 'lesson-open-4c2') {
        event.preventDefault();
        openLessonFromSubjectDashboard4C2(
          actionEl.getAttribute('data-lesson-id') || ''
        );
      }

      if (action === 'review-open-4c2') {
        event.preventDefault();
        openReviewFromSubjectDashboard4C2();
      }
    });

    var originalOpenSubjectDetail4B =
      window.openSubjectDetail4B;

    window.openSubjectDashboard4C2 =
      openSubjectDashboard4C2;

    window.renderSubjectDashboard4C2 =
      renderSubjectDashboard4C2;

    window.openLessonFromSubjectDashboard4C2 =
      openLessonFromSubjectDashboard4C2;

    window.applySubjectThemeClassesToCourseCards4C2 =
      applySubjectThemeClassesToCourseCards4C2;

    window.openSubjectDetail4B = function (subjectInput) {
      openSubjectDashboard4C2(subjectInput);
    };

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      applySubjectThemeClassesToCourseCards4C2();

      setTimeout(applySubjectThemeClassesToCourseCards4C2, 300);
      setTimeout(applySubjectThemeClassesToCourseCards4C2, 900);
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function () {
      setTimeout(applySubjectThemeClassesToCourseCards4C2, 120);
    }, true);
  })();
</script>

<script>
  /**
   * KIDLEARN_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_PATCH_4C2P
   * Phase 4C-2P — Subject Dashboard Routing + Theme Patch
   *
   * Purpose:
   * - Recolor subject cards on Home and Courses.
   * - Force subject card clicks to open real 4C-2 Subject Dashboard.
   * - Prevent old 4B placeholder screen from showing.
   */

  (function () {
    var PATCH_MARKER =
      'KIDLEARN_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_PATCH_4C2P';

    var SUBJECT_THEME_CLASS_4C2P = {
      MATH: 'subject-blue',
      VIETNAMESE: 'subject-orange',
      ENGLISH: 'subject-green',
      SCIENCE: 'subject-red',
      DEFAULT: 'subject-blue'
    };

    function normalizeText4C2P(value) {
      return String(value || '')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase()
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, '')
        .replace(/-/g, '_');
    }

    function resolveSubjectKey4C2P(code, name) {
      var text =
        normalizeText4C2P(code) + ' ' + normalizeText4C2P(name);

      if (
        text.indexOf('MATH') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('TOAN') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SUB_T') >= 0
      ) {
        return 'MATH';
      }

      if (
        text.indexOf('VIET') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('TIENGVIET') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SUB_TV') >= 0
      ) {
        return 'VIETNAMESE';
      }

      if (
        text.indexOf('ENGLISH') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('TIENGANH') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SUB_E') >= 0
      ) {
        return 'ENGLISH';
      }

      if (
        text.indexOf('SCIENCE') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('KHOAHOC') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SUB_K') >= 0 ||
        text.indexOf('SUB_S') >= 0
      ) {
        return 'SCIENCE';
      }

      return 'DEFAULT';
    }

    function getCardSubjectKey4C2P(card) {
      if (!card) return 'DEFAULT';

      var code =
        card.getAttribute('data-subject-code') ||
        card.getAttribute('data-code') ||
        card.getAttribute('data-subject-key') ||
        '';

      var titleEl =
        card.querySelector('h3, h4, strong');

      var title =
        titleEl ? titleEl.textContent || '' : card.textContent || '';

      return resolveSubjectKey4C2P(code, title);
    }

    function applySubjectThemeToCard4C2P(card) {
      if (!card) return;

      var key =
        getCardSubjectKey4C2P(card);

      card.classList.remove(
        'subject-blue',
        'subject-purple',
        'subject-pink',
        'subject-green',
        'subject-orange',
        'subject-red'
      );

      card.classList.add(
        SUBJECT_THEME_CLASS_4C2P[key] ||
        SUBJECT_THEME_CLASS_4C2P.DEFAULT
      );

      card.setAttribute('data-subject-card', '1');
      card.setAttribute('data-subject-code', key);

      var buttons =
        card.querySelectorAll('button, a, [role="button"]');

      for (var i = 0; i < buttons.length; i++) {
        buttons[i].setAttribute(
          'data-kidlearn-open-subject-4c2p',
          key
        );
      }
    }

    function applySubjectThemeToAllCards4C2P() {
      var cards =
        Array.prototype.slice.call(
          document.querySelectorAll(
            '.kl-subject-card-4b, [data-subject-card]'
          )
        );

      for (var i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
        applySubjectThemeToCard4C2P(cards[i]);
      }
    }

    function prepareSubjectDetailScreen4C2P() {
      var screen =
        document.getElementById('subjectDetailScreen');

      if (!screen) return;

      screen.classList.add('kl-4c2p-real-dashboard-active');

      /**
       * Xóa placeholder cũ 4B để dashboard 4C-2 hiện sạch.
       */
      screen.innerHTML =
        '<div id="subjectDashboard4C2Root" class="kl-subject-dashboard-root-4c2"></div>';
    }

    function routeSubjectClick4C2P(subjectKey) {
      subjectKey =
        subjectKey || 'MATH';

      prepareSubjectDetailScreen4C2P();

      if (typeof window.openSubjectDashboard4C2 === 'function') {
        window.openSubjectDashboard4C2(subjectKey);
        return;
      }

      console.warn(
        PATCH_MARKER +
        ': missing window.openSubjectDashboard4C2'
      );
    }

    function interceptSubjectCardClick4C2P(event) {
      var target =
        event.target.closest(
          '[data-kidlearn-open-subject-4c2p], .kl-subject-card-4b, [data-subject-card]'
        );

      if (!target) return;

      /**
       * Không chặn click bên trong Subject Dashboard,
       * vì trong đó còn lesson cards và review buttons.
       */
      if (target.closest('#subjectDashboard4C2Root')) {
        return;
      }

      var card =
        target.closest('.kl-subject-card-4b, [data-subject-card]') ||
        target;

      var key =
        target.getAttribute('data-kidlearn-open-subject-4c2p') ||
        getCardSubjectKey4C2P(card);

      if (!key || key === 'DEFAULT') {
        return;
      }

      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();

      if (event.stopImmediatePropagation) {
        event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      }

      routeSubjectClick4C2P(key);
    }

    /**
     * Override function cũ nếu UI 4B gọi trực tiếp function này.
     */
    window.openSubjectDetail4B = function (subjectInput) {
      var key = 'MATH';

      if (typeof subjectInput === 'string') {
        key =
          resolveSubjectKey4C2P(subjectInput, '');
      } else if (subjectInput) {
        key =
          resolveSubjectKey4C2P(
            subjectInput.subjectCode ||
              subjectInput.subjectKey ||
              subjectInput.subjectId ||
              subjectInput.code ||
              '',
            subjectInput.subjectName ||
              subjectInput.name ||
              subjectInput.title ||
              ''
          );
      }

      routeSubjectClick4C2P(key);
    };

    document.addEventListener(
      'click',
      interceptSubjectCardClick4C2P,
      true
    );

    function startSubjectCardObserver4C2P() {
      var app =
        document.getElementById('kidlearnApp') ||
        document.body;

      if (!app || typeof MutationObserver === 'undefined') {
        return;
      }

      var scheduled = false;

      var observer =
        new MutationObserver(function () {
          if (scheduled) return;

          scheduled = true;

          setTimeout(function () {
            scheduled = false;
            applySubjectThemeToAllCards4C2P();
          }, 80);
        });

      observer.observe(app, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
      });
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      applySubjectThemeToAllCards4C2P();
      startSubjectCardObserver4C2P();

      setTimeout(applySubjectThemeToAllCards4C2P, 250);
      setTimeout(applySubjectThemeToAllCards4C2P, 800);
      setTimeout(applySubjectThemeToAllCards4C2P, 1500);
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function () {
      setTimeout(applySubjectThemeToAllCards4C2P, 120);
    }, true);

    window.KIDLEARN_SUBJECT_DASHBOARD_PATCH_4C2P = {
      marker: PATCH_MARKER,
      phase: '4C-2P',
      routeSubjectClick4C2P: routeSubjectClick4C2P,
      applySubjectThemeToAllCards4C2P:
        applySubjectThemeToAllCards4C2P
    };
  })();
</script>
