<script>
  <!--
    KIDLEARN V3 QA MARKER
    Phase 4D-6P
    UI Write Gate Stability Patch
  -->
  
  /**
   * KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6
   * Phase 4D-6P — UI Controlled Write Gate Stability Patch
   *
   * Fix:
   * - Không gọi server liên tục trong MutationObserver.
   * - Không gây vòng lặp DOM mutation -> refresh gate -> mutation.
   * - Chỉ refresh gate status khi Lesson Player xuất hiện lần đầu.
   * - Submit/Complete vẫn đi qua write gate.
   */

  (function () {
    var KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6 = {
      phase: '4D-6P',
      marker: 'KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6',
      gateMode: 'GATE_CLOSED_DRY_RUN_ONLY',
      statusLoaded: false,
      statusLoading: false,
      lastStatusRefreshAt: 0,
      badgeInserted: false
    };

    window.KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6 =
      KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6;

    function escapeHtml4D6(value) {
      return String(value === null || value === undefined ? '' : value)
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
    }

    function normalizeText4D6(value) {
      return String(value || '')
        .trim()
        .toUpperCase()
        .normalize('NFD')
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, '')
        .replace(/-/g, '_');
    }

    function resolveSubjectKey4D6(lessonId) {
      var text = normalizeText4D6(lessonId);

      if (text.indexOf('TV_') >= 0 || text.indexOf('VIET') >= 0) {
        return 'VIETNAMESE';
      }

      if (text.indexOf('ENG_') >= 0 || text.indexOf('ENGLISH') >= 0) {
        return 'ENGLISH';
      }

      if (text.indexOf('SCI_') >= 0 || text.indexOf('SCIENCE') >= 0) {
        return 'SCIENCE';
      }

      return 'MATH';
    }

    function getLessonIdFromActivityId4D6(activityId) {
      activityId = String(activityId || '');

      var index = activityId.indexOf('_ACT_');

      if (index > 0) {
        return activityId.substring(0, index);
      }

      return '';
    }

    function getCurrentActivityCard4D6(activityId) {
      if (activityId) {
        var selector =
          '.kl-activity-card-4c4[data-activity-id="' +
          String(activityId).replace(/"/g, '\\"') +
          '"]';

        var found = document.querySelector(selector);

        if (found) return found;
      }

      return document.querySelector('.kl-activity-card-4c4');
    }

    function detectAnswerMode4D6(activityCard) {
      if (!activityCard) return 'UNKNOWN';

      if (activityCard.querySelector('.kl-answer-options-4c4')) {
        return 'MULTIPLE_CHOICE';
      }

      if (activityCard.querySelector('.kl-button-input-wrap-4c4')) {
        return 'BUTTON_INPUT';
      }

      if (activityCard.querySelector('.kl-text-input-wrap-4c4')) {
        return 'TEXT_INPUT';
      }

      if (activityCard.querySelector('.kl-handwriting-wrap-4c4')) {
        return 'HANDWRITE_INPUT';
      }

      return 'UNKNOWN';
    }

    function canvasHasInk4D6(canvas) {
      if (!canvas) return false;

      try {
        var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        var data = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height).data;

        for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
          var r = data[i];
          var g = data[i + 1];
          var b = data[i + 2];
          var a = data[i + 3];

          if (a > 0 && !(r > 245 && g > 245 && b > 245)) {
            return true;
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        return false;
      }

      return false;
    }

    function collectAnswerPayloadForWriteGate4D6(activityId) {
      if (
        window.collectAnswerPayload4C5 &&
        typeof window.collectAnswerPayload4C5 === 'function'
      ) {
        var base = window.collectAnswerPayload4C5(activityId);

        base.progressPercent = getCurrentProgressPercent4D6();
        base.currentStepIndex = getCurrentStepIndex4D6();
        base.startedAt = getOrCreateLessonStartedAt4D6();

        return base;
      }

      var activityCard = getCurrentActivityCard4D6(activityId);
      var answerMode = detectAnswerMode4D6(activityCard);

      var answerText = '';
      var selectedOptionId = '';
      var selectedOptionLabel = '';
      var canvasHasInk = false;
      var canvasDataUrlLength = 0;

      if (answerMode === 'MULTIPLE_CHOICE') {
        var selected =
          activityCard
            ? activityCard.querySelector('.kl-answer-option-4c4.is-selected')
            : null;

        if (selected) {
          selectedOptionId = selected.getAttribute('data-option-id') || '';
          selectedOptionLabel =
            selected.getAttribute('data-option-label') ||
            selected.textContent ||
            '';
          answerText = selectedOptionLabel;
        }
      }

      if (answerMode === 'BUTTON_INPUT') {
        var display = document.getElementById('buttonAnswerDisplay4C4');

        answerText = display ? String(display.textContent || '').trim() : '';

        if (answerText === 'Con bấm nút để nhập đáp án') {
          answerText = '';
        }
      }

      if (answerMode === 'TEXT_INPUT') {
        var input = document.getElementById('textAnswer4C4');
        answerText = input ? String(input.value || '').trim() : '';
      }

      if (answerMode === 'HANDWRITE_INPUT') {
        var canvas = document.getElementById('lessonHandwritingCanvas4C4');

        canvasHasInk = canvasHasInk4D6(canvas);

        try {
          canvasDataUrlLength =
            canvas && canvas.toDataURL
              ? String(canvas.toDataURL('image/png') || '').length
              : 0;
        } catch (error) {
          canvasDataUrlLength = 0;
        }

        answerText = canvasHasInk ? '[HANDWRITING_CAPTURED_4D6]' : '';
      }

      var lessonId = getLessonIdFromActivityId4D6(activityId);

      return {
        childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
        lessonId: lessonId,
        activityId: activityId,
        subjectCode: resolveSubjectKey4D6(lessonId),
        answerMode: answerMode,
        answerText: answerText,
        selectedOptionId: selectedOptionId,
        selectedOptionLabel: selectedOptionLabel,
        expectedAnswer: '',
        canvasHasInk: canvasHasInk,
        canvasDataUrlLength: canvasDataUrlLength,
        progressPercent: getCurrentProgressPercent4D6(),
        currentStepIndex: getCurrentStepIndex4D6(),
        startedAt: getOrCreateLessonStartedAt4D6()
      };
    }

    function getCurrentProgressPercent4D6() {
      var text = document.querySelector('.kl-lesson-progress-row-4c4');

      if (!text) return 50;

      var raw = String(text.textContent || '');
      var match = raw.match(/(\d+)\s*%/);

      if (match) {
        return Number(match[1]) || 50;
      }

      return 50;
    }

    function getCurrentStepIndex4D6() {
      var current = document.querySelector('.kl-lesson-step-card-4c4');

      if (!current) return 0;

      var text = String(current.textContent || '');
      var match = text.match(/Bước\s+(\d+)/i);

      if (match) {
        return Number(match[1]) || 0;
      }

      return 0;
    }

    function getOrCreateLessonStartedAt4D6() {
      if (!window.KIDLEARN_4D6_LESSON_STARTED_AT) {
        window.KIDLEARN_4D6_LESSON_STARTED_AT = new Date().toISOString();
      }

      return window.KIDLEARN_4D6_LESSON_STARTED_AT;
    }

    function getCurrentLessonIdForComplete4D6() {
      var activityCard = document.querySelector('.kl-activity-card-4c4');

      var activityId =
        activityCard
          ? activityCard.getAttribute('data-activity-id') || ''
          : '';

      return getLessonIdFromActivityId4D6(activityId);
    }

    function buildCompletePayload4D6() {
      var lessonId = getCurrentLessonIdForComplete4D6();
      var startedAt = getOrCreateLessonStartedAt4D6();
      var now = new Date();
      var startDate = new Date(startedAt);

      var durationSeconds =
        Math.max(
          1,
          Math.round((now.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / 1000)
        );

      var steps = document.querySelectorAll('.kl-lesson-step-card-4c4');

      return {
        sessionId: window.KIDLEARN_4D6_SESSION_ID || '',
        childId: 'CHD_V2_CHILD_DEFAULT',
        lessonId: lessonId,
        subjectCode: resolveSubjectKey4D6(lessonId),
        completedStepCount: steps ? steps.length : 0,
        startedAt: startedAt,
        completedAt: now.toISOString(),
        durationSeconds: durationSeconds
      };
    }

    function ensureWriteGateBadge4D6() {
      var player = document.querySelector('.kl-lesson-player-4c4');

      if (!player) return null;

      var badge = document.getElementById('lessonWriteGateBadge4D6');

      if (!badge) {
        badge = document.createElement('div');
        badge.id = 'lessonWriteGateBadge4D6';
        badge.className = 'kl-write-gate-badge-4d6 is-dryrun';
        badge.textContent = 'Gate: Dry-run only';

        player.insertBefore(badge, player.firstChild);
      }

      updateWriteGateBadge4D6();

      return badge;
    }

    function updateWriteGateBadge4D6() {
      var badge = document.getElementById('lessonWriteGateBadge4D6');

      if (!badge) return;

      var mode = KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6.gateMode;

      var nextClass =
        mode === 'OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED'
          ? 'kl-write-gate-badge-4d6 is-real'
          : 'kl-write-gate-badge-4d6 is-dryrun';

      var nextText =
        mode === 'OPEN_DEV_CONTROLLED'
          ? 'Gate: DEV real write đang mở'
          : 'Gate: Dry-run only';

      if (badge.className !== nextClass) {
        badge.className = nextClass;
      }

      if (badge.textContent !== nextText) {
        badge.textContent = nextText;
      }
    }

    function showWriteGateFeedback4D6(message, type, detail) {
      ensureWriteGateBadge4D6();

      var box = document.getElementById('lessonFeedback4C4');

      if (!box) {
        var card =
          document.querySelector('.kl-activity-card-4c4') ||
          document.querySelector('.kl-lesson-step-card-4c4');

        if (card) {
          box = document.createElement('div');
          box.id = 'lessonFeedback4C4';
          card.appendChild(box);
        }
      }

      if (!box) return;

      var className = 'kl-write-gate-feedback-4d6';

      if (type === 'real') {
        className += ' is-real';
      } else if (type === 'error') {
        className += ' is-error';
      } else {
        className += ' is-dryrun';
      }

      box.className = className;

      box.innerHTML =
        '<strong>' +
          escapeHtml4D6(message || '') +
        '</strong>' +
        (
          detail
            ? '<span>' + escapeHtml4D6(detail) + '</span>'
            : ''
        );
    }

    function refreshWriteGateStatus4D6(force) {
      var now = Date.now();

      if (
        !force &&
        KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6.statusLoaded
      ) {
        updateWriteGateBadge4D6();
        return;
      }

      if (
        !force &&
        now - KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6.lastStatusRefreshAt < 5000
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6.statusLoading) {
        return;
      }

      if (
        typeof google === 'undefined' ||
        !google.script ||
        !google.script.run
      ) {
        return;
      }

      KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6.statusLoading = true;
      KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6.lastStatusRefreshAt = now;

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function (response) {
          KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6.statusLoading = false;
          KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6.statusLoaded = true;

          if (response && response.gateMode) {
            KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6.gateMode =
              response.gateMode;
          }

          updateWriteGateBadge4D6();
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function () {
          KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6.statusLoading = false;
        })
        .kidlearnV3_getUiControlledWriteGate4D6StatusV3();
    }

    function callWriteGateServer4D6(functionName, payload, onSuccess) {
      if (
        typeof google === 'undefined' ||
        !google.script ||
        !google.script.run
      ) {
        showWriteGateFeedback4D6(
          'Không gọi được server write gate.',
          'error',
          'Thiếu google.script.run trong môi trường hiện tại.'
        );
        return;
      }

      showWriteGateFeedback4D6(
        'Đang gửi qua write gate...',
        'dryrun',
        'Hệ thống đang kiểm tra chế độ ghi dữ liệu.'
      );

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function (response) {
          if (response && response.gateMode) {
            KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6.gateMode =
              response.gateMode;
            KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6.statusLoaded = true;
            updateWriteGateBadge4D6();
          }

          if (onSuccess) {
            onSuccess(response);
          }
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function (error) {
          showWriteGateFeedback4D6(
            'Write gate chưa thành công.',
            'error',
            error && error.message
              ? error.message
              : String(error || 'Unknown error')
          );
        })[functionName](payload || {});
    }

    function submitAnswerThroughWriteGate4D6(activityId) {
      var payload = collectAnswerPayloadForWriteGate4D6(activityId);

      callWriteGateServer4D6(
        'kidlearnV3_submitLessonActivityFromUi4D6V3',
        payload,
        function (response) {
          var isReal =
            response &&
            response.actualSheetWritePerformed === true;

          showWriteGateFeedback4D6(
            response && response.childMessage
              ? response.childMessage
              : 'Đã gửi câu trả lời.',
            isReal ? 'real' : 'dryrun',
            isReal
              ? 'Đã ghi DEV Sheet qua cổng kiểm soát.'
              : 'Gate đang đóng, chưa ghi dữ liệu thật.'
          );
        }
      );
    }

    function completeLessonThroughWriteGate4D6() {
      var payload = buildCompletePayload4D6();

      callWriteGateServer4D6(
        'kidlearnV3_completeLessonFromUi4D6V3',
        payload,
        function (response) {
          var isReal =
            response &&
            response.actualSheetWritePerformed === true;

          showWriteGateFeedback4D6(
            response && response.childMessage
              ? response.childMessage
              : 'Đã hoàn thành bài học.',
            isReal ? 'real' : 'dryrun',
            isReal
              ? 'Đã ghi tiến độ và phiên học vào DEV.'
              : 'Gate đang đóng, hoàn thành chỉ là dry-run.'
          );
        }
      );
    }

    document.addEventListener(
      'click',
      function (event) {
        var actionEl = event.target.closest('[data-action]');

        if (!actionEl) return;

        var action = actionEl.getAttribute('data-action');

        if (action === 'lesson-open-4c2') {
          window.KIDLEARN_4D6_LESSON_STARTED_AT =
            new Date().toISOString();

          setTimeout(function () {
            ensureWriteGateBadge4D6();
            refreshWriteGateStatus4D6(true);
          }, 1200);

          return;
        }

        if (action === 'lesson-submit-demo-4c4') {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopImmediatePropagation();

          var activityId =
            actionEl.getAttribute('data-activity-id') || '';

          submitAnswerThroughWriteGate4D6(activityId);

          return;
        }

        if (action === 'lesson-complete-demo-4c4') {
          event.preventDefault();
          event.stopImmediatePropagation();

          completeLessonThroughWriteGate4D6();

          return;
        }
      },
      true
    );

    /**
     * Stable observer:
     * - Không gọi server trực tiếp mỗi lần DOM thay đổi.
     * - Chỉ thêm badge nếu Lesson Player xuất hiện.
     * - Status refresh có throttle riêng.
     */
    var observerTimer4D6 = null;

    var observer4D6 =
      new MutationObserver(function () {
        if (observerTimer4D6) {
          return;
        }

        observerTimer4D6 =
          setTimeout(function () {
            observerTimer4D6 = null;

            if (document.querySelector('.kl-lesson-player-4c4')) {
              ensureWriteGateBadge4D6();

              if (
                !KIDLEARN_UI_CONTROLLED_WRITE_GATE_4D6.statusLoaded
              ) {
                refreshWriteGateStatus4D6(false);
              }
            }
          }, 800);
      });

    observer4D6.observe(
      document.documentElement,
      {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true
      }
    );

    window.collectAnswerPayloadForWriteGate4D6 =
      collectAnswerPayloadForWriteGate4D6;

    window.submitAnswerThroughWriteGate4D6 =
      submitAnswerThroughWriteGate4D6;

    window.completeLessonThroughWriteGate4D6 =
      completeLessonThroughWriteGate4D6;

    window.showWriteGateFeedback4D6 =
      showWriteGateFeedback4D6;

    window.refreshWriteGateStatus4D6 =
      refreshWriteGateStatus4D6;
  })();
</script>

<style>

  :root {

    --kl-font-body: 'Nunito Sans', 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;

  button,

  }

  .kl-app {
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
  }

    background: rgba(255,255,255,.92);

    font-size: 24px;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(109,93,252,.25);

  .kl-brand-title {

    font-weight: 900;

    color: #ef4444;

  .kl-brand-title span:last-child {
    color: #2563eb;
  }

  .kl-brand-subtitle {
    color: var(--kl-muted);
