  #loginButton {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 20px;
  }

  .kl-hero-card {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6d5dfc, #8b5cf6);
    color: #fff;
    border-radius: 34px;
    padding: 30px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.4fr .6fr;
    gap: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 26px 70px rgba(109,93,252,.28);
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
  }

  .kl-hero-card.parent {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #22c55e);
  }

  .kl-hero-kicker {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 900;
    opacity: .9;
  }

  .kl-hero-card h2 {
    font-size: 34px;
    line-height: 1.15;
    margin: 8px 0 10px;
  }

  .kl-hero-card p {
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 1.65;
    opacity: .92;
  }

  .kl-hero-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-top: 22px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .kl-hero-actions .kl-secondary-btn {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.18);
    color: #fff;
  }

  .kl-hero-illustration {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 180px;
  }

  .kl-bubble {
    position: absolute;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.22);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    border-radius: 999px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  }

  .kl-bubble.big {
    width: 132px;
    height: 132px;
    font-size: 58px;
    right: 16px;
    top: 10px;
  }

  .kl-bubble.mid {
    width: 72px;
    height: 72px;
    font-size: 34px;
    left: 0;
    bottom: 10px;
  }

  .kl-bubble.small {
    width: 54px;
    height: 54px;
    font-size: 26px;
    right: 8px;
    bottom: 2px;
  }

  .kl-stat-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 16px;
    margin: 22px 0;
  }

  .kl-stat-card {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--kl-border);
    border-radius: 24px;
    padding: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(15,23,42,.06);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14px;
  }

  .kl-stat-icon {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    background: #eef2ff;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    font-size: 24px;
  }

  .kl-stat-value {
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .kl-stat-value.small {
    font-size: 18px;
  }

  .kl-stat-label {
    color: var(--kl-muted);
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  .kl-section-head {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 16px;
    align-items: end;
    margin: 24px 0 14px;
  }

  .kl-section-head h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 24px;
  }

  .kl-section-head p {
    margin: 5px 0 0;
    color: var(--kl-muted);
  }

  .kl-subject-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .kl-subject-card {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--kl-border);
    border-radius: 28px;
    padding: 20px;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(15,23,42,.06);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all .18s ease;
  }

  .kl-subject-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgba(15,23,42,.09);
  }

  .kl-subject-top {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: start;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .kl-subject-icon {
    width: 54px;
    height: 54px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    font-size: 28px;
  }

  .subject-blue .kl-subject-icon { background: #dbeafe; }
  .subject-purple .kl-subject-icon { background: #ede9fe; }
  .subject-pink .kl-subject-icon { background: #fce7f3; }
  .subject-green .kl-subject-icon { background: #dcfce7; }

  .kl-subject-card h3 {
    margin: 18px 0 6px;
    font-size: 19px;
  }

  .kl-subject-card p {
    margin: 0;
    color: var(--kl-muted);
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .kl-progress {
    height: 10px;
    background: #f3f4f6;
    border-radius: 999px;
    margin: 16px 0 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .kl-progress span {
    display: block;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--kl-primary);
  }

  .subject-blue .kl-progress span { background: var(--kl-blue); }
  .subject-purple .kl-progress span { background: var(--kl-purple); }
  .subject-pink .kl-progress span { background: var(--kl-pink); }
  .subject-green .kl-progress span { background: var(--kl-green); }

  .kl-subject-meta {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--kl-muted);
  }

  .kl-two-columns {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
    margin-top: 22px;
  }

  .kl-panel {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--kl-border);
    border-radius: 28px;
    padding: 22px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(15,23,42,.06);
  }

  .kl-panel h3 {
    margin: 0 0 14px;
  }

  .kl-panel p {
    color: var(--kl-muted);
    line-height: 1.7;
  }

  .kl-plan-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .kl-plan-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    background: #f9fafb;
    border: 1px solid #f3f4f6;
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 13px;
  }

  .kl-plan-left {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: center;
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  .kl-plan-status {
    color: var(--kl-primary);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .kl-progress-row {
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .kl-progress-row-head {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  .kl-empty-state {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--kl-border);
    border-radius: 32px;
    padding: 44px;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: var(--kl-shadow);
  }

  .kl-empty-icon {
    font-size: 54px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  @media (max-width: 1100px) {
    .kl-subject-grid,
    .kl-stat-grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    .kl-login-card,
    .kl-hero-card,
    .kl-two-columns {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .kl-hero-illustration {
      min-height: 120px;
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    .kl-app {
      display: block;
    }

    .kl-sidebar {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: auto;
      position: relative;
      border-right: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--kl-border);
    }

    .kl-sidebar.mobile-collapsed .kl-profile-mini,
    .kl-sidebar.mobile-collapsed .kl-nav,
    .kl-sidebar.mobile-collapsed .kl-sidebar-bottom {
      display: none;
    }

    .kl-main {
      padding: 14px;
    }

    .kl-header {
      border-radius: 22px;
    }

    .kl-menu-toggle {
      display: block;
    }

    .kl-header-actions {
      display: none;
    }

    .kl-stat-grid,
    .kl-subject-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .kl-login-card {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .kl-login-hero {
      min-height: 240px;
    }

    .kl-large-logo {
      font-size: 34px;
    }

    .kl-hero-card h2 {
      font-size: 26px;
    }
  }

  /**
   * ================================================================
   * KIDLEARN V3 Font Standard - Phase 4A-1D
   * Heading: Be Vietnam Pro
   * Body: Nunito Sans
   * ================================================================
   */

  h1,
  h2,
  h3,
  .kl-brand-title,
  .kl-large-logo,
  .kl-header-kicker,
  .kl-hero-kicker,
  .kl-nav-item,
  .kl-role-btn,
  .kl-primary-btn,
  .kl-secondary-btn,
  .kl-text-btn,
  .kl-pill,
  .kl-stat-value,
  .kl-profile-name,
  .kl-subject-card h3,
  .kl-plan-status {
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
  }

  p,
  .kl-muted,
  .kl-brand-subtitle,
  .kl-profile-grade,
  .kl-stat-label,
  .kl-subject-meta,
  .kl-login-box input,
  .kl-login-box select,
  .kl-panel,
  .kl-plan-item {
    font-family: var(--kl-font-body);
  }

  .kl-brand-title,
  .kl-large-logo,
  .kl-header h1,
  .kl-hero-card h2,
  .kl-section-head h2 {
    letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  }

  .kl-panel p,
  .kl-login-hero p,
  .kl-hero-card p,
  .kl-section-head p {
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  }

  .kl-subject-card p,
  .kl-empty-state p {
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  /**
   * ================================================================
   * KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4B-2 UI Upgrade
   * Child Home + Courses Dashboard
   * ================================================================
   */

  .kl-4b-hero-layout {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(300px, .6fr);
    gap: 18px;
    align-items: stretch;
  }

  .kl-next-lesson-card {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(249,115,22,.16), transparent 36%),
      #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid var(--kl-border);
    border-radius: 34px;
    padding: 24px;
    box-shadow: var(--kl-shadow);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    min-height: 260px;
  }

  .kl-card-kicker {
    color: var(--kl-primary);
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: 13px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: .02em;
  }

  .kl-next-icon {
    width: 70px;
    height: 70px;
    border-radius: 26px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    font-size: 34px;
    background: #eef2ff;
    margin: 18px 0 10px;
  }

  .kl-next-lesson-card h3 {
    margin: 0 0 8px;
    font-size: 22px;
    line-height: 1.25;
  }

  .kl-next-lesson-card p {
    color: var(--kl-muted);
    line-height: 1.55;
    margin: 0 0 18px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .kl-course-summary-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .kl-course-summary-card {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid var(--kl-border);
    border-radius: 26px;
    padding: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(15,23,42,.06);
    display: flex;
    gap: 14px;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .kl-course-summary-icon {
    width: 52px;
    height: 52px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    background: #eef2ff;
    font-size: 25px;
  }

  .kl-course-summary-value {
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-size: 25px;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  }

  .kl-course-summary-label {
    color: var(--kl-muted);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    right: -34px;
    top: -34px;
    width: 104px;
    height: 104px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(109,93,252,.07);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #f8fafc;
    border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
    color: #475569;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 7px 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .subject-blue .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #eff6ff;
    border-color: #bfdbfe;
    color: #1d4ed8;
  }

  .subject-purple .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #f5f3ff;
    border-color: #ddd6fe;
    color: #6d28d9;
  }

  .subject-pink .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #fdf2f8;
    border-color: #fbcfe8;
    color: #be185d;
  }

  .subject-green .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #f0fdf4;
    border-color: #bbf7d0;
    color: #15803d;
  }

  .kl-subject-next {
    margin-top: 12px;
    color: #475569;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .kl-subject-next span {
    color: var(--kl-muted);
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  .kl-subject-cta {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 14px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: #eef2ff;
    color: var(--kl-primary);
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-weight: 900;
    transition: all .18s ease;
  }

  .kl-subject-cta:hover {
    background: var(--kl-primary);
    color: #fff;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }

  .kl-recommended-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .kl-recommended-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    background: #f9fafb;
    border: 1px solid #f3f4f6;
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 13px;
  }

  .kl-recommended-icon {
    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;
    border-radius: 16px;
    background: #eef2ff;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    font-size: 22px;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }

  .kl-recommended-item strong {
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-weight: 900;
    color: #111827;
  }

  .kl-recommended-item p {
    margin: 4px 0 0;
    color: var(--kl-muted);
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.45;
  }

  .kl-course-recommended-panel {
    margin-top: 22px;
  }

  .kl-subject-detail-hero {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6d5dfc, #22c55e);
    border-radius: 34px;
    color: #fff;
    padding: 30px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 220px;
    gap: 20px;
    align-items: center;
    box-shadow: 0 26px 70px rgba(109,93,252,.24);
  }

  .kl-subject-detail-hero .kl-card-kicker {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,.88);
  }

  .kl-subject-detail-hero h2 {
    margin: 8px 0 10px;
    font-size: 36px;
    letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  }

  .kl-subject-detail-hero p {
    margin: 0;
    line-height: 1.65;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .kl-subject-detail-icon {
    width: 160px;
    height: 160px;
    border-radius: 50px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    font-size: 76px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.2);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);
    justify-self: end;
  }

  .kl-subject-detail-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 16px;
    margin-top: 22px;
  }

  .kl-mission-row {
    transition: all .18s ease;
  }

  .kl-mission-row:hover {
    transform: translateX(3px);
    background: #f3f4ff;
  }

  @media (max-width: 1100px) {
    .kl-4b-hero-layout,
    .kl-subject-detail-hero {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .kl-course-summary-grid,
    .kl-subject-detail-grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    .kl-subject-detail-icon {
      justify-self: start;
      width: 120px;
      height: 120px;
      font-size: 56px;
      border-radius: 38px;
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    .kl-course-summary-grid,
    .kl-subject-detail-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .kl-next-lesson-card {
      min-height: auto;
    }

    .kl-subject-detail-hero h2 {
      font-size: 28px;
    }
  }

    /**
   * ================================================================
   * KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4B-2R-2
   * Login Full Screen Revision
   * ================================================================
   */

  .kl-login-fullscreen {
    min-height: 100vh;
    width: 100%;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    padding: 26px;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 12% 12%, rgba(56,189,248,.18), transparent 34%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 88% 78%, rgba(34,197,94,.12), transparent 30%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #eef7ff, #f8fbff 48%, #f0f7ff);
  }

  .kl-login-layout {
    width: min(1180px, 100%);
    min-height: min(720px, calc(100vh - 52px));
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.08fr .92fr;
    gap: 22px;
    align-items: stretch;
  }

  .kl-login-brand-panel,
  .kl-login-form-panel {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
    border: 1px solid rgba(226,232,240,.95);
    border-radius: 38px;
    box-shadow: 0 28px 76px rgba(37,99,235,.14);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .kl-login-brand-panel {
    padding: 34px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 22% 24%, rgba(47,128,237,.18), transparent 30%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 80% 74%, rgba(56,189,248,.18), transparent 32%),
      #ffffff;
  }

  .kl-login-brand-top {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .kl-brand-mark.large {
    width: 62px;
    height: 62px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    font-size: 31px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2f80ed, #38bdf8);
  }

  .kl-login-brand-top .kl-large-logo {
    font-size: 38px;
    line-height: 1;
    color: #1d4ed8;
  }

  .kl-login-brand-top p {
    margin: 7px 0 0;
    color: #64748b;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .kl-login-visual {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 300px;
    margin: 22px 0;
  }

  .kl-login-visual::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 34px 80px;
    border-radius: 52px;
    background:
      linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(47,128,237,.92), rgba(56,189,248,.86));
    box-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(37,99,235,.24);
    transform: rotate(-4deg);
  }

  .kl-login-visual::after {
    content: "KID";
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(-4deg);
    color: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: 78px;
    letter-spacing: -0.06em;
  }

  .kl-login-orbit {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 2;
    width: 72px;
    height: 72px;
    border-radius: 28px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.94);
    border: 1px solid rgba(226,232,240,.95);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    font-size: 34px;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(15,23,42,.11);
  }

  .kl-login-orbit.orb-1 {
    left: 50px;
    top: 32px;
  }

  .kl-login-orbit.orb-2 {
    right: 70px;
    top: 18px;
  }

  .kl-login-orbit.orb-3 {
    left: 86px;
    bottom: 26px;
  }

  .kl-login-orbit.orb-4 {
    right: 46px;
    bottom: 48px;
  }

  .kl-login-brand-note h1 {
    margin: 0 0 10px;
    font-size: 34px;
    line-height: 1.15;
    color: #0f172a;
    letter-spacing: -0.045em;
  }

  .kl-login-brand-note p {
    margin: 0;
    max-width: 520px;
    color: #64748b;
    line-height: 1.7;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .kl-login-form-panel {
    padding: 28px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
  }

  .kl-login-form-panel .kl-login-box {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 440px;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
    background: transparent;
  }

  .kl-login-kicker {
    color: #2f80ed;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-weight: 900;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: .04em;
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .kl-login-form-panel .kl-login-box h2 {
    font-size: 30px;
    line-height: 1.2;
    letter-spacing: -0.045em;
  }

  .kl-login-role-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 12px;
    margin: 18px 0 6px;
  }

  .kl-login-role-card {
    border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 14px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 11px;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-align: left;
    transition: all .18s ease;
  }

  .kl-login-role-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(37,99,235,.12);
  }

  .kl-login-role-card.active {
    border-color: #93c5fd;
    background: #eff6ff;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 38px rgba(47,128,237,.14);
  }

  .kl-login-role-icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: 17px;
    background: #eaf4ff;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    font-size: 23px;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }

  .kl-login-role-card strong {
    display: block;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-weight: 900;
    color: #0f172a;
    font-size: 14px;
  }

  .kl-login-role-card small {
    display: block;
    color: #64748b;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 12px;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  .kl-hidden-select {
    position: absolute;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    height: 0;
    width: 0;
  }

  .kl-login-help {
    margin-top: 14px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    border-radius: 16px;
    background: #f8fafc;
    color: #64748b;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.55;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  @media (max-width: 980px) {
    .kl-login-layout {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      min-height: auto;
    }

    .kl-login-brand-panel {
      min-height: 420px;
    }

    .kl-login-form-panel {
      padding: 28px;
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 620px) {
    .kl-login-fullscreen {
      padding: 14px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .kl-login-brand-panel,
    .kl-login-form-panel {
      border-radius: 28px;
    }

    .kl-login-brand-panel {
      padding: 24px;
      min-height: 360px;
    }

    .kl-login-brand-top .kl-large-logo {
      font-size: 30px;
    }

    .kl-login-visual {
      min-height: 210px;
    }

    .kl-login-visual::before {
      inset: 30px 44px;
      border-radius: 38px;
    }

    .kl-login-visual::after {
      font-size: 52px;
    }

    .kl-login-orbit {
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      font-size: 25px;
    }

    .kl-login-orbit.orb-1 {
      left: 18px;
      top: 28px;
    }

    .kl-login-orbit.orb-2 {
      right: 22px;
      top: 18px;
    }

    .kl-login-orbit.orb-3 {
      left: 36px;
      bottom: 22px;
    }

    .kl-login-orbit.orb-4 {
      right: 22px;
      bottom: 32px;
    }

    .kl-login-brand-note h1 {
      font-size: 25px;
    }

    .kl-login-role-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
  }

    /**
   * ================================================================
   * KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4B-2R-3
   * Blue Design Token Revision
   * ================================================================
   *
   * App identity:
   * - Primary Blue: #2F80ED
   * - Deep Blue: #1D4ED8
   * - Sky Blue: #38BDF8
   * - Soft Blue Background: #EAF4FF
   * - Green Accent: #22C55E
   * - Reward Yellow: #FBBF24
   * - Soft Orange: #FDBA74
   */

  .kl-blue-identity-token {
    --kl-blue-identity-token-marker: #2F80ED;
  }

  :root {
    --kl-primary: #2F80ED;
    --kl-primary-deep: #1D4ED8;
    --kl-primary-soft: #EAF4FF;
    --kl-sky-blue: #38BDF8;
    --kl-soft-blue-bg: #EAF4FF;
    --kl-green-accent: #22C55E;
    --kl-reward-yellow: #FBBF24;
    --kl-soft-orange: #FDBA74;
    --kl-text-dark: #111827;
    --kl-muted: #64748B;
    --kl-blue-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(47,128,237,.18);
  }

  body {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 8% 8%, rgba(56,189,248,.12), transparent 28%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 92% 82%, rgba(47,128,237,.10), transparent 30%),
      #f8fbff;
    color: var(--kl-text-dark);
  }

  .kl-brand-mark,
  .kl-brand-mark.large {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2F80ED, #38BDF8);
    box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(47,128,237,.22);
  }

  .kl-brand-title span:first-child,
  .kl-large-logo,
  .kl-header-kicker,
  .kl-hero-kicker,
  .kl-card-kicker,
  .kl-login-kicker {
    color: var(--kl-primary-deep);
  }

  .kl-primary-btn {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2F80ED, #38BDF8);
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(47,128,237,.22);
  }

  .kl-primary-btn:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 42px rgba(47,128,237,.26);
  }

  .kl-secondary-btn {
    background: #ffffff;
    color: var(--kl-primary-deep);
    border-color: #bfdbfe;
  }

  .kl-secondary-btn:hover {
    background: #eff6ff;
    border-color: #93c5fd;
  }

  .kl-text-btn {
    color: var(--kl-primary-deep);
  }

  .kl-pill {
    background: #ffffff;
    border-color: #dbeafe;
    color: var(--kl-primary-deep);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(47,128,237,.08);
  }

  .kl-nav-item.active {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2F80ED, #38BDF8);
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(47,128,237,.22);
  }

  .kl-role-btn.active {
    background: #EAF4FF;
    color: var(--kl-primary-deep);
    border-color: #bfdbfe;
  }

  .kl-hero-card {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 82% 18%, rgba(255,255,255,.28), transparent 32%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #2F80ED, #38BDF8);
    box-shadow: var(--kl-blue-shadow);
  }

  .kl-hero-card.parent {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 82% 18%, rgba(255,255,255,.24), transparent 32%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #1D4ED8, #22C55E);
  }

  .kl-bubble {
    box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(15,23,42,.16);
  }

  .kl-next-lesson-card {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(56,189,248,.22), transparent 36%),
      radial-gradient(circle at bottom left, rgba(47,128,237,.10), transparent 32%),
      #ffffff;
    border-color: #dbeafe;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(47,128,237,.12);
  }

  .kl-next-icon,
  .kl-course-summary-icon,
  .kl-recommended-icon {
    background: #EAF4FF;
    color: var(--kl-primary-deep);
  }

  .kl-stat-card {
    border-color: #e0f2fe;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(47,128,237,.07);
  }

  .kl-stat-icon {
    background: #EAF4FF;
    color: var(--kl-primary-deep);
  }

  .kl-stat-card:nth-child(1) .kl-stat-icon {
    background: #fffbeb;
    color: #b45309;
  }

  .kl-stat-card:nth-child(2) .kl-stat-icon {
    background: #f0fdf4;
    color: #15803d;
  }

  .kl-stat-card:nth-child(3) .kl-stat-icon {
    background: #eff6ff;
    color: var(--kl-primary-deep);
  }

  .kl-stat-card:nth-child(4) .kl-stat-icon {
    background: #fff7ed;
    color: #c2410c;
  }

  .kl-progress span {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2F80ED, #38BDF8);
  }

  .subject-blue .kl-progress span {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2F80ED, #38BDF8);
  }

  .subject-purple .kl-progress span {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #8b5cf6, #c084fc);
  }

  .subject-pink .kl-progress span {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ec4899, #f9a8d4);
  }

  .subject-green .kl-progress span {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #22C55E, #86efac);
  }

  .subject-blue .kl-subject-icon,
  .subject-blue .kl-login-role-icon {
    background: #EAF4FF;
    color: var(--kl-primary-deep);
  }

  .subject-blue .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #eff6ff;
    border-color: #bfdbfe;
    color: var(--kl-primary-deep);
  }

  .kl-subject-cta {
    background: #EAF4FF;
    color: var(--kl-primary-deep);
  }

  .kl-subject-cta:hover {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2F80ED, #38BDF8);
    color: #ffffff;
  }

  .kl-login-fullscreen {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 10% 10%, rgba(56,189,248,.18), transparent 34%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 90% 76%, rgba(34,197,94,.10), transparent 30%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #EAF4FF, #f8fbff 48%, #eef7ff);
  }

  .kl-login-brand-panel {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 22% 24%, rgba(47,128,237,.18), transparent 30%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 80% 74%, rgba(56,189,248,.18), transparent 32%),
      #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 28px 76px rgba(47,128,237,.14);
  }

  .kl-login-form-panel {
    box-shadow: 0 28px 76px rgba(47,128,237,.12);
  }

  .kl-login-visual::before {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2F80ED, #38BDF8);
    box-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(47,128,237,.24);
  }

  .kl-login-role-card.active {
    border-color: #93c5fd;
    background: #eff6ff;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 38px rgba(47,128,237,.14);
  }

  .kl-login-role-icon {
    background: #EAF4FF;
    color: var(--kl-primary-deep);
  }

  .kl-login-help {
    background: #f8fbff;
    border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
  }

  .kl-subject-detail-hero {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 82% 18%, rgba(255,255,255,.22), transparent 32%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #2F80ED, #22C55E);
    box-shadow: 0 26px 70px rgba(47,128,237,.22);
  }

  .kl-subject-detail-icon {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  }

  .kl-recommended-item {
    background: #f8fbff;
    border-color: #e0f2fe;
  }

  .kl-panel {
    border-color: #e0f2fe;
  }

  .kl-empty-icon {
    background: #EAF4FF;
    color: var(--kl-primary-deep);
  }

    /**
   * KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4B-2R-3
   * Blue Design Token Revision marker
   */

  .kl-blue-identity-token-marker-4b2r3 {
    --kl-blue-identity-token: #2F80ED;
  }

    /**
   * ================================================================
   * KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4B-2R-4
   * Built-in SVG Cute Subject Icons
   * ================================================================
   */

  .kl-asset-svg-4b2r4,
  .kl-svg-subject-icon-4b2r4 {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
  }

  .kl-subject-icon.has-svg-4b2r4 {
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
    padding: 6px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(47,128,237,.10);
  }

  .kl-next-icon.has-svg-4b2r4 {
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #dbeafe;
    padding: 7px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(47,128,237,.10);
  }

  .kl-subject-detail-icon.has-svg-4b2r4 {
    padding: 18px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.24);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.34);
  }

  .kl-subject-detail-icon.has-svg-4b2r4 .kl-asset-svg-4b2r4 {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 14px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.18));
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b:hover .kl-subject-icon.has-svg-4b2r4 {
    transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02);
    box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(47,128,237,.16);
  }

  .kl-subject-icon.has-svg-4b2r4,
  .kl-next-icon.has-svg-4b2r4,
  .kl-subject-detail-icon.has-svg-4b2r4 {
    transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
  }

  .kl-subject-icon.has-svg-4b2r4 svg text,
  .kl-next-icon.has-svg-4b2r4 svg text,
  .kl-subject-detail-icon.has-svg-4b2r4 svg text {
    user-select: none;
  }

  .kl-subject-icon.has-svg-4b2r4 + .kl-subject-badge {
    margin-left: 4px;
  }

  @media (max-width: 620px) {
    .kl-subject-icon.has-svg-4b2r4 {
      padding: 5px;
    }

    .kl-next-icon.has-svg-4b2r4 {
      padding: 6px;
    }

    .kl-subject-detail-icon.has-svg-4b2r4 {
      padding: 14px;
    }
  }

    /**
   * ================================================================
   * KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4B-2R-3P
   * Color Contrast & Pastel Subject Cards Patch
   * contrast-pass-4b2r3p
   * ================================================================
   */

  :root {
    --kl-card-blue-pastel: #EFF6FF;
    --kl-card-blue-border: #BFDBFE;
    --kl-card-blue-strong: #1D4ED8;

    --kl-card-green-pastel: #F0FDF4;
    --kl-card-green-border: #BBF7D0;
    --kl-card-green-strong: #15803D;

    --kl-card-yellow-pastel: #FFFBEB;
    --kl-card-yellow-border: #FDE68A;
    --kl-card-yellow-strong: #B45309;

    --kl-card-purple-pastel: #F5F3FF;
    --kl-card-purple-border: #DDD6FE;
    --kl-card-purple-strong: #6D28D9;

    --kl-card-pink-pastel: #FDF2F8;
    --kl-card-pink-border: #FBCFE8;
    --kl-card-pink-strong: #BE185D;

    --kl-card-orange-pastel: #FFF7ED;
    --kl-card-orange-border: #FED7AA;
    --kl-card-orange-strong: #C2410C;

    --kl-contrast-dark: #0F172A;
    --kl-contrast-white: #FFFFFF;
  }

  /**
   * Hero contrast fix.
   * Lỗi cũ: “Xin chào” xanh trên nền xanh nên khó đọc.
   */
  .kl-hero-card .kl-hero-kicker {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    width: fit-content;
    max-width: 100%;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    background: rgba(15, 23, 42, .22);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .34);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 8px 13px;
    font-weight: 900;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, .18);
  }

  .kl-hero-card h2 {
    color: #FFFFFF;
    text-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(15, 23, 42, .14);
  }

  .kl-hero-card p {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .94);
  }

  /**
   * Hero button contrast fix.
   * Lỗi cũ: secondary hover có thể trắng nền + trắng chữ.
   */
  .kl-hero-card .kl-primary-btn {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    color: #1D4ED8;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .82);
    box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(15, 23, 42, .16);
  }

  .kl-hero-card .kl-primary-btn:hover {
    background: #FFFBEB;
    color: #0F172A;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 44px rgba(15, 23, 42, .20);
  }

  .kl-hero-card .kl-secondary-btn {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .20);
    color: #FFFFFF;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .62);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(15, 23, 42, .10);
  }

  .kl-hero-card .kl-secondary-btn:hover {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    color: #1D4ED8;
    border-color: #FFFFFF;
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(15, 23, 42, .18);
  }

  /**
   * Login role contrast.
   */
  .kl-login-role-card.active {
    border-color: #93C5FD;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EFF6FF, #FFFFFF);
  }

  .kl-login-role-card.active strong {
    color: #1D4ED8;
  }

  /**
   * Subject card pastel backgrounds.
   * Mục tiêu: vui hơn, tăng nhận diện môn học, nhưng không rối mắt.
   */
  .kl-subject-card-4b {
    border-width: 1.5px;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b h3 {
    color: #0F172A;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b p,
  .kl-subject-card-4b .kl-subject-next,
  .kl-subject-card-4b .kl-subject-meta {
    color: #334155;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-blue {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 92% 8%, rgba(56,189,248,.22), transparent 34%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #EFF6FF, #FFFFFF);
    border-color: #BFDBFE;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-blue h3 {
    color: #1D4ED8;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-blue .kl-subject-icon.has-svg-4b2r4,
  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-blue .kl-subject-icon {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border-color: #BFDBFE;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-purple {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 92% 8%, rgba(139,92,246,.18), transparent 34%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #F5F3FF, #FFFFFF);
    border-color: #DDD6FE;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-purple h3 {
    color: #6D28D9;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-purple .kl-subject-icon.has-svg-4b2r4,
  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-purple .kl-subject-icon {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border-color: #DDD6FE;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-pink {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 92% 8%, rgba(236,72,153,.16), transparent 34%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #FDF2F8, #FFFFFF);
    border-color: #FBCFE8;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-pink h3 {
    color: #BE185D;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-pink .kl-subject-icon.has-svg-4b2r4,
  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-pink .kl-subject-icon {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border-color: #FBCFE8;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-green {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 92% 8%, rgba(34,197,94,.18), transparent 34%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #F0FDF4, #FFFFFF);
    border-color: #BBF7D0;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-green h3 {
    color: #15803D;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-green .kl-subject-icon.has-svg-4b2r4,
  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-green .kl-subject-icon {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border-color: #BBF7D0;
  }

  /**
   * Subject CTA contrast by card color.
   */
  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-blue .kl-subject-cta {
    background: #DBEAFE;
    color: #1D4ED8;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-purple .kl-subject-cta {
    background: #EDE9FE;
    color: #6D28D9;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-pink .kl-subject-cta {
    background: #FCE7F3;
    color: #BE185D;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-green .kl-subject-cta {
    background: #DCFCE7;
    color: #15803D;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b .kl-subject-cta:hover {
    background: #0F172A;
    color: #FFFFFF;
  }

  /**
   * Subject badge contrast.
   */
  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-blue .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #DBEAFE;
    color: #1D4ED8;
    border-color: #93C5FD;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-purple .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #EDE9FE;
    color: #6D28D9;
    border-color: #C4B5FD;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-pink .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #FCE7F3;
    color: #BE185D;
    border-color: #F9A8D4;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-green .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #DCFCE7;
    color: #15803D;
    border-color: #86EFAC;
  }

  /**
   * Recommended / plan panels nhẹ hơn nhưng vẫn rõ.
   */
  .kl-panel {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border-color: #DBEAFE;
  }

  .kl-recommended-item,
  .kl-plan-item {
    background: #F8FBFF;
    border-color: #E0F2FE;
  }

  .kl-recommended-item strong {
    color: #0F172A;
  }

  .kl-recommended-item p {
    color: #475569;
  }

  /**
   * Course summary card contrast.
   */
  .kl-course-summary-card {
    background:
      linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFFFF, #F8FBFF);
    border-color: #DBEAFE;
  }

  .kl-course-summary-value {
    color: #0F172A;
  }

  .kl-course-summary-label {
    color: #475569;
  }

  /**
   * Next lesson card contrast.
   */
  .kl-next-lesson-card h3 {
    color: #0F172A;
  }

  .kl-next-lesson-card p {
    color: #475569;
  }

  /**
   * Mobile spacing.
   */
  @media (max-width: 760px) {
    .kl-hero-card .kl-hero-kicker {
      font-size: 13px;
      padding: 7px 11px;
    }

    .kl-hero-card .kl-primary-btn,
    .kl-hero-card .kl-secondary-btn {
      width: 100%;
      justify-content: center;
    }
  }

    /**
   * ================================================================
   * KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4C-2
   * Subject Theme Map + Subject Dashboard UI
   * ================================================================
   */

  .kl-subject-dashboard-marker-4c2 {
    display: none;
  }

  .kl-subject-dashboard-4c2 {
    --subject-primary: #2F80ED;
    --subject-pastel: #EFF6FF;
    --subject-border: #BFDBFE;
    --subject-text: #1D4ED8;
    --subject-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #2F80ED, #38BDF8);

    display: grid;
    gap: 18px;
    margin-top: 18px;
  }

  .kl-subject-theme-blue-4c2 {
    --subject-primary: #2F80ED;
    --subject-pastel: #EFF6FF;
    --subject-border: #BFDBFE;
    --subject-text: #1D4ED8;
    --subject-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #2F80ED, #38BDF8);
  }

  .kl-subject-theme-orange-4c2 {
    --subject-primary: #F97316;
    --subject-pastel: #FFF7ED;
    --subject-border: #FED7AA;
    --subject-text: #C2410C;
    --subject-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #F97316, #FDBA74);
  }

  .kl-subject-theme-green-4c2 {
    --subject-primary: #22C55E;
    --subject-pastel: #F0FDF4;
    --subject-border: #BBF7D0;
    --subject-text: #15803D;
    --subject-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #22C55E, #86EFAC);
  }

  .kl-subject-theme-red-4c2 {
    --subject-primary: #EF4444;
    --subject-pastel: #FEF2F2;
    --subject-border: #FECACA;
    --subject-text: #B91C1C;
    --subject-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #EF4444, #FB7185);
  }

  .kl-subject-loading-4c2,
  .kl-subject-error-4c2 {
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid var(--subject-border);
    border-radius: 26px;
    padding: 26px;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(15, 23, 42, .08);
  }

  .kl-spinner-4c2 {
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 4px solid #e5e7eb;
    border-top-color: var(--subject-primary);
    animation: klSpin4C2 .8s linear infinite;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  @keyframes klSpin4C2 {
    to {
      transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
  }

  .kl-subject-hero-4c2 {
    background: var(--subject-gradient);
    border-radius: 30px;
    padding: 24px;
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(15, 23, 42, .16);
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
  }

  .kl-subject-hero-4c2:after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    right: -40px;
    top: -60px;
    width: 210px;
    height: 210px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  }

  .kl-subject-hero-main-4c2 {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 18px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .kl-subject-hero-icon-4c2 {
    width: 92px;
    height: 92px;
    flex: 0 0 92px;
    border-radius: 28px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
    padding: 9px;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(15,23,42,.16);
  }

  .kl-subject-hero-icon-4c2 svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
  }

  .kl-subject-kicker-4c2 {
    display: inline-flex;
    width: fit-content;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(15,23,42,.22);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);
    padding: 7px 12px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 900;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .kl-subject-hero-4c2 h2 {
    margin: 0;
    color: #ffffff;
    font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 42px);
    letter-spacing: -.03em;
  }

  .kl-subject-hero-4c2 p {
    margin: 8px 0 0;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,.94);
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .kl-subject-hero-actions-4c2 {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-top: 22px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .kl-subject-primary-btn-4c2 {
    background: #ffffff;
    color: var(--subject-text);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.82);
    box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(15,23,42,.16);
  }

  .kl-subject-primary-btn-4c2:hover {
    background: #fff7ed;
    color: #0f172a;
  }

  .kl-subject-secondary-btn-4c2 {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.18);
    color: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.56);
  }

  .kl-subject-secondary-btn-4c2:hover {
    background: #ffffff;
    color: var(--subject-text);
  }

  .kl-subject-progress-wrap-4c2 {
    margin-top: 20px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .kl-subject-progress-row-4c2 {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    font-weight: 900;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .kl-progress-track-4c2 {
    height: 13px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.26);
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .kl-progress-fill-4c2 {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.4);
  }

  .kl-subject-overview-grid-4c2,
  .kl-subject-bottom-grid-4c2 {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.2fr .8fr;
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .kl-next-lesson-panel-4c2,
  .kl-subject-summary-panel-4c2,
  .kl-section-4c2 {
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--subject-border);
    border-radius: 26px;
    padding: 20px;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(15, 23, 42, .07);
  }

  .kl-panel-heading-4c2,
  .kl-section-title-row-4c2 {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .kl-panel-heading-4c2 span,
  .kl-section-title-row-4c2 span {
    color: #64748b;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .kl-panel-heading-4c2 strong {
    color: var(--subject-text);
    background: var(--subject-pastel);
    border: 1px solid var(--subject-border);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .kl-next-lesson-panel-4c2 h3,
  .kl-section-4c2 h3,
  .kl-lesson-group-4c2 h4 {
    margin: 0;
    color: #0f172a;
  }

  .kl-next-lesson-panel-4c2 p {
    color: #475569;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .kl-subject-summary-panel-4c2 {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 12px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff, var(--subject-pastel));
  }

  .kl-subject-summary-item-4c2 {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.76);
    border: 1px solid var(--subject-border);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 16px;
  }

  .kl-subject-summary-item-4c2 strong {
    display: block;
    color: var(--subject-text);
    font-size: 26px;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .kl-subject-summary-item-4c2 span {
    display: block;
    color: #475569;
    font-weight: 800;
    margin-top: 6px;
  }

  .kl-lesson-group-4c2 {
    margin-top: 16px;
  }

  .kl-lesson-grid-4c2 {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 14px;
    margin-top: 12px;
  }

  .kl-lesson-card-4c2 {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--subject-pastel), #ffffff);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--subject-border);
    border-radius: 22px;
    padding: 16px;
    min-height: 190px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
    transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
  }

  .kl-lesson-card-4c2:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(15,23,42,.10);
  }

  .kl-lesson-card-top-4c2 {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    color: var(--subject-text);
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .kl-lesson-status-dot-4c2 {
    width: 11px;
    height: 11px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--subject-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,.74);
  }

  .kl-lesson-card-4c2.is-completed .kl-lesson-status-dot-4c2 {
    background: #22c55e;
  }

  .kl-lesson-card-4c2.is-new .kl-lesson-status-dot-4c2 {
    background: #94a3b8;
  }

  .kl-lesson-card-4c2 h5 {
    margin: 0;
    color: #0f172a;
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.28;
  }

  .kl-lesson-card-4c2 p {
    margin: 0;
    color: #475569;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .kl-mini-progress-4c2 {
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(148,163,184,.22);
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-top: auto;
  }

  .kl-mini-progress-4c2 div {
    height: 100%;
    background: var(--subject-primary);
    border-radius: 999px;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-action-4c2 {
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    background: var(--subject-primary);
    color: #ffffff;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-weight: 900;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-action-4c2:hover {
    background: #0f172a;
  }

  .kl-skill-list-4c2,
  .kl-review-list-4c2 {
    display: grid;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .kl-skill-card-4c2 {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    align-items: center;
    border: 1px solid var(--subject-border);
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 13px;
    background: var(--subject-pastel);
  }

  .kl-skill-card-4c2 strong {
    display: block;
    color: #0f172a;
  }

  .kl-skill-card-4c2 span {
    display: block;
    color: #64748b;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 800;
    margin-top: 3px;
  }

  .kl-skill-card-4c2 em {
    color: var(--subject-text);
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .kl-review-item-4c2 {
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
    border: 1px solid var(--subject-border);
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 13px;
    background: var(--subject-pastel);
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .kl-review-item-4c2:hover {
    background: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(15,23,42,.08);
  }

  .kl-review-item-4c2 strong {
    display: block;
    color: #0f172a;
  }

  .kl-review-item-4c2 span {
    display: block;
    color: #64748b;
    font-weight: 800;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  .kl-answer-mode-preview-4c2 {
    margin-top: 16px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    background: #f8fbff;
    border: 1px dashed var(--subject-border);
    padding: 14px;
  }

  .kl-answer-mode-preview-4c2 h4 {
    margin: 0 0 6px;
    color: #0f172a;
  }

  .kl-answer-mode-preview-4c2 p {
    margin: 0 0 10px;
    color: #475569;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .kl-answer-mode-chip-row-4c2 {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .kl-answer-mode-chip-4c2 {
    display: inline-flex;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid var(--subject-border);
    color: var(--subject-text);
    padding: 7px 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .kl-empty-state-4c2 {
    border-radius: 18px;
    background: #f8fafc;
    border: 1px dashed #cbd5e1;
    padding: 16px;
    color: #64748b;
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  .kl-lesson-placeholder-message-4c2 {
    background: #fffbeb;
    border: 1px solid #fde68a;
    color: #92400e;
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 13px 15px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  .kl-lesson-placeholder-message-4c2 strong {
    color: #78350f;
  }

  /**
   * Course card color remap for 4C decision:
   * Math = blue, Vietnamese = orange, English = green, Science = red.
   */

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-orange {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 92% 8%, rgba(249,115,22,.18), transparent 34%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF7ED, #FFFFFF);
    border-color: #FED7AA;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-orange h3 {
    color: #C2410C;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-orange .kl-subject-icon.has-svg-4b2r4,
  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-orange .kl-subject-icon {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border-color: #FED7AA;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-orange .kl-subject-cta {
    background: #FFEDD5;
    color: #C2410C;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-orange .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #FFEDD5;
    color: #C2410C;
    border-color: #FDBA74;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-red {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 92% 8%, rgba(239,68,68,.16), transparent 34%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #FEF2F2, #FFFFFF);
    border-color: #FECACA;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-red h3 {
    color: #B91C1C;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-red .kl-subject-icon.has-svg-4b2r4,
  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-red .kl-subject-icon {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border-color: #FECACA;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-red .kl-subject-cta {
    background: #FEE2E2;
    color: #B91C1C;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-red .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #FEE2E2;
    color: #B91C1C;
    border-color: #FCA5A5;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-orange .kl-subject-cta:hover,
  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-red .kl-subject-cta:hover {
    background: #0F172A;
    color: #FFFFFF;
  }

  @media (max-width: 980px) {
    .kl-subject-overview-grid-4c2,
    .kl-subject-bottom-grid-4c2 {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .kl-lesson-grid-4c2 {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 620px) {
    .kl-subject-hero-4c2 {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
    }

    .kl-subject-hero-main-4c2 {
      align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .kl-subject-hero-icon-4c2 {
      width: 72px;
      height: 72px;
      flex-basis: 72px;
      border-radius: 22px;
    }

    .kl-subject-hero-actions-4c2 {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .kl-subject-primary-btn-4c2,
    .kl-subject-secondary-btn-4c2 {
      width: 100%;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .kl-lesson-grid-4c2 {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .kl-subject-summary-panel-4c2 {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }
  }

    /**
   * ================================================================
   * KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4C-2P
   * Subject Dashboard Routing + Theme Patch
   * ================================================================
   */

  .kl-subject-dashboard-patch-marker-4c2p {
    display: none;
  }

  /**
   * Home + Courses subject card color enforcement.
   * Fix: Home cards chưa đổi màu theo từng môn.
   */

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-blue {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 92% 8%, rgba(47,128,237,.18), transparent 34%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #EFF6FF, #FFFFFF);
    border-color: #BFDBFE;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-blue h3 {
    color: #1D4ED8;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-orange {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 92% 8%, rgba(249,115,22,.20), transparent 34%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF7ED, #FFFFFF);
    border-color: #FED7AA;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-orange h3 {
    color: #C2410C;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-green {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 92% 8%, rgba(34,197,94,.18), transparent 34%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #F0FDF4, #FFFFFF);
    border-color: #BBF7D0;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-green h3 {
    color: #15803D;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-red {
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 92% 8%, rgba(239,68,68,.18), transparent 34%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, #FEF2F2, #FFFFFF);
    border-color: #FECACA;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-red h3 {
    color: #B91C1C;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-blue .kl-subject-icon,
  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-orange .kl-subject-icon,
  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-green .kl-subject-icon,
  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-red .kl-subject-icon {
    background: #FFFFFF;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-blue .kl-subject-cta {
    background: #DBEAFE;
    color: #1D4ED8;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-orange .kl-subject-cta {
    background: #FFEDD5;
    color: #C2410C;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-green .kl-subject-cta {
    background: #DCFCE7;
    color: #15803D;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-red .kl-subject-cta {
    background: #FEE2E2;
    color: #B91C1C;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-blue .kl-subject-cta:hover,
  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-orange .kl-subject-cta:hover,
  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-green .kl-subject-cta:hover,
  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-red .kl-subject-cta:hover {
    background: #0F172A;
    color: #FFFFFF;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-blue .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #DBEAFE;
    color: #1D4ED8;
    border-color: #93C5FD;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-orange .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #FFEDD5;
    color: #C2410C;
    border-color: #FDBA74;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-green .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #DCFCE7;
    color: #15803D;
    border-color: #86EFAC;
  }

  .kl-subject-card-4b.subject-red .kl-subject-badge {
    background: #FEE2E2;
    color: #B91C1C;
    border-color: #FCA5A5;
  }

  /**
   * Old 4B subject placeholder button contrast fallback.
   * Fix: “Quay lại khóa học” và “Ôn nhanh” bị chìm màu.
   * Nếu patch routing hoạt động đúng thì placeholder cũ sẽ không còn hiện,
   * nhưng vẫn giữ fallback để an toàn.
   */

  .kl-subject-detail-hero .kl-primary-btn,
  .kl-subject-detail-hero .kl-subject-primary-btn-4c2 {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    color: #1D4ED8;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.82);
    box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(15,23,42,.16);
  }

  .kl-subject-detail-hero .kl-primary-btn:hover,
  .kl-subject-detail-hero .kl-subject-primary-btn-4c2:hover {
    background: #FFFBEB;
    color: #0F172A;
  }

  .kl-subject-detail-hero .kl-secondary-btn,
  .kl-subject-detail-hero .kl-subject-secondary-btn-4c2 {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.22);
    color: #FFFFFF;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.64);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.10);
  }

  .kl-subject-detail-hero .kl-secondary-btn:hover,
  .kl-subject-detail-hero .kl-subject-secondary-btn-4c2:hover {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    color: #1D4ED8;
    border-color: #FFFFFF;
  }

  /**
   * Real 4C-2 dashboard visibility.
   */

  #subjectDashboard4C2Root {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .kl-subject-dashboard-root-4c2 {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .kl-4c2p-real-dashboard-active .kl-subject-dashboard-root-4c2 {
    display: block;
  }

  /**
   * 4C-2 dashboard button contrast.
   */

  .kl-subject-hero-4c2 .kl-subject-primary-btn-4c2 {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    color: var(--subject-text);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.84);
    box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(15,23,42,.16);
  }

  .kl-subject-hero-4c2 .kl-subject-primary-btn-4c2:hover {
    background: #FFFBEB;
    color: #0F172A;
  }

  .kl-subject-hero-4c2 .kl-subject-secondary-btn-4c2 {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.22);
    color: #FFFFFF;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.64);
  }

  .kl-subject-hero-4c2 .kl-subject-secondary-btn-4c2:hover {
    background: #FFFFFF;
    color: var(--subject-text);
  }

    /**
   * KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4C-2P
   * Subject Dashboard Routing + Theme Patch marker
   */

  .kl-subject-dashboard-patch-marker-4c2p-confirm {
    --kidlearn-4c2p-marker: "KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4C-2P";
    display: none;
  }

    /**
   * ================================================================
   * KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4C-4
   * Lesson Player UI with Answer Input Modes
   * ================================================================
   */

  .kl-lesson-player-root-4c4 {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .kl-lesson-player-4c4 {
    --lesson-primary: #2F80ED;
    --lesson-pastel: #EFF6FF;
    --lesson-border: #BFDBFE;
    --lesson-text: #1D4ED8;
    --lesson-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #2F80ED, #38BDF8);

    display: grid;
    gap: 18px;
    margin-top: 18px;
  }

  .kl-lesson-theme-blue-4c4 {
    --lesson-primary: #2F80ED;
    --lesson-pastel: #EFF6FF;
    --lesson-border: #BFDBFE;
    --lesson-text: #1D4ED8;
    --lesson-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #2F80ED, #38BDF8);
  }

  .kl-lesson-theme-orange-4c4 {
    --lesson-primary: #F97316;
    --lesson-pastel: #FFF7ED;
    --lesson-border: #FED7AA;
    --lesson-text: #C2410C;
    --lesson-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #F97316, #FDBA74);
  }

  .kl-lesson-theme-green-4c4 {
    --lesson-primary: #22C55E;
    --lesson-pastel: #F0FDF4;
    --lesson-border: #BBF7D0;
    --lesson-text: #15803D;
    --lesson-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #22C55E, #86EFAC);
  }

  .kl-lesson-theme-red-4c4 {
    --lesson-primary: #EF4444;
    --lesson-pastel: #FEF2F2;
    --lesson-border: #FECACA;
    --lesson-text: #B91C1C;
    --lesson-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #EF4444, #FB7185);
  }

  .kl-lesson-loading-4c4,
  .kl-lesson-error-4c4 {
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--lesson-border);
    border-radius: 26px;
    padding: 26px;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(15, 23, 42, .08);
  }

  .kl-spinner-4c4 {
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    border: 4px solid #e5e7eb;
    border-top-color: var(--lesson-primary);
    animation: klSpin4C4 .8s linear infinite;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  @keyframes klSpin4C4 {
    to {
      transform: rotate(360deg);
    }
  }

  .kl-lesson-header-4c4 {
    background: var(--lesson-gradient);
    color: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 30px;
    padding: 24px;
    display: grid;
    gap: 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(15, 23, 42, .16);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .kl-lesson-header-4c4:after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    right: -55px;
    top: -70px;
    width: 230px;
    height: 230px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  }

  .kl-lesson-header-4c4 > * {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .kl-lesson-breadcrumb-4c4 {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 7px;
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .kl-lesson-breadcrumb-4c4 em {
    font-style: normal;
    opacity: .74;
  }

  .kl-lesson-header-4c4 h2 {
    margin: 0;
    color: #ffffff;
    font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 42px);
    letter-spacing: -.03em;
  }

  .kl-lesson-header-4c4 p {
    margin: 8px 0 0;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,.94);
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  .kl-lesson-header-actions-4c4 {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-start;
  }

  .kl-lesson-back-btn-4c4 {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.22);
    color: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.62);
  }

  .kl-lesson-back-btn-4c4:hover {
    background: #ffffff;
    color: var(--lesson-text);
  }

  .kl-lesson-progress-wrap-4c4 {
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  .kl-lesson-progress-row-4c4 {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    font-weight: 900;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .kl-lesson-progress-track-4c4 {
    height: 13px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.26);
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .kl-lesson-progress-fill-4c4 {
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: #ffffff;
  }

  .kl-lesson-step-card-4c4 {
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--lesson-border);
    border-radius: 28px;
    padding: 24px;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(15, 23, 42, .08);
  }

  .kl-lesson-step-kicker-4c4 {
    display: inline-flex;
    width: fit-content;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--lesson-pastel);
    border: 1px solid var(--lesson-border);
    color: var(--lesson-text);
    padding: 7px 12px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 900;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .kl-lesson-step-card-4c4 h3 {
    margin: 0;
    color: #0f172a;
    font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 34px);
    letter-spacing: -.02em;
  }

  .kl-lesson-step-card-4c4 p {
    color: #475569;
    font-weight: 750;
    font-size: 17px;
    line-height: 1.65;
  }

  .kl-content-layout-4c4 {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 220px;
    gap: 22px;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .kl-content-illustration-4c4 {
    min-height: 180px;
    border-radius: 28px;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 70% 15%, rgba(255,255,255,.84), transparent 40%),
      var(--lesson-pastel);
    border: 1px solid var(--lesson-border);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .kl-lesson-emoji-4c4 {
    font-size: 76px;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 14px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.14));
  }

  .kl-activity-prompt-4c4 {
    color: #0f172a !important;
    font-size: 22px !important;
    font-weight: 900 !important;
    line-height: 1.45 !important;
  }

  .kl-activity-instruction-4c4 {
    background: var(--lesson-pastel);
    border: 1px solid var(--lesson-border);
    color: #334155 !important;
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    font-size: 15px !important;
    line-height: 1.45 !important;
  }

  .kl-answer-options-4c4 {
    display: grid;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-top: 16px;
  }

  .kl-answer-option-4c4 {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14px;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--lesson-border);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 16px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, border-color .18s ease;
  }

  .kl-answer-option-4c4:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.08);
  }

  .kl-answer-option-4c4.is-selected {
    background: var(--lesson-pastel);
    border-color: var(--lesson-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(47,128,237,.10);
  }

  .kl-answer-option-4c4 span {
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--lesson-primary);
    color: #ffffff;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .kl-answer-option-4c4 strong {
    color: #0f172a;
    font-size: 17px;
  }

  .kl-button-input-wrap-4c4,
  .kl-text-input-wrap-4c4,
  .kl-handwriting-wrap-4c4 {
    margin-top: 18px;
    display: grid;
    gap: 14px;
  }

  .kl-button-answer-display-4c4 {
    min-height: 58px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    background: var(--lesson-pastel);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--lesson-border);
    color: #0f172a;
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: 900;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0 18px;
  }

  .kl-button-pad-4c4 {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .kl-button-key-4c4 {
    border: 1.5px solid var(--lesson-border);
    background: #ffffff;
    color: var(--lesson-text);
    border-radius: 18px;
    min-height: 54px;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 900;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .kl-button-key-4c4:hover {
    background: var(--lesson-pastel);
    border-color: var(--lesson-primary);
  }

  .kl-button-pad-actions-4c4 {
    display: flex;
    gap: 10px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .kl-text-answer-4c4 {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 58px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--lesson-border);
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #0f172a;
    padding: 15px 16px;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-body);
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 750;
    outline: none;
    resize: vertical;
  }

  textarea.kl-text-answer-4c4 {
    min-height: 128px;
  }

  .kl-text-answer-4c4:focus {
    border-color: var(--lesson-primary);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(47,128,237,.10);
  }

  .kl-handwriting-toolbar-4c4 {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .kl-handwriting-toolbar-4c4 span {
    color: var(--lesson-text);
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .kl-handwriting-toolbar-4c4 div {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .kl-handwriting-canvas-4c4 {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    height: 280px;
    border-radius: 22px;
    border: 2px solid var(--lesson-border);
    background: #ffffff;
    touch-action: none;
    cursor: crosshair;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(15,23,42,.03);
  }

  .kl-handwriting-note-4c4 {
    margin: 0 !important;
    color: #64748b !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
  }

  .kl-submit-demo-btn-4c4 {
    width: fit-content;
  }

  .kl-lesson-feedback-4c4 {
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 13px 15px;
    font-weight: 900;
    margin-top: 14px;
  }

  .kl-lesson-feedback-4c4.is-good {
    background: #ecfdf5;
    border: 1px solid #bbf7d0;
    color: #15803d;
  }

  .kl-lesson-feedback-4c4.is-soft {
    background: #fff7ed;
    border: 1px solid #fed7aa;
    color: #c2410c;
  }

  .kl-lesson-feedback-4c4.is-info {
    background: #eff6ff;
    border: 1px solid #bfdbfe;
    color: #1d4ed8;
  }

  .kl-lesson-footer-4c4 {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--lesson-border);
    border-radius: 24px;
    padding: 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(15,23,42,.06);
  }

  .kl-lesson-footer-4c4 button:disabled {
    opacity: .45;
    cursor: not-allowed;
  }

  @media (max-width: 880px) {
    .kl-content-layout-4c4 {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .kl-content-illustration-4c4 {
      min-height: 140px;
    }

    .kl-button-pad-4c4 {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 620px) {
    .kl-lesson-header-4c4,
    .kl-lesson-step-card-4c4 {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
    }

    .kl-lesson-footer-4c4 {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .kl-lesson-footer-4c4 button,
    .kl-submit-demo-btn-4c4,
    .kl-button-pad-actions-4c4 button {
      width: 100%;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .kl-handwriting-canvas-4c4 {
      height: 240px;
    }
  }

    /**
   * ================================================================
   * KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4C-5
   * Lesson Activity Interaction Dry-run
   * ================================================================
   */

  .kl-dryrun-badge-4c5 {
    display: inline-flex;
    width: fit-content;
    max-width: 100%;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: #FFFBEB;
    border: 1px solid #FDE68A;
    color: #92400E;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 900;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(146, 64, 14, .08);
  }

  .kl-dryrun-badge-4c5:before {
    content: "🧪";
  }

  .kl-dryrun-feedback-4c5 {
    display: grid;
    gap: 4px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    margin-top: 14px;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-body);
    font-weight: 850;
  }

  .kl-dryrun-feedback-4c5 strong {
    display: block;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-weight: 950;
  }

  .kl-dryrun-feedback-4c5 span {
    display: block;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 800;
    opacity: .86;
  }

  .kl-dryrun-feedback-4c5.is-success {
    background: #ECFDF5;
    border: 1px solid #BBF7D0;
    color: #15803D;
  }

  .kl-dryrun-feedback-4c5.is-warning {
    background: #FFF7ED;
    border: 1px solid #FED7AA;
    color: #C2410C;
  }

  .kl-dryrun-feedback-4c5.is-info {
    background: #EFF6FF;
    border: 1px solid #BFDBFE;
    color: #1D4ED8;
  }

    /**
   * ================================================================
   * KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4D-6
   * UI Controlled Write Gate
   * ================================================================
   */

  .kl-write-gate-badge-4d6 {
    display: inline-flex;
    width: fit-content;
    max-width: 100%;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 950;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, .08);
  }

  .kl-write-gate-badge-4d6:before {
    content: "🔐";
  }

  .kl-write-gate-badge-4d6.is-dryrun {
    background: #FFFBEB;
    border: 1px solid #FDE68A;
    color: #92400E;
  }

  .kl-write-gate-badge-4d6.is-real {
    background: #ECFDF5;
    border: 1px solid #BBF7D0;
    color: #15803D;
  }

  .kl-write-gate-feedback-4d6 {
    display: grid;
    gap: 4px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    margin-top: 14px;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-body);
    font-weight: 850;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
  }

  .kl-write-gate-feedback-4d6 strong {
    display: block;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-weight: 950;
  }

  .kl-write-gate-feedback-4d6 span {
    display: block;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 800;
    opacity: .86;
  }

  .kl-write-gate-feedback-4d6.is-dryrun {
    background: #EFF6FF;
    border-color: #BFDBFE;
    color: #1D4ED8;
  }

  .kl-write-gate-feedback-4d6.is-real {
    background: #ECFDF5;
    border-color: #BBF7D0;
    color: #15803D;
  }

  .kl-write-gate-feedback-4d6.is-error {
    background: #FEF2F2;
    border-color: #FECACA;
    color: #B91C1C;
  }

    /**
   * ================================================================
   * KIDLEARN V3 - Phase 4E-5B
   * Parent Review Queue UI Read-only
   * ================================================================
   */

  .kl-parent-review-entry-4e5b {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
    gap: 16px;
    align-items: center;
    border-radius: 28px;
    padding: 18px;
    margin: 0 0 18px;
    background: #F8FAFC;
    border: 1px solid #E2E8F0;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(15, 23, 42, .08);
  }

  .kl-parent-review-entry-icon-4e5b {
    width: 56px;
    height: 56px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    border-radius: 20px;
    background: #FFF7ED;
    border: 1px solid #FED7AA;
    font-size: 28px;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-entry-body-4e5b h3 {
    margin: 0 0 4px;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 950;
    color: #0F172A;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-entry-body-4e5b p {
    margin: 0;
    color: #475569;
    font-weight: 750;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-entry-meta-4e5b {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 10px;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-entry-meta-4e5b span {
    display: inline-flex;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 5px 9px;
    background: #EFF6FF;
    color: #1D4ED8;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 900;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-entry-button-4e5b {
    appearance: none;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 12px 18px;
    background: #2563EB;
    color: white;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-weight: 950;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(37, 99, 235, .22);
  }

  .kl-parent-review-panel-4e5b {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 9999;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    padding: 20px;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-backdrop-4e5b {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgba(15, 23, 42, .48);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  }

  .kl-parent-review-shell-4e5b {
    position: relative;
    width: min(980px, 100%);
    max-height: min(86vh, 860px);
    overflow: auto;
    border-radius: 32px;
    padding: 22px;
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border: 1px solid #E2E8F0;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 90px rgba(15, 23, 42, .28);
  }

  .kl-parent-review-header-4e5b {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 16px;
    padding-bottom: 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #E2E8F0;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-kicker-4e5b {
    display: inline-flex;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    background: #ECFDF5;
    color: #15803D;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 950;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-header-4e5b h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-size: 28px;
    font-weight: 950;
    color: #0F172A;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-header-4e5b p {
    margin: 6px 0 0;
    color: #475569;
    font-weight: 750;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-close-4e5b {
    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #F1F5F9;
    color: #0F172A;
    font-size: 28px;
    font-weight: 900;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-stats-4e5b {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 12px;
    margin: 16px 0;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-stats-4e5b div {
    border-radius: 22px;
    padding: 14px;
    background: #F8FAFC;
    border: 1px solid #E2E8F0;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-stats-4e5b strong {
    display: block;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 950;
    color: #0F172A;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-stats-4e5b span {
    color: #64748B;
    font-weight: 850;
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-list-4e5b {
    display: grid;
    gap: 14px;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-card-4e5b {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
    gap: 16px;
    align-items: center;
    border-radius: 26px;
    padding: 18px;
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border: 1px solid #E2E8F0;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(15, 23, 42, .06);
  }

  .kl-parent-review-subject-4e5b {
    display: inline-flex;
    width: fit-content;
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    background: #FFF7ED;
    color: #C2410C;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 950;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-card-main-4e5b h3 {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: var(--kl-font-heading);
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 950;
    color: #0F172A;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-card-main-4e5b p {
    display: grid;
    gap: 4px;
    margin: 8px 0;
    color: #475569;
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-file-4e5b {
    color: #64748B;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-file-4e5b span {
    color: #0F172A;
    font-weight: 950;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-card-side-4e5b {
    display: grid;
    gap: 10px;
    justify-items: end;
  }

  .kl-parent-review-status-4e5b {

 * Ở 3J-A, mọi request đều DRY_RUN_ONLY.
 */

window.KidlearnV3UiRealWriteGate = (function() {
  function callServer(functionName, payload) {
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(resolve)
        .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
          reject(
            new Error(
              error && error.message
                ? error.message
                : String(error)
            )
          );
        })[functionName](payload || {});
    });
  }

  function getStatus() {
    return callServer(
      'kidlearnV3_getUiRealWriteGateDevStatusV3',
      {}
    );
  }

  function getSampleContext() {
    return callServer(
      'kidlearnV3_uiRealWriteGateGetSampleContextV3',
      {}
    );
  }

  function dispatch(action, payload) {
    return callServer(
      'kidlearnV3_uiRealWriteGateDispatchV3',
      {
        action: action,
        confirmText: 'DRY_RUN_ONLY',
        dryRun: true,
        realWriteRequested: false,
        payload: payload || {}
      }
    );
  }

  function auditEvent(payload) {
    return dispatch(
      'AUDIT_EVENT',
      payload || {}
    );
  }

  function studyStart(payload) {
    return dispatch(
      'STUDY_START',
      payload || {}
    );
  }

  function studyFinish(payload) {
    return dispatch(
      'STUDY_FINISH',
      payload || {}
    );
  }

  function lessonProgressSave(payload) {
    return dispatch(
      'LESSON_PROGRESS_SAVE',
      payload || {}
    );
  }

  function dailyGoalSave(payload) {
    return dispatch(
      'DAILY_GOAL_SAVE',
      payload || {}
    );
  }

  function assignmentStart(payload) {
    return dispatch(
      'ASSIGNMENT_START',
      payload || {}
    );
  }

  function assignmentProgress(payload) {
    return dispatch(
      'ASSIGNMENT_PROGRESS',
      payload || {}
    );
  }

  function assignmentComplete(payload) {
    return dispatch(
      'ASSIGNMENT_COMPLETE',
      payload || {}
    );
  }

  function today() {
    var date =
      new Date();

    return (
      date.getFullYear() +
      '-' +
      String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') +
      '-' +
      String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
    );
  }

  function makeId(prefix) {
    var now =
      new Date();

    return (
      prefix +
      '_' +
      now.getFullYear() +
      String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') +
      String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0') +
      '_' +
      String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0') +
      String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0') +
      String(now.getSeconds()).padStart(2, '0')
    );
  }

  return {
    getStatus: getStatus,
    getSampleContext: getSampleContext,
    dispatch: dispatch,
    auditEvent: auditEvent,
    studyStart: studyStart,
    studyFinish: studyFinish,
    lessonProgressSave: lessonProgressSave,
    dailyGoalSave: dailyGoalSave,
    assignmentStart: assignmentStart,
    assignmentProgress: assignmentProgress,
    assignmentComplete: assignmentComplete,
    today: today,
    makeId: makeId
  };
})();
</script>

          <button onclick="KidlearnUiRealGatePage.studyStart()">Study Start</button>
          <button onclick="KidlearnUiRealGatePage.saveProgress(25)">Progress 25%</button>
          <button onclick="KidlearnUiRealGatePage.saveProgress(50)">Progress 50%</button>
          <button onclick="KidlearnUiRealGatePage.saveProgress(100)">Progress 100%</button>

          <button onclick="KidlearnUiRealGatePage.studyFinish()">Study Finish</button>

      </div>

        </div>

        <div class="section-body">
          <pre id="lastResponse">Chưa có response.</pre>
        </div>
      </div>
