  <script>
    window.KidlearnUiRealGatePage = (function() {
      var state = {
        context: {},
        studySessionId: '',
        lessonId: '',
        events: []
      };

      function init() {
        state.studySessionId =
          KidlearnV3UiRealWriteGate.makeId(
            'DRY_RUN_UI_GATE_SESSION'
          );

        state.lessonId =
          KidlearnV3UiRealWriteGate.makeId(
            'DRY_RUN_UI_GATE_LESSON'
          );

        setText(
          'studySessionId',
          state.studySessionId
        );

        setText(
          'lessonId',
          state.lessonId
        );

        loadStatus()
          .then(loadSample)
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              'Khởi tạo lỗi: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );
          });
      }

      function requireConfirm() {
        var value =
          document
            .getElementById('confirmText')
            .value
            .trim();

        if (value !== 'DRY_RUN_ONLY') {
          throw new Error(
            'Vui lòng nhập DRY_RUN_ONLY trước khi chạy.'
          );
        }
      }

      function loadStatus() {
        setStatus(
          'Đang lấy Gate status...',
          ''
        );

        return KidlearnV3UiRealWriteGate
          .getStatus()
          .then(function(response) {
            setLastResponse(response);

            if (!response.success) {
              throw new Error(
                getError(response)
              );
            }

            setText(
              'gateStatus',
              response.status || '-'
            );

            var safe =
              response.safeWriteStatus || {};

            setText(
              'safeWrite',
              String(safe.mode || '-') +
              ' / enabled=' +
              String(safe.enabled)
            );

            var router =
              response.routerStatus || {};

            var dryRunOnly =
              router.data
                ? router.data.dryRunOnly
                : null;

            setText(
              'router',
              'DRY_RUN_ONLY=' +
              String(dryRunOnly)
            );

            document.getElementById('gateBadge').textContent =
              '3J-A / ' + String(response.status || 'DRY_RUN');

            setStatus(
              'Gate status loaded. Real write vẫn OFF.',
              'good'
            );

            addEvent(
              'STATUS',
              'Loaded gate status.'
            );

            return response;
          });
      }

      function loadSample() {
        setStatus(
          'Đang lấy sample context...',
          ''
        );

        return KidlearnV3UiRealWriteGate
          .getSampleContext()
          .then(function(response) {
            setLastResponse(response);

            if (!response.success) {
              throw new Error(
                getError(response)
              );
            }

            var sample =
              response.data &&
              response.data.sampleContext
                ? response.data.sampleContext
                : {};

            state.context =
              sample;

            if (!state.context.childId) {
              state.context.childId =
                'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID';
            }

            if (!state.context.subjectId) {
              state.context.subjectId =
                'SUB_TV';
            }

            setText(
              'childId',
              state.context.childId || '-'
            );

            setText(
              'subjectId',
              state.context.subjectId || '-'
            );

            setStatus(
              'Sample context loaded.',
              'good'
            );

            addEvent(
              'SAMPLE',
              'Loaded sample context.'
            );

            return response;
          });
      }

      function auditEvent() {
        requireConfirm();

        return runAction(
          'AUDIT_EVENT',
          KidlearnV3UiRealWriteGate.auditEvent({
            eventType: 'UI_REAL_GATE_MANUAL_DRY_RUN',
            message: 'Manual dry-run from UI Real Write Gate',
            entityType: 'UI_GATE',
            entityId: '3J-A',
            childId: state.context.childId || ''
          })
        );
      }

      function studyStart() {
        requireConfirm();

        return runAction(
          'STUDY_START',
          KidlearnV3UiRealWriteGate.studyStart({
            studySessionId: state.studySessionId,
            childId: state.context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID',
            subjectId: state.context.subjectId || 'SUB_TV',
            lessonId: state.lessonId
          })
        );
      }

      function saveProgress(percent) {
        requireConfirm();

        return runAction(
          'LESSON_PROGRESS_SAVE_' + percent,
          KidlearnV3UiRealWriteGate.lessonProgressSave({
            childId: state.context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID',
            subjectId: state.context.subjectId || 'SUB_TV',
            lessonId: state.lessonId,
            progressPercent: percent
          })
        );
      }

      function dailyGoal() {
        requireConfirm();

        return runAction(
          'DAILY_GOAL_SAVE',
          KidlearnV3UiRealWriteGate.dailyGoalSave({
            childId: state.context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID',
            goalDate: KidlearnV3UiRealWriteGate.today(),
            targetMinutes: 20,
            completedMinutes: 10
          })
        );
      }

      function studyFinish() {
        requireConfirm();

        return runAction(
          'STUDY_FINISH',
          KidlearnV3UiRealWriteGate.studyFinish({
            studySessionId: state.studySessionId,
            durationSeconds: 300
          })
        );
      }

      function runAllDryRun() {
        requireConfirm();

        return auditEvent()
          .then(studyStart)
          .then(function() {
            return saveProgress(25);
          })
          .then(function() {
            return saveProgress(50);
          })
          .then(dailyGoal)
          .then(studyFinish)
          .then(function() {
            setStatus(
              'Run All DRY_RUN hoàn tất. Không ghi thật.',
              'good'
            );
          });
      }

      function runAction(name, promise) {
        setStatus(
          'Đang chạy ' + name + '...',
          ''
        );

        return promise
          .then(function(response) {
            setLastResponse(response);

            if (!response.success) {
              throw new Error(
                getError(response)
              );
            }

            setStatus(
              name + ' DRY_RUN thành công.',
              'good'
            );

            addEvent(
              name,
              'DRY_RUN success.'
            );

            return response;
          })
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              name + ' lỗi: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );

            addEvent(
              name,
              'ERROR: ' + String(error.message || error)
            );

            throw error;
          });
      }

      function setStatus(message, type) {
        var element =
          document.getElementById('status');

        element.className =
          'status ' + (type || '');

        element.textContent =
          message;
      }

      function setText(id, value) {
        var element =
          document.getElementById(id);

        if (element) {
          element.textContent =
            value;
        }
      }

      function setLastResponse(response) {
        document.getElementById('lastResponse').textContent =
          JSON.stringify(response, null, 2);
      }

      function addEvent(action, message) {
        state.events.unshift({
          at: new Date().toISOString(),
          action: action,
          message: message
        });

        if (state.events.length > 20) {
          state.events.pop();
        }

        renderEvents();
      }

      function renderEvents() {
        var element =
          document.getElementById('eventLog');

        if (!state.events.length) {
          element.innerHTML =
            'Chưa có event.';
          return;
        }

        var html = '';

        for (var i = 0; i < state.events.length; i++) {
          var item =
            state.events[i];

          html +=
            '<div class="event">' +
            '<strong>' +
            escapeHtml(item.action) +
            '</strong>' +
            '<div class="muted">' +
            escapeHtml(item.at) +
            '</div>' +
            '<div>' +
            escapeHtml(item.message) +
            '</div>' +
            '</div>';
        }

        element.innerHTML =
          html;
      }

      function getError(response) {
        if (
          response &&
          response.error &&
          response.error.message
        ) {
          return response.error.message;
        }

        if (
          response &&
          response.routerResponse &&
          response.routerResponse.error &&
          response.routerResponse.error.message
        ) {
          return response.routerResponse.error.message;
        }

        return 'Không rõ lỗi.';
      }

      function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value || '')
          .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
          .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
          .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
          .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
          .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
      }

      return {
        init: init,
        loadStatus: loadStatus,
        loadSample: loadSample,
        auditEvent: auditEvent,
        studyStart: studyStart,
        saveProgress: saveProgress,
        dailyGoal: dailyGoal,
        studyFinish: studyFinish,
        runAllDryRun: runAllDryRun
      };
    })();

    document.addEventListener(
      'DOMContentLoaded',
      function() {
        KidlearnUiRealGatePage.init();
      }
    );
  </script>
</body>
</html>

    );

    );

    );

      'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3JClosedV3',

  return {

    review: review,
    markReviewReady: markReviewReady,
    closePhase3J: closePhase3J,
    assertClosed: assertClosed
  };
})();
</script>

  <script>
    window.KidlearnUiRealTrial3JBPage = (function() {
      var events = [];

      function init() {
        loadStatus()
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              'Khởi tạo lỗi: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );
          });
      }

      function preview() {
        return run(
          'PREVIEW',
          KidlearnV3UiRealTrial3JB.preview()
        );
      }

      function loadStatus() {
        return KidlearnV3UiRealTrial3JB
          .getStatus()
          .then(function(response) {
            setLastResponse(response);
            renderStatus(response);

            if (!response.success) {
              throw new Error(
                getError(response)
              );
            }

            setStatus(
              'Status loaded.',
              'good'
            );

            addEvent(
              'STATUS',
              'Loaded 3J-B status.'
            );

            return response;
          });
      }

      function arm() {
        var text =
          document
            .getElementById('armText')
            .value
            .trim();

        return run(
          'ARM',
          KidlearnV3UiRealTrial3JB.arm(text)
        ).then(loadStatus);
      }

      function enable() {
        var text =
          document
            .getElementById('enableText')
            .value
            .trim();

        return run(
          'ENABLE',
          KidlearnV3UiRealTrial3JB.enable(text)
        ).then(loadStatus);
      }

      function executeTrial() {
        var text =
          document
            .getElementById('trialText')
            .value
            .trim();

        return run(
          'RUN_UI_REAL_WRITE_TRIAL',
          KidlearnV3UiRealTrial3JB.executeTrial(text)
        ).then(loadStatus);
      }

      function reset() {
        return run(
          'RESET_TO_DRY_RUN',
          KidlearnV3UiRealTrial3JB.reset()
        ).then(loadStatus);
      }

      function review() {
        return run(
          'POST_UI_REVIEW',
          KidlearnV3UiRealTrial3JB.review()
        ).then(loadStatus);
      }

      function markReviewReady() {
        return run(
          'MARK_REVIEW_READY',
          KidlearnV3UiRealTrial3JB.markReviewReady()
        ).then(loadStatus);
      }

      function closePhase3J() {
        return run(
          'CLOSE_PHASE_3J',
          KidlearnV3UiRealTrial3JB.closePhase3J()
        ).then(loadStatus);
      }

      function assertClosed() {
        return run(
          'ASSERT_PHASE_3J_CLOSED',
          KidlearnV3UiRealTrial3JB.assertClosed()
        );
      }

      function run(label, promise) {
        setStatus(
          'Đang chạy ' + label + '...',
          ''
        );

        return promise
          .then(function(response) {
            setLastResponse(response);

            if (!response.success) {
              throw new Error(
                getError(response)
              );
            }

            setStatus(
              label + ' thành công.',
              'good'
            );

            addEvent(
              label,
              'Success.'
            );

            return response;
          })
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              label + ' lỗi: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );

            addEvent(
              label,
              'ERROR: ' + String(error.message || error)
            );

            throw error;
          });
      }

      function renderStatus(response) {
        setText(
          'trialStatus',
          response.status || '-'
        );

        setText(
          'transactionId',
          response.lastTransactionId || '-'
        );

        var cw =
          response.controlledWriteStatus || {};

        setText(
          'controlledWrite',
          String(cw.status || '-') +
          ' / safe=' +
          String(cw.safeWriteMode || '-')
        );

        var sw =
          response.safeWriteStatus || {};

        setText(
          'safeWrite',
          String(sw.mode || '-') +
          ' / enabled=' +
          String(sw.enabled)
        );
      }

      function setStatus(message, type) {
        var element =
          document.getElementById('status');

        element.className =
          'status ' + (type || '');

        element.textContent =
          message;
      }

      function setText(id, value) {
        var element =
          document.getElementById(id);

        if (element) {
          element.textContent =
            value;
        }
      }

      function setLastResponse(response) {
        document.getElementById('lastResponse').textContent =
          JSON.stringify(
            response,
            null,
            2
          );
      }

      function addEvent(action, message) {
        events.unshift({
          at: new Date().toISOString(),
          action: action,
          message: message
        });

        if (events.length > 20) {
          events.pop();
        }

        renderEvents();
      }

      function renderEvents() {
        var element =
          document.getElementById('eventLog');

        if (!events.length) {
          element.innerHTML =
            'Chưa có event.';
          return;
        }

        var html = '';

        for (var i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
          var item =
            events[i];

          html +=
            '<div style="border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;">' +
            '<strong>' +
            escapeHtml(item.action) +
            '</strong>' +
            '<div class="muted">' +
            escapeHtml(item.at) +
            '</div>' +
            '<div>' +
            escapeHtml(item.message) +
            '</div>' +
            '</div>';
        }

        element.innerHTML =
          html;
      }

      function getError(response) {
        if (
          response &&
          response.error &&
          response.error.message
        ) {
          return response.error.message;
        }

        return 'Không rõ lỗi.';
      }

      function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value || '')
          .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
          .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
          .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
          .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
          .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
      }

      return {
        init: init,
        preview: preview,
        loadStatus: loadStatus,
        arm: arm,
        enable: enable,
        executeTrial: executeTrial,
        reset: reset,
        review: review,
        markReviewReady: markReviewReady,
        closePhase3J: closePhase3J,
        assertClosed: assertClosed
      };
    })();

    document.addEventListener(
      'DOMContentLoaded',
      function() {
        KidlearnUiRealTrial3JBPage.init();
      }
    );
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - UI ROUTER DEV CLIENT
 * Step: 3I.7
 * ================================================================
 */

window.KidlearnV3UiRouterClient = (function() {
  function callServer(functionName, request) {
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
      if (
        !window.google ||
        !google.script ||
        !google.script.run
      ) {
        reject({
          success: false,
          message: 'google.script.run không khả dụng.'
        });

        return;
      }

      var runner =
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function(response) {
            resolve(response);
          })
          .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
            reject({
              success: false,
              message:
                error && error.message
                  ? error.message
                  : String(error || 'Unknown error')
            });
          });

      runner[functionName](request || {});
    });
  }

  function getInitialState(request) {
    return callServer(
      'kidlearnV3_uiRouterGetInitialStateV3',
      request || {}
    );
  }

  function navigate(screen, params) {
    var request =
      params || {};

    request.screen =
      screen || 'HOME';

    return callServer(
      'kidlearnV3_uiRouterLoadScreenV3',
      request
    );
  }

  function unwrap(response) {
    if (!response) {
      throw new Error('Router response trống.');
    }

    if (response.success !== true) {
      var message =
        response.error && response.error.message
          ? response.error.message
          : 'Router trả về success=false.';

      throw new Error(message);
    }

    return response.data;
  }

  return {
    getInitialState: getInitialState,
    navigate: navigate,
    unwrap: unwrap
  };
})();
</script>

  <div class="page">
    <div class="topbar">
      <div>
        <h1 class="title">KIDLEARN V3 - UI Router DEV</h1>
        <p class="subtitle">
          Router DEV chuyển Home / Subjects / Children / Assignments theo DEV_SWITCH V3.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div>
        <span class="badge" id="modeBadge">V3 ROUTER</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="status" class="status">
      Đang khởi tạo UI Router DEV...
    </div>

    <div class="layout">
      <div class="sidebar" id="navigation">
        Đang load navigation...
      </div>

      <div class="content">
        <div id="screenContent"></div>

        <div class="section">
          <div class="section-head">
            <h3 class="section-title">Raw Router Response</h3>
          </div>
          <div class="section-body">
            <pre id="rawResponse">Chưa load.</pre>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    window.KidlearnV3UiRouter = (function() {
      var state = {
        currentScreen: 'HOME',
        navigation: [],
        lastResponse: null,
        selectedChildId: ''
      };

      function init() {
        setStatus(
          'Đang load initial state...',
          ''
        );

        KidlearnV3UiRouterClient
          .getInitialState({
            screen: 'HOME'
          })
          .then(function(response) {
            state.lastResponse =
              response;

            setRaw(response);

            if (!response.success) {
              throw new Error(
                getErrorMessage(response)
              );
            }

            state.currentScreen =
              response.currentScreen || 'HOME';

            state.navigation =
              response.navigation || [];

            renderNavigation();
            renderScreen(response);

            setStatus(
              'UI Router DEV đã load thành công.',
              'good'
            );
          })
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              'Lỗi initial state: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );
          });
      }

      function navigate(screen) {
        var childId =
          state.selectedChildId || '';

        setStatus(
          'Đang chuyển màn hình: ' + screen,
          ''
        );

        KidlearnV3UiRouterClient
          .navigate(
            screen,
            {
              childId: childId,
              limit: 100
            }
          )
          .then(function(response) {
            state.lastResponse =
              response;

            setRaw(response);

            if (!response.success) {
              throw new Error(
                getErrorMessage(response)
              );
            }

            state.currentScreen =
              response.screen || screen;

            renderNavigation();
            renderScreen(response);

            setStatus(
              'Đã chuyển sang màn hình ' +
              state.currentScreen,
              'good'
            );
          })
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              'Lỗi chuyển màn hình: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );
          });
      }

      function renderNavigation() {
        var element =
          document.getElementById('navigation');

        var navigation =
          state.navigation;

        if (!navigation || navigation.length === 0) {
          navigation = [
            {
              screen: 'HOME',
              title: 'Home',
              icon: '🏠'
            },
            {
              screen: 'SUBJECTS',
              title: 'Subjects',
              icon: '📚'
            },
            {
              screen: 'CHILDREN',
              title: 'Children',
              icon: '👧'
            },
            {
              screen: 'ASSIGNMENTS',
              title: 'Assignments',
              icon: '📝'
            }
          ];
        }

        var html = '';

        for (
          var i = 0;
          i < navigation.length;
          i++
        ) {
          var item =
            navigation[i];

          var active =
            item.screen === state.currentScreen
              ? ' active'
              : '';

          html +=
            '<button class="nav-button' +
            active +
            '" onclick="KidlearnV3UiRouter.navigate(\'' +
            escapeHtml(item.screen || '') +
            '\')">' +
            escapeHtml(item.icon || '') +
            ' ' +
            escapeHtml(item.title || item.screen || '') +
            '<div class="small">' +
            escapeHtml(item.description || '') +
            '</div>' +
            '</button>';
        }

        element.innerHTML =
          html;
      }

      function renderScreen(response) {
        var screen =
          response.screen || response.currentScreen || 'HOME';

        var data =
          response.data || {};

        document.getElementById('modeBadge').textContent =
          'Screen ' + screen;

        if (screen === 'HOME') {
          renderHome(data);
          return;
        }

        if (screen === 'SUBJECTS') {
          renderSubjects(data);
          return;
        }

        if (screen === 'CHILDREN') {
          renderChildren(data);
          return;
        }

        if (screen === 'ASSIGNMENTS') {
          renderAssignments(data);
          return;
        }

        renderUnknown(screen, data);
      }

      function renderHome(data) {
        var counts =
          data.counts || {};

        var dashboard =
          data.dashboard || {};

        var child =
          data.currentChild || null;

        if (child && child.childId) {
          state.selectedChildId =
            child.childId;
        }

        var html =
          '<div class="grid">' +
          statCard('Subjects', counts.subjects || 0) +
          statCard('Users', counts.users || 0) +
          statCard('Children', counts.children || 0) +
          statCard('Assignments', counts.assignments || 0) +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="section">' +
          '<div class="section-head"><h3 class="section-title">Current Child</h3></div>' +
          '<div class="section-body">' +
          renderChildCard(child) +
          '</div></div>' +
          '<div class="section">' +
          '<div class="section-head"><h3 class="section-title">Dashboard Summary</h3></div>' +
          '<div class="section-body">' +
          '<div class="grid">' +
          statCard('Active', dashboard.activeAssignmentCount || 0) +
          statCard('Completed', dashboard.completedAssignmentCount || 0) +
          statCard('Overdue', dashboard.overdueAssignmentCount || 0) +
          statCard('Completion %', dashboard.completionPercent || 0) +
          '</div>' +
          '</div></div>' +
          '<div class="section">' +
          '<div class="section-head"><h3 class="section-title">Subjects</h3></div>' +
          '<div class="section-body"><div class="list">' +
          renderSubjectItems(data.subjects || []) +
          '</div></div></div>' +
          '<div class="section">' +
          '<div class="section-head"><h3 class="section-title">Assignments</h3></div>' +
          '<div class="section-body"><div class="list">' +
          renderAssignmentItems(data.assignments || []) +
          '</div></div></div>';

        setContent(html);
      }

      function renderSubjects(data) {
        var rows =
          data.rows || [];

        var html =
          '<div class="grid">' +
          statCard('Subjects', data.count || rows.length) +
          statCard('Active', rows.length) +
          statCard('Screen', 'SUBJECTS') +
          statCard('Mode', 'V3') +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="section">' +
          '<div class="section-head"><h3 class="section-title">Subjects</h3></div>' +
          '<div class="section-body"><div class="list">' +
          renderSubjectItems(rows) +
          '</div></div></div>';

        setContent(html);
      }

      function renderChildren(data) {
        var rows =
          data.rows || [];

        var html =
          '<div class="grid">' +
          statCard('Children', data.count || rows.length) +
          statCard('Screen', 'CHILDREN') +
          statCard('Mode', 'V3') +
          statCard('Selected', state.selectedChildId || '-') +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="section">' +
          '<div class="section-head"><h3 class="section-title">Children</h3></div>' +
          '<div class="section-body"><div class="list">' +
          renderChildItems(rows) +
          '</div></div></div>';

        setContent(html);
      }

      function renderAssignments(data) {
        var rows =
          data.rows || [];

        var html =
          '<div class="grid">' +
          statCard('Assignments', data.count || rows.length) +
          statCard('Child ID', data.childId || state.selectedChildId || '-') +
          statCard('Screen', 'ASSIGNMENTS') +
          statCard('Mode', 'V3') +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="section">' +
          '<div class="section-head"><h3 class="section-title">Assignments</h3></div>' +
          '<div class="section-body"><div class="list">' +
          renderAssignmentItems(rows) +
          '</div></div></div>';

        setContent(html);
      }

      function renderUnknown(screen, data) {
        setContent(
          '<div class="section">' +
          '<div class="section-head"><h3 class="section-title">Unknown Screen</h3></div>' +
          '<div class="section-body">Screen: ' +
          escapeHtml(screen) +
          '</div></div>'
        );
      }

      function statCard(label, value) {
        return (
          '<div class="card">' +
          '<div class="card-label">' +
          escapeHtml(label) +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="card-value">' +
          escapeHtml(value) +
          '</div>' +
          '</div>'
        );
      }

      function renderSubjectItems(rows) {
        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
          return '<span class="small">Chưa có dữ liệu Subjects.</span>';
        }

        var html = '';

        for (
          var i = 0;
          i < rows.length;
          i++
        ) {
          var row =
            rows[i];

          html +=
            '<div class="item">' +
            '<div class="item-title">' +
            escapeHtml(row.icon || '') +
            ' ' +
            escapeHtml(row.title || row.name || '') +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="small">' +
            'id: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.id || '') +
            ' | code: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.code || '') +
            ' | theme: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.theme || '') +
            ' | status: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.status || '') +
            '</div>' +
            '</div>';
        }

        return html;
      }

      function renderChildItems(rows) {
        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
          return '<span class="small">Chưa có dữ liệu Children.</span>';
        }

        var html = '';

        for (
          var i = 0;
          i < rows.length;
          i++
        ) {
          var row =
            rows[i];

          html +=
            '<div class="item">' +
            '<div class="item-title">' +
            escapeHtml(row.title || row.name || '') +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="small">' +
            'childId: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.childId || row.id || '') +
            ' | grade: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.gradeLevel || '') +
            ' | status: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.status || '') +
            '</div>' +
            '</div>';
        }

        return html;
      }

      function renderChildCard(child) {
        if (!child) {
          return '<span class="small">Chưa có child.</span>';
        }

        return (
          '<div class="item">' +
          '<div class="item-title">' +
          escapeHtml(child.title || child.name || '') +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="small">' +
          'childId: ' +
          escapeHtml(child.childId || child.id || '') +
          ' | grade: ' +
          escapeHtml(child.gradeLevel || '') +
          ' | status: ' +
          escapeHtml(child.status || '') +
          '</div>' +
          '</div>'
        );
      }

      function renderAssignmentItems(rows) {
        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
          return '<span class="small">Chưa có Assignments hoặc chưa gắn với child hiện tại.</span>';
        }

        var html = '';

        for (
          var i = 0;
          i < rows.length;
          i++
        ) {
          var row =
            rows[i];

          html +=
            '<div class="item">' +
            '<div class="item-title">' +
            escapeHtml(row.title || '') +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="small">' +
            'id: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.assignmentId || row.id || '') +
            ' | status: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.status || '') +
            ' | priority: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.priority || '') +
            ' | progress: ' +
            escapeHtml(row.progressPercent || row.progress || 0) +
            '%</div>' +
            '</div>';
        }

        return html;
      }

      function setContent(html) {
        document.getElementById('screenContent').innerHTML =
          html;
      }

      function setStatus(message, type) {
        var element =
          document.getElementById('status');

        element.className =
          'status ' + (type || '');

        element.textContent =
          message;
      }

      function setRaw(value) {
        document.getElementById('rawResponse').textContent =
          JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
      }

      function getErrorMessage(response) {
        if (
          response &&
          response.error &&
          response.error.message
        ) {
          return response.error.message;
        }

        return 'Router trả về success=false.';
      }

      function escapeHtml(value) {
        return String(value || '')
          .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
          .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
          .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
          .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
          .replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
      }

      return {
        init: init,
        navigate: navigate
      };
    })();

    document.addEventListener(
      'DOMContentLoaded',
      function() {
        KidlearnV3UiRouter.init();
      }
    );
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - UI SERVICE CLIENT
 * Step: 3I.4
 * ================================================================
 *
 * Client JS gọi App Service Facade V3 qua google.script.run.
 */

window.KidlearnV3Client = (function() {
  var SERVICE = {
    ping: 'kidlearnV3_servicePingV3',
    bootstrap: 'kidlearnV3_serviceGetBootstrapV3',
    dashboard: 'kidlearnV3_serviceGetDashboardV3',
    subjects: 'kidlearnV3_serviceGetSubjectsV3',
    children: 'kidlearnV3_serviceGetChildrenV3',
    assignments: 'kidlearnV3_serviceGetAssignmentsV3',
    familyContext: 'kidlearnV3_serviceGetFamilyContextV3',
    config: 'kidlearnV3_serviceGetConfigV3',
    readCore: 'kidlearnV3_serviceReadCoreV3'
  };

  function call(serviceName, request) {
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
      if (
        !window.google ||
        !google.script ||
        !google.script.run
      ) {
        reject({
          success: false,
          message: 'google.script.run không khả dụng.'
        });

        return;
      }

      var runner =
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function(response) {
            resolve(response);
          })
          .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
            reject(normalizeError(error));
          });

      runner[serviceName](request || {});
    });
  }

  function normalizeError(error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        error && error.message
          ? error.message
          : String(error || 'Unknown error')
    };
  }

  function unwrap(response) {
    if (!response) {
      throw new Error('Service response trống.');
    }

    if (response.success !== true) {
      var message =
        response.error && response.error.message
          ? response.error.message
          : 'Service trả về success=false.';

      throw new Error(message);
    }

    return response.data;
  }

  function ping(request) {
    return call(
      SERVICE.ping,
      request || {}
    );
  }

  function getBootstrap(request) {
    return call(
      SERVICE.bootstrap,
      request || {}
    );
  }

  function getDashboard(childId) {
    return call(
      SERVICE.dashboard,
      {
        childId: childId || ''
      }
    );
  }

  function getSubjects() {
    return call(
      SERVICE.subjects,
      {}
    );
  }

  function getChildren(userId) {
    return call(
      SERVICE.children,
      {
        userId: userId || ''
      }
    );
  }

  function getAssignments(childId, limit) {
    return call(
      SERVICE.assignments,
      {
        childId: childId || '',
        limit: limit || 100
      }
    );
  }

  function getFamilyContext(userId) {
    return call(
      SERVICE.familyContext,
      {
        userId: userId || ''
      }
    );
  }

  function getConfig() {
    return call(
      SERVICE.config,
      {}
    );
  }

  function readCore(sheetName, options) {
    var request =
      options || {};

    request.sheetName =
      sheetName || '';

    return call(
      SERVICE.readCore,
      request
    );
  }

  return {
    call: call,
    unwrap: unwrap,
    ping: ping,
    getBootstrap: getBootstrap,
    getDashboard: getDashboard,
    getSubjects: getSubjects,
    getChildren: getChildren,
    getAssignments: getAssignments,
    getFamilyContext: getFamilyContext,
    getConfig: getConfig,
    readCore: readCore
  };
})();
</script>

<script>
/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - UI DEV SWITCH CLIENT
 * Step: 3I.5
 * ================================================================
 *
 * File này dùng cho UI cũ DEV gọi DEV_SWITCH V3.
 */

window.KidlearnV3DevSwitch = (function() {
  function dispatch(action, payload) {
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
      if (
        !window.google ||
        !google.script ||
        !google.script.run
      ) {
        reject({
          success: false,
          message: 'google.script.run không khả dụng.'
        });

        return;
      }

      google.script.run
        .withSuccessHandler(function(response) {
          resolve(response);
        })
        .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
          reject({
            success: false,
            message:
              error && error.message
                ? error.message
                : String(error || 'Unknown error')
          });
        })
        .kidlearnV3_uiApiDispatchV3({
          action: action,
          payload: payload || {}
        });
    });
  }

  function unwrap(response) {
    if (!response) {
      throw new Error('Response trống.');
    }

    if (response.success !== true) {
      var message =
        response.error && response.error.message
          ? response.error.message
          : 'Service trả về success=false.';

      throw new Error(message);
    }

    return response.data;
  }

  function ping() {
    return dispatch('PING', {});
  }

  function bootstrap(payload) {
    return dispatch(
      'BOOTSTRAP',
      payload || {}
    );
  }

  function dashboard(childId) {
    return dispatch(
      'DASHBOARD',
      {
        childId: childId || ''
      }
    );
  }

  function subjects() {
    return dispatch(
      'SUBJECTS',
      {}
    );
  }

  function children(userId) {
    return dispatch(
      'CHILDREN',
      {
        userId: userId || ''
      }
    );
  }

  function assignments(childId, limit) {
    return dispatch(
      'ASSIGNMENTS',
      {
        childId: childId || '',
        limit: limit || 100
      }
    );
  }

  function config() {
    return dispatch(
      'CONFIG',
      {}
    );
  }

  function readCore(sheetName, options) {
    var payload =
      options || {};

    payload.sheetName =
      sheetName || '';

    return dispatch(
      'READ_CORE',
      payload
    );
  }

  return {
    dispatch: dispatch,
    unwrap: unwrap,
    ping: ping,
    bootstrap: bootstrap,
    dashboard: dashboard,
    subjects: subjects,
    children: children,
    assignments: assignments,
    config: config,
    readCore: readCore
  };
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <base target="_top">
  <meta charset="UTF-8">

  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #f8fafc;
      --card: #ffffff;
      --text: #0f172a;
      --muted: #64748b;
      --border: #e2e8f0;
      --primary: #2563eb;
      --good-bg: #dcfce7;
      --good-text: #166534;
      --warn-bg: #fef3c7;
      --warn-text: #92400e;
      --bad-bg: #fee2e2;
      --bad-text: #991b1b;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .page {
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .topbar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: flex-start;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .title {
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin: 0 0 6px;
    }

    .subtitle {
      color: var(--muted);
      margin: 0;
    }

    .badge {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: #dbeafe;
      color: #1d4ed8;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .status {
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: #e2e8f0;
      color: #334155;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
    }

    .status.good {
      background: var(--good-bg);
      color: var(--good-text);
    }

    .status.warn {
      background: var(--warn-bg);
      color: var(--warn-text);
    }

    .status.bad {
      background: var(--bad-bg);
      color: var(--bad-text);
    }

    .toolbar {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    button {
      border: none;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      background: var(--primary);
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    button.secondary {
      background: #475569;
    }

    button.warning {
      background: #d97706;
    }

    .grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .card {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 14px;
      box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
    }

    .card-label {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .card-value {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 700;
      word-break: break-word;
    }

    .section {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .section-head {
      padding: 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .section-title {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .section-body {
      padding: 14px;
    }

    pre {
      margin: 0;
      background: #0f172a;
      color: #e2e8f0;
      padding: 12px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      word-break: break-word;
      max-height: 320px;
      overflow: auto;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .small {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {

  <div class="page">
    <div class="topbar">

        </p>
      </div>

      <div>
        <span class="badge" id="badge">3J.3 / DRY_RUN</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="status" class="status">
      Đang khởi tạo Write Router Test UI...
    </div>

    <div class="toolbar">
      <button onclick="KidlearnWriteRouterTestV3.loadStatus()">Get Status</button>
      <button class="secondary" onclick="KidlearnWriteRouterTestV3.loadSampleContext()">Sample Context</button>
      <button onclick="KidlearnWriteRouterTestV3.testAudit()">Audit Event</button>
      <button onclick="KidlearnWriteRouterTestV3.testStudyStart()">Study Start</button>
      <button onclick="KidlearnWriteRouterTestV3.testStudyFinish()">Study Finish</button>
      <button onclick="KidlearnWriteRouterTestV3.testLessonProgress()">Lesson Progress</button>
      <button onclick="KidlearnWriteRouterTestV3.testDailyGoal()">Daily Goal</button>

    <div class="grid">

      </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    window.KidlearnWriteRouterTestV3 = (function() {
      var state = {
        sampleContext: {},
        lastResult: null
      };

      function init() {
        loadStatus()
          .then(function() {
            return loadSampleContext();
          })
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              'Khởi tạo lỗi: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );
          });
      }

      function loadStatus() {
        setStatus(
          'Đang lấy Write Router status...',
          ''
        );

        return KidlearnV3WriteRouter
          .getStatus()
          .then(function(response) {
            setLastResult(response);

            if (!response.success) {
              throw new Error(
                getErrorMessage(response)
              );
            }

            var data =
              response.data || {};

            setText(
              'routerVersion',
              data.routerVersion || '-'
            );

            setText(
              'dryRunOnly',
              String(data.dryRunOnly)
            );

            setStatus(
              'Write Router status loaded.',
              'good'
            );

            return response;
          })
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              'Load status lỗi: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );

            throw error;
          });
      }

      function loadSampleContext() {
        setStatus(
          'Đang lấy sample context...',
          ''
        );

        return KidlearnV3WriteRouter
          .getSampleContext()
          .then(function(response) {
            setLastResult(response);

            if (!response.success) {
              throw new Error(
                getErrorMessage(response)
              );
            }

            state.sampleContext =
              response.data.sampleContext || {};

            setText(
              'childId',
              state.sampleContext.childId || '-'
            );

            setText(
              'assignmentId',
              state.sampleContext.assignmentId || '-'
            );

            document.getElementById('sampleContext').textContent =
              JSON.stringify(
                state.sampleContext,
                null,
                2
              );

            setStatus(
              'Sample context loaded.',
              'good'
            );

            return response;
          })
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              'Load sample context lỗi: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );

            throw error;
          });
      }

      function testAudit() {
        return runTest(
          KidlearnV3WriteRouter.auditEvent({
            eventType: 'UI_WRITE_ROUTER_TEST',
            message: 'Dry-run audit from Write Router UI',
            entityType: 'PHASE',
            entityId: '3J.3'
          }),
          'AUDIT_EVENT dry-run thành công.'
        );
      }

      function testStudyStart() {
        var context =
          ensureContext();

        return runTest(
          KidlearnV3WriteRouter.studyStart({
            childId: context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID',
            subjectId: context.subjectId || '',
            lessonId: context.lessonId || 'DRY_RUN_LESSON_ID'
          }),
          'STUDY_START dry-run thành công.'
        );
      }

      function testStudyFinish() {
        return runTest(
          KidlearnV3WriteRouter.studyFinish({
            studySessionId: 'DRY_RUN_STUDY_SESSION_ID',
            durationSeconds: 300
          }),
          'STUDY_FINISH dry-run thành công.'
        );
      }

      function testLessonProgress() {
        var context =
          ensureContext();

        return runTest(
          KidlearnV3WriteRouter.lessonProgressSave({
            childId: context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID',
            subjectId: context.subjectId || '',
            lessonId: context.lessonId || 'DRY_RUN_LESSON_ID',
            progressPercent: 35
          }),
          'LESSON_PROGRESS_SAVE dry-run thành công.'
        );
      }

      function testDailyGoal() {
        var context =
          ensureContext();

        return runTest(
          KidlearnV3WriteRouter.dailyGoalSave({
            childId: context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID',
            goalDate: today(),
            targetMinutes: 20,
            completedMinutes: 5
          }),
          'DAILY_GOAL_SAVE dry-run thành công.'
        );
      }

      function testAssignmentFlow() {
        var context =
          ensureContext();

        if (!context.assignmentId) {
          setStatus(
            'Không có assignmentId mẫu. Bỏ qua Assignment Flow.',
            'warn'
          );

          setLastResult({
            success: false,
            skipped: true,
            message: 'Không có assignmentId mẫu.'
          });

          return Promise.resolve(null);
        }

        return runTest(
          KidlearnV3WriteRouter.assignmentStart({
            assignmentId: context.assignmentId
          })
            .then(function() {
              return KidlearnV3WriteRouter.assignmentProgress({
                assignmentId: context.assignmentId,
                progressPercent: 50
              });
            })
            .then(function() {
              return KidlearnV3WriteRouter.assignmentComplete({
                assignmentId: context.assignmentId
              });
            }),
          'Assignment start/progress/complete dry-run thành công.'
        );
      }

      function runTest(promise, successMessage) {
        setStatus(
          'Đang chạy dry-run...',
          ''
        );

        return promise
          .then(function(response) {
            setLastResult(response);

            if (
              response &&
              response.success !== true
            ) {
              throw new Error(
                getErrorMessage(response)
              );
            }

            setStatus(
              successMessage,
              'good'
            );

            return response;
          })
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              'Dry-run lỗi: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );

            throw error;
          });
      }

      function ensureContext() {
        if (!state.sampleContext) {
          state.sampleContext = {};
        }

        return state.sampleContext;
      }

      function setStatus(message, type) {
        var element =
          document.getElementById('status');

        element.className =
          'status ' + (type || '');

        element.textContent =
          message;
      }

      function setText(id, value) {
        var element =
          document.getElementById(id);

        if (element) {
          element.textContent =
            value;
        }
      }

      function setLastResult(value) {
        state.lastResult =
          value;

        document.getElementById('lastResult').textContent =
          JSON.stringify(
            value,
            null,
            2
          );
      }

      function getErrorMessage(response) {
        if (
          response &&
          response.error &&
          response.error.message
        ) {
          return response.error.message;
        }

        return 'Không rõ lỗi.';
      }

      function today() {
        var date =
          new Date();

        var year =
          date.getFullYear();

        var month =
          String(date.getMonth() + 1)
            .padStart(2, '0');

        var day =
          String(date.getDate())
            .padStart(2, '0');

        return year + '-' + month + '-' + day;
      }

      return {
        init: init,
        loadStatus: loadStatus,
        loadSampleContext: loadSampleContext,
        testAudit: testAudit,
        testStudyStart: testStudyStart,
        testStudyFinish: testStudyFinish,
        testLessonProgress: testLessonProgress,
        testDailyGoal: testDailyGoal,
        testAssignmentFlow: testAssignmentFlow
      };
    })();

    document.addEventListener(
      'DOMContentLoaded',
      function() {
        KidlearnWriteRouterTestV3.init();
      }
    );
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - WRITE SERVICE CLIENT
 * Step: 3J.2
 * ================================================================
 *
 * Client JS cho UI DEV gọi Write Service Facade V3.
 */

window.KidlearnV3WriteService = (function() {
  var SERVER = {
    status: 'kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetStatusV3',
    sampleContext: 'kidlearnV3_writeServiceGetSampleContextV3',
    dispatch: 'kidlearnV3_writeServiceDispatchV3',
    dryRun: 'kidlearnV3_writeServiceDryRunV3',
    auditLog: 'kidlearnV3_writeServiceAuditLogV3',
    startStudySession: 'kidlearnV3_writeServiceStartStudySessionV3',
    finishStudySession: 'kidlearnV3_writeServiceFinishStudySessionV3',
    upsertLessonProgress: 'kidlearnV3_writeServiceUpsertLessonProgressV3',
    updateAssignmentStatus: 'kidlearnV3_writeServiceUpdateAssignmentStatusV3',
    upsertDailyGoal: 'kidlearnV3_writeServiceUpsertDailyGoalV3'
  };

  function callServer(functionName, request) {
    return new Promise(function(resolve, reject) {
      if (
        !window.google ||
        !google.script ||
        !google.script.run
      ) {
        reject({
          success: false,
          message: 'google.script.run không khả dụng.'
        });

        return;
      }

      var runner =
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(function(response) {
            resolve(response);
          })
          .withFailureHandler(function(error) {
            reject({
              success: false,
              message:
                error && error.message
                  ? error.message
                  : String(error || 'Unknown error')
            });
          });

      runner[functionName](request || {});
    });
  }

  function unwrap(response) {
    if (!response) {
      throw new Error('Write Service response trống.');
    }

    if (response.success !== true) {
      var message =
        response.error && response.error.message
          ? response.error.message
          : 'Write Service trả về success=false.';

      throw new Error(message);
    }

    return response.data || {};
  }

  function getStatus() {
    return callServer(
      SERVER.status,
      {}
    );
  }

  function getSampleContext() {
    return callServer(
      SERVER.sampleContext,
      {}
    );
  }

  function dispatch(action, payload, options) {
    var request =
      options || {};

    request.action =
      action || '';

    request.payload =
      payload || {};

    if (request.dryRun === undefined) {
      request.dryRun = true;
    }

    return callServer(
      SERVER.dispatch,
      request
    );
  }

  function dryRun(operation, payload) {
    return callServer(
      SERVER.dryRun,
      {
        operation: operation || '',
        payload: payload || {},
        dryRun: true
      }
    );
  }

  function auditLog(payload) {
    return callServer(
      SERVER.auditLog,
      {
        payload: payload || {},
        dryRun: true
      }
    );
  }

  function startStudySession(payload) {
    return callServer(
      SERVER.startStudySession,
      {
        payload: payload || {},
        dryRun: true
      }
    );
  }

  function finishStudySession(payload) {
    return callServer(
      SERVER.finishStudySession,
      {
        payload: payload || {},
        dryRun: true
      }
    );
  }

  function upsertLessonProgress(payload) {
    return callServer(
      SERVER.upsertLessonProgress,
      {
        payload: payload || {},
        dryRun: true
      }
    );
  }

  function updateAssignmentStatus(payload) {
    return callServer(
      SERVER.updateAssignmentStatus,
      {
        payload: payload || {},
        dryRun: true
      }
    );
  }

  function upsertDailyGoal(payload) {
    return callServer(
      SERVER.upsertDailyGoal,
      {
        payload: payload || {},
        dryRun: true
      }
    );
  }

  return {
    callServer: callServer,
    unwrap: unwrap,
    getStatus: getStatus,
    getSampleContext: getSampleContext,
    dispatch: dispatch,
    dryRun: dryRun,
    auditLog: auditLog,
    startStudySession: startStudySession,
    finishStudySession: finishStudySession,
    upsertLessonProgress: upsertLessonProgress,
    updateAssignmentStatus: updateAssignmentStatus,
    upsertDailyGoal: upsertDailyGoal
  };
})();
</script>

            childId: context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID',
            subjectId: context.subjectId || '',
            lessonId: context.lessonId || 'DRY_RUN_LESSON_ID'
          }),
          'START_STUDY_SESSION dry-run thành công.'
        );
      }

      function testLessonProgress() {
        var context =
          ensureContext();

        setStatus(
          'Đang dry-run UPSERT_LESSON_PROGRESS...',
          ''
        );

        return runTest(
          KidlearnV3WriteService.upsertLessonProgress({
            childId: context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID',
            subjectId: context.subjectId || '',
            lessonId: context.lessonId || 'DRY_RUN_LESSON_ID',
            status: 'IN_PROGRESS',
            progressPercent: 25
          }),
          'UPSERT_LESSON_PROGRESS dry-run thành công.'
        );
      }

      function testDailyGoal() {
        var context =
          ensureContext();

        setStatus(
          'Đang dry-run UPSERT_DAILY_GOAL...',
          ''
        );

        return runTest(
          KidlearnV3WriteService.upsertDailyGoal({
            childId: context.childId || 'DRY_RUN_CHILD_ID',
            goalDate: today(),
            targetMinutes: 20,
            status: 'ACTIVE'
          }),
          'UPSERT_DAILY_GOAL dry-run thành công.'
        );
      }

      function testAssignmentStatus() {
        var context =
          ensureContext();

        if (!context.assignmentId) {
          setStatus(
            'Không có assignmentId mẫu. Test này được bỏ qua.',
            'warn'
          );

          setLastResult({
            success: false,
            skipped: true,
            message: 'Không có assignmentId mẫu.'
          });

          return Promise.resolve(null);
        }

        setStatus(
          'Đang dry-run UPDATE_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS...',
          ''
        );

        return runTest(
          KidlearnV3WriteService.updateAssignmentStatus({
            assignmentId: context.assignmentId,
            status: 'IN_PROGRESS',
            progressPercent: 10
          }),
          'UPDATE_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS dry-run thành công.'
        );
      }

      function runTest(promise, successMessage) {
        return promise
          .then(function(response) {
            state.lastResult =
              response;

            setLastResult(response);

            if (!response.success) {
              throw new Error(
                getErrorMessage(response)
              );
            }

            setStatus(
              successMessage,
              'good'
            );

            return response;
          })
          .catch(function(error) {
            setStatus(
              'Dry-run lỗi: ' +
              String(error.message || error),
              'bad'
            );

            throw error;
          });
      }

      function ensureContext() {
        if (!state.sampleContext) {
          state.sampleContext = {};
        }

        return state.sampleContext;
      }

      function setStatus(message, type) {
        var element =
          document.getElementById('status');

        element.className =
          'status ' + (type || '');

        element.textContent =
          message;
      }

      function setText(id, value) {
        var element =
          document.getElementById(id);

        if (element) {
          element.textContent =
            value;
        }
      }

      function setLastResult(value) {
        document.getElementById('lastResult').textContent =
          JSON.stringify(
            value,
            null,
            2
          );
      }

      function getErrorMessage(response) {
        if (
          response &&
          response.error &&
          response.error.message
        ) {
          return response.error.message;
        }

        return 'Không rõ lỗi.';
      }

      function today() {
        var date =
          new Date();

        var year =
          date.getFullYear();

        var month =
          String(date.getMonth() + 1)
            .padStart(2, '0');

        var day =
          String(date.getDate())
            .padStart(2, '0');

        return year + '-' + month + '-' + day;
      }

      return {
        init: init,
        loadStatus: loadStatus,
        loadSampleContext: loadSampleContext,
        testAuditLog: testAuditLog,
        testStartStudySession: testStartStudySession,
        testLessonProgress: testLessonProgress,
        testDailyGoal: testDailyGoal,
        testAssignmentStatus: testAssignmentStatus
      };
    })();

    document.addEventListener(
      'DOMContentLoaded',
      function() {
        KidlearnWriteTestV3.init();
      }
    );
  </script>
</body>
</html>

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - PREPARE LEGACY V2 SHEETS
 * Step: 3H.4
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * Bản này dùng exact sheet name.
 * Không nhầm Data_Users với DATA_Users.
 */


/**
 * Data_Scores là Sheet tùy chọn.
 */
function kidlearnV3_isOptionalLegacySheet_(
  sourceName
) {
  return sourceName === 'Data_Scores';
}


/**
 * Xem trước trạng thái đổi tên Sheet V2.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewLegacyRename() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  var spreadsheet =
    context.spreadsheet;

  var plan =
    kidlearnV3_buildLegacyRenamePlan_(
      spreadsheet
    );

  var result = {
    success: true,

    environment:
      context.environment,

    spreadsheetName:
      context.spreadsheetName,

    totalCount:
      plan.length,

    readyCount:
      kidlearnV3_countLegacyPlanStatus_(
        plan,
        'READY'
      ),

    alreadyRenamedCount:
      kidlearnV3_countLegacyPlanStatus_(
        plan,
        'ALREADY_RENAMED'
      ),

    optionalMissingCount:
      kidlearnV3_countLegacyPlanStatus_(
        plan,
        'OPTIONAL_MISSING'
      ),

    missingCount:
      kidlearnV3_countLegacyPlanStatus_(
        plan,
        'MISSING'
      ),

    conflictCount:
      kidlearnV3_countLegacyPlanStatus_(
        plan,
        'CONFLICT'
      ),

    caseConflictCount:
      kidlearnV3_countLegacyPlanStatus_(
        plan,
        'CASE_CONFLICT'
      ),

    backup:
      kidlearnV3_getStoredBackupInfo_(),

    plan:
      plan
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Backup và đổi tên các Sheet V2 hiện có.
 */
function kidlearnV3_backupAndRenameLegacySheets() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewLegacyRename();

  kidlearnV3_assertLegacyPreviewReady_(
    preview
  );

  var completedCount =
    preview.alreadyRenamedCount +
    preview.optionalMissingCount;

  if (
    preview.readyCount === 0 &&
    completedCount === preview.totalCount
  ) {
    var noChangeResult = {
      success: true,
      action: 'NO_CHANGE',
      message:
        'Các Sheet V2 hiện có đã được đổi tên. ' +
        'Sheet tùy chọn không tồn tại.',
      backup: preview.backup,
      renamePreview: preview
    };

    console.log(
      JSON.stringify(
        noChangeResult,
        null,
        2
      )
    );

    return noChangeResult;
  }

  var backupResult =
    kidlearnV3_backupDatabaseV3();

  var renameResult =
    kidlearnV3_renameLegacySheets();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action:
      'BACKUP_AND_RENAME_COMPLETED',
    backup:
      backupResult,
    rename:
      renameResult
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Chỉ đổi tên Sheet V2.
 * Bắt buộc đã có backup hợp lệ.
 */
function kidlearnV3_renameLegacySheets() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  var backupInfo =
    kidlearnV3_assertValidBackup_();

  var spreadsheet =
    context.spreadsheet;

  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewLegacyRename();

  kidlearnV3_assertLegacyPreviewReady_(
    preview
  );

  var lock =
    LockService.getDocumentLock();

  var locked =
    lock.tryLock(
      KIDLEARN_V3.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS
    );

  if (!locked) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không lấy được document lock. ' +
      'Có thể tiến trình khác đang chạy.'
    );
  }

  try {
    var map =
      KIDLEARN_V2_LEGACY_SHEET_MAP;

    var sourceNames =
      Object.keys(map);

    var report = [];

    for (
      var i = 0;
      i < sourceNames.length;
      i++
    ) {
      var sourceName =
        sourceNames[i];

      var targetName =
        map[sourceName];

      var sourceSheet =
        kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
          spreadsheet,
          sourceName
        );

      var targetSheet =
        kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
          spreadsheet,
          targetName
        );

      if (
        sourceSheet &&
        targetSheet
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          'Xung đột: đồng thời tồn tại ' +
          sourceName +
          ' và ' +
          targetName +
          '.'
        );
      }

      if (
        !sourceSheet &&
        targetSheet
      ) {
        report.push({
          sourceName:
            sourceName,
          targetName:
            targetName,
          action:
            'ALREADY_RENAMED'
        });

        continue;
      }

      if (
        !sourceSheet &&
        !targetSheet
      ) {
        if (
          kidlearnV3_isOptionalLegacySheet_(
            sourceName
          )
        ) {
          report.push({
            sourceName:
              sourceName,
            targetName:
              targetName,
            action:
              'OPTIONAL_MISSING'
          });

          continue;
        }

        throw new Error(
          'Không tìm thấy Sheet nguồn hoặc Legacy: ' +
          sourceName
        );
      }

      sourceSheet.setName(
        targetName
      );

      report.push({
        sourceName:
          sourceName,
        targetName:
          targetName,
        action:
          'RENAMED'
      });
    }

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    kidlearnV3_verifyLegacyRename_(
      spreadsheet
    );

    kidlearnV3_setSetupStatus_(
      KIDLEARN_V3
        .SETUP_STATUS
        .LEGACY_RENAMED
    );

    var result = {
      success: true,

      setupStatus:
        KIDLEARN_V3
          .SETUP_STATUS
          .LEGACY_RENAMED,

      backupFileId:
        backupInfo.backupFileId,

      backupName:
        backupInfo.backupName,

      renamedCount:
        kidlearnV3_countLegacyReportAction_(
          report,
          'RENAMED'
        ),

      alreadyRenamedCount:
        kidlearnV3_countLegacyReportAction_(
          report,
          'ALREADY_RENAMED'
        ),

      optionalMissingCount:
        kidlearnV3_countLegacyReportAction_(
          report,
          'OPTIONAL_MISSING'
        ),

      totalProcessed:
        report.length,

      sheets:
        report
    };

    console.log(
      JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
    );

    return result;

  } catch (error) {
    kidlearnV3_setSetupStatus_(
      KIDLEARN_V3
        .SETUP_STATUS
        .FAILED
    );

    throw error;

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}


/**
 * Xây dựng kế hoạch đổi tên Sheet V2.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildLegacyRenamePlan_(
  spreadsheet
) {
  var map =
    KIDLEARN_V2_LEGACY_SHEET_MAP;

  var sourceNames =
    Object.keys(map);

  var plan = [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < sourceNames.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sourceName =
      sourceNames[i];

    var targetName =
      map[sourceName];

    var sourceSheet =
      kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        sourceName
      );

    var targetSheet =
      kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        targetName
      );

    var caseConflict =
      kidlearnV3_findLegacyCaseConflict_(
        spreadsheet,
        targetName
      );

    var item = {
      order:
        i + 1,

      sourceName:
        sourceName,

      targetName:
        targetName,

      sourceExists:
        sourceSheet !== null,

      targetExists:
        targetSheet !== null,

      optional:
        kidlearnV3_isOptionalLegacySheet_(
          sourceName
        ),

      status:
        '',

      message:
        ''
    };

    if (caseConflict) {
      item.status =
        'CASE_CONFLICT';

      item.message =
        'Có Sheet gần giống tên Legacy: ' +
        caseConflict.getName();

      plan.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (
      sourceSheet &&
      targetSheet
    ) {
      item.status =
        'CONFLICT';

      item.message =
        'Đồng thời tồn tại Sheet nguồn và Sheet Legacy.';

      plan.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (
      sourceSheet &&
      !targetSheet
    ) {
      item.status =
        'READY';

      item.message =
        'Sẵn sàng đổi tên.';

      plan.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (
      !sourceSheet &&
      targetSheet
    ) {
      item.status =
        'ALREADY_RENAMED';

      item.message =
        'Sheet đã được đổi tên trước đó.';

      plan.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    if (
      kidlearnV3_isOptionalLegacySheet_(
        sourceName
      )
    ) {
      item.status =
        'OPTIONAL_MISSING';

      item.message =
        'Sheet tùy chọn không tồn tại. ' +
        'Có thể tiếp tục quy trình.';

      plan.push(item);
      continue;
    }

    item.status =
      'MISSING';

    item.message =
      'Không tìm thấy Sheet nguồn hoặc Legacy.';

    plan.push(item);
  }

  return plan;
}


/**
 * Tìm xung đột tên Legacy nếu chỉ khác chữ hoa/thường.
 */
function kidlearnV3_findLegacyCaseConflict_(
  spreadsheet,
  targetName
) {
  var sheets =
    spreadsheet.getSheets();

  var lowerTarget =
    String(targetName).toLowerCase();

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < sheets.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var actualName =
      sheets[i].getName();

    if (
      actualName !== targetName &&
      actualName.toLowerCase() === lowerTarget
    ) {
      return sheets[i];
    }
  }

  return null;
}


/**
 * Dừng nếu preview có lỗi nghiêm trọng.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertLegacyPreviewReady_(
  preview
) {
  if (
    preview.conflictCount > 0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'DỪNG THỰC THI: Có Sheet nguồn và ' +
      'Sheet Legacy cùng tồn tại.'
    );
  }

  if (
    preview.caseConflictCount > 0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'DỪNG THỰC THI: Có xung đột tên Sheet ' +
      'không phân biệt chữ hoa thường.'
    );
  }

  if (
    preview.missingCount > 0
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'DỪNG THỰC THI: Có Sheet V2 bắt buộc bị thiếu.'
    );
  }

  return true;
}


/**
 * Xác nhận các Sheet V2 hiện có đã được đổi tên.
 */
function kidlearnV3_verifyLegacyRename_(
  spreadsheet
) {
  var map =
    KIDLEARN_V2_LEGACY_SHEET_MAP;

  var sourceNames =
    Object.keys(map);

  var errors = [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < sourceNames.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sourceName =
      sourceNames[i];

    var targetName =
      map[sourceName];

    var sourceSheet =
      kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        sourceName
      );

    var targetSheet =
      kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        targetName
      );

    if (sourceSheet) {
      errors.push(
        'Sheet nguồn vẫn còn: ' +
        sourceName
      );

      continue;
    }

    if (targetSheet) {
      continue;
    }

    if (
      kidlearnV3_isOptionalLegacySheet_(
        sourceName
      )
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    errors.push(
      'Thiếu Sheet Legacy bắt buộc: ' +
      targetName
    );
  }

  if (errors.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      'Kiểm tra Legacy thất bại: ' +
      errors.join(' | ')
    );
  }

  return true;
}


/**
 * Đếm trạng thái trong kế hoạch.
 */
function kidlearnV3_countLegacyPlanStatus_(
  plan,
  status
) {
  var count = 0;

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < plan.length;
    i++
  ) {
    if (
      plan[i].status === status
    ) {
      count++;
    }
  }

  return count;
}


/**
 * Đếm hành động trong báo cáo.
 */
function kidlearnV3_countLegacyReportAction_(
  report,
  action
) {
  var count = 0;

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < report.length;
    i++
  ) {
    if (
      report[i].action === action
    ) {
      count++;
    }
  }

  return count;
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - DATABASE VALIDATION ENGINE
 * Step: 3H.6
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * Bản này dùng exact sheet name.
 * Không nhầm Data_Users với DATA_Users.
 */


/**
 * Kiểm tra 44 Sheet V3 đã tồn tại và header khớp schema.
 */
function kidlearnV3_validateCreatedSheets() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  var spreadsheet =
    context.spreadsheet;

  var schema =
    kidlearnV3_buildSchema_();

  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var items = [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sheetName =
      KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER[i];

    var definition =
      schema[sheetName];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetName
      );

    if (!definition) {
      errors.push(
        sheetName + ': thiếu schema.'
      );

      items.push({
        order: i + 1,
        sheetName: sheetName,
        status: 'SCHEMA_MISSING'
      });

      continue;
    }

    if (!sheet) {
      errors.push(
        sheetName +
        ': chưa có Sheet trong Google Sheet.'
      );

      items.push({
        order: i + 1,
        sheetName: sheetName,
        status: 'SHEET_MISSING'
      });

      continue;
    }

    var check =
      kidlearnV3_checkSheetHeaders_(
        sheet,
        definition
      );

    if (
      check.errorCount > 0
    ) {
      errors =
        errors.concat(check.errors);
    }

    if (
      check.warningCount > 0
    ) {
      warnings =
        warnings.concat(check.warnings);
    }

    items.push({
      order: i + 1,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      status:
        check.errorCount === 0
          ? 'MATCH'
          : 'HEADER_ERROR',
      columnCount:
        definition.columns.length,
      maxColumns:
        sheet.getMaxColumns(),
      maxRows:
        sheet.getMaxRows()
    });
  }

  kidlearnV3_checkLegacySourceSheetsGone_(
    spreadsheet,
    errors,
    warnings
  );

  var result = {
    success:
      errors.length === 0,

    environment:
      context.environment,

    spreadsheetName:
      context.spreadsheetName,

    schemaVersion:
      KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,

    targetSheetCount:
      KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.length,

    checkedSheetCount:
      items.length,

    errorCount:
      errors.length,

    warningCount:
      warnings.length,

    errors:
      errors,

    warnings:
      warnings,

    items:
      items
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Kiểm tra 44 Sheet V3 chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      errors.length +
      '. Xem Execution log.'
    );
  }

  return result;
}
