/**
 * Preview kế hoạch tạo data validation.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewDataValidationPlan() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  var spreadsheet =
    context.spreadsheet;

  var schema =
    kidlearnV3_buildSchema_();

  var plan = [];
  var totalRuleCount = 0;

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sheetName =
      KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER[i];

    var definition =
      schema[sheetName];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetName
      );

    if (
      !definition ||
      !sheet
    ) {
      plan.push({
        order: i + 1,
        sheetName: sheetName,
        status: 'SKIPPED',
        ruleCount: 0
      });

      continue;
    }

    var rules =
      kidlearnV3_buildValidationPlanForSheet_(
        spreadsheet,
        schema,
        definition
      );

    totalRuleCount +=
      rules.length;

    plan.push({
      order: i + 1,
      sheetName: sheetName,
      status: 'READY',
      ruleCount: rules.length,
      rules: rules
    });
  }

  var result = {
    success: true,
    environment: context.environment,
    spreadsheetName: context.spreadsheetName,
    sheetCount: plan.length,
    totalRuleCount: totalRuleCount,
    plan: plan
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Apply data validation cho 44 Sheet V3.
 */
function kidlearnV3_applyDataValidationAllSheets() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  kidlearnV3_validateCreatedSheets();

  var lock =
    LockService.getDocumentLock();

  var locked =
    lock.tryLock(
      KIDLEARN_V3.LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS
    );

  if (!locked) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không lấy được document lock. ' +
      'Có thể tiến trình khác đang chạy.'
    );
  }

  try {
    var spreadsheet =
      context.spreadsheet;

    var schema =
      kidlearnV3_buildSchema_();

    var enums =
      kidlearnV3_buildEnums_();

    var report = [];
    var totalApplied = 0;
    var totalSkipped = 0;

    for (
      var i = 0;
      i < KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.length;
      i++
    ) {
      var sheetName =
        KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER[i];

      var definition =
        schema[sheetName];

      var sheet =
        kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
          spreadsheet,
          sheetName
        );

      if (
        !definition ||
        !sheet
      ) {
        report.push({
          sheetName: sheetName,
          status: 'SKIPPED',
          appliedCount: 0,
          skippedCount: 1
        });

        totalSkipped++;
        continue;
      }

      var result =
        kidlearnV3_applyValidationToSheet_(
          spreadsheet,
          schema,
          enums,
          sheet,
          definition
        );

      totalApplied +=
        result.appliedCount;

      totalSkipped +=
        result.skippedCount;

      report.push(result);
    }

    SpreadsheetApp.flush();

    kidlearnV3_markValidationAppliedSafe_();

    var finalResult = {
      success: true,
      environment: context.environment,
      spreadsheetName: context.spreadsheetName,
      schemaVersion: KIDLEARN_V3.SCHEMA_VERSION,
      totalAppliedCount: totalApplied,
      totalSkippedCount: totalSkipped,
      sheets: report
    };

    console.log(
      JSON.stringify(finalResult, null, 2)
    );

    return finalResult;

  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}


/**
 * Xóa toàn bộ data validation ở vùng dữ liệu V3.
 * Không xóa dữ liệu.
 */
function kidlearnV3_clearDataValidationAllSheets() {
  var context =
    kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();

  var spreadsheet =
    context.spreadsheet;

  var schema =
    kidlearnV3_buildSchema_();

  var cleared = [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sheetName =
      KIDLEARN_V3_SHEET_ORDER[i];

    var definition =
      schema[sheetName];

    var sheet =
      kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        sheetName
      );

    if (
      !definition ||
      !sheet
    ) {
      continue;
    }

    var rowCount =
      sheet.getMaxRows() - 2;

    if (rowCount < 1) {
      continue;
    }

    sheet
      .getRange(
        3,
        1,
        rowCount,
        definition.columns.length
      )
      .clearDataValidations();

    cleared.push(sheetName);
  }

  SpreadsheetApp.flush();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    clearedCount: cleared.length,
    sheets: cleared
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra header của một Sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_checkSheetHeaders_(
  sheet,
  definition
) {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];
  var columnCount =
    definition.columns.length;

  var labels =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        1,
        1,
        1,
        columnCount
      )
      .getDisplayValues()[0];

  var keys =
    sheet
      .getRange(
        2,
        1,
        1,
        columnCount
      )
      .getDisplayValues()[0];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < columnCount;
    i++
  ) {
    var column =
      definition.columns[i];

    var actualLabel =
      String(labels[i] || '').trim();

    var actualKey =
      String(keys[i] || '').trim();

    if (
      actualLabel !== column.labelVi
    ) {
      warnings.push(
        sheet.getName() +
        ': label dòng 1 khác schema tại cột ' +
        (i + 1) +
        '. Expected=' +
        column.labelVi +
        ', actual=' +
        actualLabel
      );
    }

    if (
      actualKey !== column.key
    ) {
      errors.push(
        sheet.getName() +
        ': key dòng 2 khác schema tại cột ' +
        (i + 1) +
        '. Expected=' +
        column.key +
        ', actual=' +
        actualKey
      );
    }
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    warningCount: warnings.length,
    errors: errors,
    warnings: warnings
  };
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra Sheet V2 nguồn không còn tồn tại.
 * Dùng exact name để không nhầm Data_Users với DATA_Users.
 */
function kidlearnV3_checkLegacySourceSheetsGone_(
  spreadsheet,
  errors,
  warnings
) {
  var map =
    KIDLEARN_V2_LEGACY_SHEET_MAP;

  var sourceNames =
    Object.keys(map);

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < sourceNames.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var sourceName =
      sourceNames[i];

    var sourceSheet =
      kidlearnV3_getSheetByExactName_(
        spreadsheet,
        sourceName
      );

    if (sourceSheet) {
      errors.push(
        'Sheet V2 nguồn vẫn còn tồn tại: ' +
        sourceName +
        '. Cần đổi tên sang ' +
        map[sourceName]
      );
    }
  }
}


/**
 * Lọc Sheet có lỗi debug.
 */
function kidlearnV3_filterDebugErrorItems_(
  items
) {
  var result = [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < items.length;
    i++
  ) {
    if (
      items[i].status !== 'MATCH'
    ) {
      result.push(
        items[i]
      );
    }
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Đánh dấu validation đã apply.
 */
function kidlearnV3_markValidationAppliedSafe_() {
  try {
    kidlearnV3_setSetupStatus_(
      'VALIDATION_APPLIED'
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn(
      'Không cập nhật được setup status VALIDATION_APPLIED: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }
}

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - DATA VALIDATION RULE HELPERS
 * Step: 3H.6
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * File này chứa helper tạo rule validation.
 */


/**
 * Tạo plan rule validation cho một Sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildValidationPlanForSheet_(
  spreadsheet,
  schema,
  definition
) {
  var rules = [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < definition.columns.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var column = definition.columns[i];

    var ruleType =
      kidlearnV3_getValidationRuleType_(
        column
      );

    if (!ruleType) {
      continue;
    }

    rules.push({
      columnIndex: i + 1,
      key: column.key,
      labelVi: column.labelVi,
      type: column.type,
      ruleType: ruleType
    });
  }

  return rules;
}


/**
 * Apply validation cho một Sheet.
 */
function kidlearnV3_applyValidationToSheet_(
  spreadsheet,
  schema,
  enums,
  sheet,
  definition
) {
  var applied = [];
  var skipped = [];

  var rowCount =
    sheet.getMaxRows() - 2;

  if (rowCount < 1) {
    return {
      sheetName: sheet.getName(),
      status: 'NO_DATA_ROWS',
      appliedCount: 0,
      skippedCount: 0,
      applied: [],
      skipped: []
    };
  }

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < definition.columns.length;
    i++
  ) {
    var column = definition.columns[i];

    var range =
      sheet.getRange(
        3,
        i + 1,
        rowCount,
        1
      );

    var buildResult =
      kidlearnV3_buildDataValidationRule_(
        spreadsheet,
        schema,
        enums,
        column
      );

    if (!buildResult.rule) {
      skipped.push({
        key: column.key,
        reason: buildResult.reason
      });

      continue;
    }

    range.setDataValidation(
      buildResult.rule
    );

    applied.push({
      key: column.key,
      ruleType: buildResult.ruleType
    });
  }

  return {
    sheetName: sheet.getName(),
    status: 'DONE',
    appliedCount: applied.length,
    skippedCount: skipped.length,
    applied: applied,
    skipped: skipped
  };
}


/**
 * Xác định loại rule dự kiến.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getValidationRuleType_(
  column
) {
  var T = KIDLEARN_V3_DATA_TYPES;

  if (column.type === T.ENUM) {
    return 'ENUM_DROPDOWN';
  }

  if (column.type === T.BOOLEAN) {
    return 'CHECKBOX';
  }

  if (column.type === T.NUMBER) {
    return 'NUMBER';
  }

  if (column.type === T.DATE) {
    return 'DATE';
  }

  if (column.type === T.DATETIME) {
    return 'DATETIME';
  }

  if (column.type === T.URL) {
    return 'URL';
  }

  if (
    column.validation &&
    column.validation.targetSheet
  ) {
    return 'REFERENCE_DROPDOWN';
  }

  return '';
}


/**
 * Tạo DataValidation rule cho một cột.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildDataValidationRule_(
  spreadsheet,
  schema,
  enums,
  column
) {
  var T = KIDLEARN_V3_DATA_TYPES;

  if (column.type === T.ENUM) {
    return kidlearnV3_buildEnumRule_(
      enums,
      column
    );
  }

  if (column.type === T.BOOLEAN) {
    return kidlearnV3_buildCheckboxRule_(
      column
    );
  }

  if (column.type === T.NUMBER) {
    return kidlearnV3_buildNumberRule_(
      column
    );
  }

  if (column.type === T.DATE) {
    return kidlearnV3_buildDateRule_(
      column,
      'DATE'
    );
  }

  if (column.type === T.DATETIME) {
    return kidlearnV3_buildDateRule_(
      column,
      'DATETIME'
    );
  }

  if (column.type === T.URL) {
    return kidlearnV3_buildUrlRule_(
      column
    );
  }

  if (
    column.validation &&
    column.validation.targetSheet
  ) {
    return kidlearnV3_buildReferenceRule_(
      spreadsheet,
      schema,
      column
    );
  }

  return {
    rule: null,
    ruleType: '',
    reason: 'NO_RULE'
  };
}


/**
 * Dropdown ENUM.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildEnumRule_(
  enums,
  column
) {
  if (
    !column.validation ||
    !column.validation.enumKey
  ) {
    return {
      rule: null,
      ruleType: 'ENUM_DROPDOWN',
      reason: 'ENUM_KEY_MISSING'
    };
  }

  var enumKey =
    column.validation.enumKey;

  var values =
    enums[enumKey];

  if (!values || values.length === 0) {
    return {
      rule: null,
      ruleType: 'ENUM_DROPDOWN',
      reason:
        'ENUM_VALUES_MISSING: ' +
        enumKey
    };
  }

  var rule =
    SpreadsheetApp
      .newDataValidation()
      .requireValueInList(values, true)
      .setAllowInvalid(false)
      .setHelpText(
        'Chọn một giá trị trong enum: ' +
        enumKey
      )
      .build();

  return {
    rule: rule,
    ruleType: 'ENUM_DROPDOWN',
    reason: ''
  };
}


/**
 * Checkbox BOOLEAN.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildCheckboxRule_(
  column
) {
  var rule =
    SpreadsheetApp
      .newDataValidation()
      .requireCheckbox()
      .setAllowInvalid(false)
      .setHelpText(
        'Chỉ nhận TRUE hoặc FALSE.'
      )
      .build();

  return {
    rule: rule,
    ruleType: 'CHECKBOX',
    reason: ''
  };
}


/**
 * Number validation.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildNumberRule_(
  column
) {
  var validation =
    column.validation;

  if (
    validation &&
    typeof validation.min === 'number' &&
    typeof validation.max === 'number'
  ) {
    var rule =
      SpreadsheetApp
        .newDataValidation()
        .requireNumberBetween(
          validation.min,
          validation.max
        )
        .setAllowInvalid(false)
        .setHelpText(
          'Nhập số từ ' +
          validation.min +
          ' đến ' +
          validation.max +
          '.'
        )
        .build();

    return {
      rule: rule,
      ruleType: 'NUMBER_RANGE',
      reason: ''
    };
  }

  var numberRule =
    SpreadsheetApp
      .newDataValidation()
      .requireNumberGreaterThanOrEqualTo(0)
      .setAllowInvalid(true)
      .setHelpText(
        'Nên nhập giá trị dạng số.'
      )
      .build();

  return {
    rule: numberRule,
    ruleType: 'NUMBER_SOFT',
    reason: ''
  };
}


/**
 * Date hoặc DateTime validation.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildDateRule_(
  column,
  ruleType
) {
  var rule =
    SpreadsheetApp
      .newDataValidation()
      .requireDate()
      .setAllowInvalid(true)
      .setHelpText(
        'Nhập giá trị ngày hoặc ngày giờ hợp lệ.'
      )
      .build();

  return {
    rule: rule,
    ruleType: ruleType,
    reason: ''
  };
}


/**
 * URL validation.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildUrlRule_(
  column
) {
  var rule =
    SpreadsheetApp
      .newDataValidation()
      .requireTextIsUrl()
      .setAllowInvalid(true)
      .setHelpText(
        'Nhập URL hợp lệ.'
      )
      .build();

  return {
    rule: rule,
    ruleType: 'URL',
    reason: ''
  };
}


/**
 * Dropdown tham chiếu sang Sheet khác.
 */
function kidlearnV3_buildReferenceRule_(
  spreadsheet,
  schema,
  column
) {
  var validation =
    column.validation;

  if (
    !validation ||
    !validation.targetSheet ||
    !validation.targetKey
  ) {
    return {
      rule: null,
      ruleType: 'REFERENCE_DROPDOWN',
      reason: 'REFERENCE_CONFIG_MISSING'
    };
  }

  var targetDefinition =
    schema[validation.targetSheet];

  if (!targetDefinition) {
    return {
      rule: null,
      ruleType: 'REFERENCE_DROPDOWN',
      reason:
        'TARGET_SCHEMA_MISSING: ' +
        validation.targetSheet
    };
  }

  var targetSheet =
    spreadsheet.getSheetByName(
      validation.targetSheet
    );

  if (!targetSheet) {
    return {
      rule: null,
      ruleType: 'REFERENCE_DROPDOWN',
      reason:
        'TARGET_SHEET_MISSING: ' +
        validation.targetSheet
    };
  }

  var targetColumnIndex =
    kidlearnV3_findColumnIndexByKeyForValidation_(
      targetDefinition,
      validation.targetKey
    );

  if (targetColumnIndex < 1) {
    return {
      rule: null,
      ruleType: 'REFERENCE_DROPDOWN',
      reason:
        'TARGET_KEY_MISSING: ' +
        validation.targetSheet +
        '.' +
        validation.targetKey
    };
  }

  var targetRowCount =
    targetSheet.getMaxRows() - 2;

  if (targetRowCount < 1) {
    return {
      rule: null,
      ruleType: 'REFERENCE_DROPDOWN',
      reason: 'TARGET_RANGE_EMPTY'
    };
  }

  var targetRange =
    targetSheet.getRange(
      3,
      targetColumnIndex,
      targetRowCount,
      1
    );

  var rule =
    SpreadsheetApp
      .newDataValidation()
      .requireValueInRange(
        targetRange,
        true
      )
      .setAllowInvalid(true)
      .setHelpText(
        'Nên chọn ID từ ' +
        validation.targetSheet +
        '.' +
        validation.targetKey
      )
      .build();

  return {
    rule: rule,
    ruleType: 'REFERENCE_DROPDOWN',
    reason: ''
  };
}


/**
 * Tìm số thứ tự cột theo technical key.
 */
function kidlearnV3_findColumnIndexByKeyForValidation_(
  definition,
  key
) {
  var columns =
    definition.columns || [];

  for (
    var i = 0;
    i < columns.length;
    i++
  ) {
    if (columns[i].key === key) {
      return i + 1;
    }
  }

  return 0;
}

<!-- 
  File: View_Gradebook.html
  Mô tả: Giao diện chi tiết Bảng điểm học tập theo thiết kế UI Mockup 00

<div class="flex flex-col gap-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto w-full h-full pb-10">
  
  <!-- Header Phần Bảng Điểm -->
  <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
    <div>
      <p class="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">Bảng điểm</p>
      <h1 class="text-3xl font-extrabold text-slate-800 tracking-tight">Kết quả học tập</h1>
    </div>
    <div class="flex gap-4">
      <button class="flex items-center gap-2 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold hover:bg-indigo-100 transition-colors border border-indigo-100 shadow-sm">
        <span class="text-lg">📥</span> Xuất bảng điểm
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Vùng Bộ Lọc (Filters) -->
  <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-center bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
      <label class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600">Học kỳ:</label>
      <select id="gb-filter-semester" class="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-slate-800 text-sm rounded-lg focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 block p-2 font-medium outline-none">
        <option value="Học kỳ I">Học kỳ I</option>
        <option value="Học kỳ II" selected>Học kỳ II</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 ml-4">
      <label class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600">Năm học:</label>
      <select id="gb-filter-year" class="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-slate-800 text-sm rounded-lg focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 block p-2 font-medium outline-none">
        <option value="2023 - 2024">2023 - 2024</option>
        <option value="2024 - 2025" selected>2024 - 2025</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 ml-4">
      <label class="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600">Lớp:</label>
      <select class="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-slate-800 text-sm rounded-lg focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 block p-2 font-medium outline-none">
        <option value="Lớp 2A" selected>Lớp 2A</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <button onclick="GradebookController.fetchData()" class="ml-auto bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white p-2 rounded-lg font-bold shadow transition-colors flex items-center justify-center w-10 h-10">
      <span class="text-sm">🔄</span>
    </button>
  </div>

  <!-- Lưới Nội Dung (Grid Layout) 70/30 -->
  <div class="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-6 items-start">
    
    <!-- CỘT TRÁI: Bảng Điểm Chi Tiết (Chiếm 2 phần) -->
    <div class="xl:col-span-2 bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden flex flex-col">
      <div class="overflow-x-auto">
        <table class="w-full text-left border-collapse">
          <thead>
            <tr class="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-center">
              <th class="p-4 w-12">STT</th>
              <th class="p-4 text-left">Tên môn học</th>
              <th class="p-4">Điểm quá trình<br><span class="text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-400">(40%) ℹ️</span></th>
              <th class="p-4">Điểm kiểm tra<br><span class="text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-400">(20%) ℹ️</span></th>
              <th class="p-4">Điểm thi<br><span class="text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-400">(40%) ℹ️</span></th>
              <th class="p-4 border-l border-slate-100 bg-slate-100/50">Điểm tổng kết<br><span class="text-[10px] font-medium text-slate-400">(100%)</span></th>
              <th class="p-4">Đánh giá / Nhận xét</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody id="gb-table-body" class="divide-y divide-slate-100">
            <!-- Dòng Loading Mặc Định -->
            <tr>
              <td colspan="7" class="p-12 text-center">
                <div class="loader-spinner !border-indigo-500 mb-3"></div>
                <p class="text-slate-500 font-medium text-sm">Đang tải bảng điểm...</p>
              </td>
            </tr>
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      
      <!-- Footer Bảng Điểm (Trung bình chung) -->
      <div class="mt-auto bg-slate-50/80 p-5 border-t border-slate-200 flex justify-between items-center px-8">
        <span class="text-lg font-bold text-slate-700">Điểm trung bình học kỳ</span>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-6">
          <span class="text-3xl font-extrabold text-green-600" id="gb-avg-score">--</span>
          <div class="bg-green-100 text-green-700 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full font-bold text-sm border border-green-200 flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm">
            Học lực: <span id="gb-avg-grade">--</span> <span>⭐</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- CỘT PHẢI: Các Widget Thống Kê (Chiếm 1 phần) -->
    <div class="xl:col-span-1 flex flex-col gap-6">
      
      <!-- Widget 1: Biểu đồ Tổng Quan Học Kỳ -->
      <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-6 relative overflow-hidden">
        <h3 class="font-bold text-slate-800 mb-4 text-base">Tổng quan học kỳ</h3>
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div class="relative w-32 h-32">
            <canvas id="gb-pie-chart"></canvas>
            <!-- Label Điểm TB nằm giữa biểu đồ Donut -->
            <div class="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
              <span class="text-2xl font-extrabold text-slate-800" id="gb-pie-avg">--</span>
              <span class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-medium">Điểm TB</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <!-- Legend Tự tạo -->
          <ul class="text-xs space-y-2 font-medium text-slate-600" id="gb-pie-legend">
             <!-- Render qua JS -->
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Widget 2: Nhận xét chung -->
      <div class="bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50 to-blue-50 rounded-3xl border border-indigo-100 shadow-sm p-6">
        <h3 class="font-bold text-slate-800 mb-4 text-base">Nhận xét chung</h3>
        <div class="flex gap-4 items-start">
          <div class="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-white shadow-sm border border-indigo-100 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
             <span class="text-3xl">🏅</span>
          </div>
          <p class="text-sm text-slate-700 leading-relaxed font-medium">
            Minh Anh có tinh thần học tập nghiêm túc, chăm chỉ và luôn hoàn thành tốt các bài tập. Cần tiếp tục phát huy khả năng tư duy và đọc hiểu.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div class="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-indigo-100/50 text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-600">
          GVCN: Trần Thị Hoa
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Widget 3: Biểu đồ Tiến Bộ -->
      <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-6">
        <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
          <h3 class="font-bold text-slate-800 text-base">So sánh tiến bộ</h3>
          <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 px-2 py-1 rounded">Điểm TB</span>
        </div>
        <div class="w-full h-32 relative">
          <canvas id="gb-line-chart"></canvas>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
  
  <!-- Chú thích Thang điểm -->
  <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-6 items-center justify-center bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm mt-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-600">
    <span class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-purple-500"></span> 9.0 - 10: Xuất sắc</span>
    <span class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-green-500"></span> 7.0 - 8.9: Tốt</span>
    <span class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-blue-500"></span> 5.0 - 6.9: Khá</span>
    <span class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-yellow-400"></span> 3.5 - 4.9: Đạt</span>
    <span class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-red-500"></span> < 3.5: Chưa đạt</span>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- 
  File: View_Header.html
  Mô tả: Component Header (Thanh trên cùng) của ứng dụng.

-->
<div class="flex items-center justify-between w-full h-full">
  
  <!-- Nút Menu Mobile (Chỉ hiện trên màn hình nhỏ) -->
  <div class="md:hidden flex items-center">
    <button class="p-2 text-slate-500 hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-50">
      <i class="ph ph-list text-2xl"></i>
    </button>

  <!-- Vùng Trống / Thanh Tìm kiếm (Tùy chọn) -->
  <div class="hidden md:flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-400 font-sans text-sm w-1/3">
     <!-- Nếu cần thiết, có thể thêm ô tìm kiếm ở đây. Hiện tại giữ thiết kế tối giản. -->
  </div>

  <!-- Nhóm Thống Kê & Người Dùng (Căn phải) -->
  <div class="flex items-center gap-3 sm:gap-5 ml-auto">
    
    <!-- Widget: Điểm thưởng -->
    <div class="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-2 bg-yellow-50 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-yellow-100 shadow-sm cursor-pointer hover:bg-yellow-100 transition-colors">
      <span class="text-xl drop-shadow-sm">⭐</span>
      <div class="flex flex-col justify-center">
        <span class="font-display font-extrabold text-yellow-700 leading-tight text-sm">860</span>
        <span class="text-[9px] font-sans font-semibold text-yellow-600 leading-none uppercase tracking-wide">Điểm thưởng</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Widget: Chuỗi ngày học (Streak) -->

      <span class="text-xl drop-shadow-sm">🔥</span>
      <div class="flex flex-col justify-center">
        <span class="font-display font-extrabold text-orange-700 leading-tight text-sm">7</span>
        <span class="text-[9px] font-sans font-semibold text-orange-600 leading-none uppercase tracking-wide">Ngày liên tiếp</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    
    <!-- Đường kẻ phân cách -->
    <div class="hidden sm:block w-px h-8 bg-slate-200 mx-1"></div>

    <!-- Nút Thông báo -->
    <button class="relative p-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors rounded-full hover:bg-indigo-50">
      <i class="ph ph-bell text-2xl"></i>
      <!-- Chấm đỏ thông báo chưa đọc -->
      <span class="absolute top-1 right-2 w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-red-500 rounded-full border-2 border-white shadow-sm"></span>

    <!-- Khối Thông tin Người dùng (User Profile) -->

      <!-- Tên & Lớp (Ẩn trên mobile nhỏ) -->
      <div class="text-right hidden md:block">
        <p class="font-display font-bold text-sm text-slate-700 group-hover:text-indigo-600 transition-colors">Nguyễn Minh Anh</p>

/**
 * ================================================================
 * KIDLEARN V3 - CONTROLLED WRITE ENABLEMENT FOR DEV
 * Step: 3J.6
 * Version: 3.1.0
 * ================================================================
 *
 * File này tạo cơ chế bật ghi thật có kiểm soát trong DEV.
 *
 * Chỉ cho phép bật khi:
 * - Phase 3I đã CLOSED_LOCKED
 * - 3J.5 đã READY_FOR_WRITE_REVIEW hoặc PASSED
 * - Safe Write Layer đang DRY_RUN
 * - Database mode là V3
 * - Môi trường là DEV
 * - Đã ARM trước khi ENABLE
 *
 * KHÔNG sửa PROD.
 * KHÔNG tự ghi dữ liệu học tập thật.
 */


var KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS = {
  STATUS: 'KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_STATUS',
  ARMED_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_ARMED_AT',
  ARMED_BY: 'KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_ARMED_BY',
  ARM_EXPIRES_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_ARM_EXPIRES_AT',
  ENABLED_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_ENABLED_AT',
  ENABLED_BY: 'KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_ENABLED_BY',
  DISABLED_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_DISABLED_AT',
  DISABLED_BY: 'KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_DISABLED_BY',
  DISABLE_REASON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_DISABLE_REASON',
  LAST_PREVIEW_AT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_LAST_PREVIEW_AT',
  LAST_RESULT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_LAST_RESULT_JSON',
  LAST_ENABLE_SNAPSHOT_JSON: 'KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_LAST_ENABLE_SNAPSHOT_JSON',
  ENABLE_COUNT: 'KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_ENABLE_COUNT'
};

var KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_STATUS = {
  DISABLED: 'DISABLED',
  ARMED: 'ARMED',
  ENABLED: 'ENABLED'
};

var KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_CONFIG = {
  VERSION: '3J.6',
  ARM_TTL_MINUTES: 15,
  NEXT_PHASE: '3J.7'
};


/**
 * Preview trước khi bật ghi thật có kiểm soát.
 */
function kidlearnV3_previewControlledWriteDevV3() {
  var errors = [];
  var warnings = [];

  var requiredFunctions = [
    'kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3',
    'kidlearnV3_assertDryRunNoDatabaseChangesV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getDryRunNoWriteChecklistStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getSafeWriteLayerStatusV3',
    'kidlearnV3_getAppDevConnectionV3Status',
    'kidlearnV3_servicePingV3'
  ];

  var functionChecks =
    kidlearnV3_controlWriteCheckFunctions_(
      requiredFunctions
    );

  errors =
    errors.concat(
      functionChecks.errors
    );

  var devCheck =
    kidlearnV3_controlWriteCheckDevEnvironment_();

  if (!devCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      devCheck.message
    );
  }

  var phase3I =
    kidlearnV3_controlWriteSafePhase3I_();

  if (!phase3I.success) {
    errors.push(
      'Phase 3I chưa CLOSED_LOCKED: ' +
      phase3I.message
    );
  }

  var dryRunCheck =
    kidlearnV3_controlWriteSafe3J5_();

  if (!dryRunCheck.success) {
    errors.push(
      '3J.5 chưa READY_FOR_WRITE_REVIEW: ' +
      dryRunCheck.message
    );
  }

  var connection =
    kidlearnV3_controlWriteSafeConnection_();

  if (
    connection.databaseMode !== 'V3' ||
    connection.connectionStatus !== 'CONNECTED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'App DEV chưa CONNECTED với Database V3.'
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_controlWriteSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode !== 'DRY_RUN' &&
    safeWrite.mode !== 'ENABLED'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write Layer phải ở DRY_RUN hoặc ENABLED. Mode hiện tại: ' +
      safeWrite.mode
    );
  }

  if (
    safeWrite.mode === 'ENABLED' &&
    safeWrite.enabled === true
  ) {
    warnings.push(
      'Safe Write Layer đang ENABLED. Không cần bật lại.'
    );
  }

  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'PREVIEW_CONTROLLED_WRITE_DEV_V3',
    phase: '3J.6',
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    canEnable:
      errors.length === 0,
    errorCount:
      errors.length,
    warningCount:
      warnings.length,
    errors:
      errors,
    warnings:
      warnings,
    devCheck:
      devCheck,
    phase3I:
      phase3I,
    dryRunCheck3J5:
      dryRunCheck,
    connection:
      connection,
    safeWriteStatus:
      safeWrite,
    controlledWriteStatus:
      status,
    functionChecks:
      functionChecks.items
  };

  PropertiesService
    .getScriptProperties()
    .setProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.LAST_PREVIEW_AT,
      new Date().toISOString()
    );

  kidlearnV3_controlWriteSaveResult_(
    result
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * ARM bước bật ghi thật.
 *
 * Sau khi ARM, chị có 15 phút để chạy enable.
 * Nếu quá hạn phải ARM lại.
 */
function kidlearnV3_armControlledWriteDevV3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewControlledWriteDevV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể ARM Controlled Write. Preview chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      preview.errorCount
    );
  }

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_controlWriteSafeWriteStatus_();

  if (
    safeWrite.mode === 'ENABLED' &&
    safeWrite.enabled === true
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      'Safe Write Layer đã ENABLED. Không cần ARM lại.'
    );
  }

  var now =
    new Date();

  var expiresAt =
    new Date(
      now.getTime() +
      KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_CONFIG.ARM_TTL_MINUTES *
      60 *
      1000
    );

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_STATUS.ARMED
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.ARMED_AT,
    now.toISOString()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.ARMED_BY,
    kidlearnV3_controlWriteGetUserEmail_()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.ARM_EXPIRES_AT,
    expiresAt.toISOString()
  );

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'ARM_CONTROLLED_WRITE_DEV_V3',
    phase: '3J.6',
    status: 'ARMED',
    armTtlMinutes:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_CONFIG.ARM_TTL_MINUTES,
    armedAt:
      now.toISOString(),
    armExpiresAt:
      expiresAt.toISOString(),
    message:
      'Controlled Write đã ARM. Chạy kidlearnV3_enableControlledWriteDevV3 trong thời hạn ARM.'
  };

  kidlearnV3_controlWriteSaveResult_(
    result
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Bật ghi thật có kiểm soát trong DEV.
 *
 * Hàm này chỉ set Safe Write Layer sang ENABLED.
 * Không tự ghi dữ liệu học tập.
 */
function kidlearnV3_enableControlledWriteDevV3() {
  var preview =
    kidlearnV3_previewControlledWriteDevV3();

  if (!preview.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể ENABLE Controlled Write. Preview chưa đạt. Errors: ' +
      preview.errorCount
    );
  }

  var arm =
    kidlearnV3_controlWriteCheckArm_();

  if (!arm.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Không thể ENABLE Controlled Write: ' +
      arm.message
    );
  }

  var now =
    new Date();

  var snapshot =
    kidlearnV3_controlWriteBuildEnableSnapshot_();

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_KEYS.MODE,
    KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_MODES.ENABLED
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_KEYS.ENABLED,
    'TRUE'
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_STATUS.ENABLED
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.ENABLED_AT,
    now.toISOString()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.ENABLED_BY,
    kidlearnV3_controlWriteGetUserEmail_()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.LAST_ENABLE_SNAPSHOT_JSON,
    JSON.stringify(snapshot)
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.ENABLE_COUNT,
    String(
      kidlearnV3_controlWriteGetEnableCount_() + 1
    )
  );

  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'ENABLE_CONTROLLED_WRITE_DEV_V3',
    phase: '3J.6',
    status: 'ENABLED',
    safeWriteMode: 'ENABLED',
    safeWriteEnabled: true,
    enabledAt: now.toISOString(),
    enabledBy:
      kidlearnV3_controlWriteGetUserEmail_(),
    nextPhase:
      KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_CONFIG.NEXT_PHASE,
    warning:
      'Ghi thật đã được bật ở DEV. Chỉ dùng các hàm write có confirmWrite token.',
    controlledWriteStatus:
      status
  };

  kidlearnV3_controlWriteSaveResult_(
    result
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Tắt ghi thật và đưa Safe Write Layer về DRY_RUN.
 */
function kidlearnV3_disableControlledWriteDevV3(request) {
  var safeRequest =
    kidlearnV3_controlWriteNormalizeRequest_(
      request
    );

  var reason =
    String(
      safeRequest.reason ||
      'MANUAL_DISABLE_TO_DRY_RUN'
    ).trim();

  var now =
    new Date();

  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_KEYS.MODE,
    KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_MODES.DRY_RUN
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_KEYS.ENABLED,
    'FALSE'
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.STATUS,
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_STATUS.DISABLED
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.DISABLED_AT,
    now.toISOString()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.DISABLED_BY,
    kidlearnV3_controlWriteGetUserEmail_()
  );

  properties.setProperty(
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.DISABLE_REASON,
    reason
  );

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'DISABLE_CONTROLLED_WRITE_DEV_V3',
    phase: '3J.6',
    status: 'DISABLED',
    safeWriteMode: 'DRY_RUN',
    safeWriteEnabled: false,
    disabledAt: now.toISOString(),
    reason: reason,
    message:
      'Controlled Write đã tắt. Safe Write Layer quay về DRY_RUN.'
  };

  kidlearnV3_controlWriteSaveResult_(
    result
  );

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Reset nhanh về DRY_RUN.
 */
function kidlearnV3_resetControlledWriteDevToDryRunV3() {
  return kidlearnV3_disableControlledWriteDevV3({
    reason: 'RESET_TO_DRY_RUN'
  });
}


/**
 * Xem trạng thái Controlled Write DEV.
 */
function kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var safeWrite =
    kidlearnV3_controlWriteSafeWriteStatus_();

  var result = {
    success: true,
    action: 'GET_CONTROLLED_WRITE_DEV_STATUS_V3',
    phase: '3J.6',
    status:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.STATUS
      ) ||
      KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_STATUS.DISABLED,
    safeWriteMode:
      safeWrite.mode || '',
    safeWriteEnabled:
      safeWrite.enabled === true,
    armedAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.ARMED_AT
      ) ||
      '',
    armExpiresAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.ARM_EXPIRES_AT
      ) ||
      '',
    enabledAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.ENABLED_AT
      ) ||
      '',
    disabledAt:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.DISABLED_AT
      ) ||
      '',
    enabledBy:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.ENABLED_BY
      ) ||
      '',
    disabledBy:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.DISABLED_BY
      ) ||
      '',
    disableReason:
      properties.getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.DISABLE_REASON
      ) ||
      '',
    enableCount:
      kidlearnV3_controlWriteGetEnableCount_(),
    arm:
      kidlearnV3_controlWriteCheckArm_(),
    lastResult:
      kidlearnV3_controlWriteReadLastResult_()
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert Controlled Write đã bật.
 *
 * Dùng cho bước 3J.7.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertControlledWriteDevEnabledV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (status.status !== 'ENABLED') {
    errors.push(
      'Controlled Write status chưa ENABLED. Hiện tại: ' +
      status.status
    );
  }

  if (status.safeWriteMode !== 'ENABLED') {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write mode chưa ENABLED. Hiện tại: ' +
      status.safeWriteMode
    );
  }

  if (status.safeWriteEnabled !== true) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write enabled chưa bằng true.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_CONTROLLED_WRITE_DEV_ENABLED_V3',
    phase: '3J.6',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    status: status
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Controlled Write DEV chưa bật đúng điều kiện. Errors: ' +
      errors.length
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Assert Controlled Write đang tắt hoặc DRY_RUN.
 */
function kidlearnV3_assertControlledWriteDevDryRunV3() {
  var status =
    kidlearnV3_getControlledWriteDevStatusV3();

  var errors = [];

  if (status.safeWriteMode !== 'DRY_RUN') {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write mode phải là DRY_RUN. Hiện tại: ' +
      status.safeWriteMode
    );
  }

  if (status.safeWriteEnabled !== false) {
    errors.push(
      'Safe Write enabled phải là false.'
    );
  }

  var result = {
    success: errors.length === 0,
    action: 'ASSERT_CONTROLLED_WRITE_DEV_DRY_RUN_V3',
    phase: '3J.6',
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    status: status
  };

  console.log(
    JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)
  );

  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(
      'Controlled Write DEV chưa ở DRY_RUN. Errors: ' +
      errors.length
    );
  }

  return result;
}


/**
 * Kiểm tra ARM còn hiệu lực.
 */
function kidlearnV3_controlWriteCheckArm_() {
  var properties =
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();

  var status =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.STATUS
    ) ||
    KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_STATUS.DISABLED;

  var expiresText =
    properties.getProperty(
      KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.ARM_EXPIRES_AT
    ) ||
    '';

  if (status === 'ENABLED') {
    return {
      success: true,
      status: status,
      message: 'Already ENABLED.'
    };
  }

  if (status !== 'ARMED') {
    return {
      success: false,
      status: status,
      message:
        'Controlled Write chưa ARM. Hãy chạy kidlearnV3_armControlledWriteDevV3 trước.'
    };
  }

  if (!expiresText) {
    return {
      success: false,
      status: status,
      message:
        'Không có ARM expiry time.'
    };
  }

  var expiresAt =
    new Date(expiresText);

  var now =
    new Date();

  if (
    isNaN(expiresAt.getTime()) ||
    expiresAt.getTime() < now.getTime()
  ) {
    return {
      success: false,
      status: status,
      armExpiresAt: expiresText,
      message:
        'ARM đã hết hạn. Hãy chạy kidlearnV3_armControlledWriteDevV3 lại.'
    };
  }

  return {
    success: true,
    status: status,
    armExpiresAt: expiresText,
    message: 'ARM còn hiệu lực.'
  };
}


/**
 * Check DEV environment.
 */
function kidlearnV3_controlWriteCheckDevEnvironment_() {
  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_ === 'function'
    ) {
      kidlearnV3_assertDevEnvironment_();
    }

    var connection =
      kidlearnV3_controlWriteSafeConnection_();

    var spreadsheetName =
      String(connection.spreadsheetName || '');

    if (
      spreadsheetName &&
      spreadsheetName.toUpperCase().indexOf('DEV') === -1
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Database spreadsheet name không chứa DEV: ' +
          spreadsheetName
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'DEV environment OK.',
      spreadsheetName: spreadsheetName
    };

  } catch (error) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message:
        'DEV environment check failed: ' +
        String(error.message || error)
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Build snapshot lúc enable.
 */
function kidlearnV3_controlWriteBuildEnableSnapshot_() {
  var snapshot = {
    capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    safeWriteStatus:
      kidlearnV3_controlWriteSafeWriteStatus_(),
    dryRunChecklistStatus:
      kidlearnV3_controlWriteSafe3J5Status_(),
    connection:
      kidlearnV3_controlWriteSafeConnection_()
  };

  try {
    if (
      typeof kidlearnV3_dryRunSnapshotSheets_ === 'function' &&
      typeof KIDLEARN_V3_DRY_RUN_TARGET_SHEETS !== 'undefined'
    ) {
      snapshot.databaseSnapshot =
        kidlearnV3_dryRunSnapshotSheets_(
          KIDLEARN_V3_DRY_RUN_TARGET_SHEETS
        ).summary;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    snapshot.snapshotWarning =
      String(error.message || error);
  }

  return snapshot;
}


/**
 * Check required functions.
 */
function kidlearnV3_controlWriteCheckFunctions_(
  functionNames
) {
  var errors = [];
  var items = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < functionNames.length; i++) {
    var exists = false;

    try {
      exists =
        eval(
          'typeof ' +
          functionNames[i] +
          ' === "function"'
        );
    } catch (error) {
      exists = false;
    }

    items.push({
      name: functionNames[i],
      exists: exists
    });

    if (!exists) {
      errors.push(
        'Thiếu function: ' +
        functionNames[i]
      );
    }
  }

  if (
    typeof KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_KEYS === 'undefined'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_KEYS từ App_Safe_Write_V3.gs.'
    );
  }

  if (
    typeof KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_MODES === 'undefined'
  ) {
    errors.push(
      'Thiếu KIDLEARN_V3_SAFE_WRITE_MODES từ App_Safe_Write_V3.gs.'
    );
  }

  return {
    errorCount: errors.length,
    errors: errors,
    items: items
  };
}


/**
 * Safe Phase 3I.
 */
function kidlearnV3_controlWriteSafePhase3I_() {
  try {
    var result =
      kidlearnV3_assertPhase3IClosedFor3JV3();

    return {

    };

  } catch (error) {

      success: false,

}

function kidlearnV3_controlWriteSafe3J5_() {

      kidlearnV3_assertDryRunNoDatabaseChangesV3();

      success: result.success === true,

function kidlearnV3_controlWriteSafe3J5Status_() {

  } catch (error) {

function kidlearnV3_controlWriteSafeConnection_() {

      success: false,

      connectionStatus: '',

function kidlearnV3_controlWriteSafeWriteStatus_() {

    };

/**
 * Enable count.
 */
function kidlearnV3_controlWriteGetEnableCount_() {
  return Number(
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.ENABLE_COUNT
      ) ||
      0
  );
}


/**
 * Normalize request.
 */
function kidlearnV3_controlWriteNormalizeRequest_(
  request
) {
  if (!request) {
    return {};
  }

  if (typeof request !== 'object') {
    return {
      value: request
    };
  }

  return request;
}


/**
 * Save compact result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_controlWriteSaveResult_(
  result
) {
  try {
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .setProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON,
        JSON.stringify({
          success: result.success,
          action: result.action,
          phase: result.phase,
          status: result.status || '',
          safeWriteMode: result.safeWriteMode || '',
          at: new Date().toISOString(),
          errorCount: result.errorCount || 0,
          warningCount: result.warningCount || 0
        })
      );
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn(
      'Không lưu được Controlled Write result: ' +
      String(error.message || error)
    );
  }
}


/**
 * Read last result.
 */
function kidlearnV3_controlWriteReadLastResult_() {
  var text =
    PropertiesService
      .getScriptProperties()
      .getProperty(
        KIDLEARN_V3_CONTROLLED_WRITE_KEYS.LAST_RESULT_JSON
      );

  if (!text) {
    return null;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(text);
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      raw: text
    };
  }
}


/**
 * Current user email.
 */
function kidlearnV3_controlWriteGetUserEmail_() {
  try {
    return Session.getActiveUser().getEmail() || '';
  } catch (error) {
    return '';
  }
}
